b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Pao Kurirewu Bataruji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Pao Kurirewu Bataruji

b: Mare boe eimijera ure João Batista tugu baicorewuto. Ca Jesus mearudure nowu inoduji dukeje ure tugirimi Galiléia moto ka Nazaré ba kurirewu ka.
source: Mare boe eimijera ure João Batista tugu baicorewuto. Ca Jesus mearudure nowu inoduji dukeje ure tugirimi Galiléia moto ka Nazaré ba kurirewu ka.

b: Nono Jesus uture Nazaré ba kurirewu piji. Uture toro Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka. Nou Cafarnaum ba kurirewu mugure nowu pobo maerewu okwai. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia. Naftali moto kejere nowu Cafarnaum ba kurirewu mugure. Nou Cafarnaum ba kurirewu mugu puredure Zebulom moto ji jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus uture Nazaré ba kurirewu piji. Uture toro Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka. Nou Cafarnaum ba kurirewu mugure nowu pobo maerewu okwai. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia. Naftali moto kejere nowu Cafarnaum ba kurirewu mugure. Nou Cafarnaum ba kurirewu mugu puredure Zebulom moto ji jamedu.

b: Dukodire ia Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Isaías ure nowu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore:
source: Dukodire ia Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Isaías ure nowu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore:

b: – Nou iere Galiléia aino jiwu pobo maerewu okwai Zebulom moto mugure, Naftali moto mugure jamedu. Boe ekodumode nowu moto kajeje taregoduwo nowu pobo maerewu ka, taregoduwo Jordão Po ka jamedu. Boe tuginaiwuge emugure nowu moto keje jamedu. Nou boe emugu pemegakare. Emugure boeco tada. Emugure kejewu moto ure nono birewuge eda mogadure. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Nou boe eruduware tuwimoduie. Dujire inagoino. Eruduwakare tuwo tuginorudo nowu tuwi piji. Dujire inagoino. Mare aino erudure ia jorugu kurirewuji. Ure nono meri joku rutu mogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Meri joku rutu ji karega inagoino jamedu. Umode boe ekinorudowu jire inagoino. Boe eruduware umode boe ekinorudowuji. Dujire inagoino. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. Aino care Jesus aregodure. Dujire nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru akoino.
source: – Nou iere Galiléia aino jiwu pobo maerewu okwai Zebulom moto mugure, Naftali moto mugure jamedu. Boe ekodumode nowu moto kajeje taregoduwo nowu pobo maerewu ka, taregoduwo Jordão Po ka jamedu. Boe tuginaiwuge emugure nowu moto keje jamedu. Nou boe emugu pemegakare. Emugure boeco tada. Emugure kejewu moto ure nono birewuge eda mogadure. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Nou boe eruduware tuwimoduie. Dujire inagoino. Eruduwakare tuwo tuginorudo nowu tuwi piji. Dujire inagoino. Mare aino erudure ia jorugu kurirewuji. Ure nono meri joku rutu mogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Meri joku rutu ji karega inagoino jamedu. Umode boe ekinorudowu jire inagoino. Boe eruduware umode boe ekinorudowuji. Dujire inagoino. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. Aino care Jesus aregodure. Dujire nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru akoino.

b: Nou meri kejere Jesus makogodure boe ji. Makore tu tu je boe ewiagai tuwo boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Akore tagera ra taro pegarewu piji. Kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi rugadu.
source: Nou meri kejere Jesus makogodure boe ji. Makore tu tu je boe ewiagai tuwo boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Akore tagera ra taro pegarewu piji. Kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi rugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Nou Ture Joruduwadowuge Boetojiwuge Etae
source: Jesus Makore Nou Ture Joruduwadowuge Boetojiwuge Etae

b: Ia meri keje Jesus merure nowu Galiléia Po Maerewu okwaji. Nono jorudure Simãoji nono pobo okwai. Nou Simão iere Pedro jamedu. Jesus jorudure nowu Simão umanaji jamedu. Nou umana iere André. Nou ime pobedu doge ere tuwuge barigu poboto kare ewagai. Emaragodae reno.
source: Ia meri keje Jesus merure nowu Galiléia Po Maerewu okwaji. Nono jorudure Simãoji nono pobo okwai. Nou Simão iere Pedro jamedu. Jesus jorudure nowu Simão umanaji jamedu. Nou umana iere André. Nou ime pobedu doge ere tuwuge barigu poboto kare ewagai. Emaragodae reno.

b: Nono Jesus makore etae. Akore mato itabo. Imode tawogudo ime ewagai. Mare tawogu ji karega inagoino. Tamode boe emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino. Ainore Jesus akore.
source: Nono Jesus makore etae. Akore mato itabo. Imode tawogudo ime ewagai. Mare tawogu ji karega inagoino. Tamode boe emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino. Ainore Jesus akore.

b: Ca nowu ime pobedu doge ere tugera ra tuwuge piji taci je. Eture Jesus apo rugadu tumaragodae piji rugadu.
source: Ca nowu ime pobedu doge ere tugera ra tuwuge piji taci je. Eture Jesus apo rugadu tumaragodae piji rugadu.

b: Eture ji je dukeje erudure ia boe ji pugeje. Zebedeu ore imenure emage. Ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Nou uwie imedu iere João. Emugure tuo apo to ika kurirewu tada. Emaragodure tuwugeji tuwo tuwuge pemegado. Nono Jesus makore etae.
source: Eture ji je dukeje erudure ia boe ji pugeje. Zebedeu ore imenure emage. Ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Nou uwie imedu iere João. Emugure tuo apo to ika kurirewu tada. Emaragodure tuwugeji tuwo tuwuge pemegado. Nono Jesus makore etae.

b: Ca eture to ika kurirewu piji kuri je. Nono eture tuo piji tuduwo Jesus apo rugadu.
source: Ca eture to ika kurirewu piji kuri je. Nono eture tuo piji tuduwo Jesus apo rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Kogodurewuge Epemegago
source: Jesus Ure Kogodurewuge Epemegago

b: Nono Jesus kodure nowu Galiléia moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe eiamedu boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Ure turemo tu tu nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu to baito tuwo eruduwado nono. Ure ewie tu tu je Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino rugadu. Ure kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus kodure nowu Galiléia moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe eiamedu boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Ure turemo tu tu nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu to baito tuwo eruduwado nono. Ure ewie tu tu je Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino rugadu. Ure kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.

b: Nou Jesus akaru ure tumaedo Síria moto jamedu boe ka. Dukodire boe etaregodure Jesus bagai kogodurewuge eiamedu boebo. Iage etaora, emorora, ekana, epogora korire ei rugadu. Bope doge emedure iage etada. Iage epogora pegare emeru bokware. Iage ewi kigodure tu tu je tumagadu tabo. Jesus ure awu kogodurewuge eiamedu boe epemegago.
source: Nou Jesus akaru ure tumaedo Síria moto jamedu boe ka. Dukodire boe etaregodure Jesus bagai kogodurewuge eiamedu boebo. Iage etaora, emorora, ekana, epogora korire ei rugadu. Bope doge emedure iage etada. Iage epogora pegare emeru bokware. Iage ewi kigodure tu tu je tumagadu tabo. Jesus ure awu kogodurewuge eiamedu boe epemegago.

b: Boe emagare taregodu tabo Jesus ae tuduwo Jesus apo rugadu. Boe etaregodure Galiléia moto piji, Decápolis moto piji, Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji, Judéia moto piji. Nou torowu Jordão Po bakowu kejewuge boe ekurugodure nowu pobo kajeje mato Jesus ae tuduwo apo jamedu.
source: Boe emagare taregodu tabo Jesus ae tuduwo Jesus apo rugadu. Boe etaregodure Galiléia moto piji, Decápolis moto piji, Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji, Judéia moto piji. Nou torowu Jordão Po bakowu kejewuge boe ekurugodure nowu pobo kajeje mato Jesus ae tuduwo apo jamedu.

b: Jesus Ruture Tori Ao Ka Tuwo Boe Eruduwado
source: Jesus Ruture Tori Ao Ka Tuwo Boe Eruduwado

b: Jesus jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje ruture ia tori kurirewu ao ka. Nono ure tumugudo. Nou ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae jamedu.
source: Jesus jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje ruture ia tori kurirewu ao ka. Nono ure tumugudo. Nou ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae jamedu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei tuwo eruduwado. Akore
source: Nono Jesus makore ei tuwo eruduwado. Akore

b: Ia boe enojarokare pudui. Dukodire eragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo. Ere tugimijerado ema dukodire eragojemode apo rugadu boe pemegarewu keje. Dukodire egaremode pudui. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.
source: Ia boe enojarokare pudui. Dukodire eragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo. Ere tugimijerado ema dukodire eragojemode apo rugadu boe pemegarewu keje. Dukodire egaremode pudui. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.

b: Ia boe etragudure tugiarigodure dukodi. Mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu umode ewudugugo. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.
source: Ia boe etragudure tugiarigodure dukodi. Mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu umode ewudugugo. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.

b: Ia boe emaragodu pemegamode tugimijera ai mare ekorigodumodukare ji rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode tumagore jiboe maku nowu maragodu pemegarewuge etai rugadu. Dukodire egaremode pudui. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.
source: Ia boe emaragodu pemegamode tugimijera ai mare ekorigodumodukare ji rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode tumagore jiboe maku nowu maragodu pemegarewuge etai rugadu. Dukodire egaremode pudui. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.

b: Ia boe ere turagado pudui tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tuwo turo jetorodo. Ewiagorore tu turo pemegawo tu rugadu. Ewiapagakare iaboe ji iaboe ji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode turaga maku etai rugadu ewo turo jetorodo. Dukodire egaremode pudui. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.
source: Ia boe ere turagado pudui tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tuwo turo jetorodo. Ewiagorore tu turo pemegawo tu rugadu. Ewiapagakare iaboe ji iaboe ji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode turaga maku etai rugadu ewo turo jetorodo. Dukodire egaremode pudui. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu.

b: Ia boe enogudugodure boebo rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu okudugodumode ebo nowu ero jipagi. Dukodire boe pemegamode ei rugadu. Egaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Ia boe enogudugodure boebo rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu okudugodumode ebo nowu ero jipagi. Dukodire boe pemegamode ei rugadu. Egaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Ia boe emearudae pegarewu bokware. Emearudae pemegare. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu. Erudumode Pao Kurirewu ji tuioku tabo rugadu. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Ia boe emearudae pegarewu bokware. Emearudae pemegare. Boe pemegamode ei rugadu. Erudumode Pao Kurirewu ji tuioku tabo rugadu. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Ia boe erugodukare boe ji. Emago kigodure boe ji erugodukawo pui pugeje epemegawo pui rugadu. Boe pemegamode nowu boe ji. Pao Kurirewu umode toredo emage. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Ia boe erugodukare boe ji. Emago kigodure boe ji erugodukawo pui pugeje epemegawo pui rugadu. Boe pemegamode nowu boe ji. Pao Kurirewu umode toredo emage. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Ia boe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire ro pegarewuge emago pegare ei, ero pega kigodure ei. Mare du inodu tabo boe pemegamode nowu mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ji. Ere tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukodire eragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu boe pemegarewu keje. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Ia boe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire ro pegarewuge emago pegare ei, ero pega kigodure ei. Mare du inodu tabo boe pemegamode nowu mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ji. Ere tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukodire eragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu boe pemegarewu keje. Dukodire egaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Tamearutorumode imagore tai jiboe ji dukodire boe emago pegamode tarore jiboe ji boe emearutorukawo tai pugeje. Tagodumode iwadaru kodaji dukeje boe emago pegamode tai, ero pegamode tai, egomode taro pegaie tuwadrarodu tabo. Ainore ewobe emago pegare jamedu jaoboe ji. Mariguduwuge ewobe ero pegare nowu mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei jamedu. Mare tare tamearutorudo i dukodire emago pegare aino tai jamedu. Mare kocare tamearutorukaba egoino jiboe ji. Taegaredo tai. Mare paga karega. Pao Kurirewu umode mori kurido tagai toro baru tada. Dukodire care taegaregodumode tai rugadu.
source: Tamearutorumode imagore tai jiboe ji dukodire boe emago pegamode tarore jiboe ji boe emearutorukawo tai pugeje. Tagodumode iwadaru kodaji dukeje boe emago pegamode tai, ero pegamode tai, egomode taro pegaie tuwadrarodu tabo. Ainore ewobe emago pegare jamedu jaoboe ji. Mariguduwuge ewobe ero pegare nowu mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei jamedu. Mare tare tamearutorudo i dukodire emago pegare aino tai jamedu. Mare kocare tamearutorukaba egoino jiboe ji. Taegaredo tai. Mare paga karega. Pao Kurirewu umode mori kurido tagai toro baru tada. Dukodire care taegaregodumode tai rugadu.

b: Boe Ere Nono Sal Mogadure Ere Nono Jorugu Mogadure
source: Boe Ere Nono Sal Mogadure Ere Nono Jorugu Mogadure

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore tamearutorure i dukodire tare nono sal mogadure. Sal pemegare. Mare nowu sal pegomode dukeje nowu sal akedumode. Nono umodukare nono sal mogadure pugeje. Dukodire boe eromodukare iaboe ji nowu sal tabo pugeje. Emode barigu. Ewure jomode keje. Mare sal ji karega inagoino. Tamearutorure i. Dujire inagoino. Tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji. Nono mearutorukarewuge erudumode taro pemegarewuji. Nono etaidumode tumearutoruwo i jamedu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore tamearutorure i dukodire tare nono sal mogadure. Sal pemegare. Mare nowu sal pegomode dukeje nowu sal akedumode. Nono umodukare nono sal mogadure pugeje. Dukodire boe eromodukare iaboe ji nowu sal tabo pugeje. Emode barigu. Ewure jomode keje. Mare sal ji karega inagoino. Tamearutorure i. Dujire inagoino. Tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji. Nono mearutorukarewuge erudumode taro pemegarewuji. Nono etaidumode tumearutoruwo i jamedu. Dujire inagoino.

b: – Tamearutorure i dukodire tare nono jorugu mogadure. Boe emode jorugudo ia tori kurirewu ao keje dukeje boe eiamedu boe erudumode joruguji.
source: – Tamearutorure i dukodire tare nono jorugu mogadure. Boe emode jorugudo ia tori kurirewu ao keje dukeje boe eiamedu boe erudumode joruguji.

b: Boe emode pori bu jorugu aogeje dukeje urugumodukare. Mare boe emode jorugu bararedo, uruguwo pudui.
source: Boe emode pori bu jorugu aogeje dukeje urugumodukare. Mare boe emode jorugu bararedo, uruguwo pudui.

b: Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Tamearutorure i. Dujire inagoino. Tamodukare tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji dukeje boe erudumode taro pemegarewuji. Dujire inagoino. Boe erudumode taro pemegarewu ji dukeje emago pemegamode tamearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Dujire inagoino.
source: Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Tamearutorure i. Dujire inagoino. Tamodukare tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji dukeje boe erudumode taro pemegarewuji. Dujire inagoino. Boe erudumode taro pemegarewu ji dukeje emago pemegamode tamearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Dujire inagoino.

b: Moisés Ure Maku Judeu Doge Etaiwu Bakaru Reo
source: Moisés Ure Maku Judeu Doge Etaiwu Bakaru Reo

b: – Ia boe egore itaregoduie iwo Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru akedudo. Mare itaregodukare iwo nowu bakaru akedudo. Ia boe egore itaregoduie iwo makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore jiboe akedudo. Mare itaregodukare iwo nowu emagore jiboe akedudo. Itaregodure iwo Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru makore jiboe jetudo pudui. Itaregodure iwo nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore jiboe jetudo pudui.
source: – Ia boe egore itaregoduie iwo Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru akedudo. Mare itaregodukare iwo nowu bakaru akedudo. Ia boe egore itaregoduie iwo makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore jiboe akedudo. Mare itaregodukare iwo nowu emagore jiboe akedudo. Itaregodure iwo Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru makore jiboe jetudo pudui. Itaregodure iwo nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore jiboe jetudo pudui.

b: Moisés makore jiwu Pao Kurirewu o bakaru jetumode pudui rugadu. Nouia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore jiwu Pao Kurirewu o bakaru jetumode pudui rugadu. Nou Pao Kurirewu o bakaru tadawu ia batarurogu akedumodukare piji rugadu jii toro moto akedumode du ka, jii toro baru akedumode du ka. Nou makore jiboe jamedu boe jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino rugadu.
source: Moisés makore jiwu Pao Kurirewu o bakaru jetumode pudui rugadu. Nouia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore jiwu Pao Kurirewu o bakaru jetumode pudui rugadu. Nou Pao Kurirewu o bakaru tadawu ia batarurogu akedumodukare piji rugadu jii toro moto akedumode du ka, jii toro baru akedumode du ka. Nou makore jiboe jamedu boe jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino rugadu.

b: Ia boe emearutorumodukare awu Pao Kurirewu bakaru tadawu bataru roguji. Emode ia boe emearutoru bokwado nowu bataru roguji jamedu dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijerado pudumi dukeje mako pegamode ei. Akomode nowu roinowugei: – Itugarege joruduwakarewugenure tagi pemegakarewugenure tagi. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akomode ei. Umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ainore akomode ei rugadu. Mare ia boe emearutorumode awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji, emode boe eruduwado awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu mako pemegamode ei. Akomode ei eruduwaie epemegaie ekurie nowu tudugarege eiamedu boe ekori. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ainore akomode ei.
source: Ia boe emearutorumodukare awu Pao Kurirewu bakaru tadawu bataru roguji. Emode ia boe emearutoru bokwado nowu bataru roguji jamedu dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijerado pudumi dukeje mako pegamode ei. Akomode nowu roinowugei: – Itugarege joruduwakarewugenure tagi pemegakarewugenure tagi. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akomode ei. Umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ainore akomode ei rugadu. Mare ia boe emearutorumode awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji, emode boe eruduwado awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu mako pemegamode ei. Akomode ei eruduwaie epemegaie ekurie nowu tudugarege eiamedu boe ekori. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ainore akomode ei.

b: Iwo tawie. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi rugadu. Mare tamodukare taro jetorodo fariseu doge ero kori dukeje tagimijera umodukare Pao Kurirewuce. Tamodukare taro jetorodo nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ero kori dukeje tagimijera umodukare Pao Kurirewuce.
source: Iwo tawie. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi rugadu. Mare tamodukare taro jetorodo fariseu doge ero kori dukeje tagimijera umodukare Pao Kurirewuce. Tamodukare taro jetorodo nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ero kori dukeje tagimijera umodukare Pao Kurirewuce.

b: Boe Ekawo Boe Ewido
source: Boe Ekawo Boe Ewido

b: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore boe ji ekawo boe ewido. Taruduware nowu bataru ji marigudu. Pao Kurirewu akore boe emoduie boe ewido dukeje boe eimijerage emoduie boe pegado ei ero pegarewu morice.
source: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore boe ji ekawo boe ewido. Taruduware nowu bataru ji marigudu. Pao Kurirewu akore boe emoduie boe ewido dukeje boe eimijerage emoduie boe pegado ei ero pegarewu morice.

b: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Boe ekorigodumode timediaji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ei nono turo moga nowu ure boe ewidowu jitu mogadure. Ia pugeje. Ia boe akomode timediaji boe kaieguie ema dukeje nowu metia umode nowu akoino puduiwu reko Judeu doge ekimijerage etae ewo boe pegado ji nowu bataru pegarewu morice. Ainore tarore. Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Ia boe akomode timediaji joruduwa bokwaie rugadu dukeje boe pegamode ji rugadu. Umodukare togwa ra nowu tuwadaru pegarewu piji dukeje barigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto rugadu.
source: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Boe ekorigodumode timediaji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ei nono turo moga nowu ure boe ewidowu jitu mogadure. Ia pugeje. Ia boe akomode timediaji boe kaieguie ema dukeje nowu metia umode nowu akoino puduiwu reko Judeu doge ekimijerage etae ewo boe pegado ji nowu bataru pegarewu morice. Ainore tarore. Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Ia boe akomode timediaji joruduwa bokwaie rugadu dukeje boe pegamode ji rugadu. Umodukare togwa ra nowu tuwadaru pegarewu piji dukeje barigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto rugadu.

b: Dukodire imode tawie. Tagaregodumode Pao Kurirewu uwai ka ia tagoe tabo tawo maku Pao Kurirewu ai. Mare tagaregodu keje tawiabuture ia taro pegare tamedia jitu keje. Nou tamedia jorudu pemegakaie nowu taroino pudui duji.

b: Dukodire tamode nowu tagoe bu moto keje nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada taduwo kuri nowu tamedia bagai. Tarudumode nowu tamediaji dukeje tamago pemegado ji tagiarigoduie nowu taro pegarewuji, tamodukaie nowu taro towuje pugeje. Dutabore tamode tabemegado ji pugeje. Tabemegamode pui pugeje dukeje tamode tagirimi Pao Kurirewu uwai ka tawo nowu tagoe maku Pao Kurirewu ai rugadu.

Nou boe eimijera makomoduie tai tawo iaboe maku nowu boe etai taro pegarewu morice. Nou boe eimijera umoduie tamagu tugobaigarege etai. Umoduie tadugu baicorewuto. Ainore nowu korigodure taiwuge egomode. Paruduwakare boemode aino tai rugadu duji. Dukodire imode tawie. Ia boe ekorigodumode tai. Emagomode tai tumoduie tarego boe eimijera bagai aiwowo ia taro pegarewu bagai dukeje tamago pemegado ei tawo nowu boe ekorigoduredu barigu epiji. Taro pemegado ei ekorigodukawo tai pugeje kuri je.

b: Boe Eribarikawo Toreduje Piji Toredu Piji
source: Boe Eribarikawo Toreduje Piji Toredu Piji

b: – Marigudu taruduware bakaruji rugadu. Akore boe eribarikaiago toreduje piji toredu piji.
source: – Marigudu taruduware bakaruji rugadu. Akore boe eribarikaiago toreduje piji toredu piji.

b: Mare aino care imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Boe etaiwomode areduji tumearudae pegarewu tabo tuwo tugeragu nowu areduji. Dutabore emearudae ure nono boe ero moga tieribari tabo jitu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare nowu emearudae ji.
source: Mare aino care imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Boe etaiwomode areduji tumearudae pegarewu tabo tuwo tugeragu nowu areduji. Dutabore emearudae ure nono boe ero moga tieribari tabo jitu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare nowu emearudae ji.

b: Boe etaidukare tuioku bokwawo. Mare epagudure tuwariguduwo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto rugadu. Dukodire imode tawie. Taeku umode tamearudae pegado dukeje nowu taeku tawuje. Mare taeku remawu ji karega inagoino. Tagaidure jiwu tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino. Nou tamearudae pegarewu barigu tagaora piji rugadu tamearudaekawo nowu tamearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino.

Dujire inagoino.

b: Boe etaidukare tugera kadoduwo tugana piji. Mare epagudure tuwariguduwo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto rugadu. Dukodire imode tawie. Tagera umode taro pegado dukeje nowu tagera kado tagana piji rugadu. Mare tagera remawu ji karega inagoino. Tagaidure jiwu taro pegarewu jire inagoino. Nou taro pegarewu barigu tabiji rugadu tarokawo nowu taro pegarewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino.

b: Boe Ekawo Tugera Ra Toreduje Piji Toredu Piji
source: Boe Ekawo Tugera Ra Toreduje Piji Toredu Piji

b: – Marigudu Moisés ure taro maku tagai. Akore ia imedu umoduie tugera ra toreduje piji dukeje umoduie bapera atugodo tuwo maku toreduje ai tuwo toreduje bie tuie tugera ra piji duji. Umoduie tugie bu nowu bapera atugododurewu keje rugadu.
source: – Marigudu Moisés ure taro maku tagai. Akore ia imedu umoduie tugera ra toreduje piji dukeje umoduie bapera atugodo tuwo maku toreduje ai tuwo toreduje bie tuie tugera ra piji duji. Umoduie tugie bu nowu bapera atugododurewu keje rugadu.

b: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Imedu umode tugera ra toreduje piji mare mugumode ia aredu apo pugeje. Du pegare Pao Kurirewu jakai rugadu. Nou imedu ro peganure nowu toreduje boeto jiwudo piji rugadu. Ure tudo nono jeribarire toreduje pijiwu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai. Mare imedu oreduje jeribarimode nowu toredu piji dukeje nowu imedu aidumode tuwo tugera ra toreduje piji du pegakare. Mare imedu oreduje jeribarikare toredu piji mare nowu imedu umode tugera ra toreduje piji dukeje ro peganure nowu toredujeji rugadu. Turoino dutabo umode toreduje udo nono jeribarire toredu pijiwu aredu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai. Imedu jamedu mugukawo ia aredu ure tugera ra toredu pijiwudo apo. Mugumode apo dukeje umode tudo nono jeribarire toreduje pijiwu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai.

Mugumode apo dukeje umode tudo nono jeribarire toreduje pijiwu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai.

b: Boe Emode Tuwadaru Maku Du Reo
source: Boe Emode Tuwadaru Maku Du Reo

b: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore boe ji emagomoduie Pao Kurirewu ie tabo turomode jiboe ji dukeje ekawo tuwadaru pogurudo. Mare boe emagomoduie Pao Kurirewu ie tabo dukeje nowu emagore jiboe ewo towuje rugadu. Taruduware nowu bataru ji marigudu.
source: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore boe ji emagomoduie Pao Kurirewu ie tabo turomode jiboe ji dukeje ekawo tuwadaru pogurudo. Mare boe emagomoduie Pao Kurirewu ie tabo dukeje nowu emagore jiboe ewo towuje rugadu. Taruduware nowu bataru ji marigudu.

b: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Tamagokaba iaboe iaboe ie tabo. Mare tamagodo tamearudae pemegarewuji. Tawadrarodukaba rugadu. Tamagomode jiboe jetudo pudui rugadu. Tagaba tawadaru pogurudo. Tamagomode uu taromoduie ia taroji dukeje tarodo ji rugadu. Tamagomode boro taromodukaie ia boe eroji dukeje tarokaba ji rugadu. Ia boe emagore baru ie tabo tuwo boe emearutorudo tuwadaru ji. Mare tamagokaba baru ie tabo. Nonore Pao Kurirewu mugure. Ia boe emagore moto ie tabo tuwo boe emearutorudo tuwadaru ji. Mare tamagokaba moto ie tabo. Nonore Pao Kurirewu umode tuwure udo tamudo. Ia boe emagomode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ie tabo tuwo boe emearutorudo tuwadaru ji. Tamagokaba Jerusalém ba kurirewu ie tabo. Jerusalém tadare Pagimijera Kurirewu mugumode rugadu. Ia boe emagomode taora ie tabo tuwo boe emearutorudo tuwadaru ji. Mare tamagokaba tagaora ie tabo. Taroiwakare tawo tagao corewu kigadudo. Taroiwakare tawo tagao kigadurewu codo pugeje. Tu Pao Kurirewu emare roiware tuwo boe etao udo nono tumearudae mogadure. Dukodire inagoino. Tawadrarodukaba. Tamagore jiboe jamedu boe jetudo pudui rugadu tawo boe emearutorudo tawadaru ji. Mareboe aidure boe ewadraroduwo boe emearutorukawo pui. Dukodire nowu mareboe mearudae jire boe eroino tumagowo iaboe ie tabo ia tumagore jiboe ji.

b: Boe Ero Pegarewu Mori Reo
source: Boe Ero Pegarewu Mori Reo

b: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nuba eromoduie tuwo ia boe ero pegare jiboe morido etai. Akore boe erowo ji nono ro pegare jitu mogadure. Ia boe umoduie ia timedia joku pegado dukeje boe ewo nowu ro pegare timedia jiwu joku pegado jamedu ro pegare timedia jitu morice. Ia boe umoduie ia timedia o kado dukeje boe ewo nowu ro pegare timedia jiwu o kado jamedu ro pegare timedia jitu morice. Taruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji marigudu.
source: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nuba eromoduie tuwo ia boe ero pegare jiboe morido etai. Akore boe erowo ji nono ro pegare jitu mogadure. Ia boe umoduie ia timedia joku pegado dukeje boe ewo nowu ro pegare timedia jiwu joku pegado jamedu ro pegare timedia jitu morice. Ia boe umoduie ia timedia o kado dukeje boe ewo nowu ro pegare timedia jiwu o kado jamedu ro pegare timedia jitu morice. Taruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji marigudu.

b: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji rugadu. Tagaba ro pegarewu rore taiboe morido ai. Ia ro pegarewu umode tugera to taeji tae abowu metia maku ai jamedu uwo tugera to ji jamedu.
source: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji rugadu. Tagaba ro pegarewu rore taiboe morido ai. Ia ro pegarewu umode tugera to taeji tae abowu metia maku ai jamedu uwo tugera to ji jamedu.

b: Ia boe etumode boe eimijera bagai tuwo tugeragu tagudau meture taiwuji tabiji dukeje maku etai rugadu. Mare ia tagudau okwatorurewu biaku epa maku etai jamedu.
source: Ia boe etumode boe eimijera bagai tuwo tugeragu tagudau meture taiwuji tabiji dukeje maku etai rugadu. Mare ia tagudau okwatorurewu biaku epa maku etai jamedu.

b: Ia boe tuginaiwuge tugobaigarege ero rakamode tai tagoreduwo toe tabo pudai jii quilômetro oto pa ka tageragu ji tagoreduwo tabo rugadu. Mare quilômetro udo pobe taroino enoe tabo duji.
source: Ia boe tuginaiwuge tugobaigarege ero rakamode tai tagoreduwo toe tabo pudai jii quilômetro oto pa ka tageragu ji tagoreduwo tabo rugadu. Mare quilômetro udo pobe taroino enoe tabo duji.

b: Ia boe enogwamagudumode tai iaboe bagai dukeje maku etai rugadu. Ia boe enogwamagudumode tai ia tago diero bagai mare ia meri kejeie tumoduie morido tagai dukeje diero maku etai rugadu.
source: Ia boe enogwamagudumode tai iaboe bagai dukeje maku etai rugadu. Ia boe enogwamagudumode tai ia tago diero bagai mare ia meri kejeie tumoduie morido tagai dukeje diero maku etai rugadu.

b: Boe Emearudu Kuriwo Jorudu Pegare Puduiwugei Rugadu
source: Boe Emearudu Kuriwo Jorudu Pegare Puduiwugei Rugadu

b: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu akore boe emearudu kuriwo tumedagei tuwobei. Marigudu tagimijerage egore boe erudu pegawo jorudu pegare puduiwuge ji. Tamearudure nowu bataru ji marigudu.
source: – Marigudu Pao Kurirewu akore boe emearudu kuriwo tumedagei tuwobei. Marigudu tagimijerage egore boe erudu pegawo jorudu pegare puduiwuge ji. Tamearudure nowu bataru ji marigudu.

b: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Tamearudu kurido jorudu pegare taiwugei, onare taiwuge ji. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu ro pegare taiwuge eparu tabo.
source: Mare imode tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Tamearudu kurido jorudu pegare taiwugei, onare taiwuge ji. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu ro pegare taiwuge eparu tabo.

b: Dukodire care boe eruduwamode Pao Kurirewu orenure tagi duji. Pao Kurirewu emare ure meri joku jorugudo ro pemegarewugei ro pegarewugei jamedu. Emare ure bubutudo ro pemegarewuge eno moto keje ro pegarewuge eno moto keje jamedu.
source: Dukodire care boe eruduwamode Pao Kurirewu orenure tagi duji. Pao Kurirewu emare ure meri joku jorugudo ro pemegarewugei ro pegarewugei jamedu. Emare ure bubutudo ro pemegarewuge eno moto keje ro pegarewuge eno moto keje jamedu.

b: Tamearudu kurimode tu ro pemegare taiwugei dukeje taro pemegamodukare ro pegarewuge ero kori. Nou ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwu imedu ro pemegare nowu ro pemegare puduiwugei jamedu. Mare tamearudu kuriwo boe eiamedu boe ji nono Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado tai jamedu.
source: Tamearudu kurimode tu ro pemegare taiwugei dukeje taro pemegamodukare ro pegarewuge ero kori. Nou ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwu imedu ro pemegare nowu ro pemegare puduiwugei jamedu. Mare tamearudu kuriwo boe eiamedu boe ji nono Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado tai jamedu.

b: Tagimadumode tu tawobebo tu tamedagebo dukeje taro pemegamodukare ro pegarewuge ero kori. Ro pegarewuge mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ekimadure tuwobebo tumedagebo jamedu. Mare tagimaduwo boe eiamedu boebo. Nono Pao Kurirewu jorudu pemegamode tarore jiboe ji.
source: Tagimadumode tu tawobebo tu tamedagebo dukeje taro pemegamodukare ro pegarewuge ero kori. Ro pegarewuge mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ekimadure tuwobebo tumedagebo jamedu. Mare tagimaduwo boe eiamedu boebo. Nono Pao Kurirewu jorudu pemegamode tarore jiboe ji.

b: Dukodire inure tawie. Taro jamedu boe pemegado nono Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu mogadure rugadu.
source: Dukodire inure tawie. Taro jamedu boe pemegado nono Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu mogadure rugadu.

b: Boe Ewo Ia Toe Maku Marenarue Doge Etai
source: Boe Ewo Ia Toe Maku Marenarue Doge Etai

b: – Taro pemegamode boe ji tu boe egai mare boe etaiwokare dukeje tamodukare taro pemegado boe ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umodukare nowu taro pemegarewu morido baru tada.
source: – Taro pemegamode boe ji tu boe egai mare boe etaiwokare dukeje tamodukare taro pemegado boe ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umodukare nowu taro pemegarewu morido baru tada.

b: Dukodire tamode ia tagoe maku marenarue doge etai dukeje tagaba boe ewie tapira ukiga tabo. Ia mearutorukare tuwadaru jiwuge emode boe edo tapira ukiga akodo Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tada, awara okwai jamedu tuwo boe eiamedu boe ewie tuie ia toe maku marenarue doge etai. Etaidure tuwo boe emearudae pemegado pudui. Dukodire boe emago pemegamode ei eroino nowu marenarue dogei duji. Mare ere turo pegarewu biado boe epiji. Dukodire boe emago pemegare ei du morimode tu nouce rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umodukare nowu ero pemegarewu morido etai.
source: Dukodire tamode ia tagoe maku marenarue doge etai dukeje tagaba boe ewie tapira ukiga tabo. Dukodire boe emago pemegare ei du morimode tu nouce rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umodukare nowu ero pemegarewu morido etai.

b: Iwo tawie. Tamode iaboe maku marenarue doge etai dukeje tagaba boe ewie taroino duji. Tagaba tamedage ewie. Tagaba tawobe ewie taroino duji.
source: Iwo tawie. Tamode iaboe maku marenarue doge etai dukeje tagaba boe ewie taroino duji. Tagaba tamedage ewie. Tagaba tawobe ewie taroino duji.

b: Aino taro pemegarewu biadodumode boe epiji. Mare Pao Kurirewu jorudumode tarore jiboe jamedu boe ji. Emare umode nowu taro pemegarewu morido tagai rugadu.
source: Aino taro pemegarewu biadodumode boe epiji. Mare Pao Kurirewu jorudumode tarore jiboe jamedu boe ji. Emare umode nowu taro pemegarewu morido tagai rugadu.

b: Boe Emagowo Pao Kurirewu Bagai Baruto
source: Boe Emagowo Pao Kurirewu Bagai Baruto

b: – Ia boe emearutorukare tuwadaru ji. Emagere etaidure tuwo turagojedo nono Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tada tumagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai boe eruduwo turoinoduji. Etaidure turagojewo nono awara kajeje nono boe eda oiadada tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to boe eiamedu boe eruduwo turoinoduji. Iwo tawie. b: Jesus mearudure nowu tugobaigarege eimijera akoino duji dukeje Jesus jebogodure. Makore nowu rakojere pudabowuge ji. Akore iwo tawie. Judeu karegure ema mare awu imedu mearutorure i rugadu Israel moto kejewu Judeu doge eiamedu boe emearutoru kori.
source: Jesus mearudure nowu tugobaigarege eimijera akoino duji dukeje Jesus jebogodure. Makore nowu rakojere pudabowuge ji. Akore iwo tawie. Judeu karegure ema mare awu imedu mearutorure i rugadu Israel moto kejewu Judeu doge eiamedu boe emearutoru kori.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore Judeu doge ewagai emearutoruwo pudui. Makore ei tumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu arego etae. Abraão mearutorure nowu bataru ji. Onaregedu Isaque mearutorure. Isaque onaregedu Jacó mearutorure jamedu. Dukodire toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe ekimijerado pudumi dukeje umode ia tuwadae tawuje etai toro baru tada. Ca nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregodure. Mare Judeu doge emearutorure nowu umode boe ekinorudowu jiwuge emagakare. Mearutorukare nowu umode boe ekinorudowu jiwuge ewarigudumode toro boeco tadawu joru pegarewuto. Nonore boe etragudu rakamode rugadu, emode to reko pui tuwiri boe kori koia. Mare boe tuginaiwuge emearutorumode nowu umode boe ekinorudowuji rugadu. Mearutorure jiwuge emagamode rugadu moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emugumode Abraão apo, Isaque apo, Jacó apo nono Pao Kurirewu uwadae keje toro baru tada.

Emugumode Abraão apo, Isaque apo, Jacó apo nono Pao Kurirewu uwadae keje toro baru tada.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu tugobaigarege eimijeraji pugeje. Akore ca. Amearutorure i rugadu. Ire nowu atugare pemegago tu iwadaru tabo nono amearutorure i dumogadure. Atudo aibagi toro awai ka aruduwo ji. Ca Jesus ure tuwadaru iado dukeje nowu tugobaigarege eimijera utugare pemegagodure rugadu taci je.

Atudo aibagi toro awai ka aruduwo ji. Ca Jesus ure tuwadaru iado dukeje nowu tugobaigarege eimijera utugare pemegagodure rugadu taci je.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Epemegago Rugadu. Emagare.
source: Jesus Ure Boe Epemegago Rugadu. Emagare.

b: Nono Jesus aregodure Pedro uwai ka. Nou Pedro uwai tadare Jesus jorudure Pedro ucarugoji. Nou Pedro ucarugo kogodure rugadu. Biri urure dukodire padure nono tuba keje.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure Pedro uwai ka. Nou Pedro uwai tadare Jesus jorudure Pedro ucarugoji. Nou Pedro ucarugo kogodure rugadu. Biri urure dukodire padure nono tuba keje.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugera bu Pedro ucarugo iera keje. Ca nowu biri uru akedure piji taci je. Dukodire nowu Pedro ucarugo ure tumugudo. Ure turagojedo. Dukejere ure ia tugerogu towuje. Ure ia maku Jesus ai ukeje rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugera bu Pedro ucarugo iera keje. Ca nowu biri uru akedure piji taci je. Dukodire nowu Pedro ucarugo ure tumugudo. Ure turagojedo. Dukejere ure ia tugerogu towuje. Ure ia maku Jesus ai ukeje rugadu.

b: Nou boeco ji ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae. Emagare pugeje. Etaregodure bope doge emedure tadawugebo rugadu. Nono Jesus ure nowu bope doge etawuje nowu boe epiji tuwadaru tabo. Makore ei dukodire eture nowu boe epiji. Jesus ure kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.
source: Nou boeco ji ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae. Emagare pugeje. Etaregodure bope doge emedure tadawugebo rugadu. Nono Jesus ure nowu bope doge etawuje nowu boe epiji tuwadaru tabo. Makore ei dukodire eture nowu boe epiji. Jesus ure kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.

b: Dukodire care Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Marigudu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Isaías ure nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Rakare boe ekogodaeji. Ure boe epemegago rugadu. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu nowu umode boe ekinorudowu romoduie aino rugadu.
source: Dukodire care Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Marigudu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Isaías ure nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Rakare boe ekogodaeji. Ure boe epemegago rugadu. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu nowu umode boe ekinorudowu romoduie aino rugadu.

b: Iage Boe Etaidure Tugoduwo Jesus Apo
source: Iage Boe Etaidure Tugoduwo Jesus Apo

b: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo rugadu. Ere taiado Jesus apo rugadu. Jesus jorudure nowu boe eiamedu boe ji emagare rugadu dukodire makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei etuwo pudabo toro nowu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka.
source: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo rugadu. Ere taiado Jesus apo rugadu. Jesus jorudure nowu boe eiamedu boe ji emagare rugadu dukodire makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei etuwo pudabo toro nowu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka.

b: Ere tudo turugadu tuduwo dukeje ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu imedu aregodure Jesus ae. Makore Jesus ji. Akore boe eimijeranure aki. Itaidure ikoduwo akabo akodure jiboe ka.
source: Ere tudo turugadu tuduwo dukeje ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu imedu aregodure Jesus ae. Makore Jesus ji. Akore boe eimijeranure aki. Itaidure ikoduwo akabo akodure jiboe ka.

b: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore okwa doge emugure tiari poro ja tada. Kiebarege emode tamudo tuwaradu ja tada jamedu. Imire Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Mare iwai bokware iedurewu bokware iwo itamudo tada, inuduwo tada. Boe rakamode kodure itabowugei jamedu.
source: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore okwa doge emugure tiari poro ja tada. Kiebarege emode tamudo tuwaradu ja tada jamedu. Imire Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Mare iwai bokware iedurewu bokware iwo itamudo tada, inuduwo tada. Boe rakamode kodure itabowugei jamedu.

b: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu makore Jesus ji jamedu. Akore ikodumode akabo rugadu mare kajao. Aino kuri aino itumode kuri iogwa uwai ka. Iogwa bire dukodire itaidure iwo iogwa tugu mototo jao. Dukejere ikodumode akabo akodure jiboe ka.
source: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu makore Jesus ji jamedu. Akore ikodumode akabo rugadu mare kajao. Aino kuri aino itumode kuri iogwa uwai ka. Iogwa bire dukodire itaidure iwo iogwa tugu mototo jao. Dukejere ikodumode akabo akodure jiboe ka.

b: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore birewuge etugudumode birewugebo mare awiapagakaba ei. Atudo epiji. Ako itabo rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore birewuge etugudumode birewugebo mare awiapagakaba ei. Atudo epiji. Ako itabo rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Bakuru Pegarewu Akedudo
source: Jesus Ure Bakuru Pegarewu Akedudo

b: Nono Jesus ure turemo ika kurirewuto. Nou ure joruduwadowuge ere turemo apo jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus ure turemo ika kurirewuto. Nou ure joruduwadowuge ere turemo apo jamedu.

b: Ekodure nowu ika kurirewu tabo nowu pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje Jesus unudure nowu ika kurirewu ja tada. Ca ia bakuru pegarewu aregodure etae taci je. Nou bakuru ure nowu pobo redo. Nou inodu kodire pobo jeture nowu ika kurirewuji. Dukodire pobo ure turemo nowu ika kurirewuto rugadu.
source: Ekodure nowu ika kurirewu tabo nowu pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje Jesus unudure nowu ika kurirewu ja tada. Ca ia bakuru pegarewu aregodure etae taci je. Nou bakuru ure nowu pobo redo. Nou inodu kodire pobo jeture nowu ika kurirewuji. Dukodire pobo ure turemo nowu ika kurirewuto rugadu.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge epagudugodure dukodire ere Jesus jetadudo. egore cegimijera. Pawimode poboto! Arodo iaboe ji awo paginorudo.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge epagudugodure dukodire ere Jesus jetadudo. egore cegimijera. Pawimode poboto! Arodo iaboe ji awo paginorudo.

b: Jesus akore Kocare tabagudure? Kocare tamearutorukare i? Nono Jesus ure turagojedo ika ja tada. Nono makore nowu bakuruji nowu poboji dukodire nowu bakuru akedure, nowu pobo butugugodure jamedu.
source: Jesus akore Kocare tabagudure? Kocare tamearutorukare i? Nono Jesus ure turagojedo ika ja tada. Nono makore nowu bakuruji nowu poboji dukodire nowu bakuru akedure, nowu pobo butugugodure jamedu.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ebogodure rugadu. Egore pui: – Dubobanure awu imeduce? Kocare bakuru, pobo emearutorure awu imedu bataru ji rugadu!
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ebogodure rugadu. Egore pui: – Dubobanure awu imeduce? Kocare bakuru, pobo emearutorure awu imedu bataru ji rugadu!

b: Jesus Ure Bope Doge Etawuje Ime Pobedu Doge Epiji
source: Jesus Ure Bope Doge Etawuje Ime Pobedu Doge Epiji

b: Dukejere Jesus aregodure toro nowu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka ture joruduwadowugebo nowu ika kurirewu tabo. Nou etaregodure kawu moto iere Gadara. Etaregodure dukeje ere tudawuje ika kurirewu piji. Mare bope doge emedu tadawu ime eture Jesus togi. Marigudu nowu bope doge emedure nowu ime etada dukodire erore pudabo turo pega tabo boe eiamedu boe ji. Dukodire boe epagudure ece. Dukodire boe etukare toro etae pugeje. Nou ime pobedu doge edu pagare nono aroe eda keje jamedu.
source: Dukejere Jesus aregodure toro nowu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka ture joruduwadowugebo nowu ika kurirewu tabo. Nou etaregodure kawu moto iere Gadara. Marigudu nowu bope doge emedure nowu ime etada dukodire erore pudabo turo pega tabo boe eiamedu boe ji. Dukodire boe epagudure ece. Dukodire boe etukare toro etae pugeje. Nou ime pobedu doge edu pagare nono aroe eda keje jamedu.

b: Nono ekudugodure Jesus ae. egore Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure aki. Kodiba akaregodure mato cedae? Kaba kodiba aroino cewagai? Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado cei rugadu. Aki kana amode boe pegado cei kuri aino?
source: Nono ekudugodure Jesus ae. egore Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure aki. Kodiba akaregodure mato cedae? Kaba kodiba aroino cewagai? Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado cei rugadu. Aki kana amode boe pegado cei kuri aino?

b: Jugurewuge edu puredure nono togwage tabo. Emagare rugadu.
source: Jugurewuge edu puredure nono togwage tabo. Emagare rugadu.

b: Nou meture nowu ime tadawu bope doge emagore nowu ime eiabiji Jesus ji. egore amode cedawuje awu ime epiji dukeje cedudo toro nowu jugurewuge etae. Cedo ceremo nowu jugurewugeto.
source: Nou meture nowu ime tadawu bope doge emagore nowu ime eiabiji Jesus ji. egore amode cedawuje awu ime epiji dukeje cedudo toro nowu jugurewuge etae. Cedo ceremo nowu jugurewugeto.

b: Dukodire Jesus akore Toro. Dukodire ere tudawuje nowu ime epiji. Eture toro nowu jugurewuge etae. Ere turemo nowu jugurewugeto. Dukodire nowu jugurewuge eregodure toro ia moto ri ao piji taci poboto. Dukodire eiamedu boe ewire poboto rugadu.
source: Dukodire Jesus akore Toro. Dukodire ere tudawuje nowu ime epiji. Eture toro nowu jugurewuge etae. Ere turemo nowu jugurewugeto. Dukodire nowu jugurewuge eregodure toro ia moto ri ao piji taci poboto. Dukodire eiamedu boe ewire poboto rugadu.

b: Nou jeture nowu jugurewuge eiwuge eregodure Jesus piji toro nowu tuwai mugure tadawu ba kurirewu ka tureadoduwo boe ewiagai nono. Ereadodure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai.
source: Nou jeture nowu jugurewuge eiwuge eregodure Jesus piji toro nowu tuwai mugure tadawu ba kurirewu ka tureadoduwo boe ewiagai nono. Ereadodure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai.

b: Nou ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe eture toro Jesus ae. Erudure Jesus ji dukeje emagore ji utuwo nowu boe epiji. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji rugadu utuwo nowu moto piji rugadu.
source: Nou ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe eture toro Jesus ae. Erudure Jesus ji dukeje emagore ji utuwo nowu boe epiji. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji rugadu utuwo nowu moto piji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Pogora Pegarewu Imedu Pemegago
source: Jesus Ure Pogora Pegarewu Imedu Pemegago

b: Nono Jesus ure turemo ika kurirewuto pugeje. Ure tugirimi nowu pobo maerewu kajeje pugeje nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Dukejere etaregodure nowu Jesus mugure kejewu ba kurirewu ka.
source: Nono Jesus ure turemo ika kurirewuto pugeje. Ure tugirimi nowu pobo maerewu kajeje pugeje nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Dukejere etaregodure nowu Jesus mugure kejewu ba kurirewu ka.

b: Nono ia boe etaregodure ia imedu pogora pegarewu apo. Nou imedu pogora pegarewu padure tugudau kodo keje. Jesus jorudure emearutorure pudui duji kodire etaregodure aino nowu imedu pogora pegarewu apo pudae rugadu duji. Dukodire makore nowu imedu pogora pegarewuji. Akore me. Ire aro pegarewu jamedu boe barigu apiji dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumode aro pegare jiboe piji rugadu.
source: Nono ia boe etaregodure ia imedu pogora pegarewu apo. Nou imedu pogora pegarewu padure tugudau kodo keje. Jesus jorudure emearutorure pudui duji kodire etaregodure aino nowu imedu pogora pegarewu apo pudae rugadu duji. Dukodire makore nowu imedu pogora pegarewuji. Akore me. Ire aro pegarewu jamedu boe barigu apiji dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumode aro pegare jiboe piji rugadu.

b: Ia boe eimijerage joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidukare nowu Jesus akoino duji. Egore tudada: – Awu makore jiboe ukare turugadu! Pagare akoino. Unure tudo nono Pao Kurirewure. Tu Pao Kurirewu umode boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji.
source: Ia boe eimijerage joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidukare nowu Jesus akoino duji. Egore tudada: – Awu makore jiboe ukare turugadu! Pagare akoino. Unure tudo nono Pao Kurirewure. Tu Pao Kurirewu umode boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji.

b: Jesus joruduware emearudaere jiboe ji rugadu. Dukodire makore ei. Akore kocare kodiba tamearudae pegare aino i.
source: Jesus joruduware emearudaere jiboe ji rugadu. Dukodire makore ei. Akore kocare kodiba tamearudae pegare aino i.

b: Boe jokodu. Boe emodukare boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji rugadu. Tu Pao Kurirewu umode boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji rugadu. Mare boe emodukare awu imedu pogora pegarewu pemegago jamedu. Emodukare pemegago rugadu. Tu Pao Kurirewu koiare umode nowu imedu pogora pemegago.
source: Boe jokodu. Boe emodukare boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji rugadu. Tu Pao Kurirewu umode boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji rugadu. Mare boe emodukare awu imedu pogora pegarewu pemegago jamedu. Emodukare pemegago rugadu. Tu Pao Kurirewu koiare umode nowu imedu pogora pemegago.

b: Dukodire imode awu imedu pemegago dukeje taruduwamode Imedu Onaregedunure imi duji. Dukodire imode taruduwado iragare iwo boe ero pegarewu barigu epiji ewarigudukawo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto rugadu. Ainore Jesus akore nowu boe eimijeragei. Nono ure tuie mekido nowu imedu pogora pegarewu ae. Nono makore ji. Akore me. Aragojedo. Akeragu akudau kodoji atuwo tabo aibagi awai ka.
source: Dukodire imode awu imedu pemegago dukeje taruduwamode Imedu Onaregedunure imi duji. Dukodire imode taruduwado iragare iwo boe ero pegarewu barigu epiji ewarigudukawo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto rugadu. Ainore Jesus akore nowu boe eimijeragei. Nono ure tuie mekido nowu imedu pogora pegarewu ae. Nono makore ji. Akore me. Aragojedo. Akeragu akudau kodoji atuwo tabo aibagi awai ka.

b: Ca nowu imedu ure turagojedo rugadu. Meru pegakare dukodire uture tuwai ka rugadu.
source: Ca nowu imedu ure turagojedo rugadu. Meru pegakare dukodire uture tuwai ka rugadu.

b: Nou boe eiamedu boe erudure nowu rore aino duji. Erore ta je. Mare emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Egore emaie roino Jesus ji uwo nowu imedu pogora pegarewu pemegago.
source: Nou boe eiamedu boe erudure nowu rore aino duji. Erore ta je. Mare emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Egore emaie roino Jesus ji uwo nowu imedu pogora pegarewu pemegago.

b: Jesus Makore Mateus Bagai
source: Jesus Makore Mateus Bagai

b: Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Kodure awara ji dukeje jorudure ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwu imeduji. Du iere Mateus. Nou Mateus mugure nono ira keje. Nonore ure tugeragu dieroji boe epiji tuwo maku boe eimijera kurirewu ai. Nono Jesus makore ji. Akore ako itabo. Nono Mateus ure turagojedo. Ure tugera ra tumaragodae piji tuduwo Jesus apo rugadu.
source: Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Kodure awara ji dukeje jorudure ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwu imeduji. Du iere Mateus. Nou Mateus mugure nono ira keje. Nonore ure tugeragu dieroji boe epiji tuwo maku boe eimijera kurirewu ai. Nono Jesus makore ji. Akore ako itabo. Nono Mateus ure turagojedo. Ure tugera ra tumaragodae piji tuduwo Jesus apo rugadu.

b: Mateus makore Jesus ji okwagewo tuwai keje pudabo. Dukodire Jesus uture Mateus apo toro uwai ka. Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture Jesus apo jamedu. Boe emagare nono togwage tabo ebo. Imposto diero makudure aiwuge imenure emage. Boe egore ro pegarewuge enuie emage. Ia boe etaidukare jiwuge eragojere nono Jesus apo jamedu.
source: Mateus makore Jesus ji okwagewo tuwai keje pudabo. Dukodire Jesus uture Mateus apo toro uwai ka. Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture Jesus apo jamedu. Boe emagare nono togwage tabo ebo. Imposto diero makudure aiwuge imenure emage. Boe egore ro pegarewuge enuie emage. Ia boe etaidukare jiwuge eragojere nono Jesus apo jamedu.

b: Fariseu doge etaregodure toro etae jamedu. Erudure Jesus rore jiboe ji dukeje emagore nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ji. egore kocare tagimijera okwagere awu ro pegarewugebo? Ukare turugadu!
source: Fariseu doge etaregodure toro etae jamedu. Erudure Jesus rore jiboe ji dukeje emagore nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ji. egore kocare tagimijera okwagere awu ro pegarewugebo? Ukare turugadu!

b: Jesus mearudure egoino duji dukeje makore nowu fariseu doge ewadaru jipagi. Akore jorubo kuru epa jemarumodukare kogodukarewuge ewagai. Mare kogodurewuge ewagaire jemarumode tuwo epemegago.
source: Jesus mearudure egoino duji dukeje makore nowu fariseu doge ewadaru jipagi. Akore jorubo kuru epa jemarumodukare kogodukarewuge ewagai. Mare kogodurewuge ewagaire jemarumode tuwo epemegago.

b: Irore nono nowu jorubo kuru epa ro mogadure. Mare jorubo kuru epa ji karega inagoino. Itaregodure woe mare ro pemegarewuge ewagai karega iroino. Ro pegarewuge ewagaire iroino ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Dujire inagoino. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure tawie. Tagaiwodo nowu Pao Kurirewu bagai. Akore Boe emode boe egu barogorogu kowu tuwo maku inai turo pegarewu morice. Mare itaidure boe enogudugoduwo puapo rugadu. Dujire itaidure rugadu.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. Ca taruduwado nowu bataru ji tamearutoruwo ji tarore jiboe tabo.
source: Irore nono nowu jorubo kuru epa ro mogadure. Mare jorubo kuru epa ji karega inagoino. Itaregodure woe mare ro pemegarewuge ewagai karega iroino. Ro pegarewuge ewagaire iroino ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Dujire inagoino. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure tawie. Tagaiwodo nowu Pao Kurirewu bagai. Akore Boe emode boe egu barogorogu kowu tuwo maku inai turo pegarewu morice. Mare itaidure boe enogudugoduwo puapo rugadu. Dujire itaidure rugadu.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. Ca taruduwado nowu bataru ji tamearutoruwo ji tarore jiboe tabo.

b: Boe Enarare Jesus ji Ure Joruduwadowuge Ero Bagai
source: Boe Enarare Jesus ji Ure Joruduwadowuge Ero Bagai

b: Ia meri keje João Batista ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae. egore ia meri keje cenogwagemodukare nowu meri ji cemagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu meri keje. Ainore cerore. Fariseu doge eromode aino jamedu cero mogadure. Kodiba nowu are joruduwadowuge erokare aino jamedu?
source: Ia meri keje João Batista ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae. egore ia meri keje cenogwagemodukare nowu meri ji cemagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu meri keje. Ainore cerore. Fariseu doge eromode aino jamedu cero mogadure. Kodiba nowu are joruduwadowuge erokare aino jamedu?

b: Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore ire nono uwiremodewu imedu mogadure. Boe etuwirere dukeje boe ere tuwadae towuje. Nou ewadae kejere boe enogwagemode rugadu. Ewadae reno. Ekiarigodumodukare nowu meri ji. Mare ewadae akedure dukeje uwirerewu imedu utumode epiji toreduje apo. Dukejere care boe emode ia meri tawuje togwagekawo nowu meri ji tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu meri ji. Ire nono nowu uwiremodewu imedu mogadure. Mare uwiremodewu imedu ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino. Ire irawuje baru piji mato boe ewagai. Mare ia meri keje itumode nowu boe epiji. Dujire inagoino. Itumode nowu boe epiji dukeje boe emode ia meri tawuje togwagekawo nowu meri ji tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu meri keje. Dujire inagoino.

b: Boe ekudau areia pegagodurewu umode tuwowuje. Mare boe emodukare tugudau areia maiwu kado tuwo nowu tugudau pegagodurewu poro miwuje tabo. Boe eromode aino dukeje nowu ekudau areia maiwu gigirimode. Dukodire umode tuwowuje nowu boe ekudau areia pegagodurewu piji kuri je rugadu. Dukodire nowu ekudau areia pegagodurewu umode tuwowuje ja je pugeje.

Boe eromode aino dukeje nowu ekudau areia maiwu gigirimode. Dukodire umode tuwowuje nowu boe ekudau areia pegagodurewu piji kuri je rugadu. Dukodire nowu ekudau areia pegagodurewu umode tuwowuje ja je pugeje.

b: Boe ere tapira biri maiwu pemegado nowu tuge vinho kuru maiwu jace. Mare emode vinho kuru maiwu tugu tapira biri codurewuto dukeje nowu tapira biri codurewu umode tuwowuje. Nono nowu vinho kuru umode tuwarigu nowu tapira biri codurewu piji rugadu. Dukodire boe ekare tuge vinho kuru maiwu tugu tapira biri codurewuto. Ere tuge vinho kuru maiwu tugu tapira biri maiwuto tu tu je. Ainore Jesus akore. Mare areia ji karega akoino. Vinho kuru ji karega akoino. Tuwadaru maiwu jire Jesus akoino.

b: Jesus Ure Areme Epemegago
source: Jesus Ure Areme Epemegago

b: Jesus akoino dukeje ia boe eimijera aregodure ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai. Makore Jesus ji. Akore itonaregedu aredu bire aino maigodu. Mare atudo itabo iwai ka awo akera bu nowu itonaregedu aredu biri keje dukeje jewodumode pugeje.
source: Jesus akoino dukeje ia boe eimijera aregodure ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai. Makore Jesus ji. Akore itonaregedu aredu bire aino maigodu. Mare atudo itabo iwai ka awo akera bu nowu itonaregedu aredu biri keje dukeje jewodumode pugeje.

b: Jesus ure turagojedo tumuga piji. Uture nowu boe eimijera apo toro uwai ka ture joruduwadowugebo.
source: Jesus ure turagojedo tumuga piji. Uture nowu boe eimijera apo toro uwai ka ture joruduwadowugebo.

b: Ekodure awara ji dukeje ia aredu kodure ebo Jesus rekodaji. Marigudu nowu aredu kogodaere tu tu je. Nou aredu ku rere piji nono areme etorewudae mogadure. Mare nowu aredu o akedukare piji. Re kimonure piji meri jamedu ji. Joru oto padu kejeboere doze nowu aredu ku rere piji duji. Aino nowu aredu makore tudada. Akore imode ikera otorogu jetudo Jesus ukudau areiaji dukeje ipemegagodumode. Ainore nowu aredu akore tudada. Dukodire nowu aredu ure tugera raido. Nono iera otorogu jeture Jesus ukudau areiaji.
source: Ekodure awara ji dukeje ia aredu kodure ebo Jesus rekodaji. Marigudu nowu aredu kogodaere tu tu je. Nou aredu ku rere piji nono areme etorewudae mogadure. Mare nowu aredu o akedukare piji. Re kimonure piji meri jamedu ji. Joru oto padu kejeboere doze nowu aredu ku rere piji duji. Aino nowu aredu makore tudada. Akore imode ikera otorogu jetudo Jesus ukudau areiaji dukeje ipemegagodumode. Ainore nowu aredu akore tudada. Dukodire nowu aredu ure tugera raido. Nono iera otorogu jeture Jesus ukudau areiaji.

b: Nono Jesus ure tuie mekido. Jorudure nowu areduji rugadu. Akore are. Amearutorure i rugadu. Dukodire apemegagodumode rugadu. Nono nowu aredu pemegagodure taci je rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tuie mekido. Jorudure nowu areduji rugadu. Akore are. Amearutorure i rugadu. Dukodire apemegagodumode rugadu. Nono nowu aredu pemegagodure taci je rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus aregodure nowu boe eimijera uwai ka. Boe emagare nono tragudu tabo. Edukiorokare. Nou boe ere tuwabo ako rakado jamedu. Jesus jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje makore nowu boe ji. Akore tadawuje awu bai piji. Aredurogu bikare. Unudunure tu je. Mare nowu boe eruduware nowu nogwaredu bire rugadu duji dukodire enogwarigodure Jesus ji.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure nowu boe eimijera uwai ka. Boe emagare nono tragudu tabo. Edukiorokare. Nou boe ere tuwabo ako rakado jamedu. Jesus jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje makore nowu boe ji. Akore tadawuje awu bai piji. Aredurogu bikare. Unudunure tu je. Mare nowu boe eruduware nowu nogwaredu bire rugadu duji dukodire enogwarigodure Jesus ji.

b: Mare nowu boe eimijera ure nowu boe etawuje tuwai piji. Dukejere Jesus ure turemo nowu nogwaredu padure tadawu baito. Dukeje ure tugeragu nowu nogwaredu ieraji. Nono nowu nogwaredu jewodure pugeje rugadu. Ure tumugudo rugadu.
source: Mare nowu boe eimijera ure nowu boe etawuje tuwai piji. Dukejere Jesus ure turemo nowu nogwaredu padure tadawu baito. Dukeje ure tugeragu nowu nogwaredu ieraji. Nono nowu nogwaredu jewodure pugeje rugadu. Ure tumugudo rugadu.

b: Nou boe eruduware nowu inoduji dukodire ereadodure boe eiamedu boe ewiagai awu Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Nou boe eruduware nowu inoduji dukodire ereadodure boe eiamedu boe ewiagai awu Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ime Epemegago Jamedu
source: Jesus Ure Ime Epemegago Jamedu

b: Nono Jesus uture pugeje. Mare ia ime joku bokwarewuge ekodure Jesus rekodaji. Ere pobe. Ekudugodure Jesus bagai. egore Mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Davi uwobenure aki. Akogudugo cedabo.
source: Nono Jesus uture pugeje. Mare ia ime joku bokwarewuge ekodure Jesus rekodaji. Ere pobe. Ekudugodure Jesus bagai. egore Mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Davi uwobenure aki. Akogudugo cedabo.

b: Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ime joku bokwarewuge ere turemo Jesus rekodaji. Etaregodure Jesus ae rugadu. Jesus makore ei. Akore tamearutorure i imode tabemegago duji rugadu kana? egore uu. Cegimijeranure aki.
source: Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ime joku bokwarewuge ere turemo Jesus rekodaji. Etaregodure Jesus ae rugadu. Jesus makore ei. Akore tamearutorure i imode tabemegago duji rugadu kana? egore uu. Cegimijeranure aki.

b: Dukejere Jesus ure tugera bu eku keje. Nono makore ei. Akore tamearutorure jiboe jetuwo pudui tai rugadu.
source: Dukejere Jesus ure tugera bu eku keje. Nono makore ei. Akore tamearutorure jiboe jetuwo pudui tai rugadu.

b: Nono epemegagodure taci je rugadu. Etaiwore pugeje rugadu. Mare Jesus makogodure ei. Akore tareadodukaba boe ewiagai awu irore jiboe ji.
source: Nono epemegagodure taci je rugadu. Etaiwore pugeje rugadu. Mare Jesus makogodure ei. Akore tareadodukaba boe ewiagai awu irore jiboe ji.

b: Mare eture Jesus piji dukeje ereadodure Jesus rore jiboe ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto rugadu boe parugajeje.
source: Mare eture Jesus piji dukeje ereadodure Jesus rore jiboe ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto rugadu boe parugajeje.

b: Eture dukeje iage etaregodure ia imedu apo Jesus bagai pugeje. Nou imedu mako bokware. Roiwakare tumagowo. Bope meture tada kodi.
source: Eture dukeje iage etaregodure ia imedu apo Jesus bagai pugeje. Nou imedu mako bokware. Roiwakare tumagowo. Bope meture tada kodi.

b: Mare Jesus ure nowu bope tawuje nowu imedu piji dukeje nowu imedu makore pugeje. Boe emagare nono tuiorudure Jesus roino jitu tabo. Eiamedu boe ebogodure rugadu. egore Marigudu Israel moto kejewu boe erudukare ia awu inodu boe ji jii aino.
source: Mare Jesus ure nowu bope tawuje nowu imedu piji dukeje nowu imedu makore pugeje. Boe emagare nono tuiorudure Jesus roino jitu tabo. Eiamedu boe ebogodure rugadu. egore Marigudu Israel moto kejewu boe erudukare ia awu inodu boe ji jii aino.

b: Mare fariseu doge etaidukare Jesus rore jiboe ji. Emago pegare ji. egore bope doge eimijera kurirewu raka tabore awu Jesus roino tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.
source: Mare fariseu doge etaidukare Jesus rore jiboe ji. Emago pegare ji. egore bope doge eimijera kurirewu raka tabore awu Jesus roino tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.

b: Maragodure Pao Kurirewu Aiwuge Emagakare
source: Maragodure Pao Kurirewu Aiwuge Emagakare

b: Jesus kodure nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje boe eda jamedu boe ka. Aregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje ure turemo nowu Judeu doge ere bato pui towu baito. Nonore ure eruduwado tuwadaru pemegarewu ji tu tu je. Ure ewie Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijerado pudumi kuri je rugadu. Ure kogodurewuge eiamedu boe epemegago jamedu.
source: Jesus kodure nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje boe eda jamedu boe ka. Aregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje ure turemo nowu Judeu doge ere bato pui towu baito. Nonore ure eruduwado tuwadaru pemegarewu ji tu tu je. Ure ewie Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijerado pudumi kuri je rugadu. Ure kogodurewuge eiamedu boe epemegago jamedu.

b: Boe emagare Jesus apo tu tu je. Jesus jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje okudugodure ebo rugadu. Akore eie nono ovelha doge emogadure. Jetu pemegare eiwu bokwaie. Boe pegaie ei. Eruduwakaie nuba turomode. Mare ovelha ji karega akoino. Nou boe eroiwakare tuwo tuginorudo. Dujire akoino. Ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jiwu bokware. Dujire akoino.
source: Boe emagare Jesus apo tu tu je. Jesus jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje okudugodure ebo rugadu. Akore eie nono ovelha doge emogadure. Jetu pemegare eiwu bokwaie. Boe pegaie ei. Eruduwakaie nuba turomode. Mare ovelha ji karega akoino. Nou boe eroiwakare tuwo tuginorudo. Dujire akoino. Ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jiwu bokware. Dujire akoino.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boepa kurire rugadu. Nou boepa tadaboe ure turugadu boe ewo kado. Mare umode boepa tadaboe kadowuge emagakare.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boepa kurire rugadu. Nou boepa tadaboe ure turugadu boe ewo kado. Mare umode boepa tadaboe kadowuge emagakare.

b: Dukodire tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Boepa jiwu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Tamagodo ji maragoduwo boepa jiwuge emagawo etuwo boepato ewo boepa tadaboe kado rugadu. Mare boepa ji karega Jesus akoino. Mearutorumode Pao Kurirewu jiwugeire akoino. Boe emode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji, Pao Kurirewu umode ekinorudo. Dujire akoino.
source: Dukodire tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Boepa jiwu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Tamagodo ji maragoduwo boepa jiwuge emagawo etuwo boepato ewo boepa tadaboe kado rugadu. Mare boepa ji karega Jesus akoino. Mearutorumode Pao Kurirewu jiwugeire akoino. Boe emode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji, Pao Kurirewu umode ekinorudo. Dujire akoino.

b: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Enodo Padure Doze
source: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Enodo Padure Doze

b: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai pudae. Ere doze. Nono ure eragado ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ure eragado ewo boe epemegago ekogodae boe piji.
source: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai pudae. Ere doze. Nono ure eragado ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ure eragado ewo boe epemegago ekogodae boe piji.

b: Ainore nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekiere: Simão. Iere Pedro jamedu. André. Pedro uwienure ema. Tiago. Nou Tiago uo iere Zebedeu. João. Tiago uwienure ema.
source: Ainore nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekiere: Simão. Iere Pedro jamedu. André. Pedro uwienure ema. Tiago. Nou Tiago uo iere Zebedeu. João. Tiago uwienure ema.

b: Filipe, Bartolomeu, Tomé, Mateus. Boe ere to diero maku nowu Mateus ai uwo maku boe eimijerage etai. Tiago. Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Tadeu.
source: Filipe, Bartolomeu, Tomé, Mateus. Boe ere to diero maku nowu Mateus ai uwo maku boe eimijerage etai. Tiago. Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Tadeu.

b: Simão. Emare makore tumedagei marigudu emearutorukawo Roma kejewu boe eimijeragei pugeje. Judas Iscariotes. Emare umode Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Nou ime eture Jesus bataru tabowuge umode emage rugadu.
source: Simão. Emare makore tumedagei marigudu emearutorukawo Roma kejewu boe eimijeragei pugeje. Judas Iscariotes. Emare umode Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Nou ime eture Jesus bataru tabowuge umode emage rugadu.

b: Awu doze ime dogere Jesus ure etudo tuwadaru tabo. Makore ei. Akore tadukaba boe tuginaiwuge etae. Tadukaba ia Samaritano doge eda ka.
source: Awu doze ime dogere Jesus ure etudo tuwadaru tabo. Makore ei. Akore tadukaba boe tuginaiwuge etae. Tadukaba ia Samaritano doge eda ka.

b: Tadudo tu Judeu doge etae. Ere nono okware boetowuge ovelha doge emogadure. Mare ovelha ji karega inagoino. Nou Judeu doge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino.
source: Tadudo tu Judeu doge etae. Ere nono okware boetowuge ovelha doge emogadure. Mare ovelha ji karega inagoino. Nou Judeu doge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino.

b: Tadumode dukeje tamagomode tarudure jiwuge ewiagai awu iwadaru ji. Tamagodo: “Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri je.” Ainore tagagomode boe ji.
source: Tadumode dukeje tamagomode tarudure jiwuge ewiagai awu iwadaru ji. Tamagodo: “Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri je.” Ainore tagagomode boe ji.

b: Tadumode dukeje tamode kogodurewuge epemegago. Tamode birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Tamode kogodurewuge biri pegarewuge epemegago. Tamode bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ire taragado tarowo awu inagoino jiwu taroji mare ikare nowu ire maku tagaiboe morido. Dukodire tamodukare boe edo iaboe maku tagai tarore jiboe morice jamedu.
source: Tadumode dukeje tamode kogodurewuge epemegago. Tamode birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Tamode kogodurewuge biri pegarewuge epemegago. Tamode bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ire taragado tarowo awu inagoino jiwu taroji mare ikare nowu ire maku tagaiboe morido. Dukodire tamodukare boe edo iaboe maku tagai tarore jiboe morice jamedu.

b: Tadukaba tori kuieje tabo. Tadukaba prata tabo. Tadukaba ia diero tabo rugadu.
source: Tadukaba tori kuieje tabo. Tadukaba prata tabo. Tadukaba ia diero tabo rugadu.

b: Tadukaba ia tagudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau areia tabo. Tadukaba ia tawure okeakejewu tabo. Tadukaba ia tagedu jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadumode tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Dukodire boe etu pemegamode tai.
source: Tadukaba ia tagudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau areia tabo. Tadukaba ia tawure okeakejewu tabo. Tadukaba ia tagedu jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadumode tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Dukodire boe etu pemegamode tai.

b: Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tagaiwodo ia ro pemegarewu bagai tamuguwo nono uwai keje jii tadure kejewu meri ka.
source: Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tagaiwodo ia ro pemegarewu bagai tamuguwo nono uwai keje jii tadure kejewu meri ka.

b: Tamode taremo nowu baito dukeje tagimadudo nowu boebo.
source: Tamode taremo nowu baito dukeje tagimadudo nowu boebo.

b: Nou bai tadawuge ero pemegamode tai, etaidumode tai tietu pemegawo tai dukeje tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ei. Mare ero pemegamodukare tai dukeje tagaba tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai.
source: Nou bai tadawuge ero pemegamode tai, etaidumode tai tietu pemegawo tai dukeje tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ei. Mare ero pemegamodukare tai dukeje tagaba tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai.

b: Ia boe eda kejewuge etaidumodukare tamagore jiboe ji. Ekimadumodukare tagabo dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode nowu boe eda piji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu tawuje nowu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe jituji kodire umode tugera ra epiji.
source: Ia boe eda kejewuge etaidumodukare tamagore jiboe ji. Ekimadumodukare tagabo dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode nowu boe eda piji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu tawuje nowu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe jituji kodire umode tugera ra epiji.

b: Inure tawie. Boe pegamode nowu aidukare taiwugei rugadu. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji. Mariguduwuge Sodoma kejewuge ero pegare. Gomorra kejewuge ero pegare jamedu. Dukodire nowu meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado nowu Sodoma kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Umode boe pegado nowu Gomorra kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Mare nowu aidukare taiwuge boe eire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sodoma kejewuge ekori, nowu Gomorra kejewuge ekori jamedu.
source: Inure tawie. Boe pegamode nowu aidukare taiwugei rugadu. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji. Mariguduwuge Sodoma kejewuge ero pegare. Gomorra kejewuge ero pegare jamedu. Dukodire nowu meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado nowu Sodoma kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Umode boe pegado nowu Gomorra kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Mare nowu aidukare taiwuge boe eire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sodoma kejewuge ekori, nowu Gomorra kejewuge ekori jamedu.

b: Boe Pegamode Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei
source: Boe Pegamode Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei

b: – Nou ire tadudo etaewuge ere nono rie doge emogadure. Tare nono ovelha doge emogadure. Mare barogo ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu bokware. Dujire inagoino. Mare tadumode ewagaiwuge emearudae pegamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire inure tawie. Taeku jado nono awagu ro mogadure. Mare awagu ji karega inagoino. Taruduwado boe emearudae jamedu boe ji. Dujire inagoino. Mare tamearudae pegarewu bokwado nono metugo mogadure. Mare metugo ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegakaba boe ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Taeku jado ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewu bagai. Mare ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu tai rugadu. Emode tamagu Judeu doge eimijerage etai. Emode tarego Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore emode boeto tai tapira biri iku tabo.

b: Tamearutorumode i dukodire ro pegarewuge emode tamagu boe ekimijera governador doge etai. Emode tamagu boe ekimijerage kurirewuge etai rugadu. Nono tamode nowu boe ekimijerage ewie iwadaru ji jamedu. Tamode boe tuginaiwuge ewie iwadaru ji jamedu.

b: Mare nowu boe ekimijerage emode tadugu baicorewuto dukeje tamororamagadukaba ia tamagomode jiboe bagai. Tamororamagadukaba tamode ewie jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari makomode tai tuwo tamagore jiboe maku tagai Taonure ema kodi. Emare umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu makomode jiboe ji tamagowo nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ekimijerage ewiagai.

Emare umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu makomode jiboe ji tamagowo nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ekimijerage ewiagai.

b: – Imode tawie iaboe ji pugeje. Tamearutorure i dukodire boe erudu pegamode tai, ero pegamode tai. Mare tamodukare tagera ra ipiji dukeje imode taginorudo rugadu. Ia boe emearutorumode i dukodire etumana mage emode nowu tuwiemage mearutorure iwuge emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Ia boe emearutorumode i dukodire etuo jorudu pegamode ei. Dukodire nowu etuo umode tore mearutorure iwuge emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Ia boe etore etuje mearutorumode i dukodire boe etore etaidumodukare nowu tujeji pugeje. Ia boe etore etuo mearutorumode i dukodire nowu boe etore etaidumodukare nowu tuoji pugeje. Dukodire nowu boe etore emode tujemage tuomage mearutorure iwuge emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo jamedu.

b: Mare ia boe ero pegamode tai dukeje tarego nowu boe epiji tamuguwo ia boe eda keje pugeje. Iwo tawie. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Tadumode Judeu doge eno moto kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka jii toro imode ikirimi kejewu meri ka. Mare tagaregodumodukare nowu Judeu doge emugure kejewu eda jamedu boe ka jii itaregodumode du ka.

b: Boe emearutorumodukare ia mugure bapera kejewuji joruduwamodukare nono tugimijera mogadure. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu mugure bapera kejewu ukimijeraji. Boe emearutorumodukare ia boe eimijera utugareji. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu boe eimijeraji.

b: Mare nowu mugure bapera kejewu joruduware jiboe umode nono nowu ukimijera joruduware jiboe mogadure. Du ure turugadu. Nou boe eimijera utugare romode nono tugimijera ro mogadure. Du ure turugadu. Boe emode ia boe etuo iedo “Mareboe” aino dukeje emode nowu imedu uwobe ekiedo aino jamedu. Mare ire inagoino. Taire inagoino jamedu. Boe etokire i nowu bope ie tabo. Etokimode tai jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Etoki kuricigomode tai rugadu tokire i dupiji rugadu.

Etokimode tai jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Etoki kuricigomode tai rugadu tokire i dupiji rugadu.

b: Mare tabagudukaba ece. Boe ero pegamode dukeje etaidumode tuwo nowu turo pegarewu biado boe epiji tumagowo ro pemegarewuge nuie pudumi. Mare Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu ero pegarewu ji dukodire boe eruduwamode nowu ero pegarewu ji jamedu.

b: Tu tagi taruduware ia ire taruduwado jiboe ji mare tamagodo nowu ire taruduwado jiboe ji boe ewiagai rugadu. Tamago pemegado ji boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo tamagore jiboe ji.

b: Boe Epagudukawo Ceboe Reo
source: Boe Epagudukawo Ceboe Reo

b: – Tabagudukaba boece. Boe emode tawido mare eragakare tuwo tawarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tabagudukaba ece. Tu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare umode boe ewarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto boe ewi keje. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Mare tabagudu remawu ji karega inagoino. Taragado tai rugadu tamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: – Tabagudukaba boece. Boe emode tawido mare eragakare tuwo tawarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tabagudukaba ece. Tu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare umode boe ewarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto boe ewi keje. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Mare tabagudu remawu ji karega inagoino. Taragado tai rugadu tamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ca kiebarege kugure emode pobe dukeje boe emode to diero torirogu udo mitotu je tuwo akirodo nowu kiebarege kugurei tugece tuwo kowuje. Nou kiebarege emori bokware mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare epiji rugadu. Ewudumodukare moto ka Pao Kurirewu mearudae piji.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu aidure tai du kodure nowu kiebarege kugure eiamedu boe ekori. Dukodire jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Joruduware tai rugadu. Joruduware tagao iku jamedu boe ji. Joruduware nowu inodurogu boe ji kodire joruduware nuba boe mode tai duji rugadu. Jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tabagudukawo boece rugadu.

Joruduware nowu inodurogu boe ji kodire joruduware nuba boe mode tai duji rugadu. Jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tabagudukawo boece rugadu.

b: Boe Ewo Boe Ewie Tumearutoruie Jesus ji
source: Boe Ewo Boe Ewie Tumearutoruie Jesus ji

b: – Iwo tawie iaboe ji pugeje. Ia boe emagomode boe eiamedu boe ewiagai tuie tumagu inai tumearutoruwo tu i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu biagai baru tada nowu mearutorure iwu nuie ema rugadu. Toro nowu Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu meri kejere imagomode aino ji.
source: – Iwo tawie iaboe ji pugeje. Ia boe emagomode boe eiamedu boe ewiagai tuie tumagu inai tumearutoruwo tu i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu biagai baru tada nowu mearutorure iwu nuie ema rugadu. Toro nowu Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu meri kejere imagomode aino ji.

b: Mare ia boe makomode boe ewiagai tugaie tumagu inai, tumearutorukaie i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu biagai baru tada nowu mearutorukare iwu nuie ema rugadu.

b: Tamearudaere itaregodure iwo boe epemegado pui. Ca itaregodure iwo boe pemegado boe ji rugadu. Mare ia boe emearutorumodukare i. Dukodire emearudaemodukare nono pumearudae mogadure imagore jiboe ji. Dukodire boe epemegamodukare pui.
source: Tamearudaere itaregodure iwo boe epemegado pui. Ca itaregodure iwo boe pemegado boe ji rugadu. Mare ia boe emearutorumodukare i. Dukodire emearudaemodukare nono pumearudae mogadure imagore jiboe ji. Dukodire boe epemegamodukare pui.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nuba boemode mearutorure iwuge ji. Aino nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Akore ime emearudaemodukare nono tuo mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuo mearudae pegamode nowu tore imei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono tuje mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuje mearudae pegamode nowu tore aremei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono turagomage emearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu eturago mage emearudae pegamode nowu tujarugo magei. Nou imedu uwobe erudu pegamode ji. Jorudu pegare jiwuge emode emage. – Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nuba boemode mearutorure iwuge ji. Aino nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Akore ime emearudaemodukare nono tuo mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuo mearudae pegamode nowu tore imei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono tuje mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuje mearudae pegamode nowu tore aremei. Jorudu pegare jiwuge emode emage. – Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu.

b: Iwo tawie pugeje. Boe emearudu kurimodukare i tuje kori, tuo kori, tore ime ekori, tore areme ekori, dukeje ukare turugadu iwo eruduwado imearudae ji.

b: Imearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu ji dukodire boe erudu pegare i, emode iwido. Boe etaidumode tuwo tumearutorudo imearudae ji dukeje ewo tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure. Emodukare tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure dukeje imodukare eruduwado imearudae ji.

b: Boe emearudae pemegare tuwo tuginorudo mare emearudaere tu pudui. Mare nowu eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare tuginorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra tumearudae piji, taidure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo i rugadu. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto.

Dukejere Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto.

b: Inure tawie. Ia boe eruduware tamearutorure i duji. Nono ekimadumode tagabo ekimadunure itabo jamedu. Ire eroino jamedu. Boe ekimadumode itabo ekimadunure ure itarego matowu Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Ire eroino Pao Kurirewu jire eroino jamedu.
