b: Iwo tawie rugadu. Boe eruduware mearutorure iwugei dukodire emode pobo maku etai ekuduwo ce. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei eroino du morice.
source: Iwo tawie rugadu. Boe eruduware mearutorure iwugei dukodire emode pobo maku etai ekuduwo ce. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei eroino du morice.

b: João Batista Ure Joruduwadowuge Ero Reo
source: João Batista Ure Joruduwadowuge Ero Reo

b: Jesus ure tumago akedudo nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje uture pugeje. Nou ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze. Ca uture Galiléia moto kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka tuwo boe eruduwado. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai tu tu je.
source: Jesus ure tumago akedudo nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje uture pugeje. Nou ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze. Ca uture Galiléia moto kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka tuwo boe eruduwado. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai tu tu je.

b: João Batista rakojere baicorewu tada. Boe ere João Batista bie nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Dukodire João Batista ure ia ture joruduwadowuge etudo toro Jesus bagai.
source: João Batista rakojere baicorewu tada. Boe ere João Batista bie nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Dukodire João Batista ure ia ture joruduwadowuge etudo toro Jesus bagai.

b: Makore ei enarawo Jesus ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie maku boe etaiwu boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu kana? Enarawo Jesus ji boe epagaiago ia bagai kimo kana? Dukodire eture Jesus ae rugadu. Enarare Jesus ji nono tugimijera makore pudui dumogadure rugadu.
source: Makore ei enarawo Jesus ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie maku boe etaiwu boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu kana? Enarawo Jesus ji boe epagaiago ia bagai kimo kana? Dukodire eture Jesus ae rugadu. Enarare Jesus ji nono tugimijera makore pudui dumogadure rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore tagirimi tawo João biedu pemegado rugadu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji tamearudure jiwu imagore jiboe ji.
source: Nono Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore tagirimi tawo João biedu pemegado rugadu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji tamearudure jiwu imagore jiboe ji.

b: Ire joku bokwarewuge epemegago etaiwowo pugeje. Ire pogora pegarewuge epemegago emeruwo pugeje. Ire kogodurewuge ewiri pegarewuge epemegago ewiri pemegawo pugeje. Ire bija bokwarewuge epemegago emearuduwo pugeje. Ire birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Ire marenarue doge ewie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregoduie rugadu.
source: Ire joku bokwarewuge epemegago etaiwowo pugeje. Ire pogora pegarewuge epemegago emeruwo pugeje. Ire kogodurewuge ewiri pegarewuge epemegago ewiri pemegawo pugeje. Ire bija bokwarewuge epemegago emearuduwo pugeje. Ire birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Ire marenarue doge ewie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregoduie rugadu.

b: Boe pemegamode nowu mearutorure iwu boe ji. Emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji nono egaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Boe pemegamode nowu mearutorure iwu boe ji. Emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji nono egaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Nou João Batista ure joruduwadowuge eture pugeje Jesus piji. Dukeje Jesus makore João Batista rore jiboe ji nowu rakojere pudabowuge boe ewiagai. Akore marigudu tadure jice boe akurugudu maerewu ka mare taruduwo bakuru jeture boebutu jitu bagai karega. Taruduwo ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe ewagai karega. Taruduwo oe kurirewuge ewagai karega. Nou ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe emugure bai kurirewu tada. Oe kurirewuge emugure bai kurirewu tada. Tadumode bai kurirewu ka nouge ewagai. Mare tadure boe maerewu ka. Tadure toro taruduwo João Batistaji. Taruduware João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jituji. Dukodire tadure toro boe maerewu ka João Batista bagai. Aino ca imode tawie. João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Mare imode tawie iaboe ji pugeje. João Batista rore nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu.
source: Nou João Batista ure joruduwadowuge eture pugeje Jesus piji. Dukeje Jesus makore João Batista rore jiboe ji nowu rakojere pudabowuge boe ewiagai. Akore marigudu tadure jice boe akurugudu maerewu ka mare taruduwo bakuru jeture boebutu jitu bagai karega. Taruduwo ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe ewagai karega. Taruduwo oe kurirewuge ewagai karega. Nou ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe emugure bai kurirewu tada. Oe kurirewuge emugure bai kurirewu tada. Tadumode bai kurirewu ka nouge ewagai. Mare tadure boe maerewu ka. Tadure toro taruduwo João Batistaji. Taruduware João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jituji. Dukodire tadure toro boe maerewu ka João Batista bagai. Aino ca imode tawie. João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Mare imode tawie iaboe ji pugeje. João Batista rore nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu.

b: Ia Boe Eda Kejewuge Ekiarigodukaie Turo Pegarewuji, Ekaie Tugera Ra Turo Pegarewu Piji

b: Nono Jesus mako pegare ia boe eda kejewuge ji. Jesus ure turo rakado boe egai nono nowu boe eda jamedu boe keje mare du inodu tabo nowu boe ekare tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Emearutorukare Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Jesus akore Iro rakare Corazim ba kurirewu keje iwo nowu boe eruduwado i. Dukodire erudure iro rakarewuji. Mare du inodu tabo emearutorukare i. Dukodire boe pegamode ei rugadu. Iro rakare Betsaida ba kurirewu keje iwo nowu boe eruduwado i. Erudure iro rakarewuji. Mare du inodu tabo emearutorukare i. Dukodire boe pegamode ei jamedu. Marigudu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Marigudu Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Nou Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge, nowu Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge erudumode iro rakarewu ji dukeje ekiarigodumode turo pegarewu ji rugadu. Emode tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Emode jorugudu bu taora keje tuwo boe eruduwado tugiarigodure turo pegarewu boe ji. Emode tugudau areia kwatorurewu tugu pudui tuwo boe eruduwado tugiarigodure turo pegarewu boe ji rugadu tumode tugera ra turo pegare jiboe piji duji. Mare erudukare i, erudukare iro rakarewu ji dukodire eruduwakare i. Ekare tugera ra turo pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare kocare Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge, Betsaida ba kurirewu kejewuge, erudure iro rakarewu ji mare du inodu tabo ekiarigodukare turo pegarewuji. Etaidukare tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji rugadu.

b: Bope Uwari Umode Tugirimi

b: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore bope uwari pegarewu umode tudawuje ia imedu piji dukeje utumode toro boe maerewu ka taiwo tabo tumode tamudo kejewu bagai. Jorudumodukare taidure jiboe ji dukeje mearudaemode tuwo tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae pugeje tuwo turemo to pugeje. Dukodire nowu bope uwari pegarewu umode tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae rugadu. Aregodumode dukeje jorudumode ji pemegare duji. Jorudumode ji ure nono tuwai moturewu umogadure.

Imedu Onaregedu umode tugirimi pugeje dukeje umode tudugarege baru tadawuge etudo tododai nowu mearutorure bope doge eimijera jiwuge ro pegarewuge ewagai. Emode to reko pui tuwiri boe kori koia.

b: Boe Etaiduwo Tuwo Tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce Nono Boe Etaidure Boe Enoe Mori Kurirewu Jitu Mogadure

Akore boe etaiduwo tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce nono boe etaidure biadodurewu tori kuieje mori kurirewu jitu mogadure. Nou tori kuieje tugudure mototo biadoduwo boe epiji. Toro ia meri keje imedu jorudure nowu biadodurewu tori kuiejeji nowu moto keje. Jakarere pudui rugadu. Mare utukare tabo raga. Ure tugu mototo pugeje jii tumode akirodo nowu moto jitu ka. Ainore rore tuwo tugeragu nowu tori kuieje mori kurirewu ji toce. Mare tori kuieje ji karega Jesus akoino. Boe ewo tuwia ra tumearudae jamedu boe piji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tuwo tugimijerado ema. Dujire akoino.

b: Ia meri keje Herodes ure tuwadae towuje tuwiabutuwo tuwudure kejewu ariji meri ji. Nou uwadae keje nowu aredu Herodias onaregedu aredu rerure boe eiamedu boe egai. Moture rugadu. Ure Herodes jakaredo pudui rugadu.
source: Ia meri keje Herodes ure tuwadae towuje tuwiabutuwo tuwudure kejewu ariji meri ji. Nou uwadae keje nowu aredu Herodias onaregedu aredu rerure boe eiamedu boe egai. Moture rugadu. Ure Herodes jakaredo pudui rugadu.

b: Nono Herodes makore nowu nogwareduji. Akore amearutorudo i. Imode akogwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku akai rugadu.
source: Nono Herodes makore nowu nogwareduji. Akore amearutorudo i. Imode akogwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku akai rugadu.

b: Dukodire nogwaredu uture tuje bagai okituwawo pudui nuba turowo nuba togwamaguduwo Herodiji. Uce okituware ji dukodire okwamagudure João Batista aora bagai paduwo ia baku keje kuri aino rugadu.
source: Dukodire nogwaredu uture tuje bagai okituwawo pudui nuba turowo nuba togwamaguduwo Herodiji. Uce okituware ji dukodire okwamagudure João Batista aora bagai paduwo ia baku keje kuri aino rugadu.

b: Boe eimijera Herodes kiarigodure. Makore nowu boe egai tumoduie nowu nogwaredu okwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku ai rugadu. Nou makore bagaiboe makudumode ai rugadu.
source: Boe eimijera Herodes kiarigodure. Makore nowu boe egai tumoduie nowu nogwaredu okwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku ai rugadu. Nou makore bagaiboe makudumode ai rugadu.

b: Nono ca makore tugobaigaregei ewo João Batista aora kado nowu baicorewu tada rugadu.
source: Nono ca makore tugobaigaregei ewo João Batista aora kado nowu baicorewu tada rugadu.

b: Dukodire tugobaigarege etaregodure aora tabo. Padure baku keje rugadu. Nono ca ere maku nowu nogwaredu ai. Dukejere ure reko toro tuje ae rugadu.
source: Dukodire tugobaigarege etaregodure aora tabo. Padure baku keje rugadu. Nono ca ere maku nowu nogwaredu ai. Dukejere ure reko toro tuje ae rugadu.

b: Nono João Batista utugarege etaregodure tugimijera birewu ka. Nono ere tugeragu tugimijera biji. Ere reko toro to moto ka tuwo tugu mototo. Dukodire eture toro tureadoduwo Jesus biagai.
source: Nono João Batista utugarege etaregodure tugimijera birewu ka. Nono ere tugeragu tugimijera biji. Ere reko toro to moto ka tuwo tugu mototo. Dukodire eture toro tureadoduwo Jesus biagai.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo
source: Jesus Ure Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo

b: Joruduware boe pegare João Batista jituji. Dukodire care Jesus ure tudawuje nowu boe epiji. Nono ure taredo ika kurirewuto tuduwo nowu boe maerewu ka turagojewo nono tuginaigodu. Du inodu tabo nowu boe makarewuge eruduware kaiba rakojere. Tieda pijire nowu boe eture tuwure tabo Jesus rekodaji.
source: Joruduware boe pegare João Batista jituji. Dukodire care Jesus ure tudawuje nowu boe epiji. Nono ure taredo ika kurirewuto tuduwo nowu boe maerewu ka turagojewo nono tuginaigodu. Du inodu tabo nowu boe makarewuge eruduware kaiba rakojere. Tieda pijire nowu boe eture tuwure tabo Jesus rekodaji.

b: Ca Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji. Aiwore, jorudure boe emagare duji. Okudugodure ebo rugadu. Nono ca iogore nowu kogodurewugei, nowu mugure nonowugei jamedu.
source: Ca Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji. Aiwore, jorudure boe emagare duji. Okudugodure ebo rugadu. Nono ca iogore nowu kogodurewugei, nowu mugure nonowugei jamedu.

b: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae merirekodutabo. Ca egore Merirekodu. Awu boe etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Emearudaere tuwo nowu boe etudo ia boe etae ewo tugeragu ia tuge roguji.
source: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae merirekodutabo. Ca egore Merirekodu. Awu boe etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Emearudaere tuwo nowu boe etudo ia boe etae ewo tugeragu ia tuge roguji.

b: Dukeje Jesus makogodure ewadaru jipagi. Akore nou boe etumodukare. Taigoiare tamode enogwagedo.
source: Dukeje Jesus makogodure ewadaru jipagi. Akore nou boe etumodukare. Taigoiare tamode enogwagedo.

b: Ca egore cege amirewure ikera aboudure tu je. Cege karorogu ere pobetu je jamedu.
source: Ca egore cege amirewure ikera aboudure tu je. Cege karorogu ere pobetu je jamedu.

b: Jesus akore arego mato itae.
source: Jesus akore arego mato itae.

b: Nono ca makore nowu boe ji ewo tumugudo boebutu keje. Dukeje ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji nowu kare kugurei jamedu. Nono ca aiwore baru to. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo uwo nowu amirewu nowu kare kugure eidodudo. Nono ca ure nowu amirewu kado puiato. Ca ure maku tudugarege etai ewo pedo boe ji.
source: Nono ca makore nowu boe ji ewo tumugudo boebutu keje. Dukeje ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji nowu kare kugurei jamedu. Nono ca aiwore baru to. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo uwo nowu amirewu nowu kare kugure eidodudo. Nono ca ure nowu amirewu kado puiato. Ca ure maku tudugarege etai ewo pedo boe ji.

b: Nono ca eiamedu boe enogwagere. Nono ca ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu. Ca nowu utugarege ere nowu kadarabo doge korau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo dogere enodo padu kejeboere doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.
source: Nono ca eiamedu boe enogwagere. Nono ca ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu. Ca nowu utugarege ere nowu kadarabo doge korau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo dogere enodo padu kejeboere doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.

b: Nou okwagerewuge ime enodo padu kejeboere cinco mil. Ekare areme eremagu. Ekare etore eremagu jamedu.
source: Nou okwagerewuge ime enodo padu kejeboere cinco mil. Ekare areme eremagu. Ekare etore eremagu jamedu.

b: Jesus Merure Pobo Aoji
source: Jesus Merure Pobo Aoji

b: Kuri je dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei etuwo pobo maerewu okwa ka ewo turemo ika kurirewuto etuwo tododai. Ekurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu kajeje toro bakowu ka. Jesus rakojere eiageje tumago tabo nowu boe ji tuwo etudo.
source: Kuri je dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei etuwo pobo maerewu okwa ka ewo turemo ika kurirewuto etuwo tododai. Ekurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu kajeje toro bakowu ka. Jesus rakojere eiageje tumago tabo nowu boe ji tuwo etudo.

b: Ure boe etudo dukeje Jesus ruture ia tori ao ka tumagowo Pao Kurirewu ji tuginaigodu. Nono ca boecodure. Mare Jesus mugu kimore nono tuginaigodu kimo.
source: Ure boe etudo dukeje Jesus ruture ia tori ao ka tumagowo Pao Kurirewu ji tuginaigodu. Nono ca boecodure. Mare Jesus mugu kimore nono tuginaigodu kimo.

b: Dukeje care nowu ure joruduwadowuge ekodure tabowu ika kurirewu mugu kimore pobo maerewu oiadada rugadu. Nono bakuru jore etogi dukodire nowu pobo jetu rakare nowu ika kurirewu ji rugadu.
source: Dukeje care nowu ure joruduwadowuge ekodure tabowu ika kurirewu mugu kimore pobo maerewu oiadada rugadu. Nono bakuru jore etogi dukodire nowu pobo jetu rakare nowu ika kurirewu ji rugadu.

b: Toro baregodutabo, Jesus uture toro tumeru tabo pobo aoji.
source: Toro baregodutabo, Jesus uture toro tumeru tabo pobo aoji.

b: Dukeje nowu utugarege erudure Jesus merure pobo ao jituji. Dukodire etokudure tubagudu koia. egore Parudure ia boe pegarewuji!
source: Dukeje nowu utugarege erudure Jesus merure pobo ao jituji. Dukodire etokudure tubagudu koia. egore Parudure ia boe pegarewuji!

b: Mare Jesus akore Taragado tai! Imi rugadu reo. Tabagudukaba.
source: Mare Jesus akore Taragado tai! Imi rugadu reo. Tabagudukaba.

b: Nono Pedro makore Ikimijera mode aki rugadu dukeje imerudo pobo aoji jii toro akae.
source: Nono Pedro makore Ikimijera mode aki rugadu dukeje imerudo pobo aoji jii toro akae.

b: Jesus akore Mato. Dukodire care Pedro ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje care merure pobo aoji jii toro Jesus ae jamedu.
source: Jesus akore Mato. Dukodire care Pedro ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje care merure pobo aoji jii toro Jesus ae jamedu.

b: Mare puredugodure Jesus ae dukeje jorudure bakuru rakare pudui duji. Dukeje ca pagudugodure. Nono ure tuwogwaiago poboto dukeje ca kudugodure. Akore ikimijera! Akeragu ikeraji! Iwogwakawo poboto!
source: Mare puredugodure Jesus ae dukeje jorudure bakuru rakare pudui duji. Dukeje ca pagudugodure. Nono ure tuwogwaiago poboto dukeje ca kudugodure. Akore ikimijera! Akeragu ikeraji! Iwogwakawo poboto!

b: Kuri je Jesus ure tugera raido. Nono ca ure tugera kogudo Pedro iera kajeje. Makore Pedro ji. Akore ca amearutoru biagare tu je. Kodiba amororamagadure iwadaru boe ji? Amearutorukanure i pugeje?
source: Kuri je Jesus ure tugera raido. Nono ca ure tugera kogudo Pedro iera kajeje. Makore Pedro ji. Akore ca amearutoru biagare tu je. Kodiba amororamagadure iwadaru boe ji? Amearutorukanure i pugeje?

b: Nono ca ei pobedu ere turemo ika kurirewuto. Nono ca bakuru akedure jamedu.
source: Nono ca ei pobedu ere turemo ika kurirewuto. Nono ca bakuru akedure jamedu.

b: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Jesus ji rugadu. egore Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure aki rugadu.
source: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Jesus ji rugadu. egore Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure aki rugadu.

b: Jesus Iogore Boei Genesaré Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Jesus Iogore Boei Genesaré Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: J e s u s k u r u g o d u r e t u r e joruduwadowugebo pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje etaregodure Genesaré ba kurirewu ka.
source: J e s u s k u r u g o d u r e t u r e joruduwadowugebo pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje etaregodure Genesaré ba kurirewu ka.

b: Boe eruduware Jesus ji dukodi ca ere mugure puredure puduiwuge kogodurewuge ewie. Dukeje care nowu boe ere kogodurewuge erego toro Jesus ae.
source: Boe eruduware Jesus ji dukodi ca ere mugure puredure puduiwuge kogodurewuge ewie. Dukeje care nowu boe ere kogodurewuge erego toro Jesus ae.

b: Boe enogwamagudure Jesus ji nowu kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu nowu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje. Nou ure tugera bu ukudau areia okwa kejewuge epemegagodure rugadu.
source: Boe enogwamagudure Jesus ji nowu kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu nowu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje. Nou ure tugera bu ukudau areia okwa kejewuge epemegagodure rugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Nou Judeu Doge Eroiaji
source: Jesus Makore Nou Judeu Doge Eroiaji

b: Ca ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jerusalém piji. Nouia joruduware bakaru jiwuge jamedu etaregodure Jerusalém piji jamedu tumagowo Jesus ji. Ca enarare ji.
source: Ca ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jerusalém piji. Nouia joruduware bakaru jiwuge jamedu etaregodure Jerusalém piji jamedu tumagowo Jesus ji. Ca enarare ji.

b: egore kodiba atugarege enogwagere tugera rorogodu tabo? Emearutorukare nowu jaoboe emagore jiboe ji. Erokare nono jaoboe ero mogadure.
source: egore kodiba atugarege enogwagere tugera rorogodu tabo? Emearutorukare nowu jaoboe emagore jiboe ji. Erokare nono jaoboe ero mogadure.

b: Jesus makogodure ei. Akore kodiba tamearutorukare Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe ji? Tagodure tu nowu tamearudae rekodaji.
source: Jesus makogodure ei. Akore kodiba tamearutorukare Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe ji? Tagodure tu nowu tamearudae rekodaji.

b: Ca Pao Kurirewu akore Tamearutorudo taoji, tajeji. Ca nowu boe mako pegamode tuoji, tujeji tuwo epogurudo dukeje bitoduiago.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore jawu tawobei.
source: Ca Pao Kurirewu akore Tamearutorudo taoji, tajeji. Ca nowu boe mako pegamode tuoji, tujeji tuwo epogurudo dukeje bitoduiago.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore jawu tawobei.

b: Mare tagi tare boe eruduwado ia bataru tuginaiwuji boe ekawo tugera maku tuwo ai tuje ai. Tagagore imedu makomoduie tujeji tuoji tumodukaie tugera maku etai tumoduie toe maku Pao Kurirewu ai kodi. Dukodire tumodukaie tugera maku tuwo ai tuje ai. Ainore boe eromoduie. Mare pagare egoino. Etaidukare tuwo tugera maku tuwo ai tuje ai dukodire egoino. Taigoiare tare boe egodo aino. Dukodire care tagaidukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Tamearutorukare ji. Tagaidure tagoduwo tu nowu tamearudae rekodaji.
source: Mare tagi tare boe eruduwado ia bataru tuginaiwuji boe ekawo tugera maku tuwo ai tuje ai. Tagagore imedu makomoduie tujeji tuoji tumodukaie tugera maku etai tumoduie toe maku Pao Kurirewu ai kodi. Dukodire tumodukaie tugera maku tuwo ai tuje ai. Ainore boe eromoduie. Mare pagare egoino. Etaidukare tuwo tugera maku tuwo ai tuje ai dukodire egoino. Taigoiare tare boe egodo aino. Dukodire care tagaidukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Tamearutorukare ji. Tagaidure tagoduwo tu nowu tamearudae rekodaji.

b: Ca tamagore boe ji tawo boe eruduwado. Mare tamearutorukare tagagoino jiboe ji. Tagodu pegare nowu tagagoino jiboe ji tarore jiboe ji rugadu. Mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Imedu Isaías mako pemegare. Makore ainore taromode rugadu duji. Akore:
source: Ca tamagore boe ji tawo boe eruduwado. Mare tamearutorukare tagagoino jiboe ji. Tagodu pegare nowu tagagoino jiboe ji tarore jiboe ji rugadu. Mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Imedu Isaías mako pemegare. Makore ainore taromode rugadu duji. Akore:

b: – Pao Kurirewu akore awu boe emagore togwa tabo tumearutoruie i mare nowu boe rugadu boe emearudae remawu ure tuginai rugadu toro imearudae piji rugadu.
source: – Pao Kurirewu akore awu boe emagore togwa tabo tumearutoruie i mare nowu boe rugadu boe emearudae remawu ure tuginai rugadu toro imearudae piji rugadu.

b: Awu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i mare pagare egoino. Ere boe eruduwado bakaruji. Egore iwadaruie. Mare pagare egoino. Ia tumagore jiwu bakaru jire nowu boe egoino rugadu.”
source: Awu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i mare pagare egoino. Ere boe eruduwado bakaruji. Egore iwadaruie. Mare pagare egoino. Ia tumagore jiwu bakaru jire nowu boe egoino rugadu.”

b: Jesus makore boe makarewuge etae ewo bato pui pudae. Akore tawiapagado. Taruduwado.
source: Jesus makore boe makarewuge etae ewo bato pui pudae. Akore tawiapagado. Taruduwado.

b: Nou tagwagemode jiboe umodukare tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumodukare mugure tagabowu tago bakaru piji rugadu. Mare nowu taiabijiwu tawadaru pegarewu emare umode tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumode mugure tagabowu tago bakaru piji rugadu jii toro rugadu.
source: Nou tagwagemode jiboe umodukare tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumodukare mugure tagabowu tago bakaru piji rugadu. Mare nowu taiabijiwu tawadaru pegarewu emare umode tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumode mugure tagabowu tago bakaru piji rugadu jii toro rugadu.

b: Ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere tuburedo ji. egore nou fariseu doge ekorigodure nowu amagore cei jiboe ji.
source: Ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere tuburedo ji. egore nou fariseu doge ekorigodure nowu amagore cei jiboe ji.

b: Ca Jesus makore pugeje. Akore nou baru tadawu Iogwa ukare tuguwu iguru rugadu boe tawujedumode. Mare iguru ji karega inagoino. Nou fariseu doge eire inagoino.
source: Ca Jesus makore pugeje. Akore nou baru tadawu Iogwa ukare tuguwu iguru rugadu boe tawujedumode. Mare iguru ji karega inagoino. Nou fariseu doge eire inagoino.

b: Dukodire tamororamagadukaba nowu fariseu dogei. Eku bokware. Mare nowu joku bokwarewu iera bararemode nowu timedia joku bokwarewu ji dukeje ei pobedu ewudumode nowu boeiakoto. Mare eku bokwa ji karega inagoino. Emearudae pegare nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu piji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Dukodire tamororamagadukaba nowu fariseu dogei. Eku bokware. Mare nowu joku bokwarewu iera bararemode nowu timedia joku bokwarewu ji dukeje ei pobedu ewudumode nowu boeiakoto. Mare eku bokwa ji karega inagoino. Emearudae pegare nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu piji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ca Pedro okwamagudure: – Ceruduwado nowu akagoino mariguduboe jiboe ji cewiagai.
source: Ca Pedro okwamagudure: – Ceruduwado nowu akagoino mariguduboe jiboe ji cewiagai.

b: Jesus akore Kocare tagaora rakare taruduwagoduwo boe remawu ji?
source: Jesus akore Kocare tagaora rakare taruduwagoduwo boe remawu ji?

b: Nou tagwagere jiboe utumode tagurito mare umode tudawuje tabiji.
source: Nou tagwagere jiboe utumode tagurito mare umode tudawuje tabiji.

b: Mare nowu umode tudawuje taiabijiwu tawadaru aregodumode nowu tamearudae piji. Nou inodu koiare umode boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.
source: Mare nowu umode tudawuje taiabijiwu tawadaru aregodumode nowu tamearudae piji. Nou inodu koiare umode boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.

b: Du nowu tamearudae pegarewu aregodumode tabiji rugadu. Nou umode boe ewidowu, nowu jeribarimode toreduje pijiwu toredu pijiwu, nowu umode turo pegarewu tieribari tabowu, nowu iwogurewu, nowu umode boe ekiripagadowu, nowu mako pegamode timedia ro jiwu.
source: Du nowu tamearudae pegarewu aregodumode tabiji rugadu. Nou umode boe ewidowu, nowu jeribarimode toreduje pijiwu toredu pijiwu, nowu umode turo pegarewu tieribari tabowu, nowu iwogurewu, nowu umode boe ekiripagadowu, nowu mako pegamode timedia ro jiwu.

b: Awu boe ero pegarewu koiare umode boe epegado rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji rugadu. Mare boe enogwagemode tugera rorogodutabo du umodukare boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai.
source: Awu boe ero pegarewu koiare umode boe epegado rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji rugadu. Mare boe enogwagemode tugera rorogodutabo du umodukare boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai.

b: Aredu Tuginaiwudo
source: Aredu Tuginaiwudo

b: Jesus ure tudawuje nowu boe piji nono utu puredure nouia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda mugu puredure nowu Tiro ba kurirewuji, nowu Sidom ba kurirewu ji jamedu.
source: Jesus ure tudawuje nowu boe piji nono utu puredure nouia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda mugu puredure nowu Tiro ba kurirewuji, nowu Sidom ba kurirewu ji jamedu.

b: Ca nouia aredu cananeu kejewudo mugure nowu moto kejewudo ure tuburedo Jesus ae. Ca kudugodure boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore ikimijeranure aki. Jawu boe eimijera kurirewu Davi onaregedunure aki. Ca akogududo itabo. Bope meture itonaregedu aredu tada. Ro pega kigodure ji dukodire boe pegare ji rugadu. Awo nowu bope tawuje itonaregedu piji.
source: Ca nouia aredu cananeu kejewudo mugure nowu moto kejewudo ure tuburedo Jesus ae. Ca kudugodure boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore ikimijeranure aki. Jawu boe eimijera kurirewu Davi onaregedunure aki. Ca akogududo itabo. Bope meture itonaregedu aredu tada. Ro pega kigodure ji dukodire boe pegare ji rugadu. Awo nowu bope tawuje itonaregedu piji.

b: Mare Jesus makokare boe ji. Dukodire care ure joruduwadowuge etaregodu puredure ae. Ca egore awu aredu utudo pabiji. Ukare boe kiorodo paregodaji.
source: Mare Jesus makokare boe ji. Dukodire care ure joruduwadowuge etaregodu puredure ae. Ca egore awu aredu utudo pabiji. Ukare boe kiorodo paregodaji.

b: Ca Jesus makogodure: – Imi itaregodure woe itaiwowo nowu Israel doge egu ovelha okwarewuge ewagai. Mare ovelha ji karega inagoino. Israel moto kejewu mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eire inagoino.
source: Ca Jesus makogodure: – Imi itaregodure woe itaiwowo nowu Israel doge egu ovelha okwarewuge ewagai. Mare ovelha ji karega inagoino. Israel moto kejewu mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eire inagoino.

b: Ca nowu aredu aregodure. Ca ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus bure keje. Ca akore akera maku inai.
source: Ca nowu aredu aregodure. Ca ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus bure keje. Ca akore akera maku inai.

b: Jesus akore Ukare turugadu boe ewo tore ekerogu tawuje epiji tuwo maku tagu ariga doge etai.
source: Jesus akore Ukare turugadu boe ewo tore ekerogu tawuje epiji tuwo maku tagu ariga doge etai.

b: Ca aredu makogodure: – Boe rugadu. Mare ariga doge emode nowu buture nowu ira kudawu boe eke gigudu rugadu boe kowuje.
source: Ca aredu makogodure: – Boe rugadu. Mare ariga doge emode nowu buture nowu ira kudawu boe eke gigudu rugadu boe kowuje.

b: Ca Jesus akore aino nowu areduji. Akore aredu. Amearutoru kurire i rugadu. Nou akaidure bagaiboe todumode rugadu. Ca kuri je nowu aredu onaregedu pemegagodure rugadu.
source: Ca Jesus akore aino nowu areduji. Akore aredu. Amearutoru kurire i rugadu. Nou akaidure bagaiboe todumode rugadu. Ca kuri je nowu aredu onaregedu pemegagodure rugadu.

b: Jesus Iogore Boe Makarewugei
source: Jesus Iogore Boe Makarewugei

b: Jesus ure tudawuje nowu boe epiji. Nono uture toro nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nono Jesus kodure nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwaji. Nono ca ruture nouia tori ao ka. Ca ure tumugudo nono.
source: Jesus ure tudawuje nowu boe epiji. Nono uture toro nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nono Jesus kodure nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwaji. Nono ca ruture nouia tori ao ka. Ca ure tumugudo nono.

b: Nono ca boe makarewuge eture Jesus ae. Ere nowu kogodurewuge erego toro Jesus ae. Nou joku bokwarewuge, nowu mako bokwarewuge, nowu meru bokwarewuge, nowu pogora pegarewuge, nowu kana pegarewuge, nowu kogodurewuge jamedu ere erego toro Jesus ae. Nono Jesus iogore eiamedu boe ji.
source: Nono ca boe makarewuge eture Jesus ae. Ere nowu kogodurewuge erego toro Jesus ae. Nou joku bokwarewuge, nowu mako bokwarewuge, nowu meru bokwarewuge, nowu pogora pegarewuge, nowu kana pegarewuge, nowu kogodurewuge jamedu ere erego toro Jesus ae. Nono Jesus iogore eiamedu boe ji.

b: Nou boe erore ta je erudure nowu mako bokwarewuge emagore duji, nowu kana pegarewuge nowu pogora pegarewuge epemegagodure duji, nowu meru bokwarewuge emerure duji, nowu joku bokwarewuge etaiwore duji. Nono ca nowu boe emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. egore israel moto kejewu pawobe emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare pai rugadu.
source: Nou boe erore ta je erudure nowu mako bokwarewuge emagore duji, nowu kana pegarewuge nowu pogora pegarewuge epemegagodure duji, nowu meru bokwarewuge emerure duji, nowu joku bokwarewuge etaiwore duji. Nono ca nowu boe emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. egore israel moto kejewu pawobe emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare pai rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Ia Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo Jamedu
source: Jesus Ure Ia Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo Jamedu

b: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Nono ca makore ei. Akore inogudugodure awu boebo. Merire pobe metia bokware ei woe itabo. Woe boe eke bokware rugadu ewo ko. Itaidukare iwo etudo tuguri bioro tabo. Eragamodukare tumeruwo awara ji tuguri bioro tabo.
source: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Nono ca makore ei. Akore inogudugodure awu boebo. Merire pobe metia bokware ei woe itabo. Woe boe eke bokware rugadu ewo ko. Itaidukare iwo etudo tuguri bioro tabo. Eragamodukare tumeruwo awara ji tuguri bioro tabo.

b: Nono ca Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nowu boe emagaie nono dukodire enaragodure nuba turomoduie nowu boe maerewuto boe eke bagai nowu boe ekeje.
source: Nono ca Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nowu boe emagaie nono dukodire enaragodure nuba turomoduie nowu boe maerewuto boe eke bagai nowu boe ekeje.

b: Jesus akore Nuba tage amirewu rogure tu je? egore amirewu oto padure sete. Kare kugure enowarore tu je.
source: Jesus akore Nuba tage amirewu rogure tu je? egore amirewu oto padure sete. Kare kugure enowarore tu je.

b: Nono ca Jesus makore nowu boe ewo tumugudo moto keje.
source: Nono ca Jesus makore nowu boe ewo tumugudo moto keje.

b: Nono ca ure tugeragu nowu sete amirewu ji nowu kare kugurei jamedu. Nono ca imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo jamedu uwo nowu amirewu nowu kare kugure eidodudo. Nono ca ure kado puiato. Ure maku nowu ture joruduwadowuge etai. Nono ere reko nowu boe etae. Ere pedo boe ji rugadu.
source: Nono ca ure tugeragu nowu sete amirewu ji nowu kare kugurei jamedu. Nono ca imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo jamedu uwo nowu amirewu nowu kare kugure eidodudo. Nono ca ure kado puiato. Ure maku nowu ture joruduwadowuge etai. Nono ere reko nowu boe etae. Ere pedo boe ji rugadu.

b: Nono ca nowu boe eiamedu boe enogwagere rugadu. Egarere pudui rugadu tuguredure duji. Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere kadarabo korobadurewugedo sete nowu boe eke kobo tabo.
source: Nono ca nowu boe eiamedu boe enogwagere rugadu. Egarere pudui rugadu tuguredure duji. Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere kadarabo korobadurewugedo sete nowu boe eke kobo tabo.

b: Nou okwagerewuge boe enodo padu kejeboere quatro mil ime. Aremere jamedu. Boe etore kugurere jamedu.
source: Nou okwagerewuge boe enodo padu kejeboere quatro mil ime. Aremere jamedu. Boe etore kugurere jamedu.

b: Nono ca Jesus makore nowu boe ji etuwo. Ca ure taredo nowu ika kurirewuto. Nono ca uture nowu pobo maerewu kajeje toro nowu Magadã ba kurirewu ka.
source: Nono ca Jesus makore nowu boe ji etuwo. Ca ure taredo nowu ika kurirewuto. Nono ca uture nowu pobo maerewu kajeje toro nowu Magadã ba kurirewu ka.

b: Enogwamagudure Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewu Bagai
source: Enogwamagudure Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewu Bagai

b: Nouia fariseu doge nouia saduceu doge jamedu eture tumagowo Jesus ji. Etaidure tuioruduwawo nouia ro rakarewu bagai. Dukeje enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.
source: Nouia fariseu doge nouia saduceu doge jamedu eture tumagowo Jesus ji. Etaidure tuioruduwawo nouia ro rakarewu bagai. Dukeje enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.

b: Mare Jesus makogodure: – Baru kujagure merirekodutabo dukeje tamagore boe pemegamoduie baru kujaguie dukodi. Bubutumodukaie barogwato. Ainore tagagore. Ainore taruduware.
source: Mare Jesus makogodure: – Baru kujagure merirekodutabo dukeje tamagore boe pemegamoduie baru kujaguie dukodi. Bubutumodukaie barogwato. Ainore tagagore. Ainore taruduware.

b: Mare baru kujagumode braekododutabo dukeje tagagore bubutumoduie baru kujagure boe tugure dukodi. Taruduware tagaiwowo baru to. Taruduware boetugu umode bubutudo. Kocare iro rakare jiboe ukare taruduwado Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji?
source: Mare baru kujagumode braekododutabo dukeje tagagore bubutumoduie baru kujagure boe tugure dukodi. Taruduware tagaiwowo baru to. Taruduware boetugu umode bubutudo. Kocare iro rakare jiboe ukare taruduwado Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji?

b: Tagi taro pegare tamearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire tagogwamagudure ia iro rakarewu bagai mare pagatu je. Ca marigudu jawu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Jonas jiboere makudumode tagai. Mare boemode i nono boe moga Jonas jitu mogadure jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire boe eruduwamode i rugadu. Mare du inodu tabo tamearutorumodukare i. Tamagore i iwo ia iro rakarewu tawuje taegai. Mare pagatu jere tagagoino. Dukodire iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji taegai pugeje. Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo dukeje ure tudawuje epiji. Ca uture.
source: Tagi taro pegare tamearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire tagogwamagudure ia iro rakarewu bagai mare pagatu je. Ca marigudu jawu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Jonas jiboere makudumode tagai. Mare boemode i nono boe moga Jonas jitu mogadure jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire boe eruduwamode i rugadu. Mare du inodu tabo tamearutorumodukare i. Tamagore i iwo ia iro rakarewu tawuje taegai. Mare pagatu jere tagagoino. Dukodire iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji taegai pugeje. Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo dukeje ure tudawuje epiji. Ca uture.

b: Fariseu Doge Saduceu Doge Ero Pegarewu Reo
source: Fariseu Doge Saduceu Doge Ero Pegarewu Reo

b: Dukeje nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekurugodure Jesus apo toro nouia pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nono ewiagodure tuwo nouia tuge amirewu towuje.
source: Dukeje nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekurugodure Jesus apo toro nouia pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nono ewiagodure tuwo nouia tuge amirewu towuje.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore tamearuduwadudo tai nowu fariseu doge nowu saduceu doge eno fermentuji.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore tamearuduwadudo tai nowu fariseu doge nowu saduceu doge eno fermentuji.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui kaba jiba akoino nowu fermento jiboe ji. Nono egore pui: – Pawiagodure page amirewu piji dukodire pagimijera akoino pai.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui kaba jiba akoino nowu fermento jiboe ji. Nono egore pui: – Pawiagodure page amirewu piji dukodire pagimijera akoino pai.

b: Jesus joruduware egoino pui duji. Nono unaragodure ei. Akore kodiba tamagore pui nowu tage amirewu bokwaie duji? Tamearutoru kurikare. Tamearutoru biagare tu je.
source: Jesus joruduware egoino pui duji. Nono unaragodure ei. Akore kodiba tamagore pui nowu tage amirewu bokwaie duji? Tamearutoru kurikare. Tamearutoru biagare tu je.

b: Kocare taruduwa bokware kimo. Tawiabutudo nowu irore jiboe keje nowu amirewurogu ure ikera aboudure tu je. Dutabore ire boe enogwagedo nowu ime enodo padure cinco mil. Ca nuba tare nowu kadarabo dogedo nowu boe eke kobo tabo?
source: Kocare taruduwa bokware kimo. Tawiabutudo nowu irore jiboe keje nowu amirewurogu ure ikera aboudure tu je. Dutabore ire boe enogwagedo nowu ime enodo padure cinco mil. Ca nuba tare nowu kadarabo dogedo nowu boe eke kobo tabo?

b: Ca ia meri keje pugeje nowu amirewu doge enodo padure sete boe etai pugeje du nowu ime enodo padure quatro mil. Ca nuba tare nowu kadarabo dogedo nowu boe eke kobo tabo?
source: Ca ia meri keje pugeje nowu amirewu doge enodo padure sete boe etai pugeje du nowu ime enodo padure quatro mil. Ca nuba tare nowu kadarabo dogedo nowu boe eke kobo tabo?

b: Kocare taruduwakare kimo imago karegure amirewu jiboe ji. Imagore tai tamearuduwaduwo tai nowu fariseu doge nowu saduceu doge emearudaere jiboe ji. Emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Mare fermento ji karega inagoino. Emearudaere jiboe jire inagoino.
source: Kocare taruduwakare kimo imago karegure amirewu jiboe ji. Imagore tai tamearuduwaduwo tai nowu fariseu doge nowu saduceu doge emearudaere jiboe ji. Emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Mare fermento ji karega inagoino. Emearudaere jiboe jire inagoino.

b: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere tuwia tugu boeto nowu Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Dukodire eruduwagodure makore pudui jiboe ji. Eruduwagodure fermento remawu ji karega akoino duji. Mare nowu fariseu doge nowu saduceu doge ere boe eruduwado jiboe jire akoino. Dujire Jesus akoino ture joruduwadowugei emearudu waduwo pudui rugadu.
source: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere tuwia tugu boeto nowu Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Dukodire eruduwagodure makore pudui jiboe ji. Eruduwagodure fermento remawu ji karega akoino duji. Mare nowu fariseu doge nowu saduceu doge ere boe eruduwado jiboe jire akoino. Dujire Jesus akoino ture joruduwadowugei emearudu waduwo pudui rugadu.

b: Pedro Akore umoduie Boe Ekinorudowu Nuie Jesusce Rugadu
source: Pedro Akore umoduie Boe Ekinorudowu Nuie Jesusce Rugadu

b: Jesus uture ia moto ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Etaregodure toro dukeje ure tuwuredo ebo. Epuredure nowu Cesaréia Filipe ba kurirewuji. Nono ca Jesus unaragodure nowu ture joruduwadowugei nuba boe emearudaere nowu Imedu Onaregeduji.
source: Jesus uture ia moto ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Etaregodure toro dukeje ure tuwuredo ebo. Epuredure nowu Cesaréia Filipe ba kurirewuji. Nono ca Jesus unaragodure nowu ture joruduwadowugei nuba boe emearudaere nowu Imedu Onaregeduji.

b: Emage emagogodure: – Boe egore João Batista nuie aki. Nouiage egore elias nuie aki. Nouiage egore Jeremias nuie aki. Nouiage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu nuie aki.
source: Emage emagogodure: – Boe egore João Batista nuie aki. Nouiage egore elias nuie aki. Nouiage egore Jeremias nuie aki. Nouiage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu nuie aki.

b: Jesus unaragodure ei pugeje. Akore tagi. Nuba tamearudaere i?
source: Jesus unaragodure ei pugeje. Akore tagi. Nuba tamearudaere i?

b: Nono ca Simão Pedro makogodure. Akore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki rugadu. Pao Kurirewu remawu onaregedunure aki rugadu.
source: Nono ca Simão Pedro makogodure. Akore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki rugadu. Pao Kurirewu remawu onaregedunure aki rugadu.

b: Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore akiere Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Boe remawu jire akagoino. Mare boe ekare aruduwado. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure aruduwado aino. Dukodire boe pemegare ai rugadu.
source: Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore akiere Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Boe remawu jire akagoino. Mare boe ekare aruduwado. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure aruduwado aino. Dukodire boe pemegare ai rugadu.

b: Dukodire inagoino ai akire akiere Pedro. Awu tori tabore imode iwai towuje. Mare iwai ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge emagagodumode. Dujire inagoino. Imode emagagodudo rugadu. Bope doge etaidumode turo pegawo ei. Mare du inodu tabo boe emagamode tumearutorure i dutabo rugadu.
source: Dukodire inagoino ai akire akiere Pedro. Awu tori tabore imode iwai towuje. Mare iwai ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge emagagodumode. Dujire inagoino. Imode emagagodudo rugadu. Bope doge etaidumode turo pegawo ei. Mare du inodu tabo boe emagamode tumearutorure i dutabo rugadu.

b: Nono imode mugure baru tadawu chave maku akai. Mare chave ji karega inagoino. Arudu pegamode boe erore jiboe ji woe moto keje baru tadawuge erudu pegamode ji jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Nono arudu pemegamode boe erore jiboe ji woe moto keje baru tadawuge erudu pemegamode ji jamedu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Nono imode mugure baru tadawu chave maku akai. Mare chave ji karega inagoino. Arudu pegamode boe erore jiboe ji woe moto keje baru tadawuge erudu pegamode ji jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Nono arudu pemegamode boe erore jiboe ji woe moto keje baru tadawuge erudu pemegamode ji jamedu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei ereadodukawo boe ewiagai umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi duji.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei ereadodukawo boe ewiagai umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi duji.

b: Jesus Makore Tudugaregei Tuwimoduie Duji
source: Jesus Makore Tudugaregei Tuwimoduie Duji

b: Nono ca Jesus makogodure rugadu nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore itumode nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Nonore Judeu doge eimijerage emode boe pegado i rugadu. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ero pegamode i jamedu. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emode boe pegado i jamedu. Nou boe eiamedu boe emode iorududo boe koriji rugadu. Iwimode rugadu. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware i dukeje iewodumode pugeje.
source: Nono ca Jesus makogodure rugadu nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore itumode nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Nonore Judeu doge eimijerage emode boe pegado i rugadu. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ero pegamode i jamedu. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emode boe pegado i jamedu. Nou boe eiamedu boe emode iorududo boe koriji rugadu. Iwimode rugadu. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware i dukeje iewodumode pugeje.

b: Mare Pedro aidukare nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Ure tumegido Jesus apo kuri nono tumagowo ji. Akore boe modukare aino ai. Pao Kurirewu aidukare boewo aino ai rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro aidukare nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Ure tumegido Jesus apo kuri nono tumagowo ji. Akore boe modukare aino ai. Pao Kurirewu aidukare boewo aino ai rugadu.

b: Mare Jesus ure tumegido nono makore Pedro ji. Akore akaradai ikoda piji bope Satanás. Are nono ia tori mogadure nowu itowara oiadada. Arore aino i awo iwududo. Mare tori ji karega inagoino. Amearudae jire inagoino. Amearudaere nono boe emearudae mogadure. Boe emearudae kare nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure dukodi.
source: Mare Jesus ure tumegido nono makore Pedro ji. Akore akaradai ikoda piji bope Satanás. Are nono ia tori mogadure nowu itowara oiadada. Arore aino i awo iwududo. Mare tori ji karega inagoino. Amearudae jire inagoino. Amearudaere nono boe emearudae mogadure. Boe emearudae kare nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure dukodi.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore ia tagi tagaidumode tamearutoruwo i dukeje tagera ra nowu taro pegarewu piji, tawia ra tamearudae pegarewu piji tagaidure jiboe piji. Tado tarugadu boe pegawo tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Iwimode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dukodire inagoino tai tado tarugadu tagoduwo itabo.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore ia tagi tagaidumode tamearutoruwo i dukeje tagera ra nowu taro pegarewu piji, tawia ra tamearudae pegarewu piji tagaidure jiboe piji. Tado tarugadu boe pegawo tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Iwimode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dukodire inagoino tai tado tarugadu tagoduwo itabo.

b: Boe etaidumode tuwo boe pemegado tu pudui turaga tabo dukeje nowu boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare cinorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare nowu boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji tumearudae pegarewu piji taidure jiboe piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu.
source: Boe etaidumode tuwo boe pemegado tu pudui turaga tabo dukeje nowu boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare cinorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare nowu boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji tumearudae pegarewu piji taidure jiboe piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu.

b: Boe emode toedo boe jamedu boece. Mare nowu enoe umodukare erududo baru to. Boe ewiagorokare tuwo tumearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Ewiagorore tu tuwo toe kurido pagatu je. Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe emodukare turudure baru todu morido toe tabo.
source: Boe emode toedo boe jamedu boece. Mare nowu enoe umodukare erududo baru to. Boe ewiagorokare tuwo tumearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Ewiagorore tu tuwo toe kurido pagatu je. Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe emodukare turudure baru todu morido toe tabo.

b: Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imode ikirimi mato moto ka pugeje. Itaregodumode nono iraga mode nono iogwa raka mogadure. Itaregodumode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugebo. Itaregodumode iogwa o jorugu pemegarewu tabo. Nono imode ro pegarewuge ero morido etai rugadu. Imode ro pemegarewuge ero morido etai jamedu.
source: Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imode ikirimi mato moto ka pugeje. Itaregodumode nono iraga mode nono iogwa raka mogadure. Itaregodumode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugebo. Itaregodumode iogwa o jorugu pemegarewu tabo. Nono imode ro pegarewuge ero morido etai rugadu. Imode ro pemegarewuge ero morido etai jamedu.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imode boe eimijera kurirewudo imi dukeje imode ikirimi pugeje. Ia tagi tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe ji. Tawimodukare jii toro tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe jitu ka.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imode boe eimijera kurirewudo imi dukeje imode ikirimi pugeje. Ia tagi tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe ji. Tawimodukare jii toro tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe jitu ka.

b: Jesus Ure Tiedo Tuginai
source: Jesus Ure Tiedo Tuginai

b: Meri oto padure seis Jesus ji pugeje. Nono ca uture ia ture joruduwadowugebo toro ia tori ricorewu ao ka. Nou ure joruduwadowuge ere pobe metia bokware. Pedrore, Tiagore, Joãore. Tiago uwienure Joãoce.
source: Meri oto padure seis Jesus ji pugeje. Nono ca uture ia ture joruduwadowugebo toro ia tori ricorewu ao ka. Nou ure joruduwadowuge ere pobe metia bokware. Pedrore, Tiagore, Joãore. Tiago uwienure Joãoce.

b: Etaregodure nowu tori ao ka rugadu. Nonore Jesus jere tuginai. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erudure ji rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare ure Jesus je udo aino. Dukodire Jesus jere nono meri joku urugu mogadure. Dukodire je ure nono jorugu urugu mogadure. Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus ukudau areia kigadu maerewudo ji. Kigadure rugadu kigadureboe jamedu boe kori.
source: Etaregodure nowu tori ao ka rugadu. Nonore Jesus jere tuginai. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erudure ji rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare ure Jesus je udo aino. Dukodire Jesus jere nono meri joku urugu mogadure. Dukodire je ure nono jorugu urugu mogadure. Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus ukudau areia kigadu maerewudo ji. Kigadure rugadu kigadureboe jamedu boe kori.

b: Nono ca rore puku ei ime pobedu doge edure nono ebo. Moisere, Eliare edu nono tumago tabo Jesus ji.
source: Nono ca rore puku ei ime pobedu doge edure nono ebo. Moisere, Eliare edu nono tumago tabo Jesus ji.

b: Nono Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore cegimijeranure aki rugadu. Padure woe dure turugadu pai. Amearudaemode nono imearudae ji dukeje imode ia macebradudo pobe metia bokware woe. Iamode akai. Iamode Moisés ai. Iamode Elias ai jamedu.
source: Nono Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore cegimijeranure aki rugadu. Padure woe dure turugadu pai. Amearudaemode nono imearudae ji dukeje imode ia macebradudo pobe metia bokware woe. Iamode akai. Iamode Moisés ai. Iamode Elias ai jamedu.

b: Pedro mako kimore dukeje nono ia boetugu ure turawuje etae. Nou boetugu urugu kigadure rugadu. Ure taiado ebo. Nono nowu boe emearudure ia boe emagoji nowu boetugu piji. Akore itonaregedu reo. Imearudu kurire ji rugadu. Rore jiboe ure iagaredo i rugadu. Tawiapaga pemegado awu itonaregedu bataru ji rugadu.
source: Pedro mako kimore dukeje nono ia boetugu ure turawuje etae. Nou boetugu urugu kigadure rugadu. Ure taiado ebo. Nono nowu boe emearudure ia boe emagoji nowu boetugu piji. Akore itonaregedu reo. Imearudu kurire ji rugadu. Rore jiboe ure iagaredo i rugadu. Tawiapaga pemegado awu itonaregedu bataru ji rugadu.

b: Nou Jesus utugarege emearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje epagudugodure rugadu. Nono ere tubu jodo tori keje.
source: Nou Jesus utugarege emearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje epagudugodure rugadu. Nono ere tubu jodo tori keje.

b: Mare Jesus ure tuburedo ei nono ure tugera bu ewugeje. Akore taragojedo. Tabagudukaba.
source: Mare Jesus ure tuburedo ei nono ure tugera bu ewugeje. Akore taragojedo. Tabagudukaba.

b: Nono ere turagojedo. Nono ere tie maedo mare erudukare ia boe ji pugeje. Tu emage eragojere nono Jesus apo.
source: Nono ere turagojedo. Nono ere tie maedo mare erudukare ia boe ji pugeje. Tu emage eragojere nono Jesus apo.

b: Nono ere turawuje nowu tori ao piji. Dukejere Jesus makore ei. Akore tareadodukaba tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Iewodumode pugeje dukeje tareadodumode awu tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai.
source: Nono ere turawuje nowu tori ao piji. Dukejere Jesus makore ei. Akore tareadodukaba tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Iewodumode pugeje dukeje tareadodumode awu tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai.

b: Nou ure joruduwadowuge enarare ji. egore kodiba pawobe eruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge egore elias aregodumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu otodai?
source: Nou ure joruduwadowuge enarare ji. egore kodiba pawobe eruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge egore elias aregodumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu otodai?

b: Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Pao Kurirewu akore Elias aregodumoduie rugadu. Umoduie boe ewie ewo tudo turugadu nowu umode boe ekinorudowu togi.
source: Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Pao Kurirewu akore Elias aregodumoduie rugadu. Umoduie boe ewie ewo tudo turugadu nowu umode boe ekinorudowu togi.

b: Mare inure tawie. Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiwu imedu Elias aregodure marigudu. Rore nono Elias ro mogadure. Mare boe etaidukare ji. Ero pegare ji tumearudae pegarewu tabo. Inure tawie. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Nou boe ero pegamode i nono erore jitu mogadure.
source: Mare inure tawie. Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiwu imedu Elias aregodure marigudu. Rore nono Elias ro mogadure. Mare boe etaidukare ji. Ero pegare ji tumearudae pegarewu tabo. Inure tawie. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Nou boe ero pegamode i nono erore jitu mogadure.

b: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwagodure João Batista jire Jesus akoino duji rugadu.
source: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwagodure João Batista jire Jesus akoino duji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Mareboe Meture Tadawu Iparedu Pemegago
source: Jesus Ure Mareboe Meture Tadawu Iparedu Pemegago

b: Nono Jesus ure turawuje tori ao piji boe etae pugeje Pedro apo, João apo, Tiago apo. Boe emagare nono. Nono ca ia imedu aregodure Jesus ae rugadu. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.
source: Nono Jesus ure turawuje tori ao piji boe etae pugeje Pedro apo, João apo, Tiago apo. Boe emagare nono. Nono ca ia imedu aregodure Jesus ae rugadu. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.

b: Nou imedu makore Jesus ji. Akore boe eimijeranure aki. Inogwamagudunure ai akoguduwo itonaregedu iparedu apo. Boe pegare ji rugadu. Ia boe kogodae pegarewu jeture ji dukodire butumode moto ka pagatu je. Boe romode puku ji buture duji. Butumode joru to. Butumode poboto.
source: Nou imedu makore Jesus ji. Akore boe eimijeranure aki. Inogwamagudunure ai akoguduwo itonaregedu iparedu apo. Boe pegare ji rugadu. Ia boe kogodae pegarewu jeture ji dukodire butumode moto ka pagatu je. Boe romode puku ji buture duji. Butumode joru to. Butumode poboto.

b: Itaregodure apo nouia are joruduwadowuge ewagai ewo pemegago. Mare eroiwakare tuwo pemegago rugadu.
source: Itaregodure apo nouia are joruduwadowuge ewagai ewo pemegago. Mare eroiwakare tuwo pemegago rugadu.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore tare ikiarigo. Tamearutorukare rugadu. Taruduwakare tawo tamearudae pemegado. Iragoje raimodukare tagabo. Nuba tagaidure irowo tamearutoruwo i? Nono Jesus makore iagei. Akore mato nowu iparedu apo itae!
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore tare ikiarigo. Tamearutorukare rugadu. Taruduwakare tawo tamearudae pemegado. Iragoje raimodukare tagabo. Nuba tagaidure irowo tamearutoruwo i? Nono Jesus makore iagei. Akore mato nowu iparedu apo itae!

b: Jesus mako pegare nowu meture nowu iparedu tadawu mareboe ji. Dukodire ure tudawuje nowu iparedu piji rugadu. Nono ca nowu iparedu pemegare rugadu. Jesus ure pemegago taci je rugadu.
source: Jesus mako pegare nowu meture nowu iparedu tadawu mareboe ji. Dukodire ure tudawuje nowu iparedu piji rugadu. Nono ca nowu iparedu pemegare rugadu. Jesus ure pemegago taci je rugadu.

b: Nou boe eture dukeje Jesus rakojere nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Emagore Jesus ji. egore kodiba ceroiwakare cewo nowu mareboe tawuje nowu iparedu piji?
source: Nou boe eture dukeje Jesus rakojere nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Emagore Jesus ji. egore kodiba ceroiwakare cewo nowu mareboe tawuje nowu iparedu piji?

b: Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore iwo tawie. Tamearutoru biagare Pao Kurirewu ji kodire taroiwakare. Mare tamearutoru biagamode Pao Kurirewu ji mare tamode taragado tai tamearutoru rakawo tu jao. Nono tamagomode ia tori ricorewu ji uwo tudawuje tumuga piji. Nono Pao Kurirewu koiare umode nowu tori ricorewu mearutorudo tawadaru ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu raka koiare umode taroiwado boe jamedu boe ji.
source: Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore iwo tawie. Tamearutoru biagare Pao Kurirewu ji kodire taroiwakare. Mare tamearutoru biagamode Pao Kurirewu ji mare tamode taragado tai tamearutoru rakawo tu jao. Nono tamagomode ia tori ricorewu ji uwo tudawuje tumuga piji. Nono Pao Kurirewu koiare umode nowu tori ricorewu mearutorudo tawadaru ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu raka koiare umode taroiwado boe jamedu boe ji.

b: Boe emodukare togwa ra tuge piji jao tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to dukeje eroiwamodukare tuwo awu inodu mareboe tawuje boe epiji. Boe emode togwa ra tuge piji ia meri keje togwamaguduwo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nono eroiwamode tuwo awu inodu mareboe tawuje boe epiji rugadu.
source: Boe emodukare togwa ra tuge piji jao tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to dukeje eroiwamodukare tuwo awu inodu mareboe tawuje boe epiji. Boe emode togwa ra tuge piji ia meri keje togwamaguduwo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nono eroiwamode tuwo awu inodu mareboe tawuje boe epiji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Tuwimoduie Tuiewodumoduie Pugeje Duji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Tuwimoduie Tuiewodumoduie Pugeje Duji

b: Jesus uture nowu moto piji ture joruduwadowugebo jii toro nowu Galiléia moto ka. Nonore Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai.
source: Jesus uture nowu moto piji ture joruduwadowugebo jii toro nowu Galiléia moto ka. Nonore Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai.

b: Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje. Dukodi nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekiarigodure rugadu.
source: Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje. Dukodi nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekiarigodure rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwai Mori Reo
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwai Mori Reo

b: J e s u s a r e g o d u r e t u r e joruduwadowugebo Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka. Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai pijiwuge ime etaregodure Pedro ae. Ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwugenure emage. Ere tugeragu Pao Kurirewu uwai mori roguji boe eiamedu boe epiji tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawuge eimijera ai. Awu ime emaragodaenure nowu inoduce rugadu. Nono enarare Pedro ji. egore nou ure taruduwadowu imedu umode Pao Kurirewu uwai mori maku kana?
source: J e s u s a r e g o d u r e t u r e joruduwadowugebo Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka. Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai pijiwuge ime etaregodure Pedro ae. Ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwugenure emage. Ere tugeragu Pao Kurirewu uwai mori roguji boe eiamedu boe epiji tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawuge eimijera ai. Awu ime emaragodaenure nowu inoduce rugadu. Nono enarare Pedro ji. egore nou ure taruduwadowu imedu umode Pao Kurirewu uwai mori maku kana?

b: Pedro akore Uu! Ure maku rugadu. Nono Pedro uture epiji. Ure turemo Jesus rakojere tadawu baito. Nouia utugarege edu nono jamedu. Nono Jesus makore boeto ji. Akore nuba amearudaere Pedro? Ioguduba pijiba moto kejewu boe eimijerage emode tugeragu boe enoe moriji? Emode tugeragu ji tuwobe epiji? Emode tugeragu ji ia boe tuginaiwuge epiji kana?
source: Pedro akore Uu! Ure maku rugadu. Nono Pedro uture epiji. Ure turemo Jesus rakojere tadawu baito. Nouia utugarege edu nono jamedu. Nono Jesus makore boeto ji. Akore nuba amearudaere Pedro? Ioguduba pijiba moto kejewu boe eimijerage emode tugeragu boe enoe moriji? Emode tugeragu ji tuwobe epiji? Emode tugeragu ji ia boe tuginaiwuge epiji kana?

b: Pedro akore Boro. Emode tugeragu boe tuginaiwuge enoe moriji mare emodukare tugeragu tuwobe enoe moriji rugadu. Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Emodukare tugeragu tuwobe enoe moriji rugadu.
source: Pedro akore Boro. Emode tugeragu boe tuginaiwuge enoe moriji mare emodukare tugeragu tuwobe enoe moriji rugadu. Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Emodukare tugeragu tuwobe enoe moriji rugadu.

b: Ca Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure imi dukodire ukare turugadu iwo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai mori maku. Mare pagawo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawuge eimijera korigo. Pawo nowu mori maku rugadu. Ca atudo toro nowu pobo maerewu ka. Awodiku barigu. Amode bitowu karo boeto jiwu okwa jado. Nou karo okwa ja tadare arudumode ia diero toriji. Nou diero umode turugadu pai pawo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai mori maku. Nou tarudumode jiwu diero tori reko nowu ure tugeragu Pao Kurirewu mori jiwuge etae rugadu.
source: Ca Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure imi dukodire ukare turugadu iwo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai mori maku. Mare pagawo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawuge eimijera korigo. Pawo nowu mori maku rugadu. Ca atudo toro nowu pobo maerewu ka. Awodiku barigu. Amode bitowu karo boeto jiwu okwa jado. Nou karo okwa ja tadare arudumode ia diero toriji. Nou diero umode turugadu pai pawo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai mori maku. Nou tarudumode jiwu diero tori reko nowu ure tugeragu Pao Kurirewu mori jiwuge etae rugadu.

b: Duboba Boe Eimijerage Mode Emage
source: Duboba Boe Eimijerage Mode Emage

b: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae. Enarare ji. egore Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje umode boe eimijeragedo iagece jamedu. Ca duboba umode emage?
source: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae. Enarare ji. egore Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje umode boe eimijeragedo iagece jamedu. Ca duboba umode emage?

b: Jesus makore ia boe etonaregedurogu bagai. Makore ji rakojewo nono nowu boe etoiadada.
source: Jesus makore ia boe etonaregedurogu bagai. Makore ji rakojewo nono nowu boe etoiadada.

b: Nono Jesus akore Boe remawu jire imode tawie. Tamodukare tamearudae udo nono boe etore emearudae mogadure dukeje tamodukare tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Tamodukare taremo baru to.
source: Nono Jesus akore Boe remawu jire imode tawie. Tamodukare tamearudae udo nono boe etore emearudae mogadure dukeje tamodukare tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Tamodukare taremo baru to.

b: Mare boe emode tumearudae pemegado tugawo boe remawugedo pudumi nono boe etore emogadure dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijerage paru towugedo emage. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje umode boe eimijera paru towugedo emage jamedu.
source: Mare boe emode tumearudae pemegado tugawo boe remawugedo pudumi nono boe etore emogadure dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijerage paru towugedo emage. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje umode boe eimijera paru towugedo emage jamedu.

b: Boe emode tugera podo boe etonaregedu apo dukeje itabore ere tugera podo jamedu.
source: Boe emode tugera podo boe etonaregedu apo dukeje itabore ere tugera podo jamedu.

b: Boe emode tori kurirewu kogudo imedu itoru kajeje tuwo barigu poboto dukodire nowu barigudure pobo towu imedu bimode rugadu. Mare ia boe umode nowu itore mearutorure maibari iwuge edo tugera ra ipiji ero pegawo pugeje dukeje boe pegamode nowu ure nowu boe etore etaora pegadowuji rugadu. Jire boe pegarewu kodumode nowu barigudure pobo towu imedu kori.
source: Boe emode tori kurirewu kogudo imedu itoru kajeje tuwo barigu poboto dukodire nowu barigudure pobo towu imedu bimode rugadu. Mare ia boe umode nowu itore mearutorure maibari iwuge edo tugera ra ipiji ero pegawo pugeje dukeje boe pegamode nowu ure nowu boe etore etaora pegadowuji rugadu. Jire boe pegarewu kodumode nowu barigudure pobo towu imedu kori.

b: Boe pegamode mearutorukare iwuge ji. Ere tumearudae kodudo boe emearudae pegarewu kodaji dukodire boe pegamode ei ero pegarewu morice. Boe emearudae pegarewu makudumode boe etai tu tu je emearudae pegawo ero pegawo jamedu. Mare boe pegamode rugadu nowu ure tumearudae pegarewu maku boe etaiwugei rugadu.
source: Boe pegamode mearutorukare iwuge ji. Ere tumearudae kodudo boe emearudae pegarewu kodaji dukodire boe pegamode ei ero pegarewu morice. Boe emearudae pegarewu makudumode boe etai tu tu je emearudae pegawo ero pegawo jamedu. Mare boe pegamode rugadu nowu ure tumearudae pegarewu maku boe etaiwugei rugadu.

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Tagera umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tagera kado tabiji. Tawure jamedu umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tawure kado tabiji. Mare tagera remawu tawure remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Nou joru akedumodukare rugadu. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pemegamode tai nono jii toro rugadu. Kodire inagoino tai. Boe ekera umode mitotu je, boe ewure umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo emearutorure i dukeje erudumode baru to rugadu tuwikawo pugeje.
source: Jesus mako kimore: – Tagera umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tagera kado tabiji. Tawure jamedu umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tawure kado tabiji. Boe ekera umode mitotu je, boe ewure umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo emearutorure i dukeje erudumode baru to rugadu tuwikawo pugeje.

Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Nou joru umode boe ekowu jii toro rugadu. Nou joru akedumodukare. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tarudumode baru to dukeje boe pemegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Kodire inagoino tai. Taeku umode mitotu je mare tamearutorure i rugadu dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.

b: Carneiro Ure Tuwarigu Boeto
source: Carneiro Ure Tuwarigu Boeto

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Taeku jado. Tarudu pegakaba nowu mearutorure maibari iwuge ji. Itorenure emage. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emagore awu itore eparu tabo Pao Kurirewu bagai. Nou Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge edu nono Pao Kurirewu apo tu je. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Itaregodure iwo ure tuwarigu boetowuge ekinorudo etukawo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto, etuwo baru to rugadu.
source: Jesus mako kimore: – Taeku jado. Tarudu pegakaba nowu mearutorure maibari iwuge ji. Itorenure emage. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emagore awu itore eparu tabo Pao Kurirewu bagai. Nou Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge edu nono Pao Kurirewu apo tu je. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Itaregodure iwo ure tuwarigu boetowuge ekinorudo etukawo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto, etuwo baru to rugadu.

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Ireadoduwo ia bakaruji tawiagai iwo taruduwado ia Pao Kurirewu mearudae pemegarewuji. Ia imedu aku carneiro doge enodo padure cem. Ia okware boeto nowu iage epiji. Nou akure cewu imedu uture rugadu nowu tagu noventa e nove carneiro doge epiji taiwowo nowu okware boetowu carneiro bagai rugadu. Nou noventa e nove carneiro doge edure nono boebutu pemegarewu keje. Mare nowu akure cewu imedu aiwore rugadu nowu okware boetowu tagu carneiro bagai jii toro tuiorudure jitu ka.

Emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje emode tuwarigu boeto. Ewarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Pao Kurirewu aidukare boewo aino boe ji rugadu.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwu Biagodumode Ro Pegare Puduiwu Ro Pegarewu Piji
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwu Biagodumode Ro Pegare Puduiwu Ro Pegarewu Piji

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Ia mearutorure iwu ro pegamode ia tai dukeje atudo toro ae awo nowu ro pegare aiwu bie. Amagodo ji ro pegare ai du boe ji. Mare amago rakakaba ji. Tu aki amagodo ji. Tamagodo tu pui. Nono nowu ro pegare aiwu biapagamode amagore jiboe ji dukeje amedia mode ema. Tamedage mode pugi pugeje. Awiagodumode nowu ro pegare ai dupiji.
source: Jesus mako kimore: – Ia mearutorure iwu ro pegamode ia tai dukeje atudo toro ae awo nowu ro pegare aiwu bie. Amagodo ji ro pegare ai du boe ji. Mare amago rakakaba ji. Tu aki amagodo ji. Tamagodo tu pui. Nono nowu ro pegare aiwu biapagamode amagore jiboe ji dukeje amedia mode ema. Tamedage mode pugi pugeje. Awiagodumode nowu ro pegare ai dupiji.

b: Mare biapagamodukare amagore pudui duji dukeje akaiwodo ia mearutorure iwuge ewagai. Emode mito pobe dukeje atudo ebo toro nowu ro pegare aiwu bagai pugeje. Nou uture akabowuge ewiapagamode tamagore pui jiboe ji. Ainore padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore marigudu. Makore boe ji erowo pui tuwo tumearudae pegare puidu barigu pubiji. Akore Boe ewo pobe, boe ewo pobe metia bokware emagore jiboe uwo nono pu mogadure boe eruduwawo boe remawu ji.” Ainore padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore marigudu.

b: Dukodire atumode amedagebo nowu ro pegare aiwu bagai mare nowu ro pegare aiwu biapagamodukare amagore jiboe ji, amedage emagore jiboe ji dukeje atumode nowu mearutorure iwuge ere bato puiwu bai ka tawo nowu mearutorure iwuge eiamedu boe ewie nowu ro pegare aiwu ro pegare jiboe ji. Nono nowu mearutorure iwuge emagomode nowu ro pegare aiwuji jamedu. Biapagamodukare nowu mearutorure iwugei dukeje tamode tagera ra nowu ro pegare aiwu piji. Tamode udo nono mearutorukare iwu mogadure taegai. Tamode udo nono ia ro pegarewu ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwu iwogurewu mogadure taegai.

b: Inure tawie boe remawu ji. Tarudu pegamode boe erore jiboe ji woe moto keje du baru tadawuge erudu pegamode ji jamedu. Nono tarudu pemegamode boe erore jiboe ji woe moto keje du baru tadawuge erudu pemegamode ji jamedu.

b: Iwo tawie pugeje. Ia tagi tamode pobe, tamode pobe metia bokware dukeje tamode bato pui tamagowo pui, taruduwawo imearudae ji. Nono iragojemode tagabo rugadu. Dukodire tamearudaemode nono pu mearudaere dukeje tamagomode nowu tamearudae ji Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode nowu tagogwamagudure bagaiboe udo turugadu tai ure nono imearudae mogadure dukodi.

b: Boe Utugare Ro Pegarewu Reo
source: Boe Utugare Ro Pegarewu Reo

b: Jesus akoino dukeje Pedro ure tuburedo Jesus ji. Unarare: – Cegimijeranure aki. Ia mearutorure aiwu ro pegamode i dukeje nuba iromode ji? Iwiagodumode nowu ro pegare iboe piji kana? Mare ro pegamode i oto padumode sete dukeje nuba iromode? Iwiagodumode nowu ro pegare iboe jamedu boe piji rugadu kana?

Mare ro pegamode i oto padumode sete dukeje nuba iromode? Iwiagodumode nowu ro pegare iboe jamedu boe piji rugadu kana?

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ireadoduwo iwo taruduwado nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji tawiagai. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijerado pudumi dukeje romode nono ia boe eimijera kurirewu ro mogadure. Nou boe eimijera aidure tuwo nowu tudugarege ere tugeragu jiboe mori makuduwo pudai.

b: Dukodire makore tudugarege ewagai ewo nowu mori maku pudai rugadu. Ca ia utugare aregodure tugimijera ae. Nou utugare ure tugeragu jiboe kurire rugadu. Maragodumode jii toro tuwi ka mare umodukare tugeragu jiboe morido ai rugadu.

b: Nono roiwakare tuwo nowu mori maku tugimijera ai rugadu. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera makore tumoduie nowu tudugare maku oreduje maku ore kugure emagu jamedu diero bagai rugadu.

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Nou boe eimijera utugare joruduware nowu tugimijera mearudae ji dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje nowu tugimijera jokorai. Okwamagudure tugimijeraji. Akore Akorigodukaba i. Arokaba ia arore jiboe ji i kuri je imode ikare maku akaiboe rugadu maku akai rugadu.”

Akore Itugare pegarewunure aki. Ro pegarewunure aki rugadu. Akogwamagudure i akragudu tabo. Dukodire inogudugodure akabo rugadu. Imagore ai akaiago nowu are akeragu jiboe morido inai pugeje. b: Boe Emugu Pemegawo Puapo Ekawo Tugera Ra Pubiji

b: Jesus ure nowu tumago akedudo dukeje uture Galiléia moto piji. Uture Judéia moto ka. Kurugodure Jordão po kajeje toro bakowu ka.

b: Boe emagare tudu tabo Jesus rekodaji toro nowu moto ka. Jesus ure kogodurewuge epemegago.
source: Boe emagare tudu tabo Jesus rekodaji toro nowu moto ka. Jesus ure kogodurewuge epemegago.

b: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure nono Jesus rakojerewu ka jamedu. Etaidure tuwo turokogado Jesus ji tuioruduwo ia Jesus ro pegarewu ji ia Jesus mako pegarewuji. Erudumode dukeje emago pegamode ji rugadu. Dukodire enarare Jesus ji. egore nuba Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu pago bakaru akore? Ukana turugadu imedu uwo toreduje utudo tubiji tumugukawo apo pugeje? Romode aino pagatu je mare pegakare kana? Nou pago bakaru ukana turugadu imedu rore aino duji?

b: Pao Kurirewu makoie ei imedu utumoduie tuo piji tuje piji tumuguwo toreduje apo dukeje emodukaie pobe pugeje, emoduie mitotu je rugadu.

b: Dukodire iwo tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji pugeje. Imedu umode tugera ra toreduje piji mare mugumode ia aredu apo pugeje. Du pegare Pao Kurirewu jakai. b: Ia ime ewodure dukeje ewa pegare dukodire ime mode emage mare eroiwakare tieribariwo areduji dukodire etuwiremodukare. Ia ime ewa bokware mare ime ro pegarewuge ero koiare ere nowu ime ewa tawuje. Ia boe eragare taiduwo awu iwadaru ji du etaiduwo ji rugadu.

b: Imedu Oe Kurire
source: Imedu Oe Kurire

b: Ia imedu aregodure Jesus ae. Unarare Jesus ji. Akore joruduwarewunure aki. Nuba iromode iwo iro pemegado iewoduwo pugeje imuguwo baru tada Pao Kurirewu apo du akedukawo rugadu?

b: Jesus akore Ca anarare i boe ero pemegarewu bagai. Aruduwa kana kaba jiba akagoino? Pemegarewu ure mitotu je. Marigudu aruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji. Ure maku etai marigudu. Akaidure aewoduwo pugeje amuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo du akedukawo dukodi amearutorudo nowu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji.

b: Nou imedu unarare pugeje. Akore nou bakaru kurire rugadu. Imearutorumodu kana nowu bakaru jamedu boe ji? Kaba bataru ji ba imearutorumode? Jesus makore nowu imedu bataru jipagi. Akore akaba boe ewido. Aeribarikaba akoreduje piji. Akiwogukaba. Awadrarodukaba boe erore jiboe ji.

b: Nono Pedro akore Cegi cere cegera ra cenoe jamedu boe piji cegoduwo akabo. Nuba boemode cei?

b: Maragodure Uva Iku Jiwuge Reo
source: Maragodure Uva Iku Jiwuge Reo

b: Jesus makore boe ji pugeje. Akore ireadodumode ia maragodure boepa jiwuge erore jiboe ji tawiagai iwo tawie ia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Boe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Boe emode tugimijerado ema tumuguwo apo baru tada dukeje Pao Kurirewu romode ei nono ia ore moto cewu ro mogadure. Nou ore moto cewu o boepare. Uva iku makare nowu o boepa tada. Nou boepa kurire. Ia meri keje meri rutukare raga dukeje nowu ore moto cewu ure tudawuje tuwai piji taiwowo ia ime ewagai tumagowo ei emaragoduwo to boepa tada pudai.

Dukodire nowu ime etaidure nowu ore moto cewu mearudae ji. Nono ere tuwadaru maku ai tumaragodumoduie ai nowu meri ji jii merirekodu ka nowu akoino jiwu mori bagai rugadu.

b: Nono merirekodugodutabo rugadu dukeje nowu ore moto cewu uture boe eda ka pugeje. Jorudure ia imei nono pugeje. Edu pagare tu nono. Nono nowu ore moto cewu unarare ei. Akore Kaba kodiba tadu pagare woe awu meri ji jii merirekodu ka?”

b: Ure nowu diero maku etai dukeje eruduware to diero ure mitotu je rugadu. Emago pegare nowu ore moto cewu rore pudui duji. Egore ukaie turugadu.
