b: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Pugeje Tuwimoduie
source: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Pugeje Tuwimoduie

b: Nono Jesus uture pugeje. Kodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu kawu awara ji. Nono ure tuwuredo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo tumagowo ei. Enodo padure doze.
source: Nono Jesus uture pugeje. Kodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu kawu awara ji. Nono ure tuwuredo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo tumagowo ei. Enodo padure doze.

b: Akore Padumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etai. Imagudumode nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etai. Nou boe eimijerage egomode ipegaie. Etaidumode tuwo iwido rugadu.
source: Akore Padumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etai. Imagudumode nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etai. Nou boe eimijerage egomode ipegaie. Etaidumode tuwo iwido rugadu.

b: Dukodire emode imagu boe tuginaiwuge eimijera ai nowu boe tuginaiwuge eimijera uwo to tugobaigarege edo boeto i. Emode iwido ipadumode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje rugadu.
source: Dukodire emode imagu boe tuginaiwuge eimijera ai nowu boe tuginaiwuge eimijera uwo to tugobaigarege edo boeto i. Emode iwido ipadumode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje rugadu.

b: Ia Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etuje Makore Jesus ji Tore Eparu Tabo
source: Ia Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etuje Makore Jesus ji Tore Eparu Tabo

b: Ia aredu aregodure Jesus ae tore ime pobedu dogebo. Etuo iere Zebedeu. Nou aredu ore ime ekodure Jesus apo marigudu. Jesus ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Etuje ure tubu jodo moto keje togwamaguduwo Jesus ji iaboe bagai.
source: Ia aredu aregodure Jesus ae tore ime pobedu dogebo. Etuo iere Zebedeu. Nou aredu ore ime ekodure Jesus apo marigudu. Jesus ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Etuje ure tubu jodo moto keje togwamaguduwo Jesus ji iaboe bagai.

b: Jesus makore nowu areduji. Akore kaba jiba akaidure? Nou aredu akore amode boe eimijerado aki woe dukeje amugumode ira kurirewu keje nono boe ekimijerage ero mogadure. Itaidure awo itore ime emugudo amegi boe eimijera mugure kejewu ira keje jamedu. Ia mugudo nono akana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia mugudo akana pegarewu jagwai.
source: Jesus makore nowu areduji. Akore kaba jiba akaidure? Nou aredu akore amode boe eimijerado aki woe dukeje amugumode ira kurirewu keje nono boe ekimijerage ero mogadure. Itaidure awo itore ime emugudo amegi boe eimijera mugure kejewu ira keje jamedu. Ia mugudo nono akana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia mugudo akana pegarewu jagwai.

b: Jesus mearudure nowu aredu bataru ji dukeje makore nowu aredu ore ime pobedu dogei. Akore taruduwakare kaboba bagaiba taje akoino. Boe pegamode tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure dukeje taroiwakana tawo taragado tai tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure idu piji? egore uu. Cemode ceragado cei rugadu.
source: Jesus mearudure nowu aredu bataru ji dukeje makore nowu aredu ore ime pobedu dogei. Akore taruduwakare kaboba bagaiba taje akoino. Boe pegamode tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure dukeje taroiwakana tawo taragado tai tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure idu piji? egore uu. Cemode ceragado cei rugadu.

b: Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore inure tawie. Boe pegamode tai rugadu nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Mare iroiwakare iwo tamugudo itabo ikana pemegarewu jagwai, ikana pegarewu jagwai. Iogwa Kurirewu emare ure nowu imegiwu udo turugadu. Tu ema joruduware turomode jiboe ji. Emare umode taidure jiwuge emugudo ikana pemegarewu jagwai, ikana pegarewu jagwai.
source: Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore inure tawie. Boe pegamode tai rugadu nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Mare iroiwakare iwo tamugudo itabo ikana pemegarewu jagwai, ikana pegarewu jagwai. Iogwa Kurirewu emare ure nowu imegiwu udo turugadu. Tu ema joruduware turomode jiboe ji. Emare umode taidure jiwuge emugudo ikana pemegarewu jagwai, ikana pegarewu jagwai.

b: Nou pobedu doge emedage enodo padure dez. Jesus ure eruduwado jamedu. Emearudure nowu tumedage etuje okwamagudure jiboe ji dukeje ekorigodure nowu tumedage pobedu dogei.
source: Nou pobedu doge emedage enodo padure dez. Jesus ure eruduwado jamedu. Emearudure nowu tumedage etuje okwamagudure jiboe ji dukeje ekorigodure nowu tumedage pobedu dogei.

b: Nono Jesus makore eiamedu boe etae ewiapagawo tuwadaru ji. Akore taruduware boe tuginaiwuge ekimijerage erore jiboe ji. Ero rakare boe ji. Boe emearutorumode tugimijeragei rugadu. Emearutorumodukare ei dukeje nowu boe ekimijerage emode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwugei rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore eiamedu boe etae ewiapagawo tuwadaru ji. Akore taruduware boe tuginaiwuge ekimijerage erore jiboe ji. Ero rakare boe ji. Boe emearutorumode tugimijeragei rugadu. Emearutorumodukare ei dukeje nowu boe ekimijerage emode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwugei rugadu.

b: Mare tarokaba nono nowu boe tuginaiwuge ekimijerage ero mogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe ekimijerado tagi dukeje tamearudae udo nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tawo boe eimijera pemegarewugedo tagi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi.
source: Mare tarokaba nono nowu boe tuginaiwuge ekimijerage ero mogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe ekimijerado tagi dukeje tamearudae udo nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tawo boe eimijera pemegarewugedo tagi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi.

b: Tarodo nono iro mogadure. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Itaregodukare iwo boe ekimijerado imi. Itaregodure iwo boe etugaredo imi. Itaregodure iwo imagu boe etai. Itaregodure iwiwo boe ero pegarewu morice rugadu.
source: Tarodo nono iro mogadure. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Itaregodukare iwo boe ekimijerado imi. Itaregodure iwo boe etugaredo imi. Itaregodure iwo imagu boe etai. Itaregodure iwiwo boe ero pegarewu morice rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Joku Bokwarewuge Ime Pobedu Doge Epemegago
source: Jesus Ure Joku Bokwarewuge Ime Pobedu Doge Epemegago

b: Toro ia meri keje, Jesus uture Jericó ba kurirewu piji ture joruduwadowugebo. Ia boe ekodure awara ji Jesus apo jamedu. Emagare rugadu.
source: Toro ia meri keje, Jesus uture Jericó ba kurirewu piji ture joruduwadowugebo. Ia boe ekodure awara ji Jesus apo jamedu. Emagare rugadu.

b: Joku bokwarewuge ime pobedu doge emugure nono nowu awara okwai. Emearudure Jesus kodure tugori duji. Kodire ekudure Jesus rekodaji. egore cegimijera! Davi Onaregedunure aki! Akogududo cedabo! Nou joku bokwarewu ime eruduware Davi uwobenure Jesusce duji dukodire egoino Davi Onaregedu nuie ema.
source: Joku bokwarewuge ime pobedu doge emugure nono nowu awara okwai. Emearudure Jesus kodure tugori duji. Kodire ekudure Jesus rekodaji. egore cegimijera! Davi Onaregedunure aki! Akogududo cedabo! Nou joku bokwarewu ime eruduware Davi uwobenure Jesusce duji dukodire egoino Davi Onaregedu nuie ema.

b: Nou kodure nonowu boe emago rakare ei emugu kiorowo. Mare ekudu rakare pugeje. egore cegimijera! Davi Onaregedunure aki! Akogududo cedabo!
source: Nou kodure nonowu boe emago rakare ei emugu kiorowo. Mare ekudu rakare pugeje. egore cegimijera! Davi Onaregedunure aki! Akogududo cedabo!

b: Nono ca Jesus ure tuwuredo nono. Makore toro etae. Akore kaba jiba tagaidure irowo tai?
source: Nono ca Jesus ure tuwuredo nono. Makore toro etae. Akore kaba jiba tagaidure irowo tai?

b: egore cegimijeranure aki. Cedaidure cedaiwowo pugeje.
source: egore cegimijeranure aki. Cedaidure cedaiwowo pugeje.

b: Jesus okudugodure ebo rugadu. Ure tugera bu eku keje. Aino ca etaiwore pugeje taci je. Etaiwo pemegare rugadu. Dukodire ekodure Jesus rekodaji rugadu.
source: Jesus okudugodure ebo rugadu. Ure tugera bu eku keje. Aino ca etaiwore pugeje taci je. Etaiwo pemegare rugadu. Dukodire ekodure Jesus rekodaji rugadu.

b: Jesus Aregodure Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka Dukeje Boe Egarere Ji
source: Jesus Aregodure Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka Dukeje Boe Egarere Ji

b: Nou inodu otobiji Jesus uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Epuredugodure boe eda Betfagé ka. Nou boe eda mugu puredure Oliveira Riji. Aregodure toro dukeje makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ime pobedu dogei tuwo etudo tododai.
source: Nou inodu otobiji Jesus uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Epuredugodure boe eda Betfagé ka. Nou boe eda mugu puredure Oliveira Riji. Aregodure toro dukeje makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ime pobedu dogei tuwo etudo tododai.

b: Akore ei: – Tadudo toro nowu boe eda ka. Tagaregodumode dukeje tarudumode ia jumenta areduji onaregedu apo duji. Boe ere ekogudo nono duji. Tamode bukigu kiwuje dukeje tadumode mato ebo itae.
source: Akore ei: – Tadudo toro nowu boe eda ka. Tagaregodumode dukeje tarudumode ia jumenta areduji onaregedu apo duji. Boe ere ekogudo nono duji. Tamode bukigu kiwuje dukeje tadumode mato ebo itae.

b: Ia boe enaramode kaba kodiba tarore aino dukeje tamagodo aino ji: “Pagimijera aidure ei”, aino. Nono nowu boe emode tadudo ebo itae rugadu.
source: Ia boe enaramode kaba kodiba tarore aino dukeje tamagodo aino ji: “Pagimijera aidure ei”, aino. Nono nowu boe emode tadudo ebo itae rugadu.

b: Dukodire ia Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui. Marigudu ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu ure nowu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore:
source: Dukodire ia Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui. Marigudu ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu ure nowu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore:

b: – Awu mugure Jerusalém kejewuge tagi. Tabagudukaba. Tagimijera kurirewu ro butugumode boe ji rugadu. Mugumode jumenta keje taregoduwo tagae. Jumenta onaregedu kejere mugumode rugadu taregoduwo tagae.
source: – Awu mugure Jerusalém kejewuge tagi. Tabagudukaba. Tagimijera kurirewu ro butugumode boe ji rugadu. Mugumode jumenta keje taregoduwo tagae. Jumenta onaregedu kejere mugumode rugadu taregoduwo tagae.

b: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge pobedu doge erore nono Jesus makore pudui dumogadure rugadu.
source: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge pobedu doge erore nono Jesus makore pudui dumogadure rugadu.

b: Etaregodure tuibagi nowu jumenta apo, nowu jumenta onaregedu apo rugadu Jesus ae rugadu. Nono nowu boe ere tugudau areia cobertor boe bu nowu jumenta poru keje, nowu jumenta onaregedu poru keje Jesus muguwo keje rugadu.
source: Etaregodure tuibagi nowu jumenta apo, nowu jumenta onaregedu apo rugadu Jesus ae rugadu. Nono nowu boe ere tugudau areia cobertor boe bu nowu jumenta poru keje, nowu jumenta onaregedu poru keje Jesus muguwo keje rugadu.

b: Boe emagare nono nowu Jerusalém kawu awara keje. Iage ere tugudau areia cobertor bu awara keje rugadu. Iage ere bai kado. Ere nowu bai bu awara keje jamedu Jesus koduwo nowu jumenta apo nowu awara ji Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.
source: Boe emagare nono nowu Jerusalém kawu awara keje. Iage ere tugudau areia cobertor bu awara keje rugadu. Iage ere bai kado. Ere nowu bai bu awara keje jamedu Jesus koduwo nowu jumenta apo nowu awara ji Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.

b: Boe emagare rugadu tugodu tabo Jesus apo. Eture tiegarere pudui dutabo rugadu. Dukodire ewadodu rakare Pao Kurirewu ie tabo tumago pemegare ji dutabo. egore Davi onaregedunure ema dukodire pagimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ji rugadu! Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae. Ure turaga maku ai rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emago pemegawo ji rugadu woe moto keje, baru tada jamedu.
source: Boe emagare rugadu tugodu tabo Jesus apo. Eture tiegarere pudui dutabo rugadu. Dukodire ewadodu rakare Pao Kurirewu ie tabo tumago pemegare ji dutabo. egore Davi onaregedunure ema dukodire pagimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ji rugadu! Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae. Ure turaga maku ai rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emago pemegawo ji rugadu woe moto keje, baru tada jamedu.

b: Nono ca Jesus aregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka rugadu. Nou ba kurirewu tadawuge eiamedu boe erore ta je. Eruduwakare kodiba nowu boe eroino. Dukodire enarare boe ji. egore ioguduba ure ema?
source: Nono ca Jesus aregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka rugadu. Nou ba kurirewu tadawuge eiamedu boe erore ta je. Eruduwakare kodiba nowu boe eroino. Dukodire enarare boe ji. egore ioguduba ure ema?

b: Nou kodure Jesus apowuge boe emagarewuge egore Jesus reo. Emare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Aregodure Galiléia moto piji, Nazaré ba kurirewu piji.
source: Nou kodure Jesus apowuge boe emagarewuge egore Jesus reo. Emare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Aregodure Galiléia moto piji, Nazaré ba kurirewu piji.

b: Jesus Ure Turemo Pao Kurirewu Uwaito
source: Jesus Ure Turemo Pao Kurirewu Uwaito

b: Jesus ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Nono jorudure nowu boe ji ere tagu metugoe emagu diero bagai duji ere diero maku puai duji. Dukodire korigodure rugadu. Ure nowu boe enoe rugadu barigu. Ure emugure kejewu ira rugadu boe barigu. Ure nowu metugoe emedure tadaboe rugadu barigu. Ure nowu boe etudo Pao Kurirewu uwai piji rugadu.
source: Jesus ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Nono jorudure nowu boe ji ere tagu metugoe emagu diero bagai duji ere diero maku puai duji. Dukodire korigodure rugadu. Ure nowu boe enoe rugadu barigu. Ure emugure kejewu ira rugadu boe barigu. Ure nowu metugoe emedure tadaboe rugadu barigu. Ure nowu boe etudo Pao Kurirewu uwai piji rugadu.

b: Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu uwai tadare boe emagomode bagai baru to. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore. Ainore bapera atugo ure. Mare tare awu Pao Kurirewu uwai udo nono iwogurewuge ewai mogadure.
source: Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu uwai tadare boe emagomode bagai baru to. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore. Ainore bapera atugo ure. Mare tare awu Pao Kurirewu uwai udo nono iwogurewuge ewai mogadure.

b: Joku bokwarewuge, pogora pegarewuge, etaregodure Jesus ae nowu Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Nono Jesus ure epemegago.
source: Joku bokwarewuge, pogora pegarewuge, etaregodure Jesus ae nowu Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Nono Jesus ure epemegago.

b: Mare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge erudure Jesus ure boe epemegago duji. Emearudure nowu boe etore ekudure Jesus ro pemegarewu tabo boe egai duji. Dukodire ekorigodure. Nou boe etore egore Davi onaregedu nuie ema duji. Pagimijera kurirewu nuie ema rugadu. Pawo boe pemegado ji rugadu! Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage erudu pegare Jesus ji. Ekorigodure.
source: Mare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge erudure Jesus ure boe epemegago duji. Emearudure nowu boe etore ekudure Jesus ro pemegarewu tabo boe egai duji. Dukodire ekorigodure. Nou boe etore egore Davi onaregedu nuie ema duji. Pagimijera kurirewu nuie ema rugadu. Pawo boe pemegado ji rugadu! Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage erudu pegare Jesus ji. Ekorigodure.

b: Dukodire emagore Jesus ji. egore amearudu kana nowu boe etore emagoji? Emagore jiboe ukare turugadu. Pagare egoino. Atudo toro etae awo edukiorodo. Mare Jesus akore Boro. Taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nowu emagomoduie aino duji rugadu. Padure bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu uie boe etore kugure emago pemegado rugadu. Emago pemegaie Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire Pao Kurirewu aidure. Dujire Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawure.
source: Dukodire emagore Jesus ji. egore amearudu kana nowu boe etore emagoji? Emagore jiboe ukare turugadu. Pagare egoino. Atudo toro etae awo edukiorodo. Mare Jesus akore Boro. Taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nowu emagomoduie aino duji rugadu. Padure bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu uie boe etore kugure emago pemegado rugadu. Emago pemegaie Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire Pao Kurirewu aidure. Dujire Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawure.

b: Nono ca Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji toro Betânia boe eda ka. Nonore unudure nowu boeco ji.
source: Nono ca Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji toro Betânia boe eda ka. Nonore unudure nowu boeco ji.

b: Jesus Mako Pegare Ia Figo Iji
source: Jesus Mako Pegare Ia Figo Iji

b: Nou barogwato ca boecoto Jesus kodure awara ji pugeje tuwo tugirimi Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka pugeje. Mare uke boeire ji.
source: Nou barogwato ca boecoto Jesus kodure awara ji pugeje tuwo tugirimi Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka pugeje. Mare uke boeire ji.

b: Nono jorudure ia figo iji nowu awara okwai. Uture nowu i ka. Aiwore ia tudu kurodurewu bagai mare jorudukare boe ji. Jorudure tu aruji rugadu. Nono Jesus mako pegare nowu iji. Akore boe emodukare akurodu kowuje pugeje awimode kodi. Ca nono nowu figo i bire aino taci je!
source: Nono jorudure ia figo iji nowu awara okwai. Uture nowu i ka. Aiwore ia tudu kurodurewu bagai mare jorudukare boe ji. Jorudure tu aruji rugadu. Nono Jesus mako pegare nowu iji. Akore boe emodukare akurodu kowuje pugeje awimode kodi. Ca nono nowu figo i bire aino taci je!

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu inoduji dukeje eku kidure rugadu. egore kocare awu figo i bire aino taci je rugadu?
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu inoduji dukeje eku kidure rugadu. egore kocare awu figo i bire aino taci je rugadu?

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore inure tawie boe remawu ji. Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Tameartugukaba ji. Tamearutorumode dukeje taromode figo iji nono iro mogadure. Nono tamagomode tori riji uwo tuwarigu pobo maerewuto. Tamagomode ji dukeje barigudumode pobo maerewuto rugadu. Mare tamearutorumodukare dukeje umodukare tuwarigu.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore inure tawie boe remawu ji. Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Tameartugukaba ji. Tamearutorumode dukeje taromode figo iji nono iro mogadure. Nono tamagomode tori riji uwo tuwarigu pobo maerewuto. Tamagomode ji dukeje barigudumode pobo maerewuto rugadu. Mare tamearutorumodukare dukeje umodukare tuwarigu.

b: T a m e a r t o r u m o d e d u k e j e tamagomode Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to iaboe bagai dukeje umode tamagore bagaiboe maku tagai rugadu.
source: T a m e a r t o r u m o d e d u k e j e tamagomode Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to iaboe bagai dukeje umode tamagore bagaiboe maku tagai rugadu.

b: Boe Enarare Jesus ji Ioguduba Koiaba Ure Turaga Maku Ai
source: Boe Enarare Jesus ji Ioguduba Koiaba Ure Turaga Maku Ai

b: Jesus aregodure Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje. Ure turemo dukeje ure boe eruduwado nono. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nouia boe eimijerage etaregodure Jesus ae jamedu. Emagore Jesus ji: – Ioguduba ure akarego mato? Ioguduba ure turaga maku akai aro rakawo aino?
source: Jesus aregodure Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje. Ure turemo dukeje ure boe eruduwado nono. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nouia boe eimijerage etaregodure Jesus ae jamedu. Emagore Jesus ji: – Ioguduba ure akarego mato? Ioguduba ure turaga maku akai aro rakawo aino?

b: Jesus akore Imi jamedu inaramode tai. Ioguduba ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo? Pao Kurirewu koia kana? Ia boe eigoia kana? Tamagomode iwadaru jipagi dukeje imagomode tawadaru jipagi jamedu. Mare nowu boe eimijerage eruduwakare tumagowo Jesus bataru jipagi. Dukodire emagore pui nuba tagomode Jesus bataru jipagi. egore Pamagomode Pao Kurirewu koiare ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo mare pamearutorukare nowu inoduji. Awu Jesus joruduware pamearutorukare nowu inodu jituji. Dukodire pagagomode aino dukeje Jesus umode pawadaru pogurudo. Akomode: “Kodiba tamearutorukare ji?” Ainore akomode pai.
source: Jesus akore Imi jamedu inaramode tai. Ioguduba ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo? Pao Kurirewu koia kana? Ia boe eigoia kana? Tamagomode iwadaru jipagi dukeje imagomode tawadaru jipagi jamedu. Mare nowu boe eimijerage eruduwakare tumagowo Jesus bataru jipagi. Dukodire emagore pui nuba tagomode Jesus bataru jipagi. egore Pamagomode Pao Kurirewu koiare ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo mare pamearutorukare nowu inoduji. Awu Jesus joruduware pamearutorukare nowu inodu jituji. Dukodire pagagomode aino dukeje Jesus umode pawadaru pogurudo. Akomode: “Kodiba tamearutorukare ji?” Ainore akomode pai.

b: Mare pagagomode boe eigoiaie dukeje awu woewu boe ekorigodumode pai rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emearutorure João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jituji. Egore Pao Kurirewu koiare ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo rugadu. Pagagomode boe eigoiaie mare pabagudure boece dukodire pamagomodukare aino.
source: Mare pagagomode boe eigoiaie dukeje awu woewu boe ekorigodumode pai rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emearutorure João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jituji. Egore Pao Kurirewu koiare ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo rugadu. Pagagomode boe eigoiaie mare pabagudure boece dukodire pamagomodukare aino.

b: Nono nowu boe eimijerage emagore Jesus ji. egore ceruduwakare ioguduba koiare ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo. Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore tamagokare iwadaru jipagi dukodire imagomodukare ioguduba ure itarego mato jamedu duji.

b: Imedu Ore Ime Ere Pobe
source: Imedu Ore Ime Ere Pobe

b: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe eimijeragei. Akore ireadodumode ia bakaruji iwo tawie ia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Ia imedu ore ime ere pobe. Nou imedu makore nowu tonaregedu imedu boeto jiwuji. Makore ji. Akore Atudo toro pago boepato amaragoduwo nowu boepa tadawu uva ikuji.”
source: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe eimijeragei. Akore ireadodumode ia bakaruji iwo tawie ia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Ia imedu ore ime ere pobe. Nou imedu makore nowu tonaregedu imedu boeto jiwuji. Makore ji. Akore Atudo toro pago boepato amaragoduwo nowu boepa tadawu uva ikuji.”

b: – Mare nowu imedu onaregedu boeto jiwu akore tudumodukaie, tumaragodumodukaie boepaji nowu meri ji. Mare nowu imedu onaregedu boeto jiwu ure tumearudae mekido dukodire uture rugadu boepato rugadu. Maragodure ji rugadu nowu meri ji.
source: – Mare nowu imedu onaregedu boeto jiwu akore tudumodukaie, tumaragodumodukaie boepaji nowu meri ji. Mare nowu imedu onaregedu boeto jiwu ure tumearudae mekido dukodire uture rugadu boepato rugadu. Maragodure ji rugadu nowu meri ji.

b: Mare nowu uo joruduwakare nowu inoduji dukodire uture nowu tonaregedu boigoduwu bagai. Makore ji utuiago to boepato nowu meri ji, maragoduiago boepaji nowu meri ji. Nou imedu onaregedu boigoduwu akore tudumoduie tumaragoduwo rugadu. Mare ca utukare rugadu.

b: Ainore Jesus readodure. Nono Jesus unarare nowu boe eimijeragei. Akore kakojiwu imedu onaregedu ba mearutorure nowu tuo makore pudui duji? Nou boe eimijerage egore nou imedu onaregedu boeto jiwu emare mearutorure tuo bataru ji. Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Boe egore nowu umoduie tugeragu boe enoe morijiwu emugumodukaie Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada. Boe egore nowu areme ure tugeragu dieroji tieribari tabowuge emugumodukaie Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada erore aino dukodi. Mare iwo tawie boe remawu ji. João Batista makore nowu boe ji dukodire ekiarigodure nowu turo pegarewuji. Ere nowu tumearudae pegarewu barigu tubiji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Ainore boe erore tuwo tudo turugadu tumuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada rugadu. João Batista ure taruduwado jamedu. Ure taruduwado Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Ure taruduwado nuba taromode tawo tado nono ro pemegarewugere Pao Kurirewu jakai. Tarudure nouia boe ji ere tumearudae pegarewu barigu tubiji duji. Tarudure nouia boe ji emearutorure João Batista makore pudui duji. Mare tagire tamearutorukare. Tagare tamearudae pegarewu barigu tabiji. Dukodire tagare tarugadu raga tamuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada rugadu.

b: Ro Pegarewuge Etu Pemegawo Boepaji
source: Ro Pegarewuge Etu Pemegawo Boepaji

b: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge ji. Akore imagowo ia bakaruji tawiagai iwo tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji pugeje. Ainore nowu bakaru ure. Ia imedu ure uva tugu to boepa tada. Ure ramiku aiado to boepa tabo. Ure ia moto porodo tuwo tuwuredo nowu uva kurodu keje tuwo kuru tawuje. Ure ia tugamo pemegado boe ewo tumugudo toro aogeje taiwo pemegawo boepaji. Nono ure tugeragu ia boe ji tuwo etudo nowu to boepaji. Nono nowu ore boepa cewu uture epiji tugiriadu tabo toro ia boe eda jaerewu ka.
source: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge ji. Akore imagowo ia bakaruji tawiagai iwo tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji pugeje. Ainore nowu bakaru ure. Nono nowu ore boepa cewu uture epiji tugiriadu tabo toro ia boe eda jaerewu ka.

b: Nou boepa tadawu uva kurodumode kejewu ari puredugodure dukeje nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ure tudugarege etudo toro nowu jeture to boepa jiwuge etae nowu tugiriadure kawu moto piji. Ure nowu tudugarege etudo ewo tugeragu nowu makudumode pudaiwu boe ji. Nou jeture nowu boepa jiwuge emode uva rugadu kado dukeje emode ia kado puiato nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ai.
source: Nou boepa tadawu uva kurodumode kejewu ari puredugodure dukeje nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ure tudugarege etudo toro nowu jeture to boepa jiwuge etae nowu tugiriadure kawu moto piji. Ure nowu tudugarege etudo ewo tugeragu nowu makudumode pudaiwu boe ji. Nou jeture nowu boepa jiwuge emode uva rugadu kado dukeje emode ia kado puiato nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ai.

b: Nou imedu utugarege etaregodure nowu boepa ka. Mare nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwuge etaidukare tuwo uva kado puiato pugeje nowu ore boepa cewu ai. Dukodire ere tugeragu nowu imedu utugaregei turaga tabo. Ere boeto iaji. Ere ia bito. Eidore tori tabo iaji.
source: Nou imedu utugarege etaregodure nowu boepa ka. Mare nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwuge etaidukare tuwo uva kado puiato pugeje nowu ore boepa cewu ai. Dukodire ere tugeragu nowu imedu utugaregei turaga tabo. Ere boeto iaji. Ere ia bito. Eidore tori tabo iaji.

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Nou utugarege etaregodukare iaboe tabo dukeje nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ure ia tudugarege etudo pugeje toro nowu jeture to boepa jiwuge ewagai pugeje. Ure tudugarege emagado toro rugadu. Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ero pegare nowu imedu utugaregei nono turo mogadure pugeje.
source: Jesus mako kimore: – Nou utugarege etaregodukare iaboe tabo dukeje nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ure ia tudugarege etudo pugeje toro nowu jeture to boepa jiwuge ewagai pugeje. Ure tudugarege emagado toro rugadu. Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ero pegare nowu imedu utugaregei nono turo mogadure pugeje.

b: Nono ca nowu ore boepa cewu ure tonaregedu imedu utudo nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ewagai boigodu. Imedu makore tudada tonaregedu jie emearutorumoduie.
source: Nono ca nowu ore boepa cewu ure tonaregedu imedu utudo nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ewagai boigodu. Imedu makore tudada tonaregedu jie emearutorumoduie.

b: Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge erudure nowu ore boepa cewu onaregedu kodure aino pudae duji dukeje emagore pui. Egore: “Awu ore boepa cewu onaregedu reo. Emare omode tuo oe jamedu boece. Pawo bito pagowo oe jamedu boece.”
source: Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge erudure nowu ore boepa cewu onaregedu kodure aino pudae duji dukeje emagore pui. Egore: “Awu ore boepa cewu onaregedu reo. Emare omode tuo oe jamedu boece. Pawo bito pagowo oe jamedu boece.”

b: Ainore emagore pui. Nono ere tugeragu nowu ore boepa cewu onaregeduji. Ere barigu nowu boepa piji. Nono ere bito toro.
source: Ainore emagore pui. Nono ere tugeragu nowu ore boepa cewu onaregeduji. Ere barigu nowu boepa piji. Nono ere bito toro.

b: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe eimijeragei. Akore ainore erore rugadu. Ca. Nuba tamearudaere nowu ore boepa cewu romode nowu jeture boepa jiwugei?
source: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe eimijeragei. Akore ainore erore rugadu. Ca. Nuba tamearudaere nowu ore boepa cewu romode nowu jeture boepa jiwugei?

b: Nou boe eimijerage emagore Jesus bataru jipagi. egore umode nowu jeture to boepa jiwuge ro pegarewuge ewido. Nono umode to boepa maku ia ime etai etuwo ji. Nouge ca emode ia kurodureboe maku nowu ore boepa cewu ai rugadu.
source: Nou boe eimijerage emagore Jesus bataru jipagi. egore umode nowu jeture to boepa jiwuge ro pegarewuge ewido. Nono umode to boepa maku ia ime etai etuwo ji. Nouge ca emode ia kurodureboe maku nowu ore boepa cewu ai rugadu.

b: Jesus akore Boe rugadu jire tagagoino. Mare tagaiwokare rugadu kana ia padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji? Ainore awu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Boe emearudae pegare toriji. Egore pegaie tuwo tuwaido ema. Mare nowu tori pemegarewunure ema rugadu boe ewo tuwaido ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure nowu tori pemegado aino. Ure pemegado nouia tori jamedu boe ekori. Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure nowu Pao Kurirewu roino duji. – Ainore nowu batarure.
source: Jesus akore Boe rugadu jire tagagoino. Mare tagaiwokare rugadu kana ia padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji? Ainore awu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Boe emearudae pegare toriji. Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure nowu Pao Kurirewu roino duji. – Ainore nowu batarure.

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Iwo tawie awu Pao Kurirewu bataru boe ji. Tori ji karega akoino. Umode boe ekinorudowu imedu jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Nou umode boe ekinorudowu romode boe ji nono ia boe ewudure kejewu tori ro mogadure. Buture tori aogejewuge eiamedu boe emode togorido. Mare tori ji karega inagoino. Nou umode boe ekinorudowu umode mearutorukare puduiwuge erugadu boe epegado. Dujire inagoino. Nou umode boe ekinorudowu romode boe ji nono ia buture boe ewugejewu tori ro mogadure jamedu. Tori butumode boe ewugeje dukeje umode nowu boe egugudo. Mare tori ji karega inagoino. Nou umode boe ekinorudowu umode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Dujire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Care imode tawie boe remawu ji. Tamearudaere tamugumoduie Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada. Tamearudaere tagimijera nuie Pao Kurirewuce. Mare pagare tagagoino. Pao Kurirewu makomodukare tawagai pugeje. Makomode ia boe ewagai. Nono emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu dukodire emagere emugumode Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada rugadu. Emode tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce rugadu.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji. Nou boe eimijerage fariseu doge emearudure jamedu. Emearudure Jesus readodure jiwu bakaruji dukeje eruduware puduire Jesus akoino duji.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge eiamedu boe etaidure tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo tugu baicorewuto kuri je rugadu. Mare boe etaidukare ero pegawo Jesus ji. Egore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu nuie ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu uie arego rugadu. Boe etaidure tuwiapagawo Jesus makore jiboe ji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge epagudure, eroiwakare tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji nowu boe epiji rugadu.

b: Boe Emugure Puapowu Boe Ewadae Kurirewu Reo
source: Boe Emugure Puapowu Boe Ewadae Kurirewu Reo

b: Jesus makore nowu boe ji pugeje. Makore ia bakaruji tuwo boe ewie toro ia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ka pugeje.
source: Jesus makore nowu boe ji pugeje. Makore ia bakaruji tuwo boe ewie toro ia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ka pugeje.

b: Akore Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ainore boemode. Imode tawie bakaruji. Ia boe eimijera kurirewu onaregedu imedu uwiremode. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ure ia boe ewadae kurirewu towuje.
source: Akore Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ainore boemode. Imode tawie bakaruji. Ia boe eimijera kurirewu onaregedu imedu uwiremode. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ure ia boe ewadae kurirewu towuje.

b: Ure boe jamedu boe udo turugadu dukeje ure tudugarege etudo nowu tumagore bagaiwuge ewagai tuwo ewie boe uie turugadu duji etaregoduwo tuwadae ka rugadu. Mare nowu makore bagaiwuge etaidukare tuduwo toro. Eiamedu boe egore tudumodukaie.
source: Ure boe jamedu boe udo turugadu dukeje ure tudugarege etudo nowu tumagore bagaiwuge ewagai tuwo ewie boe uie turugadu duji etaregoduwo tuwadae ka rugadu. Mare nowu makore bagaiwuge etaidukare tuduwo toro. Eiamedu boe egore tudumodukaie.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ure ia tudugarege etudo pugeje toro nowu makore bagaiwuge ewagai pugeje. Akore nowu tudugaregei: “Tamagodo nowu imagore bagaiwugei ire boe eke kurido rugadu. Tapira kodu karewu uie turugadu. Boe jamedu boe uie turugadu.”
source: Dukodire nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ure ia tudugarege etudo pugeje toro nowu makore bagaiwuge ewagai pugeje. Akore nowu tudugaregei: “Tamagodo nowu imagore bagaiwugei ire boe eke kurido rugadu. Tapira kodu karewu uie turugadu. Boe jamedu boe uie turugadu.”

b: Ainore nowu boe eimijera kurirewu akore. Dukodire nowu utugarege eture nowu boe ewagai. Mare nowu boe ewiapagakare ewadaru ji. Eture nowu boe eimijera kurirewu utugarege epiji. Ia uture to boepato. Ia uture tumaragodure tadawu bai ka.
source: Ainore nowu boe eimijera kurirewu akore. Dukodire nowu utugarege eture nowu boe ewagai. Mare nowu boe ewiapagakare ewadaru ji. Eture nowu boe eimijera kurirewu utugarege epiji. Ia uture to boepato. Ia uture tumaragodure tadawu bai ka.

b: Iage ere tugeragu nowu boe eimijera kurirewu utugaregei. Ero pegare ei. Ere ewido.
source: Iage ere tugeragu nowu boe eimijera kurirewu utugaregei. Ero pegare ei. Ere ewido.

b: Nou boe eimijera joruduware nowu inoduji dukeje korigodure nowu boe ji rugadu. Ure to tugobaigarege etudo nowu boe eda ka. Nou tugobaigarege ere nowu boe ewido rugadu. Ere joru tugu nowu ewai jamedu boeto.
source: Nou boe eimijera joruduware nowu inoduji dukeje korigodure nowu boe ji rugadu. Ure to tugobaigarege etudo nowu boe eda ka. Nou tugobaigarege ere nowu boe ewido rugadu. Ere joru tugu nowu ewai jamedu boeto.

b: Nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewu makore tudugaregei pugeje. Akore Itonaregedu uwiremode dukodire ire ewadae pemegado. Boe jamedu boe ure turugadu. Mare nowu imagore bagaiwuge epemegakare, etaregodukare. Itaidukare ei pugeje.
source: Nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewu makore tudugaregei pugeje. Akore Itonaregedu uwiremode dukodire ire ewadae pemegado. Boe jamedu boe ure turugadu. Mare nowu imagore bagaiwuge epemegakare, etaregodukare. Itaidukare ei pugeje.

b: Dukodire care tadudo toro nowu boe eda ka ia boe ewagai pugeje. Tamagodo tarudumode jiwuge eiamedu boe ji etaregoduwo mato nowu iwadae ka.”
source: Dukodire care tadudo toro nowu boe eda ka ia boe ewagai pugeje. Tamagodo tarudumode jiwuge eiamedu boe ji etaregoduwo mato nowu iwadae ka.”

b: Dukodire care nowu utugarege eture nowu boe eda ka rugadu. Ekodure nowu boe eda jamedu boe parugajeje. Emagore tuiorudure jiwuge eiamedu boe ji etaregoduwo nowu tugimijera kurirewu uwadae ka. Nou emagore jiwuge epemegare iage epegare. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera kurirewu uwadae kejewu bai kurirewu korobadure boebo rugadu.
source: Dukodire care nowu utugarege eture nowu boe eda ka rugadu. Ekodure nowu boe eda jamedu boe parugajeje. Emagore tuiorudure jiwuge eiamedu boe ji etaregoduwo nowu tugimijera kurirewu uwadae ka. source: Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Boe erugodu akedukaie. Boe egomode nowu torowu boe ekorigoduie dukodie erugodu kurie pui rugadu. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.

b: Boe eimijerage kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu.
source: Boe eimijerage kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu.

b: Awu inagoino jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji nono aredu kurijirigodu mogadure. Aredu kurijirigodure dukeje boe eruduware kuri butumode kuri aino duji. Mare aredu kurijirigodu ji karega inagoino. Boe pegamode moto ji nono iwadaru mogadure dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Awu inagoino jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji nono aredu kurijirigodu mogadure. Aredu kurijirigodure dukeje boe eruduware kuri butumode kuri aino duji. Mare aredu kurijirigodu ji karega inagoino. Boe pegamode moto ji nono iwadaru mogadure dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Nono ro pegarewuge emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ero pegawo tai, ewo tawido. Tamearutorure i dukeje boe erudu pegamode tai moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Nono ro pegarewuge emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ero pegawo tai, ewo tawido. Tamearutorure i dukeje boe erudu pegamode tai moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Nou meri keje boe emode tugera ra tumearutorure idu piji rugadu. Erudu pegamode pui. Emode pu maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai.
source: Nou meri keje boe emode tugera ra tumearutorure idu piji rugadu. Erudu pegamode pui. Emode pu maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai.

b: Boe egomode tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare pagatu jere egoino. Mare du inodu tabo boe emearutorumode ei. Emode jekiripagadowuge emagamode rugadu.
source: Boe egomode tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare pagatu jere egoino. Mare du inodu tabo boe emearutorumode ei. Emode jekiripagadowuge emagamode rugadu.

b: Boe emode turo pegarewu kodudo tugori pugeje. Dukodi boe emearudu kurimodukare pui pugeje. Mearudu kurire puiwuge enowaromode tu je.
source: Boe emode turo pegarewu kodudo tugori pugeje. Dukodi boe emearudu kurimodukare pui pugeje. Mearudu kurire puiwuge enowaromode tu je.

b: Mare ia boe emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji dukeje imode ekinorudo.
source: Mare ia boe emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji dukeje imode ekinorudo.

b: Nono boe emagomode boe ji ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emagomode nowu bataru ji boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ewiagai dukeje moto akedumode.
source: Nono boe emagomode boe ji ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emagomode nowu bataru ji boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ewiagai dukeje moto akedumode.

b: Iwo tawie. Tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Marigudu nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Daniel ure boe ewie boemoduie aino rugadu. Jorudumode awu bapera jiwuge eiamedu boe ewiapaga pemegawo awu bataru ji.
source: Iwo tawie. Tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Marigudu nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Daniel ure boe ewie boemoduie aino rugadu. Jorudumode awu bapera jiwuge eiamedu boe ewiapaga pemegawo awu bataru ji.

b: Mare boe erudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakamode toro tori ao ka tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.
source: Mare boe erudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakamode toro tori ao ka tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.

b: Nou rakojere tuwai ao kejewuge eregoduwo tuwai piji kuri je rugadu. Ekawo turemo tuwai jagi iaboe bagai. Etuwo tugera kedo tabo rugadu.
source: Nou rakojere tuwai ao kejewuge eregoduwo tuwai piji kuri je rugadu. Ekawo turemo tuwai jagi iaboe bagai. Etuwo tugera kedo tabo rugadu.

b: Nou maragodure to boepa jiwuge eregoduwo nowu to boepa piji kuri je jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka ia tugudau areia bagai.
source: Nou maragodure to boepa jiwuge eregoduwo nowu to boepa piji kuri je jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka ia tugudau areia bagai.

b: Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwakare turegodu rakawo dukodi. Boe pegamode boe etore etuje magei jamedu eroiwakare ture rakawo dukodi.
source: Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwakare turegodu rakawo dukodi. Boe pegamode boe etore etuje magei jamedu eroiwakare ture rakawo dukodi.

b: Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai boe pegakawo aino boe ji sábado meri keje. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai biaku butukawo boe ji nowu eregodure jiwu meri keje.
source: Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai boe pegakawo aino boe ji sábado meri keje. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai biaku butukawo boe ji nowu eregodure jiwu meri keje.

b: Mare paga karega. Boe pegamode boe ji rugadu boe pega jamedu boe kori. Pao Kurirewu ure moto to dupiji boe erudukare awu boe pegarewu boe ji jii aino. Mare boe pegamode moto ji rugadu. Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu merido biagatu je rugadu. Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode rugadu dukeje boe eiamedu boe ewimode rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu boe pegamode kejewu merido biagatu je tuwo mearutorure puduiwuge edo cinorudo.
source: Mare paga karega. Boe pegamode boe ji rugadu boe pega jamedu boe kori. Pao Kurirewu ure moto to dupiji boe erudukare awu boe pegarewu boe ji jii aino. Mare boe pegamode moto ji rugadu. Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu merido biagatu je rugadu. Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode rugadu dukeje boe eiamedu boe ewimode rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu boe pegamode kejewu merido biagatu je tuwo mearutorure puduiwuge edo cinorudo.

b: Mare boe pegamode kejewu meri aregodumode dukeje boe egomode: “Umode boe ekinorudowu aregodu! Ema reo!” Ainore boe egomode. Mare tawiapagakaba ewadaru ji. Pagare egoino.
source: Mare boe pegamode kejewu meri aregodumode dukeje boe egomode: “Umode boe ekinorudowu aregodu! Ema reo!” Ainore boe egomode. Mare tawiapagakaba ewadaru ji. Pagare egoino.

b: Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe etaregodumode rugadu nowu tuwadaru tabo rugadu. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare egoino. Egomode tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare pagare egoino. Ero rakamode boe emearutoruwo pudui Pao Kurirewu piji pagatu je. Emodukare mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge remawuge ekiripagado. Mare etaidumode tuwo mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ekiripagado nowu turo rakarewu tabo rugadu.

Mare etaidumode tuwo mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ekiripagado nowu turo rakarewu tabo rugadu.

b: Dukodi care ire tawie rugadu. Taeku jado. Pagare eroino.
source: Dukodi care ire tawie rugadu. Taeku jado. Pagare eroino.

b: Dukodire taruduwamode. Boe egomode umode boe ekinorudowu rakojeie boe maerewu keje mare tamearutorukaba ei. Boe egomode rakojeie ia bai tada mare tamearutorukaba ei.
source: Dukodire taruduwamode. Boe egomode umode boe ekinorudowu rakojeie boe maerewu keje mare tamearutorukaba ei. Boe egomode rakojeie ia bai tada mare tamearutorukaba ei.

b: Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode moto ka pugeje dukeje boe erudumode ji rugadu nono boe erudure boeiaragudu jitu mogadure. Boeiaragudure dukeje boe erudu jaere ji. Nono boe erudu jaemode itaregoduji jamedu.
source: Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode moto ka pugeje dukeje boe erudumode ji rugadu nono boe erudure boeiaragudu jitu mogadure. Boeiaragudure dukeje boe erudu jaere ji. Nono boe erudu jaemode itaregoduji jamedu.

b: Boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregoduji nono boe erudure poburewuge ere tago puae barogo birewu kodu keje jitu mogadure.
source: Boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregoduji nono boe erudure poburewuge ere tago puae barogo birewu kodu keje jitu mogadure.

b: Boe pegare moto jiboe akedumode dukeje meri joku akedumode jamedu. Ari joku akedumode. Kuieje doge ewudumode baru piji jamedu. Baru magadugodumode rugadu.
source: Boe pegare moto jiboe akedumode dukeje meri joku akedumode jamedu. Ari joku akedumode. Kuieje doge ewudumode baru piji jamedu. Baru magadugodumode rugadu.

b: Dukeje care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregeduji baru tada. Boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ekiarigodumode rugadu boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Erudumode Imedu Onaregeduji kodure boetugu aoji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Dukeje care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregeduji baru tada. Boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ekiarigodumode rugadu boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Erudumode Imedu Onaregeduji kodure boetugu aoji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Nono umode tudugare baru tadawu udo tapira ukiga akodo tuwo tudugarege baru tadawuge etudo Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwuge ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emode edo tudo pui.
source: Nono umode tudugare baru tadawu udo tapira ukiga akodo tuwo tudugarege baru tadawuge etudo Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwuge ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emode edo tudo pui.

b: Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je. Figo i okurogu boture dukeje taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.
source: Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je. Figo i okurogu boture dukeje taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.

b: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode boe puredugodure itaregoduwo iwo boe jamedu boe akedudo. Mare bubutu ji karega inagoino. Nou itaregodumode jiwu meri jire inagoino.
source: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode boe puredugodure itaregoduwo iwo boe jamedu boe akedudo. Mare bubutu ji karega inagoino. Nou itaregodumode jiwu meri jire inagoino.

b: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.
source: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.

b: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode jamedu. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode jamedu. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Boe Eruduwakare Jesus Aregodumode Kejewu Meriji
source: Boe Eruduwakare Jesus Aregodumode Kejewu Meriji

b: Nono Jesus mako kimore. Akore boe eruduwakare nowu meri ji rugadu. Boe eruduwakare nuba meri mode awu iwadaru jetuwo pudui. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge eruduwakare. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu joruduwakare. Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware tu rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus mako kimore. Akore boe eruduwakare nowu meri ji rugadu. Boe eruduwakare nuba meri mode awu iwadaru jetuwo pudui. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge eruduwakare. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu joruduwakare. Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware tu rugadu.

b: Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode pugeje dukeje boe emearudaemode nono rakojere boe etumana Noé apowuge emearudae pegarewu mogadure.
source: Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode pugeje dukeje boe emearudaemode nono rakojere boe etumana Noé apowuge emearudae pegarewu mogadure.

b: Mariguduboe etumana Noé rakoje kimore dukeje boe ewiapagakare pobo aregodumode duji. Ewiapagare tu tugeji tugudure ce boe ji. Ime ewiapagare tu tuwirewo. Areme ewiapagare tu tugogewo jamedu. Erore aino jii toro Noé ure turemo ikarerewu to du ka. Noé ure turemo ikarerewuto tu tuwobebo rugadu. Mare iage ewiapagakare Noéji dukodire eruduwa bokware pobo umode moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etagedudo duji. Dukodire nowu pobo aregodure, ure eiamedu boe etagedudo rugadu. Ainore boe emearudaemode pugeje. Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode pugeje mare boe ewiapagamodukare bagai rugadu.
source: Mariguduboe etumana Noé rakoje kimore dukeje boe ewiapagakare pobo aregodumode duji. Ewiapagare tu tugeji tugudure ce boe ji. Ime ewiapagare tu tuwirewo. Areme ewiapagare tu tugogewo jamedu. Erore aino jii toro Noé ure turemo ikarerewu to du ka. Noé ure turemo ikarerewuto tu tuwobebo rugadu. Mare iage ewiapagakare Noéji dukodire eruduwa bokware pobo umode moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etagedudo duji. Dukodire nowu pobo aregodure, ure eiamedu boe etagedudo rugadu. Ainore boe emearudaemode pugeje. Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode pugeje mare boe ewiapagamodukare bagai rugadu.

b: Ime emode pobe tumaragodae keje ipoguru keje. Imode ikeragu iaji mare metia utumodukare.
source: Ime emode pobe tumaragodae keje ipoguru keje. Imode ikeragu iaji mare metia utumodukare.

b: Areme emode pobe tumaragodae keje tuwo trigo kududo. Imode ikeragu iarodoji mare metago utumodukare.
source: Areme emode pobe tumaragodae keje tuwo trigo kududo. Imode ikeragu iarodoji mare metago utumodukare.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai taeku jaewo. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba Tagimijera Kurirewu aregodumode pugeje.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai taeku jaewo. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba Tagimijera Kurirewu aregodumode pugeje.

b: Mare tawiagodukaba. Uwaire bai cewu joruduwamode kaba meri kejeba iwogurewu aregodumode dukeje umode tudo turugadu taiwo tabo nowu iwogurewu bagai nowu iwogurewu ukawo turemo nowu baito nowu boeco ji.
source: Mare tawiagodukaba. Uwaire bai cewu joruduwamode kaba meri kejeba iwogurewu aregodumode dukeje umode tudo turugadu taiwo tabo nowu iwogurewu bagai nowu iwogurewu ukawo turemo nowu baito nowu boeco ji.

b: Tado tarugadu tagaiwo tabo jamedu. Mare iwogurewu bagai karega. Tado tarugadu Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode dubagai. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba aregodumode dukodire inagoino tawo tado tarugadu jii toro rugadu.
source: Tado tarugadu tagaiwo tabo jamedu. Mare iwogurewu bagai karega. Tado tarugadu Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode dubagai. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba aregodumode dukodire inagoino tawo tado tarugadu jii toro rugadu.

b: Boe Utugare Pemegarewu Reo
source: Boe Utugare Pemegarewu Reo

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore nuba boemode boe utugare pemegarewu joruduwarewuji? Ukimijera aidumode tuduwo toro ia moto ka dukeje umode nowu tudugare pemegarewu mugudo tumugato tudugarege eimijerawo ema uwo iage eke maku etai nowu tudure jiwu meri keje.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore nuba boemode boe utugare pemegarewu joruduwarewuji? Ukimijera aidumode tuduwo toro ia moto ka dukeje umode nowu tudugare pemegarewu mugudo tumugato tudugarege eimijerawo ema uwo iage eke maku etai nowu tudure jiwu meri keje.

b: Nou utugare ro pemegamode mearutorumode tugimijeraji jii toro tugimijera aregodumode kejewu meri ka dukeje jakaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Nou utugare ro pemegamode mearutorumode tugimijeraji jii toro tugimijera aregodumode kejewu meri ka dukeje jakaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Dukejere care nowu boe eimijera umode nowu tudugare jetudo toe jamedu boe ji jetu pemegawo ji. Boe jokodu jire inagoino rugadu.
source: Dukejere care nowu boe eimijera umode nowu tudugare jetudo toe jamedu boe ji jetu pemegawo ji. Boe jokodu jire inagoino rugadu.

b: Mare ia boe utugare mearudae pegamode. Nou ukimijera utu jaemode jamedu dukeje aregodumodukare tuibagi kuri je. Nono nowu utugare pegarewu mearudaemode tugimijera aregodumodukaie pugeje duji.
source: Mare ia boe utugare mearudae pegamode. Nou ukimijera utu jaemode jamedu dukeje aregodumodukare tuibagi kuri je. Nono nowu utugare pegarewu mearudaemode tugimijera aregodumodukaie pugeje duji.

b: Nono umode boeto nouia tudugarege imei, aremei jamedu. Nono maragodumodukare pugeje mare okwagemode, kudumode jamedu. Nono uke kurumode ji jamedu.
source: Nono umode boeto nouia tudugarege imei, aremei jamedu. Nono maragodumodukare pugeje mare okwagemode, kudumode jamedu. Nono uke kurumode ji jamedu.

b: Care ia meri keje nowu ukimijera aregodumode tuibagi pugeje. Mare nowu utugare upagakare bagai. Joruduwakare aregodumode kejewu meri ji.
source: Care ia meri keje nowu ukimijera aregodumode tuibagi pugeje. Mare nowu utugare upagakare bagai. Joruduwakare aregodumode kejewu meri ji.

b: Nono nowu boe eimijera jorudumode nowu tudugare ro pegare duji. Dukodire nowu ukimijera umode nowu tudugare bito. Umode bowuje rugadu. Nono umode nowu tudugare barigu toro boe pegarewuto ime pegarewugebo nowu mearutorukare tuwadaru jiwugebo. Torore boe etragudu rakamode. Torore boe emode to reko pui tuwiri boe kori koia.
source: Nono nowu boe eimijera jorudumode nowu tudugare ro pegare duji. Dukodire nowu ukimijera umode nowu tudugare bito. Umode bowuje rugadu. Nono umode nowu tudugare barigu toro boe pegarewuto ime pegarewugebo nowu mearutorukare tuwadaru jiwugebo. Torore boe etragudu rakamode. Torore boe emode to reko pui tuwiri boe kori koia.

b: Nogware Enodo Padure Dez
source: Nogware Enodo Padure Dez

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore imode tawie nuba ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewuge emode toro nowu inagoino jiwu meri keje. Ireadodumode bakaruji iwo tawie. Ca nogware enodo padu kejeboere dez. Ere tudawuje tuwai piji joru kuru meture tadawu to jorugu tabo tuduwo uwiremodewu iparedu togi.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore imode tawie nuba ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewuge emode toro nowu inagoino jiwu meri keje. Ireadodumode bakaruji iwo tawie. Ca nogware enodo padu kejeboere dez. Ere tudawuje tuwai piji joru kuru meture tadawu to jorugu tabo tuduwo uwiremodewu iparedu togi.

b: Joruduwarewuge nogwarere ikera aboudure. Joruduwa bokwarewuge nogwarere ikera aboudure jamedu.
source: Joruduwarewuge nogwarere ikera aboudure. Joruduwa bokwarewuge nogwarere ikera aboudure jamedu.

b: Nou joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware eture to jorugu tabo mare etukare ia joru kuru kobo tabo. Eture tabowu joru kuru meture to jorugu tada tu rugadu.
source: Nou joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware eture to jorugu tabo mare etukare ia joru kuru kobo tabo. Eture tabowu joru kuru meture to jorugu tada tu rugadu.

b: Mare nowu joruduwarewu nogware eture to jorugu tabo, nowu meture to jorugu tadawu joru kuru tabo, ia joru kuru kobo tabo jamedu, joru kuru akedukawo.
source: Mare nowu joruduwarewu nogware eture to jorugu tabo, nowu meture to jorugu tadawu joru kuru tabo, ia joru kuru kobo tabo jamedu, joru kuru akedukawo.

b: Ca nowu uwiremodewu iparedu akekare ji dukodire aregodukare jii boeco ji. Dukodire nowu nogware eiamedu boe enudure. Norire ekuji dukodire enudure.
source: Ca nowu uwiremodewu iparedu akekare ji dukodire aregodukare jii boeco ji. Dukodire nowu nogware eiamedu boe enudure. Norire ekuji dukodire enudure.

b: Ca ari aregodure baru oia ka dukeje boe ekudure boe etae. Egore: “Uwiremodewu iparedu aregodu! Mato! Mato togi!”
source: Ca ari aregodure baru oia ka dukeje boe ekudure boe etae. Egore: “Uwiremodewu iparedu aregodu! Mato! Mato togi!”

b: Dukodire nowu nogware edadure. Ere nowu to jorugu uradurogu kado urugu pemegawo.
source: Dukodire nowu nogware edadure. Ere nowu to jorugu uradurogu kado urugu pemegawo.

b: Mare nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware emagore nowu joruduwarewuge ji. Egore: “Ia joru kuru maku cenai. Ceno joru kuru akedugodu.”
source: Mare nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware emagore nowu joruduwarewuge ji. Egore: “Ia joru kuru maku cenai. Ceno joru kuru akedugodu.”

b: Mare nowu joruduwarewuge nogware egore: “Boro. Ceno joru kuru kurikare. Umode turugadu tu cei tu rugadu. Umodukare turugadu tai. Tadudo toro boe jeturewu ka tawo tageragu ia joru kuruji pugeje tagoce.”
source: Mare nowu joruduwarewuge nogware egore: “Boro. Ceno joru kuru kurikare. Umode turugadu tu cei tu rugadu. Umodukare turugadu tai. Tadudo toro boe jeturewu ka tawo tageragu ia joru kuruji pugeje tagoce.”

b: Dukodire nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware eture rugadu tuwo akirodo joru kuruji. Mare ekare tugirimi dukeje nowu uwiremodewu iparedu aregodure. Nou joruduwarewuge nogware ere tudo turugadu marigudu dukodire ere turemo nowu uwiremodewu uwaito nowu boe ewadae ka rugadu. Nono nowu bai poro midure tuku rugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware eture rugadu tuwo akirodo joru kuruji. Mare ekare tugirimi dukeje nowu uwiremodewu iparedu aregodure. Nou joruduwarewuge nogware ere tudo turugadu marigudu dukodire ere turemo nowu uwiremodewu uwaito nowu boe ewadae ka rugadu. Nono nowu bai poro midure tuku rugadu.

b: Jii je dukeje nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware etaregodure boe jeturewu piji. Nono egore: “Cegimijera. Bai poro jado cenai.”
source: Jii je dukeje nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge nogware etaregodure boe jeturewu piji. Nono egore: “Cegimijera. Bai poro jado cenai.”

b: Mare nowu uwiremodewu iparedu uwai tadawu boe eimijera akore Ioruduwakare tai. Imodukare jado.”
source: Mare nowu uwiremodewu iparedu uwai tadawu boe eimijera akore Ioruduwakare tai. Imodukare jado.”

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ainore nowu boe egore. Mare Pao Kurirewu mearudae jire ireadodure aino tawiagai. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu aregodumode pugeje dukodire tado tarugadu marigudu.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ainore nowu boe egore. Mare Pao Kurirewu mearudae jire ireadodure aino tawiagai. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu aregodumode pugeje dukodire tado tarugadu marigudu.

b: Boe Etugarege Ere Pobe Metia Bokware
source: Boe Etugarege Ere Pobe Metia Bokware

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ca ia bakaru reo pugeje iwo tawie nuba ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewuge emode toro nowu inagoino jiwu meri keje. Ia meri keje imedu ure tumearudae tawuje tudu jaewo toro ia moto ka. Dukodire makore tudugarege ewagai. Ure etudo toe jamedu boe ji.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ca ia bakaru reo pugeje iwo tawie nuba ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewuge emode toro nowu inagoino jiwu meri keje. Ia meri keje imedu ure tumearudae tawuje tudu jaewo toro ia moto ka. Dukodire makore tudugarege ewagai. Ure etudo toe jamedu boe ji.

b: Nou utugarege pemegarewuge etaire ure to diero kurido etai. Dukodire ure diero tori kuieje oto padudo quinhentos makuduwo ia tudugare pemegarewu ai. Ure udo quinhentos ai utugare pemegarewunure ema kodi. Ure diero tori kuieje oto padudo duzentos makuduwo ia tudugare ai. Ure diero tori kuieje oto padudo cem makuduwo ia tudugare ai pugeje. Ure udo cem ai utugare pemega jokodukare dukodi. Nono nowu imedu uture. Utu jaere toro ia moto ka.
source: Nou utugarege pemegarewuge etaire ure to diero kurido etai. Dukodire ure diero tori kuieje oto padudo quinhentos makuduwo ia tudugare pemegarewu ai. Ure udo quinhentos ai utugare pemegarewunure ema kodi. Ure diero tori kuieje oto padudo duzentos makuduwo ia tudugare ai. Ure diero tori kuieje oto padudo cem makuduwo ia tudugare ai pugeje. Ure udo cem ai utugare pemega jokodukare dukodi. Nono nowu imedu uture. Utu jaere toro ia moto ka.

b: Nou quinhentos makudure aiwu imedu ure tudawuje kuri je tumaragoduwo nowu diero tabo tuwo nowu diero kurido tugori pugeje. Dukodire ure nowu diero kurido rugadu dukodire o diero oto padure mil.
source: Nou quinhentos makudure aiwu imedu ure tudawuje kuri je tumaragoduwo nowu diero tabo tuwo nowu diero kurido tugori pugeje. Dukodire ure nowu diero kurido rugadu dukodire o diero oto padure mil.

b: Nou duzentos makudure aiwu imedu rore nono nowu timedia ro mogadure jamedu. Ure to diero kurido jamedu dukodire o diero oto padure quatrocentos pugeje.
source: Nou duzentos makudure aiwu imedu rore nono nowu timedia ro mogadure jamedu. Ure to diero kurido jamedu dukodire o diero oto padure quatrocentos pugeje.

b: Mare nowu cem makudure aiwu imedu maragodukare nowu makudure pudaiwu diero tabo. Ure tudawuje nowu diero tabo. Ure moto porodo nono ure nowu makudure pudaiwu diero tugu nowu mototo tuwo nowu tugimijera o diero biado.
source: Mare nowu cem makudure aiwu imedu maragodukare nowu makudure pudaiwu diero tabo. Ure tudawuje nowu diero tabo. Ure moto porodo nono ure nowu makudure pudaiwu diero tugu nowu mototo tuwo nowu tugimijera o diero biado.

b: Toro ia meri keje nowu utu jaerewu imedu aregodure tuibagi to moto ka tuwai ka. Dukeje care makore nowu tudugarege ewagai pugeje tumagowo nowu eture jiwu diero bagai.
source: Toro ia meri keje nowu utu jaerewu imedu aregodure tuibagi to moto ka tuwai ka. Dukeje care makore nowu tudugarege ewagai pugeje tumagowo nowu eture jiwu diero bagai.

b: Nou quinhentos makudure aiwu utugare aregodure nowu to diero rugadu boe tabo. Akore Ikimijera. Are quinhentos maku inai. Ca ire kurido dukodire oto padure mil aino. Ema reo.”
source: Nou quinhentos makudure aiwu utugare aregodure nowu to diero rugadu boe tabo. Akore Ikimijera. Are quinhentos maku inai. Ca ire kurido dukodire oto padure mil aino. Ema reo.”

b: Ukimijera akore aru! Aro pemegare rugadu. Itugare pemegarewunure aki rugadu! Amearutorure i rugadu dukodire aro pemegare inoe roguji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado aki rugadu aetu pemegawo inoe kurirewu ji rugadu. Mato. Aremo iwaito aegarewo ai itabo.”
source: Ukimijera akore aru! Aro pemegare rugadu. Itugare pemegarewunure aki rugadu! Amearutorure i rugadu dukodire aro pemegare inoe roguji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado aki rugadu aetu pemegawo inoe kurirewu ji rugadu. Mato. Aremo iwaito aegarewo ai itabo.”

b: Nono nouia utugare aregodure jamedu. Akore Ikimijera. Are duzentos maku inai. Akaiwodo. Ire ako diero kurido. Dukodire oto padure quatrocentos aino. Ema reo.”
source: Nono nouia utugare aregodure jamedu. Akore Ikimijera. Are duzentos maku inai. Akaiwodo. Ire ako diero kurido. Dukodire oto padure quatrocentos aino. Ema reo.”

b: Ukimijera akore aru! Aro pemegare rugadu. Itugare pemegarewunure aki rugadu! Amearutorure i rugadu dukodire aro pemegare inoe roguji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado aki rugadu aetu pemegawo inoe kurirewu ji rugadu. Mato. Aremo iwaito aegarewo ai itabo.”
source: Ukimijera akore aru! Aro pemegare rugadu. Itugare pemegarewunure aki rugadu! Amearutorure i rugadu dukodire aro pemegare inoe roguji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado aki rugadu aetu pemegawo inoe kurirewu ji rugadu. Mato. Aremo iwaito aegarewo ai itabo.”

b: Nono nowu utugare pemega jokodukarewu aregodure jamedu. Akore Ikimijera. Ipagudure ace. Are boe emaragodae rakado ei awo akoe kurido. Are boe emaragodu rakado ako boepaji. Emagere ere ako boepa pemegado mare akai rugadu. Are emaragodae rakado ei ako boepa tadaboe kadoduwo mare etai karega akai rugadu.
source: Nono nowu utugare pemega jokodukarewu aregodure jamedu. Akore Ikimijera. Ipagudure ace. Are boe emaragodae rakado ei awo akoe kurido. Are boe emaragodu rakado ako boepaji. Emagere ere ako boepa pemegado mare akai rugadu. Are emaragodae rakado ei ako boepa tadaboe kadoduwo mare etai karega akai rugadu.

b: Dukodire itaidukare iwo ako diero barigu boeto. Dukodire imaragodukare ako diero tabo. Ire biado moto kuda akedukawo. Ca itaregodure tabo. Ema reo.”
source: Dukodire itaidukare iwo ako diero barigu boeto. Dukodire imaragodukare ako diero tabo. Ire biado moto kuda akedukawo. Ca itaregodure tabo. Ema reo.”

b: Mare nowu ukimijera jorudu pegare tudugare roino duji. Akore Aro pega! Akera kiarire rugadu. Amearudae pega kana irore jiboe ji? Ire tamaragodae maku tagai tawo ino boepa pemegado rugadu dukodire inoe kurire rugadu.
source: Mare nowu ukimijera jorudu pegare tudugare roino duji. Akore Aro pega! Akera kiarire rugadu. Amearudae pega kana irore jiboe ji? Ire tamaragodae maku tagai tawo ino boepa pemegado rugadu dukodire inoe kurire rugadu.

b: Mare kodiba akare ino diero tugu boe mode tugeragu diero pijiwu baito? Aromode aino dukeje ino diero itodumode rugadu.”
source: Mare kodiba akare ino diero tugu boe mode tugeragu diero pijiwu baito? Aromode aino dukeje ino diero itodumode rugadu.”

b: Nono nowu ukimijera makore ia tudugarege ewagai. Makore ei. Akore Tageragu nowu dieroji nowu itugare pegarewu piji tawo maku nowu mil apowu ai.
source: Nono nowu ukimijera makore ia tudugarege ewagai. Makore ei. Akore Tageragu nowu dieroji nowu itugare pegarewu piji tawo maku nowu mil apowu ai.

b: Imode tawie. Maragodu pemegarewuge etaire boe makudumode. Mare nowu maragodu pegarewuge etaire boe makudumodukare rugadu. Nou maragodu pegarewuge enoerogu mode mare nowu enoerogu akedumode epiji rugadu.
source: Imode tawie. Maragodu pemegarewuge etaire boe makudumode. Mare nowu maragodu pegarewuge etaire boe makudumodukare rugadu. Nou maragodu pegarewuge enoerogu mode mare nowu enoerogu akedumode epiji rugadu.

b: Ca nowu itugare pegarewu barigu toro boecoto. Nou rakojere torowuge etragudu rakamode rugadu. Torore nowu boe emode to reko pui tuwiri boe kori koia rugadu.”
source: Ca nowu itugare pegarewu barigu toro boecoto. Nou rakojere torowuge etragudu rakamode rugadu. Torore nowu boe emode to reko pui tuwiri boe kori koia rugadu.”

b: Pao Kurirewu Umode Ro Pemegarewuge Etawuje Ro Pegarewuge Epiji
source: Pao Kurirewu Umode Ro Pemegarewuge Etawuje Ro Pegarewuge Epiji

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore toro ia meri keje Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode to jorugu kurirewu tabo joruguwo moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Aregodumode turo rakarewu tabo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etaregodumode apo jamedu. Dukeje Imedu Onaregedu umode tumugudo boe eimijera mugure kejewu to ira moturewu keje. Boe eruduwamode baru tadawunure ema duji.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore toro ia meri keje Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode to jorugu kurirewu tabo joruguwo moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Aregodumode turo rakarewu tabo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etaregodumode apo jamedu. Dukeje Imedu Onaregedu umode tumugudo boe eimijera mugure kejewu to ira moturewu keje. Boe eruduwamode baru tadawunure ema duji.

b: Nono boe eiamedu boe etaregodumode bagai moto jamedu boe piji. Dukeje care Imedu Onaregedu aiwomode boe ji. Umode tugeragu mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge remawugei tuwo etawuje mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge epiji. Romode nono ia imedu jeture boe eguie jitu ro mogadure. Jeture ovelha dogeiwu umode ovelha doge etawuje cabrito doge epiji.
source: Nono boe eiamedu boe etaregodumode bagai moto jamedu boe piji. Dukeje care Imedu Onaregedu aiwomode boe ji. Umode tugeragu mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge remawugei tuwo etawuje mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge epiji. Romode nono ia imedu jeture boe eguie jitu ro mogadure. Jeture ovelha dogeiwu umode ovelha doge etawuje cabrito doge epiji.

b: Nono umode nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge ovelha doge emugudo nono tugana pemegarewu jagwai. Mare umode nowu cabrito doge emugudo nono tugana pegarewu jagwai.
source: Nono umode nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge ovelha doge emugudo nono tugana pemegarewu jagwai. Mare umode nowu cabrito doge emugudo nono tugana pegarewu jagwai.

b: Mare boe eguie ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Boe Eimijera Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pemegarewu jagwaiwuge ji. Akomode: “Mato. Taremo Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Pao Kurirewu aidure tai. Tare tagimijerado ema tamearutoruwo tu ji dukodire umode nowu tamearutorure pudui du morido tagai tamuguwo boe pemegarewu keje. Ure nowu boe pemegarewu towuje marigudu. Ukare moto to raga dukeje ure nowu boe pemegarewu towuje mearutorure puduiwuge emuguwo keje toro ia meri keje.
source: Mare boe eguie ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Boe Eimijera Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pemegarewu jagwaiwuge ji. Akomode: “Mato. Taremo Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Pao Kurirewu aidure tai. Tare tagimijerado ema tamearutoruwo tu ji dukodire umode nowu tamearutorure pudui du morido tagai tamuguwo boe pemegarewu keje. Ure nowu boe pemegarewu towuje marigudu. Ukare moto to raga dukeje ure nowu boe pemegarewu towuje mearutorure puduiwuge emuguwo keje toro ia meri keje.

b: Mare paga karega. Ike boeire i dukeje tare ike maku inai. Pobo boeire i dukeje tare pobo maku inai ikuduwo ce. Boe tuginaiwure imi dukeje tare iremo tawaito iwo itamudo.
source: Mare paga karega. Ike boeire i dukeje tare ike maku inai. Pobo boeire i dukeje tare pobo maku inai ikuduwo ce. Boe tuginaiwure imi dukeje tare iremo tawaito iwo itamudo.

b: Ikudau areia bokware dukeje tare ia boe ekudau areia maku inai ikudauce. Ikogodure dukeje taetu pemegare i. Iragojere baicorewu tada dukeje tagaregodure itae tamagowo i tawo ikiarigodu barigu ipiji.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pemegarewu jagwaiwuge ji.
source: Ikudau areia bokware dukeje tare ia boe ekudau areia maku inai ikudauce. Ikogodure dukeje taetu pemegare i. Iragojere baicorewu tada dukeje tagaregodure itae tamagowo i tawo ikiarigodu barigu ipiji.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pemegarewu jagwaiwuge ji.

b: Nono nowu ro pemegarewuge emagomode Pao Kurirewu ji. Egomode: “Cegimijera. Kocare cerudukare ai ake boeire ai duji dukodire cegare boe eke maku akai. Cerudukare ai pobo boeire ai duji dukodire cegare pobo maku akai akuduwo ce.
source: Nono nowu ro pemegarewuge emagomode Pao Kurirewu ji. Egomode: “Cegimijera. Kocare cerudukare ai ake boeire ai duji dukodire cegare boe eke maku akai. Cerudukare ai pobo boeire ai duji dukodire cegare pobo maku akai akuduwo ce.

b: Cerudukare ai boe tuginaiwunure aki duji dukodire cegare aremo cewaito. Cerudukare ai akudau bokware duji dukodire cegare cegudau areia maku akai.
source: Cerudukare ai boe tuginaiwunure aki duji dukodire cegare aremo cewaito. Cerudukare ai akudau bokware duji dukodire cegare cegudau areia maku akai.

b: Cerudukare ai akogodure baicorewu tada duji dukodire cedaregodukare akae cewo akiarigodu barigu apiji.” Ainore nowu ro pemegarewuge egomode.
source: Cerudukare ai akogodure baicorewu tada duji dukodire cedaregodukare akae cewo akiarigodu barigu apiji.” Ainore nowu ro pemegarewuge egomode.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu makomode ei: “Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Mearutorure iwugeire tarore awu inagoino jiboe ji dukodire inaire taroino. Emearutorure i dukodire iwobere emage. Rakakarewugenure emage marenarue dogenure emage mare du inodu tabo taro pemegare ei dukodire inaire taroino.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pemegarewu jagwaiwuge ji.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu makomode ei: “Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Mearutorure iwugeire tarore awu inagoino jiboe ji dukodire inaire taroino. Emearutorure i dukodire iwobere emage. Rakakarewugenure emage marenarue dogenure emage mare du inodu tabo taro pemegare ei dukodire inaire taroino.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pemegarewu jagwaiwuge ji.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pegarewu jagwaiwuge ji. Akomode: “Ipiji! Boe pegamode tai rugadu! Ire joru pegarewu towuje bope doge eimijera bariguduwo to, bope doge ewariguduwo to. Nou joru pegarewu akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Ca tawariguduwo to ipiji jamedu.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu makomode nowu mugure tugana pegarewu jagwaiwuge ji. Akomode: “Ipiji! Boe pegamode tai rugadu! Ire joru pegarewu towuje bope doge eimijera bariguduwo to, bope doge ewariguduwo to. Nou joru pegarewu akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Ca tawariguduwo to ipiji jamedu.

b: Mare paga karega. Tarudure i ike boeire iduji mare tagare ike maku inai. Pobo boeire i mare tagare pobo maku inai.
source: Mare paga karega. Tarudure i ike boeire iduji mare tagare ike maku inai. Pobo boeire i mare tagare pobo maku inai.

b: Tarudure i boe tuginaiwunure imi duji mare tagare iremo tawaito iwo itamudo. Ikudau areia bokware mare tagare tagudau areia maku inai ikudauce. Ikogodure. Iragojere baicorewu tada. Mare tagaiwokare i taetu pemegakare i.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akomode nowu mugure tugana pegarewu jagwaiwuge ji.
source: Tarudure i boe tuginaiwunure imi duji mare tagare iremo tawaito iwo itamudo. Ikudau areia bokware mare tagare tagudau areia maku inai ikudauce. Ikogodure. Iragojere baicorewu tada. Mare tagaiwokare i taetu pemegakare i.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akomode nowu mugure tugana pegarewu jagwaiwuge ji.

b: Mare egomode: “Cegimijera. Kocare cerudukare ai ake boeire ai duji. Cerudukare ai pobo boeire ai duji. Cerudukare ai boe tuginaiwunure aki duji. Cerudukare ai akogodure duji. Cerudukare ai baicorewu tada. Dukodire cegare cegera maku akai.”
source: Mare egomode: “Cegimijera. Kocare cerudukare ai ake boeire ai duji. Cerudukare ai pobo boeire ai duji. Cerudukare ai boe tuginaiwunure aki duji. Cerudukare ai akogodure duji. Cerudukare ai baicorewu tada. Dukodire cegare cegera maku akai.”

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu akomode: “Mare imode tawie boe remawu ji. Tarudure mearutorure iwugei rugadu. Eire inagoino. Tagare tagera maku nowu mearutorure iwuge etai dukodire inagoino tagare tagera maku inai. Ire taroino. Eragakare marenarue dogenure emage mare du inodu tabo iwobere emage dukodire inagoino ire taroino.”
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu akomode: “Mare imode tawie boe remawu ji. Tarudure mearutorure iwugei rugadu. Eire inagoino. Tagare tagera maku nowu mearutorure iwuge etai dukodire inagoino tagare tagera maku inai. Ire taroino. Eragakare marenarue dogenure emage mare du inodu tabo iwobere emage dukodire inagoino ire taroino.”

b: – Dukeje care nowu boe ewarigudumode nowu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto eragojewo nono jii toro rugadu. Mare nowu ro pemegarewuge emugumode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu jii toro rugadu.
source: – Dukeje care nowu boe ewarigudumode nowu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto eragojewo nono jii toro rugadu. Mare nowu ro pemegarewuge emugumode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu jii toro rugadu.

b: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Tawuje Tuwo Jesus Bito
source: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Tawuje Tuwo Jesus Bito

b: Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo nowu boe ji. Nono care makore ture joruduwadowuge ji.
source: Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo nowu boe ji. Nono care makore ture joruduwadowuge ji.

b: Akore merimode pobe dukeje boe emode tuwadae Páscoa towuje nono paroiaji. Nono Imedu Onaregedu makudumode boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai bitoduwo ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
source: Akore merimode pobe dukeje boe emode tuwadae Páscoa towuje nono paroiaji. Nono Imedu Onaregedu makudumode boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai bitoduwo ipo padure pugajejewu keje.

b: Toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu rakojere tuwai kurirewu tada nouia Judeu doge eimijeragebo. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu iere Caifás.
source: Toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu rakojere tuwai kurirewu tada nouia Judeu doge eimijeragebo. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu iere Caifás.

b: Ere bato pui nono tuwo tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito. Mare emagore pui tumoduie nowu tumearudae biado boe epiji.
source: Ere bato pui nono tuwo tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito. Mare emagore pui tumoduie nowu tumearudae biado boe epiji.

b: egore Pawadae Páscoa kejere pamodukare pageragu ji. Pamode pageragu ji pawadae keje dukeje boe ekorigodumode pai. Emode bato pui turugoduwo pai. Dukodire pamodukare pageragu ji pawadae keje rugadu.
source: egore Pawadae Páscoa kejere pamodukare pageragu ji. Pamode pageragu ji pawadae keje dukeje boe ekorigodumode pai. Emode bato pui turugoduwo pai. Dukodire pamodukare pageragu ji pawadae keje rugadu.

b: Jesus Uture Boe Eda Betânia Ka
source: Jesus Uture Boe Eda Betânia Ka

b: Nono Jesus uture boe eda Betânia ka. Nonore rakojere Simão uwai tada. Nou Simão iere Biri Pegarewu jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus uture boe eda Betânia ka. Nonore rakojere Simão uwai tada. Nou Simão iere Biri Pegarewu jamedu.

b: Jesus mugure nono nowu bai tada ira keje togwage tabo. Nono ia aredu aregodure Jesus ae poarirogu tabo. Nou boe ere nowu poari towuje tori tabo. Nou tori iere alabastro. Roreboe mori kurirewu meture nowu poarirogu tada. Nono ca nowu aredu ure nowu poari jado. Ure nowu roreboe redo Jesus aora joki.
source: Jesus mugure nono nowu bai tada ira keje togwage tabo. Nono ia aredu aregodure Jesus ae poarirogu tabo. Nou boe ere nowu poari towuje tori tabo. Nou tori iere alabastro. Roreboe mori kurirewu meture nowu poarirogu tada. Nono ca nowu aredu ure nowu poari jado. Ure nowu roreboe redo Jesus aora joki.

b: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu aredu roino duji dukeje emago pegare rore jiboe ji. egore kocare ure barigu.
source: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu aredu roino duji dukeje emago pegare rore jiboe ji. egore kocare ure barigu.

b: Nou roreboe mori kurire rugadu. Kocare ukare maku diero bagai tuwo diero kurido tuwo maku marenarue doge etai.
source: Nou roreboe mori kurire rugadu. Kocare ukare maku diero bagai tuwo diero kurido tuwo maku marenarue doge etai.

b: Mare Jesus joruduware emagore pui duji. Dukodire makore ei. Akore tagaba awu aredu pogurudo rore i duji. Rore i du moture Pao Kurirewu jakai.
source: Mare Jesus joruduware emagore pui duji. Dukodire makore ei. Akore tagaba awu aredu pogurudo rore i duji. Rore i du moture Pao Kurirewu jakai.

b: Mare paga karega. Marenarue doge edumode tagabo jii toro rugadu. Mare imire itumode tabiji rugadu.
source: Mare paga karega. Marenarue doge edumode tagabo jii toro rugadu. Mare imire itumode tabiji rugadu.

b: Emarodo ure iwiri udo turugadu ituguduwo mototo iwi keje.
source: Emarodo ure iwiri udo turugadu ituguduwo mototo iwi keje.

b: Dukodire imode tawie boe remawu ji. Awu aredu rore iboe akedumodukare boe etaora piji jii toro rugadu. Boe etumode moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe eruduwado emearutoruwo i iwo ekinorudo dukeje ereadodumode awu aredu rore iduji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire boe ewiagodumodukare awu aredu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu.
source: Dukodire imode tawie boe remawu ji. Awu aredu rore iboe akedumodukare boe etaora piji jii toro rugadu. Boe etumode moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe eruduwado emearutoruwo i iwo ekinorudo dukeje ereadodumode awu aredu rore iduji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire boe ewiagodumodukare awu aredu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu.

b: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai
source: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai

b: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes uture nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae. Makore ei: – Imode Jesus maku tagai dukeje nuba tamode dierodo inai nowu iro morice? Etaidure Judas bataru ji dukodire ere diero prata oto padudo trinta Judas Iscariotes ai uwo Jesus maku pudai.
source: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes uture nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae. Makore ei: – Imode Jesus maku tagai dukeje nuba tamode dierodo inai nowu iro morice? Etaidure Judas bataru ji dukodire ere diero prata oto padudo trinta Judas Iscariotes ai uwo Jesus maku pudai.

b: Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo tumode maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu meri bagai.
source: Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo tumode maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu meri bagai.

b: Jesus Okwagemode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Ekeji Ture Joruduwadowugebo
source: Jesus Okwagemode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Ekeji Ture Joruduwadowugebo

b: Páscoa meri boeto jiwu aregodure dukeje Judeu doge ere tuge amirewu pemegado nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji. Nou meri ji nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaiba cemode page pemegado pawo ko, pawaduwo Páscoaji?
source: Páscoa meri boeto jiwu aregodure dukeje Judeu doge ere tuge amirewu pemegado nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji. Nou meri ji nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaiba cemode page pemegado pawo ko, pawaduwo Páscoaji?

b: Jesus akore Tadudo toro nowu ba kurirewu ka. Torore tarudumode imeduji. Tamagodo ji tagimijera akoie uwai tadare uie turugadu tuwo tuge ko tuwaduwo Pascoaji ture joruduwadowugebo.
source: Jesus akore Tadudo toro nowu ba kurirewu ka. Torore tarudumode imeduji. Tamagodo ji tagimijera akoie uwai tadare uie turugadu tuwo tuge ko tuwaduwo Pascoaji ture joruduwadowugebo.

b: Jesus akoino ei dukodire nowu ure joruduwadowuge erore nono Jesus mako mogadure. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Pascoaji.
source: Jesus akoino ei dukodire nowu ure joruduwadowuge erore nono Jesus mako mogadure. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Pascoaji.

b: Nou boeco ji Jesus mugure nono ira keje togwagewo ture joruduwadowugebo. Nou ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe edu nono dukodire enodo padure doze nono Jesus apo.
source: Nou boeco ji Jesus mugure nono ira keje togwagewo ture joruduwadowugebo. Nou ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe edu nono dukodire enodo padure doze nono Jesus apo.

b: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Ia tagi tamode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Ia tagi tamode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Ekiarigodure nowu Jesus makore pudui duji. Dukodire emagore tugimijeraji tu tu puregodaji. egore i karega akagoino ikimijera?
