source: Ekiarigodure nowu Jesus makore pudui duji. Dukodire emagore tugimijeraji tu tu puregodaji. egore i karega akagoino ikimijera?

b: Jesus akore Nou ure tuge amirewu pegodo nowu carneiro kuru towu nono itabowu emare umode imagu boe ekimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Jesus akore Nou ure tuge amirewu pegodo nowu carneiro kuru towu nono itabowu emare umode imagu boe ekimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie iwimoduie duji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje. Aino care iwimode nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koia. Mare boe pegamode rugadu nowu ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji. Botumodukare dukeje boe pegamodukaie ji. Mare aino care umode imagu boe ekimijerage pegarewuge etai dukodire boe pegamode ji rugadu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie iwimoduie duji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje. Aino care iwimode nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koia. Mare boe pegamode rugadu nowu ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji. Botumodukare dukeje boe pegamodukaie ji. Mare aino care umode imagu boe ekimijerage pegarewuge etai dukodire boe pegamode ji rugadu.

b: Judas umode Jesus maku rugadu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai rugadu. Nono emare makore Jesus ji. Akore i karega akagoino ikimijera? Jesus akore Uu. Aki rugadu.
source: Judas umode Jesus maku rugadu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai rugadu. Nono emare makore Jesus ji. Akore i karega akagoino ikimijera? Jesus akore Uu. Aki rugadu.

b: Care enogwage kimore. Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tagwagedo awuji. Ikodu reo tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.
source: Care enogwage kimore. Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tagwagedo awuji. Ikodu reo tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.

b: Nono ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu. Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu uva kuru paru tabo dukeje ure pedo ei jamedu. Akore tagududo ce taiamedu boe.
source: Nono ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu. Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu uva kuru paru tabo dukeje ure pedo ei jamedu. Akore tagududo ce taiamedu boe.

b: Ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Iku redodumode boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu tumoduie turo maiwu maku boe etai tuwo boe ekinorudo. Aino care iku umode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu. Nou iku koiare Pao Kurirewu biagodumode mearutorure puduiwuge ero pegare jiboe piji tuwo ekinorudo rugadu.
source: Ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Iku redodumode boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu tumoduie turo maiwu maku boe etai tuwo boe ekinorudo. Aino care iku umode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu. Nou iku koiare Pao Kurirewu biagodumode mearutorure puduiwuge ero pegare jiboe piji tuwo ekinorudo rugadu.

b: Mare iwo tawie. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode mato ibagi pugeje du ka. Itaregodumode pugeje dukeje boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi. Nono ikudumode vinho kuru maiwuce tagabo.
source: Mare iwo tawie. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode mato ibagi pugeje du ka. Itaregodumode pugeje dukeje boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi. Nono ikudumode vinho kuru maiwuce tagabo.

b: Jesus akoino dukeje urare Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Nono ere tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri ao ka.
source: Jesus akoino dukeje urare Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Nono ere tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri ao ka.

b: Jesus Joruduware Nuba Pedro Akomode
source: Jesus Joruduware Nuba Pedro Akomode

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje. Akore awu boeco ji ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu i rugadu. Dukodire taiamedu boe tamode tagera ra ipiji. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Nou bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode nowu jeture boeiwu bito. Nono nowu boe eiamedu boe emode taodo nowu tugimijera piji nono ovelha doge ero mogadure.”
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje. Akore awu boeco ji ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu i rugadu. Dukodire taiamedu boe tamode tagera ra ipiji. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Nou bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode nowu jeture boeiwu bito. Nono nowu boe eiamedu boe emode taodo nowu tugimijera piji nono ovelha doge ero mogadure.”

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. Ire akoino. Mare iewodumode pugeje dukeje itumode tagododai toro Galiléia moto ka.
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. Ire akoino. Mare iewodumode pugeje dukeje itumode tagododai toro Galiléia moto ka.

b: Mare Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore nou iage emode tugera ra apiji mare imire iromodukare aino. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore nou iage emode tugera ra apiji mare imire iromodukare aino. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu.

b: Jesus akore Imode awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji rugadu akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.
source: Jesus akore Imode awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji rugadu akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.

b: Mare Pedro aidukare Jesus akoino pudui duji. Akore iwimode akabo mare imodukare iwadaru udo nono akago mogadure. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu. Ainore Pedro akore. Nono nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nono Pedro ako mogadure jamedu.
source: Mare Pedro aidukare Jesus akoino pudui duji. Akore iwimode akabo mare imodukare iwadaru udo nono akago mogadure. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu. Ainore Pedro akore. Nono nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nono Pedro ako mogadure jamedu.

b: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai Getsêmani Moto Keje
source: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai Getsêmani Moto Keje

b: Nono Jesus aregodure ture joruduwadowugebo ia iguru jeturewu ka. Nou iguru iere Getsêmani. Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tamugudo woe. Itumode kuri je. Imagomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure ture joruduwadowugebo ia iguru jeturewu ka. Nou iguru iere Getsêmani. Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tamugudo woe. Itumode kuri je. Imagomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu Pedro ji, Tiagoji, Joãoji tuduwo ebo kuri nono. Dukeje kiarigodu rakare. Joruduware boe pegamode pudui duji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu Pedro ji, Tiagoji, Joãoji tuduwo ebo kuri nono. Dukeje kiarigodu rakare. Joruduware boe pegamode pudui duji rugadu.

b: Nono makore nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge ji. Akore ikiarigodu rakare rugadu. Rakare tuwo iwido rugadu. Ca tadu ruga woe tamagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai itabo.
source: Nono makore nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge ji. Akore ikiarigodu rakare rugadu. Rakare tuwo iwido rugadu. Ca tadu ruga woe tamagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai itabo.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji. Nono ure tuie jodo moto ka tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Akore iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Mare ukawo nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji. Nono ure tuie jodo moto ka tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Akore iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Mare ukawo nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.

b: Care ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Mare kocare enudunure. Nono makore Pedro ji. Akore amagodo Pao Kurirewu bagai itabowu hora uwo mitotu je mare kocare anudure kuri je.
source: Care ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Mare kocare enudunure. Nono makore Pedro ji. Akore amagodo Pao Kurirewu bagai itabowu hora uwo mitotu je mare kocare anudure kuri je.

b: Amearudae pemegare. Mare araga bokware. Aino care anudukaba pugeje. Amagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku akai aro pegakawo.
source: Amearudae pemegare. Mare araga bokware. Aino care anudukaba pugeje. Amagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku akai aro pegakawo.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji pugeje. Care makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to pugeje. Akore iogwa. Boe ero pegamode idu utumodukare ipiji dukeje uwo nono akaidu mogadure.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji pugeje. Care makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to pugeje. Akore iogwa. Boe ero pegamode idu utumodukare ipiji dukeje uwo nono akaidu mogadure.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae pugeje. Jorudure ei enudu kimore duji. Norire ekuji dukodire enudure rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae pugeje. Jorudure ei enudu kimore duji. Norire ekuji dukodire enudure rugadu.

b: Dukodire ure tudaru gu epiji pugeje. Makore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai pugeje. Makore nono nowu tuwadaru mogadure pugeje.
source: Dukodire ure tudaru gu epiji pugeje. Makore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai pugeje. Makore nono nowu tuwadaru mogadure pugeje.

b: Dukeje care ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae pugeje. Nono makore ei. Akore tamugudo. Tanudu kimonure rugadu kana? Aino care imagudumode boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai kuri aino rugadu.
source: Dukeje care ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae pugeje. Nono makore ei. Akore tamugudo. Tanudu kimonure rugadu kana? Aino care imagudumode boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai kuri aino rugadu.

b: Ca taragojedo. Pugeje. Paduwo. Nou ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu aregodu!
source: Ca taragojedo. Pugeje. Paduwo. Nou ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu aregodu!

b: Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji
source: Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji

b: Jesus mako kimore dukeje Judas Iscariotes aregodure. Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema rugadu. Mare aino nowu Judas Iscariotes aregodure boebo. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nouia boe eimijerage pegarewuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai dukodire etaregodure rago tabo, tariga kurirewu tabo.
source: Jesus mako kimore dukeje Judas Iscariotes aregodure. Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema rugadu. Mare aino nowu Judas Iscariotes aregodure boebo. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nouia boe eimijerage pegarewuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai dukodire etaregodure rago tabo, tariga kurirewu tabo.

b: Nou Judas Iscariotes makore ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai. Tugimadumoduie Jesus apo, tumoduie togwa to je koduto tuwo boe pegarewuge erududo etaidure tuwo tugeragu jiwunure ema duji.
source: Nou Judas Iscariotes makore ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai. Tugimadumoduie Jesus apo, tumoduie togwa to je koduto tuwo boe pegarewuge erududo etaidure tuwo tugeragu jiwunure ema duji.

b: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture kuri Jesus ae rugadu. Ukimadure apo rugadu. Akore joruduwarewunure aki rugadu. Nono Judas Iscariotes ure togwa to Jesus je koduto.
source: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture kuri Jesus ae rugadu. Ukimadure apo rugadu. Akore joruduwarewunure aki rugadu. Nono Judas Iscariotes ure togwa to Jesus je koduto.

b: Jesus makore ji. Akore me. Arodo akaidure jiboe ji rugadu. Nono nouia ime ere tuburedo Jesus ji. Nono ere tugeragu Jesus ji turaga tabo rugadu.
source: Jesus makore ji. Akore me. Arodo akaidure jiboe ji rugadu. Nono nouia ime ere tuburedo Jesus ji. Nono ere tugeragu Jesus ji turaga tabo rugadu.

b: Mare ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure tugeragu tariga kurirewuji. Ure ia imedu bija kado. Nou imedu nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu utugarenure ema.
source: Mare ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure tugeragu tariga kurirewuji. Ure ia imedu bija kado. Nou imedu nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu utugarenure ema.

b: Mare Jesus akore arokaba aino. Tariga kurirewu tugu tuiato pugeje. Boe emode tugeragu tariga kurirewu ji turugoduwo tabo dukeje ewimode tariga kurirewu tabo rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus akore arokaba aino. Tariga kurirewu tugu tuiato pugeje. Boe emode tugeragu tariga kurirewu ji turugoduwo tabo dukeje ewimode tariga kurirewu tabo rugadu.

b: Tawiapagakare iragaji rugadu. Itaidumode imagowo Iogwa Kurirewu bagai dukeje umode tudugarege baru tadawuge enodo padu kejewudo doze mil etuwo mato iwagai emearutoruwo i erowo nono imearudae mogadure.
source: Tawiapagakare iragaji rugadu. Itaidumode imagowo Iogwa Kurirewu bagai dukeje umode tudugarege baru tadawuge enodo padu kejewudo doze mil etuwo mato iwagai emearutoruwo i erowo nono imearudae mogadure.

b: Mare imagomodukare ewagai. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie tumearudae remawu ji iwimoduie. Padure bapera keje. Aino care nowu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Dukodire imagomodukare nowu baru tadawuge Pao Kurirewu utugarege ewagai rugadu.
source: Mare imagomodukare ewagai. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie tumearudae remawu ji iwimoduie. Padure bapera keje. Aino care nowu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Dukodire imagomodukare nowu baru tadawuge Pao Kurirewu utugarege ewagai rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu ro pegamoduie puduiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Akore ire boe emearudae pegado kana emearutorukawo tugimijeragei kana? Kocare tagaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo rago tabo tawo tageragu i nono taro moga ro pegarewuge eidu mogadure. Iragojere tagabo meri jamedu ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ire boe eruduwado nono. Mare tagare tageragu i nono.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu ro pegamoduie puduiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Akore ire boe emearudae pegado kana emearutorukawo tugimijeragei kana? Kocare tagaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo rago tabo tawo tageragu i nono taro moga ro pegarewuge eidu mogadure. Iragojere tagabo meri jamedu ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ire boe eruduwado nono. Mare tagare tageragu i nono.

b: Mare aino tagaregodure iwagai woe tarowo i nono tarore ro pegarewugei dumogadure. Dujire Pao Kurirewu akoino marigudu. Aino ca nowu Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe jeture pudui. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere nowu bataru bu bapera keje marigudu. Jesus akoino dukeje nowu ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe eregodure piji rugadu.
source: Mare aino tagaregodure iwagai woe tarowo i nono tarore ro pegarewugei dumogadure. Dujire Pao Kurirewu akoino marigudu. Aino ca nowu Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe jeture pudui. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere nowu bataru bu bapera keje marigudu. Jesus akoino dukeje nowu ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe eregodure piji rugadu.

b: Jesus Rakojere Judeu Doge Eimijerage Egorai
source: Jesus Rakojere Judeu Doge Eimijerage Egorai

b: Nou boe ere Jesus reko toro Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou imedu iere Caifás. Ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewunure ema. Nouia Judeu doge eimijerage edu nono jamedu. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edu nono jamedu. Boe eimijerage paru towuge edu nono jamedu.
source: Nou boe ere Jesus reko toro Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou imedu iere Caifás. Ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewunure ema. Nouia Judeu doge eimijerage edu nono jamedu. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edu nono jamedu. Boe eimijerage paru towuge edu nono jamedu.

b: Pedro kodu jaere boe ji tudu tabo Jesus rekodaji boe erudukawo pudui. Nono aregodure nowu Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou uwai kejere ure tumugudo nono tugobaigaregebo tuioruduwawo nuba boemode Jesus ji.
source: Pedro kodu jaere boe ji tudu tabo Jesus rekodaji boe erudukawo pudui. Nono aregodure nowu Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou uwai kejere ure tumugudo nono tugobaigaregebo tuioruduwawo nuba boemode Jesus ji.

b: Nou bai ja tadare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure. Nou Jerusalém kejewu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe edure nono jamedu. Eiamedu boe etaiwore ia Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Ewiapagare batrarodurewuge ewadaru ji taiwo tabo nowu Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Etaidure tuwo Jesus bito.
source: Nou bai ja tadare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure. Nou Jerusalém kejewu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe edure nono jamedu. Eiamedu boe etaiwore ia Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Ewiapagare batrarodurewuge ewadaru ji taiwo tabo nowu Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Etaidure tuwo Jesus bito.

b: Mare erudukare ia Jesus ro pegarewuji. Nou boe egore Jesus ro pegaie. Mare ewadaru kodukare puregodaji. Nono care imere pobe ere turagojedo tumagowo.
source: Mare erudukare ia Jesus ro pegarewuji. Nou boe egore Jesus ro pegaie. Mare ewadaru kodukare puregodaji. Nono care imere pobe ere turagojedo tumagowo.

b: egore awu imedu akore tumoduie awu Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu butudo dukeje merimoduie pobe metia bokware tuwo nowu bai rakojedo pugeje.
source: egore awu imedu akore tumoduie awu Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu butudo dukeje merimoduie pobe metia bokware tuwo nowu bai rakojedo pugeje.

b: Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure turagojedo jamedu. Makore Jesus ji. Akore amagomodukare nowu ewadaru jipagi kana? Boe rugadu ji kana egoino ai rugadu?
source: Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure turagojedo jamedu. Makore Jesus ji. Akore amagomodukare nowu ewadaru jipagi kana? Boe rugadu ji kana egoino ai rugadu?

b: Mare Jesus makokare boe ji rugadu. Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu unarare ji pugeje. Akore Pao Kurirewu aiwore pai. Dukodire amagodo boe remawu ji cei rugadu. Umode boe ekinorudowunure aki kana? Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure aki rugadu kana?
source: Mare Jesus makokare boe ji rugadu. Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu unarare ji pugeje. Akore Pao Kurirewu aiwore pai. Dukodire amagodo boe remawu ji cei rugadu. Umode boe ekinorudowunure aki kana? Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure aki rugadu kana?

b: Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Mare iwo tawie Imedu Onaregedu romode jiboe ji. Awu inodu otobiji tarudumode i imugure Pao Kurirewu ukana pemegarewu jagwai duji. Tarudumode i ire irawuje baru piji boetugu tabo duji.
source: Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Mare iwo tawie Imedu Onaregedu romode jiboe ji. Awu inodu otobiji tarudumode i imugure Pao Kurirewu ukana pemegarewu jagwai duji. Tarudumode i ire irawuje baru piji boetugu tabo duji.

b: Care nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure tugudau areia mega bowuje tugorigodure dukodi. Dukodire makore tumedage boe eimijeragei. Akore unure tudo nono Pao Kurirewure. Pagare akoino. Mako peganure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Pawiapagamodukare ia boe emagore jiboe ji pugeje. Tamearudure ji mako pegare Pao Kurirewu jituji rugadu.
source: Care nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure tugudau areia mega bowuje tugorigodure dukodi. Dukodire makore tumedage boe eimijeragei. Akore unure tudo nono Pao Kurirewure. Pagare akoino. Mako peganure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Pawiapagamodukare ia boe emagore jiboe ji pugeje. Tamearudure ji mako pegare Pao Kurirewu jituji rugadu.

b: Dukodi care nuba tamearudaere? Nuba paromode? Nou boe eimijerage egore Mako pegare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dukodire care bitoduwo rugadu.
source: Dukodi care nuba tamearudaere? Nuba paromode? Nou boe eimijerage egore Mako pegare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dukodire care bitoduwo rugadu.

b: Nono ere todoguru barigu Jesus je joki. Ere boeto ji jamedu.
source: Nono ere todoguru barigu Jesus je joki. Ere boeto ji jamedu.

b: Egokodure ji. egore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki rugadu kana? Ioguduba ure boeto ai? Amagodo!
source: Egokodure ji. egore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki rugadu kana? Ioguduba ure boeto ai? Amagodo!

b: Pedro Makore Tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji
source: Pedro Makore Tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji

b: Pedro mugu kimore nono bawadu keje. Nono ia aredu maragodure nowu bai tadawu ure tuburedo Pedro ae. Akore aragojere nowu Galiléia kejewu Jesus apo jamedu.
source: Pedro mugu kimore nono bawadu keje. Nono ia aredu maragodure nowu bai tadawu ure tuburedo Pedro ae. Akore aragojere nowu Galiléia kejewu Jesus apo jamedu.

b: Mare Pedro akore turagojekaie apo rugadu nowu boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Akore ioruduwakare kaba jiba akagoino.
source: Mare Pedro akore turagojekaie apo rugadu nowu boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Akore ioruduwakare kaba jiba akagoino.

b: Dukejere Pedro uture nowu bai poro bawadu kejewu ka mare ukare tudawuje. Nonore rakojere rugadu. Dukejere care ia aredu jorudure ji. Makore boe ji nono. Akore awu imedu rakojere nowu Nazaré kejewu imedu Jesus apo rugadu.
source: Dukejere Pedro uture nowu bai poro bawadu kejewu ka mare ukare tudawuje. Nonore rakojere rugadu. Dukejere care ia aredu jorudure ji. Makore boe ji nono. Akore awu imedu rakojere nowu Nazaré kejewu imedu Jesus apo rugadu.

b: Mare Pedro akore Boe rugadu jire inagoino. Ioruduwakare ji rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro akore Boe rugadu jire inagoino. Ioruduwakare ji rugadu.

b: Mare Pedro utukare. Rakojere ji je nono rugadu. Dukejere care iage ere tuburedo Pedro ji pugeje. egore awadarure nono nowu rakojere Jesus apowuge ewadaru mogadure. Dukodire care boe eruduware aragojere Jesus apo duji rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro utukare. Rakojere ji je nono rugadu. Dukejere care iage ere tuburedo Pedro ji pugeje. egore awadarure nono nowu rakojere Jesus apowuge ewadaru mogadure. Dukodire care boe eruduware aragojere Jesus apo duji rugadu.

b: Mare Pedro mako pegare ei tumagomodukaie boe remawu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu uiago boe pegado pudui. Akore ioruduwakare nowu tagagoino jiwu imeduji rugadu. Care rore puku kagariga kudugodure rugadu duji.
source: Mare Pedro mako pegare ei tumagomodukaie boe remawu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu uiago boe pegado pudui. Akore ioruduwakare nowu tagagoino jiwu imeduji rugadu. Care rore puku kagariga kudugodure rugadu duji.

b: Kodire Pedro biabuture Jesus makore puduiwu tuwadaru keje. Jesus makore Pedro ji makomoduie tuioruduwakaie pudui dukeje nowu kagariga kudugodumoduie rugadu. Pedro makomoduie tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji dumoduie pobe metia bokware rugadu. Aino ca Pedro biabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje rugadu jeture pudui duji rugadu. Dukodire uture nowu boe epiji rugadu. Ragudure rugadu turore aino duji.
source: Kodire Pedro biabuture Jesus makore puduiwu tuwadaru keje. Jesus makore Pedro ji makomoduie tuioruduwakaie pudui dukeje nowu kagariga kudugodumoduie rugadu. Pedro makomoduie tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji dumoduie pobe metia bokware rugadu. Aino ca Pedro biabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje rugadu jeture pudui duji rugadu. Dukodire uture nowu boe epiji rugadu. Ragudure rugadu turore aino duji.

b: Boe Ere Jesus Reko Boe Eimijera Pilatos Uwai Ka
source: Boe Ere Jesus Reko Boe Eimijera Pilatos Uwai Ka

b: N o u b a r o g w a t o , barogwakododutabo nowu Judeu doge enomea makudure aiwuge eimijerage, nowu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe emagore pui tuwo tumearudae tawuje tuwo Jesus bito rugadu.
source: N o u b a r o g w a t o , barogwakododutabo nowu Judeu doge enomea makudure aiwuge eimijerage, nowu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe emagore pui tuwo tumearudae tawuje tuwo Jesus bito rugadu.

b: Nono ere Jesus kogudo. Dukejere ere reko nowu boe eimijera governador Pilatos bagai rugadu.
source: Nono ere Jesus kogudo. Dukejere ere reko nowu boe eimijera governador Pilatos bagai rugadu.

b: Judas Iscariotes Ure Tuwido
source: Judas Iscariotes Ure Tuwido

b: Nou ure Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etaiwu Judas Iscariotes joruduware Jesus bitodumoduie dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Dukeje care uture nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ewagai pugeje, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ewagai pugeje tuwo nowu diero tori maku tuibagi etai. Ere nowu diero tori prata oto padudo trinta Judas Iscariotes ai uwo Jesus maku pudai.
source: Nou ure Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etaiwu Judas Iscariotes joruduware Jesus bitodumoduie dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Dukeje care uture nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ewagai pugeje, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ewagai pugeje tuwo nowu diero tori maku tuibagi etai. Ere nowu diero tori prata oto padudo trinta Judas Iscariotes ai uwo Jesus maku pudai.

b: Judas Iscariotes akore Iro pegare. Ire maku tagaiwu imedu ro pegarewu bokware. Mare nowu boe eimijerage egore aki rugadu aroino. Cegi karega.
source: Judas Iscariotes akore Iro pegare. Ire maku tagaiwu imedu ro pegarewu bokware. Mare nowu boe eimijerage egore aki rugadu aroino. Cegi karega.

b: Ca Judas Iscariotes ure nowu diero tori rugadu boe barigu nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewuto. Dukeje care uture pugeje toro nowu ba kurirewu piji. Dukeje care ure tuwido ture bukigu kogudo tugidoru kajeje dutabo.
source: Ca Judas Iscariotes ure nowu diero tori rugadu boe barigu nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewuto. Dukeje care uture pugeje toro nowu ba kurirewu piji. Dukeje care ure tuwido ture bukigu kogudo tugidoru kajeje dutabo.

b: Nou Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu tadare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere tugeragu nowu diero tori kugurei. Egore pui: – Awu diero makudure imedu bitoduwo. Parore jiboe koiare pamodukare awu diero maku Pao Kurirewu uwai tadaboe bagai. Pago bakaru jire paromodukare aino.
source: Nou Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu tadare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere tugeragu nowu diero tori kugurei. Egore pui: – Awu diero makudure imedu bitoduwo. Parore jiboe koiare pamodukare awu diero maku Pao Kurirewu uwai tadaboe bagai. Pago bakaru jire paromodukare aino.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ere tumearudae tawuje puapo tuwo tugeragu ia moto roguji nowu diero tabo. Nonore boe tuginaiwuge etugudumode mototo aroe eda keje.
source: Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ere tumearudae tawuje puapo tuwo tugeragu ia moto roguji nowu diero tabo. Nonore boe tuginaiwuge etugudumode mototo aroe eda keje.

b: Nou diero makudure Jesus bitoduwo dukodire nowu boe ere nowu moto iedo. Egore Boe Eku Jeture Kejewu Moto Reo aino ji. Ainore iere jii aino.
source: Nou diero makudure Jesus bitoduwo dukodire nowu boe ere nowu moto iedo. Egore Boe Eku Jeture Kejewu Moto Reo aino ji. Ainore iere jii aino.

b: Mare paga karega. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie boe eromoduie aino duji. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Jeremias ure nowu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore israel kejewuge ere tumearudae tawuje puapo tuwo diero prata tori oto padudo trinta nowu imedu morice.
source: Mare paga karega. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie boe eromoduie aino duji. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Jeremias ure nowu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore israel kejewuge ere tumearudae tawuje puapo tuwo diero prata tori oto padudo trinta nowu imedu morice.

b: Nono boe ere tugeragu nowu dieroji. Ere nowu diero maku ia maragodure rotu jiwu imedu ai tuwo tugeragu ia moto roguji. Mare paga karega emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe ji. Ainore nowu padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore rugadu. Jeture pudui rugadu.
source: Nono boe ere tugeragu nowu dieroji. Ere nowu diero maku ia maragodure rotu jiwu imedu ai tuwo tugeragu ia moto roguji. Mare paga karega emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe ji. Ainore nowu padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore rugadu. Jeture pudui rugadu.

b: Jesus Rakojere Boe Eimijera Pilatos Jokorai
source: Jesus Rakojere Boe Eimijera Pilatos Jokorai

b: Toro nowu boe eimijera governador uwai kejere Jesus rakojere nowu boe eimijera kurirewu Pilatos jokorai. Unarare Jesus ji. Akore boe rugadu kana? Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu? Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino.
source: Toro nowu boe eimijera governador uwai kejere Jesus rakojere nowu boe eimijera kurirewu Pilatos jokorai. Unarare Jesus ji. Akore boe rugadu kana? Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu? Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino.

b: Mare nouia boe eimijerage, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emago pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji nowu Pilatos biagai. Mare Jesus makokare boe ji tubaru tabo ewadaru jipagi.
source: Mare nouia boe eimijerage, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emago pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji nowu Pilatos biagai. Mare Jesus makokare boe ji tubaru tabo ewadaru jipagi.

b: Dukodire care Pilatos unarare Jesus ji pugeje. Akore amearudu kana nowu boe emago pegare ai duji rugadu?
source: Dukodire care Pilatos unarare Jesus ji pugeje. Akore amearudu kana nowu boe emago pegare ai duji rugadu?

b: Mare Jesus makokare boe ji pugeje. Dukodire nowu Pilatos joku kidure Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus makokare boe ji pugeje. Dukodire nowu Pilatos joku kidure Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Egore Jesus Bitoduiago Rugadu
source: Egore Jesus Bitoduiago Rugadu

b: Judeu doge ewadae Páscoa kejere Pilatos ure ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji Judeu doge eroiaji. Judeu doge emagomode ia ro pegarewu ieji dukeje Pilatos umode nowu ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje joru jamedu ji.
source: Judeu doge ewadae Páscoa kejere Pilatos ure ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji Judeu doge eroiaji. Judeu doge emagomode ia ro pegarewu ieji dukeje Pilatos umode nowu ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje joru jamedu ji.

b: Ca awu joruji ia boe eruduware jiwu ro pegarewu imedu rakojere baicorewu tada. Iere Barrabás. Boe eiamedu boe eruduware ji rugadu. Ro pegarewu remawunure ema rugadu.
source: Ca awu joruji ia boe eruduware jiwu ro pegarewu imedu rakojere baicorewu tada. Iere Barrabás. Boe eiamedu boe eruduware ji rugadu. Ro pegarewu remawunure ema rugadu.

b: Nono nowu boe emagare ture bato pui dutabo Pilatos ae. Dukejere Pilatos unarare ei. Akore ioguduba jiba tagaidure iwo tawuje baicorewu piji awu joruji utuwo pugeje? Tagaidu kana Barrabaji utuwo pugeje kana? Tagaidu kana awu boe egoino umode boe ekinorudowu Jesus ji kana utuwo pugeje?
source: Nono nowu boe emagare ture bato pui dutabo Pilatos ae. Dukejere Pilatos unarare ei. Akore ioguduba jiba tagaidure iwo tawuje baicorewu piji awu joruji utuwo pugeje? Tagaidu kana Barrabaji utuwo pugeje kana? Tagaidu kana awu boe egoino umode boe ekinorudowu Jesus ji kana utuwo pugeje?

b: Pilatos akoino tuwo Jesus utudo pugeje rugadu. Joruduware nowu Judeu doge eimijerage emearudae pegare Jesus jituji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui rugadu. Dukodire etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae boe emearutorukawo Jesus ji pugeje.
source: Pilatos akoino tuwo Jesus utudo pugeje rugadu. Joruduware nowu Judeu doge eimijerage emearudae pegare Jesus jituji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui rugadu. Dukodire etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae boe emearutorukawo Jesus ji pugeje.

b: Ca Pilatos mugure nowu taiwore boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu ira keje. Dukeje care oreduje bataru makudure ai nono. Akore akera ra nowu imedu piji. Ro pegarewu bokware rugadu. Iniau pegare ji awu boeco ji dukodire ipagudure ce. Ainore nowu Pilatos oreduje makore nowu toredu bagai.
source: Ca Pilatos mugure nowu taiwore boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu ira keje. Dukeje care oreduje bataru makudure ai nono. Akore akera ra nowu imedu piji. Ro pegarewu bokware rugadu. Iniau pegare ji awu boeco ji dukodire ipagudure ce. Ainore nowu Pilatos oreduje makore nowu toredu bagai.

b: Mare nowu Judeu doge eimijerage, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere boe ero jodo nono Pilatos jokorai. Dukodire nowu boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ro pegarewu imedu Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Mare uwo Jesus bito rugadu.
source: Mare nowu Judeu doge eimijerage, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere boe ero jodo nono Pilatos jokorai. Dukodire nowu boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ro pegarewu imedu Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Mare uwo Jesus bito rugadu.

b: Pilatos unarare ei pugeje. Akore ioguduba imode tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje? egore barrabás tawujeduiago rugadu!
source: Pilatos unarare ei pugeje. Akore ioguduba imode tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje? egore barrabás tawujeduiago rugadu!

b: Dukeje care Pilatos unarare pugeje. Akore nuba iromode awu boe egoino umode boe ekinorudowu Jesus ji? Nou boe eiamedu boe egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu!
source: Dukeje care Pilatos unarare pugeje. Akore nuba iromode awu boe egoino umode boe ekinorudowu Jesus ji? Nou boe eiamedu boe egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu!

b: Pilatos akore Kodiba tagagoino? Ro pegarewu pa? Mare ewiapagakare ji. Ere tugudu rakado. egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu!
source: Pilatos akore Kodiba tagagoino? Ro pegarewu pa? Mare ewiapagakare ji. Ere tugudu rakado. egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu!

b: Ca Pilatos joruduware nowu boe ekorigodure rugadu tugaie ewudugugo kodi. Dukeje care ure tugeragu poboji. Ure tugera kabi nowu boe egai. Akore ca. Imi karega imode awu imedu ku redo. Tagire taromode aino rugadu.
source: Ca Pilatos joruduware nowu boe ekorigodure rugadu tugaie ewudugugo kodi. Dukeje care ure tugeragu poboji. Ure tugera kabi nowu boe egai. Akore ca. Imi karega imode awu imedu ku redo. Tagire taromode aino rugadu.

b: Nou boe eiamedu boe egore uu! Ceigoia rugadu cemode ku redo rugadu dukodire cegire cemode morido, cedore emode morido jamedu.
source: Nou boe eiamedu boe egore uu! Ceigoia rugadu cemode ku redo rugadu dukodire cegire cemode morido, cedore emode morido jamedu.

b: Dukodire care Pilatos ure Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Mare ure tugobaigarege edo boeto Jesus ji bukigu tabo. Nono ure maku etai ewo Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
source: Dukodire care Pilatos ure Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Mare ure tugobaigarege edo boeto Jesus ji bukigu tabo. Nono ure maku etai ewo Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje.

b: Tugobaigarege Egokodure Jesus ji
source: Tugobaigarege Egokodure Jesus ji

b: Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Jesus ji. Ere turemo apo nowu tugimijera Pilatos uwaito. Nono emagore nouia tugobaigarege ewagai. Ere bato pui nono Jesus ae.
source: Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Jesus ji. Ere turemo apo nowu tugimijera Pilatos uwaito. Nono emagore nouia tugobaigarege ewagai. Ere bato pui nono Jesus ae.

b: Care ere Jesus ukudau areia tawuje piji. Nono ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu kujagurewu tugu Jesus ji.
source: Care ere Jesus ukudau areia tawuje piji. Nono ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu kujagurewu tugu Jesus ji.

b: Ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu atadawu towuje. Ere nowu atadawudo botoguruce. Dukejere ere tugu Jesus aoto atadawuwo ema. Ere Jesus iedudo ia ipoji tugana pemegarewu tabo. Dukejere care ere tubu jodo Jesus jokorai tuwadarukeadae pegarewu tabo. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki. Boe pemegawo ai rugadu. Mare pagare egoino. Emearutorukare Jesus ji dukodi rugadu.
source: Ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu atadawu towuje. Ere nowu atadawudo botoguruce. Dukejere ere tugu Jesus aoto atadawuwo ema. Ere Jesus iedudo ia ipoji tugana pemegarewu tabo. Dukejere care ere tubu jodo Jesus jokorai tuwadarukeadae pegarewu tabo. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki. Boe pemegawo ai rugadu. Mare pagare egoino. Emearutorukare Jesus ji dukodi rugadu.

b: Dukodire ere todoguru barigu ji. Ere tugeragu nowu ipoji piji dutabore ere boeto ji nowu ipo tabo rugadu. Ere boeto boeto aoraji rugadu.
source: Dukodire ere todoguru barigu ji. Ere tugeragu nowu ipoji piji dutabore ere boeto ji nowu ipo tabo rugadu. Ere boeto boeto aoraji rugadu.

b: Ere tumago pegado ji pugeje. Dukejere care ere nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tawuje Jesus piji. Ere Jesus ukudau areia tugu ji pugeje. Nono ere tugeragu Jesus ji tuduwo apo Jerusalém piji tuwo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu.
source: Ere tumago pegado ji pugeje. Dukejere care ere nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tawuje Jesus piji. Ere Jesus ukudau areia tugu ji pugeje. Nono ere tugeragu Jesus ji tuduwo apo Jerusalém piji tuwo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu.

b: Boe Ere Jesus Bu Ipo Padure Pugajejewu Keje
source: Boe Ere Jesus Bu Ipo Padure Pugajejewu Keje

b: Eture Jesus apo rugadu. Ekodure dukeje erudure ia imeduji. Iere Simão. Cirene ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Ca nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu nowu Simãoji oreduwo nowu Jesus bitodumode kejewu ipo tabo rugadu.
source: Eture Jesus apo rugadu. Ekodure dukeje erudure ia imeduji. Iere Simão. Cirene ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Ca nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu nowu Simãoji oreduwo nowu Jesus bitodumode kejewu ipo tabo rugadu.

b: Nono eture Jesus apo toro ia tori ri ao ka. Ewadaru tabo nowu tori iere Gólgota. Nou Gólgota ewadaru tabo iere: “Boe ewirewuge etaora ra jeta reo”, aino.
source: Nono eture Jesus apo toro ia tori ri ao ka. Ewadaru tabo nowu tori iere Gólgota. Nou Gólgota ewadaru tabo iere: “Boe ewirewuge etaora ra jeta reo”, aino.

b: Ere ia jorubo barigu vinho kuruto. Nou jorubo iere mirra. Nono ere nowu vinho kuru maku Jesus ai kuduwo ce. Mare Jesus ure togwa pagado ji dukodire aidukare tuguduwo ce.
source: Ere ia jorubo barigu vinho kuruto. Nou jorubo iere mirra. Nono ere nowu vinho kuru maku Jesus ai kuduwo ce. Mare Jesus ure togwa pagado ji dukodire aidukare tuguduwo ce.

b: Nono tugobaigarege ere Jesus bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Ere Jesus ukudau areia pedo pui. Ere tuwadumode tabowu torirogu barigu tuioruduwawo duboba umode tugeragu Jesus ukudau areiaji.
source: Nono tugobaigarege ere Jesus bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Ere Jesus ukudau areia pedo pui. Ere tuwadumode tabowu torirogu barigu tuioruduwawo duboba umode tugeragu Jesus ukudau areiaji.

b: Dukejere care ere tumugudo nono taiwo tabo Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Dukejere care ere tumugudo nono taiwo tabo Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Ere atugoreboe bu ipo keje Jesus aora bukajeje. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu reo. Iere Jesus.
source: Ere atugoreboe bu ipo keje Jesus aora bukajeje. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu reo. Iere Jesus.

b: Ere ia ro pegarewuge ime pobedu doge emugudo nono Jesus apo jamedu nowu meri ji. Ia rakojere Jesus kana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia rakojere Jesus kana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.
source: Ere ia ro pegarewuge ime pobedu doge emugudo nono Jesus apo jamedu nowu meri ji. Ia rakojere Jesus kana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia rakojere Jesus kana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.

b: Boe etaregodure nono dukeje ere taora paradudo. Emago pegare Jesus ji.
source: Boe etaregodure nono dukeje ere taora paradudo. Emago pegare Jesus ji.

b: egore akagore amoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo mare merimoduie pobe metia bokware dukeje amoduie rakojedo pugeje. Ca Pao Kurirewu onaregedu mode aki dukeje amode arawuje nowu ipo piji awo akinorudo.
source: egore akagore amoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo mare merimoduie pobe metia bokware dukeje amoduie rakojedo pugeje. Ca Pao Kurirewu onaregedu mode aki dukeje amode arawuje nowu ipo piji awo akinorudo.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge, nouia Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe edu nono tumago pega tabo Jesus ji jamedu.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge, nouia Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe edu nono tumago pega tabo Jesus ji jamedu.

b: egore ure boe ekinorudo mare kocare roiwakare tuwo tuginorudo rugadu! Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu karegure ema kana? Umode turawuje nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji dukeje cemearutorumode ji rugadu.
source: egore ure boe ekinorudo mare kocare roiwakare tuwo tuginorudo rugadu! Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu karegure ema kana? Umode turawuje nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji dukeje cemearutorumode ji rugadu.

b: Kocare awu Jesus mearutoruie Pao Kurirewu ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu onaregedu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare akoino. Aino Pao Kurirewu umodukare udo cinorudo rugadu. Ainore nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egore tumago pega tabo ji rugadu.
source: Kocare awu Jesus mearutoruie Pao Kurirewu ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu onaregedu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare akoino. Aino Pao Kurirewu umodukare udo cinorudo rugadu. Ainore nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egore tumago pega tabo ji rugadu.

b: Nou rakojere Jesus apowuge ro pegarewuge pobedu doge emago pegare Jesus ji jamedu.
source: Nou rakojere Jesus apowuge ro pegarewuge pobedu doge emago pegare Jesus ji jamedu.

b: Jesus Bire
source: Jesus Bire

b: Meri aregodure pagaia ka dukeje boecodure moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boecodure rugadu. Nou boeco kodure kuri toro nowu três hora ka.
source: Meri aregodure pagaia ka dukeje boecodure moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boecodure rugadu. Nou boeco kodure kuri toro nowu três hora ka.

b: Dukeje care Jesus makore tugudu tabo nowu boe ewadaru tabo. Akore eli, Eli lemá sabactani? Boe ewadaru tabore akore Pao Kurirewu, Pao Kurirewu! Kaba kodiba are akera ra ipiji? – Dujire akoino tuwadaru tabo.
source: Dukeje care Jesus makore tugudu tabo nowu boe ewadaru tabo. Akore eli, Eli lemá sabactani? Boe ewadaru tabore akore Pao Kurirewu, Pao Kurirewu! Kaba kodiba are akera ra ipiji? – Dujire akoino tuwadaru tabo.

b: Ia boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje egore tawiapagado. Jesus kudugodure Elias bagai.
source: Ia boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje egore tawiapagado. Jesus kudugodure Elias bagai.

b: Ia imedu rekodure ia esponja tabo. Ure nowu esponja pegodo vinho kuru tabo. Nono aregodure tabo Jesus ae. Ure nowu esponja kogudo ipo oto tabo. Nono ure nowu esponja raido nowu ipo tabo toro Jesus okwa ka kuduwo ce.
source: Ia imedu rekodure ia esponja tabo. Ure nowu esponja pegodo vinho kuru tabo. Nono aregodure tabo Jesus ae. Ure nowu esponja kogudo ipo oto tabo. Nono ure nowu esponja raido nowu ipo tabo toro Jesus okwa ka kuduwo ce.

b: Nou iage egore ca parokawo iaboe ji pugeje. Pabagawo Elias bagai. Aregodumode rugadu kana? Umode Jesus rawuje nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji kana?
source: Nou iage egore ca parokawo iaboe ji pugeje. Pabagawo Elias bagai. Aregodumode rugadu kana? Umode Jesus rawuje nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji kana?

b: Nono Jesus kudugodu rakare dukeje bire.
source: Nono Jesus kudugodu rakare dukeje bire.

b: Care rore puku je nowu areia kurirewu bararere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tadawu ure tuwowuje nowu bai ja oto piji moto ka. Moto magadugodure. Nou tori boe ere tuwowuje.
source: Care rore puku je nowu areia kurirewu bararere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tadawu ure tuwowuje nowu bai ja oto piji moto ka. Moto magadugodure. Nou tori boe ere tuwowuje.

b: Birewuge eiari ere tuiado jamedu. Nono mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge birewuge eewodure pugeje. Emagare rugadu.
source: Birewuge eiari ere tuiado jamedu. Nono mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge birewuge eewodure pugeje. Emagare rugadu.

b: Ere tudawuje nowu etugudure towu tori poro boe piji. Jesus jewodumode pugeje dukeje nowu jewodurewuge etumode nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewuto. Israel doge emuga kurirewu reo. Nonore boe erudure nowu jewodurewugei rugadu. Jorudure eiwuge emagare nowu ba kurirewu keje.
source: Ere tudawuje nowu etugudure towu tori poro boe piji. Jesus jewodumode pugeje dukeje nowu jewodurewuge etumode nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewuto. Israel doge emuga kurirewu reo. Nonore boe erudure nowu jewodurewugei rugadu. Jorudure eiwuge emagare nowu ba kurirewu keje.

b: Mare aino nowu Romano doge tugobaigarege eimijera jorudure moto magadugodure duji. Nou tugobaigarege erudure jamedu. Eiamedu boe erudure nowu inodu boe ji. Dukodire epagudugodure rugadu. egore boe rugadu! Awu imedunure Pao Kurirewu onaregeduce rugadu.
source: Mare aino nowu Romano doge tugobaigarege eimijera jorudure moto magadugodure duji. Nou tugobaigarege erudure jamedu. Eiamedu boe erudure nowu inodu boe ji. Dukodire epagudugodure rugadu. egore boe rugadu! Awu imedunure Pao Kurirewu onaregeduce rugadu.

b: Areme eragojere nono jamedu. Emagare. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Ia etumedago iere Maria jamedu. Nou Maria ore ime ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Umana iere José. Zebedeu ore etuje rakojere nono jamedu. Jesus rakoje kimore Galiléia moto keje dutabo nowu areme emearutorure ji. Ekodure Jesus apo tu tu je tietu pemegawo Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Areme eragojere nono jamedu. Emagare. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Ia etumedago iere Maria jamedu. Nou Maria ore ime ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Umana iere José. Zebedeu ore etuje rakojere nono jamedu. Jesus rakoje kimore Galiléia moto keje dutabo nowu areme emearutorure ji. Ekodure Jesus apo tu tu je tietu pemegawo Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Boe Ere Jesus Tugu Tori Poroto
source: Boe Ere Jesus Tugu Tori Poroto

b: Merirekodugodutabo José aregodure. Arimatéia ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Oe kurirewunure ema. Mearutorure Jesus ji jamedu. Nou José uture boe eimijera Pilatos bagai tumagowo ji birewu Jesus bagai tuwo Jesus tugu mototo. Nono Pilatos makore tugobaigaregei ewo Jesus birewu maku nowu José ai rugadu.
source: Merirekodugodutabo José aregodure. Arimatéia ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Oe kurirewunure ema. Mearutorure Jesus ji jamedu. Nou José uture boe eimijera Pilatos bagai tumagowo ji birewu Jesus bagai tuwo Jesus tugu mototo. Nono Pilatos makore tugobaigaregei ewo Jesus birewu maku nowu José ai rugadu.

b: Dukodire care José ure tugeragu birewu Jesus ji. Ure upodo areia pemegarewu tabo.
source: Dukodire care José ure tugeragu birewu Jesus ji. Ure upodo areia pemegarewu tabo.

b: Nono ure Jesus tugu to tori poro maiwuto. Emare ure nowu tori porodo aino maigodu. Dukeje ure tuiodo nouia tori kurirewu keje tuwo bu nowu tori poro je keje tuwo nowu tori poro midu pemegado.
source: Nono ure Jesus tugu to tori poro maiwuto. Emare ure nowu tori porodo aino maigodu. Dukeje ure tuiodo nouia tori kurirewu keje tuwo bu nowu tori poro je keje tuwo nowu tori poro midu pemegado.

b: Nou Maria Madalena, nowu iarodo Maria ere tudaru nowu tori poro ka tumugu pureduwo nowu tori poroji taiwo tabo nowu José roino duji.
source: Nou Maria Madalena, nowu iarodo Maria ere tudaru nowu tori poro ka tumugu pureduwo nowu tori poroji taiwo tabo nowu José roino duji.

b: Tugobaigarege Emugure Nou Tori Poro Je Jagwai Taiwo Tabo Ji
source: Tugobaigarege Emugure Nou Tori Poro Je Jagwai Taiwo Tabo Ji

b: Nou barogwato nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage eture Pilatos bagai ia fariseu dogebo. Sábado meri kejere eroino.
source: Nou barogwato nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage eture Pilatos bagai ia fariseu dogebo. Sábado meri kejere eroino.

b: Emagore Pilatoji. egore cegimijera. Cewiabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje. Akore merimoduie pobe metia bokware pudui dukeje tuiewodumoduie pugeje. Tuwo boe ekiripagado dubagaire nowu Jesus akoino.
source: Emagore Pilatoji. egore cegimijera. Cewiabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje. Akore merimoduie pobe metia bokware pudui dukeje tuiewodumoduie pugeje. Tuwo boe ekiripagado dubagaire nowu Jesus akoino.

b: Dukodire cedaidure cewo cemearudae maku akai. Ukana turugadu awo ia tugobaigarege etu pemegado nowu birewu meture tadawu tori poroji jii nowu akoino jiwu meri akedumode du ka? Amodukare tugobaigarege etudo toro dukeje ia ure joruduwadowuge etumode toro nowu tori poro ka. Emode birewu tawuje nowu tori poro piji. Nono ewadrarodumode boe ewiagai jewoduie pugeje duji. Dutabore emode boe ekiripaga kurido nowu Jesus makore jiboe kori.
source: Dukodire cedaidure cewo cemearudae maku akai. Ukana turugadu awo ia tugobaigarege etu pemegado nowu birewu meture tadawu tori poroji jii nowu akoino jiwu meri akedumode du ka? Amodukare tugobaigarege etudo toro dukeje ia ure joruduwadowuge etumode toro nowu tori poro ka. Emode birewu tawuje nowu tori poro piji. Nono ewadrarodumode boe ewiagai jewoduie pugeje duji. Dutabore emode boe ekiripaga kurido nowu Jesus makore jiboe kori.

b: Nono Pilatos akore Ca. Tadudo awu tugobaigaregebo taetu pemegawo nowu birewu meture tadawu tori poroji nono tamearudae umogadure.
source: Nono Pilatos akore Ca. Tadudo awu tugobaigaregebo taetu pemegawo nowu birewu meture tadawu tori poroji nono tamearudae umogadure.

b: Dukodi ca eture rugadu. Ere iaboe bu nowu tori okwaji boe eruduwawo tawujedukare nowu tori poro piji rugadu. Nono ere nowu tugobaigarege emugudo nono etaiwo pemegawo nowu tori poroji rugadu boe ekawo tugeragu nowu birewu ji nowu tori poro piji.
source: Dukodi ca eture rugadu. Ere iaboe bu nowu tori okwaji boe eruduwawo tawujedukare nowu tori poro piji rugadu. Nono ere nowu tugobaigarege emugudo nono etaiwo pemegawo nowu tori poroji rugadu boe ekawo tugeragu nowu birewu ji nowu tori poro piji.

b: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje
source: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje

b: Nou Sábado meri akedure dukeje nowu barogwato kuri ca je Maria Madalena uture nowu Maria apo toro nowu Jesus meture tadawu tori poro ka taiwowo ji.
source: Nou Sábado meri akedure dukeje nowu barogwato kuri ca je Maria Madalena uture nowu Maria apo toro nowu Jesus meture tadawu tori poro ka taiwowo ji.

b: Ca moto magadugodu rakare rugadu. Mare ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure turawuje baru piji. Aregodure nowu tori poro ka rugadu. Dukeje ca ure tuiodo nowu padure nowu tori poro je kejewu tori kurirewu keje tuwo nowu tori poro jado. Dukeje ca ure tumugudo nowu tori keje.
source: Ca moto magadugodu rakare rugadu. Mare ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure turawuje baru piji. Aregodure nowu tori poro ka rugadu. Dukeje ca ure tuiodo nowu padure nowu tori poro je kejewu tori kurirewu keje tuwo nowu tori poro jado. Dukeje ca ure tumugudo nowu tori keje.

b: Ukudau areia kigadure rugadu. Ure nono boeiaragudu mogadure boe etaiwo tabo ji.
source: Ukudau areia kigadure rugadu. Ure nono boeiaragudu mogadure boe etaiwo tabo ji.

b: Dukodire care nowu tugobaigarege epagudugodure ce rugadu. Dukodire epogora kugudugodure rugadu. Ere nono birewuge emogadure. Mare ewi ji karega inagoino. Erokare iaboe ji iaboe ji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Dukodire care nowu tugobaigarege epagudugodure ce rugadu. Dukodire epogora kugudugodure rugadu. Ere nono birewuge emogadure. Mare ewi ji karega inagoino. Erokare iaboe ji iaboe ji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ca nono nowu baru pijiwu Pao Kurirewu utugare makore nowu aremei. Akore tabagudukaba. Ioruduware tagaiwore bagaiwu boe ji. Tagaiwore bitodurewu Jesus bagai.
source: Ca nono nowu baru pijiwu Pao Kurirewu utugare makore nowu aremei. Akore tabagudukaba. Ioruduware tagaiwore bagaiwu boe ji. Tagaiwore bitodurewu Jesus bagai.

b: Ca rakojekare woe pugeje. Jewodure pugeje. Makore jiwu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Mato tagaiwowo padurewu ka.
source: Ca rakojekare woe pugeje. Jewodure pugeje. Makore jiwu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Mato tagaiwowo padurewu ka.

b: Tadumode dukeje tadudo tamara tabo tawo ure joruduwadowuge ewie jewodure pugeje duji. Ewie utumoduie tagododai toro Galiléia moto ka. Toroie tarudumoduie pudui. Ca inure tawie aino.
source: Tadumode dukeje tadudo tamara tabo tawo ure joruduwadowuge ewie jewodure pugeje duji. Ewie utumoduie tagododai toro Galiléia moto ka. Toroie tarudumoduie pudui. Ca inure tawie aino.

b: Dukodire nowu areme eture nowu tori poro piji tumara tabo rugadu. Epagudure. Mare egarere pudui jamedu. Eregodu rakare toro nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai.
source: Dukodire nowu areme eture nowu tori poro piji tumara tabo rugadu. Epagudure. Mare egarere pudui jamedu. Eregodu rakare toro nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai.

b: Mare erore puku je Jesus ure tuie bu taci etae. Akore itaregodu. Ere tuburedo ji. Nono ere tubu jodo jokorai. Ere tugeragu bureji. Emago pemegare ji.
source: Mare erore puku je Jesus ure tuie bu taci etae. Akore itaregodu. Ere tuburedo ji. Nono ere tubu jodo jokorai. Ere tugeragu bureji. Emago pemegare ji.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore tabagudukaba. Tadudo toro ire joruduwadowuge ewagai. Aino ere nono imedage remawuge emogadure. Tamagodo ei etuwo toro Galiléia moto ka. Nonore erudumode i rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore tabagudukaba. Tadudo toro ire joruduwadowuge ewagai. Aino ere nono imedage remawuge emogadure. Tamagodo ei etuwo toro Galiléia moto ka. Nonore erudumode i rugadu.

b: Boe Eimijerage Emagore Tugobaigaregei Ewadraroduwo
source: Boe Eimijerage Emagore Tugobaigaregei Ewadraroduwo

b: Ca nowu areme eture rugadu. Mare ca nowu tugobaigarege eture jamedu toro ba kurirewu ka tureadoduwo nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ewiagai nowu boe jamedu boe ji.
source: Ca nowu areme eture rugadu. Mare ca nowu tugobaigarege eture jamedu toro ba kurirewu ka tureadoduwo nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ewiagai nowu boe jamedu boe ji.

b: Nono ca nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui nouia boe eimijeragebo tuwo tumearudae tawuje. Dukodire ere tumearudae maku puai tuwo diero kurirewu maku nowu tugobaigarege etai.
source: Nono ca nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui nouia boe eimijeragebo tuwo tumearudae tawuje. Dukodire ere tumearudae maku puai tuwo diero kurirewu maku nowu tugobaigarege etai.

b: Ere nowu diero maku nowu tugobaigarege etai tumagore ei dutabo. egore tawadrarodumode boe eiamedu boe ji tanuduie nowu boeco ji dukejeie ure joruduwadowuge etaregoduie nowu tori poro ka. Emageie ere tugeragu nowu birewu ji nowu tori poro piji.
source: Ere nowu diero maku nowu tugobaigarege etai tumagore ei dutabo. egore tawadrarodumode boe eiamedu boe ji tanuduie nowu boeco ji dukejeie ure joruduwadowuge etaregoduie nowu tori poro ka. Emageie ere tugeragu nowu birewu ji nowu tori poro piji.

b: Nou tagimijera Pilatos mearudumode nowu tawadrarodaeji dukeje korigodumode tai tanudure duji. Mare tamororamagadukaba. Cegi cemode butugugo boe pegakawo tai.
source: Nou tagimijera Pilatos mearudumode nowu tawadrarodaeji dukeje korigodumode tai tanudure duji. Mare tamororamagadukaba. Cegi cemode butugugo boe pegakawo tai.

b: Dukodire care nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu nowu dieroji rugadu. Dukeje ewadrarodure nono nowu boe eimijerage egore pudui dumogadure. Dukodire nowu ewadrarodae ure tumaedo nowu Judeu doge ekao jii aino.
source: Dukodire care nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu nowu dieroji rugadu. Dukeje ewadrarodure nono nowu boe eimijerage egore pudui dumogadure. Dukodire nowu ewadrarodae ure tumaedo nowu Judeu doge ekao jii aino.

b: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Erududo Pudui Rugadu
source: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Erududo Pudui Rugadu

b: Aino ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure onze. Nono ca eture Galiléia moto ka rugadu. Dukeje care etaregodure nowu Jesus makore jiwu tori ao ka.
source: Aino ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure onze. Nono ca eture Galiléia moto ka rugadu. Dukeje care etaregodure nowu Jesus makore jiwu tori ao ka.

b: Etaregodure dukeje erudure Jesus ji rugadu. Ere tubu jodo moto keje tumago pemegawo ji. Mare iage eruduwa jokodukare ure ema duji.
source: Etaregodure dukeje erudure Jesus ji rugadu. Ere tubu jodo moto keje tumago pemegawo ji. Mare iage eruduwa jokodukare ure ema duji.

b: Dukeje care Jesus ure tuburedo ei. Nono akore Pao Kurirewu ure baru tadawu raka jamedu boe maku inai. Ure moto kejewu raka jamedu boe maku inai.
source: Dukeje care Jesus ure tuburedo ei. Nono akore Pao Kurirewu ure baru tadawu raka jamedu boe maku inai. Ure moto kejewu raka jamedu boe maku inai.

b: Dukodire imode tawie. Tadudo boe eiamedu boe ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje tamago raiwo boe ji emearutoruwo i ewo tugimijerado imi. Emearutorumode i dukeje etao pegodo jamedu Pao Kurirewu ie tabo, Onaregedu ie tabo, Uwari ie tabo jamedu.
source: Dukodire imode tawie. Tadudo boe eiamedu boe ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje tamago raiwo boe ji emearutoruwo i ewo tugimijerado imi. Emearutorumode i dukeje etao pegodo jamedu Pao Kurirewu ie tabo, Onaregedu ie tabo, Uwari ie tabo jamedu.

b: Eruduwado ire maku tagaiwu taro jamedu boe ji emearutoruwo ji jamedu. Mare tawiagodukaba. Iragojemode tagabo meri jamedu ji rugadu jii toro moto akedumode du ka.
source: Eruduwado ire maku tagaiwu taro jamedu boe ji emearutoruwo ji jamedu. Mare tawiagodukaba. Iragojemode tagabo meri jamedu ji rugadu jii toro moto akedumode du ka.

b: Ure Awu Jesus Rore Jiboe Makore Jiboe Bu Bapera Keje João Batista Ure Boe Ewie Pao Kurirewu Bataruji
source: Ure Awu Jesus Rore Jiboe Makore Jiboe Bu Bapera Keje João Batista Ure Boe Ewie Pao Kurirewu Bataruji

b: Pao Kurirewu o bakaru pemegarewu reo. Jesus Cristo jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Onaregedunure ema.
source: Pao Kurirewu o bakaru pemegarewu reo. Jesus Cristo jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Onaregedunure ema.

b: Marigudu rugadu imedu Isaías ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Ainore nowu bataru akore Imode itugare utudo uwo boe pemegado nowu umode boe ekinorudowu togi. – Itugare kudugodumode boe ewagai boe maerewu keje boe ewo awara jetorodo boe eimijera kurirewu aregodumode boe etae duji. Mare awara ji karega inagoino. Boe ewo turo pemegado. Dujire inagoino.
source: Marigudu rugadu imedu Isaías ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Ainore nowu bataru akore Imode itugare utudo uwo boe pemegado nowu umode boe ekinorudowu togi. – Itugare kudugodumode boe ewagai boe maerewu keje boe ewo awara jetorodo boe eimijera kurirewu aregodumode boe etae duji. Mare awara ji karega inagoino. Boe ewo turo pemegado. Dujire inagoino.

b: Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe jeture pudui rugadu. João Batista jirabodu Pao Kurirewu akoino. Pao Kurirewu utugarenure ema. Aregodure boe maerewu ka. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Ure boe etao pegodo. Akore tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje imode tagao pegodo. Nono Pao Kurirewu biagodumode taro pegarewu piji.
source: Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe jeture pudui rugadu. João Batista jirabodu Pao Kurirewu akoino. Pao Kurirewu utugarenure ema. Aregodure boe maerewu ka. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Ure boe etao pegodo. Akore tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje imode tagao pegodo. Nono Pao Kurirewu biagodumode taro pegarewu piji.

b: Boe eture João ae. Emagare tudu tabo toro ae. Etaregodure Judéia moto piji. Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji jamedu. Emearudure João Batista bataru ji dukeje emagore turo pegarewuji, taiduie tuwo tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji. Nono João Batista ure etao pegodo Jordão Po tada.
source: Boe eture João ae. Emagare tudu tabo toro ae. Etaregodure Judéia moto piji. Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji jamedu. Emearudure João Batista bataru ji dukeje emagore turo pegarewuji, taiduie tuwo tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji. Nono João Batista ure etao pegodo Jordão Po tada.

b: João Batista ukudaure camelo buce. Pegajejewure tapira biri rema. Okwagere tu kitariga dogei, ropa doge eweguruji tu rugadu.
source: João Batista ukudaure camelo buce. Pegajejewure tapira biri rema. Okwagere tu kitariga dogei, ropa doge eweguruji tu rugadu.

b: Nono ure boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Akore ia imedu ro kodumode ikoriwu aregodumode iregodaji. Boe pemegarewunure ema, boe kurirewu mode ema rugadu. Dukodire ipogurumode ipureduwo ji iro rakakare kodi. Imire ire boe etao pegodo pobo tabo. Emare umode Tuwari tugu boe emearudaeto boe ero pemegawo.
source: Nono ure boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Akore ia imedu ro kodumode ikoriwu aregodumode iregodaji. Boe pemegarewunure ema, boe kurirewu mode ema rugadu. Dukodire ipogurumode ipureduwo ji iro rakakare kodi. Imire ire boe etao pegodo pobo tabo. Emare umode Tuwari tugu boe emearudaeto boe ero pemegawo.

b: João Ure Jesus Ao Pegodo
source: João Ure Jesus Ao Pegodo

b: Ia meri keje Jesus uture tuwai piji Nazaré ba kurirewu piji toro Galiléia moto ka. Nono aregodure João Batista ae toro Jordão Po ka. Nonore João ure Jesus ao pegodo Jordão Po tada.
source: Ia meri keje Jesus uture tuwai piji Nazaré ba kurirewu piji toro Galiléia moto ka. Nono aregodure João Batista ae toro Jordão Po ka. Nonore João ure Jesus ao pegodo Jordão Po tada.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje Jordão Po piji dukeje aiwore baru to. Nono barure tuiado dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje baru piji. Ure tudo nono metugore. Ure tumugudo Jesus keje.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje Jordão Po piji dukeje aiwore baru to. Nono barure tuiado dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje baru piji. Ure tudo nono metugore. Ure tumugudo Jesus keje.

b: Nono Pao Kurirewu makore baru piji. Akore itonaregedunure aki. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Are iagaredo i rugadu.
source: Nono Pao Kurirewu makore baru piji. Akore itonaregedunure aki. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Are iagaredo i rugadu.

b: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Jesus utudo toro boe maerewu ka.
source: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Jesus utudo toro boe maerewu ka.

b: Meri oto padure quarenta Jesus ji nono. Bope doge eimijera Satanás aregodure ae nono. Aidure tuwo turokogado Jesus ji tuwo Jesus mearudae pegado nono tumearudae mogadure. Barege pegarewuge emagare nono Jesus apo. Mare Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etaregodure ae. Etu pemegare Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Meri oto padure quarenta Jesus ji nono. Bope doge eimijera Satanás aregodure ae nono. Aidure tuwo turokogado Jesus ji tuwo Jesus mearudae pegado nono tumearudae mogadure. Barege pegarewuge emagare nono Jesus apo. Mare Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etaregodure ae. Etu pemegare Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Uwogurewuge Ewagai
source: Jesus Makore Uwogurewuge Ewagai

b: Boe eimijera pegarewu ure João Batista tugu baicorewuto. Jesus uture Galiléia moto ka. Nonore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewiagai.
source: Boe eimijera pegarewu ure João Batista tugu baicorewuto. Jesus uture Galiléia moto ka. Nonore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewiagai.

b: Akore kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo imi rugadu. Ca tagera ra taro pegarewu piji. Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu.
source: Akore kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo imi rugadu. Ca tagera ra taro pegarewu piji. Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu.

b: Jesus merure pobo maerewu okwaji. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia. Nono Jesus jorudure imei. Ere pobe. Ia iere Simão. Uwie iere André. Ewogure tuwuge tabo. Ere kare ewido.
source: Jesus merure pobo maerewu okwaji. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia. Nono Jesus jorudure imei. Ere pobe. Ia iere Simão. Uwie iere André. Ewogure tuwuge tabo. Ere kare ewido.

b: Jesus makore etae. Akore mato tagoduwo itabo. Imode taruduwado tawoguwo ime ewagai. Mare tawogu ji karega inagoino. Tamode boe emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Jesus makore etae. Akore mato tagoduwo itabo. Imode taruduwado tawoguwo ime ewagai. Mare tawogu ji karega inagoino. Tamode boe emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Nono ere tugera ra tuwogu piji taci je. Eture Jesus apo rugadu tumaragodae piji.
source: Nono ere tugera ra tuwogu piji taci je. Eture Jesus apo rugadu tumaragodae piji.

b: Jesus kodure nowu pobo maerewu okwaji kimo. Nono jorudure ia imei. Ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Nou uwie imedu iere João. Etuo iere Zebedeu. Eragojere to ika kurirewu tada. Emaragodure tuwugeji tuwo pemegado.
source: Jesus kodure nowu pobo maerewu okwaji kimo. Nono jorudure ia imei. Ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Nou uwie imedu iere João. Etuo iere Zebedeu. Eragojere to ika kurirewu tada. Emaragodure tuwugeji tuwo pemegado.

b: Jesus jorudure ei dukeje makore etae. Dukodire eture tuo piji, to ika kurirewu piji, tudugarege epiji tugoduwo Jesus apo.
source: Jesus jorudure ei dukeje makore etae. Dukodire eture tuo piji, to ika kurirewu piji, tudugarege epiji tugoduwo Jesus apo.

b: Bope Meture Imedu Tada
source: Bope Meture Imedu Tada

b: Jesus aregodure Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowuge ebo. Sábado meri keje Jesus uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado.
source: Jesus aregodure Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowuge ebo. Sábado meri keje Jesus uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado.

b: Boe emearudure Jesus bataru ji dukeje nono eiamedu boe eku kidure rugadu nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Jesus makore jiboe ukare nono nowu boe eimijerage joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ewadaru mogadure. Jesus mako pemegare mako jetorore rugadu dukodire boe eruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire Jesus akoino duji.
source: Boe emearudure Jesus bataru ji dukeje nono eiamedu boe eku kidure rugadu nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Jesus makore jiboe ukare nono nowu boe eimijerage joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ewadaru mogadure. Jesus mako pemegare mako jetorore rugadu dukodire boe eruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire Jesus akoino duji.

b: Nono ia bope meture tadawu imedu kudugodure. Nou bope uwari emare akoino.
source: Nono ia bope meture tadawu imedu kudugodure. Nou bope uwari emare akoino.

b: Akore nazaré pijiwu Jesusnure aki rugadu. Nuba aromode cei? Amode cedagedudo na? Ceruduware ai. Aro pega bokware. Pao Kurirewu ure akarego mato tuwadaru pemegarewu tabo boe ewagai rugadu!
source: Akore nazaré pijiwu Jesusnure aki rugadu. Nuba aromode cei? Amode cedagedudo na? Ceruduware ai. Aro pega bokware. Pao Kurirewu ure akarego mato tuwadaru pemegarewu tabo boe ewagai rugadu!

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu bope bataru jipagi. Akore amagokaba boe ji pugeje. Atawuje awu imedu piji.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu bope bataru jipagi. Akore amagokaba boe ji pugeje. Atawuje awu imedu piji.

b: Nou bope uwari ure nowu imedu magadudo ure kudugodudo jamedu. Dukejere ure tudawuje nowu imedu piji.
source: Nou bope uwari ure nowu imedu magadudo ure kudugodudo jamedu. Dukejere ure tudawuje nowu imedu piji.

b: Boe erore ta je Jesus rore aino duji. Dukodire emagore pui. egore nuba awu Jesus rore? Ure nowu bope uwari utudo taci awu imedu piji. Nou bope mearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji. Marigudu ceruduwakare cerowo aino.
source: Boe erore ta je Jesus rore aino duji. Dukodire emagore pui. egore nuba awu Jesus rore? Ure nowu bope uwari utudo taci awu imedu piji. Nou bope mearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji. Marigudu ceruduwakare cerowo aino.

b: Dukodire boe ere nowu Galiléia moto kejewuge boe eiamedu boe ewie Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji jamedu.
source: Dukodire boe ere nowu Galiléia moto kejewuge boe eiamedu boe ewie Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji jamedu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Epemegago
source: Jesus Ure Boe Epemegago

b: Jesus uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai piji. Uture nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Tiago uture apo. João uture apo jamedu. Eture Simão, André ewai ka.
source: Jesus uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai piji. Uture nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Tiago uture apo. João uture apo jamedu. Eture Simão, André ewai ka.

b: Simão ucarugo kogodure. Biri urure. Padure nono tuba keje. Jesus aregodure dukeje boe ere bie.
source: Simão ucarugo kogodure. Biri urure. Padure nono tuba keje. Jesus aregodure dukeje boe ere bie.

b: Dukodire uture ae. Ure tugeragu ieraji. Ure rakojedo dukeje nowu biri uru akedure taci je. Pemegagodure pugeje. Dukodire ure eke pemegado.
source: Dukodire uture ae. Ure tugeragu ieraji. Ure rakojedo dukeje nowu biri uru akedure taci je. Pemegagodure pugeje. Dukodire ure eke pemegado.

b: Boecoji boe etaregodure Jesus ae kogodurewugebo, bope doge emedure tadawugebo jamedu.
source: Boecoji boe etaregodure Jesus ae kogodurewugebo, bope doge emedure tadawugebo jamedu.

b: Nou mugure ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe etaregodure Jesus ae.
source: Nou mugure ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe etaregodure Jesus ae.

b: Jesus ure nowu kogodurewuge epemegago. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji tuwo etudo epiji rugadu. Nou bope doge eruduware Jesus ji dukodire Jesus ure nowu bope doge emago bokwado.
source: Jesus ure nowu kogodurewuge epemegago. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji tuwo etudo epiji rugadu. Nou bope doge eruduware Jesus ji dukodire Jesus ure nowu bope doge emago bokwado.

b: Jesus Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataruji Galiléia Moto Keje
source: Jesus Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataruji Galiléia Moto Keje

b: Nou barogwato boedugu kimoto Jesus ure tudawuje. Uture nowu bai piji. Uture nowu ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe maerewu ka tumagowo Tuo bagai baru to.
source: Nou barogwato boedugu kimoto Jesus ure tudawuje. Uture nowu bai piji. Uture nowu ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe maerewu ka tumagowo Tuo bagai baru to.

b: Nono Simão uture tumedagebo tiemaru tabo bagai.
source: Nono Simão uture tumedagebo tiemaru tabo bagai.

b: Nono erudure ji dukeje egore boe emarure awagai tumearuduwo awadaru ji pugeje.
source: Nono erudure ji dukeje egore boe emarure awagai tumearuduwo awadaru ji pugeje.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore emearudure iwadaru ji marigudu dukodire padumode ia boe etae pugeje. Imagomode Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji ewiagai jamedu. Dukodire itaregodure baru piji.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore emearudure iwadaru ji marigudu dukodire padumode ia boe etae pugeje. Imagomode Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji ewiagai jamedu. Dukodire itaregodure baru piji.

b: Dukodire uture Galiléia moto jamedu boe parugajeje tumagowo Tuo bataru ji boe ewiagai. Makore boe ji ere bato puiwu bai tada. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji jamedu.
source: Dukodire uture Galiléia moto jamedu boe parugajeje tumagowo Tuo bataru ji boe ewiagai. Makore boe ji ere bato puiwu bai tada. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji jamedu.

b: Jesus Ure Imedu Pemegago Pugeje
source: Jesus Ure Imedu Pemegago Pugeje

b: Ia imedu kogodurewu aregodure Jesus ae pugeje. Nou kogodae ure biri pegado rugadu. Aregodure Jesus ae dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje jokorai. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera maku pudai rugadu. Akore aragare rugadu awo ipemegago. Mare akaidumode dukeje amode ipemegago.
source: Ia imedu kogodurewu aregodure Jesus ae pugeje. Nou kogodae ure biri pegado rugadu. Aregodure Jesus ae dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje jokorai. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera maku pudai rugadu. Akore aragare rugadu awo ipemegago. Mare akaidumode dukeje amode ipemegago.

b: Jesus okudugodure apo. Dukodire ure tugera bu nowu imedu keje. Akore uu. Itaidure. Ca. Apemegare rugadu.
source: Jesus okudugodure apo. Dukodire ure tugera bu nowu imedu keje. Akore uu. Itaidure. Ca. Apemegare rugadu.

b: Nono nowu imedu biri pemegagodure taci je rugadu.
source: Nono nowu imedu biri pemegagodure taci je rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus ure tumago rakado ji ukawo boe ewie nowu turore jiboe ji. Akore amagokaba awu irore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Atudo kuri nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. source: Jesus makore nowu imedu iera pegarewuji. Akore aragojedo. Mato itae woe boe etoia ka.

b: Nono Jesus unarare nouia boe ji. Akore nuba pago bakaru akore paromoduie sábado meri keje? Paro pegamoduie boe ji kana? Paro pemegamoduie boe ji kana? Pamode boe ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji sábado meri keje kana? Pamode boe ewarigu boe pegarewuto sábado meri keje kana? Nou boe emagokare boe ji.
source: Nono Jesus unarare nouia boe ji. Akore nuba pago bakaru akore paromoduie sábado meri keje? Paro pegamoduie boe ji kana? Paro pemegamoduie boe ji kana? Pamode boe ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji sábado meri keje kana? Pamode boe ewarigu boe pegarewuto sábado meri keje kana? Nou boe emagokare boe ji.

b: Jesus korigodure ei. Aiwore ei. Etaidukare tumearuduwo Jesus makore jiboe ji emearudae pegare kodi. Mare Jesus okudugodure ebo jamedu. Dukejere Jesus makore nowu imedu iera pegarewuji. Akore akera raido itae. Nono nowu imedu ure tugera raido ae. Care iera pemegagodure taci je.
source: Jesus korigodure ei. Aiwore ei. Etaidukare tumearuduwo Jesus makore jiboe ji emearudae pegare kodi. Mare Jesus okudugodure ebo jamedu. Dukejere Jesus makore nowu imedu iera pegarewuji. Akore akera raido itae. Nono nowu imedu ure tugera raido ae. Care iera pemegagodure taci je.

b: Mare fariseu doge eture nowu bai piji tumara tabo boe korire ei kodi. Erudu pegare Jesus rore aino duji sábado meri keje. Sábado meri ji emaragodumodukare eromodukare ia turore jiboe ji. Dukodire ekorigodure Jesus ji. Ere bato pui ia mearutorure Herodes bataru jiwu imebo. Emagore pui tuwo ia tumearudae tawuje tuwo Jesus bito.
source: Mare fariseu doge eture nowu bai piji tumara tabo boe korire ei kodi. Erudu pegare Jesus rore aino duji sábado meri keje. Sábado meri ji emaragodumodukare eromodukare ia turore jiboe ji. Dukodire ekorigodure Jesus ji. Ere bato pui ia mearutorure Herodes bataru jiwu imebo. Emagore pui tuwo ia tumearudae tawuje tuwo Jesus bito.

b: Boe Emagare Pobo Maerewu Po Okwai
source: Boe Emagare Pobo Maerewu Po Okwai

b: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia Po. Aidure Jesus bataru jiwuge eture Jesus rekodaji pugeje. Emagare rugadu.
source: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia Po. Aidure Jesus bataru jiwuge eture Jesus rekodaji pugeje. Emagare rugadu.

b: Galiléia kejewugere. Judéia kejewugere. Iduméia kejewugere. Tiro ba kurirewu kejewugere. Sidom ba kurirewu kejewugere. Ia Jordão Po bakowu kejewuge ekurugodure Jordão Po kajeje taregoduwo Jesus ae jamedu. Emearudure Jesus rore jiboe ji dukodire nowu boe etaregodure tuioruduwo Jesus ji.
source: Galiléia kejewugere. Judéia kejewugere. Iduméia kejewugere. Tiro ba kurirewu kejewugere. Sidom ba kurirewu kejewugere. Ia Jordão Po bakowu kejewuge ekurugodure Jordão Po kajeje taregoduwo Jesus ae jamedu. Emearudure Jesus rore jiboe ji dukodire nowu boe etaregodure tuioruduwo Jesus ji.

b: Boe ere tuiodo puwugeje pu otodai dukodire Jesus roiwakare tumago pemegawo ei. Dukodire makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo ia ika kurirewu po barigu tuwo taredo to. Ewo tuiodo ika keje pobo oiado. Nono akuamode tumago pemegawo nowu boe ji nowu ika piji.
source: Boe ere tuiodo puwugeje pu otodai dukodire Jesus roiwakare tumago pemegawo ei. Dukodire makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo ia ika kurirewu po barigu tuwo taredo to. Ewo tuiodo ika keje pobo oiado. Nono akuamode tumago pemegawo nowu boe ji nowu ika piji.

b: Jesus ure kogodurewuge epemegago. Emagare rugadu. Mare ia kogodurewuge kimore. Etaidure tuwo tuburedo Jesus ji tuwo tugera jetudo Jesus ukudau areiaji tubemegagoduwo.
source: Jesus ure kogodurewuge epemegago. Emagare rugadu. Mare ia kogodurewuge kimore. Etaidure tuwo tuburedo Jesus ji tuwo tugera jetudo Jesus ukudau areiaji tubemegagoduwo.

b: Bope doge emedure iage etada. Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje ere tuwududo moto keje tugudu tabo Jesus jokorai. egore Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki!
source: Bope doge emedure iage etada. Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje ere tuwududo moto keje tugudu tabo Jesus jokorai. egore Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki!

b: Jesus mako rakare nowu bope doge ewadaru jipagi emagokawo nowu inoduji boe ewiagai.
source: Jesus mako rakare nowu bope doge ewadaru jipagi emagokawo nowu inoduji boe ewiagai.

b: Jesus Ure Tugeragu Tumode Joruduwadowugei Tuwo Etudo Tuwadaru Tabo Boe Ewagai
source: Jesus Ure Tugeragu Tumode Joruduwadowugei Tuwo Etudo Tuwadaru Tabo Boe Ewagai

b: Nono Jesus ruture ia tori ao ka. Nono makore taidure jiwuge boe ewagai. Nono etaregodure ae.
source: Nono Jesus ruture ia tori ao ka. Nono makore taidure jiwuge boe ewagai. Nono etaregodure ae.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu jiwuge ime enodo padure kejewugere doze. Ure tugie maku etai. Akore uture iwadaru tabowu boenure tagi. Ire ikeragu tai taragojewo itabo. Imode taruduwado tamagowo iboe ji boe ewiagai.
source: Jesus ure tugeragu jiwuge ime enodo padure kejewugere doze. Ure tugie maku etai. Akore uture iwadaru tabowu boenure tagi. Ire ikeragu tai taragojewo itabo. Imode taruduwado tamagowo iboe ji boe ewiagai.

b: Imode taragado tawo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.
source: Imode taragado tawo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.

b: Ainore nowu Jesus ure tugeragu jiwuge ekiere. Ia iere Simão. (Jesus ure awu Simão iedo Pedro)
source: Ainore nowu Jesus ure tugeragu jiwuge ekiere. Ia iere Simão. (Jesus ure awu Simão iedo Pedro)

b: Ia iere Tiago. Zebedeu onaregedunure ema. Ia iere João. Tiago uwienure ema. (Jesus ure nowu ime pobedu doge ekiedo Boanerges. Ewadaru tabo egore aino: “Boeiaruru orenure emage.”)
source: Ia iere Tiago. Zebedeu onaregedunure ema. Ia iere João. Tiago uwienure ema. (Jesus ure nowu ime pobedu doge ekiedo Boanerges. Ewadaru tabo egore aino: “Boeiaruru orenure emage.”)

b: Ia iere André. Ia iere Filipe. Ia iere Bartolomeu. Ia iere Mateus. Ia iere Tomé. Ia iere Tiago. Nou Tiago Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Ia iere Tadeu. Ia iere Simão Zelote.
source: Ia iere André. Ia iere Filipe. Ia iere Bartolomeu. Ia iere Mateus. Ia iere Tomé. Ia iere Tiago. Nou Tiago Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Ia iere Tadeu. Ia iere Simão Zelote.

b: Ia imedu iere Judas Iscariotes. Emare umode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Ia imedu iere Judas Iscariotes. Emare umode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Boe Emago Pegare Jesus Rore jiboe ji
source: Boe Emago Pegare Jesus Rore jiboe ji

b: Nono Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Boe emagare nono apo pugeje. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare togwagewo ture joruduwadowugebo.
source: Nono Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Boe emagare nono apo pugeje. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare togwagewo ture joruduwadowugebo.

b: Jesus uwobe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaidure tuwo Jesus utudo nowu boe doge epiji. Boe egore Jesus aora bai baie kodi.
source: Jesus uwobe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaidure tuwo Jesus utudo nowu boe doge epiji. Boe egore Jesus aora bai baie kodi.

b: Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji. Erudu pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji dukodire emago pegare ji. egore bope doge eimijera iere Belzebu. Emare meture nowu Jesus tada. Emare ure turaga maku Jesus ai Jesus uwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.
source: Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji. Erudu pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji dukodire emago pegare ji. egore bope doge eimijera iere Belzebu. Emare meture nowu Jesus tada. Emare ure turaga maku Jesus ai Jesus uwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.

b: Dukodire Jesus makore ewagai tumagowo ewadaru jipagi. Akore bope doge eimijera iere Satanás jamedu. Umodukare tudawuje boe epiji tuginai. Mare ia imedu ro rakarewu koiare umode tawuje boe epiji.
source: Dukodire Jesus makore ewagai tumagowo ewadaru jipagi. Akore bope doge eimijera iere Satanás jamedu. Umodukare tudawuje boe epiji tuginai. Mare ia imedu ro rakarewu koiare umode tawuje boe epiji.

b: Ia boe epokare puapo dukeje erugodure pui. Dukeje eraga akedumode epiji kuri je.
source: Ia boe epokare puapo dukeje erugodure pui. Dukeje eraga akedumode epiji kuri je.

b: Boe erugodumode tuwobei dukeje emode tugera ra pubiji rugadu. Dukodire eraga bokwamode rugadu.
source: Boe erugodumode tuwobei dukeje emode tugera ra pubiji rugadu. Dukodire eraga bokwamode rugadu.

b: Mare mearutorure Satanás jiwugeire inagoino. Epomodukare puapo dukeje eragamodukare pugeje. Boe pegamode ei rugadu. Etagedumode rugadu.
source: Mare mearutorure Satanás jiwugeire inagoino. Epomodukare puapo dukeje eragamodukare pugeje. Boe pegamode ei rugadu. Etagedumode rugadu.

b: Ca iwogurewu aidure tuwo turemo ia tugobaigare uwaito tuwo tugeragu nowu tugobaigare ia oeji. Mare umode nowu tugobaigare kogudo bukigu tabo boeto ji. Nono umode tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji rugadu tuduwo tabo rugadu.
source: Ca iwogurewu aidure tuwo turemo ia tugobaigare uwaito tuwo tugeragu nowu tugobaigare ia oeji. Mare umode nowu tugobaigare kogudo bukigu tabo boeto ji. Nono umode tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji rugadu tuduwo tabo rugadu.

b: – Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe etaidukare turo pegarewu ji pugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu piji. Emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare ekiarigodumode nowu tuwadaru pegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ewadaru pegarewu piji.
source: – Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe etaidukare turo pegarewu ji pugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu piji. Emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare ekiarigodumode nowu tuwadaru pegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ewadaru pegarewu piji.

b: Mare ia boe emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu. Nou bataru metumode nowu boebo ji rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu inodu piji.
