source: Mare ia boe emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu. Nou bataru metumode nowu boebo ji rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu inodu piji.

b: Nou boe egore bope uwari metuie Jesus tada dukodire Jesus akoino ei.
source: Nou boe egore bope uwari metuie Jesus tada dukodire Jesus akoino ei.

b: Jesus Uce, Uwiemage Etaregodure
source: Jesus Uce, Uwiemage Etaregodure

b: Jesus uce, uwiemage etaregodure bagai. Eragojere bawadu keje. Emagore Jesus bagai toro nowu baito.
source: Jesus uce, uwiemage etaregodure bagai. Eragojere bawadu keje. Emagore Jesus bagai toro nowu baito.

b: Boe emagare nowu bai tada Jesus apo. Emagore Jesus ji. egore akaiwodo. Ace, awiemage etaregodure. Epagare awagai bawadu keje.
source: Boe emagare nowu bai tada Jesus apo. Emagore Jesus ji. egore akaiwodo. Ace, awiemage etaregodure. Epagare awagai bawadu keje.

b: Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore imode tawie iogudubanure mugace, iogudubanure iwobece. Nono Jesus aiwore nowu mugure pudabowuge ji. Akore awu boe ere nono iwobe mogadure. Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu mearudae jiwu areme ime ere nono iwobe emogadure rugadu. Ere nono iwie mage emogadure rugadu. Ere nono muga mage emogadure rugadu.
source: Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore imode tawie iogudubanure mugace, iogudubanure iwobece. Nono Jesus aiwore nowu mugure pudabowuge ji. Akore awu boe ere nono iwobe mogadure. Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu mearudae jiwu areme ime ere nono iwobe emogadure rugadu. Ere nono iwie mage emogadure rugadu. Ere nono muga mage emogadure rugadu.

b: Boepa Tadaboe Jiwu Bakaru Reo
source: Boepa Tadaboe Jiwu Bakaru Reo

b: Nono Jesus uture nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka pugeje. Boe ere bato pui nono tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji pugeje. Emagare rugadu. Dukodire Jesus ure taredo ia ika kurirewuto. Nou ika kurirewu padure nono pobo tada. Nou boe edure pobo okwai tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji. Jesus ure tumugudo nowu ika kurirewu ja tada.
source: Nono Jesus uture nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka pugeje. Boe ere bato pui nono tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji pugeje. Emagare rugadu. Dukodire Jesus ure taredo ia ika kurirewuto. Nou ika kurirewu padure nono pobo tada. Nou boe edure pobo okwai tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji. Jesus ure tumugudo nowu ika kurirewu ja tada.

b: Nono Jesus makore ia bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai tuwo nowu boe eruduwado nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji.
source: Nono Jesus makore ia bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai tuwo nowu boe eruduwado nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji.

b: Akore tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Ia meri keje imedu uture to boepato tuwo boe tugu mototo.
source: Akore tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Ia meri keje imedu uture to boepato tuwo boe tugu mototo.

b: Ure boe a roto ja ja moto joki to boepa tada. Ia a buture awara okwaji. Dukodire kiebarege ere nowu buture awara okwa jiwu boe a rugadu kowuje.
source: Ure boe a roto ja ja moto joki to boepa tada. Ia a buture awara okwaji. Dukodire kiebarege ere nowu buture awara okwa jiwu boe a rugadu kowuje.

b: Ia a buture toriguru tada. Boture kuri je mare moto pegare ji.
source: Ia a buture toriguru tada. Boture kuri je mare moto pegare ji.

b: Dukodire boeru jeture ji dukejere nowu boeru ure nowu botureboe bito kuri je rugadu. Ukwa bokware kodi. Moto pegare kodi.
source: Dukodire boeru jeture ji dukejere nowu boeru ure nowu botureboe bito kuri je rugadu. Ukwa bokware kodi. Moto pegare kodi.

b: Ia a buture botoguru tada. Botoguru boture tabo jamedu mare botoguru ure bito. Dukodire nowu buture botoguru tadawu boe a ricodukare pemegakare jamedu.
source: Ia a buture botoguru tada. Botoguru boture tabo jamedu mare botoguru ure bito. Dukodire nowu buture botoguru tadawu boe a ricodukare pemegakare jamedu.

b: Mare ia a buture moto pemegarewu keje. Ere tuguwu sacu ure mitotu je. Botu pemegare, ricodu pemegare, enari kurire rugadu. Kidure dukeje ere rawuje ciwu piji. Ere a rawuje tuwo tugu sacuto. Nou sacu doge emagare. Paruduwakare nuba nowu ere korau sacu dogere. Ere cem, ere sessenta, ere trinta rabodu nowu boe a tabo. Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji taruduwawo kaba jiba inagoino tai.
source: Mare ia a buture moto pemegarewu keje. Ere tuguwu sacu ure mitotu je. Botu pemegare, ricodu pemegare, enari kurire rugadu. Kidure dukeje ere rawuje ciwu piji. Ere a rawuje tuwo tugu sacuto. Nou sacu doge emagare. Paruduwakare nuba nowu ere korau sacu dogere. Ere cem, ere sessenta, ere trinta rabodu nowu boe a tabo. Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji taruduwawo kaba jiba inagoino tai.

b: Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo dukeje makore ei pugeje. Akore tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji.
source: Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo dukeje makore ei pugeje. Akore tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Kodiba Tumagore Bakaruji Boe Ewiagai
source: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Kodiba Tumagore Bakaruji Boe Ewiagai

b: Jesus uture nowu boe epiji ture joruduwadowugebo. Mare iage etaidure tuioruduwawo kaboba jiba nowu bakaru akoino. Dukodire eture rekodaji tumearudu pemegawo kaba jiba akoino.
source: Jesus uture nowu boe epiji ture joruduwadowugebo. Mare iage etaidure tuioruduwawo kaboba jiba nowu bakaru akoino. Dukodire eture rekodaji tumearudu pemegawo kaba jiba akoino.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore ireadodure bakaruji iwo boe eruduwado nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Mare paga karega. Ireadodure bakaruji aino Pao Kurirewu uwo taruduwado meture pudabowu tumearudae boe ji boe ewo tugimijerado tu ema. Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emearudumode imagore jiwu bakaruji mare emodukare boe pa nowu bakaruji.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore ireadodure bakaruji iwo boe eruduwado nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Mare paga karega. Ireadodure bakaruji aino Pao Kurirewu uwo taruduwado meture pudabowu tumearudae boe ji boe ewo tugimijerado tu ema. Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emearudumode imagore jiwu bakaruji mare emodukare boe pa nowu bakaruji.

b: Dukodire: – Etaiwomode rugadu mare erudumodukare boe ji; Ewiapagamode mare eruduwamodukare boe ji. Mare eruduwamode dukeje emode tumagu Pao Kurirewu ai. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu boe piji.
source: Dukodire: – Etaiwomode rugadu mare erudumodukare boe ji; Ewiapagamode mare eruduwamodukare boe ji. Mare eruduwamode dukeje emode tumagu Pao Kurirewu ai. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu boe piji.

b: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eruduwado Tumagore Jiboe ji
source: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eruduwado Tumagore Jiboe ji

b: Nono Jesus unarare ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduware awu inagoino jiwu bakaruji? Nuba taromode taruduwawo awu bakaruji?
source: Nono Jesus unarare ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduware awu inagoino jiwu bakaruji? Nuba taromode taruduwawo awu bakaruji?

b: Nono Jesus ure eruduwado nowu bakaruji. Akore boe eire inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru jire inagoino jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus ure eruduwado nowu bakaruji. Akore boe eire inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru jire inagoino jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu o bataru ure nono nowu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru aregodumode boe etae. Nono boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare bope doge eimijera umode nowu boe ewiagodudo nowu tumearudure jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru piji. Dukodire emearutorumodukare ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Pao Kurirewu o bataru ure nono nowu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru aregodumode boe etae. Nono boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare bope doge eimijera umode nowu boe ewiagodudo nowu tumearudure jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru piji. Dukodire emearutorumodukare ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji pugeje. Nono nowu boe emode nono nowu boture toriguru tadawu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe eragamodukare tumearutoru raiwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino. Emode tugeragu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tiagare tabo mare emearutoru raimodukare ji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji pugeje. Nono nowu boe emode nono nowu boture toriguru tadawu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe eragamodukare tumearutoru raiwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino. Emode tugeragu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tiagare tabo mare emearutoru raimodukare ji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji pugeje. Awu boe emode nono nowu boture botoguru tadawu boe a mogadure. Botoguru umode boe pegado ji umode bito. Mare boture botoguru tadawu boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji pugeje. Awu boe emode nono nowu boture botoguru tadawu boe a mogadure. Botoguru umode boe pegado ji umode bito. Mare boture botoguru tadawu boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Mare emororamagadumode tu tumearudae boe ji kuri je. Emearudaere tu pudui tuwo to diero kurido. Dujire inagoino. Etaidumode tu taidure jiboe ji. Emearudaere nowu taidure jiboe umode tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji mare pagatu je. Dukodire emode tugera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru piji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Mare emororamagadumode tu tumearudae boe ji kuri je. Emearudaere tu pudui tuwo to diero kurido. Dujire inagoino. Etaidumode tu taidure jiboe ji. Emearudaere nowu taidure jiboe umode tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji mare pagatu je. Dukodire emode tugera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru piji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Mare ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji rugadu. Dukodire epemegamode rugadu nono nowu boture moto pemegarewu boe a mogadure. Mare boture moto pemegarewu kejewu boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nono emearutorumode ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure jitu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Mare ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji rugadu. Dukodire epemegamode rugadu nono nowu boture moto pemegarewu boe a mogadure. Mare boture moto pemegarewu kejewu boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nono emearutorumode ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure jitu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Boe Emodukare Pori Bu Jorugu Aogeje
source: Boe Emodukare Pori Bu Jorugu Aogeje

b: Jesus makore kimo. Akore boe emode pori bu lamparina aogeje dukeje urugumodukare. Boe emode jorugu mugudo tuba kuda dukeje urugumodukare jamedu. Mare boe emode lamparina urugu bararedo, uruguwo pudui.
source: Jesus makore kimo. Akore boe emode pori bu lamparina aogeje dukeje urugumodukare. Boe emode jorugu mugudo tuba kuda dukeje urugumodukare jamedu. Mare boe emode lamparina urugu bararedo, uruguwo pudui.

b: Ca boe etaidumode tuwo turo pegarewu biado boe epiji. Mare Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu ero pegarewuji. Dukodire boe eruduwamode nowu ero pegarewu ji jamedu.
source: Ca boe etaidumode tuwo turo pegarewu biado boe epiji. Mare Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu ero pegarewuji. Dukodire boe eruduwamode nowu ero pegarewu ji jamedu.

b: Taipaga pemegado iwadaru ji.
source: Taipaga pemegado iwadaru ji.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore taipaga pemegado tamearudure jiboe ji. Tagaiwomode boe eroji ero pegamode dubagai dukeje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode taro pegarewu bagai jamedu. Tagaidumode boe pegawo boe ji ero pegarewu morice dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado tai rugadu taro pegarewu morice.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore taipaga pemegado tamearudure jiboe ji. Tagaiwomode boe eroji ero pegamode dubagai dukeje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode taro pegarewu bagai jamedu. Tagaidumode boe pegawo boe ji ero pegarewu morice dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado tai rugadu taro pegarewu morice.

b: Boe eruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode eruduwa kurido pudui emearutoruwo pudui rugadu. Mare ia boe etaidumodukare tumearutoruwo tuioruduware jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode eruduwa bokwado tuwadaru ji. Emearudaere tuioruduwaie rugadu mare pagatu je.
source: Boe eruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode eruduwa kurido pudui emearutoruwo pudui rugadu. Mare ia boe etaidumodukare tumearutoruwo tuioruduware jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode eruduwa bokwado tuwadaru ji. Emearudaere tuioruduwaie rugadu mare pagatu je.

b: Boe A Boture Dukodiwu Bakaru Reo
source: Boe A Boture Dukodiwu Bakaru Reo

b: Jesus makore boe ji pugeje. Akore boe eimijera kurirewunure Pao Kurirewuce rugadu. Mearutorure jiwuge emagamode rugadu. Mare boe eruduwakare mearutorumode jiwugei mearutorumodukare jiwugei jamedu. Imode taruduwado nowu inoduji bakaru tabo. Imedu ure boe a tugu mototo mare joruduwakare botumodewugei botumodukarewugei jamedu. Ure boe a roto ja ja moto joki.
source: Jesus makore boe ji pugeje. Akore boe eimijera kurirewunure Pao Kurirewuce rugadu. Mearutorure jiwuge emagamode rugadu. Mare boe eruduwakare mearutorumode jiwugei mearutorumodukare jiwugei jamedu. Imode taruduwado nowu inoduji bakaru tabo. Imedu ure boe a tugu mototo mare joruduwakare botumodewugei botumodukarewugei jamedu. Ure boe a roto ja ja moto joki.

b: Nono nudure boeco ji. Nou barogwato ure tie bu. Ure tuguwu boe a boture mare imedu jorudukare ji mototo. Joruduwakare nuba nowu boe a rore tuwoduwo.
source: Nono nudure boeco ji. Nou barogwato ure tie bu. Ure tuguwu boe a boture mare imedu jorudukare ji mototo. Joruduwakare nuba nowu boe a rore tuwoduwo.

b: Moto koiare ure nowu boe a botudo. Boture dukeje ricodure. Ricore dukeje enarire. Enari kurire.
source: Moto koiare ure nowu boe a botudo. Boture dukeje ricodure. Ricore dukeje enarire. Enari kurire.

b: Imedu pagare kuroduwo. Kurodumode dukeje ure kado tariga tabo. Inagore imedu uie boe a tugu mototo. Boere nono nowu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Ia boe emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Iage emearutorumodukare ji jamedu.
source: Imedu pagare kuroduwo. Kurodumode dukeje ure kado tariga tabo. Inagore imedu uie boe a tugu mototo. Boere nono nowu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Ia boe emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Iage emearutorumodukare ji jamedu.

b: Mostarda A Boture
source: Mostarda A Boture

b: Jesus makore boe ji pugeje. Akore itaidure iwo taruduwado nuba Pao Kurirewu utugarege ere. Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagakare mare ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagagodumode rugadu. Ireadoduwo ia bakaruji tawiagai.
source: Jesus makore boe ji pugeje. Akore itaidure iwo taruduwado nuba Pao Kurirewu utugarege ere. Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagakare mare ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagagodumode rugadu. Ireadoduwo ia bakaruji tawiagai.

b: Ia imedu ure ia mostarda a tugu to boepato. Mostarda a kurikare rugadu. Boe a jamedu boe kurire nowu mostarda a kori. Imedu ure tugu to boepato.
source: Ia imedu ure ia mostarda a tugu to boepato. Mostarda a kurikare rugadu. Boe a jamedu boe kurire nowu mostarda a kori. Imedu ure tugu to boepato.

b: Nono ia meri keje boture. Ricodure rugadu. Nono iku kurire nowu boe emode tugu to boepa tadaboe iku jamedu boe kori. Kiebarege ere tumugudo keje. Ere tuwaradu pemegado keje. Pao Kurirewu utugarege ere nono nowu mostarda arogu mogadure. Mare mostarda a ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu utugarege eire inagoino. Emagakare mare ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Nono ia meri keje boture. Ricodure rugadu. Nono iku kurire nowu boe emode tugu to boepa tadaboe iku jamedu boe kori. Kiebarege ere tumugudo keje. Ere tuwaradu pemegado keje. Pao Kurirewu utugarege ere nono nowu mostarda arogu mogadure. Mare mostarda a ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu utugarege eire inagoino. Emagakare mare ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ainore Jesus akore. Readodu kigodure bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai tuwo eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu jii eruduwamode jitu oto pa ka.
source: Ainore Jesus akore. Readodu kigodure bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai tuwo eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu jii eruduwamode jitu oto pa ka.

b: Bakaru jire Jesus akoino boe ewiagai. Mare Jesus mugure nowu ture joruduwadowugebo tuginai dukeje ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado nowu tumagore jiwu bakaruji ewiagai. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze.
source: Bakaru jire Jesus akoino boe ewiagai. Mare Jesus mugure nowu ture joruduwadowugebo tuginai dukeje ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado nowu tumagore jiwu bakaruji ewiagai. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze.

b: Jesus Ure Bakuru Pegarewu Akedudo
source: Jesus Ure Bakuru Pegarewu Akedudo

b: Nou meri ji rugadu boeco ji Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore Pagurugoduwo awu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka.
source: Nou meri ji rugadu boeco ji Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore Pagurugoduwo awu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka.

b: Dukodire emagore nowu boe ji etuwo pugeje. Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze. Ere taredo ika kurirewuto Jesus apo. Nono eture. Ia boe eture eregodaji ika kurirewugebo jamedu.
source: Dukodire emagore nowu boe ji etuwo pugeje. Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze. Ere taredo ika kurirewuto Jesus apo. Nono eture. Ia boe eture eregodaji ika kurirewugebo jamedu.

b: Ekurugodure dukeje bakuru pegarewu aregodure etae. Nou bakuru pegarewu ure pobo maerewu rutudo. Dukodire pobo jeture nowu ika kurirewuji. Dukodire pobo ure turemo nowu ika kurirewuto. Dukodire nowu ika kurirewu korobadugodure pobo tabo.
source: Ekurugodure dukeje bakuru pegarewu aregodure etae. Nou bakuru pegarewu ure pobo maerewu rutudo. Dukodire pobo jeture nowu ika kurirewuji. Dukodire pobo ure turemo nowu ika kurirewuto. Dukodire nowu ika kurirewu korobadugodure pobo tabo.

b: Mare Jesus unudure toro nowu ika kurirewu upo keje. Aora padure takudau keje. Ca ure joruduwadowuge ere Jesus jetadudo. egore cegimijera! Akaidure pawiwo? Pawimode!
source: Mare Jesus unudure toro nowu ika kurirewu upo keje. Aora padure takudau keje. Ca ure joruduwadowuge ere Jesus jetadudo. egore cegimijera! Akaidure pawiwo? Pawimode!

b: Ca Jesus ure turagojedo. Nono mako rakare bakuruji. Akore akaguru akedudo! Nono makore poboji. Akore akaba aporudo pugeje! Dukodire nowu bakuru akedure rugadu. Nou pobo butugugodure jamedu.
source: Ca Jesus ure turagojedo. Nono mako rakare bakuruji. Akore akaguru akedudo! Nono makore poboji. Akore akaba aporudo pugeje! Dukodire nowu bakuru akedure rugadu. Nou pobo butugugodure jamedu.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore kodiba tabagudugodure? Kocare tamearutorukare i na?
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore kodiba tabagudugodure? Kocare tamearutorukare i na?

b: Mare epagudugodure rugadu. Nono emagore pui. egore Dubobanure awu imeduce? Kocare bakuru, pobo emearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji rugadu!
source: Mare epagudugodure rugadu. Nono emagore pui. egore Dubobanure awu imeduce? Kocare bakuru, pobo emearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji rugadu!

b: Jesus Ure Bope Doge Etuwaire Tawuje Ia Imedu Piji
source: Jesus Ure Bope Doge Etuwaire Tawuje Ia Imedu Piji

b: J e s u s a r e g o d u r e t u r e joruduwadowugebo toro nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka. Nou etaregodure kawu moto iere Gerasa.
source: J e s u s a r e g o d u r e t u r e joruduwadowugebo toro nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka. Nou etaregodure kawu moto iere Gerasa.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje bope doge emedure tadawu imedu uture Jesus togi.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje bope doge emedure tadawu imedu uture Jesus togi.

b: Dukodire nowu imedu mugure boe ere birewuge etugu tadawu tori poro tada. Boe etaidure tuwo nowu imedu kogudo meriri iku tabo mare meriri iku rakakare nowu imeduji.
source: Dukodire nowu imedu mugure boe ere birewuge etugu tadawu tori poro tada. Boe etaidure tuwo nowu imedu kogudo meriri iku tabo mare meriri iku rakakare nowu imeduji.

b: Marigudu boe ere nowu imedu bure kogudo meriri iku tabo. Ere nowu imedu iera kogudo meriri iku tabo. Mare nowu imedu ure nowu meriri iku kado turaga tabo tu tu je. Raka kodure boe eiamedu boe ekori.
source: Marigudu boe ere nowu imedu bure kogudo meriri iku tabo. Ere nowu imedu iera kogudo meriri iku tabo. Mare nowu imedu ure nowu meriri iku kado turaga tabo tu tu je. Raka kodure boe eiamedu boe ekori.

b: Nou imedu meru pagare tori aoji, nowu tori poro jamedu boe parugajeje meri ji boeco ji. Kudu pagare meri jamedu boe ji tu tu je. Ure tuwiri kado nowu tori mega tabo rugadu.
source: Nou imedu meru pagare tori aoji, nowu tori poro jamedu boe parugajeje meri ji boeco ji. Kudu pagare meri jamedu boe ji tu tu je. Ure tuwiri kado nowu tori mega tabo rugadu.

b: Nou imedu aiwo jaere Jesus togi. Nono rekodure toro ae. Aregodure Jesus ae dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.
source: Nou imedu aiwo jaere Jesus togi. Nono rekodure toro ae. Aregodure Jesus ae dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.

b: Dukejere ure tugudu rakado. Akore Jesusnure aki! Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki! Boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewunure Pao Kurirewuce! Jesus akore Bope uwarinure aki. Atawuje awu imedu piji! Nou bope uwari akore Nuba aromode cei? Akaba itudo boe pegarewuto. Amagodo Pao Kurirewu biagai aro pegamodukaie i rugadu.
source: Dukejere ure tugudu rakado. Akore Jesusnure aki! Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki! Boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewunure Pao Kurirewuce! Jesus akore Bope uwarinure aki. Atawuje awu imedu piji! Nou bope uwari akore Nuba aromode cei? Akaba itudo boe pegarewuto. Amagodo Pao Kurirewu biagai aro pegamodukaie i rugadu.

b: Jesus unarare ji. Akore nuba akiere? Nou meture nowu imedu tadawu bope uwari akore Cegiere bope doge makarewuge. Cemagare awu imedu tada.
source: Jesus unarare ji. Akore nuba akiere? Nou meture nowu imedu tadawu bope uwari akore Cegiere bope doge makarewuge. Cemagare awu imedu tada.

b: Nono nowu meture nowu imedu tadawu bope doge enogwamagudure Jesus ji ukawo tududo nowu moto piji.
source: Nono nowu meture nowu imedu tadawu bope doge enogwamagudure Jesus ji ukawo tududo nowu moto piji.

b: Jugurewuge edu puredure togwage tabo nono.
source: Jugurewuge edu puredure togwage tabo nono.

b: Dukodire nowu meture nowu imedu tadawu bope doge enogwamagudure Jesus ji nowu imedu ja piji. egore cedudo toro nowu jugurewuge etae. Cedo ceremo nowu jugurewugeto.
source: Dukodire nowu meture nowu imedu tadawu bope doge enogwamagudure Jesus ji nowu imedu ja piji. egore cedudo toro nowu jugurewuge etae. Cedo ceremo nowu jugurewugeto.

b: Nono Jesus ure etudo. Dukodire nowu bope doge ere tudawuje nowu imedu piji. Ere turemo nowu jugurewugeto. Dukodire nowu jugurewuge eiamedu boe eregodure kuri ia moto ri ao piji taci poboto. Dukodire eiamedu boe ewire poboto. Enodo padure dois mil.
source: Nono Jesus ure etudo. Dukodire nowu bope doge ere tudawuje nowu imedu piji. Ere turemo nowu jugurewugeto. Dukodire nowu jugurewuge eiamedu boe eregodure kuri ia moto ri ao piji taci poboto. Dukodire eiamedu boe ewire poboto. Enodo padure dois mil.

b: Nou jeture nowu jugurewuge eiwuge ime eregodure nowu boe epiji toro tuwai mugure tadawu ba kurirewu ka. Ereadodure Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu ba kurirewu tadawu boe ewiagai. Ereadodure boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu. Dukodire nowu boe eture Jesus ae tuioruduwo ji, tuioruduwo nowu imeduji jamedu.
source: Nou jeture nowu jugurewuge eiwuge ime eregodure nowu boe epiji toro tuwai mugure tadawu ba kurirewu ka. Ereadodure Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu ba kurirewu tadawu boe ewiagai. Ereadodure boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu. Dukodire nowu boe eture Jesus ae tuioruduwo ji, tuioruduwo nowu imeduji jamedu.

b: Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje erudure nowu bope doge emedure tadawu imeduji pemegagodure duji. Butugugodure. Ukudau areia meture ji. Eruduware ji. Eruduware Jesus ure bope doge etawuje nowu imedu piji dukodire nowu imedu pemegagodure. Dukodire nowu boe epagudugodure.
source: Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje erudure nowu bope doge emedure tadawu imeduji pemegagodure duji. Butugugodure. Ukudau areia meture ji. Eruduware ji. Eruduware Jesus ure bope doge etawuje nowu imedu piji dukodire nowu imedu pemegagodure. Dukodire nowu boe epagudugodure.

b: Jorudure nowu Jesus rore jiwuge ereadodure nouia boe ewiagai nuba Jesus rore nowu bope doge emedure tadawu imeduji. Ereadodure nowu bope doge ere turemo jugurewugeto duji nouia boe ewiagai jamedu.
source: Jorudure nowu Jesus rore jiwuge ereadodure nouia boe ewiagai nuba Jesus rore nowu bope doge emedure tadawu imeduji. Ereadodure nowu bope doge ere turemo jugurewugeto duji nouia boe ewiagai jamedu.

b: Nou boe epagudugodure dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji utuwo nowu to moto piji.
source: Nou boe epagudugodure dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji utuwo nowu to moto piji.

b: Dukodire Jesus uiago taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje. Mare nowu bope doge ere tudawuje pijiwu imedu okwamagudure Jesus ji. Akore itaidure ikoduwo akabo.
source: Dukodire Jesus uiago taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje. Mare nowu bope doge ere tudawuje pijiwu imedu okwamagudure Jesus ji. Akore itaidure ikoduwo akabo.

b: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boro. Atudo aibagi awobe etae. Areadoduwo ewiagai nuba Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ai duji rugadu. Areadodudo ewiagai Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ai du boe ji.
source: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boro. Atudo aibagi awobe etae. Areadoduwo ewiagai nuba Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ai duji rugadu. Areadodudo ewiagai Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ai du boe ji.

b: Dukodire nowu imedu uture Jesus piji tuwobe etae. Boe eda enodo padure dez nowu moto keje. Nou imedu readodure Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare pudui duji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe eiamedu boe erore ta je nowu imedu akoino tureadodu tabo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai duji.
source: Dukodire nowu imedu uture Jesus piji tuwobe etae. Boe eda enodo padure dez nowu moto keje. Nou imedu readodure Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare pudui duji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe eiamedu boe erore ta je nowu imedu akoino tureadodu tabo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai duji.

b: Jesus Ure Ia Areme Epemegago
source: Jesus Ure Ia Areme Epemegago

b: Jesus kurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje tuibagi. Aregodure toro dukeje boe emagare nono pobo okwai.
source: Jesus kurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje tuibagi. Aregodure toro dukeje boe emagare nono pobo okwai.

b: Judeu doge ere bato pui ia bai tada tu tu je. Jeture nowu bai jiwu boe eimijera iere Jairo. Nou imedu Jairo aregodure Jesus togi. Dukejere ure tuwududo moto keje Jesus jokorai.
source: Judeu doge ere bato pui ia bai tada tu tu je. Jeture nowu bai jiwu boe eimijera iere Jairo. Nou imedu Jairo aregodure Jesus togi. Dukejere ure tuwududo moto keje Jesus jokorai.

b: Dukejere okwamagudure Jesus ji. Akore itonaregedu aredu bigodunure. Mato itabo awo akera bu biri keje pemegagoduwo, bikawo.
source: Dukejere okwamagudure Jesus ji. Akore itonaregedu aredu bigodunure. Mato itabo awo akera bu biri keje pemegagoduwo, bikawo.

b: Dukodire Jesus uture nowu Jairo apo. Boe emagare rugadu tugodui Jesus rekodaji dutabo. Nono nowu boe emagare rugadu dukodire ere taiado paci Jesus apo.
source: Dukodire Jesus uture nowu Jairo apo. Boe emagare rugadu tugodui Jesus rekodaji dutabo. Nono nowu boe emagare rugadu dukodire ere taiado paci Jesus apo.

b: Ia aredu kodure ebo Jesus rekodaji. Marigudu nowu aredu kogodaere tu tu je. Nou aredu ku rere piji nono areme etorewudae mogadure. Mare nowu aredu o akedukare piji. Re kimore piji meri jamedu boe ji. Joru oto padure doze nowu aredu ku rere piji dukeje. Kodire uture jorubo epage etae. Ure diero rugadu maku jorubo epage etai mare ekare nowu aredu pemegago. Pegare kimo. Jorubo epage etaiwore ji dukeje nowu kogodae ure turagado ji rugadu.
source: Ia aredu kodure ebo Jesus rekodaji. Marigudu nowu aredu kogodaere tu tu je. Nou aredu ku rere piji nono areme etorewudae mogadure. Mare nowu aredu o akedukare piji. Re kimore piji meri jamedu boe ji. Joru oto padure doze nowu aredu ku rere piji dukeje. Kodire uture jorubo epage etae. Ure diero rugadu maku jorubo epage etai mare ekare nowu aredu pemegago. Pegare kimo. Jorubo epage etaiwore ji dukeje nowu kogodae ure turagado ji rugadu.

b: Nou aredu mearudure Jesus rore jiboe ji. Dukodire uture ae. Mare boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Dukodire nowu aredu makore tudada. Akore ikera otorogu jetumode awu Jesus ukudau areiaji dukeje ipemegagodumode. Nono nowu aredu ure tugera raido. Nono iera otorogu jeture Jesus ukudau areiaji.
source: Nou aredu mearudure Jesus rore jiboe ji. Dukodire uture ae. Mare boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Dukodire nowu aredu makore tudada. Akore ikera otorogu jetumode awu Jesus ukudau areiaji dukeje ipemegagodumode. Nono nowu aredu ure tugera raido. Nono iera otorogu jeture Jesus ukudau areiaji.

b: Ca nowu aredu pemegagodure taci je. Nou aredu ku rekare piji pugeje. Joruduware tubemegagodure duji rugadu.
source: Ca nowu aredu pemegagodure taci je. Nou aredu ku rekare piji pugeje. Joruduware tubemegagodure duji rugadu.

b: Ca Jesus joruduware ia turaga iogore ia boe ji duji. Dukodire ure tuwuredo taiwowo nowu boe ji. Akore ioguduba ure tugera raido ikudau areia ka?
source: Ca Jesus joruduware ia turaga iogore ia boe ji duji. Dukodire ure tuwuredo taiwowo nowu boe ji. Akore ioguduba ure tugera raido ikudau areia ka?

b: Nou ure joruduwadowuge emagore ji. egore kodiba akagore aino? Boe emagare woe pagabo. Boe eiamedu boe ekera jeture akudau areiaji.
source: Nou ure joruduwadowuge emagore ji. egore kodiba akagore aino? Boe emagare woe pagabo. Boe eiamedu boe ekera jeture akudau areiaji.

b: Mare Jesus aiwore nowu boe ji nowu iera jeture tugudau areia jiwu bagai.
source: Mare Jesus aiwore nowu boe ji nowu iera jeture tugudau areia jiwu bagai.

b: Nou aredu joruduware tubemegagodure duji. Dukodire ure tuburedo Jesus ji. Mare pagudure dukodire mororamagadure. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai dukejere readodure turore jiboe ji Jesus biagai.
source: Nou aredu joruduware tubemegagodure duji. Dukodire ure tuburedo Jesus ji. Mare pagudure dukodire mororamagadure. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai dukejere readodure turore jiboe ji Jesus biagai.

b: Jesus makore ji. Akore are. Amearutorure i dukodire apemegagodure. Amororamagadukaba. Ire akogodae akedudo apiji rugadu.
source: Jesus makore ji. Akore are. Amearutorure i dukodire apemegagodure. Amororamagadukaba. Ire akogodae akedudo apiji rugadu.

b: Jesus mako kimore nowu areduji dukeje ime etaregodure etae Jairo uwai piji. Emagore Jairoji. egore akanaregedurogu bokware. Amagokaba nowu pagimijeraji pugeje. Piji.
source: Jesus mako kimore nowu areduji dukeje ime etaregodure etae Jairo uwai piji. Emagore Jairoji. egore akanaregedurogu bokware. Amagokaba nowu pagimijeraji pugeje. Piji.

b: Jesus mearudure emagore jiboe ji mare biapagakare ewadaru ji. Makore Jairoji. Akore amororamagadukaba. Amearutorudo i rugadu.
source: Jesus mearudure emagore jiboe ji mare biapagakare ewadaru ji. Makore Jairoji. Akore amororamagadukaba. Amearutorudo i rugadu.

b: Nono uture Jairo apo, Pedro apo, Tiago apo, Tiago uwie João apo. Eture toro Jairo uwai ka. Mare nouia ture joruduwadowuge ukare etudo pudabo. Kodire etukare rugadu.
source: Nono uture Jairo apo, Pedro apo, Tiago apo, Tiago uwie João apo. Eture toro Jairo uwai ka. Mare nouia ture joruduwadowuge ukare etudo pudabo. Kodire etukare rugadu.

b: Jesus aregodure Jairo uwai ka Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo dukeje erudure boe ji nono. Nou boe etragudu rakare. Ekiarigodure rugadu etonaregedu bire kodi.
source: Jesus aregodure Jairo uwai ka Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo dukeje erudure boe ji nono. Nou boe etragudu rakare. Ekiarigodure rugadu etonaregedu bire kodi.

b: Nono Jesus ure turemo tumagowo ei. Akore kodiba tagragudure? Kodiba tagiarigodure? Aredu bikare. Unudunure! Joruduware tumoduie jewodudo pugeje. Dukodire akoino unudunuie.
source: Nono Jesus ure turemo tumagowo ei. Akore kodiba tagragudure? Kodiba tagiarigodure? Aredu bikare. Unudunure! Joruduware tumoduie jewodudo pugeje. Dukodire akoino unudunuie.

b: Mare nowu boe eruduware nowu nogwaredu bire rugadu duji dukodire enogwarigodure Jesus ji. Dukodire Jesus ure etudo nowu bai piji. Nono ure tugeragu nowu aredu uceji, ure tugeragu aredu uoji. Ure tugeragu Pedro ji, Tiagoji, Joãoji jamedu. Nono ure turemo ebo nowu aredu padure tadawu baito.
source: Mare nowu boe eruduware nowu nogwaredu bire rugadu duji dukodire enogwarigodure Jesus ji. Dukodire Jesus ure etudo nowu bai piji. Nono ure tugeragu nowu aredu uceji, ure tugeragu aredu uoji. Ure tugeragu Pedro ji, Tiagoji, Joãoji jamedu. Nono ure turemo ebo nowu aredu padure tadawu baito.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu nowu aredu ieraji dukeje makore ji ewadaru tabo. Akore talitá cumi! (Boe ewadaru tabo akore are! Amugudo! Imire inagoino ai!)
source: Jesus ure tugeragu nowu aredu ieraji dukeje makore ji ewadaru tabo. Akore talitá cumi! (Boe ewadaru tabo akore are! Amugudo! Imire inagoino ai!)

b: Ca nowu aredu ure tumugudo taci je. (Nou aredu o joru oto padure doze.) Nono ure turagojedo. Merure nowu bai ja tada. Uce, uo erore ta je.
source: Ca nowu aredu ure tumugudo taci je. (Nou aredu o joru oto padure doze.) Nono ure turagojedo. Merure nowu bai ja tada. Uce, uo erore ta je.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei ekawo boe ewie turore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Dukejere Jesus akore awu tagonaregedu okwagedo.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei ekawo boe ewie turore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Dukejere Jesus akore awu tagonaregedu okwagedo.

b: Nazaré Ba Kurirewu Kejewuge Etaidukare Jesus ji
source: Nazaré Ba Kurirewu Kejewuge Etaidukare Jesus ji

b: Jesus uture Jairo uwai piji tuduwo turijodure kejewu Nazaré ba kurirewu ka. Ure joruduwadowuge eture rekodaji.
source: Jesus uture Jairo uwai piji tuduwo turijodure kejewu Nazaré ba kurirewu ka. Ure joruduwadowuge eture rekodaji.

b: Sábado meri ji Jesus uture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado nowu bai tada. Nono boe emagare nowu bai tada jamedu. Emearudure Jesus bataru ji dukodire erore ta je. Mare erudu pemegakare ji. egore awu Jesus maragodumode ira jiwu imedunure ema. Boe eimijera karegure ema. Ceruduware uwobe eiamedu boe ji. Uce iere Maria. Uwie ime ekiere Tiago, José, Judas, Simão. Uwie areme emugu kimore woe awu pago ba kurirewu keje rugadu. Ioguduba ure awu imedu joruduwado? Ioguduba ure turaga maku ai ro rakawo awu turo rakarewu boe ji? Boe eimijera karegure ema. Boe eimijera ukare joruduwado. Pagare akoino. Ro rakare mare pagatu je. Nono nowu boe emearutorukare Jesus ji.
source: Sábado meri ji Jesus uture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado nowu bai tada. Nono boe emagare nowu bai tada jamedu. Emearudure Jesus bataru ji dukodire erore ta je. Mare erudu pemegakare ji. egore awu Jesus maragodumode ira jiwu imedunure ema. Boe eimijera karegure ema. Ceruduware uwobe eiamedu boe ji. Uce iere Maria. Uwie ime ekiere Tiago, José, Judas, Simão. Uwie areme emugu kimore woe awu pago ba kurirewu keje rugadu. Ioguduba ure awu imedu joruduwado? Ioguduba ure turaga maku ai ro rakawo awu turo rakarewu boe ji? Boe eimijera karegure ema. Boe eimijera ukare joruduwado. Pagare akoino. Ro rakare mare pagatu je. Nono nowu boe emearutorukare Jesus ji.

b: Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu makore jiboe pemegamode boe ji. Boe emearutorumode ji. Mare turijodure kejewu boe eda kejewuge etaidumodukare makore jiboe ji. Uwobe uwai tadawu boe etaidumodukare makore jiboe ji. Tu emage rugadu. Iage etaidumode ji.
source: Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu makore jiboe pemegamode boe ji. Boe emearutorumode ji. Mare turijodure kejewu boe eda kejewuge etaidumodukare makore jiboe ji. Uwobe uwai tadawu boe etaidumodukare makore jiboe ji. Tu emage rugadu. Iage etaidumode ji.

b: Boe emearutorukare Jesus ji nono. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare tuwo turo rakarewu makado nono nowu turijodure kejewu moto keje. Akore kocare awu boe emearutorukare i. Ure ia boe epemegago. Mare emagakare. Ure tugera bu ewugeje dukeje ure epemegago rugadu. Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Aregodure ia boe eda ka pugeje. Nono ure boe eruduwado pugeje.
source: Boe emearutorukare Jesus ji nono. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare tuwo turo rakarewu makado nono nowu turijodure kejewu moto keje. Akore kocare awu boe emearutorukare i. Ure ia boe epemegago. Mare emagakare. Ure tugera bu ewugeje dukeje ure epemegago rugadu. Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Aregodure ia boe eda ka pugeje. Nono ure boe eruduwado pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Tumaragodae Maku Ture Joruduwadowuge Etai.
source: Jesus Ure Tumaragodae Maku Ture Joruduwadowuge Etai.

b: Nono makore ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Enodo padure doze. Jesus aidure tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe eiamedu boe etae. Ure edo pobe tu tu puapo boe etae. Ure eragado ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji.
source: Nono makore ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Enodo padure doze. Jesus aidure tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe eiamedu boe etae. Ure edo pobe tu tu puapo boe etae. Ure eragado ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji.

b: Akore tadukaba tage tabo. Tadukaba diero tabo. Tagaba tagoroe reko jamedu. Tadukaba ia tagedu jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadudo tu nowu tawure tadawu tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau tabo pugeje.
source: Akore tadukaba tage tabo. Tadukaba diero tabo. Tagaba tagoroe reko jamedu. Tadukaba ia tagedu jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadudo tu nowu tawure tadawu tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau tabo pugeje.

b: Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tarudumode boe ji. Etaidumode tai dukeje tagamudo ebo ji nowu tadumode kejewu meri ka.
source: Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tarudumode boe ji. Etaidumode tai dukeje tagamudo ebo ji nowu tadumode kejewu meri ka.

b: Mare tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka pugeje mare nowu boe ekimadumodukare tagabo. Etaidumodukare tuwiapagawo tawadaru ji. Dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode epiji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu barigu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe ji kodire umode tugera ra epiji.
source: Mare tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka pugeje mare nowu boe ekimadumodukare tagabo. Etaidumodukare tuwiapagawo tawadaru ji. Dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode epiji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu barigu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe ji kodire umode tugera ra epiji.

b: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture. Emagore Jesus bataru ji boe ewiagai ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji.
source: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture. Emagore Jesus bataru ji boe ewiagai ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere bope doge ewari etawuje boe epiji. Ere boekaguru redo kogodurewuge etaora keje nono Pao Kurirewu ure epemegago rugadu.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere bope doge ewari etawuje boe epiji. Ere boekaguru redo kogodurewuge etaora keje nono Pao Kurirewu ure epemegago rugadu.

b: João Batista Bitodure
source: João Batista Bitodure

b: Boe eiamedu boe emearudure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji. Etaidure tuioruduwawo kakojiwu imedu ba ure ema. Iage egore eliasnure ema. Mare iage egore boro. Elias karega. Ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema. Ure nono jaoboe makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emogadure. Mare ia boe egore boro. João Batistanure ema. Jewodure pugeje! Dukodire rakare tuwo boe pemegado boe ji. Boe eimijera kurirewu Herodes mearudure nowu inoduji jamedu.
source: Boe eiamedu boe emearudure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji. Etaidure tuioruduwawo kakojiwu imedu ba ure ema. Iage egore eliasnure ema. Mare iage egore boro. Elias karega. Ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema. Ure nono jaoboe makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emogadure. Mare ia boe egore boro. João Batistanure ema. Jewodure pugeje! Dukodire rakare tuwo boe pemegado boe ji. Boe eimijera kurirewu Herodes mearudure nowu inoduji jamedu.

b: Herodes akore João Batistanure ema rugadu. Ire João Batista itoru kado kodire bire. Macare jewodure pugeje. Mare Herodes okware boeto. João Batista bire rugadu.
source: Herodes akore João Batistanure ema rugadu. Ire João Batista itoru kado kodire bire. Macare jewodure pugeje. Mare Herodes okware boeto. João Batista bire rugadu.

b: Marigudu nowu Herodes ure tugeragu tumana Filipe oredujeji tumana piji toredujece. Nou aredu iere Herodias. Herodes ure tugeragu ji tumana piji tumuguwo apo rugadu. Dukodire João Batista mako pegare Herodes rore aino duji. Mako raire ji. Akore arokaba aino amana oredujeji. Paro kigodukare aino. Amearutoru bokware dukodire amugure nowu aredu Herodias apo. Ainore João Batista akore. Herodias korigodure João Batista akoino duji dukodire Herodes makore to tugobaigaregei ewo João Batista kogudo tuwo tugu baicorewuto.
source: Marigudu nowu Herodes ure tugeragu tumana Filipe oredujeji tumana piji toredujece. Nou aredu iere Herodias. Herodes ure tugeragu ji tumana piji tumuguwo apo rugadu. Dukodire João Batista mako pegare Herodes rore aino duji. Mako raire ji. Akore arokaba aino amana oredujeji. Paro kigodukare aino. Amearutoru bokware dukodire amugure nowu aredu Herodias apo. Ainore João Batista akore. Herodias korigodure João Batista akoino duji dukodire Herodes makore to tugobaigaregei ewo João Batista kogudo tuwo tugu baicorewuto.

b: Herodias korigodu kimore João Batistaji dukodire aidure tuwo bito. Mare boe etaidure João Batistaji. João Batista ro pemega kuricigore boe eiamedu boe ji. Dukodire Herodes pagudure turo pegawo João Batistaji dukodire ukare João Batista bito. Herodes aidure tuwiapagawo João Batista bataru ji. Mare biapagare João Batista bataru ji dukeje biagorore rugadu.
source: Herodias korigodu kimore João Batistaji dukodire aidure tuwo bito. Mare boe etaidure João Batistaji. João Batista ro pemega kuricigore boe eiamedu boe ji. Dukodire Herodes pagudure turo pegawo João Batistaji dukodire ukare João Batista bito. Herodes aidure tuwiapagawo João Batista bataru ji. Mare biapagare João Batista bataru ji dukeje biagorore rugadu.

b: Ia meri keje Herodias joruduware nuba turomode tuwo João Batista bito. Herodes ure tuwadae towuje tuwiabutuwo tuwudure kejewu ari keje. Makore boe eimijerage eiamedu boe ewagai Galiléia moto keje. Etaregodure tuwaduwo apo nowu meri ji. Makore tugobaigarege eimijerage ewagai jamedu.
source: Ia meri keje Herodias joruduware nuba turomode tuwo João Batista bito. Herodes ure tuwadae towuje tuwiabutuwo tuwudure kejewu ari keje. Makore boe eimijerage eiamedu boe ewagai Galiléia moto keje. Etaregodure tuwaduwo apo nowu meri ji. Makore tugobaigarege eimijerage ewagai jamedu.

b: Ere bato pui dukeje Herodias onaregedu rerure nowu boe eiamedu boe egai. Ure Herodes jakaredo pudui. Ure nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egaredo pudui jamedu. Dukodire Herodes makore nowu nogwareduji. Akore amearutorudo i. Kaba jiba akaidure? Imode akogwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku akai rugadu.
source: Ere bato pui dukeje Herodias onaregedu rerure nowu boe eiamedu boe egai. Ure Herodes jakaredo pudui. Ure nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egaredo pudui jamedu. Dukodire Herodes makore nowu nogwareduji. Akore amearutorudo i. Kaba jiba akaidure? Imode akogwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku akai rugadu.

b: Nono Herodes mako pemegare ji pugeje. Akore imagore jiboe imodukare udo tugirimi. Imode maku. Imode akaidure jiboe maku akai rugadu. Akaidumode ia ino moto ji dukeje imode ino moto kado puiato. Imode maku akai rugadu.
source: Nono Herodes mako pemegare ji pugeje. Akore imagore jiboe imodukare udo tugirimi. Imode maku. Imode akaidure jiboe maku akai rugadu. Akaidumode ia ino moto ji dukeje imode ino moto kado puiato. Imode maku akai rugadu.

b: Nono nowu nogwaredu uture epiji tuje bagai. Makore tujeji. Akore kaboba bagaiba inogwamagudumode Herodiji? Uce makore tonaregeduji. Akore akogwamagududo João Batista aora bagai.
source: Nono nowu nogwaredu uture epiji tuje bagai. Makore tujeji. Akore kaboba bagaiba inogwamagudumode Herodiji? Uce makore tonaregeduji. Akore akogwamagududo João Batista aora bagai.

b: Dukodire nowu nogwaredu uture tuibagi tumara tabo Herodes ae. Akore itaidure João Batista aoraji. João Batista aora bu ia baku keje kuri aino rugadu awo aora maku inai.
source: Dukodire nowu nogwaredu uture tuibagi tumara tabo Herodes ae. Akore itaidure João Batista aoraji. João Batista aora bu ia baku keje kuri aino rugadu awo aora maku inai.

b: Herodes mearudure nowu inoduji dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Aidukare tuwo João Batista bito. Mare makore nowu boe egai tumoduie nowu nogwaredu okwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku ai rugadu. Nou makore bagaiboe makudumoduie ai rugadu. Dukodire Herodes aidukare tuwo tuwadaru pogurudo.
source: Herodes mearudure nowu inoduji dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Aidukare tuwo João Batista bito. Mare makore nowu boe egai tumoduie nowu nogwaredu okwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku ai rugadu. Nou makore bagaiboe makudumoduie ai rugadu. Dukodire Herodes aidukare tuwo tuwadaru pogurudo.

b: Dukodire makore ia tugobaigare bagai uwo João Batista bito, uwo aora kado piji, uwo João Batista aora reko pudae. Dukodire nowu tugobaigare uture João Batista bagai nowu baicorewu ka tuwo João Batista bito. Ure João Batista itoru kado kodire ure bito.
source: Dukodire makore ia tugobaigare bagai uwo João Batista bito, uwo aora kado piji, uwo João Batista aora reko pudae. Dukodire nowu tugobaigare uture João Batista bagai nowu baicorewu ka tuwo João Batista bito. Ure João Batista itoru kado kodire ure bito.

b: Dukejere tugobaigare aregodure João Batista aora tabo. Padure baku keje. Nono ca ure maku nowu nogwaredu ai. Dukeje care nowu nogwaredu ure reko toro tuje ae rugadu.
source: Dukejere tugobaigare aregodure João Batista aora tabo. Padure baku keje. Nono ca ure maku nowu nogwaredu ai. Dukeje care nowu nogwaredu ure reko toro tuje ae rugadu.

b: Nono ca João Batista utugarege emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaregodure tugimijera birewu bagai. Nono ca ere tugeragu birewuji. Ere reko toro to moto ka tuwo tugu toro to moto keje.
source: Nono ca João Batista utugarege emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaregodure tugimijera birewu bagai. Nono ca ere tugeragu birewuji. Ere reko toro to moto ka tuwo tugu toro to moto keje.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eke Maku Boe Etai. Ime Enodo Padure Cinco Mil
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eke Maku Boe Etai. Ime Enodo Padure Cinco Mil

b: Uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi Jesus ae pugeje. Enodo padure doze. Ereadodure turore jiboe ji, tumagore jiboe ji Jesus biagai.
source: Uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi Jesus ae pugeje. Enodo padure doze. Ereadodure turore jiboe ji, tumagore jiboe ji Jesus biagai.

b: Boe emagare nono. Etaregodure tumagowo Jesus ji. Iage eture mare iage etaregodure pugeje tumagowo Jesus ji jamedu. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare tuwo boe kowuje nowu boe doge eigoia. Nou ure joruduwadowuge enogwagekare jamedu. Dukodire Jesus makore ei. Akore Paduwo ia boe eda tuginaiwu ka awu boe epiji pawo pagamudo.
source: Boe emagare nono. Etaregodure tumagowo Jesus ji. Iage eture mare iage etaregodure pugeje tumagowo Jesus ji jamedu. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare tuwo boe kowuje nowu boe doge eigoia. Nou ure joruduwadowuge enogwagekare jamedu. Dukodire Jesus makore ei. Akore Paduwo ia boe eda tuginaiwu ka awu boe epiji pawo pagamudo.

b: Dukodire eture ika kurirewu tabo ia boe maerewu ka nowu boe epiji tuwo tamudo.
source: Dukodire eture ika kurirewu tabo ia boe maerewu ka nowu boe epiji tuwo tamudo.

b: Mare boe erudure ei rugadu. Dukodire eregodure ika kurirewu me keje taregoduwo nowu ika kurirewu otodai tubagawo ewagai toro. Nou boe emagare toro. Etaregodure boe eda jamedu boe piji.
source: Mare boe erudure ei rugadu. Dukodire eregodure ika kurirewu me keje taregoduwo nowu ika kurirewu otodai tubagawo ewagai toro. Nou boe emagare toro. Etaregodure boe eda jamedu boe piji.

b: Jesus aregodure nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Mare boe emagare nono marigudu. Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje jorudure nowu boe ji rugadu. Okudugodure ebo rugadu. Akore eie nono ovelha doge emogadure. Jetu pemegare eiwu bokwaie. Mare ovelha ji karega akoino. Nou boe eroiwakare tuwo tuginorudo. Dujire akoino. Dukodire mako raire ei tuwo eruduwado boe jamedu boe ji.
source: Jesus aregodure nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Mare boe emagare nono marigudu. Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje jorudure nowu boe ji rugadu. Okudugodure ebo rugadu. Akore eie nono ovelha doge emogadure. Jetu pemegare eiwu bokwaie. Mare ovelha ji karega akoino. Nou boe eroiwakare tuwo tuginorudo. Dujire akoino. Dukodire mako raire ei tuwo eruduwado boe jamedu boe ji.

b: Merirekodutabo Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure ae. Enodo padure doze. Emagore Jesus ji. egore Merirekodure. Awu boe etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Boe bokware woe du kodi.
source: Merirekodutabo Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure ae. Enodo padure doze. Emagore Jesus ji. egore Merirekodure. Awu boe etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Boe bokware woe du kodi.

b: Awu boe etudo ia boe etae ewo tugeragu ia tuge roguji.
source: Awu boe etudo ia boe etae ewo tugeragu ia tuge roguji.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boro. Taigoiare tamode enogwagedo. egore awu boe emagare. Boe maragodumode kejewu arimode oito dukeje o dieromode tuwo akirodo boe ekeji awu boe ekece. Mare pago diero bokware. Nuba paromode pawo enogwagedo?
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boro. Taigoiare tamode enogwagedo. egore awu boe emagare. Boe maragodumode kejewu arimode oito dukeje o dieromode tuwo akirodo boe ekeji awu boe ekece. Mare pago diero bokware. Nuba paromode pawo enogwagedo?

b: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore Page amirewu rogure? Tagaiwodo bagai. Dukodire Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaiwore amirewu bagai. Erudu iaji dukeje ere reko Jesus ae. egore akaiwodo. Cerudure jiwu amirewu ure ikera aboudure tu je. Page karorogu ere pobetu je.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore Page amirewu rogure? Tagaiwodo bagai. Dukodire Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaiwore amirewu bagai. Erudu iaji dukeje ere reko Jesus ae. egore akaiwodo. Cerudure jiwu amirewu ure ikera aboudure tu je. Page karorogu ere pobetu je.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tudo pui ewo tudo cinquenta ewo tudo cem tu tu tumuga boe keje.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tudo pui ewo tudo cinquenta ewo tudo cem tu tu tumuga boe keje.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eiamedu boe ere tudo pui. Ere tudo cinquenta ere tudo cem tu tu nowu tumuga boebutu keje.
source: Dukodire nowu boe eiamedu boe ere tudo pui. Ere tudo cinquenta ere tudo cem tu tu nowu tumuga boebutu keje.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji nowu kare kugurei. Nou amirewu ure ikera aboudure. Nou kare kugure ere pobetu je. Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Dukeje Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo jamedu. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado tuwo maku nowu ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo pedo nowu boe dogei jamedu. Nono Jesus ure nowu kare ekado jamedu nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewo pedo ei jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji nowu kare kugurei. Nou amirewu ure ikera aboudure. Nou kare kugure ere pobetu je. Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Dukeje Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo jamedu. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado tuwo maku nowu ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo pedo nowu boe dogei jamedu. Nono Jesus ure nowu kare ekado jamedu nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewo pedo ei jamedu.

b: Jesus koiare ure nowu boe doge eke kodudo tugori boe eiamedu boe etai. Boe eiamedu boe enogwagere rugadu. Ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu.
source: Jesus koiare ure nowu boe doge eke kodudo tugori boe eiamedu boe etai. Boe eiamedu boe enogwagere rugadu. Ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu.

b: Ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere nowu kadarabo doge korau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo doge enodo padure doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.
source: Ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere nowu kadarabo doge korau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo doge enodo padure doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.

b: Ime enodo padure cinco mil nono togwage tabo nowu meri ji.
source: Ime enodo padure cinco mil nono togwage tabo nowu meri ji.

b: Jesus Merure Pobo Aoji
source: Jesus Merure Pobo Aoji

b: Kuri je dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei ewo turemo ika kurirewuto etuwo tododai. Ekurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu kajeje toro bakowu ka toro Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Jesus rakojere eiageje tumago tabo nowu boe ji tuwo etudo.
source: Kuri je dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei ewo turemo ika kurirewuto etuwo tododai. Ekurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu kajeje toro bakowu ka toro Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Jesus rakojere eiageje tumago tabo nowu boe ji tuwo etudo.

b: Jesus uture nowu boe epiji dukeje Jesus ruture toro ia tori ao ka tuginaigodu tumagowo Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Jesus uture nowu boe epiji dukeje Jesus ruture toro ia tori ao ka tuginaigodu tumagowo Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Boecodure dukeje nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture tabowu ika kurirewu mugu kimore nowu pobo maerewu oiadada. Mare Jesus rakoje kimore toro nowu tori aogeje tuginaigodu.
source: Boecodure dukeje nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture tabowu ika kurirewu mugu kimore nowu pobo maerewu oiadada. Mare Jesus rakoje kimore toro nowu tori aogeje tuginaigodu.

b: Barogwakododukare raga dutabo Jesus jorudure ture joruduwadowugei toro pobo maerewu oiadada. Bakuru jore etogi. Boe korire nowu bakuruji rugadu dukodire ere tubeodo pudui traiga tabo nowu ikaji nowu bakuru togi. Toro baregodutabo, Jesus uture toro tumeru tabo pobo aoji. Ca ure tugoduiago toro etododai.
source: Barogwakododukare raga dutabo Jesus jorudure ture joruduwadowugei toro pobo maerewu oiadada. Bakuru jore etogi. Boe korire nowu bakuruji rugadu dukodire ere tubeodo pudui traiga tabo nowu ikaji nowu bakuru togi. Toro baregodutabo, Jesus uture toro tumeru tabo pobo aoji. Ca ure tugoduiago toro etododai.

b: Mare nowu ture joruduwadowuge erudure Jesus merure pobo aoji. Emearudaere ia boe pegarewu nuie ema. Dukodire epagudugodure. Nono etokudure tubagudu koia ce.
source: Mare nowu ture joruduwadowuge erudure Jesus merure pobo aoji. Emearudaere ia boe pegarewu nuie ema. Dukodire epagudugodure. Nono etokudure tubagudu koia ce.

b: Eiamedu boe epagudugodure rugadu. Ca Jesus makore ei. Akore taragado tai! Imi rugadu reo. Tabagudukaba.
source: Eiamedu boe epagudugodure rugadu. Ca Jesus makore ei. Akore taragado tai! Imi rugadu reo. Tabagudukaba.

b: Nono ure turemo ika kurirewuto ebo. Ca nowu bakuru rakarewu akedure taci je. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erore ta je.
source: Nono ure turemo ika kurirewuto ebo. Ca nowu bakuru rakarewu akedure taci je. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erore ta je.

b: Jesus ure boe enogwagedo jawu meri ji. Boe ekuredure rugadu dukodire egarere pudui. Mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo ji dukodire eruduwakare Jesus rore jiboe ji. Pao Kurirewu maragodae reno. Ca Jesus merure pobo aoji, ure bakuru rakarewu akedudo jamedu mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo ji raga dukodire eruduwakare nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji pugeje. Pao Kurirewu maragodae reno pugeje.
source: Jesus ure boe enogwagedo jawu meri ji. Boe ekuredure rugadu dukodire egarere pudui. Mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo ji dukodire eruduwakare Jesus rore jiboe ji. Pao Kurirewu maragodae reno. Ca Jesus merure pobo aoji, ure bakuru rakarewu akedudo jamedu mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo ji raga dukodire eruduwakare nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji pugeje. Pao Kurirewu maragodae reno pugeje.

b: Jesus Iogore Boei Genesaré Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Jesus Iogore Boei Genesaré Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: Ekurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje etaregodure Genesaré moto ka. Nonore ere to ika kurirewu bu. Ere kogudo.
source: Ekurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje etaregodure Genesaré moto ka. Nonore ere to ika kurirewu bu. Ere kogudo.

b: Ere tudawuje to ika kurirewu piji dukeje boe erudure Jesus ji. Eruduware Jesus ure ema duji.
source: Ere tudawuje to ika kurirewu piji dukeje boe erudure Jesus ji. Eruduware Jesus ure ema duji.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eregodure nowu boe eda jamedu boe ji tuwo nowu boe ewie Jesus aregodure duji. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe etaregodure tuwobe kogodurewugebo Jesus ae. Nou kogodurewuge epadure tugudau kodo keje.
source: Dukodire nowu boe eregodure nowu boe eda jamedu boe ji tuwo nowu boe ewie Jesus aregodure duji. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe etaregodure tuwobe kogodurewugebo Jesus ae. Nou kogodurewuge epadure tugudau kodo keje.

b: Jesus uture nowu boe eiamedu boe eda ka. Uture boe eda ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje. Uture ba kurirewu ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo nono jamedu. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje jamedu. Nono nowu ure tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa kejewuge eiamedu boe epemegagodure rugadu.
source: Jesus uture nowu boe eiamedu boe eda ka. Uture boe eda ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje. Uture ba kurirewu ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo nono jamedu. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje jamedu. Nono nowu ure tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa kejewuge eiamedu boe epemegagodure rugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Nou Judeu Doge Eroiaji
source: Jesus Makore Nou Judeu Doge Eroiaji

b: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae jamedu. Ere bato pui Jesus ae.
source: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae jamedu. Ere bato pui Jesus ae.

b: Eruduware Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enogwagere tugera tabo duji. Nou fariseu doge etaidure boe ewo tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge tuwobe ero mogadure. Judeu doge erore tu tu aino togwagewo. Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erokare nono ero mogadure.
source: Eruduware Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enogwagere tugera tabo duji. Nou fariseu doge etaidure boe ewo tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge tuwobe ero mogadure. Judeu doge erore tu tu aino togwagewo. Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erokare nono ero mogadure.

b: Marigudu fariseu doge, Judeu doge eiamedu boe erore nowu mariguduwuge tugimijerage ere maku pudaiwu bakaru tadawu ero boe ji tu tu je. Dukodire marigudu ere tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure togwagewo tu tu je. Ainore erore jii aino.
source: Marigudu fariseu doge, Judeu doge eiamedu boe erore nowu mariguduwuge tugimijerage ere maku pudaiwu bakaru tadawu ero boe ji tu tu je. Dukodire marigudu ere tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure togwagewo tu tu je. Ainore erore jii aino.

b: Emode akirodo tugeji nowu boe jeto tadawu bai piji dukeje emode kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure jamedu tu tu je. Mariguduwuge Judeu doge eno bakaru kurire dukodire erore jiboe makare rugadu. Kodire ere turuwobo kabi tu tu je. Ere tudaria kabi tu tu je. Ere tubagaga kabi tu tu je. Ere tubadure kejewu kamorewu kabi tu tu je jamedu. Emodukare tugera ra turore aino dupiji rugadu. Turoia jire eroino tu tu je tuwo nowu jamedu boe pemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu turo boe ji tu tu je.
source: Emode akirodo tugeji nowu boe jeto tadawu bai piji dukeje emode kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure jamedu tu tu je. Mariguduwuge Judeu doge eno bakaru kurire dukodire erore jiboe makare rugadu. Kodire ere turuwobo kabi tu tu je. Ere tudaria kabi tu tu je. Ere tubagaga kabi tu tu je. Ere tubadure kejewu kamorewu kabi tu tu je jamedu. Emodukare tugera ra turore aino dupiji rugadu. Turoia jire eroino tu tu je tuwo nowu jamedu boe pemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu turo boe ji tu tu je.

b: Dukodire nowu fariseu doge, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidukare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekare tugera kabi duji. Enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba nowu are joruduwadowuge emearutorukare mariguduwuge pawobe emagore jiboe ji? Erokare nono nowu mariguduwuge pawobe ero mogadure. Enogwagere mare ekare tugera kabi nono nowu mariguduwu paro mogadure. Ukare turugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu fariseu doge, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidukare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekare tugera kabi duji. Enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba nowu are joruduwadowuge emearutorukare mariguduwuge pawobe emagore jiboe ji? Erokare nono nowu mariguduwuge pawobe ero mogadure. Enogwagere mare ekare tugera kabi nono nowu mariguduwu paro mogadure. Ukare turugadu.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore tare boe eruduwado mare tamearutorukare tawadaru ji. Boe jokodu jire Isaías akoino marigudu. Marigudu rugadu ure pawobe ewie taromode tamearudaemode jiboe ji. Marigudu Isaías akore Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie rugadu. Akore Awu boe emagore togwa tabo tumearutoruie i mare emearudae remawu ure tuginai rugadu toro imearudae piji rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore tare boe eruduwado mare tamearutorukare tawadaru ji. Boe jokodu jire Isaías akoino marigudu. Marigudu rugadu ure pawobe ewie taromode tamearudaemode jiboe ji. Marigudu Isaías akore Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie rugadu. Akore Awu boe emagore togwa tabo tumearutoruie i mare emearudae remawu ure tuginai rugadu toro imearudae piji rugadu.

b: – “Awu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i mare pagare egoino. Ere boe eruduwado bakaruji. Egore iwadaruie. Mare pagare egoino. Ia tumagore jiwu bakaru jire nowu boe egoino.”
source: – “Awu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i mare pagare egoino. Ere boe eruduwado bakaruji. Egore iwadaruie. Mare pagare egoino. Ia tumagore jiwu bakaru jire nowu boe egoino.”

b: Jesus makore nowu fariseu dogei pugeje. Akore taro kodure nowu imedu Isaías ure boe ewie jiboe ji rugadu. Tare tagera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji tamearutoruwo tu tamearudae ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru ji karega tagagoino.
source: Jesus makore nowu fariseu dogei pugeje. Akore taro kodure nowu imedu Isaías ure boe ewie jiboe ji rugadu. Tare tagera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji tamearutoruwo tu tamearudae ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru ji karega tagagoino.

b: – Jerorewugenure tagi. Tamago moture tawo boe emearutorudo tawadaru ji ekoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji emearutorukawo Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji.
source: – Jerorewugenure tagi. Tamago moture tawo boe emearutorudo tawadaru ji ekoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji emearutorukawo Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji.

b: Marigudu Moisés ure pawobe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji. Akore Tamearutorudo taoji tajeji. Ca nowu boe mako pegamode tuoji tujeji tuwo epogurudo dukeje bitoduiago.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore jawu tawobei.
source: Marigudu Moisés ure pawobe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji. Akore Tamearutorudo taoji tajeji. Ca nowu boe mako pegamode tuoji tujeji tuwo epogurudo dukeje bitoduiago.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore jawu tawobei.

b: Mare tagi tare boe eruduwado ia bataru tuginaiwuji boe ekawo tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Tagagore imedu makomoduie tujeji tuoji tumodukaie tugera maku etai tumoduie toe maku Pao Kurirewu ai kodi. Dukodire tumodukaie tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Ainore boe eromoduie.
source: Mare tagi tare boe eruduwado ia bataru tuginaiwuji boe ekawo tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Tagagore imedu makomoduie tujeji tuoji tumodukaie tugera maku etai tumoduie toe maku Pao Kurirewu ai kodi. Dukodire tumodukaie tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Ainore boe eromoduie.

b: Mare pagare egoino. Etaidukare tuwo tugera maku tuje ai tuo ai dukodire egoino.
source: Mare pagare egoino. Etaidukare tuwo tugera maku tuje ai tuo ai dukodire egoino.

b: Taigoiare tare boe egodo aino. Dukodire care tagaidukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Tamearutorukare ji. Tagaidure tagoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji. Ainore tarore ia taroji jamedu. Tare taro udo tuginai Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu piji rugadu.
source: Taigoiare tare boe egodo aino. Dukodire care tagaidukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Tamearutorukare ji. Tagaidure tagoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji. Ainore tarore ia taroji jamedu. Tare taro udo tuginai Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu piji rugadu.

b: Ainore Boe Emode Tubegado
source: Ainore Boe Emode Tubegado

b: Nono Jesus makore boe makarewuge etae ewo bato pui pudae. Makore nowu boe ji. Akore taiamedu boe tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Iwo taruduwa kuricigodo iwadaru ji.
source: Nono Jesus makore boe makarewuge etae ewo bato pui pudae. Makore nowu boe ji. Akore taiamedu boe tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Iwo taruduwa kuricigodo iwadaru ji.

b: Nou tagwagemode jiboe umodukare tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumodukare tago bakaru tadawu taro piji. Mare nowu taiabijiwu tawadaru pegarewu umode tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumode tago bakaru tadawu taro piji jii je.
source: Nou tagwagemode jiboe umodukare tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumodukare tago bakaru tadawu taro piji. Mare nowu taiabijiwu tawadaru pegarewu umode tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumode tago bakaru tadawu taro piji jii je.

b: Dukeje Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji uwo tuioruduwado kaba jiba akoino nowu boe ji.
source: Dukeje Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji uwo tuioruduwado kaba jiba akoino nowu boe ji.

b: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduwa bokware nono nowu boe emogadure. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Tamodukare tabegado tage tabo rugadu.
source: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduwa bokware nono nowu boe emogadure. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Tamodukare tabegado tage tabo rugadu.

b: Tamode tage ko dukeje taguredumode. Nono umode tudawuje tabiji. Mare tabemega kimomode tarowo boe eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Tage umodukare tamearudae pegado boe ji. Tagoino dutabo Jesus ure nowu Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu ia ero akedudo. Nou bakaru akore ekaiago ia tuge kowuje tuwo tubemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Aino care Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo. Boe eke jamedu boe uie turugadu.
source: Tamode tage ko dukeje taguredumode. Nono umode tudawuje tabiji. Mare tabemega kimomode tarowo boe eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Tage umodukare tamearudae pegado boe ji. Tagoino dutabo Jesus ure nowu Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu ia ero akedudo. Nou bakaru akore ekaiago ia tuge kowuje tuwo tubemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Aino care Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo. Boe eke jamedu boe uie turugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore boe ero pegarewu umode tudawuje boe emearudae piji. Nou inodu koiare umode boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore boe ero pegarewu umode tudawuje boe emearudae piji. Nou inodu koiare umode boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.

b: Du nowu boe emearudae pegarewu aregodumode epiji rugadu. Emode nowu tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo rugadu. Ero pegamode tieribari tabo. Ekiwogumode. Emode boe ewido.
source: Du nowu boe emearudae pegarewu aregodumode epiji rugadu. Emode nowu tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo rugadu. Ero pegamode tieribari tabo. Ekiwogumode. Emode boe ewido.

b: Eribarimode toreduje piji toredu piji. Enogwa kidumode tu pudai tuwo toe kurido tumedage epiji. Emode turo pegarewu kurido rugadu. Boe emode boe ekiripagado. Boe etaora bai baimode tuge kurure pudui dutabo. Boe ekorigodumode boe enoe keje. Boe emago pegamode tumedage eroji. Boe enojaromode tuwadaru ji. Boe eruduwa bokwamode turore jiboe ji.
source: Eribarimode toreduje piji toredu piji. Enogwa kidumode tu pudai tuwo toe kurido tumedage epiji. Emode turo pegarewu kurido rugadu. Boe emode boe ekiripagado. Boe etaora bai baimode tuge kurure pudui dutabo. Boe ekorigodumode boe enoe keje. Boe emago pegamode tumedage eroji. Boe enojaromode tuwadaru ji. Boe eruduwa bokwamode turore jiboe ji.

b: Boe emode tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turowo awu boe ero pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Awu boe ero pegarewu koiare umode boe epegado rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.
source: Boe emode tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turowo awu boe ero pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Awu boe ero pegarewu koiare umode boe epegado rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.

b: Aredu Tuginaiwudo
source: Aredu Tuginaiwudo

b: Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Uture toro ia moto ka. Puredure Tiro ba kurirewuji. Nono ure turemo ia boe ewaito. Aidure tuwo tamudo. Aidukare boe eruduwawo turagojere nono duji mare boe erudure ure turemo nowu bai toduji.
source: Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Uture toro ia moto ka. Puredure Tiro ba kurirewuji. Nono ure turemo ia boe ewaito. Aidure tuwo tamudo. Aidukare boe eruduwawo turagojere nono duji mare boe erudure ure turemo nowu bai toduji.

b: Ia aredu joruduware Jesus rakojere nono duji. Bope uwari meture nowu aredu onaregedu tada. Dukodire uce aregodure Jesus ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.
source: Ia aredu joruduware Jesus rakojere nono duji. Bope uwari meture nowu aredu onaregedu tada. Dukodire uce aregodure Jesus ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.

b: Nou aredu Judeu kejewu aredu karegure ema. Boture Fenícia moto keje puredure Síria moto ji. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo nowu bope uwari tawuje tonaregedu aredu piji.
source: Nou aredu Judeu kejewu aredu karegure ema. Boture Fenícia moto keje puredure Síria moto ji. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo nowu bope uwari tawuje tonaregedu aredu piji.

b: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boe etore enogwagewo jii tuguredu ka. Ukare turugadu boe ewo tore ekerogu tawuje epiji tuwo maku tagu ariga doge etai.
source: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boe etore enogwagewo jii tuguredu ka. Ukare turugadu boe ewo tore ekerogu tawuje epiji tuwo maku tagu ariga doge etai.

b: Nou aredu joruduware boe etore ji karega Jesus akoino duji. Joruduware Judeu dogeire Jesus akoino duji. Jesus aregodure moto ka tumagowo Judeu dogei rugadu. Nono nowu aredu makore Jesus bataru jipagi. Akore boe rugadu. Mare ariga doge epuredumode boe etorei tuwo nowu buture ira kudawu boe etore eke gigudu rugadu boe kowuje.
source: Nou aredu joruduware boe etore ji karega Jesus akoino duji. Joruduware Judeu dogeire Jesus akoino duji. Jesus aregodure moto ka tumagowo Judeu dogei rugadu. Nono nowu aredu makore Jesus bataru jipagi. Akore boe rugadu. Mare ariga doge epuredumode boe etorei tuwo nowu buture ira kudawu boe etore eke gigudu rugadu boe kowuje.

b: Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Atudo aibagi awai ka akanaregedu aredu bagai. Ire nowu bope uwari tawuje piji dukodire akanaregedu pemegagodure rugadu. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji.
source: Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Atudo aibagi awai ka akanaregedu aredu bagai. Ire nowu bope uwari tawuje piji dukodire akanaregedu pemegagodure rugadu. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji.

b: Dukodire nowu aredu ure tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka tuioruduwo tonaregeduji. Aregodure tuwai ka dukeje jorudure tonaregedu padure kamorewu keje duji. Pemegagodure. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji rugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu aredu ure tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka tuioruduwo tonaregeduji. Aregodure tuwai ka dukeje jorudure tonaregedu padure kamorewu keje duji. Pemegagodure. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Bija Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago
source: Jesus Ure Bija Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago

b: Nono Jesus uture nowu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge epiji. Uture Sidom ba kurirewu ka. Dukeje merure boe eda kejewu moto ji. Boe eda enodo padure dez nono nowu moto keje. Nono aregodure nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka.
source: Nono Jesus uture nowu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge epiji. Uture Sidom ba kurirewu ka. Dukeje merure boe eda kejewu moto ji. Boe eda enodo padure dez nono nowu moto keje. Nono aregodure nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka.

b: Nonore ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia bija bokwarewu imedu apo. Roiwakare tumagowo jamedu. Nono nowu boe enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu nowu imedu keje pemegagoduwo.
source: Nonore ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia bija bokwarewu imedu apo. Roiwakare tumagowo jamedu. Nono nowu boe enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu nowu imedu keje pemegagoduwo.

b: Dukodire Jesus ure taradaino boe epiji nowu imedu apo. Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje pudogi. Dukejere ure todoguru bu tugerako keje. Nono ure raido nowu imedu eru ka.
source: Dukodire Jesus ure taradaino boe epiji nowu imedu apo. Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje pudogi. Dukejere ure todoguru bu tugerako keje. Nono ure raido nowu imedu eru ka.

b: Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Ure ake tawuje tubiji. Dukejere makore Judeu doge ewadaru tabo. Akore efatá. (Boe ewadaru tabore boe egore: “Uwo tuiado” aino.)
source: Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Ure ake tawuje tubiji. Dukejere makore Judeu doge ewadaru tabo. Akore efatá. (Boe ewadaru tabore boe egore: “Uwo tuiado” aino.)

b: Ca nowu imedu bija pemegagodure pugeje taci je. Mearudure boe emagoji rugadu. Makore jamedu. Mako pemegare.
source: Ca nowu imedu bija pemegagodure pugeje taci je. Mearudure boe emagoji rugadu. Makore jamedu. Mako pemegare.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ekawo boe ewie nowu turore jiboe ji. Makore ei mare emearutorukare. Ere boe ewie rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ekawo boe ewie nowu turore jiboe ji. Makore ei mare emearutorukare. Ere boe ewie rugadu.

b: Biapagare nowu Jesus ro jiwuge eiamedu boe erore ta je. egore awu Jesus ro pemegare rugadu! Rakare rugadu kodire umode bija bokwarewuge ewija epemegago emearuduwo boe ji eruduwawo boe emagore pudui duji. Rakare tuwo mako bokwarewuge emagodo pugeje.
source: Biapagare nowu Jesus ro jiwuge eiamedu boe erore ta je. egore awu Jesus ro pemegare rugadu! Rakare rugadu kodire umode bija bokwarewuge ewija epemegago emearuduwo boe ji eruduwawo boe emagore pudui duji. Rakare tuwo mako bokwarewuge emagodo pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ia Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo Jamedu
source: Jesus Ure Ia Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo Jamedu

b: Ia meri keje boe ere bato pui pugeje tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji. Emagare rugadu. Enodo padure quatro mil. Care eke akedure dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Nono ca makore ei.
source: Ia meri keje boe ere bato pui pugeje tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji. Emagare rugadu. Enodo padure quatro mil. Care eke akedure dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Nono ca makore ei.

b: Akore inogudugodure awu boebo. Merire pobe metia bokware ei woe itabo. Woe boe eke bokware rugadu ewo ko.
source: Akore inogudugodure awu boebo. Merire pobe metia bokware ei woe itabo. Woe boe eke bokware rugadu ewo ko.

b: Itaidukare iwo etudo tuguri bioro tabo mare eragamodukare tumeruwo awara ji pugeje. Iage etaregodu jaere woe itae.
source: Itaidukare iwo etudo tuguri bioro tabo mare eragamodukare tumeruwo awara ji pugeje. Iage etaregodu jaere woe itae.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nou boe emagare rugadu woe pagabo. Nuba ceromode woe boe maerewuto boe eke bagai nowu boe ekeje?
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nou boe emagare rugadu woe pagabo. Nuba ceromode woe boe maerewuto boe eke bagai nowu boe ekeje?

b: Jesus akore Nuba tage amirewu rogure tu je? egore amirewu oto padure sete.
source: Jesus akore Nuba tage amirewu rogure tu je? egore amirewu oto padure sete.

b: Nono Jesus makore boe eiamedu boe ji ewo tumugudo moto keje. Dukejere ure tugeragu nowu amirewuji. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Dukejere ure nowu amirewu kado. Ure maku ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo reko boe etae. Dukodire ere pedo boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore boe eiamedu boe ji ewo tumugudo moto keje. Dukejere ure tugeragu nowu amirewuji. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Dukejere ure nowu amirewu kado. Ure maku ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo reko boe etae. Dukodire ere pedo boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu.

b: Ia kare kugurere nono jamedu. Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo. Dukejere makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo nowu kare kugure pedo boe eiamedu boe ji jamedu.
source: Ia kare kugurere nono jamedu. Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo. Dukejere makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo nowu kare kugure pedo boe eiamedu boe ji jamedu.

b: Nono ca nowu boe eiamedu boe enogwagere. Egarere pudui rugadu tuguredure duji. Emagare. Enodo padure quatro mil. Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere kadarabo korobadurewugedo sete nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje.
source: Nono ca nowu boe eiamedu boe enogwagere. Egarere pudui rugadu tuguredure duji. Emagare. Enodo padure quatro mil. Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere kadarabo korobadurewugedo sete nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje.

b: Dukejere Jesus ure taredo ika kurirewuto ture joruduwadowugebo. Eture toro Dalmanuta moto ka.
source: Dukejere Jesus ure taredo ika kurirewuto ture joruduwadowugebo. Eture toro Dalmanuta moto ka.

b: Fariseu Doge Etaidure Tuioruduwo Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewuji
source: Fariseu Doge Etaidure Tuioruduwo Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewuji

b: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jesus ae. Ere tunarado ji tumago rakarewu tabo tuioruduwo joruduwamode rugadu dubagai. Dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo ro rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.
source: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jesus ae. Ere tunarado ji tumago rakarewu tabo tuioruduwo joruduwamode rugadu dubagai. Dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo ro rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.

b: Mare Jesus joruduware nowu boe emearutorukare pudui duji dukodire ure ake ta tubiji tugiarigodure dukodi. Nono akore Kocare awu boe etaidure tu iro rakawo tuioruduwawo i rugadu. Boro! Iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji rugadu! Pagare egoino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo i rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus joruduware nowu boe emearutorukare pudui duji dukodire ure ake ta tubiji tugiarigodure dukodi. Nono akore Kocare awu boe etaidure tu iro rakawo tuioruduwawo i rugadu. Boro! Iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji rugadu! Pagare egoino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo i rugadu.

b: Dukodire uture epiji. Ure taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje tugurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka.
source: Dukodire uture epiji. Ure taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje tugurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka.

b: Fariseu Doge Ero Pegarewu Reo
source: Fariseu Doge Ero Pegarewu Reo

b: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewiagodure tuwo tugeragu ia tuge amirewu ji pugeje. Dukodire eke akedugodure. Eke amirewure mitotu je nowu ika kurirewu tada.
source: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewiagodure tuwo tugeragu ia tuge amirewu ji pugeje. Dukodire eke akedugodure. Eke amirewure mitotu je nowu ika kurirewu tada.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore tawiapagado tawo tado tarugadu. Fariseu doge emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Herodes mearudae ure nono fermento mogadure jamedu. Tamearudaekaba nono nowu emearudae mogadure.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore tawiapagado tawo tado tarugadu. Fariseu doge emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Herodes mearudae ure nono fermento mogadure jamedu. Tamearudaekaba nono nowu emearudae mogadure.
