b: Mare Jesus joruduware nowu Simão makore tudada jiboe ji. Dukodire makore Simãoji. Akore ioruduware awu areduji, umode tumagu paga paga ime etaiwudonure ema rodo rugadu. Ca ireadodumode iaboe ji tawiagai. Simão akore areadodudo.
source: Mare Jesus joruduware nowu Simão makore tudada jiboe ji. Dukodire makore Simãoji. Akore ioruduware awu areduji, umode tumagu paga paga ime etaiwudonure ema rodo rugadu. Ca ireadodumode iaboe ji tawiagai. Simão akore areadodudo.

b: Jesus akore Imedu ure diero maku aiwuge imere pobe. Ia ai ure oto bu 500. Nou metia ai ure oto bu 50.
source: Jesus akore Imedu ure diero maku aiwuge imere pobe. Ia ai ure oto bu 500. Nou metia ai ure oto bu 50.

b: Boe aregodure nowu meri ka ewo nowu diero maku tuibagi nowu imedu ai. Mare ere nowu diero rugadu akedudo kodire eroiwakare tuwo morido tuibagi. Dukodire nowu imedu makore ei ekawo morido pudai enoe bokware kodi. Kaibowu imedu ba mearudu kurimode nowu imeduji rugadu?
source: Boe aregodure nowu meri ka ewo nowu diero maku tuibagi nowu imedu ai. Mare ere nowu diero rugadu akedudo kodire eroiwakare tuwo morido tuibagi. Dukodire nowu imedu makore ei ekawo morido pudai enoe bokware kodi. Kaibowu imedu ba mearudu kurimode nowu imeduji rugadu?

b: Simão akore Ure diero oto bu 500 aiwu imedure mearudu kurimode rugadu nowu ure diero maku pudaiwu imeduji rugadu ukare udo morido pudai kodi. Jakaremode pudui akore aino pudui duji. Okwa imadumode apo rugadu ukare udo morido pudai kodi. Nono Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Ca ire iremo awaito mare akimadukare itabo. Akare pobo maku inai iwo iwure kabi akimaduwo itabo nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Mare awudorema ure iwure kabi tuioguru tabo, ure iwure kidudo tao tabo.

b: Aki akare akogwa to ie koduto akimaduwo itabo nono Judeu doge ero mogadure mare awudorema ukare tugera ra ture togwa to iwureto dupiji.
source: Aki akare akogwa to ie koduto akimaduwo itabo nono Judeu doge ero mogadure mare awudorema ukare tugera ra ture togwa to iwureto dupiji.

b: Akare boekaguru tugu itaoto nono Judeu doge erore tugimaduwo boebo dumogadure, mare awudorema ure roreboe reko iwure joki.
source: Akare boekaguru tugu itaoto nono Judeu doge erore tugimaduwo boebo dumogadure, mare awudorema ure roreboe reko iwure joki.

b: Awu aredu rore aino i dukodire ioruduware mearudu kurire i rugadu duji. Pao Kurirewu biagodure awu aredu ro pegare jiboe piji tuwo awu aredu ro pegarewu boe pijido ukawo morido pugeje dukodire mearudu kuricigore aino i. Mare tagi tamearudaere taro pegarewu bokwaie kodire Pao Kurirewu ukare taro pegarewu pijido. Dukodire tamearudu kurikare aino i rugadu.
source: Awu aredu rore aino i dukodire ioruduware mearudu kurire i rugadu duji. Pao Kurirewu biagodure awu aredu ro pegare jiboe piji tuwo awu aredu ro pegarewu boe pijido ukawo morido pugeje dukodire mearudu kuricigore aino i. Mare tagi tamearudaere taro pegarewu bokwaie kodire Pao Kurirewu ukare taro pegarewu pijido. Dukodire tamearudu kurikare aino i rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu areduji. Akore aro pegarewu jamedu boe iwiagodure piji marigudu.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu areduji. Akore aro pegarewu jamedu boe iwiagodure piji marigudu.

b: Dukodire care nowu Simão, nowu mugure nono apowuge, erudu pegare Jesus akoino duji. egore ukare turugadu. Awu Jesus umodukare boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji. Tu Pao Kurirewu romode aino tu rugadu. Emearutorukare Jesus ji dukodire egoino.
source: Dukodire care nowu Simão, nowu mugure nono apowuge, erudu pegare Jesus akoino duji. egore ukare turugadu. Awu Jesus umodukare boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji. Tu Pao Kurirewu romode aino tu rugadu. Emearutorukare Jesus ji dukodire egoino.

b: Jesus makore nowu areduji pugeje. Akore amearutorure i dukodire akinorudodure aro pegarewu jamedu boe piji dukodire awarigudumodukare toro bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Akirimi aibagi awai ka. Amororamagadukaba. Boe pegarewu puredumodukare ai.
source: Jesus makore nowu areduji pugeje. Akore amearutorure i dukodire akinorudodure aro pegarewu jamedu boe piji dukodire awarigudumodukare toro bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Akirimi aibagi awai ka. Amororamagadukaba. Boe pegarewu puredumodukare ai.

b: Areme Ekodure Jesus Apo
source: Areme Ekodure Jesus Apo

b: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowu imebo boe eda jamedu boe ka tuwo boe ewie tuwadaru pemegarewuji, tumagowo Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Makore boe ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijerado pudumi kuri je. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze.
source: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowu imebo boe eda jamedu boe ka tuwo boe ewie tuwadaru pemegarewuji, tumagowo Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Makore boe ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijerado pudumi kuri je. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze.

b: Ia areme ekodure Jesus apo jamedu. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Joana. Nou iarodo iere Susana. Marigudu bope doge emedure nowu Maria Madalena tada. Nou bope doge enodo padure sete. Mare Jesus ure nowu bope doge etawuje nowu Maria Madalena piji dukodire nowu Maria Madalena kodure apo. Nou Joana oredu iere Cuza. Nou Cuza maragodure boe eimijera Herodes ai. Ia areme ekodure Jesus apo jamedu. Jesus ure bope doge etawuje iage epiji. Ure iage epemegago tugogodae piji. Dukodire nowu areme ere tugera maku etai nowu toe makudu tabo Jesus ai, nowu utugarege etai jamedu.

b: Boepa Tadaboe Jiwu Bakaru Reo
source: Boepa Tadaboe Jiwu Bakaru Reo

b: Boe emagare taregodu tabo Jesus ae. Etaregodure tieda jamedu boe piji tuwo bato pui Jesus ae tumearuduwo Jesus makore jiboe ji. Dukeje Jesus readodure ewiagai ia bakaruji tuwo jebato toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ka.
source: Boe emagare taregodu tabo Jesus ae. Etaregodure tieda jamedu boe piji tuwo bato pui Jesus ae tumearuduwo Jesus makore jiboe ji. Dukeje Jesus readodure ewiagai ia bakaruji tuwo jebato toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ka.

b: Akore ia imedu ure tudawuje tuwo boe a roto ja ja moto joki to boepa tada. Ia a buture awara okwaji. Boe ewure jore nowu buture awara okwa jiwu a keje, kiebarege ere nowu boe a rugadu kowuje.
source: Akore ia imedu ure tudawuje tuwo boe a roto ja ja moto joki to boepa tada. Ia a buture awara okwaji. Boe ewure jore nowu buture awara okwa jiwu a keje, kiebarege ere nowu boe a rugadu kowuje.

b: Ia a buture toriguru tada. Boture mare kidure, tori uru koia, moto pegare ji kodi.
source: Ia a buture toriguru tada. Boture mare kidure, tori uru koia, moto pegare ji kodi.

b: Ia a buture botoguru tada. Botoguru boture tabo jamedu mare botoguru ure bito.
source: Ia a buture botoguru tada. Botoguru boture tabo jamedu mare botoguru ure bito.

b: Mare ia a buture moto pemegarewu keje. Ere tuguwu sacu ure mitotu je. Botu pemegare, ricodu pemegare, enari kurire rugadu. Kidure dukeje ere rawuje ciwu piji. Ere a rawuje tuwo tugu sacuto. Nou sacu oto padure kejeboere cem nowu boe a tabo. Nono Jesus okituware nowu boe ji. Akore tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji taruduwawo kaba jiba inagoino tai.
source: Mare ia a buture moto pemegarewu keje. Ere tuguwu sacu ure mitotu je. Botu pemegare, ricodu pemegare, enari kurire rugadu. Kidure dukeje ere rawuje ciwu piji. Ere a rawuje tuwo tugu sacuto. b: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eruduwado Tumagore Jiboe ji
source: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eruduwado Tumagore Jiboe ji

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare ji: – Kaba awadaru jiba akaidure ceruduwawo akagoino cei duji?
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare ji: – Kaba awadaru jiba akaidure ceruduwawo akagoino cei duji?

b: Jesus akore Ire boe eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu nowu bakaru tabo. Mare paga karega. Ireadodure aino Pao Kurirewu uwo taruduwado meture pudabowu tumearudae boe ji, boe ewo tugimijerado tu ema, taruduwawo nuba Pao Kurirewu romode tudugaregei. Mare ireadodure bakaruji kodire ia boe eruduwamode awu bakaruji mare emodukare boe pa nowu bakaruji. Ewiapagamode ji mare eruduwamodukare nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji.
source: Jesus akore Ire boe eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu nowu bakaru tabo. Mare paga karega. Mare ireadodure bakaruji kodire ia boe eruduwamode awu bakaruji mare emodukare boe pa nowu bakaruji. Ewiapagamode ji mare eruduwamodukare nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji.

b: – Ainore awu bakaru ure. Boe eire inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru ure nono nowu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru aregodumode boe etae. Nono boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ia imedu ure Jesus bie. Akore ikimijera. Ace, awiemage etaregodure awagai. Etaidure tumagowo ai.

b: Jesus Ure Bakuru Pegarewu Akedudo
source: Jesus Ure Bakuru Pegarewu Akedudo

b: Ia meri keje Jesus ure turemo ture joruduwadowugebo ia ika kurirewuto. Makore ei: – Pagurugoduwo awu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka.
source: Ia meri keje Jesus ure turemo ture joruduwadowugebo ia ika kurirewuto. Makore ei: – Pagurugoduwo awu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka.

b: Nono eture. Ekurugodure dutabo Jesus unudure. Macare ia bakuru pegarewu aregodure etae taci je. Nou bakuru ure nowu pobo maerewu rutudo. Kodire pobo jeture nowu ika kurirewuji. Dukejere nowu pobore turemo nowu ika kurirewuto rugadu. Boe pegare nowu ika kurirewu tadawu boe dogei rugadu.
source: Nono eture. Ekurugodure dutabo Jesus unudure. Macare ia bakuru pegarewu aregodure etae taci je. Nou bakuru ure nowu pobo maerewu rutudo. Kodire pobo jeture nowu ika kurirewuji. Dukejere nowu pobore turemo nowu ika kurirewuto rugadu. Boe pegare nowu ika kurirewu tadawu boe dogei rugadu.

b: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge epagudugodure rugadu dukodire ere Jesus jetadudo. egore cegimijera! Pawimode poboto! Nono Jesus ure turagojedo. Nono makore nowu bakuruji nowu poboji dukodire nowu bakuru akedure, nowu pobo butugugodure jamedu.

b: Jesus Ure Bope Doge Etawuje Imedu Piji

b: Ekurugodure Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka. Nou etaregodure kawu moto iere Gerasa.
source: Ekurugodure Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka. Nou etaregodure kawu moto iere Gerasa.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje ika piji dukeje bope doge emedu tadawu imedu uture Jesus togi. Marigudu nowu bope doge emedure nowu imedu tada dukodire boe ere kogudo ia meriri iku tabo boe etuwo ji rekodukawo. Mare nowu bope doge ere nowu imedu rakado rugadu dukodire nowu imedu ure nowu meriri iku kado tu tu je. Nono nowu bope doge ere nowu imedu utudo boe epiji. Dukodire merure tuwiri kedo tabo, rekodure tuwai piji jamedu. Mugure boe ere birewuge etugu tadawu tori poro ja tada boe maerewu keje. Nono Jesus makore nowu meture nowu imedu tadawu bope dogei. Akore tadawuje nowu imedu piji! Nou imedu kudugodu rakare dukeje ure tuwududo Jesus jokorai. Ure tumago rakado. Akore Jesus! Boe eimijera Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure aki! Nuba aromode cei? Inogwamagudumode ai. Akaba cedudo boe pegarewuto.

b: Jesus kurugodure tuibagi ika kurirewu tabo pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka pugeje ture joruduwadowugebo. Etaregodure dukeje boe ekimadure Jesus apo. Epagare bagai marigudu tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji.

b: Ca ia bai kejewu boe eimijera iere Jairo. Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai kejewu boe eimijeranure ema. Nou imedu Jairo aregodure Jesus ae, tragudu tabo. Okwamagudure Jesus ji koduiago pudabo toro tuwai ka. Tonaregedu nogwaredurogu ure mitotu jedu bigoduiure. Dukodire Jesus uture apo uwai ka. Mare nono nowu boe emagare rugadu dukodire ere taiado paci Jesus apo.

Re kimore piji meri jamedu boe ji. Joru oto padure doze nowu aredu ku rere piji dukeje. Kodire uture jorubo epage etae. Mare ekare nowu aredu pemegago nowu tugogodae piji. Pega kimore rugadu.

b: Mare Jesus akore Ioruduware ipijire ia iraga rakarewu ure tudawuje dukejere iogore ia boe ji. Dukodire ioruduware ia boe ekera jeture ikudau areia jituji.

b: Ere turemo dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu nowu nogwaredu ieraji. Makore ji. Akore are. Aragojedo.
source: Ere turemo dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu nowu nogwaredu ieraji. Makore ji. Akore are. Aragojedo.

b: Ca. Nou nogwaredu jewodure taci je. Nono ure turagojedo. Uce, uo erore ta je Jesus rore aino duji. Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore awu tagonaregedu okwagedo. Imode tawie. Tareadodukaba boe ewiagai irore aino woe tawai keje duji.
source: Ca. Nou nogwaredu jewodure taci je. Nono ure turagojedo. Uce, uo erore ta je Jesus rore aino duji. Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore awu tagonaregedu okwagedo. Imode tawie. Tareadodukaba boe ewiagai irore aino woe tawai keje duji.

b: Jesus Ure Tumaragodae Maku Ture Joruduwadowuge Etai
source: Jesus Ure Tumaragodae Maku Ture Joruduwadowuge Etai

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Enodo padure doze. Ure turaga maku etai ewo boe epemegago ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji jamedu. Ure eragado turaga tabo ewo boe epemegago ekogodae boe piji.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Enodo padure doze. Ure turaga maku etai ewo boe epemegago ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji jamedu. Ure eragado turaga tabo ewo boe epemegago ekogodae boe piji.

b: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tadukaba nowu tagedure jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadukaba marenaru ukudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Tadukaba tage tabo. Tadukaba diero tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau areia metia tabo pugeje. Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tarudumode boe ji. Etaidumode tai dukeje tamugudo ebo jii nowu tadumode kejewu meri ka. Mare tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka pugeje mare nowu boe etaidumodukare tai. Ekimadumodukare tagabo dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode epiji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu tawuje nowu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe ji kodire umode tugera ra epiji. Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje ure etudo ewo boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce. Ure etudo ewo kogodurewuge boe epemegago jamedu.
source: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tadukaba nowu tagedure jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadukaba marenaru ukudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Tadukaba tage tabo. Tadukaba diero tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau areia metia tabo pugeje. Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tarudumode boe ji. Etaidumode tai dukeje tamugudo ebo jii nowu tadumode kejewu meri ka. Mare tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka pugeje mare nowu boe etaidumodukare tai. Ekimadumodukare tagabo dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode epiji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu tawuje nowu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe ji kodire umode tugera ra epiji. Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje ure etudo ewo boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce. Ure etudo ewo kogodurewuge boe epemegago jamedu.

b: Dukodire nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture. Eture boe eda jamedu boe ka. Ere boe eiamedu boe ewie nowu Jesus bataru pemegarewu jamedu boe ji. Ere kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.
source: Dukodire nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture. Eture boe eda jamedu boe ka. Ere boe eiamedu boe ewie nowu Jesus bataru pemegarewu jamedu boe ji. Ere kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.

b: Herodes Joruduwa Bokware Nou Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Erore Jiboe ji
source: Herodes Joruduwa Bokware Nou Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Erore Jiboe ji

b: Galiléia moto kejewu boe eimijera iere Herodes. Mearudure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Mare joruduwa bokware ioguduba nuie ema duji. Ia boe egore João Batista jewoduie pugeje kodie João Batistanure ema.
source: Galiléia moto kejewu boe eimijera iere Herodes. Mearudure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Mare joruduwa bokware ioguduba nuie ema duji. Ia boe egore João Batista jewoduie pugeje kodie João Batistanure ema.

b: Ia boe egore elias uie tugirimi baru piji. Iage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu jewoduie pugeje.
source: Ia boe egore elias uie tugirimi baru piji. Iage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu jewoduie pugeje.

b: Herodes akore Boe egore ia imedu ro rakaie rugadu. Dukodire imire imagore itugaregei ewo João Batista itoru kado. Dukodire ere bito rugadu. Ema karega rore aino. Ca kakojiwu imedu ba ro rakare aino pugeje? Dukodire Herodes jemarure Jesus bagai tunarawo ji ioguduba nuie ema rugadu.
source: Herodes akore Boe egore ia imedu ro rakaie rugadu. Dukodire imire imagore itugaregei ewo João Batista itoru kado. Dukodire ere bito rugadu. Ema karega rore aino. Ca kakojiwu imedu ba ro rakare aino pugeje? Dukodire Herodes jemarure Jesus bagai tunarawo ji ioguduba nuie ema rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eke Maku Boe Etai. Ime Enodo Padure Cinco Mil
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eke Maku Boe Etai. Ime Enodo Padure Cinco Mil

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi tuibagi Jesus ae. Ereadodure turore jiboe ji Jesus biagai. Dukejere Jesus uture ebo pugeje boe epiji. Etuiago toro Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Mare boe eruduware Jesus kodure toro duji dukeje eture rekodaji. Emagare. Dukodire Jesus ure tuwuredo nono boe maerewu keje tumagowo nowu boe ji. Ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Nono nowu tumugurewu keje ure boe kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi tuibagi Jesus ae. Ereadodure turore jiboe ji Jesus biagai. Dukejere Jesus uture ebo pugeje boe epiji. Etuiago toro Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Mare boe eruduware Jesus kodure toro duji dukeje eture rekodaji. Emagare. Dukodire Jesus ure tuwuredo nono boe maerewu keje tumagowo nowu boe ji. Ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Nono nowu tumugurewu keje ure boe kogodurewuge epemegago jamedu.

b: Nono merirekodutabo nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore Jesus ji. egore boe doge etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Edo taodo ia tieda puredurewu bagai emuguwo keje etaiwowo ia tugerogu bagai. Boe bokware woe du kodire.
source: Nono merirekodutabo nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore Jesus ji. egore boe doge etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Edo taodo ia tieda puredurewu bagai emuguwo keje etaiwowo ia tugerogu bagai. Boe bokware woe du kodire.

b: Jesus akore Boro. Taigoiare tamode enogwagedo. egore awu boe emagare rugadu. Ime enodo padure cinco mil. Mare page amirewu rogure ikera aboudure tu je. Page karo rogure pobetu je. Tu rugadu. Akaidukana ceduwo toro ba kurirewuto cewo cegeragu awu boe eiamedu boe ekeji kana? Mare Jesus akore Tamagodo awu boe ji ewo tudo pui enodo paduwo cinquenta tu tu tumuga boe keje.
source: Jesus akore Boro. Taigoiare tamode enogwagedo. egore awu boe emagare rugadu. Ime enodo padure cinco mil. Mare page amirewu rogure ikera aboudure tu je. Page karo rogure pobetu je. Tu rugadu. Akaidukana ceduwo toro ba kurirewuto cewo cegeragu awu boe eiamedu boe ekeji kana? Mare Jesus akore Tamagodo awu boe ji ewo tudo pui enodo paduwo cinquenta tu tu tumuga boe keje.

b: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erore aino. Ere nowu boe eiamedu boe edo tudo pui tumuga jamedu boe keje. Eiamedu boe ere tudo pui rugadu. Dukodire ere tumugudo tu tu tumuga boe keje.
source: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erore aino. Ere nowu boe eiamedu boe edo tudo pui tumuga jamedu boe keje. Eiamedu boe ere tudo pui rugadu. Dukodire ere tumugudo tu tu tumuga boe keje.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu nowu boe eke roguji tumagowo Tuwo Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu boe ekerogu paru tabo. Imadure Tuwo Kurirewu apo nowu boe ekerogu paru tabo dukeje Jesus ure nowu boe eke kado puiato ture joruduwadowuge ewo maku boe etai. Nou boe erore puku je nowu boe eke itodure aino duji. Dukodire nowu boe eke ure turugadu boe eiamedu boe ji.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu nowu boe eke roguji tumagowo Tuwo Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu boe ekerogu paru tabo. Imadure Tuwo Kurirewu apo nowu boe ekerogu paru tabo dukeje Jesus ure nowu boe eke kado puiato ture joruduwadowuge ewo maku boe etai. Nou boe erore puku je nowu boe eke itodure aino duji. Dukodire nowu boe eke ure turugadu boe eiamedu boe ji.

b: Boe eiamedu boe enogwagere. Nono ca ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu. Ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere nowu kadarabo doge ekorau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo doge enodo padure doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.
source: Boe eiamedu boe enogwagere. Nono ca ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu. Ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere nowu kadarabo doge ekorau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo doge enodo padure doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.

b: Pedro Makore Nuba Tumearudaere Jesus ji
source: Pedro Makore Nuba Tumearudaere Jesus ji

b: Ia meri keje Jesus makore baru to Tuo Kurirewu bagai. Rakojere tuginaigodu. Tu nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge edure tu nono Jesus apo. Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo dukeje unarare nowu ture joruduwadowugei: – Nuba boe emearudaere i?
source: Ia meri keje Jesus makore baru to Tuo Kurirewu bagai. Rakojere tuginaigodu. Tu nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge edure tu nono Jesus apo. Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo dukeje unarare nowu ture joruduwadowugei: – Nuba boe emearudaere i?

b: egore boe egore João Batista nuie aki. Nou iage egore elias nuie aki. Nou iage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu jewodurewu nuie aki.
source: egore boe egore João Batista nuie aki. Nou iage egore elias nuie aki. Nou iage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu jewodurewu nuie aki.

b: Jesus akore Mare tagi. Nuba tamearudaere i? Pedro akore Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwunure aki. Umode boe ekinorudowunure aki.
source: Jesus akore Mare tagi. Nuba tamearudaere i? Pedro akore Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwunure aki. Umode boe ekinorudowunure aki.

b: Jesus akore Tareadodukaba nowu inoduji boe ewiagai. Mare du inodu tabo boe erorerumode i. Boe etaidumodukare i. Judeu doge eimijerage erudu pegamode i rugadu. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge erudu pegamode i rugadu. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage erudu pegamode i rugadu. Boe emode iwido rugadu. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode taci je pugeje.
source: Jesus akore Tareadodukaba nowu inoduji boe ewiagai. Mare du inodu tabo boe erorerumode i. Boe etaidumodukare i. Judeu doge eimijerage erudu pegamode i rugadu. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge erudu pegamode i rugadu. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage erudu pegamode i rugadu. Boe emode iwido rugadu. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode taci je pugeje.

b: Nono Jesus makore nouia boe ji pugeje. Akore ia tagi tagaidure tagoduwo itabo kana? Ca iwo tawie. Tagaidumode dukeje tamearutorudo tu i dukeje tagera ra taro pegarewu piji, tawia ra tamearudae pegarewu piji, tagaidure jiboe piji jamedu. Tado tarugadu meri jamedu ji boe pegamode tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Iwimode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dukodire inagoino tai tado tarugadu tagoduwo itabo.
source: Nono Jesus makore nouia boe ji pugeje. Akore ia tagi tagaidure tagoduwo itabo kana? Ca iwo tawie. Tagaidumode dukeje tamearutorudo tu i dukeje tagera ra taro pegarewu piji, tawia ra tamearudae pegarewu piji, tagaidure jiboe piji jamedu. Tado tarugadu meri jamedu ji boe pegamode tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Iwimode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dukodire inagoino tai tado tarugadu tagoduwo itabo.

b: Mare ia boe ewiapagamode tuwo boe pemegado tu pudui turaga tabo dukeje nowu boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare cinorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji tumearudae pegarewu piji taidure jiboe piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu.
source: Mare ia boe ewiapagamode tuwo boe pemegado tu pudui turaga tabo dukeje nowu boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare cinorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji tumearudae pegarewu piji taidure jiboe piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu.

b: Pagatu jere boe emode turagado pudui toe kuriwo awu moto keje. Ca nowu enoe umodukare erududo baru to. Ewiagorokare tuwo tumearutorudo tu Pao Kurirewu ji kodi. Ewiagorore tu tuwo toe kurido mare pagatu je.
source: Pagatu jere boe emode turagado pudui toe kuriwo awu moto keje. Ca nowu enoe umodukare erududo baru to. Ewiagorokare tuwo tumearutorudo tu Pao Kurirewu ji kodi. Ewiagorore tu tuwo toe kurido mare pagatu je.

b: Ia boe epogurumode tumagowo iwadaru ji tumedage ewiagai dukeje imi imodukare ikeragu ei itae. Itaregodumode Pao Kurirewu o jorugu kurirewu tabo Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugebo dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei. Nou Pao Kurirewu o jorugu kurirewu urugure Pao Kurirewu kujegajeje. Imode ikirimi mato dukeje urugumode ikujegajeje jamedu. Urugumode nowu aregodumode itabowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ekujegajeje jamedu.
source: Ia boe epogurumode tumagowo iwadaru ji tumedage ewiagai dukeje imi imodukare ikeragu ei itae. Itaregodumode Pao Kurirewu o jorugu kurirewu tabo Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugebo dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei. Nou Pao Kurirewu o jorugu kurirewu urugure Pao Kurirewu kujegajeje. Imode ikirimi mato dukeje urugumode ikujegajeje jamedu. Urugumode nowu aregodumode itabowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ekujegajeje jamedu.

b: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ia tagi tarudumode awu Pao Kurirewu roino duji. Tawimodukare jii toro tarudumode roino jitu ka.
source: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje ia tagi tarudumode awu Pao Kurirewu roino duji. Tawimodukare jii toro tarudumode roino jitu ka.

b: Jesus Ruture Tori Ao Ka
source: Jesus Ruture Tori Ao Ka

b: Nou akoinodu bataru rekodaji semanare mito. Dukeje Jesus uture Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo jamedu toro ia tori ricorewu ao ka. Toro nowu tori ricorewu ao kejere Jesus makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to.
source: Nou akoinodu bataru rekodaji semanare mito. Dukeje Jesus uture Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo jamedu toro ia tori ricorewu ao ka. Toro nowu tori ricorewu ao kejere Jesus makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to.

b: Jesus makore baru to dukeje je ure tudo tuginai. Ukudau areia kigadu maere ji. Gurugure nono boeiaragudu urugu mogadure rugadu.
source: Jesus makore baru to dukeje je ure tudo tuginai. Ukudau areia kigadu maere ji. Gurugure nono boeiaragudu urugu mogadure rugadu.

b: Nono ia ime doge epadure taci toro ae. Ere pobe. Ia iere Moisés. Metia iere Elias. Nou Pao Kurirewu jorugu pemegarewu urugure ekujegajeje. Emagore Jesus ji. Jesus makore ei jamedu. Ere pu bie Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare boe pegamoduie Jesus ji nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje dukodire Jesus bimoduie Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje rugadu. Mare jewodumoduie pugeje turuduwo baru to rugadu.
source: Nono ia ime doge epadure taci toro ae. Ere pobe. Ia iere Moisés. Metia iere Elias. Nou Pao Kurirewu jorugu pemegarewu urugure ekujegajeje. Emagore Jesus ji. Jesus makore ei jamedu. Ere pu bie Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare boe pegamoduie Jesus ji nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje dukodire Jesus bimoduie Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje rugadu. Mare jewodumoduie pugeje turuduwo baru to rugadu.

b: Mare Pedro unudure tumedagebo. Care edadure dukeje erudure nowu urugure Jesus kujegajejewu Pao Kurirewu jorugu pemegarewuji. Erudure nowu ime pobedu dogei jamedu.
source: Mare Pedro unudure tumedagebo. Care edadure dukeje erudure nowu urugure Jesus kujegajejewu Pao Kurirewu jorugu pemegarewuji. Erudure nowu ime pobedu dogei jamedu.

b: Ca nowu ime pobedu doge ere tuduiago tuibagi baru to dukeje Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Ure turugadu paeduwo woe. Cemode ia macebradudo pobe metia bokware. Iamode akai. Iamode Moisés ai. Iamode Elias ai jamedu. Mare Pedro joruduwakare tuiorudure jiboe ji dukodire mako pagare.
source: Ca nowu ime pobedu doge ere tuduiago tuibagi baru to dukeje Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Ure turugadu paeduwo woe. Cemode ia macebradudo pobe metia bokware. Iamode akai. Iamode Moisés ai. Iamode Elias ai jamedu. Mare Pedro joruduwakare tuiorudure jiboe ji dukodire mako pagare.

b: Pedro mako kimore dukeje ia boe tugu ure turawuje etae. Nou boe tugu ure turorido eiogi. Dukodire nowu Pedro, nowu rakojere apowuge metage epagudugodure.
source: Pedro mako kimore dukeje ia boe tugu ure turawuje etae. Nou boe tugu ure turorido eiogi. Dukodire nowu Pedro, nowu rakojere apowuge metage epagudugodure.

b: Nono emearudure ia boe emagoji nowu boe tugu piji. Akore imearudu kurire jiwu itonaregedu reo. Ire ikeragu ji iwo udo boe ekinorudo. Tawiapaga pemegado makore jiboe ji.
source: Nono emearudure ia boe emagoji nowu boe tugu piji. Akore imearudu kurire jiwu itonaregedu reo. Ire ikeragu ji iwo udo boe ekinorudo. Tawiapaga pemegado makore jiboe ji.

b: Akore aino dukeje nowu boe tugu akedure. Ca Jesus rakojere nono. Nou ime pobedu doge eragojekare nono pugeje. Mare Pedro, Tiago, João nowu meri ji ereadodukare tumedage ewiagai tuiorudure tumearudure jiboe ji jii toro, ia boe ewiagai jii toro jamedu.
source: Akore aino dukeje nowu boe tugu akedure. Ca Jesus rakojere nono. Nou ime pobedu doge eragojekare nono pugeje. Mare Pedro, Tiago, João nowu meri ji ereadodukare tumedage ewiagai tuiorudure tumearudure jiboe ji jii toro, ia boe ewiagai jii toro jamedu.

b: Jesus Ure Bope Uwari Tawuje Iparedu Piji
source: Jesus Ure Bope Uwari Tawuje Iparedu Piji

b: Nou barogwato ere turawuje nowu tori ao piji dukejere boe emagare taregodu tabo Jesus togi.
source: Nou barogwato ere turawuje nowu tori ao piji dukejere boe emagare taregodu tabo Jesus togi.

b: Ia imedu akore Ikimijera! Ikimijera! Inogwamaguduwo ai itonaregedurogu paru tabo bope uwari pegarewu meture tada kodi. Nou bope uwari ro pegare ji kodire ure magadudo, ure kudugo. Jataro aregodure jabiji, rakakare tuwo turagojedo pugeje. Kodire ure tiamedu boe korido. Ukare tudawuje itonaregedu piji rugadu. Dukodire inogwamagudunure ai akaiwowo ji awo pemegago. Rogure mitotu inai. Imagore awu ia are joruduwadowugei ewo nowu bope uwari pegarewu barigu piji. Mare ero rakakare ji.
source: Ia imedu akore Ikimijera! Ikimijera! Inogwamaguduwo ai itonaregedurogu paru tabo bope uwari pegarewu meture tada kodi. Nou bope uwari ro pegare ji kodire ure magadudo, ure kudugo. Jataro aregodure jabiji, rakakare tuwo turagojedo pugeje. Kodire ure tiamedu boe korido. Ukare tudawuje itonaregedu piji rugadu. Dukodire inogwamagudunure ai akaiwowo ji awo pemegago. Rogure mitotu inai. Imagore awu ia are joruduwadowugei ewo nowu bope uwari pegarewu barigu piji. Mare ero rakakare ji.

b: Jesus akore nowu boei: – Tare ikiarigo. Tamearutorukare rugadu. Taruduwakare tawo tamearudae pemegado. Iragoje raimodukare tagabo. Nuba tagaidure irowo tamearutoruwo i? Nono Jesus makore nowu imeduji. Akore mato akanaregedu apo.
source: Jesus akore nowu boei: – Tare ikiarigo. Tamearutorukare rugadu. Taruduwakare tawo tamearudae pemegado. Iragoje raimodukare tagabo. Nuba tagaidure irowo tamearutoruwo i? Nono Jesus makore nowu imeduji. Akore mato akanaregedu apo.

b: Nono boe ere nowu iparedu reko Jesus ae dukeje nowu bope uwari pegarewu ure nowu iparedu butudo moto keje pugeje. Magadugodure nono nowu moto keje. Mare Jesus mako rakare nowu bope uwariji uwo tudawuje nowu iparedu piji. Ainore care ure nowu bope tawuje nowu iparedu piji rugadu. Dukodire ure pemegago. Nono ure nowu iparedu maku tuo ai pugeje.
source: Nono boe ere nowu iparedu reko Jesus ae dukeje nowu bope uwari pegarewu ure nowu iparedu butudo moto keje pugeje. Magadugodure nono nowu moto keje. Mare Jesus mako rakare nowu bope uwariji uwo tudawuje nowu iparedu piji. Ainore care ure nowu bope tawuje nowu iparedu piji rugadu. Dukodire ure pemegago. Nono ure nowu iparedu maku tuo ai pugeje.

b: Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure Pao Kurirewu ro rakare aino duji. Nou boe ebogodu kimore Jesus rore jiboe ji. Dukeje Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje.
source: Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure Pao Kurirewu ro rakare aino duji. Nou boe ebogodu kimore Jesus rore jiboe ji. Dukeje Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ewie Pugeje Tuwimoduie Duji
source: Jesus Ure Ewie Pugeje Tuwimoduie Duji

b: Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai ero pegawo i. Tawiagodukaba awu imagore tai dupiji.
source: Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai ero pegawo i. Tawiagodukaba awu imagore tai dupiji.

b: Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare kaba jiba Jesus akoino pudui duji. Nou Jesus makore jiboe ukare turemo etaorato. Dukodire ure tuwiado epiji. Mare epagudure jamedu tunarawo Jesus ji kaba jiba Jesus akoino pudui.
source: Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare kaba jiba Jesus akoino pudui duji. Nou Jesus makore jiboe ukare turemo etaorato. Dukodire ure tuwiado epiji. Mare epagudure jamedu tunarawo Jesus ji kaba jiba Jesus akoino pudui.

b: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etaidure Tuioruduwawo Kakojiwu Pudumi Ba Boe Eimijera Mode Pudumi Dubagai
source: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etaidure Tuioruduwawo Kakojiwu Pudumi Ba Boe Eimijera Mode Pudumi Dubagai

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere bato pui tunarawo kakojiwu pudumiba boe kurirewu mode ema. Eiamedu boe egore boe eimijera kurirewu moduie pudumi nowu tumedage epiji.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere bato pui tunarawo kakojiwu pudumiba boe kurirewu mode ema. Eiamedu boe egore boe eimijera kurirewu moduie pudumi nowu tumedage epiji.

b: Mare Jesus joruduware emearudae jamedu boe ji. Nono Jesus ure tugeragu ia boe etonaregedu roguji. Makore ji rakojewo nono pudabo tugana pemegarewu jagwai.
source: Mare Jesus joruduware emearudae jamedu boe ji. Nono Jesus ure tugeragu ia boe etonaregedu roguji. Makore ji rakojewo nono pudabo tugana pemegarewu jagwai.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore mearutorure iwu umode tugera podo boe etonaregedu apo dukeje unure tugera podo itabo jamedu. Mearutorure iwu umode tugera podo itabo dukeje unure tugera podo nowu ure itarego matowu apo jamedu. Tagaidumodukare tawo tagurido tamedage ekori pugeje, mare tamode tado itugaregedo tagi dukeje Pao Kurirewu aidu kurimode tai boe eimijerage kurirewuge ekori.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore mearutorure iwu umode tugera podo boe etonaregedu apo dukeje unure tugera podo itabo jamedu. Mearutorure iwu umode tugera podo itabo dukeje unure tugera podo nowu ure itarego matowu apo jamedu. Tagaidumodukare tawo tagurido tamedage ekori pugeje, mare tamode tado itugaregedo tagi dukeje Pao Kurirewu aidu kurimode tai boe eimijerage kurirewuge ekori.

b: Ro Pegakare Paiwuge Emearudu Kurinure Pai
source: Ro Pegakare Paiwuge Emearudu Kurinure Pai

b: João makore Jesus ji. Akore cerudure ia imeduji. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji akie tabo. Pamedia karegure ema. Dukodire cemagore ji uwo tugera ra nowu turo piji makokawo akie tabo pugeje.
source: João makore Jesus ji. Akore cerudure ia imeduji. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji akie tabo. Pamedia karegure ema. Dukodire cemagore ji uwo tugera ra nowu turo piji makokawo akie tabo pugeje.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore Piji. Ro pegakare paiwuge emearudu kurinure pai.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore Piji. Ro pegakare paiwuge emearudu kurinure pai.

b: Ia Samaria Moto Kejewu Boe Etaidukare Jesus ji
source: Ia Samaria Moto Kejewu Boe Etaidukare Jesus ji

b: Jesus joruduware meri puredugodure pudui turuduwo baru to. Dukodire ure tumearudae udo turugadu tuduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.
source: Jesus joruduware meri puredugodure pudui turuduwo baru to. Dukodire ure tumearudae udo turugadu tuduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.

b: Ure tugeragu nouia ture joruduwadowuge pobedu dogei tuwo etudo tododai tuwadaru tabo toro Samaria moto kejewu ia boe eda ka ewo boe udo turugadu Jesus togi aregodumode toro kodi.
source: Ure tugeragu nouia ture joruduwadowuge pobedu dogei tuwo etudo tododai tuwadaru tabo toro Samaria moto kejewu ia boe eda ka ewo boe udo turugadu Jesus togi aregodumode toro kodi.

b: Dukodire nowu pobedu doge eture nowu Samaria moto kejewu boe eda ka rugadu. Mare nowu boe eruduware Jesus utumoduie Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukodire etaidukare Jesus aregoduwo pudae.
source: Dukodire nowu pobedu doge eture nowu Samaria moto kejewu boe eda ka rugadu. Mare nowu boe eruduware Jesus utumoduie Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukodire etaidukare Jesus aregoduwo pudae.

b: Mare nowu pobedu doge eruduware nowu boe emearudae ji dukodire ere tugirimi Jesus ae tuwo Jesus bie nowu boe egore Jesus jituji. Ere Jesus bie dukeje nowu Tiago, nowu João emearudure egoino duji jamedu. Dukodire emagore Jesus ji. egore cegimijera. Akaidukana cemagowo baru to joru butuwo nowu boe ewugeje, uwo nowu boe etagedudo?
source: Mare nowu pobedu doge eruduware nowu boe emearudae ji dukodire ere tugirimi Jesus ae tuwo Jesus bie nowu boe egore Jesus jituji. Ere Jesus bie dukeje nowu Tiago, nowu João emearudure egoino duji jamedu. Dukodire emagore Jesus ji. egore cegimijera. Akaidukana cemagowo baru to joru butuwo nowu boe ewugeje, uwo nowu boe etagedudo?

b: Mare Jesus akore Boro. Tamearudae pegakaba ei.
source: Mare Jesus akore Boro. Tamearudae pegakaba ei.

b: Dukejere Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo toro ia boe eda ka pugeje.
source: Dukejere Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo toro ia boe eda ka pugeje.

b: Ia Boe Etaidu Jokodukare Tugoduwo Jesus Apo
source: Ia Boe Etaidu Jokodukare Tugoduwo Jesus Apo

b: Jesus kodure awara ji dukeje ia imedu aregodure ae. Makore ji. Akore itaidure ikoduwo akabo rugadu atumode kaboe ka.
source: Jesus kodure awara ji dukeje ia imedu aregodure ae. Makore ji. Akore itaidure ikoduwo akabo rugadu atumode kaboe ka.

b: Jesus makore ji. Akore okwa doge emode tamudo tiari poro ja tada. Kiebarege emode tamudo tuwaradu ja tada jamedu. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Mare iwai bokware dukodire imode itamudo tadaboe bokware.
source: Jesus makore ji. Akore okwa doge emode tamudo tiari poro ja tada. Kiebarege emode tamudo tuwaradu ja tada jamedu. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Mare iwai bokware dukodire imode itamudo tadaboe bokware.

b: Dukeje Jesus makore ia imeduji. Akore ako itabo. Mare nowu imedu akore Ikodumode akabo rugadu mare kajao. Aino kuri aino itumode iogwa uwai ka. Iogwa bire dukodire iwo iogwa tugu mototo jao. Dukejere ikodumode akabo akodure jiboe ka.
source: Dukeje Jesus makore ia imeduji. Akore ako itabo. Mare nowu imedu akore Ikodumode akabo rugadu mare kajao. Aino kuri aino itumode iogwa uwai ka. Iogwa bire dukodire iwo iogwa tugu mototo jao. Dukejere ikodumode akabo akodure jiboe ka.

b: Jesus akore Birewuge etugudumode mototo birewugebo mare awiapagakaba ei. Atudo epiji ia boe eda ka awo nowu boe ewie boe eimijera kurirewu moduie Pao Kurirewuce rugadu duji.
source: Jesus akore Birewuge etugudumode mototo birewugebo mare awiapagakaba ei. Atudo epiji ia boe eda ka awo nowu boe ewie boe eimijera kurirewu moduie Pao Kurirewuce rugadu duji.

b: Ia boe makore Jesus ji pugeje. Akore ikodumode akabo rugadu. Mare kajao. Iwo ikirimi iwai ka jao ikimaduwo iwobebo.
source: Ia boe makore Jesus ji pugeje. Akore ikodumode akabo rugadu. Mare kajao. Iwo ikirimi iwai ka jao ikimaduwo iwobebo.

b: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore ia boe aidumode tumaragoduwo moto ji tuwo nowu merirido moto kado kuwaru apo dukeje umodukare tuie mekido tododaiwu moto piji tuwo nowu ture kadowu moto jetorodo. Aiwomodukare tuibagi. Tarodo nono nowu umode moto kadowu ro mogadure. Mare umode moto kadowu ro ji karega inagoino. Tamaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai tawo boe ewie boe eimijera kurirewu mode Pao Kurirewuce. Dujire inagoino. Boe etaidumode tumaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai dukeje ekawo tugera ra Pao Kurirewu piji tuwo tugirimi turo pegarewu ka pugeje. Dujire inagoino. Emode tugera ra Pao Kurirewu piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umodukare tudugaregedo emage.
source: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore ia boe aidumode tumaragoduwo moto ji tuwo nowu merirido moto kado kuwaru apo dukeje umodukare tuie mekido tododaiwu moto piji tuwo nowu ture kadowu moto jetorodo. Aiwomodukare tuibagi. Tarodo nono nowu umode moto kadowu ro mogadure. Mare umode moto kadowu ro ji karega inagoino. Tamaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai tawo boe ewie boe eimijera kurirewu mode Pao Kurirewuce. Dujire inagoino. Boe etaidumode tumaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai dukeje ekawo tugera ra Pao Kurirewu piji tuwo tugirimi turo pegarewu ka pugeje. Dujire inagoino. Emode tugera ra Pao Kurirewu piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umodukare tudugaregedo emage.

b: Jesus Ure Ime Etudo Tuwadaru Tabo
source: Jesus Ure Ime Etudo Tuwadaru Tabo

b: Jesus ure tugeragu imei pugeje tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe etae. Enodo padure kejewugere setenta e dois. Ure edo pobe cai cai je puapo tudumodewu ka.
source: Jesus ure tugeragu imei pugeje tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe etae. Enodo padure kejewugere setenta e dois. Ure edo pobe cai cai je puapo tudumodewu ka.

b: Makore ei. Akore boepa kurire rugadu. Nou boepa tadaboe ure turugadu boe ewo kado. Mare nowu umode boepa tadaboe kadowuge emagakare. Dukodire tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Boepa jiwu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Tamagodo ji uwo nowu maragodure boepa jiwuge emagado etuwo boepato ewo boepa tadaboe kado rugadu. Mare boepa remawu ji karega Jesus akoino. Mearutorumode Pao Kurirewu jiwugeire akoino. Boe emode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji, Pao Kurirewu umode ekinorudo rugadu. Dujire akoino.
source: Makore ei. Akore boepa kurire rugadu. Nou boepa tadaboe ure turugadu boe ewo kado. Mare nowu umode boepa tadaboe kadowuge emagakare. Dukodire tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Boepa jiwu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Tamagodo ji uwo nowu maragodure boepa jiwuge emagado etuwo boepato ewo boepa tadaboe kado rugadu. Mare boepa remawu ji karega Jesus akoino. Mearutorumode Pao Kurirewu jiwugeire akoino. Boe emode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji, Pao Kurirewu umode ekinorudo rugadu. Dujire akoino.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore nou imode tadudo etaewuge ere nono rie doge emogadure. Mare tagire tare nono ovelha doge emogadure. Mare barogo remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu bokware. Dujire inagoino. Mare nowu tadumode etaewuge emearudae pegamode tai rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Ca tadudo toro boe ewagai.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore nou imode tadudo etaewuge ere nono rie doge emogadure. Mare tagire tare nono ovelha doge emogadure. Mare barogo remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu bokware. Dujire inagoino. Mare nowu tadumode etaewuge emearudae pegamode tai rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Ca tadudo toro boe ewagai.

b: Mare tadukaba ia diero tabo. Tadukaba marenaru ukudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Mare tadudo tu nowu meture tawuretadau tawure okeakejewu tabo. Tadukaba ia metia tabo pugeje. Tagaba tawuredo awara kajeje tagimaduwo ia boebo.
source: Mare tadukaba ia diero tabo. Tadukaba marenaru ukudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Mare tadudo tu nowu meture tawuretadau tawure okeakejewu tabo. Tadukaba ia metia tabo pugeje. Tagaba tawuredo awara kajeje tagimaduwo ia boebo.

b: Tagaregodumode nowu boe ewai ka dukeje tagimadudo nowu boebo. Tamagodo aino ei: “Boe epemegawo awu bai tadawuge ji.”
source: Tagaregodumode nowu boe ewai ka dukeje tagimadudo nowu boebo. Tamagodo aino ei: “Boe epemegawo awu bai tadawuge ji.”

b: – Tamagomode aino nowu boe ji dukeje taruduwamode ei. Etaidure tuwo tubemegado boe ji dukeje tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ei. Mare etaidumodukare tuwo tubemegado boe ji dukeje tagaba tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai jamedu.
source: – Tamagomode aino nowu boe ji dukeje taruduwamode ei. Etaidure tuwo tubemegado boe ji dukeje tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ei. Mare etaidumodukare tuwo tubemegado boe ji dukeje tagaba tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai jamedu.

b: Nou boe etaidumode tai dukeje tabaduwo nowu ewai keje. Tabadu paga paga kaba ia boe ewai keje. Nou aidure taiwuge ewai kejere tabaduwo. Tagwagedo nowu emode maku tagaiwu tageji. Taeku irukaba nowu emode maku tagai boe ji. Tagududo nowu emode maku tagaiwu boece. Nou tagwagere jiboe, nowu tagudure cewu makudure tagai tamaragodae morice.
source: Nou boe etaidumode tai dukeje tabaduwo nowu ewai keje. Tabadu paga paga kaba ia boe ewai keje. Nou aidure taiwuge ewai kejere tabaduwo. Tagwagedo nowu emode maku tagaiwu tageji. Taeku irukaba nowu emode maku tagai boe ji. Tagududo nowu emode maku tagaiwu boece. Nou tagwagere jiboe, nowu tagudure cewu makudure tagai tamaragodae morice.

b: Tawo nowu boe eda kejewu kogodurewuge epemegago. Tamagodo nowu boe ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino.
source: Tawo nowu boe eda kejewu kogodurewuge epemegago. Tamagodo nowu boe ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino.

b: Mare tagaregodumode ia boe eda metia ka dukeje etaidumodukare tugimaduwo tagabo dukeje tagaba taremo ewaito nowu boe eda keje. Dukeje toro bawadu keje tagagomode aino ia boe ewiagai.
source: Mare tagaregodumode ia boe eda metia ka dukeje etaidumodukare tugimaduwo tagabo dukeje tagaba taremo ewaito nowu boe eda keje. Dukeje toro bawadu keje tagagomode aino ia boe ewiagai.

b: Tamagodo aino ei: “Cedaregodure cewo boe ewie Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino. Mare ia tagi tawiapagakare cewadaru ji. Dukeje cemode cewure okeakejewu to pui taegai cewo nowu moto urugudu tawuje cewure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare tarore aino cei duji.” Ainore tagagomode ei.
source: Tamagodo aino ei: “Cedaregodure cewo boe ewie Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino. Mare ia tagi tawiapagakare cewadaru ji. Dukeje cemode cewure okeakejewu to pui taegai cewo nowu moto urugudu tawuje cewure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare tarore aino cei duji.” Ainore tagagomode ei.

b: Mare imode tawie. Pao Kurirewu okudugodumodukare nowu aidukare taiwuge ji. Toro ia meri keje aiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji tuwo nowu erore jiboe morido etai. Marigudu nowu Sodoma kejewuge ero pegare. Dukodire nowu meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado nowu Sodoma kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Mare nowu aidukare taiwuge boe eire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sodoma kejewuge ekori. Ainore Jesus akore nowu setenta e dois boe doge ewiagai.
source: Mare imode tawie. Pao Kurirewu okudugodumodukare nowu aidukare taiwuge ji. Toro ia meri keje aiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji tuwo nowu erore jiboe morido etai. Marigudu nowu Sodoma kejewuge ero pegare. Dukodire nowu meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado nowu Sodoma kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Mare nowu aidukare taiwuge boe eire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sodoma kejewuge ekori. Ainore Jesus akore nowu setenta e dois boe doge ewiagai.

b: Nou Ba Kurirewu Kejewuge Emearutorukare Jesus ji
source: Nou Ba Kurirewu Kejewuge Emearutorukare Jesus ji

b: Nono Jesus makore nouia boe ji. Akore iro rakare Corazim ba kurirewu keje iwo nowu boe eruduwado i. Mare emearutorukare i. Dukodire boe pegamode ei rugadu. Iro rakare Betsaida ba kurirewu keje iwo nowu boe eruduwado i. Mare emearutorukare i. Dukodire boe pegamode ei jamedu. Marigudu rugadu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Marigudu rugadu Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Nou Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge, nowu Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge erudumode nowu Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge erudure jiwu iro rakarewu ji dukeje ekiarigodumode turo pegare jiboe ji rugadu. Emode tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Emode jorugudu bu taora keje tuwo boe eruduwado tugiarigodure turo pegarewu boe jituji tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Mare erudukare i, erudukare iro rakarewu ji dukodire eruduwakare i. Ekare tugera ra turo pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare kocare Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge, Betsaida ba kurirewu kejewuge, erudure iro rakarewu ji mare du inodu tabo ekiarigodukare turo pegarewuji. Etaidukare tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore nouia boe ji. Akore iro rakare Corazim ba kurirewu keje iwo nowu boe eruduwado i. Mare emearutorukare i. Dukodire boe pegamode ei rugadu. Iro rakare Betsaida ba kurirewu keje iwo nowu boe eruduwado i. Mare emearutorukare i. Dukodire boe pegamode ei jamedu. Marigudu rugadu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Marigudu rugadu Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Nou Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge, nowu Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge erudumode nowu Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge erudure jiwu iro rakarewu ji dukeje ekiarigodumode turo pegare jiboe ji rugadu. Emode tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Emode jorugudu bu taora keje tuwo boe eruduwado tugiarigodure turo pegarewu boe jituji tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Mare erudukare i, erudukare iro rakarewu ji dukodire eruduwakare i. Ekare tugera ra turo pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare kocare Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge, Betsaida ba kurirewu kejewuge, erudure iro rakarewu ji mare du inodu tabo ekiarigodukare turo pegarewuji. Etaidukare tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji rugadu.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure ia meri tawuje taiwowo boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu bagai nowu meri keje. Mare nowu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ei nowu makore kejewu meri keje. Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ei jamedu nowu makore kejewu meri keje. Mare Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge, Betsaida ba kurirewu kejewuge erudure iro rakarewu ji mare du inodu tabo emearutorukare i. Dukodire Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge eire, Betsaida ba kurirewu kejewuge eire, Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sidom kejewuge ekori, nowu Tiro kejewuge ekori jamedu. Pao Kurirewu romode aino ei toro ia meri keje. Nou makore kejewu meri keje umode boe pegado ei rugadu.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure ia meri tawuje taiwowo boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu bagai nowu meri keje. Mare nowu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ei nowu makore kejewu meri keje. Sidom ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ei jamedu nowu makore kejewu meri keje. Mare Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge, Betsaida ba kurirewu kejewuge erudure iro rakarewu ji mare du inodu tabo emearutorukare i. Dukodire Corazim ba kurirewu kejewuge eire, Betsaida ba kurirewu kejewuge eire, Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sidom kejewuge ekori, nowu Tiro kejewuge ekori jamedu. Pao Kurirewu romode aino ei toro ia meri keje. Nou makore kejewu meri keje umode boe pegado ei rugadu.

b: Cafarnaum ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorure tu pudui turuduwo baru to. Mare pagatu je. Pao Kurirewu umode ewarigu toro bope doge eda kejewu joru to nowu taiwomode boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu meri keje.
source: Cafarnaum ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutorure tu pudui turuduwo baru to. Mare pagatu je. Pao Kurirewu umode ewarigu toro bope doge eda kejewu joru to nowu taiwomode boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu meri keje.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore biapagare taiwuge ewiapagare i jamedu. Jorudu pegare taiwuge erudu pegare i jamedu. Jorudu pegare iwuge erudu pegare ure itarego matowuji jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore biapagare taiwuge ewiapagare i jamedu. Jorudu pegare taiwuge erudu pegare i jamedu. Jorudu pegare iwuge erudu pegare ure itarego matowuji jamedu.

b: Uture Jesus Bataru Tabowuge Ere Tugirimi Tuibagi Jesus Ae
source: Uture Jesus Bataru Tabowuge Ere Tugirimi Tuibagi Jesus Ae

b: Uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi tuibagi Jesus ae. Enodo padure kejeboere setenta e dois. Egarere pudui taregodure dutabo rugadu. egore cegimijera. Cemagore bope dogei akie tabo ewo tudawuje boe epiji dukodire emearutorure cewadaru ji rugadu!
source: Uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi tuibagi Jesus ae. Enodo padure kejeboere setenta e dois. Egarere pudui taregodure dutabo rugadu. egore cegimijera. Cemagore bope dogei akie tabo ewo tudawuje boe epiji dukodire emearutorure cewadaru ji rugadu!

b: Jesus akore ei: – Iorudure bope doge eimijera pegarewu Satanás buture baru piji duji. Buture nono boeiaragudu butu mogadure.
source: Jesus akore ei: – Iorudure bope doge eimijera pegarewu Satanás buture baru piji duji. Buture nono boeiaragudu butu mogadure.

b: Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji. Ire taruduwado. Ire ia iraga maku tagai. Dukodire taragare jorudu pegare paiwu Satanásji. Dukodire care boe pegarewu umodukare tagogorido. Awagu umodukare toedo tai. Betaga umodukare tudugo tugu tado.
source: Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji. Ire taruduwado. Ire ia iraga maku tagai. Dukodire taragare jorudu pegare paiwu Satanásji. Dukodire care boe pegarewu umodukare tagogorido. Awagu umodukare toedo tai. Betaga umodukare tudugo tugu tado.

b: Bope doge etuwaire emearutorure tai mare taegaregodukaba nowu inoduji. Taiamedu boe taegaredo tai nowu tagie padure bapera keje baru tada kodi.
source: Bope doge etuwaire emearutorure tai mare taegaregodukaba nowu inoduji. Taiamedu boe taegaredo tai nowu tagie padure bapera keje baru tada kodi.

b: Jesus Jakarere Pudui
source: Jesus Jakarere Pudui

b: Nou meri ji Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Jesus jakaredo pudui rugadu. Dukodire Jesus makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Akore iogwa. Baru tadawuge, moto kejewuge eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewunure aki tu rugadu. Are nowu mugukare bapera kejewuge eruduwado. Nou are eruduwado jiboe are biado joruduwarewuge epiji marigudu. Are biado nowu mugure bapera kejewuge epiji jamedu. Mare are mugukare bapera kejewuge eruduwado. Dukodire ikimadure toro awagai. Are nowu amearudae jetudo pudui rugadu akaidu tabo.
source: Nou meri ji Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Jesus jakaredo pudui rugadu. Dukodire Jesus makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Akore iogwa. Baru tadawuge, moto kejewuge eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewunure aki tu rugadu. Are nowu mugukare bapera kejewuge eruduwado. Nou are eruduwado jiboe are biado joruduwarewuge epiji marigudu. Are biado nowu mugure bapera kejewuge epiji jamedu. Mare are mugukare bapera kejewuge eruduwado. Dukodire ikimadure toro awagai. Are nowu amearudae jetudo pudui rugadu akaidu tabo.

b: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru iado tumagore tuo jitu keje makore nowu boe ji. Akore iogwa ure boe jamedu boe maku tu inai. Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware nowu Tonaregeduji. Tu nowu Onaregedu joruduware Tuoji. Dukodi nowu Onaregedu umode nowu taidure jiwuge eruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu.
source: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru iado tumagore tuo jitu keje makore nowu boe ji. Akore iogwa ure boe jamedu boe maku tu inai. Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware nowu Tonaregeduji. Tu nowu Onaregedu joruduware Tuoji. Dukodi nowu Onaregedu umode nowu taidure jiwuge eruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu.

b: Nono Jesus ure tumegido nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Dukeje makore ei. Akore tarudure irore jiboe ji dukodire boe pemegare tai.
source: Nono Jesus ure tumegido nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Dukeje makore ei. Akore tarudure irore jiboe ji dukodire boe pemegare tai.

b: Jawu pawobe emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge etaidure tuioruduwo i nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje tuioruduwo nowu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji. Mare ewire marigudu dukodire erudukare i. Jawu pawobe eimijera kurirewuge etaidure tuioruduwo i nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje tuioruduwo nowu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji. Mare ewire marigudu dukodire erudukare i. Etaidure tumearuduwo tamearudure jiwu imagore jiboe ji. Mare emearudukare ji, ewire kodi.
source: Jawu pawobe emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge etaidure tuioruduwo i nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje tuioruduwo nowu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji. Mare ewire marigudu dukodire erudukare i. Jawu pawobe eimijera kurirewuge etaidure tuioruduwo i nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje tuioruduwo nowu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji. Mare ewire marigudu dukodire erudukare i. Etaidure tumearuduwo tamearudure jiwu imagore jiboe ji. Mare emearudukare ji, ewire kodi.

b: Samaria Kejewu Imedu Pemegarewu O Bakaru Reo
source: Samaria Kejewu Imedu Pemegarewu O Bakaru Reo

b: Ia meri keje ia joruduware Pao Kurirewu o bakaru jiwu unarare Jesus ji: – Nuba iromode iewoduwo pugeje iragojewo Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada jii toro rugadu? Mare pagatu jere ure tunarado Jesus ji. Aidure tuwo Jesus barigu boeto Jesus makowo ia tuwadaru pegarewu ji nono tumago pegawo Jesus ji.
source: Ia meri keje ia joruduware Pao Kurirewu o bakaru jiwu unarare Jesus ji: – Nuba iromode iewoduwo pugeje iragojewo Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada jii toro rugadu? Mare pagatu jere ure tunarado Jesus ji. Aidure tuwo Jesus barigu boeto Jesus makowo ia tuwadaru pegarewu ji nono tumago pegawo Jesus ji.

b: Jesus akore Nuba Pao Kurirewu bataru akore boe eroiago? Nuba amearudaere ji?
source: Jesus akore Nuba Pao Kurirewu bataru akore boe eroiago? Nuba amearudaere ji?

b: Nou imedu akore Pao Kurirewu makore pai pamearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji paraga tabo, pamearudae pemegarewu tabo, parore jiboe jamedu boe tabo. Makore pai pamearudu kuriwo pamedagei nono pamearudu kurimode pai dumogadure.
source: Nou imedu akore Pao Kurirewu makore pai pamearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji paraga tabo, pamearudae pemegarewu tabo, parore jiboe jamedu boe tabo. Makore pai pamearudu kuriwo pamedagei nono pamearudu kurimode pai dumogadure.

b: Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Aromode aino dukeje aragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo du akedumodukare rugadu.
source: Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Aromode aino dukeje aragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo du akedumodukare rugadu.

b: Mare nowu imedu aidukare turo pemegawo tumearudae pemegawo tumedagei. Dukodire unarare Jesus ji pugeje. Akore kaibowugeba imedage mode emage rugadu?
source: Mare nowu imedu aidukare turo pemegawo tumearudae pemegawo tumedagei. Dukodire unarare Jesus ji pugeje. Akore kaibowugeba imedage mode emage rugadu?

b: Nono Jesus akore Ia imedu ure turawuje Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Jericó ba kurirewu ka. Nou awara keje iwogurewuge eiwogure nowu imeduji. Ere ukudau areia tawuje piji tugiwoguwo ji. Ere boeto ji. Ere kugudugodudo. Nono dukeje eture piji. Nou imedu bigodunure. Boe etaiwomodukare ji puredugodure tuwiwo kodi.
source: Nono Jesus akore Ia imedu ure turawuje Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Jericó ba kurirewu ka. Nou awara keje iwogurewuge eiwogure nowu imeduji. Ere ukudau areia tawuje piji tugiwoguwo ji. Ere boeto ji. Ere kugudugodudo. Nono dukeje eture piji. Nou imedu bigodunure. Boe etaiwomodukare ji puredugodure tuwiwo kodi.

b: Ca ia ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwu imedu kodure nowu awara ji. Jorudure nowu ere boeto jiwu imeduji mare ure tumegido awara okwa abowu ka. Aidukare tuwo tugera maku ai.
source: Ca ia ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwu imedu kodure nowu awara ji. Jorudure nowu ere boeto jiwu imeduji mare ure tumegido awara okwa abowu ka. Aidukare tuwo tugera maku ai.

b: Dukeje ia Levi uwobe imedu kodure nono pugeje. Aiwore ji mare ure tumegido awara okwa abowu ka jamedu.
source: Dukeje ia Levi uwobe imedu kodure nono pugeje. Aiwore ji mare ure tumegido awara okwa abowu ka jamedu.

b: Nono ia moto tuginaiwu kejewu imedu kodure nowu awara ji. Samaria moto kejewunure ema. Jorudure nowu imeduji dukeje okudugodure apo. Joruduwakare ji mare okudugodure apo, dukodire ure tugera maku ai.
source: Nono ia moto tuginaiwu kejewu imedu kodure nowu awara ji. Samaria moto kejewunure ema. Jorudure nowu imeduji dukeje okudugodure apo. Joruduwakare ji mare okudugodure apo, dukodire ure tugera maku ai.

b: Ure tuburedo ji. Iogore nowu epae oiaji. Dukejere ure barigu tagu kuwaru ao ka. Nono ure reko toro boe enudumode boe enogwagemode kejewu bai ka.
source: Ure tuburedo ji. Iogore nowu epae oiaji. Dukejere ure barigu tagu kuwaru ao ka. Nono ure reko toro boe enudumode boe enogwagemode kejewu bai ka.

b: Nou barogwato ure dierodo pobe uwaire bai cewu ai jetuwo nowu imeduji. Akore Imode ikirimi dukeje imode aeture jidu morido akai pugeje.”
source: Nou barogwato ure dierodo pobe uwaire bai cewu ai jetuwo nowu imeduji. Akore Imode ikirimi dukeje imode aeture jidu morido akai pugeje.”

b: Nono Jesus unaragodure nowu imeduji. Akore kaibowu imedu ba ure timediado nowu imedu koridodurewuce?
source: Nono Jesus unaragodure nowu imeduji. Akore kaibowu imedu ba ure timediado nowu imedu koridodurewuce?

b: Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu akore Nou Samaria moto kejewu imedure jeture nowu imedu koridodurewu ji kodire ure timediado ema. Jesus akore Toro. Arodo nono nowu Samaria moto kejewu imedu ro mogadure.
source: Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu akore Nou Samaria moto kejewu imedure jeture nowu imedu koridodurewu ji kodire ure timediado ema. Jesus akore Toro. Arodo nono nowu Samaria moto kejewu imedu ro mogadure.

b: Jesus Uture Marta, Maria Ewai Ka
source: Jesus Uture Marta, Maria Ewai Ka

b: Jesus uture pugeje ture joruduwadowugebo. Etaregodure ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda kejere ia aredu mugure. Iere Marta. Imadure ebo. Makore ei enogwagewo tuwai keje.
source: Jesus uture pugeje ture joruduwadowugebo. Etaregodure ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda kejere ia aredu mugure. Iere Marta. Imadure ebo. Makore ei enogwagewo tuwai keje.

b: Nou aredu uwie iere Maria. Jesus ure turemo ewaito dukeje Maria ure tumugudo nono Jesus jokorai tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji rugadu.
source: Nou aredu uwie iere Maria. Jesus ure turemo ewaito dukeje Maria ure tumugudo nono Jesus jokorai tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji rugadu.

b: Marta maragodu kimore tumugure kejewu bai tada tuwo tuge udo turugadu, tuwo boe jamedu boe udo turugadu. Mare nowu uwie ukare tugera maku ai dukodire korigodure tuwie areduji. Dukodire Marta mako pegare tuwieji Jesus biagai. Akore ikimijeranure aki. Mare awu iwie ukare tugera maku inai. Imire ire boe jamedu boe towuje ikinaigodu. Kocare amagokare ji uwo tugera maku inai. Amagodo ji uwo tugera maku inai rugadu.
source: Marta maragodu kimore tumugure kejewu bai tada tuwo tuge udo turugadu, tuwo boe jamedu boe udo turugadu. Mare nowu uwie ukare tugera maku ai dukodire korigodure tuwie areduji. Dukodire Marta mako pegare tuwieji Jesus biagai. Akore ikimijeranure aki. Mare awu iwie ukare tugera maku inai. Imire ire boe jamedu boe towuje ikinaigodu. Kocare amagokare ji uwo tugera maku inai. Amagodo ji uwo tugera maku inai rugadu.

b: Mare Jesus makore Martaji. Akore amororamagadu kurire amaragodae jamedu boe ji.
source: Mare Jesus makore Martaji. Akore amororamagadu kurire amaragodae jamedu boe ji.

b: Mare awie Maria mearudae pemegare amearudae kori. Kodire ure tumugudo iogorai tuwiapagawo imagore jiboe ji. Boe emodukare nowu biapagare jiboe tawuje aora piji rugadu. Dukodire boe emearudaemode tuwiapagawo iwadaru ji nono nowu Maria mearudae mogadure, dukeje nowu emearudae koiare umode boe pemegado boe ji.
source: Mare awie Maria mearudae pemegare amearudae kori. Kodire ure tumugudo iogorai tuwiapagawo imagore jiboe ji. Boe emodukare nowu biapagare jiboe tawuje aora piji rugadu. Dukodire boe emearudaemode tuwiapagawo iwadaru ji nono nowu Maria mearudae mogadure, dukeje nowu emearudae koiare umode boe pemegado boe ji.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Tumagowo Baruto
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Tumagowo Baruto

b: Ia meri keje Jesus makore baru to tuo bagai. Ure joruduwadowuge eragojere nono apo. Ia akore Cegimijera. Ceruduwado cemagowo baru to nono João Batista ure joruduwadowuge emogadure.
source: Ia meri keje Jesus makore baru to tuo bagai. Ure joruduwadowuge eragojere nono apo. Ia akore Cegimijera. Ceruduwado cemagowo baru to nono João Batista ure joruduwadowuge emogadure.

b: Jesus akore ainore tagagomode baru to. Iogwa Kurirewu. Mugure baru tadawunure aki. Boe emago pemegawo akieji tuwo boe emearutorudo tu ai rugadu. Boe emearutoruwo awadaru jamedu boe ji tuwo tugimijera kurirewudo aki rugadu. Akaregodu pemegado aro pemegarewu tabo mato moto ka amearudae rugadu boe jetuwo pudui rugadu, nono aro mogadure toro baru tada dumogadure.
source: Jesus akore ainore tagagomode baru to. Iogwa Kurirewu. Mugure baru tadawunure aki. Boe emago pemegawo akieji tuwo boe emearutorudo tu ai rugadu. Boe emearutoruwo awadaru jamedu boe ji tuwo tugimijera kurirewudo aki rugadu. Akaregodu pemegado aro pemegarewu tabo mato moto ka amearudae rugadu boe jetuwo pudui rugadu, nono aro mogadure toro baru tada dumogadure.

b: Cege maku cenai meri jamedu ji.
source: Cege maku cenai meri jamedu ji.

b: Awiagodudo cero pegarewu piji nono cewiagodure ro pegare ceiwuge ero piji dumogadure. Iage etaidumode tuwo tumearudae pegarewu maku cenai tuwo cero pegado. Ceginorudo epiji cewiapagakawo nowu emearudae pegarewuji. Ceginorudo boe pegarewu piji rugadu.
source: Awiagodudo cero pegarewu piji nono cewiagodure ro pegare ceiwuge ero piji dumogadure. Iage etaidumode tuwo tumearudae pegarewu maku cenai tuwo cero pegado. Ceginorudo epiji cewiapagakawo nowu emearudae pegarewuji. Ceginorudo boe pegarewu piji rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje. Akore ia boeco aregodure toia ka dukeje imedu utumode timedia uwai ka tumagowo timediaji ia uke amirewu bagai. Akore Me. Imedia aregodu. Utu jaere tugiriadu tabo mato iwai ka. Mare ike bokware. Ia ake amirewu udo pobe metia bokware inai jao. Barogwato imode ia maku akai tuibagi pugeje.”
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje. Akore ia boeco aregodure toia ka dukeje imedu utumode timedia uwai ka tumagowo timediaji ia uke amirewu bagai. Akore Me. Imedia aregodu. Utu jaere tugiriadu tabo mato iwai ka. Mare ike bokware. Ia ake amirewu udo pobe metia bokware inai jao. Barogwato imode ia maku akai tuibagi pugeje.”

b: Mare nowu imedu umodukare tie bu. Rakojemode tu tuwai ja tada tumago tabo bataru jipagi. Akomode: “Boro. Akaradaino ipiji. Ire iwai baiporo mi marigudu. Itore enudunure. Ipadure ipa kamorewu keje marigudu iwo itamudo. Imodukare ie bu iwo iaboe maku akai rugadu. Atudo iwai piji.”
source: Mare nowu imedu umodukare tie bu. Rakojemode tu tuwai ja tada tumago tabo bataru jipagi. Akomode: “Boro. Akaradaino ipiji. Ire iwai baiporo mi marigudu. Itore enudunure. Ipadure ipa kamorewu keje marigudu iwo itamudo. Imodukare ie bu iwo iaboe maku akai rugadu. Atudo iwai piji.”

b: Mare nowu imedu utumodukare nowu timedia uwai piji rugadu. Pogurukare togwamagudu raiwo nowu imeduji ia uke amirewu bagai. Nono nowu tumagore dutabo ure nowu timediado tie bu pudae rugadu. Nono nowu metia ure nowu imedu makore bagaiwu amirewu maku ai rugadu.
source: Mare nowu imedu utumodukare nowu timedia uwai piji rugadu. Pogurukare togwamagudu raiwo nowu imeduji ia uke amirewu bagai. Nono nowu tumagore dutabo ure nowu timediado tie bu pudae rugadu. Nono nowu metia ure nowu imedu makore bagaiwu amirewu maku ai rugadu.

b: Imedu rore aino. Pao Kurirewu ro kodumode nowu imedu ro kori. Dukodire imode tawie. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo boe emagore bagaiboe maku boe etai rugadu. Dukodire tagogwamagudumode Pao Kurirewu ji iaboe bagai dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode tamagore bagaiboe maku tagai rugadu. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo boe eruduwado pudui. Dukodire taemarumode Pao Kurirewu bagai dukeje umode taruduwado pudui rugadu. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo tuwai poro jado baru tada tuwo boe edo turemo baru to. Dukodire tamode tagera to Pao Kurirewu uwai poroji dukeje umode tuwai poro jado tagai rugadu. Mare bai poro ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Imedu rore aino. Pao Kurirewu ro kodumode nowu imedu ro kori. Dukodire imode tawie. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo boe emagore bagaiboe maku boe etai rugadu. Dukodire tagogwamagudumode Pao Kurirewu ji iaboe bagai dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode tamagore bagaiboe maku tagai rugadu. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo boe eruduwado pudui. Dukodire taemarumode Pao Kurirewu bagai dukeje umode taruduwado pudui rugadu. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo tuwai poro jado baru tada tuwo boe edo turemo baru to. Dukodire tamode tagera to Pao Kurirewu uwai poroji dukeje umode tuwai poro jado tagai rugadu. Mare bai poro ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: – Ro pegarewuge eruduware turo pemegawo torei. Dukodire tagore emagomode tai karo bagai tuge boe ji koia. Nono tamodukare awagu maku etai. Tawogumode karo bagai ekece.
source: – Ro pegarewuge eruduware turo pemegawo torei. Dukodire tagore emagomode tai karo bagai tuge boe ji koia. Nono tamodukare awagu maku etai. Tawogumode karo bagai ekece.

b: Tagore enogwamagudumode kagariga ba bagai tuge boe ji koia dukeje tamode maku etai. Tamodukare betaga maku etai rugadu.
source: Tagore enogwamagudumode kagariga ba bagai tuge boe ji koia dukeje tamode maku etai. Tamodukare betaga maku etai rugadu.

b: Ro pegarewugenure tagi mare du inodu tabo taruduware taro pemegawo tagorei tawo eke pemegarewu maku etai. Taruduware tawo boe pemegarewu maku tagore etai. Mare Pao Kurirewu pemegare rugadu. Dukodire umode boe pemegarewu maku boe etai rugadu du kodumode nowu tare maku tagore etaiboe kori. Umode Tuwari maku okwamagudure puduiwuge etai rugadu.
source: Ro pegarewugenure tagi mare du inodu tabo taruduware taro pemegawo tagorei tawo eke pemegarewu maku etai. Taruduware tawo boe pemegarewu maku tagore etai. Mare Pao Kurirewu pemegare rugadu. Dukodire umode boe pemegarewu maku boe etai rugadu du kodumode nowu tare maku tagore etaiboe kori. Umode Tuwari maku okwamagudure puduiwuge etai rugadu.

b: Boe Egore Bope Uwari Kurirewu Belzebu Metuie Jesus Tada
source: Boe Egore Bope Uwari Kurirewu Belzebu Metuie Jesus Tada

b: Jesus ure bope uwari pegarewu tawuje imedu piji. Nou bope uwari ure nowu imedu mako bokwado. Mare Jesus ure nowu bope uwari tawuje piji dukodire nowu imedu makore pugeje. Boe erudure Jesus rore aino duji dukeje erore ta je.
source: Jesus ure bope uwari pegarewu tawuje imedu piji. Nou bope uwari ure nowu imedu mako bokwado. Mare Jesus ure nowu bope uwari tawuje piji dukodire nowu imedu makore pugeje. Boe erudure Jesus rore aino duji dukeje erore ta je.

b: Mare iage emearutorukare ji. Dukodire egore bope doge eimijera pegarewu Belzebu meture Jesus tada dukodire ure turaga maku Jesus ai Jesus uwo bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji.
source: Mare iage emearutorukare ji. Dukodire egore bope doge eimijera pegarewu Belzebu meture Jesus tada dukodire ure turaga maku Jesus ai Jesus uwo bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji.

b: Ia mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge etaidure tunarawo Jesus ji tuwo Jesus barigu boeto. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.
source: Ia mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge etaidure tunarawo Jesus ji tuwo Jesus barigu boeto. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.

b: Mare Jesus joruduware emearudae pegarewuji. Dukodire makore ei. Akore boe epomodukare puapo dukeje emearudaere tu turugoduwo pui dukeje etagedumode. Boe erugodumode tuwobei dukeje emode tugera ra pubiji rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus joruduware emearudae pegarewuji. Dukodire makore ei. Akore boe epomodukare puapo dukeje emearudaere tu turugoduwo pui dukeje etagedumode. Boe erugodumode tuwobei dukeje emode tugera ra pubiji rugadu.

b: Ca mearutorure Satanás jiwuge epomodukare puapo dukeje emearudaere tu turugoduwo pui dukodi etagedumode. Kocare tagagore nowu Satanás raka taboie ire bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji.
source: Ca mearutorure Satanás jiwuge epomodukare puapo dukeje emearudaere tu turugoduwo pui dukodi etagedumode. Kocare tagagore nowu Satanás raka taboie ire bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji.

b: Mare nowu tare joruduwadowuge nuba erore tuwo nowu bope uwari tawuje boe epiji? Pao Kurirewu raka tabore eroino kana? Tu Pao Kurirewu rakare tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji rugadu. Dukodire nowu tare joruduwadowuge egomode pagaie tagagoino, Belzebu raka tabo karega ire bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji rugadu.
source: Mare nowu tare joruduwadowuge nuba erore tuwo nowu bope uwari tawuje boe epiji? Pao Kurirewu raka tabore eroino kana? Tu Pao Kurirewu rakare tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji rugadu. Dukodire nowu tare joruduwadowuge egomode pagaie tagagoino, Belzebu raka tabo karega ire bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu koiare ure turaga maku inai iwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji rugadu. Dukodire boe erudure Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu ji rugadu. Turore aino dutabo Pao Kurirewu makonure boe ewagai ewo tugimijera kurirewudo tu pudumi rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu koiare ure turaga maku inai iwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji rugadu. Dukodire boe erudure Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu ji rugadu. Turore aino dutabo Pao Kurirewu makonure boe ewagai ewo tugimijera kurirewudo tu pudumi rugadu.

b: – Tugobaigare rakarewu umode tuwaiga pemegado rugadu. Umode tudariga merido tietu pemegawo tuwaiji, tietu pemegawo toeji.
source: – Tugobaigare rakarewu umode tuwaiga pemegado rugadu. Umode tudariga merido tietu pemegawo tuwaiji, tietu pemegawo toeji.

b: Mare iwogurewu joruduware turagamode ji dukeje umode tubodo apo rugadu. Umode tugobaigare butudo dukeje umode tugeragu uwaigaji piji, utariga kurirewu ji piji jamedu. Umode tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji tuduwo tabo toro tumedage etae tuwo pedo pui.
source: Mare iwogurewu joruduware turagamode ji dukeje umode tubodo apo rugadu. Umode tugobaigare butudo dukeje umode tugeragu uwaigaji piji, utariga kurirewu ji piji jamedu. Umode tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji tuduwo tabo toro tumedage etae tuwo pedo pui.

b: – Aidukare iwu aidumode turo pegawo i tuwo iro pegado. Ukare tugera maku inaiwu umodukare boe etarego itae. Umode boe edo taodo ipiji.
source: – Aidukare iwu aidumode turo pegawo i tuwo iro pegado. Ukare tugera maku inaiwu umodukare boe etarego itae. Umode boe edo taodo ipiji.

b: Bope Uwari Umode Tugirimi
source: Bope Uwari Umode Tugirimi

b: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore bope uwari pegarewu umode tudawuje ia imedu piji dukeje utumode toro boe maerewu ka taiwo tabo tumode tamudo kejeboe bagai. Jorudumodukare taidure jiboe ji dukeje mearudaemode tuwo tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu bagai pugeje tuwo turemo to pugeje.
source: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore bope uwari pegarewu umode tudawuje ia imedu piji dukeje utumode toro boe maerewu ka taiwo tabo tumode tamudo kejeboe bagai. Jorudumodukare taidure jiboe ji dukeje mearudaemode tuwo tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu bagai pugeje tuwo turemo to pugeje.

b: Dukodire nowu bope uwari pegarewu umode tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae rugadu. Aregodumode dukeje jorudumode ji pemegare duji. Jorudumode ji ure nono tuwai moturewu mogadure duji.
source: Dukodire nowu bope uwari pegarewu umode tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae rugadu. Aregodumode dukeje jorudumode ji pemegare duji. Jorudumode ji ure nono tuwai moturewu mogadure duji.

b: Dukejere utumode toro tumedage bope doge ewagai. Enodo padure sete. Makomode ei etuwo pudabo toro nowu imedu ae. Nono emode turemo nowu imeduto pugeje. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu imeduji rugadu. Boetojiwu meture tadawu bope uwari ure mitotu je. Aino care bope doge enodo padu kejewumode oito nowu imedu tada. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu imeduji rugadu.
source: Dukejere utumode toro tumedage bope doge ewagai. Enodo padure sete. Makomode ei etuwo pudabo toro nowu imedu ae. Nono emode turemo nowu imeduto pugeje. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu imeduji rugadu. Boetojiwu meture tadawu bope uwari ure mitotu je. Aino care bope doge enodo padu kejewumode oito nowu imedu tada. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu imeduji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Egaregodu Remawuwo Pudui
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Egaregodu Remawuwo Pudui

b: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje, nowu boe etoiadada ia aredu ure tumago rakado toro Jesus ae mare mako pemeganure ji. Akore ace maragodu rakare tuwo arijodudo. Kurijirigodure awoduwo. Ure akogwagirido. Mare aino care boe pemegare aceji rugadu. Jakarere pudui rugadu arore jiboe ji, amagore jiboe ji.
source: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje, nowu boe etoiadada ia aredu ure tumago rakado toro Jesus ae mare mako pemeganure ji. Akore ace maragodu rakare tuwo arijodudo. Kurijirigodure awoduwo. Ure akogwagirido. Mare aino care boe pemegare aceji rugadu. Jakarere pudui rugadu arore jiboe ji, amagore jiboe ji.

b: Jesus makore nowu aredu bataru jipagi. Akore boro. Boe pemegamode biapagare Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei, mearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ji. Egare remawumode pudui rugadu.
source: Jesus makore nowu aredu bataru jipagi. Akore boro. Boe pemegamode biapagare Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei, mearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ji. Egare remawumode pudui rugadu.

b: Boe Emagore Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewu Bagai Pugeje
source: Boe Emagore Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewu Bagai Pugeje

b: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Ere taiado apo rugadu tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji. Mare pagatu jere eroino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo Jesus bataru ji. Nono Jesus akore aino care boe emearudae pegare rugadu, ero pegare rugadu. Ainore tamearudaere jamedu. Tamagore i iwo ia iro rakarewu towuje taegai taruduwo iro rakarewu ji taruduwawo kaboba nuie imi. Mare pagatu jere tagagoino. Tarudure iro rakarewu ji marigudu. Mare tagaidukare taruduwawo i. Tagaidukare tamearutoruwo i rugadu. Dukodire iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji taegai pugeje. Mare boemode i nono boere Jonas jitu mogadure. Dukejere boe eruduwamode i rugadu.
source: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Ere taiado apo rugadu tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji. Mare pagatu jere eroino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo Jesus bataru ji.
