Tagaidukare tamearutoruwo i rugadu. Dukodire iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji taegai pugeje. Mare boemode i nono boere Jonas jitu mogadure. Dukejere boe eruduwamode i rugadu.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure Jonas tawuje karo kurirewu kuri piji turo rakarewu tabo Jonas utuwo Nínive ba kurirewu ka Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo. Dukodire nowu Nínive kejewuge eruduware boe jokodu jire Jonas akoino pudui duji. Pao Kurirewu umode itawuje birewuge eda piji turo rakarewu tabo jamedu dukodire taruduwamode boe jokodu jire inagoino tai duji rugadu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure Jonas tawuje karo kurirewu kuri piji turo rakarewu tabo Jonas utuwo Nínive ba kurirewu ka Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo. Dukodire nowu Nínive kejewuge eruduware boe jokodu jire Jonas akoino pudui duji. Pao Kurirewu umode itawuje birewuge eda piji turo rakarewu tabo jamedu dukodire taruduwamode boe jokodu jire inagoino tai duji rugadu.

b: Marigudu Sabá moto kejewuge boe eimijerago kurirewudo aidure rugadu tuioruduwawo Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Salomão joruduware jiboe ji. Dukodire ure tudawuje to moto piji tuduwo toro Salomão uwai ka tumearuduwo Salomão makore jiboe ji. Mare boe eimijera kurirewunure imi. Iro kodure Salomão ro kori. Ioruduware jiboe kodure Salomão joruduware jiboe kori. Mare du inodu tabo tagaidukare tamearutoruwo i. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eewodudo pugeje taiwowo boe ero pegarewu bagai tuwo boe pegado ei ero pegarewu morice. Nou meri ji nowu Sabá moto kejewu boe eimijerago aredu mako pegamode tai tawiapagakare awu iwadaru ji kodi.
source: Marigudu Sabá moto kejewuge boe eimijerago kurirewudo aidure rugadu tuioruduwawo Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Salomão joruduware jiboe ji. Dukodire ure tudawuje to moto piji tuduwo toro Salomão uwai ka tumearuduwo Salomão makore jiboe ji. Mare boe eimijera kurirewunure imi. Iro kodure Salomão ro kori. Ioruduware jiboe kodure Salomão joruduware jiboe kori. Mare du inodu tabo tagaidukare tamearutoruwo i. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eewodudo pugeje taiwowo boe ero pegarewu bagai tuwo boe pegado ei ero pegarewu morice. Nou meri ji nowu Sabá moto kejewu boe eimijerago aredu mako pegamode tai tawiapagakare awu iwadaru ji kodi.

b: Marigudu Jonas uture Nínive ba kurirewu ka tuwo nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Emearudure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukodi ekiarigodure turo pegarewuji. Ere tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji rugadu tumearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare boe eimijera kurirewunure imi. Iro kodure nowu Jonas ro kori. Ioruduware jiboe kodure Jonas joruduware jiboe kori. Mare du inodu tabo tagaidukare tamearutoruwo i. Tagaidukare tawo tagera ra nowu taro pegarewu piji rugadu. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eewodudo pugeje taiwowo boe ero pegarewu bagai tuwo boe pegado ei ero pegarewu morice. Nou meri keje nowu Nínive kejewuge emago pegamode tai tawiapagakare awu iwadaru ji dukodi.

b: Boe Erudure Jesus ji Rugadu
source: Boe Erudure Jesus ji Rugadu

b: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore boe emode jorugu biado dukeje urugumodukare. Boe emode pori bu jorugu aogeje dukeje urugumodukare. Mare boe emode jorugu bararedo, uruguwo pudui boe ewo turemo tuwaito.
source: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore boe emode jorugu biado dukeje urugumodukare. Boe emode pori bu jorugu aogeje dukeje urugumodukare. Mare boe emode jorugu bararedo, uruguwo pudui boe ewo turemo tuwaito.

b: Tuioku tabore boe erudure boe ji. Mare boe eku pegare dukeje erudumodukare boe ji. Imagore jiboe ure nono boe eku mogadure. Mare boe eku ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutorumode tu imagore jiboe ji dukeje boe emearudae kurimode rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Mare boe emearutorumodukare imagore jiboe ji dukeje emearudae bokwamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Tuioku tabore boe erudure boe ji. Mare boe eku pegare dukeje erudumodukare boe ji. Imagore jiboe ure nono boe eku mogadure. Mare boe eku ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutorumode tu imagore jiboe ji dukeje boe emearudae kurimode rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Mare boe emearutorumodukare imagore jiboe ji dukeje emearudae bokwamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Dukodire care tamearutorudo imagore jiboe ji. Tagaidumodukare tamearutoruwo imagore jiboe ji dukeje boecomode tai rugadu. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Taruduwa bokwamode taro pegare jiboe ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Dukodire care tamearutorudo imagore jiboe ji. Tagaidumodukare tamearutoruwo imagore jiboe ji dukeje boecomode tai rugadu. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Taruduwa bokwamode taro pegare jiboe ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Mare tamearutorumode imagore jiboe ji dukeje jorugumode tai. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu bokwamode pugeje. Dujire inagoino. Tagaidumodukare taro pegawo pugeje. Taro pemegamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Mare tamearutorumode imagore jiboe ji dukeje jorugumode tai. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu bokwamode pugeje. Dujire inagoino. Tagaidumodukare taro pegawo pugeje. Taro pemegamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Jesus Mako Pegare Fariseu Dogei, Mako Pegare Joruduware Judeu Doge Eno Bakaru Jiwugei Jamedu
source: Jesus Mako Pegare Fariseu Dogei, Mako Pegare Joruduware Judeu Doge Eno Bakaru Jiwugei Jamedu

b: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje ia fariseu imedu makore ji utuwo pudabo toro tuwai ka okwagewo pudabo tuwai keje. Dukodire Jesus uture nowu fariseu uwai ka. Ure turemo uwaito dukeje ure tumugudo ira keje togwagewo.
source: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje ia fariseu imedu makore ji utuwo pudabo toro tuwai ka okwagewo pudabo tuwai keje. Dukodire Jesus uture nowu fariseu uwai ka. Ure turemo uwaito dukeje ure tumugudo ira keje togwagewo.

b: Mare Jesus ukare tugera kabi nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Nou fariseu jerore ta je tuiorudure Jesus rore aino duji.
source: Mare Jesus ukare tugera kabi nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Nou fariseu jerore ta je tuiorudure Jesus rore aino duji.

b: Mare Jesus joruduware nowu fariseu mearudae ji. Dukodire akore Fariseu dogenure tagi. Tare taruwobo kabi tabagaga kabi tawo epemegado tarowo nono Pao Kurirewu ure maku tagaiwu bakaru umogadure. Tare taragado tai tawo nowu tagoroe kabi rugadu tabemegawo nono nowu makudure tagaiwu bakaru umogadure taro boe ji. Mare kocare tu tadadare tamearudae pegarewu meture. Taruduwa bokware! Tagare tamearudae pegarewu barigu tabiji. Tawiapagare tu tai tawo tagoe kurido tamedage ekori rugadu. Tagaidure tawo boe pegado boei, tawo boe rakado boe ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare ure boe jamedu boe towuje. Ure boe etowuje jamedu. Eire Pao Kurirewu ure maku tagaiwu bakaru akoino jamedu boe ewo nono nowu ture kabiwu turuwobo mogadure tubagaga mogadure jamedu. Mare tu boe eruwobo ji karega akoino. Tu boe epagaga ji karega akoino jamedu. Meture boe etadawu emearudae jire akoino. Ca meture taruwobo tadaboe maku marenarue doge etai. Padure tabagaga tadaboe maku marenarue doge etai jamedu. Taromode aino dukeje tabemegamode tarowo nono tago bakaru umogadure taro boe ji. Mare nowu tamearudae pemegarewu tabo tamode boe pemegado tai jamedu.

b: Jesus mako raire nowu boe ji. Akore Fariseu dogenure tagi. Tare tago boepa pijiwu boe arurogu mori kurireboe kado puiato tu tu je tagomeawo iarogu tabo Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu. Mare tamearudaekare tawo taro jetorodo boe ji. Tamearudaekare tamearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu. Kodire boe pegamode tai rugadu. Tamearudu kurido Pao Kurirewu ji. Taro jetorodo boe ji. Mare tawiagodukaba tawo nowu mori kurireboe kado puiato tu tu je tagomeawo iarogu tabo Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu.

Mare tawiagodukaba tawo nowu mori kurireboe kado puiato tu tu je tagomeawo iarogu tabo Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu.

b: – Fariseu dogenure tagi. Tadumode Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka dukeje tare tageragu boe eimijera mugure kejewu iraji tamuguwo keje. Tadumode ba kurirewu ka dukeje tagaidure boe emago pemegawo tai tagaidure boe ekimijeragewo tagi kodi. Dukodire boe pegamode tai rugadu!

b: Tare nono birewuge emedure tadawu moto poro mogadure. Mare moto poro ji karega inagoino. Tabegarewu meture tadada tamearudae pegare kodi. Dujire inagoino. Boe eruduwakare ia birewuge edaji dukodire emerumode birewuge etaoji. Erudumodukare birewu meture nowu moto tada duji. Tare nono nowu boe eruduwakare jiwu birewuge eda mogadure. Mare birewuge eda ji karega inagoino tai. Boe erudukare nowu meture tadadawu tamearudae pegarewuji. Dujire inagoino tai. Dukodire boe pegamode tai rugadu!
source: Tare nono birewuge emedure tadawu moto poro mogadure. Mare moto poro ji karega inagoino. Tabegarewu meture tadada tamearudae pegare kodi. Dujire inagoino. Boe eruduwakare ia birewuge edaji dukodire emerumode birewuge etaoji. Erudumodukare birewu meture nowu moto tada duji. Tare nono nowu boe eruduwakare jiwu birewuge eda mogadure. Mare birewuge eda ji karega inagoino tai. Boe erudukare nowu meture tadadawu tamearudae pegarewuji. Dujire inagoino tai. Dukodire boe pegamode tai rugadu!

b: Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu makore Jesus ji. Akore amago pegare fariseu dogei dutabore amago pegare cei jamedu.
source: Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu makore Jesus ji. Akore amago pegare fariseu dogei dutabore amago pegare cei jamedu.

b: Jesus akore Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugenure ia tagi. Mare boe pegamode tai jamedu. Tare boe eruduwado bakaruji mare tawo boe pemegado ei karega. Tagogudukare boebo. Tagaidure tawo boe rakado boe ji rugadu. Tagare tagera maku boe etai rugadu.
source: Jesus akore Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugenure ia tagi. Mare boe pegamode tai jamedu. Tare boe eruduwado bakaruji mare tawo boe pemegado ei karega. Tagogudukare boebo. Tagaidure tawo boe rakado boe ji rugadu. Tagare tagera maku boe etai rugadu.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore tumoduie joruduware tuwadaru jiwuge etarego boe etae ewo boe ewie iwu bakaruji. Mare boe emoduie iage ewido. Emoduie boe pegado iagei jamedu. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. Ainore mariguduwu tawobe erore rugadu. Ero pegare nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei rugadu. Ere iage ewido rugadu. Aino care tare tori moturewu rakojedo nowu birewuge etugudure towu moto keje boe eruduwawo nonore nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge birewuge emedure. Mare tamearutorukare nowu bitodurewuge emagore jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dukodire boe eruduware tamearudae ji. Tamearudaere nono nowu tawobe mariguduwu emearudae pegarewu mogadure rugadu. Tagaidure emearudae pegarewu ji rugadu.

Tagaidure emearudae pegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado tai rugadu nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ewi morice.
source: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado tai rugadu nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ewi morice.

b: Tawobe ere ro pemegarewuge ewido marigudu. Ere imedu Abel bito. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu boeto jiwunure ema. Ere makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu boigoduwu Zacarias bito jamedu. Ere nowu Zacarias bito Pao Kurirewu uwai jokorai rugadu. Nou Abel pijire jii nowu Zacarias ae makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagare rugadu. Mare tawobe mariguduwuge ere iage ewido jamedu. Dukodire awu maiwu pawobe emode mariguduwu jaoboe ero pegarewu morido, aino kuri aino. Inure tawie boe remawu ji rugadu.
source: Tawobe ere ro pemegarewuge ewido marigudu. Ere imedu Abel bito. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu boeto jiwunure ema. Ere makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu boigoduwu Zacarias bito jamedu. Dukodire awu maiwu pawobe emode mariguduwu jaoboe ero pegarewu morido, aino kuri aino. Inure tawie boe remawu ji rugadu.

b: Taetu pemegare Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera kejewuji. Taro pemegare nowu baperaji rugadu. Taruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare du inodu tabo taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Dukodire tamearutorukare ji. Tagagore taie boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare tu tamearudae jire tare boe eruduwado. Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji karega tagagoino boe ji. Dukodire nowu tare joruduwadowuge eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji jamedu. Dukodi care boe pegamode tai rugadu.
source: Taetu pemegare Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera kejewuji. Taro pemegare nowu baperaji rugadu. Taruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare du inodu tabo taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Dukodire tamearutorukare ji. Tagagore taie boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare tu tamearudae jire tare boe eruduwado. Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji karega tagagoino boe ji. Dukodire nowu tare joruduwadowuge eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji jamedu. Dukodi care boe pegamode tai rugadu.

b: Jesus ure tuwadaru iado dukeje uture nowu boe epiji. Dukejere nowu fariseu doge, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emago pegare Jesus ji rugadu. Eture rekodaji tunarawo ji dutabore ere tumago rakado ji boe jamedu boe bagai.
source: Jesus ure tuwadaru iado dukeje uture nowu boe epiji. Dukejere nowu fariseu doge, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emago pegare Jesus ji rugadu. Eture rekodaji tunarawo ji dutabore ere tumago rakado ji boe jamedu boe bagai.

b: Etaidure tuwo Jesus barigu boeto ia tuwadaru keje.
source: Etaidure tuwo Jesus barigu boeto ia tuwadaru keje.

b: Jesus Makore Boei Emearudae Kaiago Nono Nou Fariseu Doge Emearudae Mogadure.
source: Jesus Makore Boei Emearudae Kaiago Nono Nou Fariseu Doge Emearudae Mogadure.

b: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Dukodire ere tuwuredo pu bure keje rugadu. Mare Jesus makore tu ture joruduwadowugei boeto ji. Akore taeku jado nowu fariseu doge emearudaere jiboe ji. Emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Mare fermento remawu ji karega inagoino. Emearudaere tuwo turo pegarewu biado boe epiji tu tu je. Ere boe emearutorudo tu tuwadaru ji mare emage emearutorukare nowu tumagore jiboe ji. Dujire inagoino. Tarokaba nono ero mogadure.
source: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Dukodire ere tuwuredo pu bure keje rugadu. Mare Jesus makore tu ture joruduwadowugei boeto ji. Akore taeku jado nowu fariseu doge emearudaere jiboe ji. Emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Mare fermento remawu ji karega inagoino. Emearudaere tuwo turo pegarewu biado boe epiji tu tu je. Ere boe emearutorudo tu tuwadaru ji mare emage emearutorukare nowu tumagore jiboe ji. Dujire inagoino. Tarokaba nono ero mogadure.

b: Boe ero pegamode dukeje etaidumode tuwo nowu turo pegarewu biado boe epiji tagowo ro pemegarewuge nuie pudumi. Mare Pao Kurirewu joruduware ero pegarewu ji marigudu dukodire boe eruduwamode nowu ero pegarewu ji jamedu. Dukodire itaidure iwo tawie. Tarokaba nono fariseu doge ero mogadure. Tamago pegamode iaboe ji boeco ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu mearudumode rugadu. Toro ia meri keje boe eiamedu boe emearudumode nowu tamagore jiboe ji jamedu. Tamago podumode pui pu bijato ia tamearudae pegarewu ji tawai tada mare Pao Kurirewu mearudumode nowu tamagore jiboe ji rugadu. Dukodire uwadodumode nowu tamagore jiboe tabo boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire inure tawie. Taro pegakaba, tamago pegakaba nono nowu fariseu doge ero mogadure.

Dukodire inure tawie. Taro pegakaba, tamago pegakaba nono nowu fariseu doge ero mogadure.

b: Boe Epagudumode Ceboe Reo
source: Boe Epagudumode Ceboe Reo

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore imedagenure tagi. Iwo tawie. Tabagudukaba boece. Tabagudukaba bope dogece. Boe emode tawido mare eragakare tuwo tawarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Bope uwari umode boe pegado tai mare rakakare tuwo tawarigu tieda kejewu joru pegarewuto.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore imedagenure tagi. Iwo tawie. Tabagudukaba boece. Tabagudukaba bope dogece. Boe emode tawido mare eragakare tuwo tawarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Bope uwari umode boe pegado tai mare rakakare tuwo tawarigu tieda kejewu joru pegarewuto.

b: Iwo tawie. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Tu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare umode boe ewarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto boe ewi keje. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce.
source: Iwo tawie. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Tu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare umode boe ewarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto boe ewi keje. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce.

b: Mare tabagudu remawu ji karega inagoino. Taeku kidugo Pao Kurirewu ji tamearutoruwo tu ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Tamearutorumode tu Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje tamororamagadumodukare boe pega boe ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino. Pao Kurirewu jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire tamearutorudo tu ji rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Ca kiebarege kugure emode ikera aboudure dukeje boe emode diero torirogu udo pobe emorice tuwo akirodo ei tugece tuwo ekowuje. Nou kiebarege emori bokware. Mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu kiebarege ekugure piji rugadu jii toro. Joruduware kiebarege eiamedu boe ji. Aidure kiebarege kugurei. Mare Pao Kurirewu aidure tai du kodure nowu kiebarege kugure eiamedu boe ekori. Dukodire jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Joruduware tai rugadu. Joruduware tagao iku jamedu boe ji. Joruduware nowu inodurogu boe ji kodire joruduware nuba boe mode tai duji rugadu. Jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tabagudukawo boece pugeje.

b: Nuba Boe Emearudaemode Jesus ji
source: Nuba Boe Emearudaemode Jesus ji

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Iwo tawie. Ia boe emagomode boe eiamedu boe ewiagai tuie tumagu inai tumearutoruwo tu i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ewiagai nowu mearutorure iwu nuie ema rugadu.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Iwo tawie. Ia boe emagomode boe eiamedu boe ewiagai tuie tumagu inai tumearutoruwo tu i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ewiagai nowu mearutorure iwu nuie ema rugadu.

b: Mare ia boe emagomode boe ewiagai tugaie tumagu inai, tumearutorukaie i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ewiagai nowu mearutorukare iwu nuie ema rugadu.
source: Mare ia boe emagomode boe ewiagai tugaie tumagu inai, tumearutorukaie i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ewiagai nowu mearutorukare iwu nuie ema rugadu.

b: Boe emago pegamode Imedu Onaregeduji mare toro ia meri keje ekiarigodumode nowu tuwadaru pegarewuji. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu ji biagoduwo nowu tuwadaru pegarewu piji. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu.
source: Boe emago pegamode Imedu Onaregeduji mare toro ia meri keje ekiarigodumode nowu tuwadaru pegarewuji. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu ji biagoduwo nowu tuwadaru pegarewu piji. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu.

b: Tamearutorure i. Dukodire boe emode tugeragu tai tuwo tarego boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo taro pegarewu bagai tuwo boe pegado tai tamearutorure i dukodi. Emago pegamode tai mare tamororamagadukaba tamagowo ewadaru jipagi.
source: Tamearutorure i. Dukodire boe emode tugeragu tai tuwo tarego boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo taro pegarewu bagai tuwo boe pegado tai tamearutorure i dukodi. Emago pegamode tai mare tamororamagadukaba tamagowo ewadaru jipagi.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode taruduwado nowu meri ji tamago pemegawo ewadaru jipagi.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode taruduwado nowu meri ji tamago pemegawo ewadaru jipagi.

b: Ia Imedu Oe Kurirewu Joruduwa Bokwarewu O Bakaru Reo
source: Ia Imedu Oe Kurirewu Joruduwa Bokwarewu O Bakaru Reo

b: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Ia imedu makore Jesus ji. Akore ure boe eruduwadowunure aki rugadu. Care inogwamaguduwo ai. Amagodo imanaji uwo iogware maku pudaiwu moto kado puiato uwo ia maku inai inoce jamedu.
source: Boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Ia imedu makore Jesus ji. Akore ure boe eruduwadowunure aki rugadu. Care inogwamaguduwo ai. Amagodo imanaji uwo iogware maku pudaiwu moto kado puiato uwo ia maku inai inoce jamedu.

b: Jesus akore Itaidure ai. Mare umode boe enoe kado puiatowu boe eimijera karegure imi.
source: Jesus akore Itaidure ai. Mare umode boe enoe kado puiatowu boe eimijera karegure imi.

b: Dukodire Jesus makore boe eiamedu boe ji. Akore taeku jado. Boe emearudaere tu pudui tuwo toe kurido tumedage ekori rugadu. Taragado tai tarokawo nono nowu boe ero mogadure. Tagoe kurimode mare tagoe umodukare tamugu pemegado. Boe enoe koia karega umode boe emugu pemegado moto keje tiegarere pudui dutabo.
source: Dukodire Jesus makore boe eiamedu boe ji. Akore taeku jado. Boe emearudaere tu pudui tuwo toe kurido tumedage ekori rugadu. Taragado tai tarokawo nono nowu boe ero mogadure. Tagoe kurimode mare tagoe umodukare tamugu pemegado. Boe enoe koia karega umode boe emugu pemegado moto keje tiegarere pudui dutabo.

b: Nono Jesus makore ia bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai. Akore ia imedu oe kurire. O moto kurire. O boepa kurire rugadu. Nouia joruji ure kadoboe kurire rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ia bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai. Akore ia imedu oe kurire. O moto kurire. O boepa kurire rugadu. Nouia joruji ure kadoboe kurire rugadu.

b: Ure boe jamedu boe tawuje nowu to boepa piji dukeje makore tudada. Akore Imode biadowu towu bai kurikare iwo ire kadoboe jamedu boe jetudo ja tada. Ca nuba iromode?”
source: Ure boe jamedu boe tawuje nowu to boepa piji dukeje makore tudada. Akore Imode biadowu towu bai kurikare iwo ire kadoboe jamedu boe jetudo ja tada. Ca nuba iromode?”

b: Nono ure tumearudae tawuje pugeje. Akore Ainore iromode. Imode nowu iwai jamedu boe butudo iwo ia iwai kurirewu mugudo pugeje iwo ire kadoboe jamedu boe jetudo nowu iwai kurirewu maiwu ja tada, iwo inoe kurirewu jamedu boe jetudo nowu iwai kurirewu ja tada jamedu.
source: Nono ure tumearudae tawuje pugeje. Akore Ainore iromode. Imode nowu iwai jamedu boe butudo iwo ia iwai kurirewu mugudo pugeje iwo ire kadoboe jamedu boe jetudo nowu iwai kurirewu maiwu ja tada, iwo inoe kurirewu jamedu boe jetudo nowu iwai kurirewu ja tada jamedu.

b: Dukeje inagomode iwaidigirire rugadu. Aino care imode itamudo rugadu. Imaragodumodukare pugeje. Nono iagaremode inogwarimode nowu inoe kurirewu jamedu boe ji. Joru makamode i mare inoe akedumodukare inoe kurire kodi. Care iwadumode imedagebo. Inogwagemode. Ikudumode. Boe pemegamode i rugadu jii toro rugadu. Boe rakamodukare i pugeje.”
source: Dukeje inagomode iwaidigirire rugadu. Aino care imode itamudo rugadu. Imaragodumodukare pugeje. Nono iagaremode inogwarimode nowu inoe kurirewu jamedu boe ji. Joru makamode i mare inoe akedumodukare inoe kurire kodi. Care iwadumode imedagebo. Inogwagemode. Ikudumode. Boe pemegamode i rugadu jii toro rugadu. Boe rakamodukare i pugeje.”

b: – Ainore nowu imedu akore. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu oe kurirewu imeduji. Akore Aruduwa bokware. Awu boeco ji awimode rugadu. Mare atumodukare nowu akoe kurirewu boe tabo. Nou akoe mugumode aiageje moto keje. Ca duboba umode tugeragu nowu akoeji?”
source: – Ainore nowu imedu akore. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu oe kurirewu imeduji. Akore Aruduwa bokware. Awu boeco ji awimode rugadu. Mare atumodukare nowu akoe kurirewu boe tabo. Nou akoe mugumode aiageje moto keje. Ca duboba umode tugeragu nowu akoeji?”

b: Nono Jesus makore pugeje. Akore ainore boemode nowu ure toe kuridowuge boe eiamedu boe ji. Ere toe kurido mare ewiapagakare tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire enoe bokwamode baru tada. Marenarue dogenure emage Pao Kurirewu jakai.
source: Nono Jesus makore pugeje. Akore ainore boemode nowu ure toe kuridowuge boe eiamedu boe ji. Ere toe kurido mare ewiapagakare tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire enoe bokwamode baru tada. Marenarue dogenure emage Pao Kurirewu jakai.

b: Pao Kurirewu Jire Pamearutorumode
source: Pao Kurirewu Jire Pamearutorumode

b: Jesus mako kimore ture jorduwadowuge ji . Akore tamororamagadukaba tage bagai, tagudau areia bagai.
source: Jesus mako kimore ture jorduwadowuge ji . Akore tamororamagadukaba tage bagai, tagudau areia bagai.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure tadowuje. Ure tawodudo. Emare jetu pemegamode tai.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure tadowuje. Ure tawodudo. Emare jetu pemegamode tai.

b: Tagaiwodo awu kiebaregei. Ekare boe tugu. Ekare tugeragu boe ji. Eke ja bokware. Eke muga bokware. Mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu koiare ure enogwagedo. Boenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji nowu kiebarege ekori. Dukodire inagoino, jetu pemegamoduie tai.
source: Tagaiwodo awu kiebaregei. Ekare boe tugu. Ekare tugeragu boe ji. Eke ja bokware. Eke muga bokware. Mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu koiare ure enogwagedo. Boenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji nowu kiebarege ekori. Dukodire inagoino, jetu pemegamoduie tai.

b: Pao Kurirewu joruduware tawimode kejewu meri ji. Tagi rema taruduwakare. Tamororamagadumode mare tamodukare tawimode kejewu meri raido toro tagododai tamugu raiwo moto keje. Dukodire inagoino, tamororamagadukaiago iaboerogu bagai pugeje. Tamearutorudo tu Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Pao Kurirewu joruduware tawimode kejewu meri ji. Tagi rema taruduwakare. Tamororamagadumode mare tamodukare tawimode kejewu meri raido toro tagododai tamugu raiwo moto keje. Dukodire inagoino, tamororamagadukaiago iaboerogu bagai pugeje. Tamearutorudo tu Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Tagaiwodo awu okureboe ji. Emodure mare emage eigoia karega ere tumodudo. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure awu okureboe emodudo aino. Mariguduwu Israel doge eimijera kurirewu Salomão oe kuricigore dukodire meture jiwu ukudau areia moture rugadu. Mare motukare nono awu okureboe emodu mogadure. Ca okureboe emodure mare joru umode ekowu kuri je. Mare boenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji nowu okureboe ekori. Dukodire umode tugera maku tagai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tamororamagadukaba tagudau areia bagai, tamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Tamearutorumode ji dukeje tamode nono awu okureboe umogadure jamedu. Pao Kurirewu jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Kocare tamearutoru kurikare ji?

b: Tamororamagadukaba nowu tagwagemode jiboe bagai. T a m o r o r a m a g a d u k a b a n o u tagudumode ceboe bagai.
source: Tamororamagadukaba nowu tagwagemode jiboe bagai. T a m o r o r a m a g a d u k a b a n o u tagudumode ceboe bagai.

b: Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ewiagorore tu nowu tuge roguji tugerogu bagai. Mare tamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje tawiagoromodukare nowu inoduji. Pao Kurirewu joruduware kaba jiba tagaidure.

b: Dukodire tamearudae tawuje tawo tagimijera kurirewudo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Tamode tagimijerado ema dukeje umode tage jamedu boe maku tagai rugadu.
source: Dukodire tamearudae tawuje tawo tagimijera kurirewudo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Tamode tagimijerado ema dukeje umode tage jamedu boe maku tagai rugadu.

b: Baru Tadawu Boe Kurirewu Remawu Reo
source: Baru Tadawu Boe Kurirewu Remawu Reo

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Tabagudukaba. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo tagimijerado pudumi tuwo boe pemegarewu maku tagai baru tada.
source: Jesus mako kimore: – Tabagudukaba. Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo tagimijerado pudumi tuwo boe pemegarewu maku tagai baru tada.

b: Tagoe rugadu boe maku. Nou morire tamode maku marenarue etai. Taromode aino dukeje tanure tagoe kurirewu jetudo baru tada. Toro tagoe akedumodukare rugadu. Toro iwogurewu iwogumodukare nowu tagoeji. Toro borewu umodukare nowu tagoe pegado.
source: Tagoe rugadu boe maku. Nou morire tamode maku marenarue etai. Taromode aino dukeje tanure tagoe kurirewu jetudo baru tada. Toro tagoe akedumodukare rugadu. Toro iwogurewu iwogumodukare nowu tagoeji. Toro borewu umodukare nowu tagoe pegado.

b: Boe etaidure tu tuwo toe kurido woe moto keje dukodire ewiagoromode tu nowu toeji woe rugadu. Nou boe ewiapagamodukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare boe emode toe jetudo baru tada dukeje boe ewiagoromodukare ia moto kejewu toeji pugeje, boe ewiapagamode tu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu.
source: Boe etaidure tu tuwo toe kurido woe moto keje dukodire ewiagoromode tu nowu toeji woe rugadu. Nou boe ewiapagamodukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Mare boe emode toe jetudo baru tada dukeje boe ewiagoromodukare ia moto kejewu toeji pugeje, boe ewiapagamode tu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu.

b: Boe Etugarege Pemegarewuge Reo
source: Boe Etugarege Pemegarewuge Reo

b: – Tado tarugadu tamaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai. Tarodo nono boe eimijera utugarege ero mogadure. Ere tumaragodure tabowu tugudau areia metudo pudui. Enoredure jorugu tabo tumaragoduwo boeco ji.
source: – Tado tarugadu tamaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai. Tarodo nono boe eimijera utugarege ero mogadure. Ere tumaragodure tabowu tugudau areia metudo pudui. Enoredure jorugu tabo tumaragoduwo boeco ji.

b: Epagare tugimijera bagai. Ekimijera uture uwiremodewu bowadae ka. Mare aregodure tuibagi tuwai ka boeco ji dukeje ure tugera to tuwai poroji. Nono utugarege ere baiporo jado kuri kuri je rugadu.
source: Epagare tugimijera bagai. Ekimijera uture uwiremodewu bowadae ka. Mare aregodure tuibagi tuwai ka boeco ji dukeje ure tugera to tuwai poroji. Nono utugarege ere baiporo jado kuri kuri je rugadu.

b: Ekimijera aregodure dukeje jorudure nowu tudugaregei enudukare duji. Dukodire jakarere pudui nowu tudugaregei. Nono utugarege egarere pudui rugadu. Egarere pudui nowu tugimijera jakarere pudui dukodi.
source: Ekimijera aregodure dukeje jorudure nowu tudugaregei enudukare duji. Dukodire jakarere pudui nowu tudugaregei. Nono utugarege egarere pudui rugadu. Egarere pudui nowu tugimijera jakarere pudui dukodi.

b: Ekimijera aregodukare kuri je. Boeco aregodure toia ka dukejere aregodure. Mare utugarege ere tudo turugadu tugimijera aregodu bagai rugadu. Dukodire egarere pudui rugadu.
source: Ekimijera aregodukare kuri je. Boeco aregodure toia ka dukejere aregodure. Mare utugarege ere tudo turugadu tugimijera aregodu bagai rugadu. Dukodire egarere pudui rugadu.

b: Uwaire bai cewu joruduwamode kaba meri kejeba iwogu kigodurewu aregodumode. Dukeje umode tudo turugadu taiwo tabo nowu iwogu kigodurewu bagai, nowu iwogu kigodurewu ukawo turemo nowu tuwaito.
source: Uwaire bai cewu joruduwamode kaba meri kejeba iwogu kigodurewu aregodumode. Dukeje umode tudo turugadu taiwo tabo nowu iwogu kigodurewu bagai, nowu iwogu kigodurewu ukawo turemo nowu tuwaito.

b: Ca iwo tawie. Tado tarugadu, taerodo tagaiwo tabo tabiji. Mare iwogurewu bagai karega. Tado tarugadu Imedu Onaregedu togi. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba aregodumode dukodire inagoino tai, tawo tado tarugadu jii toro rugadu.
source: Ca iwo tawie. Tado tarugadu, taerodo tagaiwo tabo tabiji. Mare iwogurewu bagai karega. Tado tarugadu Imedu Onaregedu togi. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba aregodumode dukodire inagoino tai, tawo tado tarugadu jii toro rugadu.

b: Boe Etugarege Ero Pemegawo
source: Boe Etugarege Ero Pemegawo

b: Pedro unarare Jesus ji. Akore tu cei na akagoino? Boe eiamedu boe ji na akagoino nowu bakaruji?
source: Pedro unarare Jesus ji. Akore tu cei na akagoino? Boe eiamedu boe ji na akagoino nowu bakaruji?

b: Jesus akore Ca nuba boemode pemegarewu joruduwarewu boe etugareji? Ukimijera aidumode tuduwo toro ia moto ka dukeje umode nowu tudugare pemegarewu mugudo tumugato tudugarege eimijerawo ema uwo eke maku etai nowu tudure jiwu meri keje.
source: Jesus akore Ca nuba boemode pemegarewu joruduwarewu boe etugareji? Ukimijera aidumode tuduwo toro ia moto ka dukeje umode nowu tudugare pemegarewu mugudo tumugato tudugarege eimijerawo ema uwo eke maku etai nowu tudure jiwu meri keje.

b: Nou utugare ro pemegamode mearutorumode tugimijeraji jii toro tugimijera aregodumode kejewu meri ka dukeje jakaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Nou utugare ro pemegamode mearutorumode tugimijeraji jii toro tugimijera aregodumode kejewu meri ka dukeje jakaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Dukejere care nowu boe eimijera umode nowu tudugare jetudo toe jamedu boe ji rugadu jetu pemegawo ji. Boe jokodu jire inagoino nowu mearutorure iwadaru jiwuge ji.
source: Dukejere care nowu boe eimijera umode nowu tudugare jetudo toe jamedu boe ji rugadu jetu pemegawo ji. Boe jokodu jire inagoino nowu mearutorure iwadaru jiwuge ji.

b: Mare ia boe utugare mearudae pegamode. Nou ukimijera utu jaemode jamedu dukeje aregodumodukare tuibagi kuri je. Nono nowu utugare pegarewu mearudaemode tugimijera aregodumodukaie pugeje. Nono umode boeto nouia tudugarege imei, aremei jamedu. Nono maragodumodukare pugeje mare okwagemode, kudumode jamedu. Nono uke kurumode ji jamedu.

Nono umode boeto nouia tudugarege imei, aremei jamedu. Nono maragodumodukare pugeje mare okwagemode, kudumode jamedu. Nono uke kurumode ji jamedu.

Nono nowu boe eimijera jorudumode nowu tudugare ro pegare duji. Dukodire nowu ukimijera umode nowu tudugare bito. Umode bowuje rugadu. Nono umode nowu tudugare mugudo mearutoru bokwarewugebo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu keje.
source: Care ia meri keje nowu ukimijera aregodumode tuibagi pugeje. Mare nowu utugare upagakare bagai. Joruduwakare aregodumode kejewu meri ji. Nono umode nowu tudugare mugudo mearutoru bokwarewugebo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu keje.

b: – Ia boe utugare joruduware tugimijera mearudae ji mare ukare turagado pudui tumearutoruwo tugimijera bataru ji. Nono nowu ukimijera umode boeto ji bukigu tabo turaga tabo rugadu. Umode boetodu kurido ji rugadu.
source: – Ia boe utugare joruduware tugimijera mearudae ji mare ukare turagado pudui tumearutoruwo tugimijera bataru ji. Nono nowu ukimijera umode boeto ji bukigu tabo turaga tabo rugadu. Umode boetodu kurido ji rugadu.

b: Ia utugare joruduwakare nowu tugimijera mearudae ji dukodire ro pegare. Dukodire ukimijera umode boeto ji bukigu tabo jamedu mare umodukare boetodu kurido ji. Boe eimijera umode tudugare maragodaerogu maku ai dukeje nowu ukimijera aidumode nowu tudugare mearutoruwo pudui tuwadaru ji uwo nowu tumaragodaerogu iado rugadu. Mare nowu ukimijera mearudaemodukare tuwo ia tumaragodae maiwu maku tudugare ai, joruduwamodukare tuwo towuje kodi. Mare boe eimijera umode tudugare joruduwado tumaragodae jamedu boe ji dukeje nowu ukimijera aidumode nowu tudugare uwo nowu tumaragodae jamedu boe towuje rugadu.

b: Boe Emearudaekare Nono Pumearudae Mogadure Jesus Makore Jiboe ji
source: Boe Emearudaekare Nono Pumearudae Mogadure Jesus Makore Jiboe ji

b: Jesus mako raire boe ji kimo. Akore itaregodure iwo joru barigu moto ka. Itaidure joru bariguduwo moto ka marigudu mare Iogwa aidukare raga. Mare joru remawu ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ro pegarewuge ji. Dujire inagoino. Ro pegarewuge ewarigudumode toro nowu joru pegarewuto. Dujire inagoino.
source: Jesus mako raire boe ji kimo. Akore itaregodure iwo joru barigu moto ka. Itaidure joru bariguduwo moto ka marigudu mare Iogwa aidukare raga. Mare joru remawu ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado ro pegarewuge ji. Dujire inagoino. Ro pegarewuge ewarigudumode toro nowu joru pegarewuto. Dujire inagoino.

b: Mare boe pegamode i boeto ji dukodire ikiarigodure rugadu.
source: Mare boe pegamode i boeto ji dukodire ikiarigodure rugadu.

b: Tamearudaere itaregodure iwo boe epemegado tai. Ca itaregodure iwo boe pemegado boe ji rugadu. Mare ia boe doge emearutorumodukare i. Dukodire emearudaemodukare nono pumearudae mogadure imagore jiboe ji. Dukodire boe epemegamodukare pui.
source: Tamearudaere itaregodure iwo boe epemegado tai. Ca itaregodure iwo boe pemegado boe ji rugadu. Mare ia boe doge emearutorumodukare i. Dukodire emearudaemodukare nono pumearudae mogadure imagore jiboe ji. Dukodire boe epemegamodukare pui.

b: Dukodi care boe epomodukare puapo dukeje emearudaemodukare nono tuwobe emearudae mogadure. Emode tugera aboudure dukeje. Nou ime pobedu doge emearudae pegamode nouia tuwobe emearudaere jiboe ji, dukodire emode tuiado pubiji.
source: Dukodi care boe epomodukare puapo dukeje emearudaemodukare nono tuwobe emearudae mogadure. Emode tugera aboudure dukeje. Nou ime pobedu doge emearudae pegamode nouia tuwobe emearudaere jiboe ji, dukodire emode tuiado pubiji.

b: Ime emearudaemodukare nono tuo mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuo mearudae pegamode nowu tore imei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono tuje mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuje mearudae pegamode nowu tore aremei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono turagomage emearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu eturagomage emearudae pegamode nowu tujarugomagei.
source: Ime emearudaemodukare nono tuo mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuo mearudae pegamode nowu tore imei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono tuje mearudae mogadure. b: Ainore Boe Eruduwamode Nuba Boemode Motoji
source: Ainore Boe Eruduwamode Nuba Boemode Motoji

b: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe ji. Akore tarudumode ia boe tugu corewu ji baru tada kodure tagae duji dukeje tagagomode bubutumoduie rugadu. Nono bubuture rugadu.
source: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe ji. Akore tarudumode ia boe tugu corewu ji baru tada kodure tagae duji dukeje tagagomode bubutumoduie rugadu. Nono bubuture rugadu.

b: Bakuru ururewu jetumode tai dukeje tagagomode awu meri ji boeru butumoduie jamedu. Nono boerure rugadu.
source: Bakuru ururewu jetumode tai dukeje tagagomode awu meri ji boeru butumoduie jamedu. Nono boerure rugadu.

b: Taruduware tawo boe ewie bubutuji boeruji. Dukodire tagagore joruduwarewuge nuie tagi. Nono tagagomode taruduwaie nuba boemoduie boe ji. Mare kocare mearutorukare tuwadaru jiwugenure tagi. Tagagore taruduwaie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Tarudure iro rakarewu remawu ji mare taruduwakare kaba jiba iroino. Dukodi care taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji.
source: Taruduware tawo boe ewie bubutuji boeruji. Dukodire tagagore joruduwarewuge nuie tagi. Nono tagagomode taruduwaie nuba boemoduie boe ji. Mare kocare mearutorukare tuwadaru jiwugenure tagi. Tagagore taruduwaie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Tarudure iro rakarewu remawu ji mare taruduwakare kaba jiba iroino. Dukodi care taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji.

b: Boe Ewo Tubemegado Aidukare Puduiwugei
source: Boe Ewo Tubemegado Aidukare Puduiwugei

b: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore kodiba tagare tamearudae tawuje nuba boe ero pemegarewumode?
source: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore kodiba tagare tamearudae tawuje nuba boe ero pemegarewumode?

b: Ia boe aidumodukare ia arore pudui duji. Aidumode tuduwo akabo toro boe eimijera ae aiwowo aroji aro pegarewu bagai. Mare amago pemegado ji tawo tamearudae maku puai taro pegakawo pugeje tawo tabemegado pui. Mare amago pemegamodukare ji dukeje umode arego toro boe eimijera ae rugadu. Nou boe eimijera aiwomode arore jiboe ji dukeje joruduwamode aro pegare jiboe ji rugadu. Nono umode amagu tugobaigarege etai ewo atugu baicorewuto.
source: Ia boe aidumodukare ia arore pudui duji. Aidumode tuduwo akabo toro boe eimijera ae aiwowo aroji aro pegarewu bagai. Mare amago pemegado ji tawo tamearudae maku puai taro pegakawo pugeje tawo tabemegado pui. Mare amago pemegamodukare ji dukeje umode arego toro boe eimijera ae rugadu. Nou boe eimijera aiwomode arore jiboe ji dukeje joruduwamode aro pegare jiboe ji rugadu. Nono umode amagu tugobaigarege etai ewo atugu baicorewuto.

b: Iwo awie. Amodukare apemegado nowu korigodure aiwuji dukeje atugudumode baicorewuto rugadu. Aragojemode nono baicorewu tada jii amode aro morido du ka.
source: Iwo awie. Amodukare apemegado nowu korigodure aiwuji dukeje atugudumode baicorewuto rugadu. Aragojemode nono baicorewu tada jii amode aro morido du ka.

b: Nou meri ji ia boe ere Jesus bie. egore boe pega. Ia pawobe Galiléia kejewuge eiago boe egu barogorogu kowu tomeawo Pao Kurirewu bagai mare Roma pijiwu boe eimijera Pilatos ure ewido.
source: Nou meri ji ia boe ere Jesus bie. egore boe pega. Ia pawobe Galiléia kejewuge eiago boe egu barogorogu kowu tomeawo Pao Kurirewu bagai mare Roma pijiwu boe eimijera Pilatos ure ewido.

b: Jesus akore Tamearudaere nowu pawobe Galiléia kejewuge birewuge ero pegaie nowu tumedage ekori dukodire ewidodure aino? Ainore boe emearudaere.
source: Jesus akore Tamearudaere nowu pawobe Galiléia kejewuge birewuge ero pegaie nowu tumedage ekori dukodire ewidodure aino? Ainore boe emearudaere.

b: Mare imode taruduwado. Ero pegarewu koia karega ewire aino. Paedure boe pegarewu tada kodire boe ewimode. Iwo tawie. Tamodukare tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje tawimode jamedu nono ewi mogadure.
source: Mare imode taruduwado. Ero pegarewu koia karega ewire aino. Paedure boe pegarewu tada kodire boe ewimode. Iwo tawie. Tamodukare tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje tawimode jamedu nono ewi mogadure.

b: Ia Jerusalém kejewuge ewire jamedu. Enodo padure dezoito. Edure Siloé tada Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje. Dukejere ia macebradu ricorewu buture ewugeje dukodire ure ewido. Boe egore nowu boe ero pegaie nouia tumedage Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewuge ekori dukodire ewire aino.
source: Ia Jerusalém kejewuge ewire jamedu. Enodo padure dezoito. Edure Siloé tada Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje. Dukejere ia macebradu ricorewu buture ewugeje dukodire ure ewido. Boe egore nowu boe ero pegaie nouia tumedage Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewuge ekori dukodire ewire aino.

b: Mare iwo taruduwado. Du inodu kodi karega ero pegare tumedage ekori. Iwo tawie. Boe eiamedu boe ero pegare. Tagi jamedu. Tamodukare tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje tawimode jamedu nono nowu enodo padure dezoito boe doge ewi mogadure.
source: Mare iwo taruduwado. Du inodu kodi karega ero pegare tumedage ekori. Iwo tawie. Boe eiamedu boe ero pegare. Tagi jamedu. Tamodukare tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje tawimode jamedu nono nowu enodo padure dezoito boe doge ewi mogadure.

b: Figo I Tudukare Rugadu
source: Figo I Tudukare Rugadu

b: Nono Jesus readodure ia to bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai. Mare bakaru remawu karega. Readodure tuwo eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Akore ia imedu o boepare. Uva ikure nowu boepa tada. Nono nowu uva iku oiadada ia figo i rakojere jamedu. Nou ore boepa cewu aiwore nowu figo ito ia tudu kurodu bagai mare jorudukare ia tuduji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus readodure ia to bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai. Mare bakaru remawu karega. Readodure tuwo eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Akore ia imedu o boepare. Uva ikure nowu boepa tada. Nono nowu uva iku oiadada ia figo i rakojere jamedu. Nou ore boepa cewu aiwore nowu figo ito ia tudu kurodu bagai mare jorudukare ia tuduji rugadu.

b: Dukodire makore tudugare ji. Akore jorure pobe metia bokware i itaiwo tabo nowu figo ito. Mare iorudukare ia tudu roguji. Dukodi awu figo i kado. Butudo. Rakojekawo nono ino boepa tada pugeje!” Ainore nowu ore boepa cewu akore.

b: Jesus akore aino dukeje nowu aidukare Jesus jiwuge eruduwakare tumagowo Jesus bataru jipagi. Dukodire epogurure tumagowo ia tuwadaru ji pugeje. Mare boe eiamedu boe egarere pudui Jesus ro pemegare aino duji.

b: Akore boe emagomode tawagai tagaregoduwo boe uwiremodewu bowadae ka dukeje tadumode toro. Nou makore tawagaiwu makomode ia boe eimijera kurirewu bagai jamedu mare taruduwakare. Tagaregodure dukeje tagaba tamugudo boe pemegarewu keje tagojaro tabo tai. Tamode tamugudo boe pemegarewu keje.
source: Akore boe emagomode tawagai tagaregoduwo boe uwiremodewu bowadae ka dukeje tadumode toro. Nou makore tawagaiwu makomode ia boe eimijera kurirewu bagai jamedu mare taruduwakare. Tagaregodure dukeje tagaba tamugudo boe pemegarewu keje tagojaro tabo tai. Tamode tamugudo boe pemegarewu keje.

b: Mare nowu boe eimijera kurirewu aregodumode dukeje nowu makore tawagaiwu umode tadawuje nowu boe pemegarewu piji nowu boe eimijera kurirewu uwo tumugudo tumuga keje. Akomode aino tai: “Aragojedo awu boe eimijera uwo tumugudo woe awu boe pemegarewu keje.” Ainore akomode tai. Nono tabogurumode. Nono tamode tamugudo toro nowu boe etugarege emuga keje.
source: Mare nowu boe eimijera kurirewu aregodumode dukeje nowu makore tawagaiwu umode tadawuje nowu boe pemegarewu piji nowu boe eimijera kurirewu uwo tumugudo tumuga keje. Akomode aino tai: “Aragojedo awu boe eimijera uwo tumugudo woe awu boe pemegarewu keje.” Ainore akomode tai. Nono tabogurumode. Nono tamode tamugudo toro nowu boe etugarege emuga keje.

b: Dukodire inagomode aino tai. Tagaba tamugudo boe pemegarewu keje tamearudae tabo. Tagaregodumode boe ewadae ka dukeje tamugudo nono nowu boe etugaregebo. Nono nowu boe ewadae kejewu boe eimijera makomode tawagai tuwo tamugudo nono taidure jiboe keje. Nono tabogurumodukare. Boe emago pemegamode tarore jiboe ji.
source: Dukodire inagomode aino tai. Tagaba tamugudo boe pemegarewu keje tamearudae tabo. Tagaregodumode boe ewadae ka dukeje tamugudo nono nowu boe etugaregebo. Nono nowu boe ewadae kejewu boe eimijera makomode tawagai tuwo tamugudo nono taidure jiboe keje. Nono tabogurumodukare. Boe emago pemegamode tarore jiboe ji.

b: Iwo tawie. Boe enojaromode pudui, emode tugimijerado tu pudumi tumearudae tabo dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode epogurudo. Mare boe emode boe utugaregedo pudumi turo pemegawo boe ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera pemegarewugedo emage.
source: Iwo tawie. Boe enojaromode pudui, emode tugimijerado tu pudumi tumearudae tabo dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode epogurudo. Mare boe emode boe utugaregedo pudumi turo pemegawo boe ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera pemegarewugedo emage.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu uwaire bai cewuji. Akore amode ake kurido awadae keje mare amagokaba amedage ewagai enogwagewo akabo. Amagokaba awobe ewagai enogwagewo akabo. Amagokaba oe kurirewuge ewagai enogwagewo akabo jamedu. Enogwagemode akabo dukeje toro ia meri keje emage emagomode awagai jamedu akwagewo pudabo jamedu nowu arore pudui du morice.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu uwaire bai cewuji. Akore amode ake kurido awadae keje mare amagokaba amedage ewagai enogwagewo akabo. Amagokaba awobe ewagai enogwagewo akabo. Amagokaba oe kurirewuge ewagai enogwagewo akabo jamedu. Enogwagemode akabo dukeje toro ia meri keje emage emagomode awagai jamedu akwagewo pudabo jamedu nowu arore pudui du morice.

b: Mare are ake kuricigodo awadae keje. Dukeje amagodo marenarue doge ewagai, joku bokwarewuge ewagai, pogora pegarewuge ewagai, kogodurewuge ewagai enogwagewo akabo.
source: Mare are ake kuricigodo awadae keje. Dukeje amagodo marenarue doge ewagai, joku bokwarewuge ewagai, pogora pegarewuge ewagai, kogodurewuge ewagai enogwagewo akabo.

b: Nono boe pemegamode ai rugadu. Emagere emodukare boe pemegarewu maku akai nowu arore pudui du morice. Mare toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eewodudo pugeje dukeje umode boe pemegado ai nowu aro pemegarewu morice.
source: Nono boe pemegamode ai rugadu. Emagere emodukare boe pemegarewu maku akai nowu arore pudui du morice. Mare toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eewodudo pugeje dukeje umode boe pemegado ai nowu aro pemegarewu morice.

b: Boe Ewadae Kurirewu Reo. Jesus Ure Nou Boe Ewadae Jebato Toro Ia Pao Kurirewu Meardae Ka Pugeje
source: Boe Ewadae Kurirewu Reo. Jesus Ure Nou Boe Ewadae Jebato Toro Ia Pao Kurirewu Meardae Ka Pugeje

b: Nouia mugure nono Jesus apowu mearudure Jesus akore aino duji dukejere makore Jesus ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje umode boe enogwagedo pudabo. Nou baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu uke kurimode rugadu. Dukodire boe pemegamode nowu okwagemode Pao Kurirewu apowuge ji. Egaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Nouia mugure nono Jesus apowu mearudure Jesus akore aino duji dukejere makore Jesus ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje umode boe enogwagedo pudabo. Nou baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu uke kurimode rugadu. Dukodire boe pemegamode nowu okwagemode Pao Kurirewu apowuge ji. Egaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ji. Akore marigudu ia imedu ure ia boe ewadae kurirewu towuje. Makore bagaiwuge emagare rugadu. Mare makore ewagai etaregoduwo nowu ture tawujewu meri ka enogwagewo pudabo.
source: Nono Jesus makore ji. Akore marigudu ia imedu ure ia boe ewadae kurirewu towuje. Makore bagaiwuge emagare rugadu. Mare makore ewagai etaregoduwo nowu ture tawujewu meri ka enogwagewo pudabo.

b: Ure boe jamedu boe udo turugadu dukeje ure tudugare utudo nowu tumagore bagaiwuge ewagai tuwo ewie boe uie turugadu duji etaregoduwo tuwadae ka rugadu. Nou utugare uture nowu boe ewagai rugadu. Makore ei. Akore Mato boe ewadae ka. Ikimijera ure boe jamedu boe udo turugadu.”
source: Ure boe jamedu boe udo turugadu dukeje ure tudugare utudo nowu tumagore bagaiwuge ewagai tuwo ewie boe uie turugadu duji etaregoduwo tuwadae ka rugadu. Nou utugare uture nowu boe ewagai rugadu. Makore ei. Akore Mato boe ewadae ka. Ikimijera ure boe jamedu boe udo turugadu.”

b: – Mare nowu makore bagaiwuge etaidukare tuduwo toro. Eiamedu boe egore nowu utugareji tudumodukaie. Ia akore Ire ikeragu ia moto ji inoce dukodire itumode toro nowu moto ka ioruduwo ji. Dukodire iroiwakare ituwo nowu akimijera bowadae ka.”
source: – Mare nowu makore bagaiwuge etaidukare tuduwo toro. Eiamedu boe egore nowu utugareji tudumodukaie. Ia akore Ire ikeragu ia moto ji inoce dukodire itumode toro nowu moto ka ioruduwo ji. Dukodire iroiwakare ituwo nowu akimijera bowadae ka.”

b: – Metia akore jamedu: “Ire akirodo tapira dogei. Enodo padure dez. Ewo tumugudo ino carroça keje. Dukodire itumode toro nowu tapira doge ewagai ioruduwo emaragodu pemegamode dubagai. Dukodire iroiwakare ituwo nowu akimijera bowadae ka.”
source: – Metia akore jamedu: “Ire akirodo tapira dogei. Enodo padure dez. Ewo tumugudo ino carroça keje. Dukodire itumode toro nowu tapira doge ewagai ioruduwo emaragodu pemegamode dubagai. Dukodire iroiwakare ituwo nowu akimijera bowadae ka.”

b: – Ia metia akore Maigodure iwirere. Iragojemode tu woe itoreduje apo. Dukodire iroiwakare ituwo nowu akimijera bowadae ka.”
source: – Ia metia akore Maigodure iwirere. Iragojemode tu woe itoreduje apo. Dukodire iroiwakare ituwo nowu akimijera bowadae ka.”

b: – Nono nowu utugare ure tugirimi tuibagi tugimijera bagai. Readodure nowu boe egore aino pudui duji nowu tugimijera biagai. Nou ukimijera korigodure nowu tumagore bagaiwuge ewagai. Makore nowu tudugare ji. Akore atudo toro nowu boe eda ka amara tabo. Amagodo marenarue dogei. Amagodo joku bokwarewuge ji. Amagodo pogora pegarewuge ji. Amagodo kogodurewuge ji. Akarego mato ebo enogwagewo pagabo.”
source: – Nono nowu utugare ure tugirimi tuibagi tugimijera bagai. Readodure nowu boe egore aino pudui duji nowu tugimijera biagai. Nou ukimijera korigodure nowu tumagore bagaiwuge ewagai. Akarego mato ebo enogwagewo pagabo.”

b: – Nou utugare mearutorure nowu tugimijera bataru ji rugadu. Makore nowu boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu. Aregodure nowu boebo tuibagi kuri je. Dukeje makore tugimijeraji pugeje. Akore Imearutorure awadaru ji rugadu. Mare aino care pawai ja kuri kimore dukodire cere boe ji kimo.”
source: – Nou utugare mearutorure nowu tugimijera bataru ji rugadu. Makore nowu boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu. Aregodure nowu boebo tuibagi kuri je. Dukeje makore tugimijeraji pugeje. Akore Imearutorure awadaru ji rugadu. Mare aino care pawai ja kuri kimore dukodire cere boe ji kimo.”

b: – Dukodire nowu ukimijera akore atudo toro ia boe eda kawu awara ji nowu mugure awara okwaiwu boe ewai jamedu boe ka amagowo nowu boe ewagai jamedu. Etudo mato rugadu. Itaidure iwai korobaduwo boebo rugadu.
source: – Dukodire nowu ukimijera akore atudo toro ia boe eda kawu awara ji nowu mugure awara okwaiwu boe ewai jamedu boe ka amagowo nowu boe ewagai jamedu. Etudo mato rugadu. Itaidure iwai korobaduwo boebo rugadu.

b: Mare iwo tawie. Nou imagore bagaiwuge boeto jiwuge enogwagemodukare woe itabo rugadu.” Ainore nowu Jesus readodure jiwu bakaru ure.
source: Mare iwo tawie. Nou imagore bagaiwuge boeto jiwuge enogwagemodukare woe itabo rugadu.” Ainore nowu Jesus readodure jiwu bakaru ure.

b: Boe Ewo Turagado Tumearutoruwo Jesus ji
source: Boe Ewo Turagado Tumearutoruwo Jesus ji

b: Ia meri keje boe emagare nono Jesus apo tugodui apo. Nono Jesus ure tuwuredo tumagowo ei.
source: Ia meri keje boe emagare nono Jesus apo tugodui apo. Nono Jesus ure tuwuredo tumagowo ei.

b: Akore ia boe etaidumode tumearutoruwo imearudae ji. Mare emearudu kurimode i dukeje imode eruduwado imearudae remawu ji rugadu. Emearudu kurimode i tuje kori, tuo kori, tore ekori, tumanamage ekori, tuduiemage ekori dukeje imode eruduwado imearudae remawu ji. Mare emearudu kurimodukare i tuje piji, tuo piji, toreduje piji, tore epiji, tumanamage epiji, tuduiemage epiji dukeje imodukare eruduwado imearudae remawu ji.
source: Akore ia boe etaidumode tumearutoruwo imearudae ji. Mare emearudu kurimode i dukeje imode eruduwado imearudae remawu ji rugadu. Emearudu kurimode i tuje kori, tuo kori, tore ekori, tumanamage ekori, tuduiemage ekori dukeje imode eruduwado imearudae remawu ji. Mare emearudu kurimodukare i tuje piji, tuo piji, toreduje piji, tore epiji, tumanamage epiji, tuduiemage epiji dukeje imodukare eruduwado imearudae remawu ji.

b: Imearutoru kurire Iogwa Kurirewu ji dukodire boe erudu pegare i, emode iwido. Boe etaidumode tuwo tumearutorudo imearudae ji dukeje ewo tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure. Emodukare tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure dukeje imodukare eruduwado imearudae remawu ji.
source: Imearutoru kurire Iogwa Kurirewu ji dukodire boe erudu pegare i, emode iwido. Boe etaidumode tuwo tumearutorudo imearudae ji dukeje ewo tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure. Emodukare tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure dukeje imodukare eruduwado imearudae remawu ji.

b: Boe emode ia tuwai towuje dukeje boe emode tumearudae pemegarewu tawuje tuioruduwawo nuba turomode tuwo tugeragu boe jamedu boe ji tuwo nowu tuwai pemegado. Etaiwomode to diero kurimode dubagai tuwo akirodo boe jamedu boe ji tuwo tuwai iado.
source: Boe emode ia tuwai towuje dukeje boe emode tumearudae pemegarewu tawuje tuioruduwawo nuba turomode tuwo tugeragu boe jamedu boe ji tuwo nowu tuwai pemegado. Etaiwomode to diero kurimode dubagai tuwo akirodo boe jamedu boe ji tuwo tuwai iado.

b: Emodukare tumearudae pemegado dukeje eromode ta je to diero akedure duji rugadu dukodire emodukare tuwai iado. Nono boe egokodumode ei.
source: Emodukare tumearudae pemegado dukeje eromode ta je to diero akedure duji rugadu dukodire emodukare tuwai iado. Nono boe egokodumode ei.

b: Egomode aino: “Akare awai iado. Amearudae pegare kodi.” Ainore egomode.
source: Egomode aino: “Akare awai iado. Amearudae pegare kodi.” Ainore egomode.

b: – Ca ia bakaru reo pugeje. Ia boe eimijera o tugobaigarege enodo padure dez mil. Mare nowu turugodumode jiwu boe eimijera o tugobaigarege enodo padure vinte mil. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera urugodumodukare nouia boe eimijeraji kuri je. Umode tumearudae pemegarewu tawuje. Jorudumode nowu to tugobaigarege eraga kodumode nowu iage eraga kori duji.
source: – Ca ia bakaru reo pugeje. Ia boe eimijera o tugobaigarege enodo padure dez mil. Mare nowu turugodumode jiwu boe eimijera o tugobaigarege enodo padure vinte mil. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera urugodumodukare nouia boe eimijeraji kuri je. Umode tumearudae pemegarewu tawuje. Jorudumode nowu to tugobaigarege eraga kodumode nowu iage eraga kori duji.

b: Eragamodukare dukeje umode tuwadaru maku tudugarege etai ewo reko toro nowu turugodumode jiwu boe eimijera bagai. Mare erugodukare pui raga dukodire makomode nowu boe eimijeraji tumoduie iaboe pemegarewu maku ai erugodukawo pui pugeje tuwo tumedagedo puce.
source: Eragamodukare dukeje umode tuwadaru maku tudugarege etai ewo reko toro nowu turugodumode jiwu boe eimijera bagai. Mare erugodukare pui raga dukodire makomode nowu boe eimijeraji tumoduie iaboe pemegarewu maku ai erugodukawo pui pugeje tuwo tumedagedo puce.

b: – Ca tarodo aino jamedu. Tagera ra tagoe jamedu boe piji tamearutoruwo tu i. Nono imode taruduwado tamearutoruwo imearudae jamedu boe ji.
source: – Ca tarodo aino jamedu. Tagera ra tagoe jamedu boe piji tamearutoruwo tu i. Nono imode taruduwado tamearutoruwo imearudae jamedu boe ji.

b: Sal Pemegamodukarewu Reo
source: Sal Pemegamodukarewu Reo

b: Jesus makore pugeje: – Sal pemegare. Mare nowu sal pegomode dukeje nowu sal akedumode. Nono umodukare nono sal mogadure pugeje.
source: Jesus makore pugeje: – Sal pemegare. Mare nowu sal pegomode dukeje nowu sal akedumode. Nono umodukare nono sal mogadure pugeje.

b: Dukodire boe eromodukare iaboe ji nowu sal tabo pugeje. Emode barigu. Mare sal remawu ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwugeire inagoino ekawo tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji rugadu. Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji tawo awu iwadaru metudo tagaora tada tamearutoruwo ji rugadu.
source: Dukodire boe eromodukare iaboe ji nowu sal tabo pugeje. Emode barigu. Mare sal remawu ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwugeire inagoino ekawo tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji rugadu. Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji tawo awu iwadaru metudo tagaora tada tamearutoruwo ji rugadu.

b: Carneiro Doge Ere Tuwarigu Boeto
source: Carneiro Doge Ere Tuwarigu Boeto

b: Ia meri keje Judeu doge etaidukare jiwuge boe etaregodure Jesus ae tuwiapagawo Jesus makore jiboe ji. Imposto mori makudure aiwugenure iage. Nou Judeu doge egore ro pegarewuge uie iage.
source: Ia meri keje Judeu doge etaidukare jiwuge boe etaregodure Jesus ae tuwiapagawo Jesus makore jiboe ji. Imposto mori makudure aiwugenure iage. Nou Judeu doge egore ro pegarewuge uie iage.

b: Nono fariseu doge etaregodure jamedu. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure jamedu. Emago pegare pu biagai nowu Jesus rore aino nowu boe dogei duji. egore awu Jesus imadure nowu boe etaidukare jiwuge ro pegarewugebo. Okwagere ebo jamedu. Nou ukare turugadu.
source: Nono fariseu doge etaregodure jamedu. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure jamedu. Emago pegare pu biagai nowu Jesus rore aino nowu boe dogei duji. egore awu Jesus imadure nowu boe etaidukare jiwuge ro pegarewugebo. Okwagere ebo jamedu. Nou ukare turugadu.

b: Dukodire Jesus readodure ia bakaruji ewiagai. Mare tuwo jebato toro Pao Kurirewu mearudae pemegarewu jitu bagaire akoino, tuwo jebato nowu boe eimijerage emearudae pegarewu jitu bagaire akoino jamedu.
source: Dukodire Jesus readodure ia bakaruji ewiagai. Mare tuwo jebato toro Pao Kurirewu mearudae pemegarewu jitu bagaire akoino, tuwo jebato nowu boe eimijerage emearudae pegarewu jitu bagaire akoino jamedu.

b: Akore ia tagi tagagu carneiro doge enodo padumode cem. Ia okwamode boeto nowu iage epiji dukeje tadumode rugadu nowu noventa e nove carneiro doge epiji tagaiwowo nowu okware boetowu carneiro bagai rugadu. Nou noventa e nove carneiro doge tamode edudo tubaga tabo ia boebutu pemegarewu keje. Nono tadumode tagaiwowo nowu okware boetowu carneiro bagai jii toro tarudure jitu ka.
source: Akore ia tagi tagagu carneiro doge enodo padumode cem. Ia okwamode boeto nowu iage epiji dukeje tadumode rugadu nowu noventa e nove carneiro doge epiji tagaiwowo nowu okware boetowu carneiro bagai rugadu. Nou noventa e nove carneiro doge tamode edudo tubaga tabo ia boebutu pemegarewu keje. Nono tadumode tagaiwowo nowu okware boetowu carneiro bagai jii toro tarudure jitu ka.

b: Tarudumode ji dukeje taegaregodumode tai rugadu. Tamode bu taganaura keje tawo reko tawai ka tuibagi pugeje.
source: Tarudumode ji dukeje taegaregodumode tai rugadu. Tamode bu taganaura keje tawo reko tawai ka tuibagi pugeje.

b: Tagaregodumode apo tawai ka dukeje tamagomode tamedage ewagai tawo ewie taruduie okware boetowu carneiroji rugadu. Taegaregoduie tai. Tamoduie boe ewadae towuje ebo. Ainore tarore. Ainore boe erore rugadu.
source: Tagaregodumode apo tawai ka dukeje tamagomode tamedage ewagai tawo ewie taruduie okware boetowu carneiroji rugadu. Taegaregoduie tai. Tamoduie boe ewadae towuje ebo. Ainore tarore. Ainore boe erore rugadu.

b: Ca baru tadawuge erore nono nowu taro mogadure jamedu. Mare carneiro doge ewagai karega eroino. Boe ero pemegamode dukeje baru tadawuge egaremode pudui. Ro pemegarewuge emode noventa e nove dukeje baru tadawuge egaremode nowu noventa e nove eiamedu boe ji. Mare ia ro pegarewu umode mitotu je dukeje umode tugera ra turo pegarewu piji turokawo aino nowu turo pegarewu ji pugeje dukeje baru tadawuge egaregodumode pudui rugadu. Egaremode nowu ure tugera ra turo pegarewu pijiwuji nowu noventa e nove ro pemegarewuge eiamedu boe ekori.
source: Ca baru tadawuge erore nono nowu taro mogadure jamedu. Mare carneiro doge ewagai karega eroino. Boe ero pemegamode dukeje baru tadawuge egaremode pudui. Ro pemegarewuge emode noventa e nove dukeje baru tadawuge egaremode nowu noventa e nove eiamedu boe ji. Mare ia ro pegarewu umode mitotu je dukeje umode tugera ra turo pegarewu piji turokawo aino nowu turo pegarewu ji pugeje dukeje baru tadawuge egaregodumode pudui rugadu. Egaremode nowu ure tugera ra turo pegarewu pijiwuji nowu noventa e nove ro pemegarewuge eiamedu boe ekori.

b: Diero Tori Okware Boetowu Reo
source: Diero Tori Okware Boetowu Reo

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ia aredu o diero torirogu enodo padure dez. Ure nono prata mogadure dukodire mori kurire. Mare akore ia okwaie tubiji. Nuba tamearudaere nowu aredu romode? Umode jorugu pemegado tuwai ja tada. Umode vassoura reko tuwai ja otoji. Aiwo pemegamode tuwai ja otoji jii toro tuiorudure nowu diero tori jitu ka.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ia aredu o diero torirogu enodo padure dez. Ure nono prata mogadure dukodire mori kurire. Mare akore ia okwaie tubiji. Nuba tamearudaere nowu aredu romode? Umode jorugu pemegado tuwai ja tada. Umode vassoura reko tuwai ja otoji. Aiwo pemegamode tuwai ja otoji jii toro tuiorudure nowu diero tori jitu ka.

b: Ca jorudure ji dukeje makomode tumedage areme ewagai ewo bato pui pudae. Etaregodure pudae dukeje makomode ei. Akore Iagarere i rugadu iorudure cewu ino diero torirogu okware ipijiwuji. Pawaduwo rugadu.” Ainore nowu aredu akomode tumedage aremei.
source: Ca jorudure ji dukeje makomode tumedage areme ewagai ewo bato pui pudae. Etaregodure pudae dukeje makomode ei. Akore Iagarere i rugadu iorudure cewu ino diero torirogu okware ipijiwuji. Pawaduwo rugadu.” Ainore nowu aredu akomode tumedage aremei.

b: Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge egaremode pudui jamedu nono nowu aredu jakare moga pudui dumogadure. Mare diero remawu ji karega egaremode. Ure tugera ra turo pegarewu pijiwu jire egaregodumode. Makore boe eimijera kurirewu moduie Pao Kurirewuce rugadu. Dukodire nowu aidure nowu bataru pemegarewu jiwuge eiamedu boe ere turagado pudui tuwo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce rugadu.

b: Moto, baru akedumode mare Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe akedumodukare rugadu jii toro rugadu. Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe jamedu boe jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Moto, baru akedumode mare Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe akedumodukare rugadu jii toro rugadu. Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe jamedu boe jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Ca iwo tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Imedu umode tugera ra toreduje piji mare mugumode ia aredu apo pugeje. Du pegare Pao Kurirewu jakai rugadu. Nou imedu ro peganure nowu toreduje boeto jiwudoji rugadu. Ure tudo nono jeribarire toreduje pijiwu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai. Ainore Pao Kurirewu mearudaere. Aredu umode tugera ra toredu piji dukeje ia imedu mugumode nowu aredu apo pugeje. Du pegare Pao Kurirewu jakai jamedu. Nou mugure nowu aredu apowu imedu ure tudo nono jeribarire toreduje pijiwu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai jamedu. Ainore Pao Kurirewu mearudaere.

Nou imedu ro peganure nowu toreduje boeto jiwudoji rugadu. Ure tudo nono jeribarire toreduje pijiwu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai. Ainore Pao Kurirewu mearudaere.
