Ere ia diero tori maku Jesus ai dukeje Jesus unarare ei. Akore ioguduba je ba padure awu diero tori keje? Ioguduba ie ba padure awu diero tori keje? Nou boe egore Roma kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu César iere padure keje.

b: Jesus akore Boe rugadu. Care awu César oeboe maku César ai. Mare Pao Kurirewu oeboe maku Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu.
source: Jesus akore Boe rugadu. Care awu César oeboe maku César ai. Mare Pao Kurirewu oeboe maku Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu.

b: Dukodi care nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge ekare Jesus udo tuwarigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji. Dukodire eroiwakare tumago pegawo Jesus makore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Erore ta je akoino pudui duji. Dukodire emagokare pugeje.
source: Dukodi care nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge ekare Jesus udo tuwarigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji. Dukodire eroiwakare tumago pegawo Jesus makore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Erore ta je akoino pudui duji. Dukodire emagokare pugeje.

b: Ia Boe Enarare Jesus ji Pugeje
source: Ia Boe Enarare Jesus ji Pugeje

b: Nono ia saduceu doge etaregodure Jesus ae tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino dutabo jamedu. Nou saduceu doge emearutorukare boe eewodumode pugeje duji. Ca emagore Jesus ji.
source: Nono ia saduceu doge etaregodure Jesus ae tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino dutabo jamedu. Nou saduceu doge emearutorukare boe eewodumode pugeje duji. Ca emagore Jesus ji.

b: egore Joruduwarewu imedunure aki. Ca mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Moisés ure jaoboe ero maku etai pamearutoruwo ji jii aino. Moisés akore imedu bimoduie mare ore bokwaie dukeje nowu imedu uwie muguwo nowu tumana birewu oreduje apo torewo nowu tumana birewu oreduje apo.
source: egore Joruduwarewu imedunure aki. Ca mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Moisés ure jaoboe ero maku etai pamearutoruwo ji jii aino. Moisés akore imedu bimoduie mare ore bokwaie dukeje nowu imedu uwie muguwo nowu tumana birewu oreduje apo torewo nowu tumana birewu oreduje apo.

b: Ainore Moisés akore marigudu tuwo paro maku pagai. Ca ia meri keje ime enodo padure sete. Etumana etuwie magenure pugi. Etumana mugure ia aredu apo. Care bire. Mare ore bokware.
source: Ainore Moisés akore marigudu tuwo paro maku pagai. Ca ia meri keje ime enodo padure sete. Etumana etuwie magenure pugi. Etumana mugure ia aredu apo. Care bire. Mare ore bokware.

b: Dukodire nowu uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo. Mare nowu imedu bire jamedu.
source: Dukodire nowu uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo. Mare nowu imedu bire jamedu.

b: Nono uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo jamedu. Mare bire jamedu. Nou uwie ime eiamedu boe emugure nowu aredu apo. Mare eiamedu boe ewire. Etore bokware nowu aredu apo rugadu.
source: Nono uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo jamedu. Mare bire jamedu. Nou uwie ime eiamedu boe emugure nowu aredu apo. Mare eiamedu boe ewire. Etore bokware nowu aredu apo rugadu.

b: Dukeje care nowu aredu bire jamedu.
source: Dukeje care nowu aredu bire jamedu.

b: Dukodire cedaidure cenarawo ai. Pao Kurirewu umode erugadu boe eewodudo dukeje duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo? Eiamedu boe emugure apo woe moto keje mare duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo baru tada?
source: Dukodire cedaidure cenarawo ai. Pao Kurirewu umode erugadu boe eewodudo dukeje duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo? Eiamedu boe emugure apo woe moto keje mare duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo baru tada?

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore boe emugumode puapo tu woe moto keje
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore boe emugumode puapo tu woe moto keje

b: Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eewodumode pugeje dukeje emode nono Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emogadure. Ewimodukare pugeje. Etuwiremodukare pugeje. Etugogemodukare pugeje. Pao Kurirewu ore mode emage eewodure pugeje dukodi.
source: Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eewodumode pugeje dukeje emode nono Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emogadure. Ewimodukare pugeje. Etuwiremodukare pugeje. Etugogemodukare pugeje. Pao Kurirewu ore mode emage eewodure pugeje dukodi.

b: Moisés ure bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ure boe eruduwado boe eewodumode pugeje duji. Pao Kurirewu ure Moisés mearududo tuwadaru ji ture iaboedo nono joru mogadure enado i piji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu makore Moisesji. Akore Abraão mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Isaque mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Jacó mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi.”
source: Moisés ure bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ure boe eruduwado boe eewodumode pugeje duji. Pao Kurirewu ure Moisés mearududo tuwadaru ji ture iaboedo nono joru mogadure enado i piji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu makore Moisesji. Akore Abraão mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Isaque mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Jacó mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi.”

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore. Mare nowu Pao Kurirewu akoino jiwu ime ewire marigudu. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore emearutoruie pudui rugadu. Dukodire paruduware eewodure pugeje duji. Birewuge emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Jewodurewuge emearutorumode ji. Pao Kurirewu umode mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe eewodudo pugeje rugadu.
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore. Mare nowu Pao Kurirewu akoino jiwu ime ewire marigudu. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore emearutoruie pudui rugadu. Dukodire paruduware eewodure pugeje duji. Birewuge emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Jewodurewuge emearutorumode ji. Pao Kurirewu umode mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe eewodudo pugeje rugadu.

b: Nono ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge eimijerage egore boe jokodu jire akagoino.
source: Nono ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge eimijerage egore boe jokodu jire akagoino.

b: Mare pagare egoino. Ca boe eraga bokware tunarawo Jesus ji pugeje. Eraga bokware tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe tabo rugadu.
source: Mare pagare egoino. Ca boe eraga bokware tunarawo Jesus ji pugeje. Eraga bokware tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe tabo rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Umode Boe Ekinorudowuji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Umode Boe Ekinorudowuji

b: Nono Jesus unarare nowu boe ji. Akore boere boe eruduwado umode boe ekinorudowuji. Egore Davi onaregedu moduie ema. Mare eruduwa pemegakare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Nono Jesus unarare nowu boe ji. Akore boere boe eruduwado umode boe ekinorudowuji. Egore Davi onaregedu moduie ema. Mare eruduwa pemegakare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Nou mariguduwu boe eimijera Davi ure ia Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu makore nowu ikimijera umode boe ekinorudowuji. Akore Amugudo woe ikana pemegarewu jagwai jii toro imode nowu jorudu pegare aiwuge etagedudo du ka.”
source: Nou mariguduwu boe eimijera Davi ure ia Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu makore nowu ikimijera umode boe ekinorudowuji. Akore Amugudo woe ikana pemegarewu jagwai jii toro imode nowu jorudu pegare aiwuge etagedudo du ka.”

b: – Tagoino dutabo Davi akore tugimijera nuie nowu umode boe ekinorudowuce. Mare Davi onaregedu mode ema jamedu. Ca nuba nowu umode boe ekinorudowu ure?
source: – Tagoino dutabo Davi akore tugimijera nuie nowu umode boe ekinorudowuce. Mare Davi onaregedu mode ema jamedu. Ca nuba nowu umode boe ekinorudowu ure?

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Boe Eimijerage Ero Pegare Jiboe ji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Boe Eimijerage Ero Pegare Jiboe ji

b: Boe emagare nono tuwiapaga tabo Jesus bataru ji. Nono Jesus ure ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado.
source: Boe emagare nono tuwiapaga tabo Jesus bataru ji. Nono Jesus ure ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado.

b: Akore taeku jado joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui. Ere boe etaiwodo tugudau areia moturewu meture pudui duji. Etaidure tuwo boe epogurudo. Etumode ba kurirewu ka dukeje etaidure boe emago pemegawo pudui etaidure boe ekimijeragewo pudumi kodi. Dukodire erore aino. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etumode Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka dukeje emode tugeragu boe eimijera mugure kejewu iraji tumuguwo keje. Etumode boe ewadae ka dukeje etumode boe eke jeture kejewu ira ka boe etododai togwagewo boeto ji.
source: Akore taeku jado joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui. Ere boe etaiwodo tugudau areia moturewu meture pudui duji. Etaidure tuwo boe epogurudo. Etumode ba kurirewu ka dukeje etaidure boe emago pemegawo pudui etaidure boe ekimijeragewo pudumi kodi. Dukodire erore aino. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etumode Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka dukeje emode tugeragu boe eimijera mugure kejewu iraji tumuguwo keje. Etumode boe ewadae ka dukeje etumode boe eke jeture kejewu ira ka boe etododai togwagewo boeto ji.

b: Eragojemode boebo dukeje emago raimode baru to boe emearuduwo tagoi tuwadaru moturewu jituji. Mare pagatu je. Ekiwogure okoge bokwarewuge aremei. Ere nowu areme okoge bokwarewuge ewai aru epiji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode ei rugadu nowu ero pegarewu morice.
source: Eragojemode boebo dukeje emago raimode baru to boe emearuduwo tagoi tuwadaru moturewu jituji. Mare pagatu je. Ekiwogure okoge bokwarewuge aremei. Ere nowu areme okoge bokwarewuge ewai aru epiji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode ei rugadu nowu ero pegarewu morice.

b: Okoge Bokwarewudo Aredu Ure To Diero Rogu Maku Pao Kurirewu Ai
source: Okoge Bokwarewudo Aredu Ure To Diero Rogu Maku Pao Kurirewu Ai

b: Jesus rakojere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada taiwo tabo nowu boe ji. Dukejere jorudure nowu oe kurirewuge ji. Ere ia toe tugu ia ira jagi tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai.
source: Jesus rakojere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada taiwo tabo nowu boe ji. Dukejere jorudure nowu oe kurirewuge ji. Ere ia toe tugu ia ira jagi tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai.

b: Dukejere jorudure ia okoge bokwarewudo areduji, marenaruji. Nou okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero torirogu pobedu tugu nowu ira jagi. Toe mitodurogu ure maku.
source: Dukejere jorudure ia okoge bokwarewudo areduji, marenaruji. Nou okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero torirogu pobedu tugu nowu ira jagi. Toe mitodurogu ure maku.

b: Nono Jesus akore Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu marenaru aredu okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero jamedu boe maku dukodire ure to diero makudu kurido nowu oe kurirewuge eiamedu boe ekori.
source: Nono Jesus akore Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu marenaru aredu okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero jamedu boe maku dukodire ure to diero makudu kurido nowu oe kurirewuge eiamedu boe ekori.

b: Mare diero kurirewu ji karega inagoino. Nou oe kurirewuge ere to diero kurido Pao Kurirewu ai mare etaidukare jiwu kobo rogure ere maku. Enoe kurire rugadu kimo. Mare awu aredu ure to diero rugadu boe maku. Dujire inagoino tai.
source: Mare diero kurirewu ji karega inagoino. Nou oe kurirewuge ere to diero kurido Pao Kurirewu ai mare etaidukare jiwu kobo rogure ere maku. Enoe kurire rugadu kimo. Mare awu aredu ure to diero rugadu boe maku. Dujire inagoino tai.

b: Jesus Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwai Akedumoduie
source: Jesus Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwai Akedumoduie

b: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui Pao Kurirewu uwai jiboe ji. Egore Pao Kurirewu uwai motuie. Boe ere towuje tabowu tori motuie. Boe eie toe makudu kurido Pao Kurirewu ai. Du paduie nono nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada.
source: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui Pao Kurirewu uwai jiboe ji. Egore Pao Kurirewu uwai motuie. Boe ere towuje tabowu tori motuie. Boe eie toe makudu kurido Pao Kurirewu ai. Du paduie nono nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore moture mare ia meri keje ro pegarewuge emode awu Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo rugadu. Tori tabore pawobe ere towuje marigudu. Mare nowu tori jamedu boe epadumodukare pu aogeje pugeje.
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore moture mare ia meri keje ro pegarewuge emode awu Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo rugadu. Tori tabore pawobe ere towuje marigudu. Mare nowu tori jamedu boe epadumodukare pu aogeje pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ewie Nuba Boe Mode Boei
source: Jesus Ure Ewie Nuba Boe Mode Boei

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu uwai butumode? Kaba jiba cerudumode ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino duji?
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu uwai butumode? Kaba jiba cerudumode ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino duji?

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore taeku jado boe ekawo taekiripagado. Boe emagamode tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Boe puredugoduie moto akeduwo. Mare pagare egoino. Mare du inodu tabo emode boe ekiripagado rugadu. Mare tamearutorukaba ei.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore taeku jado boe ekawo taekiripagado. Boe emagamode tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Boe puredugoduie moto akeduwo. Mare pagare egoino. Mare du inodu tabo emode boe ekiripagado rugadu. Mare tamearutorukaba ei.

b: Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Erugodu akedukaie. Emoduie tugimijerage etawuje turaga tabo. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.
source: Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Erugodu akedukaie. Emoduie tugimijerage etawuje turaga tabo. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.

b: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore boe eimijera kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo.
source: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore boe eimijera kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo.

b: Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Jorubo pegarewu jetumode boe ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe erudumode boe pegarewu boe ji ure turawuje baru piji duji.
source: Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Jorubo pegarewu jetumode boe ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe erudumode boe pegarewu boe ji ure turawuje baru piji duji.

b: Mare ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu tai. Emode boe pegado tai rugadu. Emode tamagu Judeu doge eimijerage etai. Nou boe eimijerage emode tarego Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka taiwowo ia taro pegare jiboe bagai. Nono emode tadugu baicorewuto. Boe eimijera kurirewuge emagomode tawagai jamedu tumago pegawo tarore jiboe ji.
source: Mare ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu tai. Emode boe pegado tai rugadu. Emode tamagu Judeu doge eimijerage etai. Nou boe eimijerage emode tarego Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka taiwowo ia taro pegare jiboe bagai. Nono emode tadugu baicorewuto. Boe eimijera kurirewuge emagomode tawagai jamedu tumago pegawo tarore jiboe ji.

b: Dukejere tamagodo iwadaru pemegarewu ji ewadaru jipagi.
source: Dukejere tamagodo iwadaru pemegarewu ji ewadaru jipagi.

b: Mare tamororamagadukaba tamagore jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega.
source: Mare tamororamagadukaba tamagore jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega.

b: Imode iwadaru maku tagai tamagowo ewadaru jipagi. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ero rakamodukare tai tawadaru jipagi pugeje.
source: Imode iwadaru maku tagai tamagowo ewadaru jipagi. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ero rakamodukare tai tawadaru jipagi pugeje.

b: Tawie mage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Taomage tajemage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tawobe emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tamedage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tagi tawidodumode rugadu.
source: Tawie mage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Taomage tajemage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tawobe emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tamedage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tagi tawidodumode rugadu.

b: Tamearutorumode i dukodire boe eiamedu boe erudu pegamode tai.
source: Tamearutorumode i dukodire boe eiamedu boe erudu pegamode tai.

b: Mare ietu pemegamode tai ia tagao iku butukawo tagaora piji rugadu.
source: Mare ietu pemegamode tai ia tagao iku butukawo tagaora piji rugadu.

b: Tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji dukeje imode taginorudo tawarigudukawo bope doge eda ka rugadu taruduwo baru to itae.
source: Tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji dukeje imode taginorudo tawarigudukawo bope doge eda ka rugadu taruduwo baru to itae.

b: Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Akedumode
source: Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Akedumode

b: Jesus makore kimo. Akore tarudumode tugobaigarege pegarewuge ere taiado Jerusalém ba kurirewu tabo duji dukeje taruduwamode boe akedumode kuri aino duji.
source: Jesus makore kimo. Akore tarudumode tugobaigarege pegarewuge ere taiado Jerusalém ba kurirewu tabo duji dukeje taruduwamode boe akedumode kuri aino duji.

b: Inure tawie. Boe erudumode nowu inoduji dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakawo toro tori ao ka. Jerusalém ba kurirewu tadawuge eregodu rakawo. Nou rakojere ipoguru kejewuge eregodu rakawo jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka iaboe bagai pugeje tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.
source: Inure tawie. Boe erudumode nowu inoduji dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakawo toro tori ao ka. Jerusalém ba kurirewu tadawuge eregodu rakawo. Nou rakojere ipoguru kejewuge eregodu rakawo jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka iaboe bagai pugeje tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.

b: Nou meri keje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu boe pegamoduie boe ji rugadu boe ero pegarewu morice. Aino makore jiboe jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Nou meri keje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu boe pegamoduie boe ji rugadu boe ero pegarewu morice. Aino makore jiboe jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode etore kugure etuje magei jamedu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode awu moto ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado awu Judeu dogei rugadu ero pegarewu morice.
source: Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode etore kugure etuje magei jamedu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode awu moto ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado awu Judeu dogei rugadu ero pegarewu morice.

b: Iage ewidodumode tariga kurirewu tabo. Boe emode iage etudo toro moto tuginaiwu ka etuguduwo baicorewuto toro. Nono boe tuginaiwuge etaregodumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwo akedudo rugadu jii toro Pao Kurirewu joruduware jiwu meri ka.
source: Iage ewidodumode tariga kurirewu tabo. Boe emode iage etudo toro moto tuginaiwu ka etuguduwo baicorewuto toro. Nono boe tuginaiwuge etaregodumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwo akedudo rugadu jii toro Pao Kurirewu joruduware jiwu meri ka.

b: Imedu Onaregedu Aregodumode Pugeje
source: Imedu Onaregedu Aregodumode Pugeje

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Meri joku umode tuginai. Ari joku umode tuginai. Kuieje doge emode tuginai jamedu. Moto kejewu boe eimijera kurirewuge epagudumode rugadu. Epagudumode pobo maerewu ako pegarewu akoji. Pobo maerewu umode pobo barigu moto ao ka.
source: Jesus mako kimore: – Meri joku umode tuginai. Ari joku umode tuginai. Kuieje doge emode tuginai jamedu. Moto kejewu boe eimijera kurirewuge epagudumode rugadu. Epagudumode pobo maerewu ako pegarewu akoji. Pobo maerewu umode pobo barigu moto ao ka.

b: Boe eruduwamode boe pegare moto jituji. Baru magadugodumode jamedu. Boe edu pagamode turoiwakare nowu boe pegare jiboe ji kodi. Dukodire ekugudugodumode tubagudu koia.
source: Boe eruduwamode boe pegare moto jituji. Baru magadugodumode jamedu. Boe edu pagamode turoiwakare nowu boe pegare jiboe ji kodi. Dukodire ekugudugodumode tubagudu koia.

b: Dukejere care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode tugodu tabo boetugu ao jituji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Dukejere care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode tugodu tabo boetugu ao jituji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Tarudumode nowu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taragojedo tawo tado tarugadu. Tagaiwowo iwagai. Taruduwamode imode taginorudo rugadu kuri aino duji rugadu.
source: Tarudumode nowu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taragojedo tawo tado tarugadu. Tagaiwowo iwagai. Taruduwamode imode taginorudo rugadu kuri aino duji rugadu.

b: Figo I Ure Boe Eruduwado
source: Figo I Ure Boe Eruduwado

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je.

b: Figo i okurogu boture dukeje tarudure roino duji rugadu. Dukodi care taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.
source: Figo i okurogu boture dukeje tarudure roino duji rugadu. Dukodi care taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.

b: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode itaregodumode kuri aino duji boe eimijera kurirewuwo imi. Bubutu ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino rugadu. Itaregodumode kejewu meri jire inagoino tai.
source: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode itaregodumode kuri aino duji boe eimijera kurirewuwo imi. Bubutu ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino rugadu. Itaregodumode kejewu meri jire inagoino tai.

b: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.
source: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.

b: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare rugadu jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare rugadu jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Boe Ewo Tuioku Jado
source: Boe Ewo Tuioku Jado

b: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore taeku jado. Tamororamagadukaba tawadae bagai. Tagaba tage kurudo tai. Tamororamagadukaba tamaragodae bagai. Tamororamagadumode nowu inoduji dukeje tamodukare tado tarugadu nowu ire tawie jiwu meri aregodumodedu ka.
source: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore taeku jado. Tamororamagadukaba tawadae bagai. Tagaba tage kurudo tai. Tamororamagadukaba tamaragodae bagai. Tamororamagadumode nowu inoduji dukeje tamodukare tado tarugadu nowu ire tawie jiwu meri aregodumodedu ka.

b: Nou meri keje aregodumode tagae tae pagare tu je du ka. Moto kejewuge eiamedu boe emodukare cinorudo nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje.
source: Nou meri keje aregodumode tagae tae pagare tu je du ka. Moto kejewuge eiamedu boe emodukare cinorudo nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai. Taeku jado. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tu tu je uwo taragado, uwo taginorudo boe pegarewu boe piji, tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji jii toro itaregodumode du ka.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai. Taeku jado. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tu tu je uwo taragado, uwo taginorudo boe pegarewu boe piji, tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji jii toro itaregodumode du ka.

b: Nono Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada meri jamedu boe ji jii toro merirekodu ka tu tu je. Nou boeco ji ure tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri tori ao ka tu tu je.
source: Nono Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada meri jamedu boe ji jii toro merirekodu ka tu tu je. Nou boeco ji ure tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri tori ao ka tu tu je.

b: Barogwakododure dukeje ure tugirimi Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje tuwo boe eruduwado nono. Boe eiamedu boe eture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka Jesus togi tu tu je tuwiapagawo Jesus makore jiboe ji pugeje. Ainore Jesus rore nowu meri jamedu ji.
source: Barogwakododure dukeje ure tugirimi Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje tuwo boe eruduwado nono. Boe eiamedu boe eture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka Jesus togi tu tu je tuwiapagawo Jesus makore jiboe ji pugeje. Ainore Jesus rore nowu meri jamedu ji.

b: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Pegarewu Tawuje
source: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Pegarewu Tawuje

b: Judeu doge epuredugodure tuwo tuwadae towuje. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Nou tuwadae kejere emode ia amirewu tuginaiwu ko. Fermento metukare nowu amirewu tada.
source: Judeu doge epuredugodure tuwo tuwadae towuje. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Nou tuwadae kejere emode ia amirewu tuginaiwu ko. Fermento metukare nowu amirewu tada.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugebo. Emagore pui nuba turowo tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito du bagai. Mare boe etaidure Jesus ji dukodire nowu jorudu pegare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage epagudure turo pegawo ji.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugebo. Emagore pui nuba turowo tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito du bagai. Mare boe etaidure Jesus ji dukodire nowu jorudu pegare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage epagudure turo pegawo ji.

b: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai
source: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai

b: Nono bope doge eimijera Satanás ure turemo nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotito.
source: Nono bope doge eimijera Satanás ure turemo nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotito.

b: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae tumagowo ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai. Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijerage eire Judas Iscariotes akoino jamedu.
source: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae tumagowo ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai. Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijerage eire Judas Iscariotes akoino jamedu.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egarere pudui. Nou boe eimijerage ere diero tori udo 30 Judas Iscariotes ai.
source: Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egarere pudui. Nou boe eimijerage ere diero tori udo 30 Judas Iscariotes ai.

b: Dukodire Judas ure tugeragu nowu dieroji. Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo boe emagakare apo dubagai tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai nowu meri keje.
source: Dukodire Judas ure tugeragu nowu dieroji. Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo boe emagakare apo dubagai tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai nowu meri keje.

b: Jesus Umode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Eke Ko Ture Joruduwadowugebo
source: Jesus Umode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Eke Ko Ture Joruduwadowugebo

b: Páscoa meri aregodure Judeu doge ere tuge amirewu pemegado, ere tagu carneiro doge kugure ewido tuwo pemegado tuwo kowuje jamedu nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji.
source: Páscoa meri aregodure Judeu doge ere tuge amirewu pemegado, ere tagu carneiro doge kugure ewido tuwo pemegado tuwo kowuje jamedu nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji.

b: Jesus makore Pedro ji, Joãoji jamedu. Akore tadudo toro tawo page pemegado pawo kowuje pawaduwo Páscoaji.
source: Jesus makore Pedro ji, Joãoji jamedu. Akore tadudo toro tawo page pemegado pawo kowuje pawaduwo Páscoaji.

b: egore kaiba cemode nowu page pemegado?
source: egore kaiba cemode nowu page pemegado?

b: Jesus akore Tadumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje ia imedu aregodumode tadogi ia pori po tabo. Tadudo nowu imedu rekodaji. Umode turemo ia baito dukeje tanarado nowu uwaire bai cewuji ia paedumodurewu bagai. Tagagodo aino: “Pagimijera aidure ia tiedumodurewu bagai togwagewo Páscoa kejewu boe ekeji ture joruduwadowugebo nowu boe edurewu ja tada.”
source: Jesus akore Tadumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje ia imedu aregodumode tadogi ia pori po tabo. Tadudo nowu imedu rekodaji. Umode turemo ia baito dukeje tanarado nowu uwaire bai cewuji ia paedumodurewu bagai. Tagagodo aino: “Pagimijera aidure ia tiedumodurewu bagai togwagewo Páscoa kejewu boe ekeji ture joruduwadowugebo nowu boe edurewu ja tada.”

b: Tagagomode aino dukeje nowu uwaire bai cewu umode tarududo ia boe edure kejewu bai pemegarewuji. Nou bai pemegamode rugadu pagwagewo Páscoa kejewu pageji. Nonore tamode page pemegado.
source: Tagagomode aino dukeje nowu uwaire bai cewu umode tarududo ia boe edure kejewu bai pemegarewuji. Nou bai pemegamode rugadu pagwagewo Páscoa kejewu pageji. Nonore tamode page pemegado.

b: Nono Pedro uture João apo jamedu. Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje erudure boe ji nono Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Pascoaji nowu bai tada rugadu.
source: Nono Pedro uture João apo jamedu. Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje erudure boe ji nono Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Pascoaji nowu bai tada rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowugebo. Nou boeco ji Jesus mugure nono ia ira keje togwage tabo ebo. Utumode Jesus bataru tabowuge emode emage.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowugebo. Nou boeco ji Jesus mugure nono ia ira keje togwage tabo ebo. Utumode Jesus bataru tabowuge emode emage.

b: Akore itaidure rugadu iwo awu Páscoa kejewu boe eke kowuje mare boe ero pegamode i du otodai.
source: Akore itaidure rugadu iwo awu Páscoa kejewu boe eke kowuje mare boe ero pegamode i du otodai.

b: Nono imodukare awu boe eke kowuje pugeje jii toro Boe Eimijera Pao Kurirewu aregodumode nowu mearutorure puduiwuge ewagai du ka. Nono imode Pao Kurirewu uke remawu kowuje Pao Kurirewu apo.
source: Nono imodukare awu boe eke kowuje pugeje jii toro Boe Eimijera Pao Kurirewu aregodumode nowu mearutorure puduiwuge ewagai du ka. Nono imode Pao Kurirewu uke remawu kowuje Pao Kurirewu apo.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu vinho kuru paru tabo. Dukeje makore pugeje nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore awu pedo tai.
source: Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu vinho kuru paru tabo. Dukeje makore pugeje nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore awu pedo tai.

b: Inure tawie aino. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode iwo boe eimijera kurirewudo imi du ka.
source: Inure tawie aino. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode iwo boe eimijera kurirewudo imi du ka.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo ei. Akore ikodu reo. Makudumode taro pegarewu morice. Tagwagedo awuji tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.
source: Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo ei. Akore ikodu reo. Makudumode taro pegarewu morice. Tagwagedo awuji tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.

b: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu turowo ji nono turo moga amirewu jitu mogadure. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Pao Kurirewu mearudae maiwu koiare imode iku redo boe ero pegarewu morice.
source: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu turowo ji nono turo moga amirewu jitu mogadure. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Pao Kurirewu mearudae maiwu koiare imode iku redo boe ero pegarewu morice.

b: Ca. Tagaiwodo. Umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu mugure woe itabo ira keje.
source: Ca. Tagaiwodo. Umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu mugure woe itabo ira keje.

b: Mare iwimode nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu. Mare boe pegamode nowu umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji jamedu.
source: Mare iwimode nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu. Mare boe pegamode nowu umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji jamedu.

b: Jesus akore aino dukeje care nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare pui duboba romode aino tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage etai du bagai.
source: Jesus akore aino dukeje care nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare pui duboba romode aino tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage etai du bagai.

b: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etokire Pui
source: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etokire Pui

b: Nono Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe etokire pui. Eiamedu boe egore boe eimijera kurirewu moduie pudumi nowu tumedage ekori.
source: Nono Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe etokire pui. Eiamedu boe egore boe eimijera kurirewu moduie pudumi nowu tumedage ekori.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore boe tuginaiwuge eimijerage mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge egore boe emedage enuie pudumi mare pagare egoino. Ero rakare boe ji. Boe emearutorure tugimijeragei rugadu. Emearutorumodukare ei dukeje nowu boe eimijerage emode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwugei rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore boe tuginaiwuge eimijerage mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge egore boe emedage enuie pudumi mare pagare egoino. Ero rakare boe ji. Boe emearutorure tugimijeragei rugadu. Emearutorumodukare ei dukeje nowu boe eimijerage emode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwugei rugadu.

b: Mare tagi tarokaba nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewuge ero mogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tagojarokaba tai tawo tado nono ipare enojaromoga pudui tumanamagei dumogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tamearudae udo nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tawo boe eimijera pemegarewugedo tagi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi.
source: Mare tagi tarokaba nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewuge ero mogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tagojarokaba tai tawo tado nono ipare enojaromoga pudui tumanamagei dumogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tamearudae udo nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tawo boe eimijera pemegarewugedo tagi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi.

b: Boe eimijerage kurirewuge enogwagemode boeto ji. Utugarege emode boe eke maku etai. Boe eimijera kurirewunure imi rugadu mare ire ido nono boe etugare mogadure iwo tage maku tagai. Tarodo nono iro mogadure jamedu.
source: Boe eimijerage kurirewuge enogwagemode boeto ji. Utugarege emode boe eke maku etai. Boe eimijera kurirewunure imi rugadu mare ire ido nono boe etugare mogadure iwo tage maku tagai. Tarodo nono iro mogadure jamedu.

b: Boe rakare i. Du inodu tabo taragojere woe itabo. Tarudure boe rakare i duji. Mare Iogwa Kurirewu ure boe eimijera kurirewudo imi ietuwo boe ji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado tagi jamedu taetuwo boe ji.
source: Boe rakare i. Du inodu tabo taragojere woe itabo. Tarudure boe rakare i duji. Mare Iogwa Kurirewu ure boe eimijera kurirewudo imi ietuwo boe ji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado tagi jamedu taetuwo boe ji.

b: Mare boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi dukeje tagwagemode itabo tagudumode itabo imugurewu keje. Tamugumode boe eimijerage emuga keje jamedu. Boe eimijerage emode tagi jamedu tagaiwowo Judeu doge eiamedu boe ero pegarewu bagai.
source: Mare boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi dukeje tagwagemode itabo tagudumode itabo imugurewu keje. Tamugumode boe eimijerage emuga keje jamedu. Boe eimijerage emode tagi jamedu tagaiwowo Judeu doge eiamedu boe ero pegarewu bagai.

b: Jesus Makore Pedro ji Umoduie Tuioruduwa Bokwado Pudui
source: Jesus Makore Pedro ji Umoduie Tuioruduwa Bokwado Pudui

b: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore Simão. Simão. Awiapaga pemegado imagomode ai jiboe ji. Bope doge eimijera Satanás okwamagudure tuwo turokogado ai tuwo amearudae pegado. Dukodire imagore Pao Kurirewu ji aparu tabo amearutorure idu akedukawo. Nono amode akirimi amearutoruwo i pugeje nono amode amedage emearutoru kurido i jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore Simão. Simão. Awiapaga pemegado imagomode ai jiboe ji. Bope doge eimijera Satanás okwamagudure tuwo turokogado ai tuwo amearudae pegado. Dukodire imagore Pao Kurirewu ji aparu tabo amearutorure idu akedukawo. Nono amode akirimi amearutoruwo i pugeje nono amode amedage emearutoru kurido i jamedu.

b: Mare Pedro akore Ikimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu. Imearutorure tu ai rugadu. Ire irugadu ikoduwo akabo imeduwo baicorewu tada akabo, iwiwo akabo jamedu.
source: Mare Pedro akore Ikimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu. Imearutorure tu ai rugadu. Ire irugadu ikoduwo akabo imeduwo baicorewu tada akabo, iwiwo akabo jamedu.

b: Jesus akore Inure awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.
source: Jesus akore Inure awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ji pugeje. Akore ire tadudo toro boe etae marigudu tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Mare ire tadudo tagadarabo bokware dutabo, tamijigu bokware dutabo, tawure okeakejewu bokware dutabo. Ca inarawo tai. Tadure toro ia boe bokware tagai kana? egore boro. Iaboe okwakare cenai rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ji pugeje. Akore ire tadudo toro boe etae marigudu tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Mare ire tadudo tagadarabo bokware dutabo, tamijigu bokware dutabo, tawure okeakejewu bokware dutabo. Ca inarawo tai. Tadure toro ia boe bokware tagai kana? egore boro. Iaboe okwakare cenai rugadu.

b: Jesus akore aino care ore micigurewu umode tugeragu to miciguji. Ukadaraborewu umode tugeragu tugodaraboji. Iaboe maku diero bagai tawo akirodo ia tarigaji.
source: Jesus akore aino care ore micigurewu umode tugeragu to miciguji. Ukadaraborewu umode tugeragu tugodaraboji. Iaboe maku diero bagai tawo akirodo ia tarigaji.

b: Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje marigudu. Akore aino: “Boe ere udo nono ro pegarewu mogadure.” Ainore padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore marigudu. Aino ca nowu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe mode aino i rugadu nono nowu bataru mogadure.
source: Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje marigudu. Akore aino: “Boe ere udo nono ro pegarewu mogadure.” Ainore padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore marigudu. Aino ca nowu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe mode aino i rugadu nono nowu bataru mogadure.

b: Ia nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu akore akaiwodo. Padarigare pobe woe. Jesus akore Ure turugadu.
source: Ia nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu akore akaiwodo. Padarigare pobe woe. Jesus akore Ure turugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai
source: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai

b: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji Oliveira ri ao ka turoiaji.
source: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji Oliveira ri ao ka turoiaji.

b: Aregodure taidure jiboe ka dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore tamagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.
source: Aregodure taidure jiboe ka dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore tamagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje epiji kuri je tumagowo baru to. Ure tubu jodo moto keje tumagowo Tuoji.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje epiji kuri je tumagowo baru to. Ure tubu jodo moto keje tumagowo Tuoji.

b: Akore iogwa. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Mare umodukare nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.
source: Akore iogwa. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Mare umodukare nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.

b: Dukeje ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Jesus ae tuwo raka maku ai.
source: Dukeje ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Jesus ae tuwo raka maku ai.

b: Jesus mako kimore baru to turaga tabo. Akaru ure nono boe ekure tuwudure moto ka dutabo.
source: Jesus mako kimore baru to turaga tabo. Akaru ure nono boe ekure tuwudure moto ka dutabo.

b: Ure tumago akedudo dukeje Jesus ure tugirimi ture joruduwadowuge etae. Jorudure ei enudure duji. Emedugodure tugiarigodure dukodi.
source: Ure tumago akedudo dukeje Jesus ure tugirimi ture joruduwadowuge etae. Jorudure ei enudure duji. Emedugodure tugiarigodure dukodi.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore kodiba tanudure? Taragojedo. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore kodiba tanudure? Taragojedo. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.

b: Boe Eimijera Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji
source: Boe Eimijera Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji

b: Jesus mako kimore aino nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje boe emagare taregodu tabo ae. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes emare roino ebo tuwo erego Jesus bagai tuwo Jesus maku etai. Nono Judas ure tuburedo Jesus ji tugimaduwo apo. Ure togwa to co Jesus je koduto tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge erududo taidure tuwo tugeragu jiwu imedunure ema duji.
source: Jesus mako kimore aino nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje boe emagare taregodu tabo ae. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes emare roino ebo tuwo erego Jesus bagai tuwo Jesus maku etai. Nono Judas ure tuburedo Jesus ji tugimaduwo apo. Ure togwa to co Jesus je koduto tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge erududo taidure tuwo tugeragu jiwu imedunure ema duji.

b: Jesus makore Judaji. Akore are imagu awu boe pegarewuge etai. Kocare akaidure akimaduwo aino itabo?
source: Jesus makore Judaji. Akore are imagu awu boe pegarewuge etai. Kocare akaidure akimaduwo aino itabo?

b: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu boe pegarewuge emode tugeragu Jesus jituji dukeje enarare Jesus ji: – Cegimijera! Cemode cebodo ebo tariga tabo?
source: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu boe pegarewuge emode tugeragu Jesus jituji dukeje enarare Jesus ji: – Cegimijera! Cemode cebodo ebo tariga tabo?

b: Mare nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu upagakare Jesus makowo nowu tumedage ewadaru jipagi. Ure taredo nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu utugare ae. Ure tariga bu nowu utugare bija kajeje.
source: Mare nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu upagakare Jesus makowo nowu tumedage ewadaru jipagi. Ure taredo nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu utugare ae. Ure tariga bu nowu utugare bija kajeje.

b: Mare Jesus akore Tarokaba aino. Urugadu. Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje. Ca ure pemegago taci je.
source: Mare Jesus akore Tarokaba aino. Urugadu. Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje. Ca ure pemegago taci je.

b: Dukeje Jesus makore nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijeragei, nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege ji jamedu, nouia boe eimijeragei jamedu. Akore ire boe emearudae pegado kana emearutorukawo tugimijeragei kana? Kocare tagaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo, rago tabo, tawo tageragu i nono taro moga ro pegarewuge eidu mogadure. Iragojere tagabo meri jamedu ji Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Mare tagare tageragu i nono. Mare bope aidure boeco ji kodire tare tarodo aino boeco kao tawo tageragu aino i boeco ji rugadu tamearutorure tagimijera bope doge eimejera ji dukodi.
source: Dukeje Jesus makore nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijeragei, nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege ji jamedu, nouia boe eimijeragei jamedu. Akore ire boe emearudae pegado kana emearutorukawo tugimijeragei kana? Kocare tagaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo, rago tabo, tawo tageragu i nono taro moga ro pegarewuge eidu mogadure. Iragojere tagabo meri jamedu ji Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Mare tagare tageragu i nono. Mare bope aidure boeco ji kodire tare tarodo aino boeco kao tawo tageragu aino i boeco ji rugadu tamearutorure tagimijera bope doge eimejera ji dukodi.

b: Pedro Makore Tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji
source: Pedro Makore Tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji

b: Dukeje nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Jesus ji. Eture apo. Ere reko nowu Judeu doge eimijerage etae toro ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Pedro uture eregodaji mare ure tugodu jaedo ei. Nou boe eimijerage ere nowu tugobaigarege etudo Jesus ji nono bawadu keje.
source: Dukeje nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Jesus ji. Eture apo. Ere reko nowu Judeu doge eimijerage etae toro ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Pedro uture eregodaji mare ure tugodu jaedo ei. Nou boe eimijerage ere nowu tugobaigarege etudo Jesus ji nono bawadu keje.

b: Nono boe ere jorugo nono bawadu keje. Pedro uture nowu boe etae. Ure tumugudo nono ebo.
source: Nono boe ere jorugo nono bawadu keje. Pedro uture nowu boe etae. Ure tumugudo nono ebo.

b: Ia utugare aredu jorudure Pedro ji nono nowu joru okwai. Aiwo pemegare ji dukeje akore awu imedu rakojere Jesus apo jamedu.
source: Ia utugare aredu jorudure Pedro ji nono nowu joru okwai. Aiwo pemegare ji dukeje akore awu imedu rakojere Jesus apo jamedu.

b: Mare Pedro akore Boro. Ioruduwakare ji.
source: Mare Pedro akore Boro. Ioruduwakare ji.

b: Mare Pedro utukare. Rakoje kimore nono nowu bawadu keje. Nono ia imedu jorudure ji dukeje makore Pedro ji. Akore ia Jesus apowunure aki jamedu? Pedro akore Boro. Imi karega.
source: Mare Pedro utukare. Rakoje kimore nono nowu bawadu keje. Nono ia imedu jorudure ji dukeje makore Pedro ji. Akore ia Jesus apowunure aki jamedu? Pedro akore Boro. Imi karega.

b: Nou inodu rekodaji ia imedu makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore ioruduware ai. Aragojere Jesus apo. Awadarure nono Galiléia kejewu boe ewadaru mogadure.
source: Nou inodu rekodaji ia imedu makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore ioruduware ai. Aragojere Jesus apo. Awadarure nono Galiléia kejewu boe ewadaru mogadure.

b: Mare Pedro akore Ioruduwakare kaba jiba akagoino. Pedro makore aino dukeje ia kagariga kudugodure.
source: Mare Pedro akore Ioruduwakare kaba jiba akagoino. Pedro makore aino dukeje ia kagariga kudugodure.

b: Nono Jesus aiwore tu Pedro ji. Dukeje Pedro biabuture Jesus makore puduiwu bataru keje. Jesus makore Pedro ji makomoduie tuioruduwakaie pudui dukeje kagariga kudugodumoduie rugadu. Pedro makomoduie tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus aiwore tu Pedro ji. Dukeje Pedro biabuture Jesus makore puduiwu bataru keje. Jesus makore Pedro ji makomoduie tuioruduwakaie pudui dukeje kagariga kudugodumoduie rugadu. Pedro makomoduie tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu.

b: Nono Pedro biabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje jeture pudui rugadu duji. Dukodi care Pedro uture nowu boe epiji rugadu. Ragudu rakare rugadu turore aino duji.
source: Nono Pedro biabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje jeture pudui rugadu duji. Dukodi care Pedro uture nowu boe epiji rugadu. Ragudu rakare rugadu turore aino duji.

b: Boe Eimijerage Etaiwore Jesus Ro Pegarewu Bagai
source: Boe Eimijerage Etaiwore Jesus Ro Pegarewu Bagai

b: Tugobaigarege ere boeto Jesus ji, egokodure ji jamedu.
source: Tugobaigarege ere boeto Jesus ji, egokodure ji jamedu.

b: Ere areia kogudo Jesus je kajeje. Nono enarare ji: – Ioguduba ure boeto ai? Amagodo! Mare pagare egoino. Enure tago kodudo ji turoi jitu tabo.
source: Ere areia kogudo Jesus je kajeje. Nono enarare ji: – Ioguduba ure boeto ai? Amagodo! Mare pagare egoino. Enure tago kodudo ji turoi jitu tabo.

b: Nono emago pegare ji rugadu.
source: Nono emago pegare ji rugadu.

b: Barogwakododure dutabo boe eimijera kurirewuge ere bato pui. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure nono. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edure nono jamedu. Nono tugobaigarege etaregodure Jesus apo etae.
source: Barogwakododure dutabo boe eimijera kurirewuge ere bato pui. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure nono. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edure nono jamedu. Nono tugobaigarege etaregodure Jesus apo etae.

b: Dukeje nowu boe eimijerage enaragodure Jesus ji. egore amagodo. Aki na umode boe ekinorudowunure aki? Jesus akore Inagomode uu. Imie rugadu mare tamearutorumodukare i dukodire imagomodukare tawadaru jipagi. Inaramode tai iaboe ji mare taruduwamodukare tamagowo iwadaru jipagi jamedu. Dukodire inaramodukare boe ji tai.
source: Dukeje nowu boe eimijerage enaragodure Jesus ji. egore amagodo. Aki na umode boe ekinorudowunure aki? Jesus akore Inagomode uu. Imie rugadu mare tamearutorumodukare i dukodire imagomodukare tawadaru jipagi. Inaramode tai iaboe ji mare taruduwamodukare tamagowo iwadaru jipagi jamedu. Dukodire inaramodukare boe ji tai.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu raka kodure boe eiamedu boe kori. Nono inure tawie. Awu inodu otobiji imugumode Pao Kurirewu ukana pemegarewu jagwai.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu raka kodure boe eiamedu boe kori. Nono inure tawie. Awu inodu otobiji imugumode Pao Kurirewu ukana pemegarewu jagwai.

b: Jesus akore aino dukeje nowu boe eimijerage enarare Jesus ji. egore Mare aki na Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki? Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Imi rugadu.
source: Jesus akore aino dukeje nowu boe eimijerage enarare Jesus ji. egore Mare aki na Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki? Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Imi rugadu.

b: Mare nowu boe eimijerage emearutorukare nowu inoduji marigudu. Dukodire emagore pui tumago pegare Jesus jitu tabo. egore Pagare akoino. Batrarodunure. Mako peganure Pao Kurirewu ji. Kodi care ure tumagu pagai nowu tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Paipagamodukare ia bataru pegarewu bagai pugeje.
source: Mare nowu boe eimijerage emearutorukare nowu inoduji marigudu. Dukodire emagore pui tumago pegare Jesus jitu tabo. egore Pagare akoino. Batrarodunure. Mako peganure Pao Kurirewu ji. Kodi care ure tumagu pagai nowu tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Paipagamodukare ia bataru pegarewu bagai pugeje.

b: Boe Eimijera Pilatos Aiwore Jesus Rore Jiboe ji
source: Boe Eimijera Pilatos Aiwore Jesus Rore Jiboe ji

b: Nono nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ere Jesus reko toro Pilatos ae. Emare Romano doge eimijera kurirewunure ema nono.
source: Nono nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ere Jesus reko toro Pilatos ae. Emare Romano doge eimijera kurirewunure ema nono.

b: Etaregodure Pilatos ae dukeje nowu Judeu doge eimijerage emago pegare Jesus ji Pilatos biagai tuwadrarodu tabo. egore cerudure awu imedu ro pegarewuji. Ure cewobe Judeu doge emearudae pegado Roma kejewu pagimijera kurirewuji. Makore boe ji ekawo imposto diero maku Roma kejewu pagimijera kurirewu César ai. Akore tumoduie boe ekinorudo Roma kejewuge epiji. Akore boe eimijera kurirewu unuie pudumi.
source: Etaregodure Pilatos ae dukeje nowu Judeu doge eimijerage emago pegare Jesus ji Pilatos biagai tuwadrarodu tabo. egore cerudure awu imedu ro pegarewuji. Ure cewobe Judeu doge emearudae pegado Roma kejewu pagimijera kurirewuji. Makore boe ji ekawo imposto diero maku Roma kejewu pagimijera kurirewu César ai. Akore tumoduie boe ekinorudo Roma kejewuge epiji. Akore boe eimijera kurirewu unuie pudumi.

b: Dukodire Pilatos unarare Jesus ji. Akore boe rugadu na? Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu? Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino.
source: Dukodire Pilatos unarare Jesus ji. Akore boe rugadu na? Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu? Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino.

b: Mare Pilatos makore nowu Judeu dogei, eimijeragei jamedu. Akore iorudukare awu imedu ia ro pegarewuji. Imodukare barigu boe pegarewuto.
source: Mare Pilatos makore nowu Judeu dogei, eimijeragei jamedu. Akore iorudukare awu imedu ia ro pegarewuji. Imodukare barigu boe pegarewuto.

b: Mare nowu boe emagore Pilatoji pugeje. egore ure boe ekiripagado Judéia kejewu moto parugajeje tuwadaru tabo. Ainore rore Galiléia moto keje ji taregodure aino woe du ka.
source: Mare nowu boe emagore Pilatoji pugeje. egore ure boe ekiripagado Judéia kejewu moto parugajeje tuwadaru tabo. Ainore rore Galiléia moto keje ji taregodure aino woe du ka.

b: Pilatos unarare nowu boe ji. Akore nou Galiléia moto kejewunure ema na? Nou boe egore uie ema rugadu. Dukodire Pilatos ure nowu Judeu doge eimijerage etudo Galiléia moto kejewuge eimijera bagai Jesus apo. Nou Galiléia moto kejewuge eimijera iere Herodes. Nou Herodes rakojere nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje nowu meri ji. Dukodire Pilatos ure Jesus utudo toro bagai.
source: Pilatos unarare nowu boe ji. Akore nou Galiléia moto kejewunure ema na? Nou boe egore uie ema rugadu. Dukodire Pilatos ure nowu Judeu doge eimijerage etudo Galiléia moto kejewuge eimijera bagai Jesus apo. Nou Galiléia moto kejewuge eimijera iere Herodes. Nou Herodes rakojere nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje nowu meri ji. Dukodire Pilatos ure Jesus utudo toro bagai.

b: Etaregodure Jesus apo Herodes ae dukeje Herodes jakaregodure pudui. Marigudu aidure tuioruduwo ia Jesus ro rakarewu ji kodi.
source: Etaregodure Jesus apo Herodes ae dukeje Herodes jakaregodure pudui. Marigudu aidure tuioruduwo ia Jesus ro rakarewu ji kodi.

b: Dukodire Herodes unara raire Jesus ji. Mare Jesus makokare boe ji, rokare ia boe ji.
source: Dukodire Herodes unara raire Jesus ji. Mare Jesus makokare boe ji, rokare ia boe ji.

b: Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emago pegare Jesus ji nowu Herodes biagai.
source: Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emago pegare Jesus ji nowu Herodes biagai.

b: Nono Herodes ure tuwadaru ocarodo Jesus ji. Nou rakojere apowu tugobaigarege ere tuwadaru ocarodo ji jamedu. Dukeje Herodes ure ia tugudau areia moturewu tugu ji mare rorerunure ji. Dukeje ure Jesus utudo toro tuibagi Pilatos ae.
source: Nono Herodes ure tuwadaru ocarodo Jesus ji. Nou rakojere apowu tugobaigarege ere tuwadaru ocarodo ji jamedu. Dukeje Herodes ure ia tugudau areia moturewu tugu ji mare rorerunure ji. Dukeje ure Jesus utudo toro tuibagi Pilatos ae.

b: Dukodire nowu meri ji Herodes, Pilatos ere tumedagedo puce. Marigudu erudu pegare pui. Aino care ere tubemegado pui.
source: Dukodire nowu meri ji Herodes, Pilatos ere tumedagedo puce. Marigudu erudu pegare pui. Aino care ere tubemegado pui.

b: Etaregodure tuibagi Pilatos ae pugeje. Dukeje Pilatos makore nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijeragei, nouia Judeu doge eimijeragei, nouia boe ji jamedu.
source: Etaregodure tuibagi Pilatos ae pugeje. Dukeje Pilatos makore nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijeragei, nouia Judeu doge eimijeragei, nouia boe ji jamedu.

b: Akore tagaregodure awu imedu Jesus apo woe itae. Tagagore uie boe emearudae pegado emearutorukawo tugimijerage cei pugeje. Aino inara raire ji woe taiamedu boe taegai. Mare iorudukare ia tagagoino jiwu awu imedu ro pegarewuji. Iorudukare ia tagagoino jiwu awu imedu bataru pegarewuji.
source: Akore tagaregodure awu imedu Jesus apo woe itae. Tagagore uie boe emearudae pegado emearutorukawo tugimijerage cei pugeje. Aino inara raire ji woe taiamedu boe taegai. Mare iorudukare ia tagagoino jiwu awu imedu ro pegarewuji. Iorudukare ia tagagoino jiwu awu imedu bataru pegarewuji.

b: Ire utudo Herodes ae. Mare Herodes jorudukare ia awu imedu ro pegarewu ji jamedu. Ure utudo tuibagi mato itae pugeje. Awu imedu ro pegarewu kurimode dukeje imagomode tugobaigaregei ewo bito. Mare iagai ro pegarewu remawu bokware dukodire imodukare edo bito.
source: Ire utudo Herodes ae. Mare Herodes jorudukare ia awu imedu ro pegarewu ji jamedu. Ure utudo tuibagi mato itae pugeje. Awu imedu ro pegarewu kurimode dukeje imagomode tugobaigaregei ewo bito. Mare iagai ro pegarewu remawu bokware dukodire imodukare edo bito.

b: Imode tugobaigarege edo boeto ji bukigu tabo nono imode ikera ra piji utuwo pugeje.
source: Imode tugobaigarege edo boeto ji bukigu tabo nono imode ikera ra piji utuwo pugeje.

b: Páscoa kejewu meri ji nowu Judeu doge ero koiare nowu Pilatos umode ia mugure baicorewu tadawu imedu tawuje utuwo nowu boe epiji ainore rore tu tu je. Ainore erore joru jamedu boe ji. Dukodire Pilatos mearudaere tuwo Jesus utudo aino. Ia imedu iere Barrabás. Ure boe ewido. Ure boe ero pegado rugadu boe eimijeragei. Ro pegarewunure ema rugadu. Dukodire nowu Barrabás rakojere baicorewu tada marigudu. Mare nowu boe ere tumago rakado toro Pilatos ae. egore nou imedu Barrabás tawuje cenai utuwo pugeje! Awu imedu Jesus remo baicorewuto nowu Barrabás mugato bitoduwo!
source: Páscoa kejewu meri ji nowu Judeu doge ero koiare nowu Pilatos umode ia mugure baicorewu tadawu imedu tawuje utuwo nowu boe epiji ainore rore tu tu je. Ainore erore joru jamedu boe ji. Dukodire Pilatos mearudaere tuwo Jesus utudo aino. Ia imedu iere Barrabás. Ure boe ewido. Ure boe ero pegado rugadu boe eimijeragei. Ro pegarewunure ema rugadu. Dukodire nowu Barrabás rakojere baicorewu tada marigudu. Mare nowu boe ere tumago rakado toro Pilatos ae. egore nou imedu Barrabás tawuje cenai utuwo pugeje! Awu imedu Jesus remo baicorewuto nowu Barrabás mugato bitoduwo!

b: Pilatos mearudaere tuwo Jesus utudo rugadu dukodire makore nowu boe ji pugeje.
source: Pilatos mearudaere tuwo Jesus utudo rugadu dukodire makore nowu boe ji pugeje.

b: Mare ere tumago rakado toro Pilatos ae. egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje! Bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje!
source: Mare ere tumago rakado toro Pilatos ae. egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje! Bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje!

b: Mare Pilatos makore nowu boe ji pugeje. Akore kodiba tagagoino? Ro pegarewu pa? Iagai awu imedu ro pegarewu remawu bokware dukodire imodukare tugobaigarege edo bito. Imode edo boeto ji bukigu tabo nono imode ikera ra piji utuwo pugeje.
source: Mare Pilatos makore nowu boe ji pugeje. Akore kodiba tagagoino? Ro pegarewu pa? Iagai awu imedu ro pegarewu remawu bokware dukodire imodukare tugobaigarege edo bito. Imode edo boeto ji bukigu tabo nono imode ikera ra piji utuwo pugeje.

b: Mare nowu boe ere tugudu rakado toro Pilatos ae rugadu Jesus bitoduwo ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu! Ere tumago raido aino dukodire ere nowu Pilatos mearudae kodudo nowu tumearudae rekodaji.
source: Mare nowu boe ere tugudu rakado toro Pilatos ae rugadu Jesus bitoduwo ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu! Ere tumago raido aino dukodire ere nowu Pilatos mearudae kodudo nowu tumearudae rekodaji.

b: Dukodire Pilatos ure Barrabás utudo baicorewu piji mare makore nowu boe ji Jesus bitodumoduie. Nou Barrabás imedu ro pegarewunure ema rugadu. Ure boe ewido. Ure boe emearudae pegado tumearutorukawo tugimijeragei pugeje. Mare nowu meri ji boe etaidure ji. Emagore Pilatoji uwo nowu Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji. Dukodire Pilatos ure utudo rugadu. Mare boe etaidukare Jesus ji. Etaidure tuwo Jesus bito rugadu. Nono Pilatos ure Jesus maku tugobaigarege etai bitoduwo nono nowu boe etaidu mogadure.
source: Dukodire Pilatos ure Barrabás utudo baicorewu piji mare makore nowu boe ji Jesus bitodumoduie. Nou Barrabás imedu ro pegarewunure ema rugadu. Ure boe ewido. Ure boe emearudae pegado tumearutorukawo tugimijeragei pugeje. Mare nowu meri ji boe etaidure ji. Emagore Pilatoji uwo nowu Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji. Dukodire Pilatos ure utudo rugadu. Mare boe etaidukare Jesus ji. Etaidure tuwo Jesus bito rugadu. Nono Pilatos ure Jesus maku tugobaigarege etai bitoduwo nono nowu boe etaidu mogadure.

b: Jesus Bitodure Ipo Padure Pugajejewu Keje
source: Jesus Bitodure Ipo Padure Pugajejewu Keje

b: Du inodu rekodaji tugobaigarege eture toro Jesus apo. Jesus oredure nowu tubadumode kejewu ipo tabo. Mare Jesus rakakare nowu ipo tabo. Dukodire tugobaigarege emagore ia imeduji oreduwo nowu ipo tabo Jesus rekodaji. Nou imedu iere Simão. Cirene ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Maigodu aino nowu Simão aregodure ipoguru piji nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.
source: Du inodu rekodaji tugobaigarege eture toro Jesus apo. Jesus oredure nowu tubadumode kejewu ipo tabo. Mare Jesus rakakare nowu ipo tabo. Dukodire tugobaigarege emagore ia imeduji oreduwo nowu ipo tabo Jesus rekodaji. Nou imedu iere Simão. Cirene ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Maigodu aino nowu Simão aregodure ipoguru piji nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.

b: Boe emagare Jesus kodumode jiwu awara ji. Ia Jerusalém kejewuge areme etragudu rakare Jesus apo.
source: Boe emagare Jesus kodumode jiwu awara ji. Ia Jerusalém kejewuge areme etragudu rakare Jesus apo.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu aremei. Akore tagragudukaba itabo. Tagragududo tagabo. Tagragududo tagorebo. Mare paga karega boe pegarewu aregodumode tagae kodi. Boe pega rakamode boe etorei rugadu dukodire areme ekiarigodumode rugadu, etragudumode rugadu torebo. Boe emagomode aino: “Cerudure boe pegare cedorei rugadu dukodire boe pega kuricigore cei rugadu. Dukodi boe pegakare ore bokwarewu aremei. Ore bokwarewu areme egarere pudui.” Ainore boe egomode.
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu aremei. Akore tagragudukaba itabo. Tagragududo tagabo. Tagragududo tagorebo. Mare paga karega boe pegarewu aregodumode tagae kodi. Boe pega rakamode boe etorei rugadu dukodire areme ekiarigodumode rugadu, etragudumode rugadu torebo. Boe emagomode aino: “Cerudure boe pegare cedorei rugadu dukodire boe pega kuricigore cei rugadu. Dukodi boe pegakare ore bokwarewu aremei. Ore bokwarewu areme egarere pudui.” Ainore boe egomode.

b: Mare paga karega. Boe pegamode boe ji rugadu. Dukodi nowu meri keje boe emagomode tori ri butuwo tuwugeje, tuwiwo boe pegarewu koda piji.
source: Mare paga karega. Boe pegamode boe ji rugadu. Dukodi nowu meri keje boe emagomode tori ri butuwo tuwugeje, tuwiwo boe pegarewu koda piji.

b: Iwidodumode nono boe ere joru tugu ia jerigi kidukarewu to dumogadure. Mare ia meri keje tagi tamode nono jerigi pemegarewure. Boe pegamode tai rugadu nono joru ure jerigi kowu dumogadure. Mare joru ji karega Jesus akoino ei. Boe pega raimodukare pudui. Dujire akoino ei. Toro ia meri keje boe pega kuricigomode Judeu dogei. Dujire akoino ei.
source: Iwidodumode nono boe ere joru tugu ia jerigi kidukarewu to dumogadure. Mare ia meri keje tagi tamode nono jerigi pemegarewure. Boe pegamode tai rugadu nono joru ure jerigi kowu dumogadure. Mare joru ji karega Jesus akoino ei. Boe pega raimodukare pudui. Dujire akoino ei. Toro ia meri keje boe pega kuricigomode Judeu dogei. Dujire akoino ei.

b: Tugobaigarege eture ia ime pobedu dogebo Jesus apo jamedu. Ro pegarewugenure emage. Ewidodumode jamedu.
source: Tugobaigarege eture ia ime pobedu dogebo Jesus apo jamedu. Ro pegarewugenure emage. Ewidodumode jamedu.

b: Nono etaregodure ture boe ewido kejewu tori ao ka. Nou tori iere “Boe ewirewuge etaora era jeta reo”. Nonore ere Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Ere nowu ro pegarewu ime pobedu doge ewido nono jamedu. Ia rakojere Jesus kana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia rakojere Jesus kana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.
source: Nono etaregodure ture boe ewido kejewu tori ao ka. Nou tori iere “Boe ewirewuge etaora era jeta reo”. Nonore ere Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Ere nowu ro pegarewu ime pobedu doge ewido nono jamedu. Ia rakojere Jesus kana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia rakojere Jesus kana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.

b: Nono Jesus akore Iogwa. Awiago awu boe ero pegare i dupiji. Eruduwakare kaba jiba turoino. Nou tugobaigarege ere Jesus ukudau areia pedo pui. Ere tuwadurogu towuje torirogu tabo tuioruduwo duboba umode tugeragu Jesus ukudau areiaji.
source: Nono Jesus akore Iogwa. Awiago awu boe ero pegare i dupiji. Eruduwakare kaba jiba turoino. Nou tugobaigarege ere Jesus ukudau areia pedo pui. Ere tuwadurogu towuje torirogu tabo tuioruduwo duboba umode tugeragu Jesus ukudau areiaji.

b: Boe etaregodure nowu Jesus ae nowu ipo padure pugajejewu ka. Eragojere nono taiwo tabo Jesus bimode dubagai. Nou boe eimijerage ekadakagirire Jesus jiwuge etaregodure nono tuioruduwo Jesus bire duji. egore are boe ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji. Ca akinorudo jamedu nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwu umode boe ekinorudowu mode aki rugadu dukeje amode akinorudo nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji.
source: Boe etaregodure nowu Jesus ae nowu ipo padure pugajejewu ka. Eragojere nono taiwo tabo Jesus bimode dubagai. Nou boe eimijerage ekadakagirire Jesus jiwuge etaregodure nono tuioruduwo Jesus bire duji. egore are boe ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji. Ca akinorudo jamedu nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwu umode boe ekinorudowu mode aki rugadu dukeje amode akinorudo nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji.

b: Tugobaigarege etomeare turore Jesus jituji jamedu. Ere vinho kuru maku Jesus ai mare kudukare ce. Nono emagore ji. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki dukeje amode akinorudo awu ipo padure pugajejewu piji.
source: Tugobaigarege etomeare turore Jesus jituji jamedu. Ere vinho kuru maku Jesus ai mare kudukare ce. Nono emagore ji. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki dukeje amode akinorudo awu ipo padure pugajejewu piji.

b: Nono ere ia ira atugodo. Ere bu Jesus aogeje. Ainore nowu ira atugo ure: – Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu reo.
source: Nono ere ia ira atugodo. Ere bu Jesus aogeje. Ainore nowu ira atugo ure: – Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu reo.

b: Nou ro pegarewu pobedu doge epadure ipo padure pugajejewu keje nono jamedu Jesus apo jamedu. Ia makore Jesus ji. Akore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki dukeje amode akinorudo amode ceginorudo jamedu.
source: Nou ro pegarewu pobedu doge epadure ipo padure pugajejewu keje nono jamedu Jesus apo jamedu. Ia makore Jesus ji. Akore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki dukeje amode akinorudo amode ceginorudo jamedu.

b: Mare nowu metia makore nowu timediaji. Akore kocare akare aeku kidugo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Boe pegare aino pai paro pegare kodi. Boe enure pawido ipo padure pugajejewu keje paro pegarewu morice. Mare awu pagaiadadawu imedu ro pega bokware rugadu. Dukodire ukare turugadu biwo aino pawi mogadure.
source: Mare nowu metia makore nowu timediaji. Akore kocare akare aeku kidugo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Boe pegare aino pai paro pegare kodi. Boe enure pawido ipo padure pugajejewu keje paro pegarewu morice. Mare awu pagaiadadawu imedu ro pega bokware rugadu. Dukodire ukare turugadu biwo aino pawi mogadure.

b: Dukeje makore Jesus ji. Akore akaregodumode pugeje boe eimijera kurirewu ure aki dutabo dukeje awiabutudo iwugeje.
source: Dukeje makore Jesus ji. Akore akaregodumode pugeje boe eimijera kurirewu ure aki dutabo dukeje awiabutudo iwugeje.

b: Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire imagomode ai. Awu meri ji rugadu aragojemode itabo boe pemegarewu keje.
source: Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire imagomode ai. Awu meri ji rugadu aragojemode itabo boe pemegarewu keje.

b: Jesus Bire Rugadu
source: Jesus Bire Rugadu

b: Meri puredugodure pagaia ka dukeje boecodure taci je moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boecodure rugadu. Nou boeco kodure kuri toro nowu três hora ka.
source: Meri puredugodure pagaia ka dukeje boecodure taci je moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boecodure rugadu. Nou boeco kodure kuri toro nowu três hora ka.

b: Care rore puku je nowu areia kurirewu bararere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tadawu ure tuwowuje nowu bai ja oto piji moto ka.
source: Care rore puku je nowu areia kurirewu bararere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tadawu ure tuwowuje nowu bai ja oto piji moto ka.

b: Nono Jesus kudugodu rakare. Akore iogwa. Iwinure aino mare imugudo akera keje. Makore aino dukeje bire.
source: Nono Jesus kudugodu rakare. Akore iogwa. Iwinure aino mare imugudo akera keje. Makore aino dukeje bire.

b: Tugobaigarege eimijera jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Akore boe rugadu. Awu imedu ro jetororewunure ema rugadu.
source: Tugobaigarege eimijera jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje makore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Akore boe rugadu. Awu imedu ro jetororewunure ema rugadu.

b: Nou etaregodure taiwowo boe ewimode dujiwuge erudure Jesus bire duji dukeje ere tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje tugiarigodu tabo. Ere boeto tumororaji nono Judeu doge ero mogadure tuwo boe erududo tugiarigodure rugadu duji.
source: Nou etaregodure taiwowo boe ewimode dujiwuge erudure Jesus bire duji dukeje ere tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje tugiarigodu tabo. Ere boeto tumororaji nono Judeu doge ero mogadure tuwo boe erududo tugiarigodure rugadu duji.

b: Mare nowu Jesus metage edu kimore nono taiwo tabo. Nou aregodure Jesus rekodajiwuge Galiléia pijiwuge areme edu kimore nono jamedu taiwo tabo Jesus bire duji.
source: Mare nowu Jesus metage edu kimore nono taiwo tabo. Nou aregodure Jesus rekodajiwuge Galiléia pijiwuge areme edu kimore nono jamedu taiwo tabo Jesus bire duji.

b: Jesus Tugudure Tori Poroto
source: Jesus Tugudure Tori Poroto

b: Ia Judéia moto kejewu Arimatéia ba kurirewu kejewu imedu Judeu doge eimijera pemegarewu iere José. Upagare umode boe ekinorudowu bagai boe emearutoruwo ji boe ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Boe eimijerare ema jamedu mare mearudaekare nono tumedage Judeu doge eimijerage emearudaere. Aidukare Jesus bitoduwo.
source: Ia Judéia moto kejewu Arimatéia ba kurirewu kejewu imedu Judeu doge eimijera pemegarewu iere José. Upagare umode boe ekinorudowu bagai boe emearutoruwo ji boe ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Boe eimijerare ema jamedu mare mearudaekare nono tumedage Judeu doge eimijerage emearudaere. Aidukare Jesus bitoduwo.

b: Barogwato Judeu doge emaragodumodukare. Dukodire nowu José okwamagudure Pilatoji tuwo Jesus tugu ia tori poroto nowu Sábado rekodajiwu meri keje. Pilatos akore pegakaie dukodire nowu imedu José ure Jesus rawuje nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji. Ure upodo areia pemegarewu tabo. Nono ure Jesus reko tumode tugu towu tori poro ka. Boe ere nowu tori porodo mare ekare ia birewu tugu to raga. Ca nowu José ure Jesus tugu nowu tori poroto sexta feira meri ji merirekodutabo.
source: Barogwato Judeu doge emaragodumodukare. Dukodire nowu José okwamagudure Pilatoji tuwo Jesus tugu ia tori poroto nowu Sábado rekodajiwu meri keje. Pilatos akore pegakaie dukodire nowu imedu José ure Jesus rawuje nowu ipo padure pugajejewu piji. Ure upodo areia pemegarewu tabo. Nono ure Jesus reko tumode tugu towu tori poro ka. Boe ere nowu tori porodo mare ekare ia birewu tugu to raga. Ca nowu José ure Jesus tugu nowu tori poroto sexta feira meri ji merirekodutabo.

b: Nou etaregodure Galiléia pijiwuge areme ekodure nowu José rekodaji. Erudure José ure tugu tori poro to duji. Ere turemo nowu tori poroto tuioruduwo Jesus meture nono duji.
source: Nou etaregodure Galiléia pijiwuge areme ekodure nowu José rekodaji. Erudure José ure tugu tori poro to duji. Ere turemo nowu tori poroto tuioruduwo Jesus meture nono duji.

b: Nono ere tugirimi tuwai ka pugeje tuwo roreboe pemegado tuwo reko nowu Jesus biriji. Nono Sábado meri keje nowu areme ere tamudo tuwai keje tumearutoruwo Judeu doge eno bakaruji nono turoiaji.
source: Nono ere tugirimi tuwai ka pugeje tuwo roreboe pemegado tuwo reko nowu Jesus biriji. Nono Sábado meri keje nowu areme ere tamudo tuwai keje tumearutoruwo Judeu doge eno bakaruji nono turoiaji.

b: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje
source: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje

b: Domingo boecoto nowu areme eture Jesus meture tadawu tori poro ka nowu ture tugera pemegado jiwu roreboe tabo.
source: Domingo boecoto nowu areme eture Jesus meture tadawu tori poro ka nowu ture tugera pemegado jiwu roreboe tabo.

b: Etaregodure toro dukeje erudure nowu Jesus meture tadawu tori poro jare duji. Sexta feira meri ji ime ere nowu tori poro mi ia tori kurirewu tabo. Mare aino nowu tori kurirewu padukare nowu tori poro keje pugeje.
source: Etaregodure toro dukeje erudure nowu Jesus meture tadawu tori poro jare duji. Sexta feira meri ji ime ere nowu tori poro mi ia tori kurirewu tabo. Mare aino nowu tori kurirewu padukare nowu tori poro keje pugeje.

b: Dukodire nowu areme ere turemo. Etaiwore mare Jesus padukare nono pugeje.
source: Dukodire nowu areme ere turemo. Etaiwore mare Jesus padukare nono pugeje.

b: Eragoje kimore nono tuioruduwa bokwa tabo dukeje nowu areme etaiwore tubiji. Erore puku je erudure Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ji. Ere pobe. Ekudau kigadure ei rugadu. Kigadure nono boeiaragudu mogadure boe etaiwowo ji.
source: Eragoje kimore nono tuioruduwa bokwa tabo dukeje nowu areme etaiwore tubiji. Erore puku je erudure Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ji. Ere pobe. Ekudau kigadure ei rugadu. Kigadure nono boeiaragudu mogadure boe etaiwowo ji.

b: Ca nowu areme epagudugodure rugadu. Ere tubu jodo moto keje. Ere tuie jodo jamedu. Nono nowu baru tadawuge egore kodiba tagaregodure woe birewu metumode tadawu tori poro ka?
source: Ca nowu areme epagudugodure rugadu. Ere tubu jodo moto keje. Ere tuie jodo jamedu. Nono nowu baru tadawuge egore kodiba tagaregodure woe birewu metumode tadawu tori poro ka?

b: Tarudumodukare tagaiwore bagaiwuji. Tagaiwore bagaiwu jewodure pugeje dukodire rakojekare woe pugeje. Marigudu, toro Galiléia moto keje, ure tawie turomode jiboe ji. Tawiabutudo nowu makore jiboe keje.
source: Tarudumodukare tagaiwore bagaiwuji. Tagaiwore bagaiwu jewodure pugeje dukodire rakojekare woe pugeje. Marigudu, toro Galiléia moto keje, ure tawie turomode jiboe ji. Tawiabutudo nowu makore jiboe keje.

b: Akore aino: “Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai. Emode iwido ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje.” Ainore akore tai marigudu.
source: Akore aino: “Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai. Emode iwido ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje.” Ainore akore tai marigudu.

b: Nono nowu areme ewiabuture nowu Jesus makore jiboe keje rugadu. Dukodire care eregodure boe piji toro nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae tureadoduwo tuiorudure jiboe ji tumearudure jiboe ji eiamedu boe ewiagai.
source: Nono nowu areme ewiabuture nowu Jesus makore jiboe keje rugadu. Dukodire care eregodure boe piji toro nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae tureadoduwo tuiorudure jiboe ji tumearudure jiboe ji eiamedu boe ewiagai.

b: Nou areme ekiere Maria Madalena, Joana, Maria. Nou Maria Tiago ucenure ema. Ia areme ekodure ebo jamedu. Nou areme etaregodure nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae dukeje ereadodure tuiorudure jiboe jamedu boe ji nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ime ewiagai.
source: Nou areme ekiere Maria Madalena, Joana, Maria. Nou Maria Tiago ucenure ema. Ia areme ekodure ebo jamedu. Nou areme etaregodure nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae dukeje ereadodure tuiorudure jiboe jamedu boe ji nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ime ewiagai.

b: Jesus ure nowu ime eruduwado tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Mare nowu areme ereadodure tuiorudure jiboe ji nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ewiagai dukeje nowu ime emearudaere pagare egoino duji. Emearutorukare nowu aremei.
source: Jesus ure nowu ime eruduwado tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Mare nowu areme ereadodure tuiorudure jiboe ji nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ewiagai dukeje nowu ime emearudaere pagare egoino duji. Emearutorukare nowu aremei.

b: Mare Pedro rekodure toro nowu Jesus meture tadawu tori poro ka. Aregodure toro dukeje ure turemo mare jorudukare boe ji. Tu nowu areia jire jorudure. Nono ure tugirimi tuibagi tuwiagoro tabo. Meardaere tudada nuba boere?
source: Mare Pedro rekodure toro nowu Jesus meture tadawu tori poro ka. Aregodure toro dukeje ure turemo mare jorudukare boe ji. Tu nowu areia jire jorudure. Nono ure tugirimi tuibagi tuwiagoro tabo. Meardaere tudada nuba boere?

b: Jesus Ure Boe Erududo Pudui Emaús Kawu Awaraji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Erududo Pudui Emaús Kawu Awaraji

b: Nou meri keje rugadu nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere pobedu doge eture Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda iere Emaús. Nou Emaús rakojere dez quilômetros Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji.
source: Nou meri keje rugadu nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere pobedu doge eture Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda iere Emaús. Nou Emaús rakojere dez quilômetros Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji.

b: Nou ime pobedu doge ekodure nowu Emaús kawu awara ji dukeje emagore pui tuiorudure jiboe ji Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada.
source: Nou ime pobedu doge ekodure nowu Emaús kawu awara ji dukeje emagore pui tuiorudure jiboe ji Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada.

b: Emagore aino pui dukeje Jesus aregodure eregodaji tugoduwo ebo jamedu.
source: Emagore aino pui dukeje Jesus aregodure eregodaji tugoduwo ebo jamedu.

b: Etaiwore ji mare eruduwakare ji.
source: Etaiwore ji mare eruduwakare ji.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore kaboba jiba tagagoino pui tagodui aino awara ji? Ere tuwuredo ca je. Ekiarigodure rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore kaboba jiba tagagoino pui tagodui aino awara ji? Ere tuwuredo ca je. Ekiarigodure rugadu.

b: Ia iere Cleopas. Emare makore Jesus ji. Akore boe pegare Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada rugadu. Nou Jerusalém kejewuge eiamedu boe eruduware nowu inoduji. Kocare aruduwakare?
source: Ia iere Cleopas. Emare makore Jesus ji. Akore boe pegare Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada rugadu. Nou Jerusalém kejewuge eiamedu boe eruduware nowu inoduji. Kocare aruduwakare?

b: Jesus akore Kaba jiba boe eroino? Iwie. egore boe ero pegare Jesus ji rugadu. Nazaré pijiwu Jesus jire eroino. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema. Pao Kurirewu aidure ji. Boe etaidure ji jamedu. Ro rakare rugadu turo jamedu boe tabo. Mako pemegare jamedu. Joruduware rugadu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe eiamedu boe kori.
source: Jesus akore Kaba jiba boe eroino? Iwie. egore boe ero pegare Jesus ji rugadu. Nazaré pijiwu Jesus jire eroino. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema. Pao Kurirewu aidure ji. Boe etaidure ji jamedu. Ro rakare rugadu turo jamedu boe tabo. Mako pemegare jamedu. Joruduware rugadu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe eiamedu boe kori.

b: Mare nowu pagimijerage nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nouia pagimijerage jamedu ero pegare ji. Ere maku nouia boe eimijera kurirewu ai. Ere tumearudae pegarewu maku nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ai jamedu uwo Jesus maku tugobaigarege etai ewo bito. Dukodire ere bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu.
source: Mare nowu pagimijerage nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nouia pagimijerage jamedu ero pegare ji. Ere maku nouia boe eimijera kurirewu ai. b: Makore aino ei dutabo ure erududo tugeraji, tuwureji.
source: Makore aino ei dutabo ure erududo tugeraji, tuwureji.

b: Ere ia karo kodu maku ai. Nono Jesus ure ko egai.
