source: Nou ewadae kejewu boe doge enogwa podure pui Jesus jiboe ji. Iage egore imedu pemegarewunure ema. Mare iage egore boro. Unure boe ekiripagado.

b: Mare emagokare nowu inodu boe ji boe ewiagai. Epagudure tugimijeragece kodi.
source: Mare emagokare nowu inodu boe ji boe ewiagai. Epagudure tugimijeragece kodi.

b: Nou Judeu doge ewadure rugadu nowu tuwadaeji. Mare ewadu kimore dukeje Jesus uture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado.
source: Nou Judeu doge ewadure rugadu nowu tuwadaeji. Mare ewadu kimore dukeje Jesus uture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado.

b: Judeu doge eimijerage erore ta je. egore boe ekare awu imedu joruduwado. Kodiba care joruduware aino?
source: Judeu doge eimijerage erore ta je. egore boe ekare awu imedu joruduwado. Kodiba care joruduware aino?

b: Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu koiare ure itarego woe. Du bataru jire inagore aino iwo boe eruduwado.
source: Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu koiare ure itarego woe. Du bataru jire inagore aino iwo boe eruduwado.

b: Aidure tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eruduwamode iwadaru ji. Eruduwamode jamedu iwadaru ji karega inagoino. Eruduwamode Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire inagoino duji.
source: Aidure tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eruduwamode iwadaru ji. Eruduwamode jamedu iwadaru ji karega inagoino. Eruduwamode Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire inagoino duji.

b: Ia boe emagomode tu pudumie tuioruduware. Nouge etaidure boe etaiwowo tu pudui, boe enojarowo nowu tuwadaru ji. Mare ia aidumode boe emago pemegawo nowu ure tarego matowuji dukeje batrarodumodukare. Boe jokodu jire akoino boe etaiduwo nowu ure tarego matowuji.
source: Ia boe emagomode tu pudumie tuioruduware. Nouge etaidure boe etaiwowo tu pudui, boe enojarowo nowu tuwadaru ji. Mare ia aidumode boe emago pemegawo nowu ure tarego matowuji dukeje batrarodumodukare. Boe jokodu jire akoino boe etaiduwo nowu ure tarego matowuji.

b: Mariguduwuge pawobe eimijera Moisés ure Pao Kurirewu mearudae maku etai eno bakaruce. Dukodire tago bakarure aino jii aino. Mare taiamedu boe tamearutorukare nowu tago bakaruji rugadu. Kodiba tagaidure tawo iwido?
source: Mariguduwuge pawobe eimijera Moisés ure Pao Kurirewu mearudae maku etai eno bakaruce. Dukodire tago bakarure aino jii aino. Mare taiamedu boe tamearutorukare nowu tago bakaruji rugadu. Kodiba tagaidure tawo iwido?

b: Nou boe egore cedaidukare cewo awido. Ia bope uwari meture atada rugadu kodire akagoino.
source: Nou boe egore cedaidukare cewo awido. Ia bope uwari meture atada rugadu kodire akagoino.

b: Jesus akore Iro rakare sábado meri keje dukodire taerore ta je.
source: Jesus akore Iro rakare sábado meri keje dukodire taerore ta je.

b: Marigudu Moisés ure taro maku tagai tawo tagore ime ewaga oto biri kado. Mare ia jawu jaoboe eigoiare ere nowu taro maku tagai boeto ji. Nono Moisés rore aino tai jamedu aino boigodu. Dukodire tare tagore ime eiamedu boe ewaga oto biri kado rugadu. Taromode aino sábado meri keje jamedu.
source: Marigudu Moisés ure taro maku tagai tawo tagore ime ewaga oto biri kado. Mare ia jawu jaoboe eigoiare ere nowu taro maku tagai boeto ji. Nono Moisés rore aino tai jamedu aino boigodu. Dukodire tare tagore ime eiamedu boe ewaga oto biri kado rugadu. Taromode aino sábado meri keje jamedu.

b: Moisés ure tago bakaru maku tagai. Akore tamaragodukaiago sábado meri keje mare boe pegakaie tai tawo tagore ime ewaga oto biri kado sábado meri keje. Ire nowu imedu pemegado sábado meri keje dukodire tagorigodure aino i. Tagagore boe erokaie aino sábado meri keje.
source: Moisés ure tago bakaru maku tagai. Akore tamaragodukaiago sábado meri keje mare boe pegakaie tai tawo tagore ime ewaga oto biri kado sábado meri keje. Ire nowu imedu pemegado sábado meri keje dukodire tagorigodure aino i. Tagagore boe erokaie aino sábado meri keje.

b: Tagaiwokaba boe ji tamearudae pegarewu tabo. Tagaiwodo boe ji eromode jiboe ji emearudaemode jiboe ji jamedu. Dukodire taruduwamode ei rugadu.
source: Tagaiwokaba boe ji tamearudae pegarewu tabo. Tagaiwodo boe ji eromode jiboe ji emearudaemode jiboe ji jamedu. Dukodire taruduwamode ei rugadu.

b: Boe Epagare Bagaiwu Umode Boe Ekinorudowu Nure Ema?
source: Boe Epagare Bagaiwu Umode Boe Ekinorudowu Nure Ema?

b: Nouia mugure Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewuge egore cowu pagimijerage etaidure tuwo bitowu imedu karegau?
source: Nouia mugure Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewuge egore cowu pagimijerage etaidure tuwo bitowu imedu karegau?

b: Kocare makore boe eiamedu boe ewiagai boe eiamedu boe egai. Mare boe emago pegarewu bokware ia tuwadaru ji ji. Pagimijerage eruduwa kana umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji? Eruduwa kana pabagare bagaiwunure ema duji?
source: Kocare makore boe eiamedu boe ewiagai boe eiamedu boe egai. Mare boe emago pegarewu bokware ia tuwadaru ji ji. Pagimijerage eruduwa kana umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji? Eruduwa kana pabagare bagaiwunure ema duji?

b: Boe eruduwamodukare kaibowu pijiba umode boe ekinorudowu aregodumode. Mare paiamedu boe paruduware kaibowu pijiba awu imedu aregodure.
source: Boe eruduwamodukare kaibowu pijiba umode boe ekinorudowu aregodumode. Mare paiamedu boe paruduware kaibowu pijiba awu imedu aregodure.

b: Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje ure tumago pemegado toro boe etae boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo tuwadaru ji. Akore tamearudaere taruduwaie itaregodure pijiwu moto ji. Mare nowu ure itarego matowu emare ure itudo jetu. Imi itaobiji karega itaregodure. Nou ure itarego matowu batrarodumodukare. Boe remawunure ema rugadu. Mare taruduwakare ji.
source: Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje ure tumago pemegado toro boe etae boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo tuwadaru ji. Akore tamearudaere taruduwaie itaregodure pijiwu moto ji. Mare nowu ure itarego matowu emare ure itudo jetu. Imi itaobiji karega itaregodure. Nou ure itarego matowu batrarodumodukare. Boe remawunure ema rugadu. Mare taruduwakare ji.

b: Iragojere apo dukodire ioruduware ji. Ema koiare ure itarego mato.
source: Iragojere apo dukodire ioruduware ji. Ema koiare ure itarego mato.

b: Nono iage etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji tuwo tugu baicorewuto. Mare Pao Kurirewu aidukare dukodire erokare aino ji rugadu.
source: Nono iage etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji tuwo tugu baicorewuto. Mare Pao Kurirewu aidukare dukodire erokare aino ji rugadu.

b: Mare iage emearutorure Jesus ji. Awu mearutorure jiwuge emagare. egore awu imedu ro rakare nono pabagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowu mogadure rugadu.
source: Mare iage emearutorure Jesus ji. Awu mearutorure jiwuge emagare. egore awu imedu ro rakare nono pabagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowu mogadure rugadu.

b: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tugobaigarege Etudo Tuwo Tugeragu Jesus ji
source: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tugobaigarege Etudo Tuwo Tugeragu Jesus ji

b: Fariseu doge emearudure nowu boe enogwa podure pui Jesus jiboe jituji. Dukejere ere tugobaigarege etudo toro tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudaere nono nowu fariseu doge emearudae mogadure jamedu.
source: Fariseu doge emearudure nowu boe enogwa podure pui Jesus jiboe jituji. Dukejere ere tugobaigarege etudo toro tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudaere nono nowu fariseu doge emearudae mogadure jamedu.

b: Jesus makore boe ji. Akore iragoje biagamode tu tagabo. Kuri aino itumode tabiji toro ure itarego matowu bagai ibagi.
source: Jesus makore boe ji. Akore iragoje biagamode tu tagabo. Kuri aino itumode tabiji toro ure itarego matowu bagai ibagi.

b: Tagaiwomode iwagai mare tarudumodukare i. Taroiwamodukare taduwo toro iragojemodewu ka.
source: Tagaiwomode iwagai mare tarudumodukare i. Taroiwamodukare taduwo toro iragojemodewu ka.

b: Nou Judeu doge egore pui: – Kaiba kodumode? Utumode kana toro pawobe etae toro ia Grécia moto kejewu ba kurirewu ka tuwo nowu Grécia kejewuge eruduwado? Nuba romode parudukawo pudui pugeje?
source: Nou Judeu doge egore pui: – Kaiba kodumode? Utumode kana toro pawobe etae toro ia Grécia moto kejewu ba kurirewu ka tuwo nowu Grécia kejewuge eruduwado? Nuba romode parudukawo pudui pugeje?

b: Akore pagaiwomoduie tuwagai mare parudumodukaie pudui. Akore paroiwamodukaie paduwo toro turagojemodewu ka. Kaba jiba akoino?
source: Akore pagaiwomoduie tuwagai mare parudumodukaie pudui. Akore paroiwamodukaie paduwo toro turagojemodewu ka. Kaba jiba akoino?

b: Awu Pobo Umode Boe Emugu Pemegado Pao Kurirewu Apo
source: Awu Pobo Umode Boe Emugu Pemegado Pao Kurirewu Apo

b: Awu meri ji nowu Judeu doge ewadae remawu akedu kejewu meri reo. Jesus ure turagojedo. Ure tumago pemegado boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore Pobo boeire ia tai dukeje tadudo itae.
source: Awu meri ji nowu Judeu doge ewadae remawu akedu kejewu meri reo. Jesus ure turagojedo. Ure tumago pemegado boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore Pobo boeire ia tai dukeje tadudo itae.

b: Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Mearutorure iwuge ekudumode nowu poboce dukeje umode turedo epiji. Nou pobo umode emugu pemegado rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu.”
source: Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Mearutorure iwuge ekudumode nowu poboce dukeje umode turedo epiji. Nou pobo umode emugu pemegado rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu.”

b: Mare pobo ji karega Jesus akoino. Pao Kurirewu Uwari jire Jesus akoino. Boe emearutorumode Jesus ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku nowu boe etai. Dujire Jesus akoino. Mare Jesus akore aino nowu boe ji kimo mare Pao Kurirewu ukare Tuwari maku boe etai raga. Jesus jewodukare tuwi piji raga turuduwo baru to dukodire ukare maku etai raga.
source: Mare pobo ji karega Jesus akoino. Pao Kurirewu Uwari jire Jesus akoino. Boe emearutorumode Jesus ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku nowu boe etai. Dujire Jesus akoino. Mare Jesus akore aino nowu boe ji kimo mare Pao Kurirewu ukare Tuwari maku boe etai raga. Jesus jewodukare tuwi piji raga turuduwo baru to dukodire ukare maku etai raga.

b: Nou Boe Emearudaekare Nou Pumearudae ji
source: Nou Boe Emearudaekare Nou Pumearudae ji

b: Nou boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje iage egore Pao Kurirewu ure pawie jiwu, makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure awu imeduce rugadu.
source: Nou boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje iage egore Pao Kurirewu ure pawie jiwu, makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure awu imeduce rugadu.

b: Iage egore Pabagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowunure ema. Mare iage emearutorukare. Eruduwakare Jesus boture Belém ba kurirewu keje duji. Dukodire egore ema karega. Awu imedu boture Galiléia moto keje.
source: Iage egore Pabagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowunure ema. Mare iage emearutorukare. Eruduwakare Jesus boture Belém ba kurirewu keje duji. Dukodire egore ema karega. Awu imedu boture Galiléia moto keje.

b: Pao Kurirewu akore Belém ba kurirewu kejeie nowu pabagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowu botumode. Jao pagimijera kurirewu Davi uwobe moduie ema. Belém ba kurirewu kejere nowu Davi mugure. Mare awu Jesus botukare Belém ba kurirewu keje. Ainore nowu boe egore. Mare eruduwakare Jesus boture Belém ba kurirewu keje duji. Dukodire egoino.
source: Pao Kurirewu akore Belém ba kurirewu kejeie nowu pabagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowu botumode. Jao pagimijera kurirewu Davi uwobe moduie ema. Belém ba kurirewu kejere nowu Davi mugure. Mare awu Jesus botukare Belém ba kurirewu keje. Ainore nowu boe egore. Mare eruduwakare Jesus boture Belém ba kurirewu keje duji. Dukodire egoino.

b: Dukodire emearutorukare ji. Dukodire nowu boe emearudaekare pumearudae mogadure Jesus jiture.
source: Dukodire emearutorukare ji. Dukodire nowu boe emearudaekare pumearudae mogadure Jesus jiture.

b: Iage etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji tuwo tugu baicorewuto. Mare boe eragakare tuduwo ae.
source: Iage etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji tuwo tugu baicorewuto. Mare boe eragakare tuduwo ae.

b: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Emearutorukare Jesus ji
source: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Emearutorukare Jesus ji

b: Dukodire tugobaigarege eture tuibagi tugimijerage fariseu doge etae, tugimijerage ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae. Nou tugobaigarege eimijerage enarare ei. egore kodiba tagaregodukare apo?
source: Dukodire tugobaigarege eture tuibagi tugimijerage fariseu doge etae, tugimijerage ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae. Nou tugobaigarege eimijerage enarare ei. egore kodiba tagaregodukare apo?

b: Nou tugobaigarege egore Marigudu boe emagokare nono nowu imedu makore jiboe mogadure ji aino. Mako pemegare rugadu.
source: Nou tugobaigarege egore Marigudu boe emagokare nono nowu imedu makore jiboe mogadure ji aino. Mako pemegare rugadu.

b: Nou fariseu doge ekorigodure. egore ure taekiripagado rugadu.
source: Nou fariseu doge ekorigodure. egore ure taekiripagado rugadu.

b: Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe emearutorukare ji rugadu. Fariseu dogenure cegi. Ceiamedu boe cemearutorukare ji rugadu.
source: Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe emearutorukare ji rugadu. Fariseu dogenure cegi. Ceiamedu boe cemearutorukare ji rugadu.

b: Awu boe eruduwakare Moisés ure maku pagaiwu pago bakaruji paroji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pegare ei. Dukodi care boe pegamode ei rugadu. Ainore nowu fariseu doge egore.
source: Awu boe eruduwakare Moisés ure maku pagaiwu pago bakaruji paroji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pegare ei. Dukodi care boe pegamode ei rugadu. Ainore nowu fariseu doge egore.

b: Ia fariseu iere Nicodemos. Emare uture Jesus ae marigudu tuioruduwawo Jesus bataru ji. Aino care makore tumedage fariseu dogei.
source: Ia fariseu iere Nicodemos. Emare uture Jesus ae marigudu tuioruduwawo Jesus bataru ji. Aino care makore tumedage fariseu dogei.

b: Akore Pawiapagamode boe ewadaru ji paruduwawo eroji dukeje pagaiwomode ero pegarewu bagai. Ainore pago bakaru ure. Ainore parore. Paromodukare aino dukeje paro peganure.
source: Akore Pawiapagamode boe ewadaru ji paruduwawo eroji dukeje pagaiwomode ero pegarewu bagai. Ainore pago bakaru ure. Ainore parore. Paromodukare aino dukeje paro peganure.

b: Mare nowu fariseu doge egore awodu kana Galiléia moto keje jamedu nono awu imedu Jesus mogadure? Akaidure ji? Akaiwodo Pao Kurirewu bataru padure kejewu baperaji. Akaiwomode ji dukeje aruduwamode nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ewodukare nowu Galiléia moto keje rugadu.
source: Mare nowu fariseu doge egore awodu kana Galiléia moto keje jamedu nono awu imedu Jesus mogadure? Akaidure ji? Akaiwodo Pao Kurirewu bataru padure kejewu baperaji. Akaiwomode ji dukeje aruduwamode nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ewodukare nowu Galiléia moto keje rugadu.

b: Boe Eimijerage Erudure Aredu Jeribarire Tumugukare Apowu Imedu Jituji
source: Boe Eimijerage Erudure Aredu Jeribarire Tumugukare Apowu Imedu Jituji

b: Boe eiamedu boe eture tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje. Mare Jesus ruture ia tori iere Oliveira Ri ao ka.
source: Boe eiamedu boe eture tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje. Mare Jesus ruture ia tori iere Oliveira Ri ao ka.

b: Barogwakododu kejere ure turawuje. Uture tuibagi Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje. Boe ere bato pui ae. Emagare. Dukodire ure tumugudo boebo dukeje ure eruduwado.
source: Barogwakododu kejere ure turawuje. Uture tuibagi Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje. Boe ere bato pui ae. Emagare. Dukodire ure tumugudo boebo dukeje ure eruduwado.

b: Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure ae aredu apo. Fariseu doge etaregodure ebo jamedu. Erudure nowu aredu jeribarire tumugukare apowu imedu jituji. Dukodire etaregodure nowu aredu apo aino. Nono ere nowu aredu rakojedo boe etoiadada.
source: Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure ae aredu apo. Fariseu doge etaregodure ebo jamedu. Erudure nowu aredu jeribarire tumugukare apowu imedu jituji. Dukodire etaregodure nowu aredu apo aino. Nono ere nowu aredu rakojedo boe etoiadada.

b: Emagore Jesus ji. egore Joruduwarewunure aki. Cerudure awu aredu jeribarire tumugukare apowu imedu jituji.
source: Emagore Jesus ji. egore Joruduwarewunure aki. Cerudure awu aredu jeribarire tumugukare apowu imedu jituji.

b: Marigudu Moisés ure Pao Kurirewu mearudae maku jawu pawobe etai pago bakaruce kodire parore aino rugadu. Emare akore aredu jeribarie tumugukare apowu imeduji dukeje boe eiago nowu aredu bito tori tabo. Ca nuba amearudaere parowo awu areduji?
source: Marigudu Moisés ure Pao Kurirewu mearudae maku jawu pawobe etai pago bakaruce kodire parore aino rugadu. Emare akore aredu jeribarie tumugukare apowu imeduji dukeje boe eiago nowu aredu bito tori tabo. Ca nuba amearudaere parowo awu areduji?

b: Nou boe eimijerage etaidure tuwo turokogado Jesus ji tumearuduwo ia Jesus bataru pegarewu bagai. Dukodire egoino ji. Mare Jesus makokare boe ji. Ure tubu jodo moto keje tuwo tuwadaru bu moto keje tugerako tabo.
source: Nou boe eimijerage etaidure tuwo turokogado Jesus ji tumearuduwo ia Jesus bataru pegarewu bagai. Dukodire egoino ji. Mare Jesus makokare boe ji. Ure tubu jodo moto keje tuwo tuwadaru bu moto keje tugerako tabo.

b: Nou boe eimijerage enara kimore ji dukeje Jesus ure turagojedo pugeje. Dukeje makore ei. Akore ia tagi taro pegarewu bokware dukeje tagidomode tori tabo nowu areduji boeto ji.
source: Nou boe eimijerage enara kimore ji dukeje Jesus ure turagojedo pugeje. Dukeje makore ei. Akore ia tagi taro pegarewu bokware dukeje tagidomode tori tabo nowu areduji boeto ji.

b: Nono Jesus ure tubu jodo moto keje pugeje dukeje ure ia tuwadaru bu moto keje tugerako tabo pugeje.
source: Nono Jesus ure tubu jodo moto keje pugeje dukeje ure ia tuwadaru bu moto keje tugerako tabo pugeje.

b: Nou boe eimijerage emearudure nowu Jesus akoino duji dukeje eture Jesus piji etododai. Pegagodurewuge eture boeto ji. Dukeje iage eture eregodaji. Nono iage eture pugeje. Ca nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe eture rugadu. Aino Jesus rakojere nono tuginaigodu nowu etaregodure apowu aredu apo.
source: Nou boe eimijerage emearudure nowu Jesus akoino duji dukeje eture Jesus piji etododai. Pegagodurewuge eture boeto ji. Dukeje iage eture eregodaji. Nono iage eture pugeje. Ca nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe eture rugadu. Aino Jesus rakojere nono tuginaigodu nowu etaregodure apowu aredu apo.

b: Nono Jesus ure turagodo dukeje makore nowu areduji. Akore kaiba ekodure? Boe edukare woe pugeje tumago pegawo ai.
source: Nono Jesus ure turagodo dukeje makore nowu areduji. Akore kaiba ekodure? Boe edukare woe pugeje tumago pegawo ai.

b: Nou aredu akore Boro. Eiamedu boe eture marigudu. Jesus akore Ca imago pegamodukare ai jamedu. Atudo awai ka aibagi. Mare paga karega. Aro pegakaba pugeje.
source: Nou aredu akore Boro. Eiamedu boe eture marigudu. Jesus akore Ca imago pegamodukare ai jamedu. Atudo awai ka aibagi. Mare paga karega. Aro pegakaba pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Nono Jorugu Pemegarewu Mogadure
source: Jesus Ure Nono Jorugu Pemegarewu Mogadure

b: Jesus makore nowu fariseu dogei pugeje. Akore jorugu pemegarewu koiare umode boe edo cinorudo boe pegarewu piji boeco ji. Ire nono jorugu pemegarewu mogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Imode boe edo cinorudo turo pegarewu piji. Boe ekodumode itabo dukeje imode boe erududo turo pegarewu ji erokawo aino pugeje. Imode eroiwado tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji.
source: Jesus makore nowu fariseu dogei pugeje. Akore jorugu pemegarewu koiare umode boe edo cinorudo boe pegarewu piji boeco ji. Ire nono jorugu pemegarewu mogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Imode boe edo cinorudo turo pegarewu piji. Boe ekodumode itabo dukeje imode boe erududo turo pegarewu ji erokawo aino pugeje. Imode eroiwado tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji.

b: Nou fariseu doge egore amagore cei mare aragojere woe akinaigodu. Tu akire akagoino. Dukodire care awadaru ukare turugadu cegai.
source: Nou fariseu doge egore amagore cei mare aragojere woe akinaigodu. Tu akire akagoino. Dukodire care awadaru ukare turugadu cegai.

b: Jesus akore Boro. Ioruduware boe jokodu jire inagoino tai duji. Taruduwakare kaibowu pijiba itaregodure. Imire ioruduware. Taruduwakare kaiba ikodumode. Imire ioruduware. Dukodire inagoino irore jiboe ji tawiagai.

Mare iage egore ia ro pegarewu imedu ro rakamodukare nono awu imedu ro raka mogadure. Awu imedu pemegare rugadu. Dukeje care emearudaekare nono pumearudaere.

Egore ia mearutorumoduie Jesus ji umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji dukeje tumode utudo nowu ture bato puiwu bai piji rugadu aregodukawo nowu bai ka pugeje. Dukodire nowu joku bokwarewu uce uo epagudugodure nowu tugimijeragece.

b: Dukodire emagokare Jesus ieji tugimijerage ewiagai. Egore tonaregedu koiaie umoduie ewie iduba roino pudui duji.

b: egore nuba rore ai tuwo aeku pemegado akaiwo pemegawo pugeje?

b: Nou joku bokwarewu imedu akore Nou imedu ure ipemegago itaiwowo pugeje. Ioku bokwakare pugeje. Boe eimijeragenure tagi. Kocare taruduwakare nowu imeduji. Kocare aruduwakare kaibowu pijiba awu imedu aregodure.

b: Iwodure ioku bokwa tabo. Aino ca nowu imedu ure itaiwodo pugeje. Marigudu rugadu ia boe erokare nono ro mogadure. Ca Pao Kurirewu biapagamodukare ro pegarewuge emagore pudui jiboe bagai. b: Nou imedu aregodukare Pao Kurirewu piji dukeje ro rakamodukare. Umodukare ipemegago. Kodiba ure ipemegago? Ca aregodure Pao Kurirewu piji rugadu.

b: Nou boe eimijerage egore awodure dukeje ro pegarewunure aki rugadu jii aino. Aki na akaidure awo ceruduwado? Aruduwa bokwa. Dukodi care ere nowu imedu utudo nowu ture bato puiwu bai piji aregodukawo nowu bai ka pugeje.
source: Nou boe eimijerage egore awodure dukeje ro pegarewunure aki rugadu jii aino. Aki na akaidure awo ceruduwado? Aruduwa bokwa. Dukodi care ere nowu imedu utudo nowu ture bato puiwu bai piji aregodukawo nowu bai ka pugeje.

b: Boe Eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu Meardaeji
source: Boe Eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu Meardaeji

b: Jesus mearudure nowu boe eimijerage erore aino duji dukeje jemarure nowu ture pemegagowu imedu bagai. Jorudure ji dukeje makore ji. Akore aki na amearutorure Imedu Onaregeduji rugadu?
source: Jesus mearudure nowu boe eimijerage erore aino duji dukeje jemarure nowu ture pemegagowu imedu bagai. Jorudure ji dukeje makore ji. Akore aki na amearutorure Imedu Onaregeduji rugadu?

Dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegare jiboe piji rugadu. Mare tagagore taruduwaie Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu. Tagagore taro pega bokwaie. Aino tagojarore tawadaru ji rugadu. b: Jeture Carneiro Doge Eiwu Bakaru Reo
source: Jeture Carneiro Doge Eiwu Bakaru Reo

b: Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emode tagu carneiro doge edu tadawu ibora pemegado eduwo tada boeco ji. Jeture carneiro doge eiwu umode turemo etae nowu eda ibora baiporoji. Mare iwogurewu umodukare turemo nowu edu tadawu ibora baiporoji. Umode turemo edu tadawu ibora kujiado.
source: Jesus akore Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emode tagu carneiro doge edu tadawu ibora pemegado eduwo tada boeco ji. Jeture carneiro doge eiwu umode turemo etae nowu eda ibora baiporoji. Mare iwogurewu umodukare turemo nowu edu tadawu ibora baiporoji. Umode turemo edu tadawu ibora kujiado.

b: Nou jeture nowu ibora baiporo jiwu umode nowu carneiro doge eda baiporo jado nowu jeture carneiro doge eiwu uwo turemo carneiro doge etae. Nou jeture carneiro doge eiwu joruduware tagu carneiro doge ekieji. Dukodire makomode tagu carneiro doge ewagai dukeje eruduware mako ji. Kodire etumode rekodaji tieda piji.

b: Umode etawuje eda piji dukeje etumode rekodaji rugadu eruduware jetu pemegare puduiwu mako ji rugadu. Jeture eiwu utumode etododai.
source: Umode etawuje eda piji dukeje etumode rekodaji rugadu eruduware jetu pemegare puduiwu mako ji rugadu. Jeture eiwu utumode etododai.

b: Carneiro doge etumodukare ia boe eregodaji rugadu. Ia makomode ewagai mare eregodumode piji rugadu. Eruduwakare mako ji dukodi eregodumode piji.
source: Carneiro doge etumodukare ia boe eregodaji rugadu. Ia makomode ewagai mare eregodumode piji rugadu. Eruduwakare mako ji dukodi eregodumode piji.

b: Jesus Jetu Pemegare Boei
source: Jesus Jetu Pemegare Boei

b: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Ire nono nowu carneiro doge eda kejewu bai poro mogadure. Mare bai poro ji karega inagoino.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Ire nono nowu carneiro doge eda kejewu bai poro mogadure. Mare bai poro ji karega inagoino.

b: Mearutorure iwuge ere nono carneiro doge emogadure. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Marigudu iage etaregodure tuwo boe erego ikoda piji mare mearutorure iwuge ewiapagakare ei.
source: Mearutorure iwuge ere nono carneiro doge emogadure. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Marigudu iage etaregodure tuwo boe erego ikoda piji mare mearutorure iwuge ewiapagakare ei.

b: Iwogurewu aidure tu tuwo tugeragu boe ji boe epiji. Aidure tu tuwo boe ewido. Aidure tu tuwo boe etagedudo. Mare imire ire nono bai poro remawu mogadure. Mare bai poro ji karega inagoino. Boe etumode itae dukeje imode ekodiwado tugodure jiboe ji. Ca itaregodure woe iwo boe emugu pemegado. Emugu pemegamode rugadu.

b: – Jetu pemegare carneiro dogeiwu umode iaboedo tuwido tuwo tagu carneiro doge ekinorudo barege pegarewuge epiji. Ca iromode nono nowu jetu pemegare carneiro dogeiwu ro mogadure. source: – Jetu pemegare carneiro dogeiwu umode iaboedo tuwido tuwo tagu carneiro doge ekinorudo barege pegarewuge epiji. Ca iromode nono nowu jetu pemegare carneiro dogeiwu ro mogadure. b: Nou akure carneiro doge ecewu utugare biagoromodukare tietu pemegawo carneiro dogei. Aku ie karega. Dukodire rekodumode nowu barogo pegarewu piji. Umode tugera ra carneiro doge epiji. Dukeje nowu barogo pegarewu umode tugeragu ia carneiroji. Umode nouia carneiro doge edo taodo pubiji toro boe maerewu ka.
source: Nou akure carneiro doge ecewu utugare biagoromodukare tietu pemegawo carneiro dogei. Aku ie karega. Dukodire rekodumode nowu barogo pegarewu piji. Umode tugera ra carneiro doge epiji. b: Ca irore nono nowu jetu pemegare carneiro dogeiwu ro mogadure. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Ietu pemegamode boe dogei rugadu. Iogwa Kurirewu joruduware i. source: Ca irore nono nowu jetu pemegare carneiro dogeiwu ro mogadure. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Ietu pemegamode boe dogei rugadu. Iogwa Kurirewu joruduware i. b: Ia boe emearutorumode i jamedu. Mare eragojekare woe. Imode ikeragu ei jamedu emugu pemegawo itabo rugadu. Ewiapagamode iwadaru ji rugadu. Mearutorumode iwuge eiamedu boe emugumode puapo. Jetu pemegare eiwu umode mitotu je.
source: Ia boe emearutorumode i jamedu. Mare eragojekare woe. Imode ikeragu ei jamedu emugu pemegawo itabo rugadu. Ewiapagamode iwadaru ji rugadu. Mearutorumode iwuge eiamedu boe emugumode puapo. Jetu pemegare eiwu umode mitotu je.

b: – Ire irugadu iwiwo dukodire Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurire i rugadu. Dukodire umode iewodudo pugeje.

b: Imi imode imagu boe pegarewuge etai itaidu tabo ewo iwido. Itaidumode imode imagu. Itaidumode iewoduwo dukeje iewodumode. Ainore Pao kurirewu akore iroiago.
source: Imi imode imagu boe pegarewuge etai itaidu tabo ewo iwido. Itaidumode imode imagu. Itaidumode iewoduwo dukeje iewodumode. Ainore Pao kurirewu akore iroiago.

b: Jesus makore aino dukeje nowu boe emearudaekare nono pumearudae mogadure pugeje nowu Jesus bataru keje.
source: Jesus makore aino dukeje nowu boe emearudaekare nono pumearudae mogadure pugeje nowu Jesus bataru keje.

b: Iage egore ia bope uwari meture awu Jesus tada. Aora bai baire rugadu. Pawiapagamodukare ji rugadu.
source: Iage egore ia bope uwari meture awu Jesus tada. Aora bai baire rugadu. Pawiapagamodukare ji rugadu.

b: Mare iage egore ia bope uwari metumode tada dukeje makomodukare aino. Romodukare aino. Ure joku bokwarewu aiwodo pugeje. Ca bope uwari meture tadawu romode aino? Romodukare aino!
source: Mare iage egore ia bope uwari metumode tada dukeje makomodukare aino. Romodukare aino. Ure joku bokwarewu aiwodo pugeje. Ca bope uwari meture tadawu romode aino? Romodukare aino!

b: Boe Emearutorukare Jesus ji
source: Boe Emearutorukare Jesus ji

b: Biaku buture dukeje nowu Judeu doge ewadure ia tuwadaeji Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje. Nou tuwadae tabore ewiabuture ture Pao Kurirewu uwai rakojedo du ka.
source: Biaku buture dukeje nowu Judeu doge ewadure ia tuwadaeji Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje. Nou tuwadae tabore ewiabuture ture Pao Kurirewu uwai rakojedo du ka.

b: Jesus merure Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Salomão Uwai Jokora jire merure.
source: Jesus merure Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Salomão Uwai Jokora jire merure.

b: Nono boe ere bato pui ae dukeje enarare ji. egore akare cewie marigudu dukodire boe raire ceruduwawo ai rugadu. Ca cewiedu pemegado. Aki na amode boe ekinorudo? Cebagare bagaiwunure aki?
source: Nono boe ere bato pui ae dukeje enarare ji. egore akare cewie marigudu dukodire boe raire ceruduwawo ai rugadu. Ca cewiedu pemegado. Aki na amode boe ekinorudo? Cebagare bagaiwunure aki?

b: Jesus akore Ire tawie marigudu. Mare tamearutorukare i. Iogwa Kurirewu ure iro rakado tamearutoruwo iro rakare rugadu duji.
source: Jesus akore Ire tawie marigudu. Mare tamearutorukare i. Iogwa Kurirewu ure iro rakado tamearutoruwo iro rakare rugadu duji.

b: Mare tamearutorukare i. Iwobe karegure tagi.
source: Mare tamearutorukare i. Iwobe karegure tagi.

b: Mearutorure iwuge eromode nono carneiro doge ero mogadure. Ire nono jeture carneiro dogeiwu mogadure. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge ewiapagamode iwadaru ji. Ioruduware ei. Ekodumode iregodaji.
source: Mearutorure iwuge eromode nono carneiro doge ero mogadure. Ire nono jeture carneiro dogeiwu mogadure. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge ewiapagamode iwadaru ji. Ioruduware ei. Ekodumode iregodaji.

b: Imode emugu pemegado. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Ewimodukare pugeje. Ia boe emodukare tugeragu ei ipiji.
source: Imode emugu pemegado. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Ewimodukare pugeje. Ia boe emodukare tugeragu ei ipiji.

b: Imearudu kurire awu Iogwa ure maku inaiwuge ji. Iogwa Kurirewu jetu pemegamode ei rugadu dukodire ia boe emodukare tugeragu ei Iogwa piji.
source: Imearudu kurire awu Iogwa ure maku inaiwuge ji. Iogwa Kurirewu jetu pemegamode ei rugadu dukodire ia boe emodukare tugeragu ei Iogwa piji.

b: Iogwa imi cere aino pure tu je.
source: Iogwa imi cere aino pure tu je.

b: Nono boe ere tugeragu toriji tuwo tori to Jesus ji.
source: Nono boe ere tugeragu toriji tuwo tori to Jesus ji.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore iogwa Kurirewu koiare ure iro rakado. Tarudure nowu iro pemegarewuji. Kodiba tagaidure tawo iwido?
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore iogwa Kurirewu koiare ure iro rakado. Tarudure nowu iro pemegarewuji. Kodiba tagaidure tawo iwido?

b: egore aro pemegakare kodi. Imedunure aki. Mare akaidure awo Pao Kurirewudo aki. Mare akagoino dutabo amago peganure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.
source: egore aro pemegakare kodi. Imedunure aki. Mare akaidure awo Pao Kurirewudo aki. Mare akagoino dutabo amago peganure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu ure taro maku tagai dukodi nowu taro padure bapera keje nowu tago bakaru tada. Nou bakaru akore Pao Kurirewu orenure tagi.”
source: Nono Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu ure taro maku tagai dukodi nowu taro padure bapera keje nowu tago bakaru tada. Nou bakaru akore Pao Kurirewu orenure tagi.”

b: Boe jokodu jire bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akoino. Ainore ure jii aino. Akedumodukare rugadu. Ca Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru maku boe etai. Emare makore ei tore nuie emage.
source: Boe jokodu jire bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akoino. Ainore ure jii aino. Akedumodukare rugadu. Ca Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru maku boe etai. Emare makore ei tore nuie emage.

b: Mare imi. Iogwa Kurirewu ure tugeragu i. Ure itarego mato moto ka. Imire inagoino Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu nuie imi. Itaidukare tamago pegawo i. Imi imago pegakare Iogwa Kurirewu ji rugadu.
source: Mare imi. Iogwa Kurirewu ure tugeragu i. Ure itarego mato moto ka. Imire inagoino Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu nuie imi. Itaidukare tamago pegawo i. Imi imago pegakare Iogwa Kurirewu ji rugadu.

b: Iromodukare Iogwa Kurirewu aidure jiboe ji dukeje tamearutorumodukare i.
source: Iromodukare Iogwa Kurirewu aidure jiboe ji dukeje tamearutorumodukare i.

b: Tamearutorumodukare i mare iromode Iogwa Kurirewu aidure jiwu iro rakarewu ji dukeje tamearutorudo iro rakare jiboe ji. Tamearutorumode irore jiboe ji dukeje taruduwamode Iogwa merure itabo rugadu duji. Taruduwamode iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo rugadu duji. Cere aino pure tu je.
source: Tamearutorumodukare i mare iromode Iogwa Kurirewu aidure jiwu iro rakarewu ji dukeje tamearutorudo iro rakare jiboe ji. Tamearutorumode irore jiboe ji dukeje taruduwamode Iogwa merure itabo rugadu duji. Taruduwamode iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo rugadu duji. Cere aino pure tu je.

b: Ca ere tuiago tugeragu Jesus ji rugadu mare Jesus ure tumegido paci toro epiji.
source: Ca ere tuiago tugeragu Jesus ji rugadu mare Jesus ure tumegido paci toro epiji.

b: Nono uture pugeje. Kurugodure Jordão po kajeje toro João Batista ure boe etao pegodo kejewu ka. Nonore Jesus rakojere tu jao.
source: Nono uture pugeje. Kurugodure Jordão po kajeje toro João Batista ure boe etao pegodo kejewu ka. Nonore Jesus rakojere tu jao.

b: Nonore boe etaregodure Jesus ae pugeje. Emagare. egore João Batista ro rakarewu bokware. Mare ure boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe jamedu boe jeture pudui rugadu.
source: Nonore boe etaregodure Jesus ae pugeje. Emagare. egore João Batista ro rakarewu bokware. Mare ure boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe jamedu boe jeture pudui rugadu.

b: Dukodire boe emagare nono tumearutorure Jesus jitu tabo rugadu.
source: Dukodire boe emagare nono tumearutorure Jesus jitu tabo rugadu.

b: Lázaro Bire
source: Lázaro Bire

b: Ia imedu kogodure. Mugure Betânia ba kurirewu keje. Nou imedu iere Lázaro. Uwie aredu iere Maria. Nou Maria utuie iere Marta. Eiamedu boe emugure nowu Betânia ba kurirewu keje.
source: Ia imedu kogodure. Mugure Betânia ba kurirewu keje. Nou imedu iere Lázaro. Uwie aredu iere Maria. Nou Maria utuie iere Marta. Eiamedu boe emugure nowu Betânia ba kurirewu keje.

b: Marigudu nowu Maria ure roreboe pemegarewu reko Jesus bure joki. Ure reko dukejere ure kidudo tao tabo pugeje. Mare aino care uwuri kogodure.
source: Marigudu nowu Maria ure roreboe pemegarewu reko Jesus bure joki. Ure reko dukejere ure kidudo tao tabo pugeje. Mare aino care uwuri kogodure.

b: Dukodire nowu Maria, nowu Marta ere boe erego tuwadaru tabo toro Jesus bagai. Egore nowu boe egoiago nowu Jesus ji tuwuri kogoduie. Mearudu kurire jiwu tuwuri kogoduie.
source: Dukodire nowu Maria, nowu Marta ere boe erego tuwadaru tabo toro Jesus bagai. Egore nowu boe egoiago nowu Jesus ji tuwuri kogoduie. Mearudu kurire jiwu tuwuri kogoduie.

b: Nou boe etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje ere Jesus bie nowu areme ewadaru ji. Jesus mearudure nowu ewadaru ji dukeje akore Ioruduware nuba boe mode nowu imedu Lazaruji. Kogodure mare bimodukare. Kogodure Pao Kurirewu ie kuriwo. Lázaro bimodukare dukodi Pao Kurirewu ie kurimode boe emago pemegawo ji. Lázaro bimodukare dukodi Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu ie kurimode boe emago pemegawo ji jamedu.
source: Nou boe etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje ere Jesus bie nowu areme ewadaru ji. Jesus mearudure nowu ewadaru ji dukeje akore Ioruduware nuba boe mode nowu imedu Lazaruji. Kogodure mare bimodukare. Kogodure Pao Kurirewu ie kuriwo. Lázaro bimodukare dukodi Pao Kurirewu ie kurimode boe emago pemegawo ji. Lázaro bimodukare dukodi Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu ie kurimode boe emago pemegawo ji jamedu.

b: Jesus mearudu kurire Martaji, Maria ji, Lazaruji jamedu.
source: Jesus mearudu kurire Martaji, Maria ji, Lazaruji jamedu.

b: Mare utukare toro ewai ka kuri je. Merire pobe ji nono dukejere makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore Pugeje. Pawo pagirimi toro Judéia moto ka Lázaro uwai ka.
source: Mare utukare toro ewai ka kuri je. Merire pobe ji nono dukejere makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore Pugeje. Pawo pagirimi toro Judéia moto ka Lázaro uwai ka.

b: Mare etaidukare utuwo. egore cegimijera. Maibari nowu jeture Judéia moto kejewuge etaidure tuwo awido tori tabo. Atukaba toro pugeje.
source: Mare etaidukare utuwo. egore cegimijera. Maibari nowu jeture Judéia moto kejewuge etaidure tuwo awido tori tabo. Atukaba toro pugeje.

b: Mare Jesus akore Meri oto padukare doze hora raga. Boe emerumode meri ji dukeje ewure jetumodukare iaboe ji erudure boe ji kodi. Meri jire boe etaiwo pemegare.
source: Mare Jesus akore Meri oto padukare doze hora raga. Boe emerumode meri ji dukeje ewure jetumodukare iaboe ji erudure boe ji kodi. Meri jire boe etaiwo pemegare.

b: Mare boe emerumode boeco ji dukeje ewure jetumode iaboe ji rugadu jorugu bokware kodi.
source: Mare boe emerumode boeco ji dukeje ewure jetumode iaboe ji rugadu jorugu bokware kodi.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei: – Pamedia Lázaro unudunure mare itumode toro bagai iwo jetadudo.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei: – Pamedia Lázaro unudunure mare itumode toro bagai iwo jetadudo.

b: Nou ure joruduwadowuge egore ca unudure. Care pemegagodumode.
source: Nou ure joruduwadowuge egore ca unudure. Care pemegagodumode.

b: Eruduwakare Jesus ure tuwadaru inodudo pudui duji. Jesus akore Lázaro unudunuie mare joruduware Lázaro bire duji. Dujire akoino. Mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge emearudaere Lázaro unudunuie rugadu duji. Emearudaere bikaie raga.
source: Eruduwakare Jesus ure tuwadaru inodudo pudui duji. Jesus akore Lázaro unudunuie mare joruduware Lázaro bire duji. Dujire akoino. Mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge emearudaere Lázaro unudunuie rugadu duji. Emearudaere bikaie raga.

b: Dukodi care Jesus mako pemegare ei. Akore Lázaro bire rugadu.
source: Dukodi care Jesus mako pemegare ei. Akore Lázaro bire rugadu.

b: Iragojekare toro apo iwo pemegago. Mare aino tarudumode iraga rakare duji. Dukodi tamearutorumode i rugadu. Ca paduwo toro bagai.
source: Iragojekare toro apo iwo pemegago. Mare aino tarudumode iraga rakare duji. Dukodi tamearutorumode i rugadu. Ca paduwo toro bagai.

b: Nono Tomé makore tumedagei. Akore Pagimijera bimode toro Judéia moto keje. Paduwo toro pagimijerapo pawiwo apo jamedu. Boe egore “Tomé” aino ji. Judeu doge ewadaru tabo egore “emegure puapowu”.
source: Nono Tomé makore tumedagei. Akore Pagimijera bimode toro Judéia moto keje. Paduwo toro pagimijerapo pawiwo apo jamedu. Boe egore “Tomé” aino ji. Judeu doge ewadaru tabo egore “emegure puapowu”.

b: Jesus Umode Boe Eewodudo Pugeje Ewikawo Pugeje
source: Jesus Umode Boe Eewodudo Pugeje Ewikawo Pugeje

b: Ca Jesus uture toro Betânia ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Etaregodure dukeje boe ere Jesus bie Lázaro bie marigudu. Egore tuie merido pobe puibiji ji meture moto tada dukeje. Aino ca Jesus aregodure.
source: Ca Jesus uture toro Betânia ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Etaregodure dukeje boe ere Jesus bie Lázaro bie marigudu. Egore tuie merido pobe puibiji ji meture moto tada dukeje. Aino ca Jesus aregodure.

b: Ca Judéia moto kejewuge etaregodure nowu Lázaro uwiemage ewai ka tuwo uwie Marta, uwie Maria ewudugugo. Nou boe emagare rugadu. Etaregodure Maria ae Marta ae tuwo etaora butugugo ewiagoduwo nowu tuwuri piji. Nou Betânia ba kurirewu padu puredure Jerusalém ba kurirewuji. Du ure três quilômetros.
source: Ca Judéia moto kejewuge etaregodure nowu Lázaro uwiemage ewai ka tuwo uwie Marta, uwie Maria ewudugugo. Nou boe emagare rugadu. Etaregodure Maria ae Marta ae tuwo etaora butugugo ewiagoduwo nowu tuwuri piji. Nou Betânia ba kurirewu padu puredure Jerusalém ba kurirewuji. Du ure três quilômetros.

b: Ca Marta joruduware Jesus aregodure duji dukeje ure tudawuje tuwai piji Jesus togi. Mare Maria ukare tudawuje.
source: Ca Marta joruduware Jesus aregodure duji dukeje ure tudawuje tuwai piji Jesus togi. Mare Maria ukare tudawuje.

b: Marta aregodure Jesus ae dukeje makore ji. Akore aragojemode woe cedabo cewuri bimodukare.
source: Marta aregodure Jesus ae dukeje makore ji. Akore aragojemode woe cedabo cewuri bimodukare.

b: Mare ioruduware Pao Kurirewu umode amagore bagaiboe maku akai rugadu duji.
source: Mare ioruduware Pao Kurirewu umode amagore bagaiboe maku akai rugadu duji.

b: Jesus makore Martaji. Akore awuri jewodumode pugeje.
source: Jesus makore Martaji. Akore awuri jewodumode pugeje.

b: Marta akore Ioruduware. Ia meri keje awu moto akedumode dukeje iwuri jewodumode pugeje turuduwo baru to.
source: Marta akore Ioruduware. Ia meri keje awu moto akedumode dukeje iwuri jewodumode pugeje turuduwo baru to.

b: Nono Jesus makore ji. Akore imire ire boe etowuje. Imire imode boe eewodudo rugadu. Mearutorure iwuge ewimode mare eewodumode pugeje.
source: Nono Jesus makore ji. Akore imire ire boe etowuje. Imire imode boe eewodudo rugadu. Mearutorure iwuge ewimode mare eewodumode pugeje.

b: Mearutorure iwuge ewimodukare pugeje jamedu. Mearutorure iwadaru jiwuge ewimodukare pugeje rugadu. Amearutorure nowu inoduji?
source: Mearutorure iwuge ewimodukare pugeje jamedu. Mearutorure iwadaru jiwuge ewimodukare pugeje rugadu. Amearutorure nowu inoduji?

b: Marta akore Uu! Imearutorure rugadu. Cebagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowunure aki. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki. Pao Kurirewu ure jawu pawobe ewie marigudu akaregodumoduie mato moto ka duji.
source: Marta akore Uu! Imearutorure rugadu. Cebagare bagaiwu umode boe ekinorudowunure aki. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki. Pao Kurirewu ure jawu pawobe ewie marigudu akaregodumoduie mato moto ka duji.

b: Jesus Ragudure Lázaro Joki
source: Jesus Ragudure Lázaro Joki

b: Marta ure tuwadaru akedudo Jesus ji dukeje ure tugirimi tuwai ka. Makore tuwie Maria bagai. Makore tu ji. Akore Pagimijera aregodu. Makore awagai.
source: Marta ure tuwadaru akedudo Jesus ji dukeje ure tugirimi tuwai ka. Makore tuwie Maria bagai. Makore tu ji. Akore Pagimijera aregodu. Makore awagai.

b: Maria mearudure nowu tuduie bataru ji dukeje ure tuie bu taci je. Ure tumara tabo pudui toro Jesus togi.
source: Maria mearudure nowu tuduie bataru ji dukeje ure tuie bu taci je. Ure tumara tabo pudui toro Jesus togi.

b: Jesus aregodukare nowu Betânia ba kurirewu ka raga mare rakoje kimore toro tuiorudure Marta jiwu awara keje.
source: Jesus aregodukare nowu Betânia ba kurirewu ka raga mare rakoje kimore toro tuiorudure Marta jiwu awara keje.

b: Nou rakojere Maria uwai tadawuge erudure Maria uture toro duji. Dukeje eture rekodaji. Emearudaere Maria utumoduie toro birewu bagai traguduwo joki.
source: Nou rakojere Maria uwai tadawuge erudure Maria uture toro duji. Dukeje eture rekodaji. Emearudaere Maria utumoduie toro birewu bagai traguduwo joki.

b: Mare Maria uture Jesus togi. Jorudure Jesus jitu keje ure tuwududo moto keje Jesus bure paru. Makore Jesus ji. Akore cegimijera. Aragojemode woe dukeje iwuri bimodukare.
source: Mare Maria uture Jesus togi. Jorudure Jesus jitu keje ure tuwududo moto keje Jesus bure paru. Makore Jesus ji. Akore cegimijera. Aragojemode woe dukeje iwuri bimodukare.

b: Jesus aiwore ji akoe tragudu tabo duji. Nono jorudure nouia boe etragudure jamedu duji. Okudugodure ebo rugadu.
source: Jesus aiwore ji akoe tragudu tabo duji. Nono jorudure nouia boe etragudure jamedu duji. Okudugodure ebo rugadu.

b: Nono makore ei. Akore kaiba tare tugu? egore Mato ka.
source: Nono makore ei. Akore kaiba tare tugu? egore Mato ka.

b: Eture apo toro ture Lázaro tugu towu tori poro ka. Nono Jesus ragudure.
source: Eture apo toro ture Lázaro tugu towu tori poro ka. Nono Jesus ragudure.

b: Nou boe erudure Jesus ragudure duji dukeje emagore pui. egore ca Jesus mearudu kurire Lazaruji rugadu.
source: Nou boe erudure Jesus ragudure duji dukeje emagore pui. egore ca Jesus mearudu kurire Lazaruji rugadu.

b: Mare iage egore kocare. Ure joku bokwarewuge etaiwodo pugeje. Kodiba aregodukare kuri je tuwo Lázaro pemegago bikawo?
source: Mare iage egore kocare. Ure joku bokwarewuge etaiwodo pugeje. Kodiba aregodukare kuri je tuwo Lázaro pemegago bikawo?

b: Jesus Ure Lázaro Jewodudo Pugeje
source: Jesus Ure Lázaro Jewodudo Pugeje

b: Jesus okudugodure nowu Lázaro uwobebo rugadu. Dukejere ure tuburedo nowu birewu padure tadawu tori poroji. Ia tori kurirewu padure nowu tori poro je keje.
source: Jesus okudugodure nowu Lázaro uwobebo rugadu. Dukejere ure tuburedo nowu birewu padure tadawu tori poroji. Ia tori kurirewu padure nowu tori poro je keje.

b: Dukeje Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore nou tori kurirewu tawuje tori poro je piji. Mare Marta akore Merire pobe puibiji ji meture nowu tori poro tada duji. Dukodire kigogodure rugadu.
source: Dukeje Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore nou tori kurirewu tawuje tori poro je piji. Mare Marta akore Merire pobe puibiji ji meture nowu tori poro tada duji. Dukodire kigogodure rugadu.

b: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore ire awie. Amearutorumode i dukeje arudumode Pao Kurirewu ro rakare duji.
source: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore ire awie. Amearutorumode i dukeje arudumode Pao Kurirewu ro rakare duji.

b: Nono nowu boe ere nowu tori kurirewu tawuje nowu tori poro je piji. Nono Jesus aiwore baru to dukeje akore Iogwa Kurirewu. Awiapagare iwadaru ji. Dukodire itaidure imago pemegawo ai rugadu.
source: Nono nowu boe ere nowu tori kurirewu tawuje nowu tori poro je piji. Nono Jesus aiwore baru to dukeje akore Iogwa Kurirewu. Awiapagare iwadaru ji. Dukodire itaidure imago pemegawo ai rugadu.

b: Ioruduware awiapagare iwadaru jituji rugadu mare itaidure iwo awu boe eruduwado nowu inoduji jamedu emearutoruwo i, emearutoruwo aki aigoiare are itarego mato rugadu duji.
source: Ioruduware awiapagare iwadaru jituji rugadu mare itaidure iwo awu boe eruduwado nowu inoduji jamedu emearutoruwo i, emearutoruwo aki aigoiare are itarego mato rugadu duji.

b: Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo tuo bagai dukeje makore toro nowu Lázaro bagai. Akore Lázaro! Ae bu mato nowu tori poro piji!
source: Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo tuo bagai dukeje makore toro nowu Lázaro bagai. Akore Lázaro! Ae bu mato nowu tori poro piji!

b: Ca Lázaro ure tudawuje nowu tori poro piji rugadu! Bikare pugeje. Jewodure pugeje rugadu. Nou boe ere upodo tabowu areia upo kimore apo. Upo kimore je tabo jamedu. Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore nou areia tawuje piji utuwo tuwai ka.
source: Ca Lázaro ure tudawuje nowu tori poro piji rugadu! Bikare pugeje. Jewodure pugeje rugadu. Nou boe ere upodo tabowu areia upo kimore apo. Upo kimore je tabo jamedu. Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore nou areia tawuje piji utuwo tuwai ka.

b: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Pegarewu Tawuje Turo Pegawo Jesus ji
source: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Pegarewu Tawuje Turo Pegawo Jesus ji

b: Nou rakojere nonowu boe eiamedu boe erudure Jesus rore aino duji. Dukodire emearutorure Jesus ji.
source: Nou rakojere nonowu boe eiamedu boe erudure Jesus rore aino duji. Dukodire emearutorure Jesus ji.

b: Mare iagere tugirimi tuibagi Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Eture tugimijerage fariseu doge etae tuwo ewie Jesus rore jiboe ji.
source: Mare iagere tugirimi tuibagi Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Eture tugimijerage fariseu doge etae tuwo ewie Jesus rore jiboe ji.

b: Dukodire nowu fariseu doge ere bato pui nowu Judeu doge eimijeragebo. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure nono jamedu. Emororamagadure rugadu boe emearutorumodukare pudui pugeje duji. Emagore pui. egore nuba paromode? Nou imedu Jesus ro rakare rugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu fariseu doge ere bato pui nowu Judeu doge eimijeragebo. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure nono jamedu. Emororamagadure rugadu boe emearutorumodukare pudui pugeje duji. Emagore pui. egore nuba paromode? Nou imedu Jesus ro rakare rugadu.

b: Boe eiamedu boe emearutorumodukare pai pugeje tumearutoruwo awu imedu Jesus ji. Nono Roma kejewuge boe eimijerage erudu pegamode boe eroino duji jamedu. Dukodire Roma kejewuge boe eimijerage etaidumode turo pegawo pai. Emode awu Pao Kurirewu uwai pegado. Emode pawobe etagedudo.
source: Boe eiamedu boe emearutorumodukare pai pugeje tumearutoruwo awu imedu Jesus ji. Nono Roma kejewuge boe eimijerage erudu pegamode boe eroino duji jamedu. Dukodire Roma kejewuge boe eimijerage etaidumode turo pegawo pai. Emode awu Pao Kurirewu uwai pegado. Emode pawobe etagedudo.

b: Awu joruji nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge boe eimijera kurirewu iere Caifás. Rakojere nono nowu boe eimijeragebo jamedu. Makore nowu tumedagei. Akore taruduwa bokware.
source: Awu joruji nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge boe eimijera kurirewu iere Caifás. Rakojere nono nowu boe eimijeragebo jamedu. Makore nowu tumedagei. Akore taruduwa bokware.

b: Boe pegakawo pai pawo nowu imedu bito pawobe ewo cinorudo Roma kejewu boe eimijerage pegarewuge epiji. Pamodukare bito paiamedu boe pawimode.
source: Boe pegakawo pai pawo nowu imedu bito pawobe ewo cinorudo Roma kejewu boe eimijerage pegarewuge epiji. Pamodukare bito paiamedu boe pawimode.

b: Nou Caifás nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewunure ema nowu joruji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tumearudae maku ai makowo nowu tuwadaru ji nowu boe eimijerage ewiagai. Mare nowu Caifás joruduwakare Pao Kurirewu bataru taboie tagoino duji. Akomode pudumie tagoino. Mare ema karega akoino. Pao Kurirewure akoino. Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore tuwo boe ewie Jesus bimoduie duji Judeu doge ero pegarewu boe morice.
source: Nou Caifás nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewunure ema nowu joruji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tumearudae maku ai makowo nowu tuwadaru ji nowu boe eimijerage ewiagai. Mare nowu Caifás joruduwakare Pao Kurirewu bataru taboie tagoino duji. Akomode pudumie tagoino. Mare ema karega akoino. Pao Kurirewure akoino. Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore tuwo boe ewie Jesus bimoduie duji Judeu doge ero pegarewu boe morice.

b: Jesus bimode boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu morice jamedu. Dukodire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe Pao Kurirewu oremode emage. Etuwobe mode pugi.
source: Jesus bimode boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu morice jamedu. Dukodire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe Pao Kurirewu oremode emage. Etuwobe mode pugi.

b: Nou meri otobiji nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo Jesus bito.
source: Nou meri otobiji nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo Jesus bito.

b: Jesus joruduware emearudae ji. Dukodire merukare Judéia moto ji pugeje mare utu jaere ia moto akurugudu maerewu ka. Uture ture joruduwadowugebo toro ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda iere Efraim. Nonore rakojere ture joruduwadowugebo pugeje.
source: Jesus joruduware emearudae ji. Dukodire merukare Judéia moto ji pugeje mare utu jaere ia moto akurugudu maerewu ka. Uture ture joruduwadowugebo toro ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda iere Efraim. Nonore rakojere ture joruduwadowugebo pugeje.

b: Boe puredugodure Judeu dogei ewaduwo ia tuwadaeji. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Dukodire boe emagare tudu tabo Jerusalém ka Judéia moto piji tuwo tubemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu turo boe ji tuwaduwo nowu tuwadae Pascoaji.
source: Boe puredugodure Judeu dogei ewaduwo ia tuwadaeji. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Dukodire boe emagare tudu tabo Jerusalém ka Judéia moto piji tuwo tubemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu turo boe ji tuwaduwo nowu tuwadae Pascoaji.

b: Nou fariseu doge, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emagore boe eiamedu boe ji ewo Jesus maku pudai. Boe erudumode Jesus ji dukeje ewo nowu boe eimijerage ewie nowu boe eimijerage ewo tugeragu Jesus ji. Dukodire nowu boe etaiwore Jesus bagai nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Emagore pui. egore nuba tamearudaere? Jesus aregodumokana? Iage egore aregodumodukare. Joruduware pagimijerage etaidure turo pegawo pudui duji.
source: Nou fariseu doge, nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emagore boe eiamedu boe ji ewo Jesus maku pudai. Boe erudumode Jesus ji dukeje ewo nowu boe eimijerage ewie nowu boe eimijerage ewo tugeragu Jesus ji. Dukodire nowu boe etaiwore Jesus bagai nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Emagore pui. egore nuba tamearudaere? Jesus aregodumokana? Iage egore aregodumodukare. Joruduware pagimijerage etaidure turo pegawo pudui duji.

b: Aredu Ure Roreboe Reko Jesus Bure Joki
source: Aredu Ure Roreboe Reko Jesus Bure Joki

b: Ca Jesus uture Betânia ba kurirewu ka pugeje. Uture ture jewodudowu Lázaro uwai ka. Okwarewu meri oto padure seis Judeu doge ewaduwo tuwadae Pascoaji.
source: Ca Jesus uture Betânia ba kurirewu ka pugeje. Uture ture jewodudowu Lázaro uwai ka. Okwarewu meri oto padure seis Judeu doge ewaduwo tuwadae Pascoaji.

b: Ca Jesus rakojere nowu Lázaro uwai keje. Nou uwai kejewuge ere boe eke pemegado Jesus uwo kowuje. Aredu Marta ure ia boe eke maku Jesus ai. Lázaro mugure nowu ira keje togwagewo jamedu.
source: Ca Jesus rakojere nowu Lázaro uwai keje. Nou uwai kejewuge ere boe eke pemegado Jesus uwo kowuje. Aredu Marta ure ia boe eke maku Jesus ai. Lázaro mugure nowu ira keje togwagewo jamedu.

b: Nono Maria aregodure roreboe mori kurirewu tabo. Nou roreboe iere nardo. Nono Maria ure nowu roreboe reko Jesus bure joki nowu boe eruduwawo boe eimijera kurirewunure ema duji. Dukejere ure Jesus bure kidudo tao tabo. Nou roreboe ro jore nowu bai oto jamedu boeto.
source: Nono Maria aregodure roreboe mori kurirewu tabo. Nou roreboe iere nardo. Nono Maria ure nowu roreboe reko Jesus bure joki nowu boe eruduwawo boe eimijera kurirewunure ema duji. Dukejere ure Jesus bure kidudo tao tabo. Nou roreboe ro jore nowu bai oto jamedu boeto.

b: Nono Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu makore ji. Nou imedu iere Judas Iscariotes. Ema koiare umode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Nono Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu makore ji. Nou imedu iere Judas Iscariotes. Ema koiare umode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Akore kodiba awu aredu ukare nowu roreboe maku diero bagai tuwo diero kurido tuwo maku marenarue doge etai? Awu roreboe mori kurire rugadu. Boe emaragodumode jii joru akedu ka tuwo tugeragu nowu diero kurirewu ji tuwo akirodo awu roreboe ji.
source: Akore kodiba awu aredu ukare nowu roreboe maku diero bagai tuwo diero kurido tuwo maku marenarue doge etai? Awu roreboe mori kurire rugadu. Boe emaragodumode jii joru akedu ka tuwo tugeragu nowu diero kurirewu ji tuwo akirodo awu roreboe ji.

b: Mare pagare Judas akoino. Aidukare tuwo diero maku marenarue doge etai. Aidure tugiwoguwo ji. Jesus ure nowu Judas jetudo to dieroji. Mare nowu Judas iwogure tu tu Jesus o dieroji.
source: Mare pagare Judas akoino. Aidukare tuwo diero maku marenarue doge etai. Aidure tugiwoguwo ji. Jesus ure nowu Judas jetudo to dieroji. Mare nowu Judas iwogure tu tu Jesus o dieroji.

b: Mare Jesus akore akaba awu aredu pogurudo rore i duji. Ure reko iwure joki tuwo iwiri udo turugadu ituguduwo mototo iwi keje nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure.
source: Mare Jesus akore akaba awu aredu pogurudo rore i duji. Ure reko iwure joki tuwo iwiri udo turugadu ituguduwo mototo iwi keje nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure.

b: Marenarue doge edumode tagabo jii toro rugadu. Mare imire itumode tabiji rugadu.
source: Marenarue doge edumode tagabo jii toro rugadu. Mare imire itumode tabiji rugadu.

b: Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etaidure Tuwo Lázaro Bito
source: Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etaidure Tuwo Lázaro Bito

b: Boe eruduware Jesus rakojere Lázaro uwai keje Betânia keje duji. Dukodire eture toro ae. Emagare. Etaidure tuioruduwo nowu Jesus ure jewodudowu Lazaruji jamedu.
source: Boe eruduware Jesus rakojere Lázaro uwai keje Betânia keje duji. Dukodire eture toro ae. Emagare. Etaidure tuioruduwo nowu Jesus ure jewodudowu Lazaruji jamedu.

b: Mare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etaidukare nowu Lazaruji jamedu. Jesus ure Lázaro jewodudo dukodire Judeu doge emearutorukare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwugei pugeje tumearutoruwo Jesus ji. Dukodire nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo Lázaro bito jamedu.
source: Mare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etaidukare nowu Lazaruji jamedu. Jesus ure Lázaro jewodudo dukodire Judeu doge emearutorukare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwugei pugeje tumearutoruwo Jesus ji. Dukodire nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo Lázaro bito jamedu.

b: Jesus Mugure Jumenta Onaregedu Keje Tuduwo Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Jesus Mugure Jumenta Onaregedu Keje Tuduwo Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Nou barogwato boe emagare nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje tuwaduwo nowu tuwadae pascoaji. Eruduware Jesus aregodumode pudae duji.
source: Nou barogwato boe emagare nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje tuwaduwo nowu tuwadae pascoaji. Eruduware Jesus aregodumode pudae duji.

b: Dukodire ere tugeragu apidoguru aiji. Eture tabo toro Jesus togi. Ekudugodure bagai. egore israel kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu reo! Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae. Ure turaga maku ai rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emago pemegawo ji rugadu! Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ji rugadu!
source: Dukodire ere tugeragu apidoguru aiji. Eture tabo toro Jesus togi. Ekudugodure bagai. egore israel kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu reo! Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae. Ure turaga maku ai rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emago pemegawo ji rugadu! Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ji rugadu!

b: Nono Jesus jorudure ia jumenta onaregeduji. Mugure keje tuduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore ainoie Jesus romode rugadu. Akore:
source: Nono Jesus jorudure ia jumenta onaregeduji. Mugure keje tuduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore ainoie Jesus romode rugadu. Akore:

b: – Awu mugure Jerusalém kejewuge tagi. Tabagudukaba. Tagimijera kurirewu mugumode jumenta onaregedu keje taregoduwo tagae.
source: – Awu mugure Jerusalém kejewuge tagi. Tabagudukaba. Tagimijera kurirewu mugumode jumenta onaregedu keje taregoduwo tagae.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare nowu Pao Kurirewu akoino jiboe ji. Mare ia meri keje Jesus jewodumode pugeje. Jesus jewodumode pugeje dukeje nowu ure joruduwadowuge ewiabutumode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru keje. Dukodi care eruduwamode ji. Eruduware Pao Kurirewu makore Jesus jiboe ji jeture pudui rugadu duji.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare nowu Pao Kurirewu akoino jiboe ji. Mare ia meri keje Jesus jewodumode pugeje. Jesus jewodumode pugeje dukeje nowu ure joruduwadowuge ewiabutumode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru keje. Dukodi care eruduwamode ji. Eruduware Pao Kurirewu makore Jesus jiboe ji jeture pudui rugadu duji.

b: Jesus ure Lázaro jewodudo pugeje dukeje ia boe ere boe eiamedu boe ewie nowu Jesus rore aino duji. Erudure Jesus rore aino duji dukodi care ere boe ewie. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe eruduware Jesus ro rakare duji.
source: Jesus ure Lázaro jewodudo pugeje dukeje ia boe ere boe eiamedu boe ewie nowu Jesus rore aino duji. Erudure Jesus rore aino duji dukodi care ere boe ewie. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe eruduware Jesus ro rakare duji.

b: Dukodire boe emagare tugodui Jesus togi.
source: Dukodire boe emagare tugodui Jesus togi.

b: Mare fariseu doge etaidukare. Egore pui: – Tagaiwodo. Boe erore taci pabiji. Boe eiamedu boe emearutorure awu Jesus ji. Dukodire erore taci pabiji toro togi.
source: Mare fariseu doge etaidukare. Egore pui: – Tagaiwodo. Boe erore taci pabiji. Boe eiamedu boe emearutorure awu Jesus ji. Dukodire erore taci pabiji toro togi.

b: Ia Grécia Kejewuge Emagore Jesus Bagai
source: Ia Grécia Kejewuge Emagore Jesus Bagai

b: Ia Grécia kejewuge eragojere Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje tuwaduwo nowu Judeu doge ewadaeji ebo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Ia Grécia kejewuge eragojere Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje tuwaduwo nowu Judeu doge ewadaeji ebo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Eture Filipe ae. Nou Filipe boture Betsaida ba kurirewu keje. Nou Betsaida ba kurirewu mugure Galiléia moto keje. Nou Grécia kejewuge emagore nowu Filipiji. egore cedaidure ceruduwo Jesus ji.
source: Eture Filipe ae. Nou Filipe boture Betsaida ba kurirewu keje. Nou Betsaida ba kurirewu mugure Galiléia moto keje. Nou Grécia kejewuge emagore nowu Filipiji. egore cedaidure ceruduwo Jesus ji.

b: Filipe uture André ae. Ure André bie nowu Grécia kejewuge etaidure jiboe ji. Dukejere eture puapo Jesus ae tuwo Jesus bie.
source: Filipe uture André ae. Ure André bie nowu Grécia kejewuge etaidure jiboe ji. Dukejere eture puapo Jesus ae tuwo Jesus bie.

b: Dukeje Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Kuri aino boe eruduwamode boe kurirewure imi duji, boe pemegarewure imi duji.
source: Dukeje Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Kuri aino boe eruduwamode boe kurirewure imi duji, boe pemegarewure imi duji.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emodukare ia trigo a tugu mototo botuwo dukeje botumodukare rugadu. Mare umode mitotu je tu rugadu. Mare boe emode trigo a tugu mototo dukeje nowu trigo enogo botumode. Mare botumode dukeje nowu trigo a pegagodumode moto tada. Botumode dukeje ricodumode enarimode. A makamode rugadu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emodukare ia trigo a tugu mototo botuwo dukeje botumodukare rugadu. Mare umode mitotu je tu rugadu. Mare boe emode trigo a tugu mototo dukeje nowu trigo enogo botumode. Mare botumode dukeje nowu trigo a pegagodumode moto tada. Botumode dukeje ricodumode enarimode. A makamode rugadu.

b: Ia boe etaidu kurimode turowo taidure jiboe ji turaga tabo tu rugadu. Nou boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Nou boe ewarigudumode toro bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu. Mare ia boe etaidumodukare tumearudaere jiboe ji tuwo tugera ra taidure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje boe pemegamode ei rugadu. Egare remawumode rugadu. Ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu. Mare emugumode baru tada jii toro rugadu. Du akedumodukare.
source: Ia boe etaidu kurimode turowo taidure jiboe ji turaga tabo tu rugadu. Nou boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Nou boe ewarigudumode toro bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu. Mare ia boe etaidumodukare tumearudaere jiboe ji tuwo tugera ra taidure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje boe pemegamode ei rugadu. Egare remawumode rugadu. Ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu. Mare emugumode baru tada jii toro rugadu. Du akedumodukare.

b: Ia boe aidumode tumearutoruwo iwadaru ji dukeje umode tugera ra taidure jiwu turo tago pegarewu boe piji tuduwo itabo. Dukeje nowu mearutorure iwu rakojemode itabo. Iogwa Kurirewu umode boe pemegado mearutorure iwadaru jiwuge ji. Mako pemegamode ei rugadu.
source: Ia boe aidumode tumearutoruwo iwadaru ji dukeje umode tugera ra taidure jiwu turo tago pegarewu boe piji tuduwo itabo. Dukeje nowu mearutorure iwu rakojemode itabo. Iogwa Kurirewu umode boe pemegado mearutorure iwadaru jiwuge ji. Mako pemegamode ei rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Tuwimode Duji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Tuwimode Duji

b: – Boe ero pegamode i dukodire ikiarigodure rugadu. Mare imago pegamodukare Iogwa Kurirewu ji uwo ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Boro. Iogwa ure maku inaiwu imaragodae koiare boe ero pegamode i. Dukodire itaregodure woe moto ka.
source: – Boe ero pegamode i dukodire ikiarigodure rugadu. Mare imago pegamodukare Iogwa Kurirewu ji uwo ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Boro. Iogwa ure maku inaiwu imaragodae koiare boe ero pegamode i. Dukodire itaregodure woe moto ka.

b: Dukeje Jesus makore baru to tuo bagai. Akore iogwa. Boe erududo aro kurirewu ji boe eruduwawo akurire rugadu duji. Nono Pao Kurirewu makore baru piji. Akore ire boe erududo iro rakarewu ji marigudu. Imode erududo iro rakarewu ji pugeje, iro pemegarewu ji jamedu.
source: Dukeje Jesus makore baru to tuo bagai. Akore iogwa. Boe erududo aro kurirewu ji boe eruduwawo akurire rugadu duji. Nono Pao Kurirewu makore baru piji. Akore ire boe erududo iro rakarewu ji marigudu. Imode erududo iro rakarewu ji pugeje, iro pemegarewu ji jamedu.

b: Boe emearudure nowu baru pijiwu mako ji. Iage emearudaere boeiaruruie akoino. Mare iage egore ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawure akoino baru piji Jesus ji.
source: Boe emearudure nowu baru pijiwu mako ji. Iage emearudaere boeiaruruie akoino. Mare iage egore ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawure akoino baru piji Jesus ji.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore i karega akoino mare taire akoino taruduwawo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore i karega akoino mare taire akoino taruduwawo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Kuri aino Pao Kurirewu aiwomode awu moto kejewuge eiamedu boe eroji ero pemegarewu bagai, ero pegarewu bagai jamedu. Kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode awu moto kejewu bope doge eimijera raka ta piji.
source: Kuri aino Pao Kurirewu aiwomode awu moto kejewuge eiamedu boe eroji ero pemegarewu bagai, ero pegarewu bagai jamedu. Kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode awu moto kejewu bope doge eimijera raka ta piji.

b: Boe emode ipo padure pugajejewu rakojedo itabo dukeje imode boe emearutorudo i rugadu.
source: Boe emode ipo padure pugajejewu rakojedo itabo dukeje imode boe emearutorudo i rugadu.

b: Jesus akoino nowu boe ji tuwo eruduwado nuba boe eromode pudui tuwo tuwido ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
source: Jesus akoino nowu boe ji tuwo eruduwado nuba boe eromode pudui tuwo tuwido ipo padure pugajejewu keje.

b: Nou boe egore Pago bakaru ure paruduwado. Akore umode boe ekinorudowu bimodukaie. Akedumodukaie. Mare akagore Imedu Onaregedu bimoduie ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Iogudubanure aki?
source: Nou boe egore Pago bakaru ure paruduwado. Akore umode boe ekinorudowu bimodukaie. Akedumodukaie. Mare akagore Imedu Onaregedu bimoduie ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Iogudubanure aki?

b: Jesus akore Jorugu pemegarewu rakojemode tagabo tu je. Tamerudo nowu jorugu tabo. Tamerumode jorugu tabo dukeje boecomodukare tumaedo taiogi. Merumode boeco kaowu joruduwamodukare kaiba tuiomode. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Boe ero pegarewu jire inagoino. Jorugu ji karega inagoino jamedu. Ire inagoino.
source: Jesus akore Jorugu pemegarewu rakojemode tagabo tu je. Tamerudo nowu jorugu tabo. Tamerumode jorugu tabo dukeje boecomodukare tumaedo taiogi. Merumode boeco kaowu joruduwamodukare kaiba tuiomode. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Boe ero pegarewu jire inagoino. Jorugu ji karega inagoino jamedu. Ire inagoino.

b: Iragoje kimore tagabo dukeje tamearutorudo i rugadu. Tamearutorumode i dukeje taruduwamode taro pemegawo nono boe erudure boe ji jorugu tada dumogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Boe ero pemegarewu jire inagoino. Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje uture boe epiji tuwo tuwiado epiji.
source: Iragoje kimore tagabo dukeje tamearutorudo i rugadu. Tamearutorumode i dukeje taruduwamode taro pemegawo nono boe erudure boe ji jorugu tada dumogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Boe ero pemegarewu jire inagoino. Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje uture boe epiji tuwo tuwiado epiji.

b: Boe Emearutorumodukare Jesus ji
source: Boe Emearutorumodukare Jesus ji

b: Ure turo rakarewu towuje nowu boe egai. Ure epemegado. Ure boe pemegado ei. Mare emearutorukare Jesus ji.
source: Ure turo rakarewu towuje nowu boe egai. Ure epemegado. Ure boe pemegado ei. Mare emearutorukare Jesus ji.

b: Erore aino dukodire Isaías makore jiboe mariguduboe jeture pudui rugadu. Emare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji marigudu. Marigudu ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewunure aki. Boe emearutorumodukare are maku inaiwu awadaru ji. Ire boe ewie ji mare emearutorukare Pao Kurirewunure aki duji. Are boe erududo aragaji. Mare emearutorukare ai rugadu.
source: Erore aino dukodire Isaías makore jiboe mariguduboe jeture pudui rugadu. Emare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji marigudu. Marigudu ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewunure aki. Boe emearutorumodukare are maku inaiwu awadaru ji. Ire boe ewie ji mare emearutorukare Pao Kurirewunure aki duji. Are boe erududo aragaji. Mare emearutorukare ai rugadu.

b: Nono nowu boe eroiwakare tumearutoruwo rugadu. Ainore Isaías akore marigudu:
source: Nono nowu boe eroiwakare tumearutoruwo rugadu. Ainore Isaías akore marigudu:

b: – Pao Kurirewu ure eruduwa bokwado emearutorukawo pudui. Pao Kurirewu akore Ire eku bokwado. Ire etaora pegado. Mare emearudae remawu jire inagoino. Dukodire ekure mare emearudaemodukare taiwowo irore jiboe ji. Etaorare mare eruduwamodukare irore jiboe ji. Dukodire emodukare tugera ra turo pegare jiboe piji tumearutoruwo i rugadu. Dukodire imodukare ekinorudo ero pegarewu piji.”
source: – Pao Kurirewu ure eruduwa bokwado emearutorukawo pudui. Pao Kurirewu akore Ire eku bokwado. Ire etaora pegado. Mare emearudae remawu jire inagoino. Dukodire ekure mare emearudaemodukare taiwowo irore jiboe ji. Etaorare mare eruduwamodukare irore jiboe ji. Dukodire emodukare tugera ra turo pegare jiboe piji tumearutoruwo i rugadu. Dukodire imodukare ekinorudo ero pegarewu piji.”

b: Marigudu rugadu Isaías makore. Emare jorudure Jesus ro pemegamode jiboe ji, ro rakamode jiboe ji. Dukodire ure awu bataru bu bapera keje.
source: Marigudu rugadu Isaías makore. Emare jorudure Jesus ro pemegamode jiboe ji, ro rakamode jiboe ji. Dukodire ure awu bataru bu bapera keje.

b: Ma care ia Judeu doge eimijerage emearutorure Jesus ji. Mare fariseu doge etaidukare Jesus ji dukodire nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagokare boe ji. Emagokare tumearutorure Jesus jituji. Emagomode dukeje fariseu doge emode etudo nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai piji.
source: Ma care ia Judeu doge eimijerage emearutorure Jesus ji. Mare fariseu doge etaidukare Jesus ji dukodire nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagokare boe ji. Emagokare tumearutorure Jesus jituji. Emagomode dukeje fariseu doge emode etudo nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai piji.

b: Etaidu kurire boe emago pemegawo pudui. Dukodire etaidu kurikare Pao Kurirewu mako pemegawo pudui epagudure nowu boe eimijeragece dukodi.
source: Etaidu kurire boe emago pemegawo pudui. Dukodire etaidu kurikare Pao Kurirewu mako pemegawo pudui epagudure nowu boe eimijeragece dukodi.

b: Jesus Bataru Umode Boe Ekiarigo Turo Pegarewuji
source: Jesus Bataru Umode Boe Ekiarigo Turo Pegarewuji

b: Jesus uwadodure tuwadaru tabo nowu boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo tagoino jiboe ji. Akore mearutorure iwuge emearutorumode ure itarego matowuji jamedu.
source: Jesus uwadodure tuwadaru tabo nowu boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo tagoino jiboe ji. Akore mearutorure iwuge emearutorumode ure itarego matowuji jamedu.

b: Jorudure iwuge erudure ure itarego matowuji jamedu.
source: Jorudure iwuge erudure ure itarego matowuji jamedu.

b: Itaregodure mato moto ka iwo nono jorugu mogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Iwo boe ewie turo pegarewuji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearutorumode i dukeje emerumodukare boeco kao pugeje. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutorumode i dukeje emode tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Itaregodure mato moto ka iwo nono jorugu mogadure. Mare jorugu ji karega inagoino. Iwo boe ewie turo pegarewuji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearutorumode i dukeje emerumodukare boeco kao pugeje. Mare boeco ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutorumode i dukeje emode tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Mare boe emearutorumodukare iwadaru ji du inodu tabo imodukare boe pegado ei kuri aino. Iwo boe pegado boe ji dubagai karega iroino mato. Itaregodure iwo boe ekinorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji.
source: Mare boe emearutorumodukare iwadaru ji du inodu tabo imodukare boe pegado ei kuri aino. Iwo boe pegado boe ji dubagai karega iroino mato. Itaregodure iwo boe ekinorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji.

b: Mare ia meri keje boe pegamode mearutorukare iwugei, aidukare iwuge ji. Awu moto akedumode dukeje imode ewiabutudo awu iwadaru keje dukeje boe pegamode ei rugadu emearutorukare i kodi.
source: Mare ia meri keje boe pegamode mearutorukare iwugei, aidukare iwuge ji. Awu moto akedumode dukeje imode ewiabutudo awu iwadaru keje dukeje boe pegamode ei rugadu emearutorukare i kodi.

b: Boe rugadu jire inagoino. Mare iwadaru karega. Iogwa Kurirewu koiare ure itarego mato. Emare ure awu iwadaru maku inai iwo boe ewie ji. Dukodire imagore jiboe ure turugadu.
source: Boe rugadu jire inagoino. Mare iwadaru karega. Iogwa Kurirewu koiare ure itarego mato. Emare ure awu iwadaru maku inai iwo boe ewie ji. Dukodire imagore jiboe ure turugadu.

b: Iogwa Kurirewu bataru umode mearutorure puduiwuge ekinorudo eduwo pudabo jii toro. Du akedumodukare. Awu tuwadarure Iogwa Kurirewu ure maku inai iwo boe ewie ji rugadu.
source: Iogwa Kurirewu bataru umode mearutorure puduiwuge ekinorudo eduwo pudabo jii toro. Du akedumodukare. Awu tuwadarure Iogwa Kurirewu ure maku inai iwo boe ewie ji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Ewure Kabi
source: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Ewure Kabi

b: Ca okwarewu merire mitotu je Judeu doge ewaduwo tuwadae Pascoaji. Dukodire Jesus joruduware tudumode baru to kuri aino duji awu moto piji Tuo bagai. Jesus mearudu kurire mearutorure puduiwugei rugadu. Mearudu kurire ei jii toro tuwimodedu ka.
source: Ca okwarewu merire mitotu je Judeu doge ewaduwo tuwadae Pascoaji. Dukodire Jesus joruduware tudumode baru to kuri aino duji awu moto piji Tuo bagai. Jesus mearudu kurire mearutorure puduiwugei rugadu. Mearudu kurire ei jii toro tuwimodedu ka.

b: Nou boeco ji Jesus ure tumugudo ia bai tada togwagewo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Bope doge eimijera ure tumearudae pegarewu tugu Judas aorato tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Nou Judas uo iere Simão Iscariotes.
source: Nou boeco ji Jesus ure tumugudo ia bai tada togwagewo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Bope doge eimijera ure tumearudae pegarewu tugu Judas aorato tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Nou Judas uo iere Simão Iscariotes.

b: Jesus joruduware Pao Kurirewu ure turaga jamedu boe maku pudai duji. Joruduware taregodure Pao Kurirewu piji rugadu. Joruduware tudumode tuibagi Pao Kurirewu ae pugeje duji.
source: Jesus joruduware Pao Kurirewu ure turaga jamedu boe maku pudai duji. Joruduware taregodure Pao Kurirewu piji rugadu. Joruduware tudumode tuibagi Pao Kurirewu ae pugeje duji.

b: Dukodire Jesus ure turagojedo nowu bai tada. Ure tugudau areia biaku epa tawuje tubiji. Ure ia areia kogudo tubeagajeje.
source: Dukodire Jesus ure turagojedo nowu bai tada. Ure tugudau areia biaku epa tawuje tubiji. Ure ia areia kogudo tubeagajeje.

b: Dukejere ure pobo redo pori piji ia meririto. Nono ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewure kabi nowu pobo tabo. Ure ewure kabi dukeje ure ekidudo nowu areia tabo.
source: Dukejere ure pobo redo pori piji ia meririto. Nono ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewure kabi nowu pobo tabo. Ure ewure kabi dukeje ure ekidudo nowu areia tabo.

b: Uiago Simão Pedro bure kabi dukeje Simão Pedro makore ji. Akore ukare turugadu awo iwure kabi. Ikimijeranure aki kodi.
source: Uiago Simão Pedro bure kabi dukeje Simão Pedro makore ji. Akore ukare turugadu awo iwure kabi. Ikimijeranure aki kodi.

b: Jesus makore Simão Pedro ji. Akore aruduwakare irore jiboe ji. Mare ia meri keje aruduwamode.
source: Jesus makore Simão Pedro ji. Akore aruduwakare irore jiboe ji. Mare ia meri keje aruduwamode.

b: Simão Pedro akore amodukare iwure kabi rugadu! Mare Jesus makore ji pugeje. Akore imodukare awure kabi dukeje ire joruduwadowu modukare aki pugeje.
source: Simão Pedro akore amodukare iwure kabi rugadu! Mare Jesus makore ji pugeje. Akore imodukare awure kabi dukeje ire joruduwadowu modukare aki pugeje.

b: Nono Simão Pedro akore Ca iwure kabi. Itaora kabi. Ikera kabi. Iamedu boe kabi.
source: Nono Simão Pedro akore Ca iwure kabi. Itaora kabi. Ikera kabi. Iamedu boe kabi.

b: Jesus akore Boe emode taimo dukeje ekabidure rugadu. Dukeje etumode tuibagi tuwai ka dukeje emodukare taimo pugeje kuri aino. Tu tuwurere emode kabi. Mare boe ewiri ji karega inagoino. Boe ero pegarewu jire inagoino. Ca Pao Kurirewu ure taro pegarewu jamedu boe barigu tabiji. Mare ia imedu ro pegarewu ure mitotu tagabo. Pao Kurirewu ukare nowu imedu ro pegarewu barigu piji.
source: Jesus akore Boe emode taimo dukeje ekabidure rugadu. Dukeje etumode tuibagi tuwai ka dukeje emodukare taimo pugeje kuri aino. Tu tuwurere emode kabi. Mare boe ewiri ji karega inagoino. Boe ero pegarewu jire inagoino. Ca Pao Kurirewu ure taro pegarewu jamedu boe barigu tabiji. Mare ia imedu ro pegarewu ure mitotu tagabo. Pao Kurirewu ukare nowu imedu ro pegarewu barigu piji.

b: Jesus joruduware nowu imeduji dukodire akoino. Nou imedu umode Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Jesus joruduware nowu imedu romode pudui duji. Dujire akoino nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu ukare ia imedu mitotu jedu ro pegarewu barigu piji.
source: Jesus joruduware nowu imeduji dukodire akoino. Nou imedu umode Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Jesus joruduware nowu imedu romode pudui duji. Dujire akoino nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu ukare ia imedu mitotu jedu ro pegarewu barigu piji.

b: Jesus ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewure kabi dukeje ure tugudau areia jamedu tugu pudui pugeje. Dukejere ure tumugudo tumuga ira keje. Nono akore Kodiba ire tawure kabi? Imode taruduwado.
source: Jesus ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewure kabi dukeje ure tugudau areia jamedu tugu pudui pugeje. Dukejere ure tumugudo tumuga ira keje. Nono akore Kodiba ire tawure kabi? Imode taruduwado.

b: Tagagore “Joruduwarewu” aino i. Tagagore “Boe Eimijera” aino i. Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Ure Taruduwadowunure imi rugadu. Tagimijeranure imi rugadu.
source: Tagagore “Joruduwarewu” aino i. Tagagore “Boe Eimijera” aino i. Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Ure Taruduwadowunure imi rugadu. Tagimijeranure imi rugadu.

b: Mare ire ido nono tadugaregere iwo tawure kabi. Tarowo nono iro mogadure. Dukodire tamode pu bure boe kabi. Tamode tagera maku puai.
source: Mare ire ido nono tadugaregere iwo tawure kabi. Tarowo nono iro mogadure. Dukodire tamode pu bure boe kabi. Tamode tagera maku puai.

b: Ire tarududo iroji tarowo nono iro mogadure taruduwawo nuba taromode.
source: Ire tarududo iroji tarowo nono iro mogadure taruduwawo nuba taromode.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tai. Boe emearutorumodukare ia boe eimijera utugareji ukimijera kori. Boe emearutorumodukare ia boe eimijera utugare uture tugimijera bataru tabowuji tugimijera kori jamedu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tai. Boe emearutorumodukare ia boe eimijera utugareji ukimijera kori. Boe emearutorumodukare ia boe eimijera utugare uture tugimijera bataru tabowuji tugimijera kori jamedu.

b: Dukodi care tarodo nono iro mogadure jamedu. Taromode nono iro mogadure dukeje taegaregodumode tai. Boe pemegamode tai rugadu. Tawiagodukaba awu ire taruduwado jiwu iwadaru piji.
source: Dukodi care tarodo nono iro mogadure jamedu. Taromode nono iro mogadure dukeje taegaregodumode tai. Boe pemegamode tai rugadu. Tawiagodukaba awu ire taruduwado jiwu iwadaru piji.

b: – Ioruduware ire ikeragu jiwuge ji. Taire inagoino tarowo nono iro mogadure. Mare ia romodukare aino. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Akore Okwagere itabowu jorudu pegamode i.”
source: – Ioruduware ire ikeragu jiwuge ji. Taire inagoino tarowo nono iro mogadure. Mare ia romodukare aino. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Akore Okwagere itabowu jorudu pegamode i.”

b: Ca itaidure iwo tawie taruduwawo nuba boe mode i duji. Nou iwadaru jetumode pudui dukeje taruduwamode i rugadu. Pao Kurirewunure imi rugadu. Itagedumodukare rugadu.
source: Ca itaidure iwo tawie taruduwawo nuba boe mode i duji. Nou iwadaru jetumode pudui dukeje taruduwamode i rugadu. Pao Kurirewunure imi rugadu. Itagedumodukare rugadu.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emode tugera upodo nowu uture iwadaru tabowugebo enure tugera upodo itabo jamedu iragojere nowu uture iwadaru tabowugebo kodi. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure itarego boe etae rugadu. Dukodire boe emode tugera upodo itabo enure tugera upodo Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emode tugera upodo nowu uture iwadaru tabowugebo enure tugera upodo itabo jamedu iragojere nowu uture iwadaru tabowugebo kodi. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure itarego boe etae rugadu. Dukodire boe emode tugera upodo itabo enure tugera upodo Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu.

b: Jesus Ure Ewie Tumagudumoduie Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai
source: Jesus Ure Ewie Tumagudumoduie Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai
