b: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Dukodire makore pugeje. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Ia tagi tamode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Jesus ure nowu tuwadaru akedudo dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Dukodire makore pugeje. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Ia tagi tamode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaiwore pui. Eruduwakare kaba jiba Jesus akoino.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaiwore pui. Eruduwakare kaba jiba Jesus akoino.

b: Ia mugure Jesus meki. Jesus mearudu kurire nowu ture joruduwadowuji.
source: Ia mugure Jesus meki. Jesus mearudu kurire nowu ture joruduwadowuji.

b: Nono Simão Pedro ure tugera nado ae utuwo pudae. Nono makore ji. Akore anarado ji uwo pawie ioguduba jiba akoino.
source: Nono Simão Pedro ure tugera nado ae utuwo pudae. Nono makore ji. Akore anarado ji uwo pawie ioguduba jiba akoino.

b: Dukodire nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure tuburedo Jesus ji tunarawo ji. Akore ioguduba jiba akagoino?
source: Dukodire nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure tuburedo Jesus ji tunarawo ji. Akore ioguduba jiba akagoino?

b: Jesus akore Imode awu amirewu pegodo nowu iaboe kuru to dukeje imode maku ia imedu ai. Nou imedu koiare umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Nono Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Ure pegodo tagoino jiboe kuruto. Dukejere ure maku Judas ai. Nou Judas uo iere Simão Iscariotes.
source: Jesus akore Imode awu amirewu pegodo nowu iaboe kuru to dukeje imode maku ia imedu ai. Nou imedu koiare umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Nono Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Ure pegodo tagoino jiboe kuruto. Dukejere ure maku Judas ai. Nou Judas uo iere Simão Iscariotes.

b: Judas ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji dukeje bope doge eimijera pegarewu Satanás ure turemo nowu Judato. Jesus makore Judaji. Akore amearudae pegarewu towuje. Amara tabo!
source: Judas ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji dukeje bope doge eimijera pegarewu Satanás ure turemo nowu Judato. Jesus makore Judaji. Akore amearudae pegarewu towuje. Amara tabo!

b: Nouia rakojere Jesus apowuge eruduwakare kodiba Jesus akoino Judaji.
source: Nouia rakojere Jesus apowuge eruduwakare kodiba Jesus akoino Judaji.

b: Marigudu Judas jeture nowu eno dieroji. Dukodire iage emearudaere Judas umoduie akirodo ia boe ekeji pugeje. Iage emearudaere Judas umoduie ia diero maku marenarue doge etai.
source: Marigudu Judas jeture nowu eno dieroji. Dukodire iage emearudaere Judas umoduie akirodo ia boe ekeji pugeje. Iage emearudaere Judas umoduie ia diero maku marenarue doge etai.

b: Judas ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji dukeje uture epiji kuri je. Boecodure marigudu.
source: Judas ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji dukeje uture epiji kuri je. Boecodure marigudu.

b: Jesus Ure Eruduwado Turo Maiwuji
source: Jesus Ure Eruduwado Turo Maiwuji

b: Judas uture epiji dukeje Jesus makore nouia ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boe erudunure aino Imedu Onaregedu pemegarewuji. Awu imedu onaregedunure imi. Inure Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu towuje dukodire boe erudumode Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu ji rugadu.
source: Judas uture epiji dukeje Jesus makore nouia ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boe erudunure aino Imedu Onaregedu pemegarewuji. Awu imedu onaregedunure imi. Inure Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu towuje dukodire boe erudumode Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Iromode Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu romode iro pemegarewu ji jamedu boe eiamedu boe eruduwawo cero pemegarewu ji kuri aino rugadu ewo Pao Kurirewu ie kurido rugadu kuri je rugadu.
source: Iromode Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu romode iro pemegarewu ji jamedu boe eiamedu boe eruduwawo cero pemegarewu ji kuri aino rugadu ewo Pao Kurirewu ie kurido rugadu kuri je rugadu.

b: Tare nono itore emogadure. Iragojemodukare tagabo kuri aino pugeje. Tagaiwomode iwagai mare taroiwakare taduwo iregodaji. Ire Judeu doge eimijerage ewie nowu inoduji marigudu.
source: Tare nono itore emogadure. Iragojemodukare tagabo kuri aino pugeje. Tagaiwomode iwagai mare taroiwakare taduwo iregodaji. Ire Judeu doge eimijerage ewie nowu inoduji marigudu.

b: Mare imode ia taro maiwu maku tagai. Tamearudu kurido pui. Tamearudu kurido pui aino imearudu kurimoga tai dure.
source: Mare imode ia taro maiwu maku tagai. Tamearudu kurido pui. Tamearudu kurido pui aino imearudu kurimoga tai dure.

b: Tamearudu kurimode pui dukeje boe eruduwamode ire joruduwadowuge nuie tagi duji.
source: Tamearudu kurimode pui dukeje boe eruduwamode ire joruduwadowuge nuie tagi duji.

b: Jesus Ure Ewie Pedro Makomode Jiboe ji
source: Jesus Ure Ewie Pedro Makomode Jiboe ji

b: Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore kaiba akodumode? Jesus akore akare arugadu atuwo itabo. Mare ia meri keje atumode toro itae.
source: Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore kaiba akodumode? Jesus akore akare arugadu atuwo itabo. Mare ia meri keje atumode toro itae.

b: Pedro akore Ikimijeranure aki. Itaidure ituwo akabo. Ire irugadu iwiwo amugato.
source: Pedro akore Ikimijeranure aki. Itaidure ituwo akabo. Ire irugadu iwiwo amugato.

b: Jesus akore Iwo awie. Akare arugadu awiwo imugato. Awu boeco ji akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.
source: Jesus akore Iwo awie. Akare arugadu awiwo imugato. Awu boeco ji akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.

b: Jesus Koiare Umode Boe Erego Pao Kurirewu Ae
source: Jesus Koiare Umode Boe Erego Pao Kurirewu Ae

b: J e s u s m a k o r e t u r e joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tamororamagadukaba. Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Tamearutorudo i jamedu.
source: J e s u s m a k o r e t u r e joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tamororamagadukaba. Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Tamearutorudo i jamedu.

b: Iogwa uwai kurirewu tadare boe eda kurirewu mugure. Itumode toro iwo tawai pemegado nono. Ainore ure rugadu. Dukodire ire tawie aino.
source: Iogwa uwai kurirewu tadare boe eda kurirewu mugure. Itumode toro iwo tawai pemegado nono. Ainore ure rugadu. Dukodire ire tawie aino.

b: Imode tawai pemegado toro baru tada dukeje imode ikirimi mato pugeje tawagai iwo tarego baru to taragojewo itabo toro.
source: Imode tawai pemegado toro baru tada dukeje imode ikirimi mato pugeje tawagai iwo tarego baru to taragojewo itabo toro.

b: Taruduware ikodumode jiwu awara ji.
source: Taruduware ikodumode jiwu awara ji.

b: Mare Tomé makore Jesus ji. Akore cegimijera. Ceruduwakare kaiba akodumode. Nuba ceromode ceruduwawo awara ji cedaregoduwo toro?
source: Mare Tomé makore Jesus ji. Akore cegimijera. Ceruduwakare kaiba akodumode. Nuba ceromode ceruduwawo awara ji cedaregoduwo toro?

b: Jesus akore Umode boe erego baru towunure imi. Boe remawunure imi. Imire imode boe eraga maku boe etai. Imire imode boe eewodudo pugeje. Boe etumodukare tuginaigodu Pao Kurirewu ae. Tu imire imode boe erego Pao Kurirewu ae.
source: Jesus akore Umode boe erego baru towunure imi. Boe remawunure imi. Imire imode boe eraga maku boe etai. Imire imode boe eewodudo pugeje. Boe etumodukare tuginaigodu Pao Kurirewu ae. Tu imire imode boe erego Pao Kurirewu ae.

b: Taruduware i. Dukodi taruduwamode Iogwa Kurirewu ji jamedu. Awu meri ji care taruduware ji. Tarudure ji rugadu.
source: Taruduware i. Dukodi taruduwamode Iogwa Kurirewu ji jamedu. Awu meri ji care taruduware ji. Tarudure ji rugadu.

b: Felipe akore Cegimijera. Cedaidure ceruduwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Cerududo ji. Dukodire cemode cerugadu.
source: Felipe akore Cegimijera. Cedaidure ceruduwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Cerududo ji. Dukodire cemode cerugadu.

b: Jesus makore Felipeji. Akore iragojere tagabo marigudu. Aki na aruduwakare i? Jorudure iwu jorudure Iogwa Kurirewu ji. Kodiba akagoino iwo tarududo Iogwa Kurirewu ji?
source: Jesus makore Felipeji. Akore iragojere tagabo marigudu. Aki na aruduwakare i? Jorudure iwu jorudure Iogwa Kurirewu ji. Kodiba akagoino iwo tarududo Iogwa Kurirewu ji?

b: Felipenure aki. Iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojere itabo. Amearutorure nowu inoduji? Imagore tai mare iwadaru ji karega inagoino. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojere itabo dukodire inagoino Iogwa bataru ji tawiagai. Iogwa maragodae jire iroino.
source: Felipenure aki. Iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojere itabo. Amearutorure nowu inoduji? Imagore tai mare iwadaru ji karega inagoino. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojere itabo dukodire inagoino Iogwa bataru ji tawiagai. Iogwa maragodae jire iroino.

b: Tamearutorudo awu iwadaru ji. Iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojere itabo jamedu. Tamearutorumodukare inagoino jiboe ji dukeje mare tamearutorudo tarudure jiwu iro rakarewu ji tamearutoruwo i.
source: Tamearutorudo awu iwadaru ji. Iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojere itabo jamedu. Tamearutorumodukare inagoino jiboe ji dukeje mare tamearutorudo tarudure jiwu iro rakarewu ji tamearutoruwo i.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emearutorumode i dukeje eromode nono iro mogadure. Uu. Ero kurimode iro kori rugadu. Itumode Iogwa Kurirewu ae. Dukodire mearutorure iwuge ero kurimode rugadu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe emearutorumode i dukeje eromode nono iro mogadure. Uu. Ero kurimode iro kori rugadu. Itumode Iogwa Kurirewu ae. Dukodire mearutorure iwuge ero kurimode rugadu.

b: Itumode Iogwa Kurirewu ae dukodire iromode tagaidure jiboe ji. Tamagomode itaidure jiboe bagai dukeje iromode awu tamagore bagai boe ji. Irore aino dutabo imode boe erududo Iogwa Kurirewu ro pemegarewu rugadu boe ji, ro rakarewu rugadu boe ji jamedu.
source: Itumode Iogwa Kurirewu ae dukodire iromode tagaidure jiboe ji. Tamagomode itaidure jiboe bagai dukeje iromode awu tamagore bagai boe ji. Irore aino dutabo imode boe erududo Iogwa Kurirewu ro pemegarewu rugadu boe ji, ro rakarewu rugadu boe ji jamedu.

b: Tamagomode itaidure jiboe bagai dukeje iromode awu tamagore bagai boe ji jamedu.
source: Tamagomode itaidure jiboe bagai dukeje iromode awu tamagore bagai boe ji jamedu.

b: Jesus Akore tumoduie Pao Kurirewu Uwari Maku Boe Etai Rugadu
source: Jesus Akore tumoduie Pao Kurirewu Uwari Maku Boe Etai Rugadu

b: – Tamearudu kurire i dukeje tamearutorumode iwadaru ji rugadu.
source: – Tamearudu kurire i dukeje tamearutorumode iwadaru ji rugadu.

b: Inogwamagudumode Iogwa Kurirewu ji dukeje umode Tuwari maku tagai rugadu. Nou Uwari umode tugera bararedo tai. Rakojemode tagabo jii toro. Utumodukare tabiji.
source: Inogwamagudumode Iogwa Kurirewu ji dukeje umode Tuwari maku tagai rugadu. Nou Uwari umode tugera bararedo tai. Rakojemode tagabo jii toro. Utumodukare tabiji.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwarinure ema. Emare ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe jokodu jire ure boe eruduwado. Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge erudumodukare Pao Kurirewu Uwariji. Eruduwamodukare ji jamedu. Dukodi nowu mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emodukare tugeragu Uwariji. Mare taruduware ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere tagabo. Rakojemode tagabo jii toro rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwarinure ema. Emare ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe jokodu jire ure boe eruduwado. Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge erudumodukare Pao Kurirewu Uwariji. Eruduwamodukare ji jamedu. Dukodi nowu mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emodukare tugeragu Uwariji. Mare taruduware ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere tagabo. Rakojemode tagabo jii toro rugadu.

b: – Iturumode. Mare ietu pemegamode tai. Nono imode ikirimi tagae.
source: – Iturumode. Mare ietu pemegamode tai. Nono imode ikirimi tagae.

b: Kuri aino boe erudumodukare i pugeje. Mare tarudumode i rugadu. Iewodumode dukodire taewodumode pugeje jamedu.
source: Kuri aino boe erudumodukare i pugeje. Mare tarudumode i rugadu. Iewodumode dukodire taewodumode pugeje jamedu.

b: Iewodumode pugeje dukeje taruduwamode iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo duji. Taruduwamode taragojere itabo duji jamedu. Taruduwamode iragojere tagabo duji rugadu.
source: Iewodumode pugeje dukeje taruduwamode iragojere Iogwa Kurirewu apo duji. Taruduwamode taragojere itabo duji jamedu. Taruduwamode iragojere tagabo duji rugadu.

b: Mearudu kurire iwuge etaidumode iwadaru ji. Mearudu kurire iwuge emearutorumode iwadaru ji. Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurimode mearudu kurire iwuge ji. Imearudu kurimode ei jamedu. Imode eruduwado i rugadu.
source: Mearudu kurire iwuge etaidumode iwadaru ji. Mearudu kurire iwuge emearutorumode iwadaru ji. Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurimode mearudu kurire iwuge ji. Imearudu kurimode ei jamedu. Imode eruduwado i rugadu.

b: Judas makore Jesus ji mare Judas Iscariotes karega. Akore cegimijera. Amode ceruduwado ai mare amodukare mearutorukare aiwuge eruduwado ai. Kodiba mearutorukare aiwuge eruduwamodukare ai?
source: Judas makore Jesus ji mare Judas Iscariotes karega. Akore cegimijera. Amode ceruduwado ai mare amodukare mearutorukare aiwuge eruduwado ai. Kodiba mearutorukare aiwuge eruduwamodukare ai?

b: Jesus makore ji. Akore mearudu kurire iwuge emearutorumode iwadaru ji. Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurimode ei jamedu. Itaregodumode etae iogwapo cemuguwo ebo.
source: Jesus makore ji. Akore mearudu kurire iwuge emearutorumode iwadaru ji. Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurimode ei jamedu. Itaregodumode etae iogwapo cemuguwo ebo.

b: Mare mearudu kurikare iwuge emearutorumodukare iwadaru ji. Ikare taruduwado iwadaru ji. Ire taruduwado Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji. Ema koiare ure itarego mato tagae.
source: Mare mearudu kurikare iwuge emearutorumodukare iwadaru ji. Ikare taruduwado iwadaru ji. Ire taruduwado Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji. Ema koiare ure itarego mato tagae.

b: Iragoje biagamode tu tagabo dukodire ire tawie aino.
source: Iragoje biagamode tu tagabo dukodire ire tawie aino.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku tagai imugato. Umode tugera bararedo tai. Umode taruduwado nowu imagore jiwu Iogwa bataru rugadu boe ji. Umode tawiabutudo awu imagore jiwu Iogwa bataru jamedu boe keje.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku tagai imugato. Umode tugera bararedo tai. Umode taruduwado nowu imagore jiwu Iogwa bataru rugadu boe ji. Umode tawiabutudo awu imagore jiwu Iogwa bataru jamedu boe keje.

b: – Inure tado tagamudo tamearudae kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mearutorukare iwuge emodukare tamearudae kurido Pao Kurirewu ji nono iro mogadure. Tamororamagadukaba. Tagiarigodukaba. Tabagudugodukaba jamedu.
source: – Inure tado tagamudo tamearudae kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mearutorukare iwuge emodukare tamearudae kurido Pao Kurirewu ji nono iro mogadure. Tamororamagadukaba. Tagiarigodukaba. Tabagudugodukaba jamedu.

b: Tamearudure iwadaru ji marigudu. Ire tawie itumoduie tabiji duji. Mare imoduie ikirimi pugeje tagae. Tamearudu kurimode i dukeje taegaremode tai iture Iogwa Kurirewu ae duji. Iogwa Kurirewu ro kurire iro kori.
source: Tamearudure iwadaru ji marigudu. Ire tawie itumoduie tabiji duji. Mare imoduie ikirimi pugeje tagae. Tamearudu kurimode i dukeje taegaremode tai iture Iogwa Kurirewu ae duji. Iogwa Kurirewu ro kurire iro kori.

b: Ire tawie nuba boemode tai, nuba boemode i jamedu. Tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe ji dukeje tamearutorumode i rugadu.
source: Ire tawie nuba boemode tai, nuba boemode i jamedu. Tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe ji dukeje tamearutorumode i rugadu.

b: Awu moto kejewu bope doge eimijera aregodumode iwagai awu boeco ji rugadu dukodire imago raimodukare tai. Nou bope doge eimijera rakakare i mare Iogwa Kurirewu mearudae koiare imode imagu ai. Imearudu kurire Iogwaji dukodi. Itaidure boe eiamedu boe eruduwawo imearudu kurire Iogwa Kurirewu jituji. Dukodire imearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. – Ca paduwo awu bai piji.
source: Awu moto kejewu bope doge eimijera aregodumode iwagai awu boeco ji rugadu dukodire imago raimodukare tai. Nou bope doge eimijera rakakare i mare Iogwa Kurirewu mearudae koiare imode imagu ai. Imearudu kurire Iogwaji dukodi. Itaidure boe eiamedu boe eruduwawo imearudu kurire Iogwa Kurirewu jituji. Dukodire imearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. – Ca paduwo awu bai piji.

b: Jesus Ure Nono Uva I Pemegarewu Mogadure
source: Jesus Ure Nono Uva I Pemegarewu Mogadure

b: Jesus makore kimo ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore ire nono uva iku paru pemegarewu mogadure. Iogwa Kurirewu ure nono jetu pemegare boepa jiwu mogadure.
source: Jesus makore kimo ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore ire nono uva iku paru pemegarewu mogadure. Iogwa Kurirewu ure nono jetu pemegare boepa jiwu mogadure.

b: Ire nono uva iku paru pemegarewu mogadure. Tare nono uva iku mogadure. Iku kadodumode dukeje nowu iku bimode, tudumodukare pugeje. Mare iku jetu kimomode ciguto dukeje bimodukare, tudumode rugadu. Iku tudumodukare dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode nowu iku kado tubaru piji. Mare iku tudumode dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode nowu iku pemegado nowu iku tudu pemegawo rugadu. Mare uva iku paru ji karega inagoino. I rugadure inagoino. Iku ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwugeire inagoino. Boepa ji karega inagoino jamedu. Pao Kurirewu jire inagoino. Ire taruduwado dukodire ire tabemegado, taro pemegawo. Tamearutoru raimode i dukeje iragojemode tagabo. Nono taedu pemegamode itabo rugadu. Tamearutoru raimode i dukeje imode taragado taro pemegawo, tawo taro pegarewu barigu tabiji. Mare iragojemodukare tagabo dukeje taro pemegamodukare rugadu.
source: Ire nono uva iku paru pemegarewu mogadure. Tare nono uva iku mogadure. Iku kadodumode dukeje nowu iku bimode, tudumodukare pugeje. Mare iku jetu kimomode ciguto dukeje bimodukare, tudumode rugadu. Iku tudumodukare dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode nowu iku kado tubaru piji. Mare iku tudumode dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode nowu iku pemegado nowu iku tudu pemegawo rugadu. Mare uva iku paru ji karega inagoino. I rugadure inagoino. Iku ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwugeire inagoino. Boepa ji karega inagoino jamedu. Pao Kurirewu jire inagoino. Ire taruduwado dukodire ire tabemegado, taro pemegawo. Tamearutoru raimode i dukeje iragojemode tagabo. Nono taedu pemegamode itabo rugadu. Tamearutoru raimode i dukeje imode taragado taro pemegawo, tawo taro pegarewu barigu tabiji. Mare iragojemodukare tagabo dukeje taro pemegamodukare rugadu.

b: Mearutorukare iwuge ewarigudumode joru to nono jerigi mogadure. Mare jerigi ji karega inagoino. Ewarigudumode Pao Kurirewu piji emearutorukare ji kodi.
source: Mearutorukare iwuge ewarigudumode joru to nono jerigi mogadure. Mare jerigi ji karega inagoino. Ewarigudumode Pao Kurirewu piji emearutorukare ji kodi.

b: Mare tamearutoru raimode i taruduwamode iwadaru ji rugadu dukeje tamagomode i tagaidure jiboe bagai. Imode tarududo tagaidure jiboe ji tamearutorure i kodi.
source: Mare tamearutoru raimode i taruduwamode iwadaru ji rugadu dukeje tamagomode i tagaidure jiboe bagai. Imode tarududo tagaidure jiboe ji tamearutorure i kodi.

b: Taro pemegamode nono Iogwa Kurirewu ro mogadure dukeje tamode boe eruduwado Iogwa Kurirewu ro pemegarewuji. Taromode aino dukeje ire joruduwadowugenure tagi.
source: Taro pemegamode nono Iogwa Kurirewu ro mogadure dukeje tamode boe eruduwado Iogwa Kurirewu ro pemegarewuji. Taromode aino dukeje ire joruduwadowugenure tagi.

b: – Imearudu kurire tai nono Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurimoga i dumogadure. Tagaba iwarigu tabiji imearudu kuriwo tai jii toro.
source: – Imearudu kurire tai nono Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurimoga i dumogadure. Tagaba iwarigu tabiji imearudu kuriwo tai jii toro.

b: Tamearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje tamodukare iwarigu tabiji. Dukodi imearudu kurimode tai jii toro rugadu. Imearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji. Ikare barigu ipiji. Emare mearudu kurire i rugadu.
source: Tamearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje tamodukare iwarigu tabiji. Dukodi imearudu kurimode tai jii toro rugadu. Imearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji. Ikare barigu ipiji. Emare mearudu kurire i rugadu.

b: Ire tawie aino tamearutoruwo awu inagoino jiboe ji, iagarewo tai rugadu. Taegarewo pui jamedu.
source: Ire tawie aino tamearutoruwo awu inagoino jiboe ji, iagarewo tai rugadu. Taegarewo pui jamedu.

b: Ca iwadaru reo. Tamearudu kurido pui nono imearudu kurimoga tai dumogadure.
source: Ca iwadaru reo. Tamearudu kurido pui nono imearudu kurimoga tai dumogadure.

b: Ia boe mearudu kurimode rugadu ia timediaji dukeje aidumode tuwiwo nowu timedia mugato nowu timedia bikawo.
source: Ia boe mearudu kurimode rugadu ia timediaji dukeje aidumode tuwiwo nowu timedia mugato nowu timedia bikawo.

b: Ca tamearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje imedage mode tagi.
source: Ca tamearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje imedage mode tagi.

b: Itugarege modukare tagi pugeje. Boe eimijera utugarege eruduwakare tugimijera mearudae ji. Mare imedagenure tagi. Dukodire ire tawie imearudae jamedu boe ji. Ire tawie Iogwa Kurirewu makore iwu tuwadaru jamedu boe ji.
source: Itugarege modukare tagi pugeje. Boe eimijera utugarege eruduwakare tugimijera mearudae ji. Mare imedagenure tagi. Dukodire ire tawie imearudae jamedu boe ji. Ire tawie Iogwa Kurirewu makore iwu tuwadaru jamedu boe ji.

b: Tagare tageragu i. Imire ire ikeragu tai. Imagore tai taro pemegawo, tawo boe pemegado boe ji. Taro akedumodukare. Dukodire Iogwa Kurirewu umode tamagore bagaiboe maku tagai rugadu. Tamagomode itaidure jiboe bagai dukeje Iogwa umode maku tagai rugadu.
source: Tagare tageragu i. Imire ire ikeragu tai. Imagore tai taro pemegawo, tawo boe pemegado boe ji. Taro akedumodukare. Dukodire Iogwa Kurirewu umode tamagore bagaiboe maku tagai rugadu. Tamagomode itaidure jiboe bagai dukeje Iogwa umode maku tagai rugadu.

b: Ca itaidure jiwu taro reo. Tamearudu kurido pui rugadu.
source: Ca itaidure jiwu taro reo. Tamearudu kurido pui rugadu.

b: Mearutorukare Jesus Jiwuge Erudu Pegamode Rugadu
source: Mearutorukare Jesus Jiwuge Erudu Pegamode Rugadu

b: – Tawiagodukaba. Mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegamode tai mare erudu pegare i boeto ji.
source: – Tawiagodukaba. Mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegamode tai mare erudu pegare i boeto ji.

b: Taromode nono mearutorukare iwuge ero mogadure dukeje etaidumode tai. Etaidumode tai nono etaidumoga pui dumogadure. Mare ire ikeragu tai nowu mearutorukare iwuge ero piji tarokawo nono ero mogadure pugeje. Dukodire mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegare tai.
source: Taromode nono mearutorukare iwuge ero mogadure dukeje etaidumode tai. Etaidumode tai nono etaidumoga pui dumogadure. Mare ire ikeragu tai nowu mearutorukare iwuge ero piji tarokawo nono ero mogadure pugeje. Dukodire mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegare tai.

b: Tawiagodukaba imagore tai dupiji. Boe etugarege ekurikare tugimijera kori dukodire boe emearutorumodukare nowu boe etugaregei ekimijera piji. Tagimijeranure imi. Boe emearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje emearutorumode ire maku tagaiwu tawadaru ji jamedu. Mare boe ero pegare i dukodire ero pegamode tai jamedu.
source: Tawiagodukaba imagore tai dupiji. Boe etugarege ekurikare tugimijera kori dukodire boe emearutorumodukare nowu boe etugaregei ekimijera piji. Tagimijeranure imi. Boe emearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje emearutorumode ire maku tagaiwu tawadaru ji jamedu. Mare boe ero pegare i dukodire ero pegamode tai jamedu.

b: Ero pegamode tai tamearutorure i kodi. Eruduwakare ure itarego matowu Iogwa Kurirewu ji kodi.
source: Ero pegamode tai tamearutorure i kodi. Eruduwakare ure itarego matowu Iogwa Kurirewu ji kodi.

b: Imodukare ewie ero pegarewu boe ji dukeje egomode turo pegakaie. Mare ire ewie. Ire ewie ero pegarewu boe ji. Dukodire egomodukare tuioruduwakaie turo pegarewuji.
source: Imodukare ewie ero pegarewu boe ji dukeje egomode turo pegakaie. Mare ire ewie. Ire ewie ero pegarewu boe ji. Dukodire egomodukare tuioruduwakaie turo pegarewuji.

b: Jorudu pegare iwuge erudu pegare Iogwa Kurirewu ji jamedu.
source: Jorudu pegare iwuge erudu pegare Iogwa Kurirewu ji jamedu.

b: Itaregodure etae iro rakarewu tabo. Ire erududo iro rakarewuji. Ia boe erokare nono iro rakarewure marigudu. Erudumodukare iro rakarewu ji dukeje eruduwamodukare i. Nono egomode tuioruduwakaie turo pegarewuji. Mare erudure iro rakarewu ji dukodire eruduware i. Eruduware ipemegare duji. Mare erudu pegare i. Erudu pegare Iogwa Kurirewu ji.
source: Itaregodure etae iro rakarewu tabo. Ire erududo iro rakarewuji. Ia boe erokare nono iro rakarewure marigudu. Erudumodukare iro rakarewu ji dukeje eruduwamodukare i. Nono egomode tuioruduwakaie turo pegarewuji. Mare erudure iro rakarewu ji dukodire eruduware i. Eruduware ipemegare duji. Mare erudu pegare i. Erudu pegare Iogwa Kurirewu ji.

b: Pao Kurirewu makore marigudu nuba eromoduie. Nou bataru padure bapera keje eno bakaruce. Akore Iro pegakare ei mare erudu pegare i.” Aino care awu bataru jeture pudui rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu makore marigudu nuba eromoduie. Nou bataru padure bapera keje eno bakaruce. Akore Iro pegakare ei mare erudu pegare i.” Aino care awu bataru jeture pudui rugadu.

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode tagae. Umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Boe jokodu jire makomode. Imi igoiare imode Pao Kurirewu Uwari arego tagae. Umode taruduwado i rugadu.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode tagae. Umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Boe jokodu jire makomode. Imi igoiare imode Pao Kurirewu Uwari arego tagae. Umode taruduwado i rugadu.

b: Nono tamode nowu mugu jaerewuge pawobe ewie i jamedu. Taragojere itabo marigudu dukodi tamode nowu boe eruduwado i jamedu.
source: Nono tamode nowu mugu jaerewuge pawobe ewie i jamedu. Taragojere itabo marigudu dukodi tamode nowu boe eruduwado i jamedu.

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ire tawie marigudu. Dukodi tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore ire tawie marigudu. Dukodi tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji.

b: Judeu doge emode tadudo nowu ture bato puiwu bai piji. Emode ia tawido jamedu. Emearudaere ainore Pao Kurirewu aidure boe erowo mearutorure iwuge ji.
source: Judeu doge emode tadudo nowu ture bato puiwu bai piji. Emode ia tawido jamedu. Emearudaere ainore Pao Kurirewu aidure boe erowo mearutorure iwuge ji.

b: Mare eruduwakare i. Eruduwakare Iogwa Kurirewu ji. Dukodire ero pegamode tai.
source: Mare eruduwakare i. Eruduwakare Iogwa Kurirewu ji. Dukodire ero pegamode tai.

b: Marigudu iragojere tagabo dukodire ikare tawie. Mare aino care ire tawie. Dukodi boe ero pegamode tai dukeje tawiabutumode awu iwadaru keje rugadu.
source: Marigudu iragojere tagabo dukodire ikare tawie. Mare aino care ire tawie. Dukodi boe ero pegamode tai dukeje tawiabutumode awu iwadaru keje rugadu.

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu Uwari Rore Boei
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu Uwari Rore Boei

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore kuri aino imode ikirimi ure itarego matowu Iogwa bagai. Marigudu tanarakare i kaiba ikodumode.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore kuri aino imode ikirimi ure itarego matowu Iogwa bagai. Marigudu tanarakare i kaiba ikodumode.

b: Ca ire tawie dukodire tagiarigodure rugadu.
source: Ca ire tawie dukodire tagiarigodure rugadu.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Itumode tabiji dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu. Ire tawie. Mare itumode tabiji boe pemegawo tai dubagai jamedu. Itumode tabiji Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregoduwo tagae dubagai jamedu. Itumodukare tabiji dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumodukare tagae. Mare itumode tabiji dukeje imode Pao Kurirewu Uwari arego tagae rugadu. Dukodire inagoino boe pemegamoduie tai rugadu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Itumode tabiji dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu. Ire tawie. Mare itumode tabiji boe pemegawo tai dubagai jamedu. Itumode tabiji Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregoduwo tagae dubagai jamedu. Itumodukare tabiji dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumodukare tagae. Mare itumode tabiji dukeje imode Pao Kurirewu Uwari arego tagae rugadu. Dukodire inagoino boe pemegamoduie tai rugadu.

b: Boe eruduwakare turo pegarewu boe ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode boe etae dukeje umode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu aidukare jiwu boe ero pegarewu boe ji boe ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu boe piji rugadu. Boe emearudaere ro jetororewuge nuie pudumi. Eruduwakare tuwo turo jetorodo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode dukeje umode eruduwado ero jetorokare duji. Umode boe eruduwado iro jetorore duji. Boe emearudaere tuioruduwaie Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode eruduwado eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jituji. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado mearutorukare iwugei ero pegarewu morice.
source: Boe eruduwakare turo pegarewu boe ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode boe etae dukeje umode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu aidukare jiwu boe ero pegarewu boe ji boe ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu boe piji rugadu. Boe emearudaere ro jetororewuge nuie pudumi. Eruduwakare tuwo turo jetorodo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode dukeje umode eruduwado ero jetorokare duji. Umode boe eruduwado iro jetorore duji. Boe emearudaere tuioruduwaie Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode eruduwado eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jituji. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado mearutorukare iwugei ero pegarewu morice.

b: Emearutorukare i dukodire eruduwakare ro pegarewuge nuie pudumi duji.
source: Emearutorukare i dukodire eruduwakare ro pegarewuge nuie pudumi duji.

b: Iro jetorore. Nono itumode Iogwa Kurirewu bagai dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode tona bu ikajeje toro. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode boe eruduwado nowu inoduji rugadu tuwo eruduwado iro jetorore duji. Dukeje care boe eruduwamode iro jetorore duji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode boe eruduwado ro jetorokarewugenure emage duji jamedu.
source: Iro jetorore. Nono itumode Iogwa Kurirewu bagai dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode tona bu ikajeje toro. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode boe eruduwado nowu inoduji rugadu tuwo eruduwado iro jetorore duji. Dukeje care boe eruduwamode iro jetorore duji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode boe eruduwado ro jetorokarewugenure emage duji jamedu.

b: Emearudaere Pao Kurirewu ro pegamodukaie pudui. Mare eruduwakare. Marigudu ure bope doge eimijera bie tumoduie boe pegado ji nowu bope doge eimijera ro pegarewu morice. Ro pegarewuge emearutorure nowu bope doge eimijeraji jamedu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pegamode ei jamedu ero pegarewu morice rugadu.
source: Emearudaere Pao Kurirewu ro pegamodukaie pudui. Mare eruduwakare. Marigudu ure bope doge eimijera bie tumoduie boe pegado ji nowu bope doge eimijera ro pegarewu morice. Ro pegarewuge emearutorure nowu bope doge eimijeraji jamedu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pegamode ei jamedu ero pegarewu morice rugadu.

b: – Iwadaru kurire iwo tawie ji. Mare taragakare taruduwawo jamedu boe ji.
source: – Iwadaru kurire iwo tawie ji. Mare taragakare taruduwawo jamedu boe ji.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode tagae dukeje umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Umode taruduwado boe jokodu remawu ji. Makomodukare tuwadaru ji. Makomode tumearudure jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tu rugadu. Umode tawie nuba boe mode boe ji awu moto jituji.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregodumode tagae dukeje umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Umode taruduwado boe jokodu remawu ji. Makomodukare tuwadaru ji. Makomode tumearudure jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tu rugadu. Umode tawie nuba boe mode boe ji awu moto jituji.

b: Umode tawie i jamedu. Umode tawie iwadaru ji. Dukodire umode boe eruduwado i. Ipemegare rugadu. Dujire umode boe eruduwado.
source: Umode tawie i jamedu. Umode tawie iwadaru ji. Dukodire umode boe eruduwado i. Ipemegare rugadu. Dujire umode boe eruduwado.

b: Iogwa Kurirewu bataru jire inagoino. Dukodire ire tawie aino. Pao Kurirewu Uwari makomode iwadaru ji tawiagai rugadu.
source: Iogwa Kurirewu bataru jire inagoino. Dukodire ire tawie aino. Pao Kurirewu Uwari makomode iwadaru ji tawiagai rugadu.

b: Boe Ekiarigodumode Mare Egaremode Pugeje
source: Boe Ekiarigodumode Mare Egaremode Pugeje

b: – Kuri aino tarudumodukare i pugeje. Mare ia meri keje tarudumode i rugadu.
source: – Kuri aino tarudumodukare i pugeje. Mare ia meri keje tarudumode i rugadu.

b: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui. egore kaba jiba akoino pai? Akore parudumodukare pudui kuri aino. Akore ia meri kejeie parudumoduie pudui pugeje. Akore tudumoduie Pao Kurirewu ae kuri aino.
source: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui. egore kaba jiba akoino pai? Akore parudumodukare pudui kuri aino. Akore ia meri kejeie parudumoduie pudui pugeje. Akore tudumoduie Pao Kurirewu ae kuri aino.

b: Kaboba jiba akoino? Paruduwakare kaba jiba akoino pai.
source: Kaboba jiba akoino? Paruduwakare kaba jiba akoino pai.

b: Jesus joruduware nowu ture joruduwadowuge emearudae ji. Dukodire makore ei pugeje. Akore inagore tai tarudumodukaie i kuri aino mare ia meri keje tarudumoduie i pugeje. Mare taruduwakare awu iwadaru ji dukodire tagagoino aino pui.
source: Jesus joruduware nowu ture joruduwadowuge emearudae ji. Dukodire makore ei pugeje. Akore inagore tai tarudumodukaie i kuri aino mare ia meri keje tarudumoduie i pugeje. Mare taruduwakare awu iwadaru ji dukodire tagagoino aino pui.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Tagiarigodumode rugadu. Tagragudumode rugadu. Mare mearutorukare iwugere egaremode pudui. Tagiarigodumode mare taegaregodumode tai pugeje.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai. Tagiarigodumode rugadu. Tagragudumode rugadu. Mare mearutorukare iwugere egaremode pudui. Tagiarigodumode mare taegaregodumode tai pugeje.

b: Aredu kurijirigodure dukeje kiarigodure tugurijiri kori koia. Mare kuri buture dukeje biagodure nowu tugurijiriredu piji. Jakarere tonaregeduji rugadu tonaregedu boture kodi.
source: Aredu kurijirigodure dukeje kiarigodure tugurijiri kori koia. Mare kuri buture dukeje biagodure nowu tugurijiriredu piji. Jakarere tonaregeduji rugadu tonaregedu boture kodi.

b: Tagiarigodure mare iorudumode tai pugeje. Dukeje taegaregodumode tai pugeje. Boe emodukare taegare akedudo tabiji rugadu.
source: Tagiarigodure mare iorudumode tai pugeje. Dukeje taegaregodumode tai pugeje. Boe emodukare taegare akedudo tabiji rugadu.

b: Iwo tawie. Nou meri ji Pao Kurirewu umode tagaidure jiboe maku tagai dukodire tagogwamagudumodukare i iaboe bagai. Tamagomode tagaidure jiboe bagai ikie tabo dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode maku tagai rugadu.
source: Iwo tawie. Nou meri ji Pao Kurirewu umode tagaidure jiboe maku tagai dukodire tagogwamagudumodukare i iaboe bagai. Tamagomode tagaidure jiboe bagai ikie tabo dukeje Iogwa Kurirewu umode maku tagai rugadu.

b: Marigudu tagogwamagudukare i iaboe bagai ikie tabo. Tamagomode bagai dukeje makudumode tagai rugadu. Dukodire taegaregodumode tai rugadu.
source: Marigudu tagogwamagudukare i iaboe bagai ikie tabo. Tamagomode bagai dukeje makudumode tagai rugadu. Dukodire taegaregodumode tai rugadu.

b: Eromodukare Boe Ero Pegarewu ji Pugeje
source: Eromodukare Boe Ero Pegarewu ji Pugeje

b: – Ireadodure boe ji tawiagai iwo Iogwa Kurirewu jebato iaboe ji iwo taruduwado Iogwa Kurirewu rore jiboe ji. Mare ia meri keje imodukare Iogwa Kurirewu jebato iaboe ji pugeje. Imago pemegamode iwo taruduwado rugadu Iogwa Kurirewu ji.
source: – Ireadodure boe ji tawiagai iwo Iogwa Kurirewu jebato iaboe ji iwo taruduwado Iogwa Kurirewu rore jiboe ji. Mare ia meri keje imodukare Iogwa Kurirewu jebato iaboe ji pugeje. Imago pemegamode iwo taruduwado rugadu Iogwa Kurirewu ji.

b: Nou meri ji tagi rugadu tamagomode ji rugadu tagaidure jiboe bagai ikie tabo. Imi karega imagomodukare ji. Tagire tamagomode ji rugadu.
source: Nou meri ji tagi rugadu tamagomode ji rugadu tagaidure jiboe bagai ikie tabo. Imi karega imagomodukare ji. Tagire tamagomode ji rugadu.

b: Emare mearudu kurire tai. Tamearudu kurire i. Tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ure itarego mato duji dukodire Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurire tai rugadu.
source: Emare mearudu kurire tai. Tamearudu kurire i. Tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ure itarego mato duji dukodire Iogwa Kurirewu mearudu kurire tai rugadu.

b: Itaregodure Iogwa Kurirewu piji rugadu. Itaregodure mato moto ka. Mare itumode awu moto piji pugeje ituwo Iogwa Kurirewu bagai.
source: Itaregodure Iogwa Kurirewu piji rugadu. Itaregodure mato moto ka. Mare itumode awu moto piji pugeje ituwo Iogwa Kurirewu bagai.

b: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore Jesus ji. egore aino care amago kicarure cewiagai. Akare Pao Kurirewu bataru jebato iaboe ji pugeje.
source: Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore Jesus ji. egore aino care amago kicarure cewiagai. Akare Pao Kurirewu bataru jebato iaboe ji pugeje.

b: Aino ceruduware ai. Aruduware boe jamedu boe ji rugadu. Boe emodukare awie tumearudae ji mare aruduware emearudae ji rugadu. Dukodire ceruduware ai. Akaregodure Pao Kurirewu piji rugadu.
source: Aino ceruduware ai. Aruduware boe jamedu boe ji rugadu. Boe emodukare awie tumearudae ji mare aruduware emearudae ji rugadu. Dukodire ceruduware ai. Akaregodure Pao Kurirewu piji rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore ca. Tamearutoru kana i rugadu?
source: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore ca. Tamearutoru kana i rugadu?

b: Kuri aino ro pegarewuge emode tagaodo ipiji taduwo tawai ka ipiji. Dukodi iragojemode ikinaigodu. Mare ikinaigodu jokodu karega. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojemode itabo.
source: Kuri aino ro pegarewuge emode tagaodo ipiji taduwo tawai ka ipiji. Dukodi iragojemode ikinaigodu. Mare ikinaigodu jokodu karega. Iogwa Kurirewu rakojemode itabo.

b: Ire tawie. Dukodi care tadudo itabo. Tadumode itabo dukeje tamode tagamudo rugadu tamearudae kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mearutorukare iwuge ero pegamode tai. Mare tarudu pegakaba. Taragado tai! Toro ia meri keje imode etagedudo rugadu.
source: Ire tawie. Dukodi care tadudo itabo. Tadumode itabo dukeje tamode tagamudo rugadu tamearudae kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mearutorukare iwuge ero pegamode tai. Mare tarudu pegakaba. Taragado tai! Toro ia meri keje imode etagedudo rugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Baruto Ture Joruduwadowuge Eparu Tabo
source: Jesus Makore Baruto Ture Joruduwadowuge Eparu Tabo

b: Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo ture joruduwadowugei dukeje aiwore baru to tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai. Akore iogwa. Akanaregedunure imi. Iwimode kuri aino boe ero pegarewu morice. Mare paga karega iwo boe ekinorudo rugadu. Are boe eiamedu boe eimijerado imi iwo akaidure jiwuge ekinorudo ewikawo pugeje emuguwo akabo jii toro rugadu. Ca iro udo turugadu iwo awu imaragodae iado, iwo imaragodae pemegado. Imode iado dukeje boe erudumode amearudaere jiwu imaragodae pemegare rugadu duji, kurire rugadu duji. Amearudae kurire boe eiamedu boe emearudae piji. Amearudae kurire awo boe ekinorudo ewikawo pugeje emuguwo akabo jii toro rugadu.
source: Jesus ure tuwadaru akedudo ture joruduwadowugei dukeje aiwore baru to tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai. Akore iogwa. Akanaregedunure imi. Iwimode kuri aino boe ero pegarewu morice. Mare paga karega iwo boe ekinorudo rugadu. Are boe eiamedu boe eimijerado imi iwo akaidure jiwuge ekinorudo ewikawo pugeje emuguwo akabo jii toro rugadu. Ca iro udo turugadu iwo awu imaragodae iado, iwo imaragodae pemegado. Imode iado dukeje boe erudumode amearudaere jiwu imaragodae pemegare rugadu duji, kurire rugadu duji. Amearudae kurire boe eiamedu boe emearudae piji. Amearudae kurire awo boe ekinorudo ewikawo pugeje emuguwo akabo jii toro rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewunure aki rugadu. Ia bokware. Are mitotu je. Boe remawunure aki rugadu. Akurire boe eiamedu boe kori. Aire boe eruduwamode rugadu tumearutoruwo ai rugadu tumuguwo akabo baru tada du akedukawo. Amearudae koiare are itarego mato moto ka. Ire boe eruduwamode jamedu tumearutoruwo i emuguwo pagabo rugadu jii toro rugadu. Jesus Cristonure imi rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewunure aki rugadu. Ia bokware. Are mitotu je. Boe remawunure aki rugadu. Akurire boe eiamedu boe kori. Aire boe eruduwamode rugadu tumearutoruwo ai rugadu tumuguwo akabo baru tada du akedukawo. Amearudae koiare are itarego mato moto ka. Ire boe eruduwamode jamedu tumearutoruwo i emuguwo pagabo rugadu jii toro rugadu. Jesus Cristonure imi rugadu.

b: Ire boe eruduwado aro rakarewu ji aro pemegarewu ji woe moto keje. Aino care ire are maku inaiwu imaragodae iado woe. Dukodire ire boe erududo apemegare duji. Apemegare boe eiamedu boe piji.
source: Ire boe eruduwado aro rakarewu ji aro pemegarewu ji woe moto keje. Aino care ire are maku inaiwu imaragodae iado woe. Dukodire ire boe erududo apemegare duji. Apemegare boe eiamedu boe piji.

b: Iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Marigudu akare awu moto to raga dukeje baru tadawuge eruduware marigudu ipemegare duji. Dukodire baru tadawuge emago pemegare i. Ere ikie kurido. Aino ire irawuje mato moto ka. Kuri aino itumode ibagi baru to iragojewo akabo pugeje. Itaidure awo boe erududo ipemegare duji nono baru tadawuge erudu mogadure.
source: Iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Marigudu akare awu moto to raga dukeje baru tadawuge eruduware marigudu ipemegare duji. Dukodire baru tadawuge emago pemegare i. Ere ikie kurido. Aino ire irawuje mato moto ka. Kuri aino itumode ibagi baru to iragojewo akabo pugeje. Itaidure awo boe erududo ipemegare duji nono baru tadawuge erudu mogadure.

b: – Are ia awu moto kejewu boe emagu inai emearutoruwo i. Ire eruduwado ai rugadu. Emearutorure ai. Dukodire are emagu inai iwo eruduwado. Nono emearutorure awadaru ji rugadu.
source: – Are ia awu moto kejewu boe emagu inai emearutoruwo i. Ire eruduwado ai rugadu. Emearutorure ai. Dukodire are emagu inai iwo eruduwado. Nono emearutorure awadaru ji rugadu.

b: Aino eruduware are maku inai boe ji. Apijire are maku inai.
source: Aino eruduware are maku inai boe ji. Apijire are maku inai.

b: Ire awadaru maku etai. Are awadaru maku inai dukeje ire ewie awadaru ji. Emearutorure ji rugadu. Eruduware itaregodure apiji duji rugadu. Are itarego mato rugadu. Emearutorure rugadu.
source: Ire awadaru maku etai. Are awadaru maku inai dukeje ire ewie awadaru ji. Emearutorure ji rugadu. Eruduware itaregodure apiji duji rugadu. Are itarego mato rugadu. Emearutorure rugadu.

b: – Mearutorure aiwuge eparu tabore inagoino baru to awagai. Imagokare mearutorukare iwuge eparu tabo. Mare imagore nowu are maku inaiwuge boe eparu tabo emearutorure ai kodi.
source: – Mearutorure aiwuge eparu tabore inagoino baru to awagai. Imagokare mearutorukare iwuge eparu tabo. Mare imagore nowu are maku inaiwuge boe eparu tabo emearutorure ai kodi.

b: Mearutorure iwuge emearutorumode ai jamedu. Mearutorure aiwuge emearutorumode i jamedu. Emearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje boe eiamedu boe eruduwamode imi rugadu iro pemegarewu kodure boe eiamedu boe kori duji.
source: Mearutorure iwuge emearutorumode ai jamedu. Mearutorure aiwuge emearutorumode i jamedu. Emearutorumode iwadaru ji dukeje boe eiamedu boe eruduwamode imi rugadu iro pemegarewu kodure boe eiamedu boe kori duji.

b: Kuri aino itumode baru to akae. Iragojemodukare mearutorukare iwugebo pugeje. Mare mearutorure iwuge eragojemode woe awu moto keje kimo. Ca Iogwa Pemegarewunure aki rugadu. Aragare rugadu. Aetu pemegado awu mearutorure iwugei emearudae pemegawo pui nono imi aki pamogadure puapo dumogadure. Pamearudae ure mitotu je. Are nowu araga maku inai marigudu.
source: Kuri aino itumode baru to akae. Iragojemodukare mearutorukare iwugebo pugeje. Mare mearutorure iwuge eragojemode woe awu moto keje kimo. Ca Iogwa Pemegarewunure aki rugadu. Aragare rugadu. Aetu pemegado awu mearutorure iwugei emearudae pemegawo pui nono imi aki pamogadure puapo dumogadure. Pamearudae ure mitotu je. Are nowu araga maku inai marigudu.

b: Dukodire ietu pemegare awu mearutorure iwugei nowu are maku inaiwu araga tabo. Dukodire ekare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji. Ma kocare ure tugera ra ipijiwu ure mitotu je. Emare mearutorukare i rugadu. Marigudu akagore ia ure tugera ra ipijiwu umoduie imagu boe eimijera pegarewuge etai amoduie boe pegado ji rugadu. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu umode imagu etaiwuji rugadu. Dukodire nowu awadaru jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Dukodire ietu pemegare awu mearutorure iwugei nowu are maku inaiwu araga tabo. Dukodire ekare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji. Ma kocare ure tugera ra ipijiwu ure mitotu je. Emare mearutorukare i rugadu. Marigudu akagore ia ure tugera ra ipijiwu umoduie imagu boe eimijera pegarewuge etai amoduie boe pegado ji rugadu. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu umode imagu etaiwuji rugadu. Dukodire nowu awadaru jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Ca, kuri aino itaregodumode baru to akae pugeje. Ire iwadaru maku awu ire joruduwadowuge etai egarewo iwadaru ji rugadu nono iagare mogadure.
source: Ca, kuri aino itaregodumode baru to akae pugeje. Ire iwadaru maku awu ire joruduwadowuge etai egarewo iwadaru ji rugadu nono iagare mogadure.

b: Ire awadaru maku awu ire joruduwadowuge etai mare mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegare ei rugadu. Awu ire joruduwadowuge emearutorure i dukodire erore nono iro mogadure. Erokare nono mearutorukare iwuge ero mogadure. Dukodire mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegare ei jamedu.
source: Ire awadaru maku awu ire joruduwadowuge etai mare mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegare ei rugadu. Awu ire joruduwadowuge emearutorure i dukodire erore nono iro mogadure. Erokare nono mearutorukare iwuge ero mogadure. Dukodire mearutorukare iwuge erudu pegare ei jamedu.

b: Imagokare awagai awo awu mearutorure iwuge etawuje awu moto piji. Mare itaidure aetu pemegawo ei rugadu awo ekinorudo bope doge eimijera piji.
source: Imagokare awagai awo awu mearutorure iwuge etawuje awu moto piji. Mare itaidure aetu pemegawo ei rugadu awo ekinorudo bope doge eimijera piji.

b: Imearudaekare nono awu mearutorukare iwuge emearudae mogadure. Awu ire joruduwadowuge emearudaekare nono awu mearutorukare iwuge emearudae mogadure jamedu.
source: Imearudaekare nono awu mearutorukare iwuge emearudae mogadure. Awu ire joruduwadowuge emearudaekare nono awu mearutorukare iwuge emearudae mogadure jamedu.

b: Awadaru ure turugadu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Mearutorure iwuge ero pemegawo. Emearutoruwo awadaru ji atugaregewo emage awo ero jetorodo rugadu.

b: Are itarego mato moto ka mearutorukare iwuge etae. Dukodire ire awu ire joruduwadowuge etudo mearutorukare iwuge etae jamedu nono are itarego mearutorukare iwuge etae dumogadure.
source: Are itarego mato moto ka mearutorukare iwuge etae. Dukodire ire awu ire joruduwadowuge etudo mearutorukare iwuge etae jamedu nono are itarego mearutorukare iwuge etae dumogadure.

b: Dukodire akaidumode jiboe ire irugadu imearutoruwo awadaru ji rugadu. Awu ire joruduwadowuge ewo tudo turugadu jamedu tumearutoruwo awadaru ji jamedu nono imogadure.

b: – Imagore eparu tabo awagai toro baru to. Emode boe eruduwado iwadaru ji dukodire boe emearutorumode i rugadu. Imagore nowu mearutorumode iwuge eparu tabo jamedu.
source: – Imagore eparu tabo awagai toro baru to. Emode boe eruduwado iwadaru ji dukodire boe emearutorumode i rugadu. Imagore nowu mearutorumode iwuge eparu tabo jamedu.

b: Imagore eparu tabo emearudae pemegawo puapo, emearudaewo nono pamearudae dumogadure. Aragojere itabo. Iragojere akabo jamedu. Paedure puapo. Pawiapagare tu pu bataru ji. Dukodire pamearudae ure mitotu je. Itaidure awu mearutorure iwuge eduwo pagabo emearudae pemegawo puapo nono pamearudae mogadure. Ia boe erudumode nowu boe emearudae pemegare puapo duji dukeje emearutorumode i are itarego moto ka duji rugadu.

b: Are iro rakado woe moto keje. Are iro pemegado woe moto keje jamedu. Dukodire boe erudure ipemegare rugadu duji. Ca ire awu iro rakarewu maku awu mearutorure iwuge etai. Dukodire boe erudumode mearutorure iwuge epemegare duji jamedu. Nono emearudae pemegamode puapo nono pamearudae dumogadure rugadu. Ikare imearudae udo tuginai apiji. Akare amearudae udo tuginai ipiji jamedu. Nono are iraga maku inai. Imode mearutorure iwuge eragado jamedu. Nono emodukare tumearudae udo tuginai pubiji jamedu. Nono boe eiamedu boe erudure nowu mearutorure iwuge emearudae pemegare puapo duji dukeje emearutorumode i, are itarego moto ka duji rugadu. Eruduwamode amearudu kurire nowu mearutorure iwugei duji jamedu. Amearudu kurire ei nono amearudu kurire i dumogadure.

b: – Iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Are nowu mearutorure iwuge emagu inai. Dukodire itaidure eduwo itabo toro imugurewu keje. Eragojemode itabo dukeje erudumode iragare boe jamedu boe jituji, erudumode boe pemegare irore jiboe ji. Are iraga maku inai marigudu. Are boe pemegado i marigudu. Akare moto to raga mare are iraga maku inai marigudu. Are boe pemegado i marigudu jamedu. Mare paga karega. Amearudu kurire i dukodire aroino i.

b: Iogwa Kurirewunure aki kodi. Apemegare rugadu. Mearutorukare iwuge eruduwakare ai. Mare imire ioruduware ai rugadu. Awu mearutorure iwuge eruduware ai are itudo mato duji.

b: Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji

b: Jesus ure nowu baru towu tuwadaru iado dukeje uture pugeje ture joruduwadowugebo. Ekurugodure pobo kajeje. Nou pobo iere Cedrom. Nono etaregodure nowu oliveira iguru ka.

source: Judas Iscariotes joruduware nowu oliveira iguruji. Marigudu Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu oliveira iguru jeturewu ka tu tu je. Dukodire Judas Iscariotes joruduware eragojere nono duji. Meardaere tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai nowu tugobaigarege etai jamedu.

b: Dukodire nowu Judas Iscariotes uture nowu oliveira iguru ka Roma kejewu tugobaigaregebo. Eture jorugu tabo jamedu tuiorudu pemegawo awara ji.

b: Simão Pedro iedure ia tariga kurirewuji. Ure tawuje tuia piji dukeje ure ia imedu bija kado. Nou imedu iere Malco. Maragodure nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ai. Nou imedu ukana pemegarewu jagwaiwu bijare ure kado.

Judeu doge eimijerage ere tudo turugadu tuwaduwo nowu tuwadaeji nowu meri keje dukodire ekare turemo nowu boe eimijera uwaito. Judeu karegure ema dukodi. Emode turemo ia boe tuginaiwuge ewaito dukeje epemegamodukare turowo to bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Dukodire ewadumodukare nowu tuwadaeji pugeje. Enogwagemodukare nowu Páscoa jiwu boe ekeji pugeje. Mare eno bakaru tadawu boe ero reo. Dukodire ekare turemo nowu Roma eimijera uwaito.

b: Imire iorudure awu inagore jiboe ji ioku tabo. Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Iwadrarodukaregure. Dukodire ire bu bapera keje aino.
source: Imire iorudure awu inagore jiboe ji ioku tabo. Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Iwadrarodukaregure. Dukodire ire bu bapera keje aino.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore nuba boe mode Jesus ji rugadu. Akore Jesus ra kadodumodukaie rugadu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore nuba boe mode Jesus ji rugadu. Akore Jesus ra kadodumodukaie rugadu.

b: Akore boe emoduie rago tugu to rugadu. Boe erudumoduie ere rago tugu to duji rugadu. Aino care nowu Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe rugadu boe jeture pudui rugadu.
source: Akore boe emoduie rago tugu to rugadu. Boe erudumoduie ere rago tugu to duji rugadu. Aino care nowu Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe rugadu boe jeture pudui rugadu.

b: Boe Ere Jesus Tugu Mototo
source: Boe Ere Jesus Tugu Mototo

b: Dukejere José makore Pilatoji Jesus bagai tuwo Jesus tugu mototo. Nou José boture Arimatéia ba kurirewu keje. Mearutorure Jesus ji mare ukare boe ewie. Pagudure Judeu doge eimijeragece kodi. Dukodire readodukare boe ewiagai tumearutorure Jesus jituji. Ca Pilatos makore nowu Joseji uie turugadu uwo tugeragu Jesus ji uwo tugu mototo. Dukodire José ure tugeragu Jesus ji.
source: Dukejere José makore Pilatoji Jesus bagai tuwo Jesus tugu mototo. Nou José boture Arimatéia ba kurirewu keje. Mearutorure Jesus ji mare ukare boe ewie. Pagudure Judeu doge eimijeragece kodi. Dukodire readodukare boe ewiagai tumearutorure Jesus jituji. Ca Pilatos makore nowu Joseji uie turugadu uwo tugeragu Jesus ji uwo tugu mototo. Dukodire José ure tugeragu Jesus ji.

b: Imedu Nicodemos uture José apo. Nou Nicodemos uture Jesus ae boeco ji marigudu tuioruduwawo Jesus bataru ji. Aino care uture roreboe tabo tuwo reko Jesus biri joki. Nou roreboe motudu oto padure trinta e cinco quilos.
source: Imedu Nicodemos uture José apo. Nou Nicodemos uture Jesus ae boeco ji marigudu tuioruduwawo Jesus bataru ji. Aino care uture roreboe tabo tuwo reko Jesus biri joki. Nou roreboe motudu oto padure trinta e cinco quilos.

b: Nou ime pobedu doge ere tugeragu birewu Jesus ji. Ere nowu roreboe reko biri joki nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Ere upodo areia tabo nono turo mogadure tuwo tugu mototo.
source: Nou ime pobedu doge ere tugeragu birewu Jesus ji. Ere nowu roreboe reko biri joki nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Ere upodo areia tabo nono turo mogadure tuwo tugu mototo.

b: Boe ere Jesus bitowu kejere nouia iguru jeture nono. Puredure nono ere Jesus bitowuji. Nou iguru tadare ia tori poro mugure nono. Boe ere nowu tori porodo tuwo birewuge etugu to. Mare ekare ia birewu tugu to raga ji aino.
source: Boe ere Jesus bitowu kejere nouia iguru jeture nono. Puredure nono ere Jesus bitowuji. Nou iguru tadare ia tori poro mugure nono. Boe ere nowu tori porodo tuwo birewuge etugu to. Mare ekare ia birewu tugu to raga ji aino.

b: Barogwato Judeu doge emaragodumodukare dukodire akere ei tuwo boe jamedu iado nowu meri ji rugadu. Aino merirekodure ei dukodire nowu ime pobedu doge ere Jesus tugu nowu tori poroto rugadu.
source: Barogwato Judeu doge emaragodumodukare dukodire akere ei tuwo boe jamedu iado nowu meri ji rugadu. Aino merirekodure ei dukodire nowu ime pobedu doge ere Jesus tugu nowu tori poroto rugadu.

b: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje
source: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje

b: Domingo meri ji ca boecoto Maria Madalena uture ere Jesus tugu towu tori poro ka. Aregodure toro dukeje jorudure tori baiporo jadodure duji. Boe ere Jesus tugu to dukeje ere ia tori kurirewu bu nowu tori poro je keje tuwo nowu tori poro miwuje. Macare nowu tori padukare tumuga keje pugeje. Nou tori poro jadodure rugadu.
source: Domingo meri ji ca boecoto Maria Madalena uture ere Jesus tugu towu tori poro ka. Aregodure toro dukeje jorudure tori baiporo jadodure duji. Boe ere Jesus tugu to dukeje ere ia tori kurirewu bu nowu tori poro je keje tuwo nowu tori poro miwuje. Macare nowu tori padukare tumuga keje pugeje. Nou tori poro jadodure rugadu.

b: Nono Maria Madalena rekodure nowu tori poro piji Simão Pedro bagai, nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu bagai jamedu. Jesus mearudu kurire nouia ture joruduwadowu imeduji. Maria Madalena aregodure etae dukeje makore ei. Akore ia boe ere tugeragu Pagimijeraji nowu tori poro piji. Paruduwakare kaiba padure pugeje.
source: Nono Maria Madalena rekodure nowu tori poro piji Simão Pedro bagai, nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu bagai jamedu. Jesus mearudu kurire nouia ture joruduwadowu imeduji. Maria Madalena aregodure etae dukeje makore ei. Akore ia boe ere tugeragu Pagimijeraji nowu tori poro piji. Paruduwakare kaiba padure pugeje.

b: Maria makore aino ei dukeje nowu ime pobedu doge eregodure toro tori poro ka.
source: Maria makore aino ei dukeje nowu ime pobedu doge eregodure toro tori poro ka.

b: Eregodure rugadu. Nou metia aregodure boeto ji.
source: Eregodure rugadu. Nou metia aregodure boeto ji.

b: Aiwore nowu tori poroto. Ukare turemo tori poroto mare jorudure nowu upore Jesus apowu areiaji.
source: Aiwore nowu tori poroto. Ukare turemo tori poroto mare jorudure nowu upore Jesus apowu areiaji.

b: Dukejere Simão Pedro aregodure jamedu. Ure turemo krai je. Jorudure nowu upore Jesus apowu areiaji jamedu.
source: Dukejere Simão Pedro aregodure jamedu. Ure turemo krai je. Jorudure nowu upore Jesus apowu areiaji jamedu.

b: Jorudure nowu upore Jesus aora tabowu areiaji jamedu. Padure nouia upore apowu areia meki. Mare erudukare Jesus ji.
source: Jorudure nowu upore Jesus aora tabowu areiaji jamedu. Padure nouia upore apowu areia meki. Mare erudukare Jesus ji.

b: Nono nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure turemo jamedu. Emare aregodure nowu tori poro ka boeto ji. Aiwore mare jorudukare Jesus ji jamedu. Nono mearutorure Jesus jewodure pugeje duji.
source: Nono nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure turemo jamedu. Emare aregodure nowu tori poro ka boeto ji. Aiwore mare jorudukare Jesus ji jamedu. Nono mearutorure Jesus jewodure pugeje duji.

b: Pao Kurirewu makore marigudu Jesus jewodumoduie pugeje. Mare nowu ime eruduwakare raga nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Pao Kurirewu makore marigudu Jesus jewodumoduie pugeje. Mare nowu ime eruduwakare raga nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Nono nowu ime pobedu doge ere tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka.
source: Nono nowu ime pobedu doge ere tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka.

b: Jesus Ure Maria Madalena Jorududo Pudui
source: Jesus Ure Maria Madalena Jorududo Pudui

b: Maria rakoje puredure nowu tori baiporoji pugeje. Ragudu kimore rugadu. Dukeje ure tumegido taiwowo nowu tori poro ka.
source: Maria rakoje puredure nowu tori baiporoji pugeje. Ragudu kimore rugadu. Dukeje ure tumegido taiwowo nowu tori poro ka.

b: Aiwore dukeje jorudure ime pobedu dogei. Mare ime karega. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge eire jorudure. Emugure nono nowu tori poro tada nowu Jesus padure kejewu tori keje. Jesus padukare nono pugeje mare nowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emugure nono. Ia mugure Jesus aora jagwai. Nouia okwacere bure jagwai.
source: Aiwore dukeje jorudure ime pobedu dogei. Mare ime karega. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge eire jorudure. Emugure nono nowu tori poro tada nowu Jesus padure kejewu tori keje. Jesus padukare nono pugeje mare nowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emugure nono. Ia mugure Jesus aora jagwai. Nouia okwacere bure jagwai.

b: Emagore Maria ji. egore are! Kodiba akragudure? Maria makore ei. Akore ia boe ere tugeragu ikimijeraji awu tori poro piji. Ioruduwakare kaiba ere tugu pugeje.
source: Emagore Maria ji. egore are! Kodiba akragudure? Maria makore ei. Akore ia boe ere tugeragu ikimijeraji awu tori poro piji. Ioruduwakare kaiba ere tugu pugeje.

b: Nono Maria ure tumegido pugeje nowu tori poro piji. Nono jorudure Jesus ji nono. Mare joruduwakare Jesus ure ema duji.
source: Nono Maria ure tumegido pugeje nowu tori poro piji. Nono jorudure Jesus ji nono. Mare joruduwakare Jesus ure ema duji.

b: Jesus makore Maria ji. Akore are! Kodiba akragudure? Ioguduba bagaiba akaiwore? Maria joruduwakare raga Jesus nuie ema duji. Meardaere maragodure boepa jiwu utugare nuie ema. Dukodire makore ji Jesus bagai. Akore aki na are akeragu Jesus ji? Kaiba are tugu pugeje? Ioruduwado ituwo bagai.
source: Jesus makore Maria ji. Akore are! Kodiba akragudure? Ioguduba bagaiba akaiwore? Maria joruduwakare raga Jesus nuie ema duji. Meardaere maragodure boepa jiwu utugare nuie ema. Dukodire makore ji Jesus bagai. Akore aki na are akeragu Jesus ji? Kaiba are tugu pugeje? Ioruduwado ituwo bagai.

b: Nono Jesus makore Maria ieji. Akore Maria. Makore tugie jitu keje care Maria joruduware Jesus ure ema duji rugadu. Dukodire uture ae. Nono Maria makore aramaico bataru tabo. Akore Rabôni! Maria makore tuwadaru tabo mare Imedu Joruduwarewu jire akoino.
source: Nono Jesus makore Maria ieji. Akore Maria. Makore tugie jitu keje care Maria joruduware Jesus ure ema duji rugadu. Dukodire uture ae. Nono Maria makore aramaico bataru tabo. Akore Rabôni! Maria makore tuwadaru tabo mare Imedu Joruduwarewu jire akoino.

b: Jesus makore Maria ji pugeje. Akore akaba akeragu i. Irudukare raga Iogwa Kurirewu ae. Ca atudo toro ire joruduwadowuge etae awo ewie. Imode ikirimi Iogwa Kurirewu ae duji. Iogwa Kurirewu Etuo Kurirewunure ema jamedu. Pao Kurirewunure ema rugadu.
source: Jesus makore Maria ji pugeje. Akore akaba akeragu i. Irudukare raga Iogwa Kurirewu ae. Ca atudo toro ire joruduwadowuge etae awo ewie. Imode ikirimi Iogwa Kurirewu ae duji. Iogwa Kurirewu Etuo Kurirewunure ema jamedu. Pao Kurirewunure ema rugadu.

b: Dukodire Maria Madalena uture nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae. Ure ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Ure ewie Jesus makore pudui duji rugadu.
source: Dukodire Maria Madalena uture nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae. Ure ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Ure ewie Jesus makore pudui duji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Erududo Pudui
source: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Erududo Pudui

b: Nou Domingo meri ji boeco ji Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere bato pui ia bai ja tada. Ere baiporo rugadu miwuje pudui epagudure Judeu doge eimijeragece dukodi. Dukeje Jesus jepadure taci etoiado nowu bai ja tada. Makore ei. Akore itaregodure pugeje.
source: Nou Domingo meri ji boeco ji Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere bato pui ia bai ja tada. Ere baiporo rugadu miwuje pudui epagudure Judeu doge eimijeragece dukodi. Dukeje Jesus jepadure taci etoiado nowu bai ja tada. Makore ei. Akore itaregodure pugeje.

b: Nono Jesus ure erududo tugeraji. Ure erududo tiaporoji. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu rago oiaji japoroto. Erudure nowu meriri oiaji ierato. Dukodire eruduware emaie rugadu duji. Dukodire egarere Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus ure erududo tugeraji. Ure erududo tiaporoji. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu rago oiaji japoroto. Erudure nowu meriri oiaji ierato. Dukodire eruduware emaie rugadu duji. Dukodire egarere Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore tamororamagadukaba. Iogwa Kurirewu ure itarego mato tawagai. Nono imode tadudo boe ewagai jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore tamororamagadukaba. Iogwa Kurirewu ure itarego mato tawagai. Nono imode tadudo boe ewagai jamedu.

b: Nono Jesus ure togwamu ei. Dukejere akore Ca Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode turawuje tagae dukeje tagaba utudo tabiji.
source: Nono Jesus ure togwamu ei. Dukejere akore Ca Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode turawuje tagae dukeje tagaba utudo tabiji.

b: Boe ekiarigodumode turo pegarewu ji dukeje tawiagodumode ero pegarewu piji. Nono Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ero pegarewu piji jamedu. Mare ia boe ekiarigodumodukare turo pegarewu ji dukeje tawiagodumodukare ero pegarewu piji jamedu. Nono Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare ero pegarewu piji jamedu.
source: Boe ekiarigodumode turo pegarewu ji dukeje tawiagodumode ero pegarewu piji. Nono Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ero pegarewu piji jamedu. Mare ia boe ekiarigodumodukare turo pegarewu ji dukeje tawiagodumodukare ero pegarewu piji jamedu. Nono Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare ero pegarewu piji jamedu.

b: Tomé Jorudure Jesus ji
source: Tomé Jorudure Jesus ji

b: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu iere Tomé. Iere Dídimo jamedu. Metage eiamedu boe eragojere nono kodire erudure Jesus ji. Mare emare rakojekare nono kodire jorudukare Jesus ji.
source: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu iere Tomé. Iere Dídimo jamedu. Metage eiamedu boe eragojere nono kodire erudure Jesus ji. Mare emare rakojekare nono kodire jorudukare Jesus ji.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere Tomé bie. egore cerudure Jesus ji rugadu! Mare Tomé akore Imearutorukare. Iorudumode enoe oiaji Jesus ierato dukeje imode ikera reko nowu epaeji. Nono imearutorumode emaie rugadu duji. Iorudumode japoroji dukeje imode ikera reko ji jamedu. Nono imearutorumode emaie rugadu duji. Mare iorudumodukare dukeje imearutorumodukare rugadu.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere Tomé bie. egore cerudure Jesus ji rugadu! Mare Tomé akore Imearutorukare. Iorudumode enoe oiaji Jesus ierato dukeje imode ikera reko nowu epaeji. Nono imearutorumode emaie rugadu duji. Iorudumode japoroji dukeje imode ikera reko ji jamedu. Nono imearutorumode emaie rugadu duji. Mare iorudumodukare dukeje imearutorumodukare rugadu.

b: Semanare mito ei pugeje dukeje nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eragojere ia bai ja tada. Ere baiporo miwuje pudui rugadu. Tomé rakojere ebo. Ma care Jesus aregodure kuri etae. Rakojere nono ebo dukeje makore ei. Akore itaregodu.
source: Semanare mito ei pugeje dukeje nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eragojere ia bai ja tada. Ere baiporo miwuje pudui rugadu. Tomé rakojere ebo. Ma care Jesus aregodure kuri etae. Rakojere nono ebo dukeje makore ei. Akore itaregodu.

b: Nono Jesus makore Toméji. Akore akera reko ikeraji. Akera reko iaporoji jamedu. Akaiwodo ikeraji. Imi rugadu reo! Amororamagadukaba i pugeje aruduwawo rugadu imire iroino duji. Amearutorudo i.
source: Nono Jesus makore Toméji. Akore akera reko ikeraji. Akera reko iaporoji jamedu. Akaiwodo ikeraji. Imi rugadu reo! Amororamagadukaba i pugeje aruduwawo rugadu imire iroino duji. Amearutorudo i.

b: Nono Tomé makogodure ji. Akore ikimijera kurirewunure aki. Pao Kurirewunure aki. Imearutorumode ai rugadu.
source: Nono Tomé makogodure ji. Akore ikimijera kurirewunure aki. Pao Kurirewunure aki. Imearutorumode ai rugadu.

b: Jesus akore arudure i dukeje amearutorure i rugadu. Mare iage erudumodukare i mare du inodu tabo emearutorumode i rugadu. Dukodire boe pemegamode ei rugadu egarewo pudui rugadu.
source: Jesus akore arudure i dukeje amearutorure i rugadu. Mare iage erudumodukare i mare du inodu tabo emearutorumode i rugadu. Dukodire boe pemegamode ei rugadu egarewo pudui rugadu.

b: João Ure Awu Pao Kurirewu Bataru Bu Bapera Keje
source: João Ure Awu Pao Kurirewu Bataru Bu Bapera Keje

b: Jesus ro rakare rugadu. Ure joruduwadowuge erudure Jesus rore jiboe ji. Ire Jesus ro rakare jiboe bu awu bapera keje mare boe jamedu karega.
source: Jesus ro rakare rugadu. Ure joruduwadowuge erudure Jesus rore jiboe ji. Ire Jesus ro rakare jiboe bu awu bapera keje mare boe jamedu karega.

b: Mare ire awu Jesus bataru bu bapera keje mare boe emearutoruwo Jesus ji rugadu du bagai. Umode boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure ema rugadu. Boe emearutorumode ji dukeje emugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.
source: Mare ire awu Jesus bataru bu bapera keje mare boe emearutoruwo Jesus ji rugadu du bagai. Umode boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure ema rugadu. Boe emearutorumode ji dukeje emugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Ia Ture Joruduwadowuge Erududo Pudui Pugeje
source: Jesus Ure Ia Ture Joruduwadowuge Erududo Pudui Pugeje

b: Jesus ure ia ture joruduwadowuge erududo pudui pugeje Galiléia pobo maerewu okwai. Nou pobo maerewu iere Tiberíades jamedu.
source: Jesus ure ia ture joruduwadowuge erududo pudui pugeje Galiléia pobo maerewu okwai. Nou pobo maerewu iere Tiberíades jamedu.

b: Simão Pedro, Tomé, Natã, ere bato pui nono. Zebedeu ore ime pobedu doge eragojere nono ebo jamedu. Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eragojere nono jamedu. Ere pobe.
source: Simão Pedro, Tomé, Natã, ere bato pui nono. Zebedeu ore ime pobedu doge eragojere nono ebo jamedu. Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eragojere nono jamedu. Ere pobe.

b: Jesus rakojekare ebo raga mare Pedro makore ei. Akore Pawoguwo. egore uu. Pawoguwo. Nono ere taredo to ika kurirewuto dukeje ewogure. Mare nowu boeco ji ekare boe bito jii toro barogwakododu ka.
source: Jesus rakojekare ebo raga mare Pedro makore ei. Akore Pawoguwo. egore uu. Pawoguwo. Nono ere taredo to ika kurirewuto dukeje ewogure. Mare nowu boeco ji ekare boe bito jii toro barogwakododu ka.

b: Barogwakododure dukeje Jesus rakojere nono kugaru keje pobo maerewu okwai. Ure joruduwadowuge etaiwo jaere toro ae ika kurirewu piji. Erudure ji mare eruduwakare ji.
source: Barogwakododure dukeje Jesus rakojere nono kugaru keje pobo maerewu okwai. Ure joruduwadowuge etaiwo jaere toro ae ika kurirewu piji. Erudure ji mare eruduwakare ji.

b: Jesus unaragodure ei ere boe bito dubagai. Akore tare boe bito? egore boro! Cegare boe bito rugadu!
source: Jesus unaragodure ei ere boe bito dubagai. Akore tare boe bito? egore boro! Cegare boe bito rugadu!

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore tawuge barigu tagana pemegarewu jagwai. Nono tamode tageragu karei rugadu. Dukodire ere tuwuge barigu tugana pemegarewu jagwai. Ca eroiwakare tuwo tuwuge tawuje pobo piji. Motudure rugadu karebo.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore tawuge barigu tagana pemegarewu jagwai. Nono tamode tageragu karei rugadu. Dukodire ere tuwuge barigu tugana pemegarewu jagwai. Ca eroiwakare tuwo tuwuge tawuje pobo piji. Motudure rugadu karebo.

b: Nou Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu ure joruduwadowu makore Pedro ji. Akore Pagimijeranure ema rugadu. Pedro mearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje ure tugudau areia biaku epa tugu pudui dukeje ure taredo poboto ika piji. Nou pobo maerewu po kokare nono dukodire Pedro aregodure nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka.
source: Nou Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu ure joruduwadowu makore Pedro ji. Akore Pagimijeranure ema rugadu. Pedro mearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje ure tugudau areia biaku epa tugu pudui dukeje ure taredo poboto ika piji. Nou pobo maerewu po kokare nono dukodire Pedro aregodure nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka.

b: Edu jaere pobo okwa jitu oto padure cem metros. Nono nouia ure joruduwadowuge eture ika kurirewu tabo pobo okwa ka. Ere tumugudo nowu tuwuge keje nowu karebo.
source: Edu jaere pobo okwa jitu oto padure cem metros. Nono nouia ure joruduwadowuge eture ika kurirewu tabo pobo okwa ka. Ere tumugudo nowu tuwuge keje nowu karebo.

b: Etaregodure dukeje ere tudawuje nowu ika kurirewu piji. Dukejere erudure Jesus ji nono. Erudure joruji, kare epadure joradu keje duji jamedu. Ia amirewu padure joradu keje jamedu. Jesus maragodae reo.
source: Etaregodure dukeje ere tudawuje nowu ika kurirewu piji. Dukejere erudure Jesus ji nono. Erudure joruji, kare epadure joradu keje duji jamedu. Ia amirewu padure joradu keje jamedu. Jesus maragodae reo.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore mato ia tare bitowu karebo itae.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore mato ia tare bitowu karebo itae.

b: Simão Pedro ure tugirimi ika ka pugeje kare ewagai. Ure nowu buke tawuje ika piji. Ure reko pobo okwa ka. Nou buke korobadure kare kurirewugebo. Kare enodo padure kejeboere cento e cinquenta e cinco nowu buke tada. Mare buke ukare tuwowuje ebo.
source: Simão Pedro ure tugirimi ika ka pugeje kare ewagai. Ure nowu buke tawuje ika piji. Ure reko pobo okwa ka. Nou buke korobadure kare kurirewugebo. Kare enodo padure kejeboere cento e cinquenta e cinco nowu buke tada. Mare buke ukare tuwowuje ebo.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore mato. Tagwagewo. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarakare Jesus ie bagai. Eruduware ure ema duji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore mato. Tagwagewo. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarakare Jesus ie bagai. Eruduware ure ema duji rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu amirewu ji dukeje ure maku nowu ture joruduwadowuge etai. Nono ure kare emagu etai jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu amirewu ji dukeje ure maku nowu ture joruduwadowuge etai. Nono ure kare emagu etai jamedu.

b: Ainore Jesus rore tuwo nowu ture joruduwadowuge erududo pudui. Tiewodure dukodi rugadu.
source: Ainore Jesus rore tuwo nowu ture joruduwadowuge erududo pudui. Tiewodure dukodi rugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Pedro ji
source: Jesus Makore Pedro ji

b: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus makore Simão Pedro ji. Akore akiere Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Aki na amearudu kurire i rugadu awu amedage epiji? Pedro akore Ikimijeranure aki rugadu. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Jesus akore aetu pemegado inagu carneiro dogei. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge eire inagoino.
source: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus makore Simão Pedro ji. Akore akiere Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Aki na amearudu kurire i rugadu awu amedage epiji? Pedro akore Ikimijeranure aki rugadu. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Jesus akore aetu pemegado inagu carneiro dogei. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge eire inagoino.

b: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Aki na amearudu kurire i rugadu? Pedro akore Uu. Ikimijeranure aki. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Jesus akore aetu pemegado inagu carneiro dogei. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge eire inagoino.
source: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Aki na amearudu kurire i rugadu? Pedro akore Uu. Ikimijeranure aki. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Jesus akore aetu pemegado inagu carneiro dogei. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge eire inagoino.

b: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Amearudu kurire i na? Jesus makore aino pugeje dukodire Pedro kiarigodure rugadu. Akore ikimijeranure aki rugadu. Aruduware boe jamedu boe ji. Imearudu kurire ai duji. Jesus akore aetu pemegado inagu carneiro dogei. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge eire inagoino.
source: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore Simão. João onaregedunure aki. Amearudu kurire i na? Jesus makore aino pugeje dukodire Pedro kiarigodure rugadu. Akore ikimijeranure aki rugadu. Aruduware boe jamedu boe ji. Imearudu kurire ai duji. Jesus akore aetu pemegado inagu carneiro dogei. Mare carneiro dogei karega inagoino. Mearutorure iwuge eire inagoino.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino ai. Iparedure aki dukeje are arugadu atuwo akaidure jiboe ka. Mare apegagodumode dukeje ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu ai tuwo akana raido tuwo akera kogudo rugadu tuwo atudo taidure jiboe ka tuwo awido.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino ai. Iparedure aki dukeje are arugadu atuwo akaidure jiboe ka. Mare apegagodumode dukeje ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu ai tuwo akana raido tuwo akera kogudo rugadu tuwo atudo taidure jiboe ka tuwo awido.

b: Jesus akoino dutabo ure Pedro bie ro pegarewuge eromoduie jitu duji. Ro pegarewuge emoduie Pedro bito mare du inodu tabo Pedro umodukaie tugera ra tumearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu piji rugadu. Dukodire boe eruduwamoduie Pao Kurirewu pemegare rugadu duji. Emoduie Pao Kurirewu ie kurido rugadu duji. Care Jesus makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore mato itabo.
source: Jesus akoino dutabo ure Pedro bie ro pegarewuge eromoduie jitu duji. Ro pegarewuge emoduie Pedro bito mare du inodu tabo Pedro umodukaie tugera ra tumearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu piji rugadu. Dukodire boe eruduwamoduie Pao Kurirewu pemegare rugadu duji. Emoduie Pao Kurirewu ie kurido rugadu duji. Care Jesus makore Pedro ji pugeje. Akore mato itabo.

b: Pedro Aidure Tuioruduwawo Nuba Boemode Nouia Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuji
source: Pedro Aidure Tuioruduwawo Nuba Boemode Nouia Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuji

b: Pedro ure tumegido dukeje jorudure nowu Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu imeduji. Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedunure ema jamedu. Marigudu Jesus okwagere nowu ture joruduwadowugebo boeco ji dukeje nowu ure joruduwadowu ure tuburedo Jesus ji tunaragoduwo Jesus ji nuburewu imedu koiaba umode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Nou Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu imedu emare unarare Jesus ji marigudu.
source: Pedro ure tumegido dukeje jorudure nowu Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu imeduji. Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedunure ema jamedu. Marigudu Jesus okwagere nowu ture joruduwadowugebo boeco ji dukeje nowu ure joruduwadowu ure tuburedo Jesus ji tunaragoduwo Jesus ji nuburewu imedu koiaba umode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Nou Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu imedu emare unarare Jesus ji marigudu.

b: Aino care Pedro jorudure nowu Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu imeduji dukeje makore Jesus ji. Akore nuba boemode awu pamediaji?
source: Aino care Pedro jorudure nowu Jesus mearudu kurire jiwu imeduji dukeje makore Jesus ji. Akore nuba boemode awu pamediaji?

b: Jesus akore Itaidumodukare bikawo jii toro itaregodure du ka du bimodukare rugadu. Mare a m o r o r a m a g a d u k a b a b a g a i . Amearutorudo imagore jiboe ji rugadu.
source: Jesus akore Itaidumodukare bikawo jii toro itaregodure du ka du bimodukare rugadu. Mare a m o r o r a m a g a d u k a b a b a g a i . Amearutorudo imagore jiboe ji rugadu.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emearudaere Jesus makore nowu tumearudu kurire jiwu imedu bimodukaie duji. Mare makokare aino. Akore itaidumodukare bikawo dukeje bimodukare rugadu.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emearudaere Jesus makore nowu tumearudu kurire jiwu imedu bimodukaie duji. Mare makokare aino. Akore itaidumodukare bikawo dukeje bimodukare rugadu.

b: Ire Jesus akoino. Imire ikiere João. Jesus ure joruduwadowunure imi. Imagore awu Jesus rore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Ire bu bapera keje jamedu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai.
source: Ire Jesus akoino. Imire ikiere João. Jesus ure joruduwadowunure imi. Imagore awu Jesus rore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Ire bu bapera keje jamedu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino tawiagai.

b: Jesus rore ia turoji jamedu. Mare bapera kurimode rugadu boe ewo Jesus rore jiboe makore jiboe jamedu boe bu nowu bapera keje. Boe mode bataru jamedu bu bapera keje dukeje kodumode awu moto kori rugadu.
source: Jesus rore ia turoji jamedu. Mare bapera kurimode rugadu boe ewo Jesus rore jiboe makore jiboe jamedu boe bu nowu bapera keje. Boe mode bataru jamedu bu bapera keje dukeje kodumode awu moto kori rugadu.

b: Ainore Jesus Ure Tugeragu Jiwuge Erore. Lucas Ure Bu Bapera Keje.
source: Ainore Jesus Ure Tugeragu Jiwuge Erore. Lucas Ure Bu Bapera Keje.

b: Imedia Teófilonure aki. Ire atugoreboe maku akai marigudu iwo awie Jesus rore jiboe ji, ure boe eruduwado jiboe ji. Aino inure ia atugoreboe pemegado pugeje iwo awie boe jamedu boe ji. Nou atugo padure bapera kejewu boeto jiwu tabore ire awie nuba Jesus rore tuwo tumaragodae towuje. Ire aruduwado ruture baru to duji. Ruture ceboje mare ure tugeragu jiwu ime ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakarewu makudumode tagai duji. Ure tugeragu nowu imei tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe eiamedu boe ewagai.
source: Imedia Teófilonure aki. Ire atugoreboe maku akai marigudu iwo awie Jesus rore jiboe ji, ure boe eruduwado jiboe ji. Aino inure ia atugoreboe pemegado pugeje iwo awie boe jamedu boe ji.
