b: Jesus bire dukeje jewodure pugeje. Nono meri oto padure 40 ji tumugui boe ebo dukeje. Nou ure tugeragu jiwuge erudure ji rugadu. Emare ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi duji. Erudure ji dukeje eruduware ure ema rugadu duji. Erudure roji dukeje eruduware ure ema rugadu duji. Dukodire eruduware rugadu Jesus jewodure pugeje duji.
source: Jesus bire dukeje jewodure pugeje. Nono meri oto padure 40 ji tumugui boe ebo dukeje. Nou ure tugeragu jiwuge erudure ji rugadu. Emare ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi duji. Erudure ji dukeje eruduware ure ema rugadu duji. Erudure roji dukeje eruduware ure ema rugadu duji. Dukodire eruduware rugadu Jesus jewodure pugeje duji.

b: Ere bato pui dukeje Jesus makore aino ei. Akore tadukaba Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji. Tabagado woe jao nowu imode maku tagaiboe bagai. Ire tawie marigudu. Pao Kurirewu umoduie Tuwari maku tagai. Tabagado bagai woe.
source: Ere bato pui dukeje Jesus makore aino ei. Akore tadukaba Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji. Tabagado woe jao nowu imode maku tagaiboe bagai. Ire tawie marigudu. Pao Kurirewu umoduie Tuwari maku tagai. Tabagado bagai woe.

b: João Batista ure boe etao pegodo pobo tabo. Mare kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari rawuje tagae metuwo tamearudae tada.
source: João Batista ure boe etao pegodo pobo tabo. Mare kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari rawuje tagae metuwo tamearudae tada.

b: Jesus Ruture Baruto
source: Jesus Ruture Baruto

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere bato pui Jesus apo dukeje enarare ji. egore amode Israel doge ekinorudo Roma kejewuge eimijera piji Israel doge eimijerawo aki woe Israel moto keje kuri aino na?
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere bato pui Jesus apo dukeje enarare ji. egore amode Israel doge ekinorudo Roma kejewuge eimijera piji Israel doge eimijerawo aki woe Israel moto keje kuri aino na?

b: Jesus akore Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduwamode turomode kejewu meri ji. Ema koiare umode boe eimijeragedo; umode boe eimijerage eraga tawuje epiji. Tagi taruduwamodukare kaba meri kejeba romode aino.
source: Jesus akore Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduwamode turomode kejewu meri ji. Ema koiare umode boe eimijeragedo; umode boe eimijerage eraga tawuje epiji. Tagi taruduwamodukare kaba meri kejeba romode aino.

b: Mare umode Tuwari maku tagai dukeje umode taraga maku tagai rugadu. Dukejere tamagomode boe ewiagai irore jiboe ji, imagore jiboe ji. Tamagomode boe ji woe Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje tu jao. Dukeje tamagomode boe ewiagai Judéia moto keje, Samaria moto keje. Dukeje tadumode awu bataru tabo moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Mare umode Tuwari maku tagai dukeje umode taraga maku tagai rugadu. Dukejere tamagomode boe ewiagai irore jiboe ji, imagore jiboe ji. Tamagomode boe ji woe Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje tu jao. Dukeje tamagomode boe ewiagai Judéia moto keje, Samaria moto keje. Dukeje tadumode awu bataru tabo moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Jesus akoino dukeje ruture baru to. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge erudure ji ruture duji. Etaiwore ji dukeje okware boetuguto.
source: Jesus akoino dukeje ruture baru to. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge erudure ji ruture duji. Etaiwore ji dukeje okware boetuguto.

b: Etaiwo kimore baru to dukeje ia baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu utugarege etaregodure etae taci je. Ekudau kigadure rugadu.
source: Etaiwo kimore baru to dukeje ia baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu utugarege etaregodure etae taci je. Ekudau kigadure rugadu.

b: Nono egore Galiléia kejewugenure tagi. Kodiba tagaiwo kimore baru to Jesus bagai? Tarudure Jesus ruture baru to duji. Dureore ia meri keje umode tugirimi tuibagi. Mare umode nono tumogadure.
source: Nono egore Galiléia kejewugenure tagi. Kodiba tagaiwo kimore baru to Jesus bagai? Tarudure Jesus ruture baru to duji. Dureore ia meri keje umode tugirimi tuibagi. Mare umode nono tumogadure.

b: Boe Ere Tugeragu Ia Imeduji Muguwo Judas Iscariotes Mugato
source: Boe Ere Tugeragu Ia Imeduji Muguwo Judas Iscariotes Mugato

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi tuibagi Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka Oliveira Ri piji. Jaere mare puredure du je jamedu.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi tuibagi Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka Oliveira Ri piji. Jaere mare puredure du je jamedu.

b: Ainore nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ekiere. Ia iere Pedro. Metia iere João. Ia iere Tiago. Metia iere André. Ia iere Filipe. Ia iere Tomé. Ia iere Bartolomeu. Ia iere Mateus. Iare Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Iere Tiago. Ia iere Simão Zelote. Iare Tiago onaregedunure ema. Iere Judas. Eiamedu boe ere turemo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewuto dukejere etaregodure tubadure kejewu bai ka.
source: Ainore nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ekiere. Ia iere Pedro. Metia iere João. Ia iere Tiago. Metia iere André. Ia iere Filipe. Ia iere Tomé. Ia iere Bartolomeu. Ia iere Mateus. Iare Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Iere Tiago. Ia iere Simão Zelote. Iare Tiago onaregedunure ema. Iere Judas. Eiamedu boe ere turemo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewuto dukejere etaregodure tubadure kejewu bai ka.

b: Nonore ere bato pui pu ae tumagowo baru to. Areme eture toro jamedu tumagowo baru to ebo. Jesus uce Maria uture toro jamedu. Jesus uwiemage eture toro jamedu.
source: Nonore ere bato pui pu ae tumagowo baru to. Areme eture toro jamedu tumagowo baru to ebo. Jesus uce Maria uture toro jamedu. Jesus uwiemage eture toro jamedu.

b: Ia meri keje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui. Enodo oto padure kejewure cento e vinte boe doge. Dukeje Pedro ure turagojedo etoiadada tumagowo ei.
source: Ia meri keje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui. Enodo oto padure kejewure cento e vinte boe doge. Dukeje Pedro ure turagojedo etoiadada tumagowo ei.

b: Akore imedagenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure jawu Israel doge eimijera Davi makodo. Davi makore nowu Judas Iscariotes romoduie aino duji, umoduie Jesus maku nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Akore imedagenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure jawu Israel doge eimijera Davi makodo. Davi makore nowu Judas Iscariotes romoduie aino duji, umoduie Jesus maku nowu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Judas Iscariotes tawujedure maragoduwo pagabo dukodire pamedia ure ema.
source: Judas Iscariotes tawujedure maragoduwo pagabo dukodire pamedia ure ema.

b: (Boe ere diero maku Judas Iscariotes ai ro pegawo aino. Nou diero tabore ure tugeragu ia moto ji pudai. Nou moto kejere nowu Judas ure tuwududo tori ao piji moto ka. Buture dukeje kurire tuborodo nono peguru jamedu boe ure tudawuje piji. Dukodi bire.
source: (Boe ere diero maku Judas Iscariotes ai ro pegawo aino. Nou diero tabore ure tugeragu ia moto ji pudai. Nou moto kejere nowu Judas ure tuwududo tori ao piji moto ka. Buture dukeje kurire tuborodo nono peguru jamedu boe ure tudawuje piji. Dukodi bire.

b: Jerusalém kejewuge eiamedu boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukodire ere nowu moto iedo: “Aceldama” aino. Israel doge ewadaru reno. Ainore nowu boe egore: “Boe eku jeture nowu moto keje”.)
source: Jerusalém kejewuge eiamedu boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukodire ere nowu moto iedo: “Aceldama” aino. Israel doge ewadaru reno. Ainore nowu boe egore: “Boe eku jeture nowu moto keje”.)

b: Pedro mako kimore. Akore Pagimijera kurirewu Davi ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje marigudu. Akore Boe edukare uwai tada. Boe emugumodukare uwai keje pugeje.” – Davi ure ia Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje jamedu. Akore Ia mugumode mugato maragoduwo maragodaeji.”
source: Pedro mako kimore. Akore Pagimijera kurirewu Davi ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje marigudu. Akore Boe edukare uwai tada. Boe emugumodukare uwai keje pugeje.” – Davi ure ia Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje jamedu. Akore Ia mugumode mugato maragoduwo maragodaeji.”

b: – Pao Kurirewu akore aino dukodire pawo pageragu ia jorudure Jesus jiwu imeduji maragoduwo pagabo uwo boe ewie Jesus jewoduie pugeje duji. Pawo pageragu jiwu rakojere Jesus apo. Pawo pageragu jiwu mearudure João Batista bataru ji jamedu. Pawo pageragu jiwu imedu merure paro kao Jesus rekodajiwu imeduji. Pawo pageragu jiwu jorudure Jesus ruture baru to duji.
source: – Pao Kurirewu akore aino dukodire pawo pageragu ia jorudure Jesus jiwu imeduji maragoduwo pagabo uwo boe ewie Jesus jewoduie pugeje duji. Pawo pageragu jiwu rakojere Jesus apo. Pawo pageragu jiwu mearudure João Batista bataru ji jamedu. Pawo pageragu jiwu imedu merure paro kao Jesus rekodajiwu imeduji. Pawo pageragu jiwu jorudure Jesus ruture baru to duji.

b: Dukodire nowu Pedro metage emagore ime ewagai. Ere pobetu je. Ia iere José. Metia iere Matias. Nou José iere Barsabás jamedu. Boe egore Justo aino ji jamedu.
source: Dukodire nowu Pedro metage emagore ime ewagai. Ere pobetu je. Ia iere José. Metia iere Matias. Nou José iere Barsabás jamedu. Boe egore Justo aino ji jamedu.

b: Ca nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagore baru to. egore cegimijeranure aki. Aki aruduware boe eiamedu boe emearudae ji. Ca cerududo akaidure jiwu imeduji maragoduwo cedabo Judas Iscariotes mugato. Utumode awadaru tabowu mode ema. Judas uture cebiji toro boe pegarewu ka turo pegarewu morice.
source: Ca nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagore baru to. egore cegimijeranure aki. Aki aruduware boe eiamedu boe emearudae ji. Ca cerududo akaidure jiwu imeduji maragoduwo cedabo Judas Iscariotes mugato. Utumode awadaru tabowu mode ema. Judas uture cebiji toro boe pegarewu ka turo pegarewu morice.

b: Dukejere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere nowu ime pobedu doge ekie bu ia torirogu keje. Nono ere nowu tori barigu. Dukejere etaiwore nowu toriji tuioruduwawo Jesus aidure jiwu imedu bagai. Jesus ure erududo nowu Matias ieji. Aino ere Matias mugudo Judas mugato tuwo uture Jesus bataru tabowuge enodo padudo doze pugeje.
source: Dukejere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere nowu ime pobedu doge ekie bu ia torirogu keje. Nono ere nowu tori barigu. Dukejere etaiwore nowu toriji tuioruduwawo Jesus aidure jiwu imedu bagai. Jesus ure erududo nowu Matias ieji. Aino ere Matias mugudo Judas mugato tuwo uture Jesus bataru tabowuge enodo padudo doze pugeje.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Aregodure
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Aregodure

b: Ia Judeu doge ewadae iere Pentecostes. Nou Pentecostes meri keje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui.
source: Ia Judeu doge ewadae iere Pentecostes. Nou Pentecostes meri keje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui.

b: Ca emearudure ia baru tadawu jaruruji. Jarurure nono bakuru rakarewu jaruru mogadure. Nou jaruru aregodure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edu tadawu bai ka. Ure turemo nowu baito. Jarurure ewai ja tada rugadu.
source: Ca emearudure ia baru tadawu jaruruji. Jarurure nono bakuru rakarewu jaruru mogadure. Nou jaruru aregodure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edu tadawu bai ka. Ure turemo nowu baito. Jarurure ewai ja tada rugadu.

b: Dukeje erudure iaboe ruguji. Ure nono joru mogadure mare joru karega. Ure nono boe ekeru mogadure mare boe ekeru karega. Ure taodo nono eiogi. Ure taodo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe eiogi.
source: Dukeje erudure iaboe ruguji. Ure nono joru mogadure mare joru karega. Ure nono boe ekeru mogadure mare boe ekeru karega. Ure taodo nono eiogi. Ure taodo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe eiogi.

b: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari meture eiamedu boebo. Dukodire emagore ia boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru tabo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari koiare ure emagodo nowu boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji aino.
source: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari meture eiamedu boebo. Dukodire emagore ia boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru tabo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari koiare ure emagodo nowu boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji aino.

b: Judeu doge etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka boe eno moto jamedu boe piji. Eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire etaregodure tuwaduwo nowu tuwadaeji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji.
source: Judeu doge etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka boe eno moto jamedu boe piji. Eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire etaregodure tuwaduwo nowu tuwadaeji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji.

b: Ewiapagare nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge egoino duji. Dukodire eture tuwo bato pui ebo tumearudu pemegawo emagore jiboe ji. Emagare. Egarere pudui eiamedu boe ewiapagare tuwadaru ji kodi. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagore nowu boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ewadaru tabo rugadu.
source: Ewiapagare nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge egoino duji. Dukodire eture tuwo bato pui ebo tumearudu pemegawo emagore jiboe ji. Emagare. Egarere pudui eiamedu boe ewiapagare tuwadaru ji kodi. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagore nowu boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ewadaru tabo rugadu.

b: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere nowu boe eku kidugo turoji dukodire egore awu makore ceiwuge Galiléia kejewugenure emage.

Mare kocare awu ime emagore aino pai pawadaru tabo. Emagore pai pawadaru tabo Pao Kurirewu ro kurire jiboe ji. Nuba erore tuioruduwawo aino pawadaru ji?

Mare kocare awu ime emagore aino pai pawadaru tabo. Emagore pai pawadaru tabo Pao Kurirewu ro kurire jiboe ji. Nuba erore tuioruduwawo aino pawadaru ji?

b: Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure rugadu. Eruduwakare kaboba ure aino duji. Enarare pui: – Nuba boe mode?
source: Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure rugadu. Eruduwakare kaboba ure aino duji. Enarare pui: – Nuba boe mode?

b: Pedro Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataruji Boe Ewiagai
source: Pedro Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataruji Boe Ewiagai

b: Dukeje nowu utumode Jesus bataru tabowuge ere turagojedo. Nono Pedro mako pemegare boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore Judeu dogenure tagi dukodire iwobenure tagi. Iwo tawie. Iwo nouia Jerusalém kejewuge ewie jamedu. Imode taruduwado awu boe erore jiboe ji. Tawiapagado iwadaru ji.
source: Dukeje nowu utumode Jesus bataru tabowuge ere turagojedo. Nono Pedro mako pemegare boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore Judeu dogenure tagi dukodire iwobenure tagi. Iwo tawie. Iwo nouia Jerusalém kejewuge ewie jamedu. Imode taruduwado awu boe erore jiboe ji. Tawiapagado iwadaru ji.

b: Tamearudaere awu boe doge eke kurure ei duji. Mare awu boe doge ekudukare piga kuruce. Meri kodu mai kimo.
source: Tamearudaere awu boe doge eke kurure ei duji. Mare awu boe doge ekudukare piga kuruce. Meri kodu mai kimo.

b: Mare erore nono makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Joel bataru mogadure. Ainore Joel akore:
source: Mare erore nono makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Joel bataru mogadure. Ainore Joel akore:

b: – Pao Kurirewu akore Imode moto akedudo. Du otodaire imode Iwari maku boe eiamedu boe etai. Tawobe ime, tawobe areme emagomode iwadaru ji boe ewiagai. Imode tawobe ipare erududo iwadaru ji. Ime pegagodurewuge eniamode iwadaru ji.
source: – Pao Kurirewu akore Imode moto akedudo. Du otodaire imode Iwari maku boe eiamedu boe etai. Tawobe ime, tawobe areme emagomode iwadaru ji boe ewiagai. Imode tawobe ipare erududo iwadaru ji. Ime pegagodurewuge eniamode iwadaru ji.

b: “Ainore umode rugadu. Imode Iwari maku itugarege ime etai, itugarege areme etai jamedu nowu moto akedumode kejewu meri otodai. Dukodire nowu ime nowu areme emagomode iwadaru ji.
source: “Ainore umode rugadu. Imode Iwari maku itugarege ime etai, itugarege areme etai jamedu nowu moto akedumode kejewu meri otodai. Dukodire nowu ime nowu areme emagomode iwadaru ji.

b: “Imode iro rakarewu to baru tada. Imode iro rakarewu to moto keje. Boe eku remode boe epiji. Joru, jeredudu umode tumaedo boe jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: “Imode iro rakarewu to baru tada. Imode iro rakarewu to moto keje. Boe eku remode boe epiji. Joru, jeredudu umode tumaedo boe jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: “Dukodire meri joku akedugodumode. Ari joku kujagumode nono boe ku kujagu mogadure. Dukejere Pagimijera Kurirewu aregodumode kejewu meri mode. Nou meri kurimode, pemegamode.
source: “Dukodire meri joku akedugodumode. Ari joku kujagumode nono boe ku kujagu mogadure. Dukejere Pagimijera Kurirewu aregodumode kejewu meri mode. Nou meri kurimode, pemegamode.

b: “Dukejere imode nowu makore Pagimijera bagaiwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore.
source: “Dukejere imode nowu makore Pagimijera bagaiwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore.

b: Ca Pedro makore pugeje. Akore iwobenure tagi. Israel dogenure tagi. Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji. Jesus ricodure Nazaré ba kurirewu keje. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu Jesus ro rakado, ro pemegado. Tarudure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji. Dukodire taruduware Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae.
source: Ca Pedro makore pugeje. Akore iwobenure tagi. Israel dogenure tagi. Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji. Jesus ricodure Nazaré ba kurirewu keje. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu Jesus ro rakado, ro pemegado. Tarudure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji. Dukodire taruduware Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae.

b: Pao Kurirewu mearudae reo. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu joruduware Jesus makudumode tagai tawo bito. Tagire tare bito. Tare ro pegarewuge edo Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
source: Pao Kurirewu mearudae reo. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu joruduware Jesus makudumode tagai tawo bito. Tagire tare bito. Tare ro pegarewuge edo Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje rugadu. Ure tawuje birewuge eda piji. Birewuge eda rakakare ji muguwo nono.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje rugadu. Ure tawuje birewuge eda piji. Birewuge eda rakakare ji muguwo nono.

b: Dujire nowu mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu akoino. Akore iorudure Pagimijera Kurirewu ji meri jamedu ji. Rakoje puredure i dukodire imororamagadukare.
source: Dujire nowu mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu akoino. Akore iorudure Pagimijera Kurirewu ji meri jamedu ji. Rakoje puredure i dukodire imororamagadukare.

b: – Dukodire iagarere i. Iwadaru jakarere. Imedunure imi. Iwimode. Mare ipagamode bagai dukodire iwudugugodumode.
source: – Dukodire iagarere i. Iwadaru jakarere. Imedunure imi. Iwimode. Mare ipagamode bagai dukodire iwudugugodumode.

b: – Pao Kurirewunure aki. Iwimode mare amodukare akera ra ipiji. Imearutorure awadaru ji kodi. Dukodire amode itawuje birewuge eda piji. Amode iewodudo pugeje dukodire iwiri guborogodumodukare moto tada.
source: – Pao Kurirewunure aki. Iwimode mare amodukare akera ra ipiji. Imearutorure awadaru ji kodi. Dukodire amode itawuje birewuge eda piji. Amode iewodudo pugeje dukodire iwiri guborogodumodukare moto tada.

b: – Are iorududo awara pemegarewu ji imugu pemegawo. Aragojere itabo dukodire iagarere i rugadu.
source: – Are iorududo awara pemegarewu ji imugu pemegawo. Aragojere itabo dukodire iagarere i rugadu.

b: Pedro mako kimore: – Imedagenure tagi. Imode taruduwa pemegado awu jawu pamana Davi bataru ji. Jao pawobe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Imode taruduwado bataru ji. Pudui karega akoino. Emare bire. Boe ere tugu mototo. Meture tadawu moto ure kimo jii aino.
source: Pedro mako kimore: – Imedagenure tagi. Imode taruduwa pemegado awu jawu pamana Davi bataru ji. Jao pawobe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Imode taruduwado bataru ji. Pudui karega akoino. Emare bire. Boe ere tugu mototo. Meture tadawu moto ure kimo jii aino.

b: Mare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ure bie marigudu. Akore tumoduie Davi ia uwobe Boe Eimijera Kurirewudo ema nono Davi umogadure. Akore tuwiagodumodukaie awu tuwadaru piji rugadu.
source: Mare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ure bie marigudu. Akore tumoduie Davi ia uwobe Boe Eimijera Kurirewudo ema nono Davi umogadure. Akore tuwiagodumodukaie awu tuwadaru piji rugadu.

b: Ca Davi mearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu ure Davi bie turomode jiboe ji. Dukodire Davi joruduware Pao Kurirewu romode jiboe ji. Joruduware Pao Kurirewu umode nowu umode boe ekinorudowu maku boe etai. Joruduware nowu umode boe ekinorudowu jewodumode pugeje duji. Dukodire akore aino: “Bimode mare Pao Kurirewu umodukare tugera ra piji. Umode tawuje birewuge eda piji. Umode jewodudo pugeje dukodire biri guborogodumodukare moto tada.”
source: Ca Davi mearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu ure Davi bie turomode jiboe ji. Dukodire Davi joruduware Pao Kurirewu romode jiboe ji. Joruduware Pao Kurirewu umode nowu umode boe ekinorudowu maku boe etai. Joruduware nowu umode boe ekinorudowu jewodumode pugeje duji. Dukodire akore aino: “Bimode mare Pao Kurirewu umodukare tugera ra piji. Umode tawuje birewuge eda piji. Umode jewodudo pugeje dukodire biri guborogodumodukare moto tada.”

b: – Jesus jire akoino. Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus jewodudo rugadu. Ceiamedu boe cerudure nowu Jesus jewodure duji.
source: – Jesus jire akoino. Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus jewodudo rugadu. Ceiamedu boe cerudure nowu Jesus jewodure duji.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus rutudo baru to. Dukodire mugure Tuo Kurirewu meki. Pao Kurirewu makore ji marigudu tumoduie Tuwari maku ai. Dukejere ure Tuwari maku ai rugadu uwo maku mearutorure puduiwuge etai jamedu. Ca Pao Kurirewu Uwari makudure cenai dukodire cerore, cemagore aino tawadaru tabo.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus rutudo baru to. Dukodire mugure Tuo Kurirewu meki. Pao Kurirewu makore ji marigudu tumoduie Tuwari maku ai. Dukejere ure Tuwari maku ai rugadu uwo maku mearutorure puduiwuge etai jamedu. Ca Pao Kurirewu Uwari makudure cenai dukodire cerore, cemagore aino tawadaru tabo.

b: Marigudu pagimijera Davi makore Jesus bataru ji. Utukare baru to raga dukeje akore Pao Kurirewu makore nowu ikimijera umode boe ekinorudowuji. Akore Amugudo woe ikana pemegarewu jagwai jii toro imode jorudu pegare aiwuge etagedudo du ka.”
source: Marigudu pagimijera Davi makore Jesus bataru ji. Utukare baru to raga dukeje akore Pao Kurirewu makore nowu ikimijera umode boe ekinorudowuji. Akore Amugudo woe ikana pemegarewu jagwai jii toro imode jorudu pegare aiwuge etagedudo du ka.”

b: Pedro mako kimore. Akore israel kejewugenure tagi. Taiamedu boe tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji taruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu. Iwo tawie rugadu. Tare Jesus bito. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure pagimijera kurirewudo ema. Umode boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu.
source: Pedro mako kimore. Akore israel kejewugenure tagi. Taiamedu boe tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji taruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu. Iwo tawie rugadu. Tare Jesus bito. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure pagimijera kurirewudo ema. Umode boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu.

b: Nou boe doge emearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje ekiarigodure turore aino duji rugadu. Emagore Pedro ji. Emagore nouia uture Jesus bataru tabowugei jamedu. egore cemana magenure tagi. Nuba ceromode?
source: Nou boe doge emearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje ekiarigodure turore aino duji rugadu. Emagore Pedro ji. Emagore nouia uture Jesus bataru tabowugei jamedu. egore cemana magenure tagi. Nuba ceromode?

b: Pedro makore ei. Akore taiamedu boe tamearudae tawuje tawo tagera ra taro pegarewu boe piji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu taro pegarewu piji. Tagao pegododuwo boe eruduwawo tamearutorure Jesus jitu duji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku tagai rugadu.
source: Pedro makore ei. Akore taiamedu boe tamearudae tawuje tawo tagera ra taro pegarewu boe piji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu taro pegarewu piji. Tagao pegododuwo boe eruduwawo tamearutorure Jesus jitu duji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku tagai rugadu.

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu romode tumagore bagaiwuge ji. Ainore akore tai, tagorei, boe eiamedu boe ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu romode tumagore bagaiwuge ji. Ainore akore tai, tagorei, boe eiamedu boe ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Pedro mako raire aino nowu boe ji tuwo emearutorudo Jesus ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu ro pegamode ro pegarewugei rugadu kuri aino. Dukodire care tamagodo Pao Kurirewu bagai uwo taginorudo.
source: Pedro mako raire aino nowu boe ji tuwo emearutorudo Jesus ji. Akore Pao Kurirewu ro pegamode ro pegarewugei rugadu kuri aino. Dukodire care tamagodo Pao Kurirewu bagai uwo taginorudo.

b: Boe emearutorure Jesus ji nowu Pedro bataru koia. Dukeje etao pegododure. Emagare. Nou meri ji ure etao pegododurewuge enodo padure três mil emearutorure Jesus ji kodi.
source: Boe emearutorure Jesus ji nowu Pedro bataru koia. Dukeje etao pegododure. Emagare. Nou meri ji ure etao pegododurewuge enodo padure três mil emearutorure Jesus ji kodi.

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere nowu mearutorurewuge eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Ere bato pui tu tu je. Enogwagere puapo. Emagore puapo baru to jamedu.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere nowu mearutorurewuge eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Ere bato pui tu tu je. Enogwagere puapo. Emagore puapo baru to jamedu.

b: Ainore Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Erore
source: Ainore Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Erore

b: Uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ero rakarewu kurire. Jesus koiare ure ero rakado aino. Ere boe eku kidugo rugadu. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe ebogodure.
source: Uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ero rakarewu kurire. Jesus koiare ure ero rakado aino. Ere boe eku kidugo rugadu. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe ebogodure.

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui tu tu je. Ere toe kobo pedo pui.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui tu tu je. Ere toe kobo pedo pui.

b: Iage ere to moto maku diero bagai. Dukeje ere nowu diero maku nouia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai nowu uke bokwarewuge etai. Ere nowu toe maku diero bagai dukeje ere nowu diero maku mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai nowu uke bokwarewuge etai.
source: Iage ere to moto maku diero bagai. Dukeje ere nowu diero maku nouia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai nowu uke bokwarewuge etai. Ere nowu toe maku diero bagai dukeje ere nowu diero maku mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai nowu uke bokwarewuge etai.

b: Ere bato pui Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada meri jamedu ji. Enogwagere puapo tuwai ja tada. Egarere pui. Enojarokare tuwadaru ji.
source: Ere bato pui Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada meri jamedu ji. Enogwagere puapo tuwai ja tada. Egarere pui. Enojarokare tuwadaru ji.

b: Mare emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe eiamedu boe etaidu pemegare ei. Meri koduredu jamedu boe ji iage emearutorure Jesus ji uwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure mearutorure puduiwuge emagado rugadu.
source: Mare emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe eiamedu boe etaidu pemegare ei. Meri koduredu jamedu boe ji iage emearutorure Jesus ji uwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure mearutorure puduiwuge emagado rugadu.

b: Pedro Ure Meru Bokwarewu Marenaru Imedu Pemegago
source: Pedro Ure Meru Bokwarewu Marenaru Imedu Pemegago

b: Ia meri keje Pedro uture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka João apo merirekodutabo. Judeu doge emagomode baru to merirekodutabo tu tu je.
source: Ia meri keje Pedro uture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka João apo merirekodutabo. Judeu doge emagomode baru to merirekodutabo tu tu je.

b: Nou Pao Kurirewu uwai ia bai poro iere Moturewu. Boe etaregodure nono ia marenaru imedu apo meri jamedu ji muguwo nono togwamaguduwo diero bagai. Nou imedu boture tubogora pegare dutabo dukodire meru bokware. Meri jamedu ji okwamagudure nowu ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwai towugei diero bagai.
source: Nou Pao Kurirewu uwai ia bai poro iere Moturewu. Boe etaregodure nono ia marenaru imedu apo meri jamedu ji muguwo nono togwamaguduwo diero bagai. Nou imedu boture tubogora pegare dutabo dukodire meru bokware. Meri jamedu ji okwamagudure nowu ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwai towugei diero bagai.

b: Ca Pedro João etaregodure nono. Nou imedu jorudure ei dukeje okwamagudure ei ia boe bagai.
source: Ca Pedro João etaregodure nono. Nou imedu jorudure ei dukeje okwamagudure ei ia boe bagai.

b: Etaiwore tu ji dukeje Pedro akore akaiwodo cei.
source: Etaiwore tu ji dukeje Pedro akore akaiwodo cei.

b: Dukodire aiwore ei. Meardaere emoduie ia iaboe maku pudai.
source: Dukodire aiwore ei. Meardaere emoduie ia iaboe maku pudai.

b: Mare Pedro akore Ino diero bokwa. Mare imode ia iaboe maku akai. Nazaré pijiwunure Jesusce. Umode boe ekinorudowunure ema. Jesus koiare umode inagojino aino ai. Aragojedo! Amerudo!
source: Mare Pedro akore Ino diero bokwa. Mare imode ia iaboe maku akai. Nazaré pijiwunure Jesusce. Umode boe ekinorudowunure ema. Jesus koiare umode inagojino aino ai. Aragojedo! Amerudo!

b: Dukejere Pedro ure tugeragu nowu imedu ieraji. Ure rakojedo. Ca Pao Kurirewu ure nowu imedu bure, pogora pemegado jamedu.
source: Dukejere Pedro ure tugeragu nowu imedu ieraji. Ure rakojedo. Ca Pao Kurirewu ure nowu imedu bure, pogora pemegado jamedu.

b: Ure turagojedo. Rakojere tuginaigodu. Merure jamedu. Dukejere ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwaito tumeruredu tabo. Ure taredo tiagare tabo. Mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Ure turagojedo. Rakojere tuginaigodu. Merure jamedu. Dukejere ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwaito tumeruredu tabo. Ure taredo tiagare tabo. Mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Boe emagare tuiorudu tabo nowu imedu merure duji. Emearudure mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu jituji.
source: Boe emagare tuiorudu tabo nowu imedu merure duji. Emearudure mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu jituji.

b: Mare eruduware rakojere nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai poro kejewu marenaru imedunure ema duji. Dukodire ebogodure rugadu. Nou Pao Kurirewu ro ure nowu boe eku kidugo.
source: Mare eruduware rakojere nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai poro kejewu marenaru imedunure ema duji. Dukodire ebogodure rugadu. Nou Pao Kurirewu ro ure nowu boe eku kidugo.

b: Pedro Ure Boe Ewie Pao Kurirewu Uwai Tada
source: Pedro Ure Boe Ewie Pao Kurirewu Uwai Tada

b: Nou imedu ukare tugera ra Pedro piji, João piji. Ia bawadu padure nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu tada. Nou bawadu iere Salomão Uwai Jokora. Pedro, João eragojere nono. Boe eregodure etae nono tiegarere pudui dutabo.
source: Nou imedu ukare tugera ra Pedro piji, João piji. Ia bawadu padure nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu tada. Nou bawadu iere Salomão Uwai Jokora. Pedro, João eragojere nono. Boe eregodure etae nono tiegarere pudui dutabo.

b: Pedro jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje makore ei. Akore israel kejewugenure tagi. Iwobenure tagi jamedu. Kodiba taebogodure aino? Kodiba tagaiwore tu cei? Cere nowu imedu pemegago dukodire tamearudaemode ro rakarewugenure cegi. Tamearudaemode ro pemegarewugenure cegi. Cere nowu imedu pemegago mare cegi karega. Cere nono tamogadure rugadu.
source: Pedro jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje makore ei. Akore israel kejewugenure tagi. Iwobenure tagi jamedu. Kodiba taebogodure aino? Kodiba tagaiwore tu cei? Cere nowu imedu pemegago dukodire tamearudaemode ro rakarewugenure cegi. Tamearudaemode ro pemegarewugenure cegi. Cere nowu imedu pemegago mare cegi karega. Cere nono tamogadure rugadu.

b: Abraão mearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Isaque mearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Jacó mearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Jao pawobe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Awu emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ure boe kurirewudo Jesusce baru tada Jesus rowo Pao Kurirewu roji. Mare tagi tagaidukare Jesus ji. Dukodire tare maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Tagimijera Pilatos aidure tuwo Jesus udo cinorudo mare tagaidukare.
source: Abraão mearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Isaque mearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Jacó mearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Jao pawobe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Awu emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ure boe kurirewudo Jesusce baru tada Jesus rowo Pao Kurirewu roji. Mare tagi tagaidukare Jesus ji. Dukodire tare maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Tagimijera Pilatos aidure tuwo Jesus udo cinorudo mare tagaidukare.

b: Jesus ro pemegare. Ro pegarewu bokware. Mare tagaidukare ji. Tagagore Pilatoji uwo ia ure boe ewidowu imedu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Nono tagagore Pilatoji uwo Jesus mugudo mugato.
source: Jesus ro pemegare. Ro pegarewu bokware. Mare tagaidukare ji. Tagagore Pilatoji uwo ia ure boe ewidowu imedu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Nono tagagore Pilatoji uwo Jesus mugudo mugato.

b: Tare Jesus bito. Emare umode boe eewodudo. Tare bito mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje. Cerudure awu jamedu boe ji.
source: Tare Jesus bito. Emare umode boe eewodudo. Tare bito mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje. Cerudure awu jamedu boe ji.

b: Cemearutorure Jesus ji. Nou imedu mearutorure ji jamedu. Dukodire pemegagodure aino. Jesus rakare. Jesus ure turaga maku nowu imedu ai tuwo pemegago. Tagaiwodo ji.
source: Cemearutorure Jesus ji. Nou imedu mearutorure ji jamedu. Dukodire pemegagodure aino. Jesus rakare. Jesus ure turaga maku nowu imedu ai tuwo pemegago. Tagaiwodo ji.

b: – Ca. Imedagenure tagi. Taro pegare Jesus ji mare taruduwakare jitu kodi. Tagimijerage ero pegare aino Jesus ji mare eruduwakare jitu kodi.
source: – Ca. Imedagenure tagi. Taro pegare Jesus ji mare taruduwakare jitu kodi. Tagimijerage ero pegare aino Jesus ji mare eruduwakare jitu kodi.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure pawie. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge egore boe pegamoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowuji. Ca ainore Pao Kurirewu ure udo rugadu. Nou makore jiboe jeture pudui rugadu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure pawie. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge egore boe pegamoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowuji. Ca ainore Pao Kurirewu ure udo rugadu. Nou makore jiboe jeture pudui rugadu.

b: Tagaidukaba taro pegarewu ji pugeje. Tagera ra piji. Tagaiwodo Pao Kurirewu bagai. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode taro pegarewu jamedu boe piji. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode tado tawia ra boe pegarewu piji. Umode Jesus arego tagae. Ure tugeragu Jesus ji marigudu uwo boe ekinorudo.
source: Tagaidukaba taro pegarewu ji pugeje. Tagera ra piji. Tagaiwodo Pao Kurirewu bagai. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode taro pegarewu jamedu boe piji. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode tado tawia ra boe pegarewu piji. Umode Jesus arego tagae. Ure tugeragu Jesus ji marigudu uwo boe ekinorudo.

b: Jesus rakojemode baru tada tu jao. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie tumoduie boe jamedu boe maidudo. Mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere boe ewie rugadu. Pao Kurirewu umode boe jamedu boe maidudo dukeje Jesus aregodumode.
source: Jesus rakojemode baru tada tu jao. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie tumoduie boe jamedu boe maidudo. Mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere boe ewie rugadu. Pao Kurirewu umode boe jamedu boe maidudo dukeje Jesus aregodumode.

b: Moisés akore Tamearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu umode ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu arego tagae nono ure itarego dumogadure. Tawobe mode ema. Tamearutorudo tu ji rugadu.
source: Moisés akore Tamearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu umode ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu arego tagae nono ure itarego dumogadure. Tawobe mode ema. Tamearutorudo tu ji rugadu.

b: Mearutorukare jiwuge ewarigudumode Pao Kurirewu uwobe epiji etageduwo.”
source: Mearutorukare jiwuge ewarigudumode Pao Kurirewu uwobe epiji etageduwo.”

b: – Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ewadaru kodure puregodaji. Ainore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Samuel akore jamedu. Marigudu emagore Pao Kurirewu romode pai jiboe ji.
source: – Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ewadaru kodure puregodaji. Ainore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Samuel akore jamedu. Marigudu emagore Pao Kurirewu romode pai jiboe ji.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore abraãoji. Akore Tagore ebo imode boe pemegado boe eiamedu boe ji.” Awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ure turugadu tai jamedu. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere mariguduwuge tawobe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Nou ewadaru ure turugadu tai jamedu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu makore abraãoji. Akore Tagore ebo imode boe pemegado boe eiamedu boe ji.” Awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ure turugadu tai jamedu. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere mariguduwuge tawobe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Nou ewadaru ure turugadu tai jamedu.

b: Ca Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu Jesus ji tudugarewo ema. Ure Jesus arego tagae boeto ji. Emare aidure turo pemegawo tai, tuwo tado tagera ra taro pegarewu piji.
source: Ca Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu Jesus ji tudugarewo ema. Ure Jesus arego tagae boeto ji. Emare aidure turo pemegawo tai, tuwo tado tagera ra taro pegarewu piji.

b: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Emagore Pedro ji Joãoji
source: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Emagore Pedro ji Joãoji

b: Pedro João emago kimore boe dogei dukeje nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge etaregodure. Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijera aregodure jamedu. Saduceu doge etaregodure nono jamedu.
source: Pedro João emago kimore boe dogei dukeje nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge etaregodure. Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijera aregodure jamedu. Saduceu doge etaregodure nono jamedu.

b: Erudu pegare nowu Pedro nowu João ewadaru ji. Pedro João egore Jesus jewoduie pugeje. Aino boe eruduwaie birewuge eewodumode pugeje duji. Mare nowu aregodurewuge emearutorukare nowu inoduji.
source: Erudu pegare nowu Pedro nowu João ewadaru ji. Pedro João egore Jesus jewoduie pugeje. Aino boe eruduwaie birewuge eewodumode pugeje duji. Mare nowu aregodurewuge emearutorukare nowu inoduji.

b: Dukodire ere tugeragu Pedro ji, Joãoji. Ere etugu baicorewuto nowu boeco ji.
source: Dukodire ere tugeragu Pedro ji, Joãoji. Ere etugu baicorewuto nowu boeco ji.

b: Mare nouia boe emearutorure Pedro bataru ji. Dukodire emearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagagodure rugadu. Enodo padure cinco mil boe doge.
source: Mare nouia boe emearutorure Pedro bataru ji. Dukodire emearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagagodure rugadu. Enodo padure cinco mil boe doge.

b: Nou barogwato nowu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe ere bato pui Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure jamedu.
source: Nou barogwato nowu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe ere bato pui Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure jamedu.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu rakojere nono jamedu. Iere Anás. Uwagedu rakojere jamedu. Iere Caifás. Nou Anás ia uwobe eragojere nono jamedu. Ia iere João. Ia iere Alexandre.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu rakojere nono jamedu. Iere Anás. Uwagedu rakojere jamedu. Iere Caifás. Nou Anás ia uwobe eragojere nono jamedu. Ia iere João. Ia iere Alexandre.

b: Nou Judeu doge eimijerage ere Pedro João etawuje baicorewu piji tuwo eragojedo nono tiogorai. Dukeje nowu boe eimijerage enaragodure Pedro ji, Joãoji. egore nuba tare tarodo tawo nowu imedu pemegago? Nuba tare tarodo kodiba nowu taraga makudure tagai?
source: Nou Judeu doge eimijerage ere Pedro João etawuje baicorewu piji tuwo eragojedo nono tiogorai. Dukeje nowu boe eimijerage enaragodure Pedro ji, Joãoji. egore nuba tare tarodo tawo nowu imedu pemegago? Nuba tare tarodo kodiba nowu taraga makudure tagai?

b: Pedro korobadure Pao Kurirewu Uwari apo. Dutabore makore nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ewadaru jipagi.
source: Pedro korobadure Pao Kurirewu Uwari apo. Dutabore makore nowu Judeu doge eimijerage ewadaru jipagi.

b: Akore nuba tagaidure taruduwawo? Tagaidure taruduwawo nuba cerore cewo nowu meru bokwarewu imedu pemegago?
source: Akore nuba tagaidure taruduwawo? Tagaidure taruduwawo nuba cerore cewo nowu meru bokwarewu imedu pemegago?

b: Cemode tawie taruduwawo, boe eiamedu boe eruduwawo. Cere nowu imedu pemegago mare cegi karega. Mare Jesus Cristo rakare. Emare ure nowu imedu pemegago rugadu. Nou Jesus ricodure boe eda Nazaré keje. Tagi tare nowu Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje.
source: Cemode tawie taruduwawo, boe eiamedu boe eruduwawo. Cere nowu imedu pemegago mare cegi karega. Mare Jesus Cristo rakare. Emare ure nowu imedu pemegago rugadu. Nou Jesus ricodure boe eda Nazaré keje. Tagi tare nowu Jesus bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje.

b: Nou Jesus jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Akore Boe emearudae pegare toriji. Egore nowu tori pegaie tuwo tuwaido ema. Mare tori pemegarewunure ema rugadu boe ewo tuwaido ema rugadu.” – Mare tori ji karega Pao Kurirewu akoino. Jesus jire akoino.
source: Nou Jesus jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Akore Boe emearudae pegare toriji. Egore nowu tori pegaie tuwo tuwaido ema. Mare tori pemegarewunure ema rugadu boe ewo tuwaido ema rugadu.” – Mare tori ji karega Pao Kurirewu akoino. Jesus jire akoino.

b: Tu Jesus umode boe ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji. Pao Kurirewu ukare tugeragu ia metiaji. Dukodire ia boe bokware moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe ekinorudo.
source: Tu Jesus umode boe ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji. Pao Kurirewu ukare tugeragu ia metiaji. Dukodire ia boe bokware moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe ekinorudo.

b: Pedro João emugukare bapera keje mare epogurukare tumagowo nowu Judeu doge eimijeragei. Nou boe eimijerage erore ta je egoino duji. Dukeje eruduware eragojere Jesus apo duji.
source: Pedro João emugukare bapera keje mare epogurukare tumagowo nowu Judeu doge eimijeragei. Nou boe eimijerage erore ta je egoino duji. Dukeje eruduware eragojere Jesus apo duji.

b: Ca nowu boe eimijerage eroiwakare tumagowo iaboe ji pugeje. Nou pemegagodurewu imedu rakojere nono Pedro apo João apo jamedu.
source: Ca nowu boe eimijerage eroiwakare tumagowo iaboe ji pugeje. Nou pemegagodurewu imedu rakojere nono Pedro apo João apo jamedu.

b: Dukeje egore nowu imei ewo tudawuje nowu bai piji tu jao. Nono nowu boe eimijerage emagore pui nuba turomode.
source: Dukeje egore nowu imei ewo tudawuje nowu bai piji tu jao. Nono nowu boe eimijerage emagore pui nuba turomode.

b: egore nuba paromode nowu imei? Ere nowu imedu pemegago. Ca Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe eruduware nowu ero rakarewuji. Paroiwakare pawo boe ekiripagado pugeje.
source: egore nuba paromode nowu imei? Ere nowu imedu pemegago. Ca Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe eruduware nowu ero rakarewuji. Paroiwakare pawo boe ekiripagado pugeje.

b: Pawo pamago rakado nowu imei ekawo boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji pugeje. Aino ia boe eruduwamodukare nowu inoduji pugeje.
source: Pawo pamago rakado nowu imei ekawo boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji pugeje. Aino ia boe eruduwamodukare nowu inoduji pugeje.

b: Dukeje nowu eimijerage emagore nowu ime ewagai pugeje. Emago rakare ei ekawo boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji pugeje, emagokawo Jesus bataru ji boe ewiagai pugeje.
source: Dukeje nowu eimijerage emagore nowu ime ewagai pugeje. Emago rakare ei ekawo boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji pugeje, emagokawo Jesus bataru ji boe ewiagai pugeje.

b: Mare Pedro, nowu João emagore nowu boe eimijerage ewadaru jipagi jamedu: – Tagaiwodo boe pemegarewu bagai. Nuba Pao Kurirewu aidumode? Cemearutorumode tawadaru ji na? Pao Kurirewu bataru ji kana?
source: Mare Pedro, nowu João emagore nowu boe eimijerage ewadaru jipagi jamedu: – Tagaiwodo boe pemegarewu bagai. Nuba Pao Kurirewu aidumode? Cemearutorumode tawadaru ji na? Pao Kurirewu bataru ji kana?

b: Cemodukare cegera ra cemago piji rugadu cewo boe ewie rugadu cerudure jiboe ji, cemearudure jiboe ji.
source: Cemodukare cegera ra cemago piji rugadu cewo boe ewie rugadu cerudure jiboe ji, cemearudure jiboe ji.

b: Mare nowu boe eimijerage emago rakare ei pugeje. Dukeje ere etudo. Nou imedu pemegagodure dukodire boe eiamedu boe emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage eroiwakare turo pegawo nowu imei.
source: Mare nowu boe eimijerage emago rakare ei pugeje. Dukeje ere etudo. Nou imedu pemegagodure dukodire boe eiamedu boe emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage eroiwakare turo pegawo nowu imei.

b: Nou Pao Kurirewu ro rakare jiwu imedu o joru oto padure quarenta.
source: Nou Pao Kurirewu ro rakare jiwu imedu o joru oto padure quarenta.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Emagore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Uwo Tuwadaru Pemegado
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Emagore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Uwo Tuwadaru Pemegado

b: Nou boe eimijerage ere nowu Pedro nowu João etudo dukeje eture tuibagi toro mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Ere ewie nowu boe eimijerage ewadaru ji.
source: Nou boe eimijerage ere nowu Pedro nowu João etudo dukeje eture tuibagi toro mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Ere ewie nowu boe eimijerage ewadaru ji.

b: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje emagore baru to puapo Pao Kurirewu bagai. egore cegimijeranure aki. Aki are baru to, are moto to, are pobo maerewu to. Are boe eiamedu boe etowuje.
source: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje emagore baru to puapo Pao Kurirewu bagai. egore cegimijeranure aki. Aki are baru to, are moto to, are pobo maerewu to. Are boe eiamedu boe etowuje.

b: Are Awari makodo jawu cegimijera Daviji. Nou Davi atugarenure ema. Awari makore aino ji. Akore Kodiba boe tuginaiwuge ekorigodure? Kodiba Judeu doge ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje?
source: Are Awari makodo jawu cegimijera Daviji. Nou Davi atugarenure ema. Awari makore aino ji. Akore Kodiba boe tuginaiwuge ekorigodure? Kodiba Judeu doge ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje?

b: Eiamedu boe eimijerage ere tudo turugadu. Ere bato pui turugoduwo Pao Kurirewu ji, turugoduwo umode boe ekinorudowuji.”
source: Eiamedu boe eimijerage ere tudo turugadu. Ere bato pui turugoduwo Pao Kurirewu ji, turugoduwo umode boe ekinorudowuji.”

b: – Ca boe jokodu jire cegimijera Davi akoino. Ainore nowu cegimijera Herodes, nowu cegimijera Pôncio Pilatos ere bato pui woe awu ba kurirewu tada boe tuginaiwugebo, Israel kejewugebo jamedu tuwo tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turo pegawo Jesus ji. Atugare pemegarewunure Jesusce. Are boe ekinorudowudo ema.
source: – Ca boe jokodu jire cegimijera Davi akoino. Ainore nowu cegimijera Herodes, nowu cegimijera Pôncio Pilatos ere bato pui woe awu ba kurirewu tada boe tuginaiwugebo, Israel kejewugebo jamedu tuwo tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turo pegawo Jesus ji. Atugare pemegarewunure Jesusce. Are boe ekinorudowudo ema.

b: Awu cegimijerage pegarewuge ere bato pui mare erore jiboe ure nono amearudae mogadure. Are nowu amearudae tawuje marigudu. Are udo araga tabo.
source: Awu cegimijerage pegarewuge ere bato pui mare erore jiboe ure nono amearudae mogadure. Are nowu amearudae tawuje marigudu. Are udo araga tabo.

b: Ca ceginorudo nowu cegimijerage ewadaru pegarewu piji. Cegimijera kurirewunure aki. Atugaregenure cegi. Ceboguru bokwado cemago pemegawo awadaru ji boe ewiagai.
source: Ca ceginorudo nowu cegimijerage ewadaru pegarewu piji. Cegimijera kurirewunure aki. Atugaregenure cegi. Ceboguru bokwado cemago pemegawo awadaru ji boe ewiagai.

b: Amagodo boe ewiagai Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Atugare pemegarewunure Jesusce. Dutabore akera bu boe ewugeje epemegagoduwo. Aro rakarewu towuje boe egai.
source: Amagodo boe ewiagai Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Atugare pemegarewunure Jesusce. Dutabore akera bu boe ewugeje epemegagoduwo. Aro rakarewu towuje boe egai.

b: Emagore baru to akedure dukeje nowu eragojere tadawu bai magadugodure. Dukejere ekorobadure Pao Kurirewu Uwari apo. Nono epogurukare tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Ere boe ewie rugadu.
source: Emagore baru to akedure dukeje nowu eragojere tadawu bai magadugodure. Dukejere ekorobadure Pao Kurirewu Uwari apo. Nono epogurukare tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Ere boe ewie rugadu.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ere Toe Pedo Pui
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ere Toe Pedo Pui

b: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudae ure mitotu je. Ekare toe biado pubiji dukodire ere toe rugadu boe pedo pui.
source: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudae ure mitotu je. Ekare toe biado pubiji dukodire ere toe rugadu boe pedo pui.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eragado rugadu emago pemegawo boe ji. Ere boe eruduwado Jesus jewodure pugeje duji. Pao Kurirewu ure turo pemegarewu maku etai rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eragado rugadu emago pemegawo boe ji. Ere boe eruduwado Jesus jewodure pugeje duji. Pao Kurirewu ure turo pemegarewu maku etai rugadu.

b: Boe bokwakare etai rugadu. Iage ere to moto maku diero bagai. Iage ere tuwai maku diero bagai. Dukeje etaregodure nowu diero tabo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae. Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere nowu diero pedo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge uke bokwarewuge etai jamedu.
source: Boe bokwakare etai rugadu. Iage ere to moto maku diero bagai. Iage ere tuwai maku diero bagai. Dukeje etaregodure nowu diero tabo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae. Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere nowu diero pedo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge uke bokwarewuge etai jamedu.

b: Ia imedu iere José. Rore aino jamedu. Levi uwobenure ema. Boture Chipre moto keje. Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere nowu imedu iedo Barnabé. Ewadaru reo. Ainore egore “ure boe eragado rugadu”.
source: Ia imedu iere José. Rore aino jamedu. Levi uwobenure ema. Boture Chipre moto keje. Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere nowu imedu iedo Barnabé. Ewadaru reo. Ainore egore “ure boe eragado rugadu”.

b: Nou Barnabé ure ia to moto maku diero bagai. Dukeje aregodure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae nowu to diero tabo. Ure maku etai rugadu.
source: Nou Barnabé ure ia to moto maku diero bagai. Dukeje aregodure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae nowu to diero tabo. Ure maku etai rugadu.

b: Imedu Ananias, Oreduje Safira, Ero Pegare
source: Imedu Ananias, Oreduje Safira, Ero Pegare

b: Ia imedu iere Ananias. Oreduje iere Safira. Ere ia to moto maku diero bagai.
source: Ia imedu iere Ananias. Oreduje iere Safira. Ere ia to moto maku diero bagai.

b: Ere tumearudae tawuje tuwo nowu diero kado puiato. Ere ia diero biado toce. Nouia diero ere maku nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etai.
source: Ere tumearudae tawuje tuwo nowu diero kado puiato. Ere ia diero biado toce. Nouia diero ere maku nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etai.

b: Ananias ure maku etai dukeje Pedro makore ananiaji. Akore kodiba awiapagare bope doge eimijera Satanás mearudae pegarewuji? Nou bope doge eimijera ure tumearudae pegarewu maku akai awadraroduwo Pao Kurirewu Uwariji. Are ia ako moto maku diero bagai. Akagore aie nowu diero rugadu maku cenai mare are ia biado.
source: Ananias ure maku etai dukeje Pedro makore ananiaji. Akore kodiba awiapagare bope doge eimijera Satanás mearudae pegarewuji? Nou bope doge eimijera ure tumearudae pegarewu maku akai awadraroduwo Pao Kurirewu Uwariji. Are ia ako moto maku diero bagai. Akagore aie nowu diero rugadu maku cenai mare are ia biado.

b: Akore nowu ako motoce rugadu. Are maku dukeje akore nowu dieroce rugadu jamedu. Amodukare nowu ako diero maku cenai du pegakare. Mare awadrarodure! Akagore aie diero rugadu boe maku mare akare rugadu boe maku. Are ia tawuje akoce. Awadrarodure mare cei karega. Awadrarodure tu Pao Kurirewu ji!
source: Akore nowu ako motoce rugadu. Are maku dukeje akore nowu dieroce rugadu jamedu. Amodukare nowu ako diero maku cenai du pegakare. Mare awadrarodure! Akagore aie diero rugadu boe maku mare akare rugadu boe maku. Are ia tawuje akoce. Awadrarodure mare cei karega. Awadrarodure tu Pao Kurirewu ji!

b: Ananias mearudure nowu Pedro mako ji dukeje bire kuri rugadu. Buture kuri tai moto keje tuwi tabo. Ia ipare ere turemo nowu uwaito. Ere nowu birewu upodo. Dukeje ere reko. Ere tugu mototo. Boe eruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji dukeje eiamedu boe epagudugodure rugadu.
source: Ananias mearudure nowu Pedro mako ji dukeje bire kuri rugadu. Buture kuri tai moto keje tuwi tabo. Ia ipare ere turemo nowu uwaito. Ere nowu birewu upodo. Dukeje ere reko. Ere tugu mototo. Boe eruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji dukeje eiamedu boe epagudugodure rugadu.

b: Nono merirekodure pobe metia bokware dukeje nowu Ananias oreduje aregodure Pedro ae jamedu. Joruduwakare nuba Pao Kurirewu rore toreduji. Ure turemo.
source: Nono merirekodure pobe metia bokware dukeje nowu Ananias oreduje aregodure Pedro ae jamedu. Joruduwakare nuba Pao Kurirewu rore toreduji. Ure turemo.

b: Dukeje Pedro unarare ji. Akore iwie. Akoredu ure nowu tare tageragu jiwu diero rugadu maku cenai? Ia kimore? Nou Safira akore Boro. Ia bokware. Ure rugadu boe maku tagai.
source: Dukeje Pedro unarare ji. Akore iwie. Akoredu ure nowu tare tageragu jiwu diero rugadu maku cenai? Ia kimore? Nou Safira akore Boro. Ia bokware. Ure rugadu boe maku tagai.

b: Dukeje Pedro akore Mare kocare. Aki akoredu tagaidure tawo Pao Kurirewu Uwari jekiripagado. Dukodire akoredu bire marigudu. Aino nowu ipare ere akoredu tugu mototo. Emage etaregodure pugeje. Emode arego jamedu tuwo atugu mototo jamedu.
source: Dukeje Pedro akore Mare kocare. Aki akoredu tagaidure tawo Pao Kurirewu Uwari jekiripagado. Dukodire akoredu bire marigudu. Aino nowu ipare ere akoredu tugu mototo. Emage etaregodure pugeje. Emode arego jamedu tuwo atugu mototo jamedu.

b: Nou inodu kodi nowu aredu buture kuri tai moto keje tuwi tabo jamedu. Nou ipare ere turemo nowu baito dukeje erudure ji bire duji. Dukeje ere nowu aredu reko pugeje. Ere tugu mototo jamedu toredu meki.
source: Nou inodu kodi nowu aredu buture kuri tai moto keje tuwi tabo jamedu. Nou ipare ere turemo nowu baito dukeje erudure ji bire duji. Dukeje ere nowu aredu reko pugeje. Ere tugu mototo jamedu toredu meki.

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe epagudugodure. Nou emearudure nowu Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji dukeje eiamedu boe epagudugodure rugadu.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe epagudugodure. Nou emearudure nowu Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji dukeje eiamedu boe epagudugodure rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Ro Rakare Pugeje
source: Pao Kurirewu Ro Rakare Pugeje

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu to rugadu. Kogodurewuge epemegagodure. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere bato pui nowu Salomão O Iogora ka tu tu je.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu to rugadu. Kogodurewuge epemegagodure. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere bato pui nowu Salomão O Iogora ka tu tu je.

b: Mare mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge etaidukare turagojewo ebo. Mare boe eiamedu boe etaidure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji.
source: Mare mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge etaidukare turagojewo ebo. Mare boe eiamedu boe etaidure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji.

b: Iage emearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Dukodire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagare. Emagagodure rugadu.
source: Iage emearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Dukodire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagare. Emagagodure rugadu.

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ero rakare dukodire kogodurewuge ere tudawuje tuwai piji turagojewo awara okwai. Boe ere kogodurewuge ewu kodo keje nono awara okwai jamedu tubaga tabo ewagai. Nono Pedro kodure nowu awara ji dukeje utugu kodure nowu kogodurewu boe etaoji. Dukejere epemegagodure. Pedro rakare Pao Kurirewu Uwari meture tada kodi. Dukodire utugu rore aino kogodurewuge ji.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ero rakare dukodire kogodurewuge ere tudawuje tuwai piji turagojewo awara okwai. Boe ere kogodurewuge ewu kodo keje nono awara okwai jamedu tubaga tabo ewagai. Nono Pedro kodure nowu awara ji dukeje utugu kodure nowu kogodurewu boe etaoji. Dukejere epemegagodure. Pedro rakare Pao Kurirewu Uwari meture tada kodi. Dukodire utugu rore aino kogodurewuge ji.

b: Boe eiamedu boe etaregodure tieda piji Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka kogodurewugebo. Etaregodure mareboe meture tadawugebo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu kogodurewuge nowu mareboe meture tadawuge erugadu boe epemegago rugadu.
source: Boe eiamedu boe etaregodure tieda piji Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka kogodurewugebo. Etaregodure mareboe meture tadawugebo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu kogodurewuge nowu mareboe meture tadawuge erugadu boe epemegago rugadu.

b: Boe Eimijerage Ero Pegare Nou Uture Jesus Bataru Tabowugei
source: Boe Eimijerage Ero Pegare Nou Uture Jesus Bataru Tabowugei

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure tumearudae pegarewu tawuje nowu tumedage saduceu dogebo. Eiamedu boe erudu pegare nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ji. Emearudaere boe emearutoruwo tu pudui boe eruduwawo boe ji. Dukodire ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turo pegawo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ji.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure tumearudae pegarewu tawuje nowu tumedage saduceu dogebo. Eiamedu boe erudu pegare nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ji. Emearudaere boe emearutoruwo tu pudui boe eruduwawo boe ji. Dukodire ere tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turo pegawo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ji.

b: Ere tugeragu ei. Ere etugu baicorewuto.
source: Ere tugeragu ei. Ere etugu baicorewuto.

b: Mare nowu boeco ji Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae. Ure nowu baicorewu baiporo jado. Ure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etawuje baicorewu piji. Dukeje makore ei.
source: Mare nowu boeco ji Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae. Ure nowu baicorewu baiporo jado. Ure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etawuje baicorewu piji. Dukeje makore ei.

b: Akore tadudo toro Pao Kurirewu uwai ka tawo boe ewie nuba Jesus romode ei emugu pemegawo.
source: Akore tadudo toro Pao Kurirewu uwai ka tawo boe ewie nuba Jesus romode ei emugu pemegawo.

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge emearutorure nowu baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu utugare bataru ji. Caboecoto eture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Nono ere boe eruduwado. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu, eimijerage parutowuge emagore nouia Judeu doge eimijerage ewagai tuwo bato pui tuwo tumearudae tawuje pugeje. Dukeje iage eture nowu ere tugu baicorewu towuge ewagai pugeje.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge emearutorure nowu baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu utugare bataru ji. Caboecoto eture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Nono ere boe eruduwado. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu, eimijerage parutowuge emagore nouia Judeu doge eimijerage ewagai tuwo bato pui tuwo tumearudae tawuje pugeje. Dukeje iage eture nowu ere tugu baicorewu towuge ewagai pugeje.

b: Etaregodure baicorewu ka dukeje erudukare nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowugei nowu baicorewu ja tada. Dukodire ere tugirimi toro tumedage boe eimijerage etae tuwo ewie.
source: Etaregodure baicorewu ka dukeje erudukare nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowugei nowu baicorewu ja tada. Dukodire ere tugirimi toro tumedage boe eimijerage etae tuwo ewie.

b: egore cedaregodure baicorewu ka. Nou baicorewu baiporo jadodukare. Nou jeture baicorewu jiwuge eragojere nono jamedu. Ma kocare cere nowu baicorewu jado dukeje boe edukare tada.
source: egore cedaregodure baicorewu ka. Nou baicorewu baiporo jadodukare. Nou jeture baicorewu jiwuge eragojere nono jamedu. Ma kocare cere nowu baicorewu jado dukeje boe edukare tada.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje eruduwakare nuba nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge erore. Nou Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijera joruduwakare jamedu. Ewiagorore ewagai.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje eruduwakare nuba nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge erore. Nou Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijera joruduwakare jamedu. Ewiagorore ewagai.

b: Ca ia imedu aregodure etae dukeje akore Tawiapagado. Awu tare tugu baicorewu towu ime eragojere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Enure boe eruduwado.
source: Ca ia imedu aregodure etae dukeje akore Tawiapagado. Awu tare tugu baicorewu towu ime eragojere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Enure boe eruduwado.

b: Dukodire nowu tugobaigarege eimijera uture to tugobaigaregebo toro. Ere nowu ime erego mato nowu boe eimijerage etae. Mare epagudure nowu boe dogece dukodire ero rakakare nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ji. Epagudure nowu boe doge emode togorido tori tabo duji.
source: Dukodire nowu tugobaigarege eimijera uture to tugobaigaregebo toro. Ere nowu ime erego mato nowu boe eimijerage etae. Mare epagudure nowu boe dogece dukodire ero rakakare nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ji. Epagudure nowu boe doge emode togorido tori tabo duji.

b: Tugobaigarege etaregodure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowugebo nowu boe eimijerage ewai ka. Ere eragojedo nowu boe eimijerage etoiadada. Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu unarare ei.
source: Tugobaigarege etaregodure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowugebo nowu boe eimijerage ewai ka. Ere eragojedo nowu boe eimijerage etoiadada. Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu unarare ei.

b: Akore cemago rakare tai tagawo boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji. Mare tamearutorukare cei. Tare tawadarudo taodo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu parugajeje. Tagagore cegie cere Jesus bito.
source: Akore cemago rakare tai tagawo boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji. Mare tamearutorukare cei. Tare tawadarudo taodo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu parugajeje. Tagagore cegie cere Jesus bito.

b: Ca Pedro nouia uture Jesus bataru tabowuge egore cemearutorumodukare imei. Cemearutorumode tu Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Ca Pedro nouia uture Jesus bataru tabowuge egore cemearutorumodukare imei. Cemearutorumode tu Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Jawu pawobe emearutorure tu Pao Kurirewu ji. Tare Jesus kana jado ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Tare bito. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus jewodudo pugeje. Awu Pao Kurirewu jire jawu pawobe emearutorure.
source: Jawu pawobe emearutorure tu Pao Kurirewu ji. Tare Jesus kana jado ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Tare bito. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus jewodudo pugeje. Awu Pao Kurirewu jire jawu pawobe emearutorure.

b: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure rutudo baru to pudae rakojewo tumegi. Ure umode boe ekinorudowudo ema. Ure boe eimijera kurirewudo ema. Rore aino tuwo nowu Israel doge ewiago turo pegarewu piji, etaidukawo turo pegarewu ji pugeje. Israel doge eromode aino dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu piji rugadu.
source: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure rutudo baru to pudae rakojewo tumegi. Ure umode boe ekinorudowudo ema. Ure boe eimijera kurirewudo ema. Rore aino tuwo nowu Israel doge ewiago turo pegarewu piji, etaidukawo turo pegarewu ji pugeje. Israel doge eromode aino dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu piji rugadu.

b: Dujire cerudure, ceruduware. Dukodire cenure boe ewie. Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku mearutorure Jesus bataru jiwuge etai. Nou Pao Kurirewu Uwari unure boe ewie awu boe jamedu boe ji.
source: Dujire cerudure, ceruduware. Dukodire cenure boe ewie. Pao Kurirewu umode Tuwari maku mearutorure Jesus bataru jiwuge etai. Nou Pao Kurirewu Uwari unure boe ewie awu boe jamedu boe ji.

b: Nou boe eimijerage emearudure nowu ewadaru ji dukeje ekorigodure rugadu. Etaidure tuwo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eiamedu boe ewido.
source: Nou boe eimijerage emearudure nowu ewadaru ji dukeje ekorigodure rugadu. Etaidure tuwo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eiamedu boe ewido.

b: Mare ia nowu boe eimijera ure turagojedo tumago tabo tuwo nowu tumedage etaora butugugo. Fariseunure ema. Iere Gamaliel. Joruduware Israel doge eno bakaruji rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe erudu pemegare ji. Ca ure boedo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etawuje nowu bai piji tu jao.
source: Mare ia nowu boe eimijera ure turagojedo tumago tabo tuwo nowu tumedage etaora butugugo. Fariseunure ema. Iere Gamaliel. Joruduware Israel doge eno bakaruji rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe erudu pemegare ji. Ca ure boedo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etawuje nowu bai piji tu jao.

b: Dukeje nowu Gamaliel makore tumedage boe eimijeragei. Akore Pabagawo tu jao pagaiwo tabo nowu imei boe emearutoru raimode ewadaru jitu bagai.
source: Dukeje nowu Gamaliel makore tumedage boe eimijeragei. Akore Pabagawo tu jao pagaiwo tabo nowu imei boe emearutoru raimode ewadaru jitu bagai.

b: Cowu imedu Teudas aregodure marigudu. Emare akore boe kurirewu nuie pudumi. Dukodire boe etaidure ji. Nono eture apo rugadu. Enodo padure quatrocentos. Mare nowu Teudas bitodure dukeje nowu boe ere taodo pubiji. Emearutorukare nowu Teudas bataru ji pugeje.
source: Cowu imedu Teudas aregodure marigudu. Emare akore boe kurirewu nuie pudumi. Dukodire boe etaidure ji. Nono eture apo rugadu. Enodo padure quatrocentos. Mare nowu Teudas bitodure dukeje nowu boe ere taodo pubiji. Emearutorukare nowu Teudas bataru ji pugeje.

b: Dukejere ia metia aregodure pugeje. Judas Galileu aregodure. Boe eimijera kurirewu aidure tuioruduwawo nowu boe emagamode dubagai dukodire ure nowu boe edo tugie bu bapera keje. Dukejere nowu Judas aregodure. Eture nowu Judas apowuge emagare jamedu. Mare nowu Judas bitodure dukeje nowu uture apowuge ere taodo pubiji jamedu. Emearutorukare nowu Judas bataru ji pugeje.
source: Dukejere ia metia aregodure pugeje. Judas Galileu aregodure. Boe eimijera kurirewu aidure tuioruduwawo nowu boe emagamode dubagai dukodire ure nowu boe edo tugie bu bapera keje. Dukejere nowu Judas aregodure. Eture nowu Judas apowuge emagare jamedu. Mare nowu Judas bitodure dukeje nowu uture apowuge ere taodo pubiji jamedu. Emearutorukare nowu Judas bataru ji pugeje.

b: Aino pabagawo tu jao pagaiwo tabo awu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Pagare egore aino enure boe ekiripagado tu je.
source: Aino pabagawo tu jao pagaiwo tabo awu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Pagare egore aino enure boe ekiripagado tu je.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu emearudae maku etai dukodi akedumodukare rugadu. Pagaiwowo tu jao pagaiwo tabo ei paruduwawo nuba boemode. Pao Kurirewu umode emearudae maku etai dukeje pamodukare boe edo tugera ra ewadaru piji. Pamode ewido dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode awu tuwadaru maku iage etai emagowo ji boe ewiagai pugeje. Nou boe eimijerage etaidure nowu Gamaliel bataru ji.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu emearudae maku etai dukodi akedumodukare rugadu. Pagaiwowo tu jao pagaiwo tabo ei paruduwawo nuba boemode. Pao Kurirewu umode emearudae maku etai dukeje pamodukare boe edo tugera ra ewadaru piji. Pamode ewido dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode awu tuwadaru maku iage etai emagowo ji boe ewiagai pugeje. Nou boe eimijerage etaidure nowu Gamaliel bataru ji.

b: Dukodire ere nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eremo nowu baito pugeje. Ere tugobaigarege edo boeto ei. Dukeje emagore ei ekawo boe eruduwado Jesus bataru ji pugeje. Dukejere ere etudo.
source: Dukodire ere nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eremo nowu baito pugeje. Ere tugobaigarege edo boeto ei. Dukeje emagore ei ekawo boe eruduwado Jesus bataru ji pugeje. Dukejere ere etudo.

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eture nowu boe eimijerage epiji dukeje egarere pudui. Boe ero pegare ei emearutorure Jesus ji kodi. Dukodire eruduware Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare pudui duji rugadu.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eture nowu boe eimijerage epiji dukeje egarere pudui. Boe ero pegare ei emearutorure Jesus ji kodi. Dukodire eruduware Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare pudui duji rugadu.

b: Meri jamedu ji nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada, nowu boe ewai ja tada jamedu. Ere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Ere boe ewie Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji.
source: Meri jamedu ji nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada, nowu boe ewai ja tada jamedu. Ere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Ere boe ewie Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji.

b: Utugarege Enodo Padure Sete
source: Utugarege Enodo Padure Sete

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagagodure pugeje. Emagare rugadu. Mare ia meri keje ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etokire pui. Joruduware Grécia bataru jiwuge Judeu doge emagore nowu Judéia kejewu Judeu dogei. Egore boe eke makudukaie tuje okoge bokwarewuge areme etai.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagagodure pugeje. Emagare rugadu. Mare ia meri keje ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etokire pui. Joruduware Grécia bataru jiwuge Judeu doge emagore nowu Judéia kejewu Judeu dogei. Egore boe eke makudukaie tuje okoge bokwarewuge areme etai.

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge enodo padure doze. Emearudure nowu boe etokire pui duji dukeje emagore ewagai. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui dukeje nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge egore ukare turugadu cewo cegera ra cemaragodae piji cewo boe eke maku boe etai. Cemaragodunure cemago tabo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge enodo padure doze. Emearudure nowu boe etokire pui duji dukeje emagore ewagai. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui dukeje nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge egore ukare turugadu cewo cegera ra cemaragodae piji cewo boe eke maku boe etai. Cemaragodunure cemago tabo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai.

b: Cemedagenure tagi. Dukodire tagaiwodo pui tawo tageragu ia imei. Tagaiwodo mugure Pao Kurirewu Uwari apowu ime ewagai. Tagaiwodo joruduwarewuge ime ewagai. Tare tageragu ei dukeje cemode edo boe eke maku boe etai.
source: Cemedagenure tagi. Dukodire tagaiwodo pui tawo tageragu ia imei. Tagaiwodo mugure Pao Kurirewu Uwari apowu ime ewagai. Tagaiwodo joruduwarewuge ime ewagai. Tare tageragu ei dukeje cemode edo boe eke maku boe etai.

b: Cegire cewiagoromode cemagowo baru to, cemagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Awu cemaragodae mode tu rugadu.
source: Cegire cewiagoromode cemagowo baru to, cemagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Awu cemaragodae mode tu rugadu.

b: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe etaidure nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ewadaru ji. Dukodire ere tugeragu jiwu ime enodo padure sete. Ia iere Estêvão. Nou Estêvão mearutorure rugadu Jesus ji. Korobadure Pao Kurirewu Uwari apo. Ia iere Filipe. Ia iere Prócoro. Ia iere Nicanor. Ia iere Timom. Ia iere Pármenas. Ia iere Nicolau. Nou Nicolau aregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu piji. Judeu karegure ema. Mare mearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji marigudu Judeu doge ero mogadure.

b: Ca mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ime etaiwodo nowu ture tugeragu jiwu imei. Dukeje nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugera bu nowu ime etaora keje dukeje emagore baru to eparu tabo.

b: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu bataru ure taodo boe parugajeje. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagagodure Jerusalém tada. Emagare rugadu. Ia ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge emearutorure Jesus ji jamedu. Emagare jamedu.

b: Estêvão Tugudure Baicorewuto
source: Estêvão Tugudure Baicorewuto

b: Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare Estêvãoji rugadu. Estêvão rakare rugadu turo rakawo, turo kuriwo boe egai.
source: Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare Estêvãoji rugadu. Estêvão rakare rugadu turo rakawo, turo kuriwo boe egai.

b: Mare ia ime erudu pegare Estêvãoji. Nou ime Judeu dogenure emage. Ere bato pui tu tu je ia bai tada. Judeu doge emagore Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu bai ja tada tu tu je. Nou bai iere “Ime Pemegarewuge”. Nou Judeu doge etaregodure Cirene ba kurirewu piji, Alexandria ba kurirewu piji jamedu. Nou Judeu doge etaidukare nowu Estêvão mearudae ji. Emagore Estêvãoji tuwo nowu Estêvão mearudae mekido. Ia Judeu doge erorino jamedu. Nouge etaregodure Cilícia moto piji, Ásia moto piji jamedu marigudu.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Estêvão joruduwado tumago pemegawo rugadu. Dukodire nowu Judeu doge eroiwakare tumagowo Estêvão bataru jipagi.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Estêvão joruduwado tumago pemegawo rugadu. Dukodire nowu Judeu doge eroiwakare tumagowo Estêvão bataru jipagi.

b: Dukejere ere diero maku ia ime etai ewadraroduwo. Dukodire ere Estêvão bataru aodo boe ewiagai. egore cemearudure awu Estêvão bataru pegarewuji. Mako pegare jawu pamana Moisesji. Mako pegare Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu.
source: Dukejere ere diero maku ia ime etai ewadraroduwo. Dukodire ere Estêvão bataru aodo boe ewiagai. egore cemearudure awu Estêvão bataru pegarewuji. Mako pegare jawu pamana Moisesji. Mako pegare Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu.

b: Ainore erore tuwo boe ekorigo rugadu. Ere boe eimijerage ekorigo jamedu. Ere joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ekorigo jamedu. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ere tugeragu Estêvãoji. Ere reko toro boe eimijerage etae.
source: Ainore erore tuwo boe ekorigo rugadu. Ere boe eimijerage ekorigo jamedu. Ere joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ekorigo jamedu. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ere tugeragu Estêvãoji. Ere reko toro boe eimijerage etae.

b: Dukejere nowu batrarodurewuge etaregodure jamedu tuwadraroduwo pugeje. egore awu imedu mako pega raire awu Pao Kurirewu uwaiji. Mako pegare Moisés ure maku boe etaiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu.
source: Dukejere nowu batrarodurewuge etaregodure jamedu tuwadraroduwo pugeje. egore awu imedu mako pega raire awu Pao Kurirewu uwaiji. Mako pegare Moisés ure maku boe etaiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu.

b: Cemearudure ji jamedu. Akore nowu Nazaré pijiwu Jesus umoduie awu Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo. Akore nowu Jesus umoduie Moisés ure maku pagaiwu paro akedudo.
source: Cemearudure ji jamedu. Akore nowu Nazaré pijiwu Jesus umoduie awu Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo. Akore nowu Jesus umoduie Moisés ure maku pagaiwu paro akedudo.

b: Nou mugure nowu bai kejewuge boe eimijerage etaiwore nowu Estêvãoji. Erudure nowu Estêvão jeji. Nou Estêvão je ure nono ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu je mogadure.
source: Nou mugure nowu bai kejewuge boe eimijerage etaiwore nowu Estêvãoji. Erudure nowu Estêvão jeji. Nou Estêvão je ure nono ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu je mogadure.

b: Estêvão Bataru Reo
source: Estêvão Bataru Reo

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu makore Estêvãoji. Akore boe jokodu ji na awu ime doge egoino?
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu makore Estêvãoji. Akore boe jokodu ji na awu ime doge egoino?

b: Estêvão akore Ikimijeragenure tagi. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Pao Kurirewu pemegare rugadu. Rakojere boe pemegarewu remawu keje. Marigudu nowu pawobe etuo Abraão mugure Mesopotâmia moto keje. Nono Pao Kurirewu makore ji. Akore Akera ra awobe epiji, ako moto piji. Atudo toro imode arududo jiwu moto ka.” Dukeje Abraão uture Mesopotâmia moto piji toro Harã moto ka. Nono Abraão uo bire. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure Abraão utudo pugeje awu tamugure kejewu moto ka.

b: Pao Kurirewu ukare awu moto maku Abraão ai. Abraão o moto bokware. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore tumoduie maku Abraão ore etai. Makore ia boe umodukaie tawuje Abraão ore epiji pugeje uwobe eno moto moduie ema rugadu ji aino. Mare Abraão ore bokware. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare Abraãoji. Dukodire Abraão onaregedu boture rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu ukare awu moto maku Abraão ai. Abraão o moto bokware. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore tumoduie maku Abraão ore etai. Makore ia boe umodukaie tawuje Abraão ore epiji pugeje uwobe eno moto moduie ema rugadu ji aino. Mare Abraão ore bokware. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare Abraãoji. Dukodire Abraão onaregedu boture rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu makore aino ji. Akore Akanaregedu ore emugumode ia boe tuginaiwuge eno moto keje. Joru oto padu kejeboe mode quatrocentos ei toro nowu boe tuginaiwuge eno moto keje. Nou akore nowu boe tuginaiwuge etugarege mode emage. Nou boe tuginaiwuge ero pegamode akorei rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu makore aino ji. Akore Akanaregedu ore emugumode ia boe tuginaiwuge eno moto keje. Joru oto padu kejeboe mode quatrocentos ei toro nowu boe tuginaiwuge eno moto keje. Nou akore nowu boe tuginaiwuge etugarege mode emage. Nou boe tuginaiwuge ero pegamode akorei rugadu.

b: Mare imire imode boe pegado nowu boe tuginaiwuge ji. Dukejere nowu akore ewobe emode tudawuje nowu moto piji. Etaregodumode mato pugeje tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i woe.”
source: Mare imire imode boe pegado nowu boe tuginaiwuge ji. Dukejere nowu akore ewobe emode tudawuje nowu moto piji. Etaregodumode mato pugeje tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i woe.”

b: – Pao Kurirewu makore aino Abraãoji dukeje ure turo maku Abraão ai boe eruduwawo nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dukodire pawobe ime eiamedu ere tuwaga oto biri kado. Pao Kurirewu ure awu paro maku nowu pao Abraão ai marigudu. Dukeje Abraão ure tonaregedu Isaque baka oto biri kado. Nou Isaque boture dukeje meri oto padure sete ji dukeje ure nowu Isaque baka oto biri kado. Nou Isaque ure tonaregedu Jacó baka oto biri kado jamedu. Nou Jacó ure tore ime eiamedu boe ewaga oto biri kado jamedu. Jacó ore ime enodo padure doze. Judeu doge etumana magenure emage.
source: – Pao Kurirewu makore aino Abraãoji dukeje ure turo maku Abraão ai boe eruduwawo nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dukodire pawobe ime eiamedu ere tuwaga oto biri kado. Pao Kurirewu ure awu paro maku nowu pao Abraão ai marigudu. Dukeje Abraão ure tonaregedu Isaque baka oto biri kado. Nou Isaque boture dukeje meri oto padure sete ji dukeje ure nowu Isaque baka oto biri kado. Nou Isaque ure tonaregedu Jacó baka oto biri kado jamedu. Nou Jacó ure tore ime eiamedu boe ewaga oto biri kado jamedu. Jacó ore ime enodo padure doze. Judeu doge etumana magenure emage.

b: – Nou Jacó ore erudu pegare tuwie Joseji. Dukodire ere nowu tuwie José maku Egito kejewuge etai diero bagai. Mare Pao Kurirewu rakojere José apo.
source: – Nou Jacó ore erudu pegare tuwie Joseji. Dukodire ere nowu tuwie José maku Egito kejewuge etai diero bagai. Mare Pao Kurirewu rakojere José apo.

b: Boe pegare Joseji rugadu dukejere Pao Kurirewu ure ukinorudo nowu boe pegarewu piji. Nou Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu makore nowu José bagai dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure José mako pemegado, ure José joruduwado rugadu. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera kurirewu aidure Joseji. Ure boe eimijera paru towudo ema rugadu aiwowo moto ji, aiwowo nowu boe eimijera kurirewu uwobei.
source: Boe pegare Joseji rugadu dukejere Pao Kurirewu ure ukinorudo nowu boe pegarewu piji. Nou Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu makore nowu José bagai dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure José mako pemegado, ure José joruduwado rugadu. Dukodire nowu boe eimijera kurirewu aidure Joseji. Ure boe eimijera paru towudo ema rugadu aiwowo moto ji, aiwowo nowu boe eimijera kurirewu uwobei.

b: Dukodi toro ia meri keje boe pegare nowu Egito moto keje, nowu Canaã moto keje jamedu. Boe pegare nowu boe ji rugadu bubutu bokware kodi. José umana mage eragojere nowu Canaã moto keje. Eke bokware rugadu jamedu.
source: Dukodi toro ia meri keje boe pegare nowu Egito moto keje, nowu Canaã moto keje jamedu. Boe pegare nowu boe ji rugadu bubutu bokware kodi. José umana mage eragojere nowu Canaã moto keje. Eke bokware rugadu jamedu.

b: Etuo Jacó mearudure boe eke makaie Egito moto keje duji. Dukeje ure tore etudo toro Egito moto ka tuge bagai. Jawu pawobenure emage, eture toro mare ere tugirimi.
source: Etuo Jacó mearudure boe eke makaie Egito moto keje duji. Dukeje ure tore etudo toro Egito moto ka tuge bagai. Jawu pawobenure emage, eture toro mare ere tugirimi.

b: Dukodi toro ia meri keje ere tugirimi Egito moto ka pugeje. Nono José ure eruduwado pudui. Ainore nowu Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu joruduware José uwobei.
source: Dukodi toro ia meri keje ere tugirimi Egito moto ka pugeje. Nono José ure eruduwado pudui. Ainore nowu Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu joruduware José uwobei.

b: Dukodire José makore toro tuo Jacó bagai. Makore tuwobe eiamedu boe ewagai. Enodo padure kejewugere setenta e cinco. Etuwo toro Egito moto ka.
source: Dukodire José makore toro tuo Jacó bagai. Makore tuwobe eiamedu boe ewagai. Enodo padure kejewugere setenta e cinco. Etuwo toro Egito moto ka.

b: Dukodire Jacó uture toro Egito moto ka rugadu. Nonore bire. Nou ore ewire nono jamedu.
source: Dukodire Jacó uture toro Egito moto ka rugadu. Nonore bire. Nou ore ewire nono jamedu.

b: Mare ewobe ekare etugu nowu Egito moto keje. Ere erego toro nowu etuo Abraão ure akirodo jiwu moto ka tuwo etugu nono. Nou moto iere Siquém. Abraão ure akirodo nowu moto ji Hamor doge epiji diero tabo.
source: Mare ewobe ekare etugu nowu Egito moto keje. Ere erego toro nowu etuo Abraão ure akirodo jiwu moto ka tuwo etugu nono. Nou moto iere Siquém. Abraão ure akirodo nowu moto ji Hamor doge epiji diero tabo.

b: – Ca boe puredugodure Pao Kurirewu bataru jetuwu puduiwu ka. Ainore boere nono pawobei toro Egito keje nono Pao Kurirewu makore abraãoji dumogadure. Pawobe emagagodure eidodure nono Egito keje rugadu.
source: – Ca boe puredugodure Pao Kurirewu bataru jetuwu puduiwu ka. Ainore boere nono pawobei toro Egito keje nono Pao Kurirewu makore abraãoji dumogadure. Pawobe emagagodure eidodure nono Egito keje rugadu.

b: Dukejere ia Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu maiwure pugeje. Nou boe eimijera joruduwakare Joseji.
source: Dukejere ia Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu maiwure pugeje. Nou boe eimijera joruduwakare Joseji.

b: Ure jawu pawobe ekiripagado. Ro pegare ei rugadu. Ure edo etore ewarigu tuwai piji toro poboto ewiwo.
