source: Ure jawu pawobe ekiripagado. Ro pegare ei rugadu. Ure edo etore ewarigu tuwai piji toro poboto ewiwo.

b: Dukejere Moisés boture. Rogu moture rugadu. Uo uce etu pemegare ji tuwai tada. Ari ure pobe metia bokware dukeje eroiwakare tuwo nowu tonaregedurogu biado boe eimijera pegarewu piji pugeje. Nono ere tugu nouia kadaraboto. Bereagu tabo ere kadarabo okwa mi okwakawo poboto. Dukejere ere nowu kadarabo mugudo pobo aogeje. Mare nowu Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu onaregedu aredu jorudure ji dukeje ure tugeragu Moisesji tonaregeduce.
source: Dukejere Moisés boture. Rogu moture rugadu. Uo uce etu pemegare ji tuwai tada. Ari ure pobe metia bokware dukeje eroiwakare tuwo nowu tonaregedurogu biado boe eimijera pegarewu piji pugeje. Nono ere tugu nouia kadaraboto. Bereagu tabo ere kadarabo okwa mi okwakawo poboto. Dukejere ere nowu kadarabo mugudo pobo aogeje. Mare nowu Egito kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu onaregedu aredu jorudure ji dukeje ure tugeragu Moisesji tonaregeduce.

b: Aino Moisés joruduware nowu Egito kejewuge eruduware jiboe ji. Imedu kurirewunure ema. Mako pemegare. Ro pegakare.
source: Aino Moisés joruduware nowu Egito kejewuge eruduware jiboe ji. Imedu kurirewunure ema. Mako pemegare. Ro pegakare.

b: – Moisés o joru oto padure quarenta dukeje mearudaere taiwowo tuwobe Israel doge ewagai tuioruduwawo nuba boere ei dubagai.
source: – Moisés o joru oto padure quarenta dukeje mearudaere taiwowo tuwobe Israel doge ewagai tuioruduwawo nuba boere ei dubagai.

b: Jorudure ia Egito kejewu ure boeto ia jituji. Dukodire ure tugera maku nowu tuwobe imedu ai. Ure nowu Egito kejewu imedu bito nowu ro pegarewu du morice.
source: Jorudure ia Egito kejewu ure boeto ia jituji. Dukodire ure tugera maku nowu tuwobe imedu ai. Ure nowu Egito kejewu imedu bito nowu ro pegarewu du morice.

b: (Moisés mearudaere nowu tuwobe eruduware pudui duji, tugimijeranure pudumi duji. Pao Kurirewu umode rakado uwo tuwobe ekinorudo Egito kejewuge epiji. Mare eruduwakare ji raga.)
source: (Moisés mearudaere nowu tuwobe eruduware pudui duji, tugimijeranure pudumi duji. Pao Kurirewu umode rakado uwo tuwobe ekinorudo Egito kejewuge epiji. Mare eruduwakare ji raga.)

b: Nou barogwato jorudure ia Israelita ime pobedu dogei. Erugodure pui duji. Moisés aidure tuwo togwa bu ewugeje erugodukawo pui. Akore Israelita dogenure tagi. Tawobenure pugi. Tarugodukaba pui.”
source: Nou barogwato jorudure ia Israelita ime pobedu dogei. Erugodure pui duji. Moisés aidure tuwo togwa bu ewugeje erugodukawo pui. Akore Israelita dogenure tagi. Tawobenure pugi. Tarugodukaba pui.”

b: – Mare emearutorukare Moisesji. Dukodire ia akore Cegimijera karegure aki.
source: – Mare emearutorukare Moisesji. Dukodire ia akore Cegimijera karegure aki.

b: Jao meri ji are ia Egito kejewu imedu bito. Akaidunure awo iwido jamedu?”
source: Jao meri ji are ia Egito kejewu imedu bito. Akaidunure awo iwido jamedu?”

b: – Moisés mearudure nowu imedu bataru ji dukeje pagudugodure. Boe eruduware ure ia imedu bito duji. Dukodire rekodure Egito moto piji. Mugure toro Midiã moto keje. Uwirere toro. Dukeje boturewu ore imere pobe nono nowu moto keje.
source: – Moisés mearudure nowu imedu bataru ji dukeje pagudugodure. Boe eruduware ure ia imedu bito duji. Dukodire rekodure Egito moto piji. Mugure toro Midiã moto keje. Uwirere toro. Dukeje boturewu ore imere pobe nono nowu moto keje.

b: – Joru oto padure quarenta ji toro. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Moisés ae. Ure Moisés jorududo pudui. Moisés jorudure ia i roguji, joru cere to duji. Rakojere boe maerewu keje puredure Sinai Tori Riji.
source: – Joru oto padure quarenta ji toro. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Moisés ae. Ure Moisés jorududo pudui. Moisés jorudure ia i roguji, joru cere to duji. Rakojere boe maerewu keje puredure Sinai Tori Riji.

b: Moisés jorudure nowu joru ure irogu kowu duji dukeje ure tuburedo ji taiwo pemegawo ji. Mare mearudure Pao Kurirewu makore pudui duji.
source: Moisés jorudure nowu joru ure irogu kowu duji dukeje ure tuburedo ji taiwo pemegawo ji. Mare mearudure Pao Kurirewu makore pudui duji.

b: Pao Kurirewu akore Jao awobe emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Abraão mearutorure i. Isaque mearutorure i. Jacó mearutorure i jamedu.” Moisés mearudure Pao Kurirewu makore pudui duji dukeje magadugodure tubagudu koia. Aidukare taiwowo nowu iji pugeje.
source: Pao Kurirewu akore Jao awobe emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Abraão mearutorure i. Isaque mearutorure i. Jacó mearutorure i jamedu.” Moisés mearudure Pao Kurirewu makore pudui duji dukeje magadugodure tubagudu koia. Aidukare taiwowo nowu iji pugeje.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu makore ji pugeje. Akore Awu aragojere kejewu moto ino moto reo. Ire udo tuginai inoce. Dukodi care awure okeakejewu tawuje awure piji. Nono ioruduwamode amearutorure iduji.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu makore ji pugeje. Akore Awu aragojere kejewu moto ino moto reo. Ire udo tuginai inoce. Dukodi care awure okeakejewu tawuje awure piji. Nono ioruduwamode amearutorure iduji.

b: Ca ioruduware boe pegare iwobei duji toro Egito moto keje. Epadu kiorokare boe kori koia. Itaregodure iwo ekinorudo Egito kejewuge epiji. Mato itabo. Iwo arego toro Egito moto ka.”
source: Ca ioruduware boe pegare iwobei duji toro Egito moto keje. Epadu kiorokare boe kori koia. Itaregodure iwo ekinorudo Egito kejewuge epiji. Mato itabo. Iwo arego toro Egito moto ka.”

b: – Mare nowu Moisés remawu Israel doge etaidukare ji marigudu. Egore: “Cegimijera karegure aki.” Mare Pao Kurirewu ure nowu Israel doge eimijerado Moisesce. Emare ure Moisés utudo tuibagi Egito moto ka uwo nowu Israel doge ekinorudo nowu Egito kejewuge epiji. Nou ure Moisés jorududo puduiwu nowu irogu pijiwu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure tugera maku Moisés ai jamedu.
source: – Mare nowu Moisés remawu Israel doge etaidukare ji marigudu. Egore: “Cegimijera karegure aki.” Mare Pao Kurirewu ure nowu Israel doge eimijerado Moisesce. Emare ure Moisés utudo tuibagi Egito moto ka uwo nowu Israel doge ekinorudo nowu Egito kejewuge epiji. Nou ure Moisés jorududo puduiwu nowu irogu pijiwu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure tugera maku Moisés ai jamedu.

b: Dukejere nowu Moisés ure nowu boe ekinorudo Egito piji. Ro rakare, ro kurire Egito keje. Ro rakare, ro kurire Pobo Maerewu Kujagurewu keje. Ro rakare, ro kurire boe maerewu keje. Joru oto padure quarenta ei toro nowu boe maerewu keje.
source: Dukejere nowu Moisés ure nowu boe ekinorudo Egito piji. Ro rakare, ro kurire Egito keje. Ro rakare, ro kurire Pobo Maerewu Kujagurewu keje. Ro rakare, ro kurire boe maerewu keje. Joru oto padure quarenta ei toro nowu boe maerewu keje.

b: Dukodi nowu Moisés mitodure makore tuwobe Israel dogei. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu arego tagae rugadu nono turomoga idu mogadure. Pawobe mode ema rugadu.”
source: Dukodi nowu Moisés mitodure makore tuwobe Israel dogei. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu arego tagae rugadu nono turomoga idu mogadure. Pawobe mode ema rugadu.”

b: – Nou Moisés aire Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru pemegarewu maku. Ure maku ai toro Sinai Tori Ri aogeje rugadu. Nou jawu pawobe Israel doge eragojere nono jamedu nowu tori paru nowu boe maerewu keje. Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakojere nono jamedu. Pao Kurirewu bataru akedukare jii aino. Du akedumodukare rugadu.
source: – Nou Moisés aire Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru pemegarewu maku. Ure maku ai toro Sinai Tori Ri aogeje rugadu. Nou jawu pawobe Israel doge eragojere nono jamedu nowu tori paru nowu boe maerewu keje. Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakojere nono jamedu. Pao Kurirewu bataru akedukare jii aino. Du akedumodukare rugadu.

b: – Mare nowu jawu pawobe emearutorukare Moisés bataru ji. Etaidure tuwo tugera ra piji tuduwo tuibagi Egito moto ka.
source: – Mare nowu jawu pawobe emearutorukare Moisés bataru ji. Etaidure tuwo tugera ra piji tuduwo tuibagi Egito moto ka.

b: Dukodire emagore Arãoji. Egore: “Ia iaboe towuje pamearutoruwo ji pawo pabu jodo jokorai. Imedu Moisés ure cedawuje Egito piji mare ceruduwakare nuba boere ji pugeje.”
source: Dukodire emagore Arãoji. Egore: “Ia iaboe towuje pamearutoruwo ji pawo pabu jodo jokorai. Imedu Moisés ure cedawuje Egito piji mare ceruduwakare nuba boere ji pugeje.”

b: Dukodire Arão ure ia iaboe towuje etai ure nono santo mogadure nowu boe emearutoruwo ji. Nou ure toboe ure nono tapira naregedu imedu mogadure. Nono ere iaboe kowu tuwo maku nowu ture towu tapira ai. Ewadure rugadu tumearutorure nowu tapira jitu kodi.
source: Dukodire Arão ure ia iaboe towuje etai ure nono santo mogadure nowu boe emearutoruwo ji. Nou ure toboe ure nono tapira naregedu imedu mogadure. Nono ere iaboe kowu tuwo maku nowu ture towu tapira ai. Ewadure rugadu tumearutorure nowu tapira jitu kodi.

b: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugera ra epiji ewo ia tumearudae tawuje pugeje. Dukodire etaidure tumearutoruwo kuieje dogei pugeje. Etaidure tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo kuieje dogei Pao Kurirewu mugato. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere awu Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje rugadu. Akore israel dogenure tagi. Inai karega tare boe egu barege ekowu taro pegarewu morice. Tare tagera ra ipiji. Tamearutoruwo ia boe pegarewu ji pugeje. Tarore ainowu joru oto padure quarenta toro boe maerewu keje.
source: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugera ra epiji ewo ia tumearudae tawuje pugeje. Dukodire etaidure tumearutoruwo kuieje dogei pugeje. Etaidure tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo kuieje dogei Pao Kurirewu mugato. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere awu Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje rugadu. Akore israel dogenure tagi. Inai karega tare boe egu barege ekowu taro pegarewu morice. Tare tagera ra ipiji. Tamearutoruwo ia boe pegarewu ji pugeje. Tarore ainowu joru oto padure quarenta toro boe maerewu keje.

b: – Tare tabu jodo tawai tadawu santo doge egorai tamago pemegawo ei tawo pao kurirewugedo emage. Ia iere Moloque. Metia iere Renfã. Tagoredure nowu Moloque uwairogu tabo tagodurewu jamedu boe ji. Tagoredure nowu Renfã uwairogu tabo jamedu. Tagagore nowu Renfã uwai roguie nono kuieje mogadure. Tare tagera ra ipiji tamearutoruwo nowu tawai tadawu santo dogei. Dukodire imode tadudo tago moto piji toro Babilônia moto jagwai aino toro. – Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore.
source: – Tare tabu jodo tawai tadawu santo doge egorai tamago pemegawo ei tawo pao kurirewugedo emage. Ia iere Moloque. Metia iere Renfã. Tagoredure nowu Moloque uwairogu tabo tagodurewu jamedu boe ji. Tagoredure nowu Renfã uwairogu tabo jamedu. Tagagore nowu Renfã uwai roguie nono kuieje mogadure. Tare tagera ra ipiji tamearutoruwo nowu tawai tadawu santo dogei. Dukodire imode tadudo tago moto piji toro Babilônia moto jagwai aino toro. – Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore.

b: Estêvão mako kimore. Akore nou pawobe eragojere nowu boe maerewu keje dukeje ere Pao Kurirewu uwairogu mugudo. Pao Kurirewu ure Moisés joruduwado dukodire ere nowu bairogu mugudo aino.
source: Estêvão mako kimore. Akore nou pawobe eragojere nowu boe maerewu keje dukeje ere Pao Kurirewu uwairogu mugudo. Pao Kurirewu ure Moisés joruduwado dukodire ere nowu bairogu mugudo aino.

b: Nou pawobe Israel doge ere nowu Pao Kurirewu uwairogu maku tore etai. Ere tugeragu nowu boe pegarewuge eno moto ji Josué apo dukeje enoredure tabo. Eture nowu moto ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure nowu boe pegarewuge etudo epiji. Nou Pao Kurirewu uwairogu mugure ebo jii toro ekimijera kurirewu Davi muguredu ka.
source: Nou pawobe Israel doge ere nowu Pao Kurirewu uwairogu maku tore etai. Ere tugeragu nowu boe pegarewuge eno moto ji Josué apo dukeje enoredure tabo. Eture nowu moto ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure nowu boe pegarewuge etudo epiji. Nou Pao Kurirewu uwairogu mugure ebo jii toro ekimijera kurirewu Davi muguredu ka.

b: Pao Kurirewu aidure rugadu nowu Daviji. Mare Davi makore Pao Kurirewu ji taiduie tuwo ia bai kurirewu to Pao Kurirewu uwaice. Jacó mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu uwaice.
source: Pao Kurirewu aidure rugadu nowu Daviji. Mare Davi makore Pao Kurirewu ji taiduie tuwo ia bai kurirewu to Pao Kurirewu uwaice. Jacó mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu uwaice.

b: Nou Davi ukare nowu bai towuje mare onaregedu Salomão ure towuje rugadu.
source: Nou Davi ukare nowu bai towuje mare onaregedu Salomão ure towuje rugadu.

b: – Mare ainore inagomode tai. Pao Kurirewu mugumodukare ime ere towu bai tada. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore:
source: – Mare ainore inagomode tai. Pao Kurirewu mugumodukare ime ere towu bai tada. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore:

b: – Imugure baru tada. Iwure emode tamudo moto keje. Boe emodukare ia bai towuje iwaice. Boe ere towu bai kurikare imuguwo ja tada.
source: – Imugure baru tada. Iwure emode tamudo moto keje. Boe emodukare ia bai towuje iwaice. Boe ere towu bai kurikare imuguwo ja tada.

b: – Imire ire boe jamedu boe towuje. – Ainore Pao kurirewu akore.
source: – Imire ire boe jamedu boe towuje. – Ainore Pao kurirewu akore.

b: Ca nowu Estêvão mako kimore nowu Judeu doge eimijeragei. Akore tamearutoru bokwa! Tamearudae pega! Tawija bokwa! Tamearudukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji! Tare nono jawu pawobe mogadure. Tagaidukare tawiapagawo Pao Kurirewu Uwari bataru ji tu tu je.
source: Ca nowu Estêvão mako kimore nowu Judeu doge eimijeragei. Akore tamearutoru bokwa! Tamearudae pega! Tawija bokwa! Tamearudukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji! Tare nono jawu pawobe mogadure. Tagaidukare tawiapagawo Pao Kurirewu Uwari bataru ji tu tu je.

b: Mariguduwuge pawobe ero pegare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Mariguduwuge pawobe ere makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ewido. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere boe ewie marigudu Pao Kurirewu Utugare Pemegarewu aregodumoduie duji. Ca aregodure rugadu. Jesusnure ema. Mare tarore Jesus ji nono ro pegarewu mogadure. Tare bito.
source: Mariguduwuge pawobe ero pegare makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Mariguduwuge pawobe ere makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ewido. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere boe ewie marigudu Pao Kurirewu Utugare Pemegarewu aregodumoduie duji. Ca aregodure rugadu. Jesusnure ema. Mare tarore Jesus ji nono ro pegarewu mogadure. Tare bito.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru maku tagai tago bakaruwo ema. Utugarege baru tadawuge ere nowu o bakaru reko boe ewagai mare emearutorukare ji.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru maku tagai tago bakaruwo ema. Utugarege baru tadawuge ere nowu o bakaru reko boe ewagai mare emearutorukare ji.

b: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Ere Estêvão Bito Tori Tabo
source: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Ere Estêvão Bito Tori Tabo

b: Nou Judeu doge eimijerage emearudure nowu Estêvão bataru ji dukeje ekorigodure rugadu. Ere to reko pui tugoridure dukodi.
source: Nou Judeu doge eimijerage emearudure nowu Estêvão bataru ji dukeje ekorigodure rugadu. Ere to reko pui tugoridure dukodi.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure Estêvão rakado rugadu nowu Tuwari apo. Aiwore baru to dukeje jorudure Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewuji. Nono Jorudure Jesus ji. Rakojere Pao Kurirewu meki.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure Estêvão rakado rugadu nowu Tuwari apo. Aiwore baru to dukeje jorudure Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewuji. Nono Jorudure Jesus ji. Rakojere Pao Kurirewu meki.

b: Estêvão akore Tagaiwodo. Iorudure baru jadodure duji. Imedu Onaregedu Jesus rakojere tuo meki.
source: Estêvão akore Tagaiwodo. Iorudure baru jadodure duji. Imedu Onaregedu Jesus rakojere tuo meki.

b: Nou boe eimijerage ekudugodure tugorigodure dukodi. Ere tugera bu tuwija keje tumearudukawo nowu Estêvão makore jiboe ji pugeje. Dukeje eregodure Estêvão ae.
source: Nou boe eimijerage ekudugodure tugorigodure dukodi. Ere tugera bu tuwija keje tumearudukawo nowu Estêvão makore jiboe ji pugeje. Dukeje eregodure Estêvão ae.

b: Ere tugeragu ji. Ere tawuje toro nowu ba kurirewu piji. Dukeje eidore tori tabo ji. Ere tugudau biaku epa areia tawuje tubiji tugidowo nowu tori tabo ji. Ere nowu tugudau areia maku ia iparedu ai jetu pemegawo ji. Nou iparedu iere Saulo.
source: Ere tugeragu ji. Ere tawuje toro nowu ba kurirewu piji. Dukeje eidore tori tabo ji. Ere tugudau biaku epa areia tawuje tubiji tugidowo nowu tori tabo ji. Ere nowu tugudau areia maku ia iparedu ai jetu pemegawo ji. Nou iparedu iere Saulo.

b: Eidore tori tabo Estêvãoji kimo dukeje Estêvão mako rakare tugimijera Jesus bagai. Akore ikimijera Jesus! Iwimode dukeje akeragu i.
source: Eidore tori tabo Estêvãoji kimo dukeje Estêvão mako rakare tugimijera Jesus bagai. Akore ikimijera Jesus! Iwimode dukeje akeragu i.

b: Estêvão ure tubu jodo moto keje dukeje kudugodure pugeje. Akore ikimijera Jesus. Awiabutukaba awu ero pegare idu keje! Estêvão makore aino dukeje bire.
source: Estêvão ure tubu jodo moto keje dukeje kudugodure pugeje. Akore ikimijera Jesus. Awiabutukaba awu ero pegare idu keje! Estêvão makore aino dukeje bire.

b: Saulo Ro Pegare Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei
source: Saulo Ro Pegare Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei

b: Saulo aidure nowu tugimijerage eroino duji, ere Estêvão bito duji. Nou inodu otobiji boe ero pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei rugadu. Dukodire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere taodo Jerusalém piji toro Judéia moto ka, Samaria moto ka. Tu nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge edu kimore Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada.
source: Saulo aidure nowu tugimijerage eroino duji, ere Estêvão bito duji. Nou inodu otobiji boe ero pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei rugadu. Dukodire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere taodo Jerusalém piji toro Judéia moto ka, Samaria moto ka. Tu nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge edu kimore Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada.

b: Aidu kurire Pao Kurirewu jiwu ime ere Estêvão tugu mototo. Etragudure joki.
source: Aidu kurire Pao Kurirewu jiwu ime ere Estêvão tugu mototo. Etragudure joki.

b: Mare Saulo aidure tuwo mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etagedudo. Uture boe ewai jamedu boe ji mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai. Ure tugeragu ei tuwo etugu baicorewuto.
source: Mare Saulo aidure tuwo mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etagedudo. Uture boe ewai jamedu boe ji mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai. Ure tugeragu ei tuwo etugu baicorewuto.

b: Boe Ere Boe Ewie Pao Kurirewu Bataru Pemegarewu ji Samaria Moto Keje
source: Boe Ere Boe Ewie Pao Kurirewu Bataru Pemegarewu ji Samaria Moto Keje

b: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere taodo moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukeje ere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji.
source: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere taodo moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukeje ere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji.

b: Filipe uture Samaria ba kurirewu ka. Ure nowu boe eruduwado Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji.
source: Filipe uture Samaria ba kurirewu ka. Ure nowu boe eruduwado Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji.

b: Nou Samaria kejewu boe ewiapaga pemegare nowu Filipe makore jiboe ji. Etaiwo pemegare nowu Filipe ro rakare duji.
source: Nou Samaria kejewu boe ewiapaga pemegare nowu Filipe makore jiboe ji. Etaiwo pemegare nowu Filipe ro rakare duji.

b: Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Nou bope doge ewari ere tudawuje boe piji tugudu tabo. Dukeje ure pogora pegarewuge emerudo. Ure meru bokwarewuge emerudo jamedu. Emagare rugadu.
source: Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Nou bope doge ewari ere tudawuje boe piji tugudu tabo. Dukeje ure pogora pegarewuge emerudo. Ure meru bokwarewuge emerudo jamedu. Emagare rugadu.

b: Dukodire nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge egarere pudui rugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge egarere pudui rugadu.

b: Ia imedu iere Simão. Mugure nowu ba kurirewu tada. Akore bari nuie pudumi. Marigudu ure boe erududo turore jiboe ji boe emearutoruwo pudui duji.
source: Ia imedu iere Simão. Mugure nowu ba kurirewu tada. Akore bari nuie pudumi. Marigudu ure boe erududo turore jiboe ji boe emearutoruwo pudui duji.

b: Nou ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe emearutorure ji. Boe kurirewuge. Marenarue doge. Eiamedu boe egore awu Simão raka ure nono Pao Kurirewu raka mogadure. Iere Imedu Rakarewu.
source: Nou ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe emearutorure ji. Boe kurirewuge. Marenarue doge. Eiamedu boe egore awu Simão raka ure nono Pao Kurirewu raka mogadure. Iere Imedu Rakarewu.

b: Marigudu Simão ure erodo ta je turore jiboe ji dukodire emearutorure ji rugadu.
source: Marigudu Simão ure erodo ta je turore jiboe ji dukodire emearutorure ji rugadu.

b: Mare emearutorure Filipe bataru ji dukodire etao pegododure. Emearutorure Jesus ji. Emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji boe eiamedu boe eimijeranure ema duji rugadu. Ime areme etao pegododure rugadu.
source: Mare emearutorure Filipe bataru ji dukodire etao pegododure. Emearutorure Jesus ji. Emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji boe eiamedu boe eimijeranure ema duji rugadu. Ime areme etao pegododure rugadu.

b: Simão jamedu mearutorure ji. Ao pegododure dukeje uture Filipe apo. Jorudure Filipe ro rakare duji, ro kurirewu ji dukeje je rore ta je.
source: Simão jamedu mearutorure ji. Ao pegododure dukeje uture Filipe apo. Jorudure Filipe ro rakare duji, ro kurirewu ji dukeje je rore ta je.

b: Jerusalém kejewuge nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge emearudure nowu Samaria moto kejewuge emearutoruie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji duji. Dukodire ere Pedro utudo toro nowu Samaria moto kejewuge etae. Ere João utudo etae jamedu.
source: Jerusalém kejewuge nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge emearudure nowu Samaria moto kejewuge emearutoruie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji duji. Dukodire ere Pedro utudo toro nowu Samaria moto kejewuge etae. Ere João utudo etae jamedu.

b: Etaregodure toro dukeje emagore baru to nowu mearutorure maigoduwuge eparu tabo Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregoduwo etae jamedu.
source: Etaregodure toro dukeje emagore baru to nowu mearutorure maigoduwuge eparu tabo Pao Kurirewu Uwari aregoduwo etae jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ukare turawuje etae raga. Etao pegododure tu je emearutorure Jesus ji kodi.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ukare turawuje etae raga. Etao pegododure tu je emearutorure Jesus ji kodi.

b: Dukejere Pedro João ere tugera bu nowu mearutorure maigoduwuge boe etao keje. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje etae tuwo eraga maku etai.
source: Dukejere Pedro João ere tugera bu nowu mearutorure maigoduwuge boe etao keje. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje etae tuwo eraga maku etai.

b: Simão jorudure nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae dukeje aidure tuwo diero maku Pedro ai João ai.
source: Simão jorudure nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae dukeje aidure tuwo diero maku Pedro ai João ai.

b: Akore nou taraga maku inai jamedu iwo nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari maku ire ikera bu kejewuge etai jamedu.
source: Akore nou taraga maku inai jamedu iwo nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari maku ire ikera bu kejewuge etai jamedu.

b: Mare Pedro akore amearudaere awo akirodo Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwu Uwariji diero tabo. Nou amearudae pega. Atudo ako diero rugadu boe tabo boe pegarewuto.
source: Mare Pedro akore amearudaere awo akirodo Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwu Uwariji diero tabo. Nou amearudae pega. Atudo ako diero rugadu boe tabo boe pegarewuto.

b: Aromodukare nono cerore jiboe ji. Amaragodumodukare cedabo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ai kodi. Amearudaekare amearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Amearudaere tu amearudae pegarewu ji rugadu.
source: Aromodukare nono cerore jiboe ji. Amaragodumodukare cedabo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ai kodi. Amearudaekare amearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Amearudaere tu amearudae pegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Ca akaidukaba nowu amearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Amagodo Pao Kurirewu ji biagoduwo nowu amearudae pegarewu piji.
source: Ca akaidukaba nowu amearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Amagodo Pao Kurirewu ji biagoduwo nowu amearudae pegarewu piji.

b: Iorudure akimaredure rugadu duji. Aro pegarewu ure tugeragu ai kodi.
source: Iorudure akimaredure rugadu duji. Aro pegarewu ure tugeragu ai kodi.

b: Simão makore Pedro ji, Joãoji. Akore tamagodo Pagimijeraji iparu tabo nowu tagagore jiwu boe pegarewu jetukawo i.
source: Simão makore Pedro ji, Joãoji. Akore tamagodo Pagimijeraji iparu tabo nowu tagagore jiwu boe pegarewu jetukawo i.

b: Nou Pedro nowu João ere boe ewie nuba boe eromode tumearutoruwo Jesus ji. Emagore Jesus rore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Dukeje eture tuibagi toro Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Eture dukeje emagore Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu Samaria kejewu boe doge ewiagai jamedu. Nou boe doge emagare nono nowu moto keje.
source: Nou Pedro nowu João ere boe ewie nuba boe eromode tumearutoruwo Jesus ji. Emagore Jesus rore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Dukeje eture tuibagi toro Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Eture dukeje emagore Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu Samaria kejewu boe doge ewiagai jamedu. Nou boe doge emagare nono nowu moto keje.

b: Filipe Makore Etiópia Kejewu Boe Eimijeraji
source: Filipe Makore Etiópia Kejewu Boe Eimijeraji

b: Ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu makore Filipiji. Akore ado arugadu. Atudo toro nowu Jerusalém pijiwu Gaza kawu awara ka. (Boe edukare nowu Gaza tada pugeje).
source: Ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu makore Filipiji. Akore ado arugadu. Atudo toro nowu Jerusalém pijiwu Gaza kawu awara ka. (Boe edukare nowu Gaza tada pugeje).

b: Dukodire Filipe ure tudo turugadu. Uture dukeje toro rugadu jorudure ia imeduji. Nou imedu Etiópia kejewunure ema. Nou Etiópia moto kejewuge eimijera kurirewu iere Candace. Aredunure ema. Nou Filipe jorudure jiwu imedu jeture tugimijera Candace o dieroji. Dukodi umaragodae reno. Filipe jorudure ji awara kajeje. Unure tugirimi Etiópia ka Jerusalém piji carreta tabo. Uture Jerusalém ka tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Aino ca uture tuibagi to moto ka taiwo tabo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Aiwore nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Isaías ure bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Dukodire Filipe ure tudo turugadu. Uture dukeje toro rugadu jorudure ia imeduji. Nou imedu Etiópia kejewunure ema. Nou Etiópia moto kejewuge eimijera kurirewu iere Candace. Aredunure ema. Nou Filipe jorudure jiwu imedu jeture tugimijera Candace o dieroji. Dukodi umaragodae reno. Filipe jorudure ji awara kajeje. Unure tugirimi Etiópia ka Jerusalém piji carreta tabo. Uture Jerusalém ka tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Aino ca uture tuibagi to moto ka taiwo tabo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Aiwore nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu Isaías ure bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Ca Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore Filipiji. Akore atudo toro nowu Etiópia kejewu imedu o carreta ka.
source: Ca Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore Filipiji. Akore atudo toro nowu Etiópia kejewu imedu o carreta ka.

b: Dukejere Filipe rekodure nowu carreta ka. Dukeje mearudure nowu Etiópia kejewu imedu bataru ji. Aiwore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tumago tabo tu pudui. Filipe mearudure nowu bataru ji. Dukodire unarare nowu Etiópia kejewu imeduji. Akore aruduware nowu akaiwore jiwu bataru ji?
source: Dukejere Filipe rekodure nowu carreta ka. Dukeje mearudure nowu Etiópia kejewu imedu bataru ji. Aiwore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tumago tabo tu pudui. Filipe mearudure nowu bataru ji. Dukodire unarare nowu Etiópia kejewu imeduji. Akore aruduware nowu akaiwore jiwu bataru ji?

b: Nou Etiópia kejewu imedu akore Boro. Ia boe edukare woe tuwo ioruduwado awu bataru ji. Dukeje makore Filipiji uwo taredo nowu carretato muguwo keje uwo tuioruduwado.
source: Nou Etiópia kejewu imedu akore Boro. Ia boe edukare woe tuwo ioruduwado awu bataru ji. Dukeje makore Filipiji uwo taredo nowu carretato muguwo keje uwo tuioruduwado.

b: Aiwore jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore aino: – Boe ere imedu bito nono boe emode ovelha bito dumogadure. Boe emode ovelha bu kado piji dukeje nowu ovelha makomodukare. Nou imedu makokare jamedu. Rore nono nowu ovelha ro mogadure.
source: Aiwore jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore aino: – Boe ere imedu bito nono boe emode ovelha bito dumogadure. Boe emode ovelha bu kado piji dukeje nowu ovelha makomodukare. Nou imedu makokare jamedu. Rore nono nowu ovelha ro mogadure.

b: – Ero pegare ji rugadu mare boe ekare nowu ero pegarewu morido etai pugeje. Tugodu mai dutabore bire dukodire ore bokware.
source: – Ero pegare ji rugadu mare boe ekare nowu ero pegarewu morido etai pugeje. Tugodu mai dutabore bire dukodire ore bokware.

b: Nou Etiópia kejewu boe eimijera makore Filipiji. Akore itaidure awo iwie. Nuba nowu ere bitowu iere? Pudui na nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu akoino kana? Ia boe ji na akoino kana?
source: Nou Etiópia kejewu boe eimijera makore Filipiji. Akore itaidure awo iwie. Nuba nowu ere bitowu iere? Pudui na nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu akoino kana? Ia boe ji na akoino kana?

b: Dukeje Filipe ure joruduwado nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu uie boe ewie turomodedu boe ji nowu bataru tabo. Mare paga karega Jesus jie Pao Kurirewu akoino. Jesus umoduie boe ekinorudo rugadu.
source: Dukeje Filipe ure joruduwado nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu uie boe ewie turomodedu boe ji nowu bataru tabo. Mare paga karega Jesus jie Pao Kurirewu akoino. Jesus umoduie boe ekinorudo rugadu.

b: Ekodu kimore awara ji nowu carreta tabo. Dukejere etaregodure ia kurugwa okwa ka. Nono nowu Etiópia kejewu boe eimijera akore Pobo reo. Ukana turugadu itao pegododuwo?
source: Ekodu kimore awara ji nowu carreta tabo. Dukejere etaregodure ia kurugwa okwa ka. Nono nowu Etiópia kejewu boe eimijera akore Pobo reo. Ukana turugadu itao pegododuwo?

b: Dutabore ure tuwuredo to carreta tabo nono. Emare ure turawuje carreta piji Filipe apo. Ere turemo poboto. Dukeje Filipe ure ao pegodo.
source: Dutabore ure tuwuredo to carreta tabo nono. Emare ure turawuje carreta piji Filipe apo. Ere turemo poboto. Dukeje Filipe ure ao pegodo.

b: Ere tudawuje pobo piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Filipe tawuje piji pugeje. Nou Etiópia kejewu boe eimijera jorudukare nowu Filipiji pugeje. Mare uture pugeje tiegarere pudui dutabo rugadu.
source: Ere tudawuje pobo piji dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Filipe tawuje piji pugeje. Nou Etiópia kejewu boe eimijera jorudukare nowu Filipiji pugeje. Mare uture pugeje tiegarere pudui dutabo rugadu.

b: Rore puku Filipiji turagojere Azoto ba kurirewu keje duji. Nono uture toro Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Nou Cesaréia kawu awara keje ure boe eiamedu boe ewie Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji rugadu.
source: Rore puku Filipiji turagojere Azoto ba kurirewu keje duji. Nono uture toro Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Nou Cesaréia kawu awara keje ure boe eiamedu boe ewie Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Saulo Mearutorumode Jesus ji
source: Saulo Mearutorumode Jesus ji

b: Saulo ro pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei kimo. Akore tumoduie ewido rugadu. Aidure tuduwo Damasco ba kurirewu ka taiwowo rore Jesus ro jiwuge ewagai tuwo tugeragu ei tuwo erego pudabo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwo etugu baicorewuto nono. Dukodire uture nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ae tuwo tugeragu nowu atugo padure kejewu baperaji tuduwo tabo toro Damasco ka. Nou bapera umode nowu Damasco kejewu Judeu doge eimijerage eruduwado nuba Saulo romode nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei, imei aremei.
source: Saulo ro pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei kimo. Akore tumoduie ewido rugadu. Aidure tuduwo Damasco ba kurirewu ka taiwowo rore Jesus ro jiwuge ewagai tuwo tugeragu ei tuwo erego pudabo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwo etugu baicorewuto nono. Dukodire uture nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ae tuwo tugeragu nowu atugo padure kejewu baperaji tuduwo tabo toro Damasco ka. Nou bapera umode nowu Damasco kejewu Judeu doge eimijerage eruduwado nuba Saulo romode nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei, imei aremei.
editorial_note: A fonte agrupa os versículos 1–2 sem numeração; faixa inferida na importação.

b: Saulo ure tugeragu nowu baperaji dukeje uture. Puredugodure nowu Damasco ba kurirewu ji dukeje rore puku je ia jorugu aregodure baru piji duji.
source: Saulo ure tugeragu nowu baperaji dukeje uture. Puredugodure nowu Damasco ba kurirewu ji dukeje rore puku je ia jorugu aregodure baru piji duji.

b: Dukejere buture moto keje. Mearudure iaboe mako ji. Akore Saulonure aki. Kodiba aro pegare i?
source: Dukejere buture moto keje. Mearudure iaboe mako ji. Akore Saulonure aki. Kodiba aro pegare i?

b: Saulo akore Kakojiwu ba ure aki? Nono akore Jesusnure imi. Aro peganure i.
source: Saulo akore Kakojiwu ba ure aki? Nono akore Jesusnure imi. Aro peganure i.

b: Ca aragojedo. Atudo toro Damasco ba kurirewu ka. Ia imedu umode awie aromode jiboe ji.
source: Ca aragojedo. Atudo toro Damasco ba kurirewu ka. Ia imedu umode awie aromode jiboe ji.

b: Nou uture Saulo apowuge ime ere tuwuredo jamedu. Emagokare boe ji. Emearudure nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji jamedu. Mare erudukare boe ji.
source: Nou uture Saulo apowuge ime ere tuwuredo jamedu. Emagokare boe ji. Emearudure nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji jamedu. Mare erudukare boe ji.

b: Saulo ure turagojedo. Ure tuioku jado mare joku bokware. Dukodire nowu uture apowu ime ere tugeragu ji tugera tabo tuduwo apo toro Damasco ba kurirewu ka.
source: Saulo ure turagojedo. Ure tuioku jado mare joku bokware. Dukodire nowu uture apowu ime ere tugeragu ji tugera tabo tuduwo apo toro Damasco ba kurirewu ka.

b: Merire pobe metia bokware ji joku bokware dukeje. Dukodire okwagekare kudukare poboce jamedu.
source: Merire pobe metia bokware ji joku bokware dukeje. Dukodire okwagekare kudukare poboce jamedu.

b: Damasco keje ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu imedu iere Ananias. Nou Ananias jorudure ia iaboe ji. Uniau mogadure dupiji Jesus makore ji. Akore ananias. Ananias akore Imireo.
source: Damasco keje ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu imedu iere Ananias. Nou Ananias jorudure ia iaboe ji. Uniau mogadure dupiji Jesus makore ji. Akore ananias. Ananias akore Imireo.

b: Jesus akore ado arugadu. Atudo toro Judas uwai ka. Nou Judas uwai mugure kejewu awara iere Awara Jetororewu. Nou Judas uwai kejere amagomode Saulo bagai. Nou Saulo Tarso ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Emare makore baru to.
source: Jesus akore ado arugadu. Atudo toro Judas uwai ka. Nou Judas uwai mugure kejewu awara iere Awara Jetororewu. Nou Judas uwai kejere amagomode Saulo bagai. Nou Saulo Tarso ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Emare makore baru to.

b: Dukodi jorudure ia iaboe ji. Tuiorudure jiboe piji jorudure ai. Are aremo pudae tumugure kejewu baito duji. Nono are akera bu ao keje joku pemegagoduwo pugeje.
source: Dukodi jorudure ia iaboe ji. Tuiorudure jiboe piji jorudure ai. Are aremo pudae tumugure kejewu baito duji. Nono are akera bu ao keje joku pemegagoduwo pugeje.

b: Ananias akore Ikimijeranure aki. Mare boe ere iwie nowu imedu Saulo ro pegarewuji. Emare ro pegare mearutorure aiwugei rugadu Jerusalém keje.
source: Ananias akore Ikimijeranure aki. Mare boe ere iwie nowu imedu Saulo ro pegarewuji. Emare ro pegare mearutorure aiwugei rugadu Jerusalém keje.

b: Aregodure mato turo pegawo nowu mako pemegare aiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere tugie maku ai rugadu ro pegawo rugadu.
source: Aregodure mato turo pegawo nowu mako pemegare aiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere tugie maku ai rugadu ro pegawo rugadu.

b: Jesus akore atudo Saulo ae rugadu. Ire ikeragu ji maragoduwo inai. Emare umode boe tuginaiwuge eruduwado i. Umode boe eimijerage eruduwado i. Umode Israel doge eruduwado i.
source: Jesus akore atudo Saulo ae rugadu. Ire ikeragu ji maragoduwo inai. Emare umode boe tuginaiwuge eruduwado i. Umode boe eimijerage eruduwado i. Umode Israel doge eruduwado i.

b: Saulo mearutorumode i rugadu. Boe rakamode ji jamedu. Mare imire imode bie nowu boe rakamode jituji.
source: Saulo mearutorumode i rugadu. Boe rakamode ji jamedu. Mare imire imode bie nowu boe rakamode jituji.

b: Nou Ananias uniau akedure dukeje uture Saulo bagai rugadu. Ure turemo nowu Saulo rakojere tadawu baito. Ure tugera bu Saulo aora keje. Makore ji. Akore amearutorure Jesus ji dukodi iwobenure aki. Jesus koiare ure itarego mato akae. Emare ure arududo pudui toro awara keje. Ure itarego mato akae iwo aku pemegado pugeje, Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojewo akabo.
source: Nou Ananias uniau akedure dukeje uture Saulo bagai rugadu. Ure turemo nowu Saulo rakojere tadawu baito. Ure tugera bu Saulo aora keje. Makore ji. Akore amearutorure Jesus ji dukodi iwobenure aki. Jesus koiare ure itarego mato akae. Emare ure arududo pudui toro awara keje. Ure itarego mato akae iwo aku pemegado pugeje, Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojewo akabo.

b: Ananias akoino dukeje care ia iaboe ure tudawuje Saulo joku piji. Ure nono karo botore. Nono Saulo joku pemegagodure pugeje. Ure turagojedo. Ao pegododure jamedu.
source: Ananias akoino dukeje care ia iaboe ure tudawuje Saulo joku piji. Ure nono karo botore. Nono Saulo joku pemegagodure pugeje. Ure turagojedo. Ao pegododure jamedu.

b: Nono okwagere dukodire rakare pugeje. Saulo rakoje raikare mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo Damasco ba kurirewu keje.
source: Nono okwagere dukodire rakare pugeje. Saulo rakoje raikare mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo Damasco ba kurirewu keje.

b: Saulo Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataruji Damasco Kejewu Boe Doge Ewiagai
source: Saulo Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataruji Damasco Kejewu Boe Doge Ewiagai

b: Uture Judeu doge etae ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore makore ei Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu nuie Jesusce.
source: Uture Judeu doge etae ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore makore ei Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu nuie Jesusce.

b: Mearudure jiwuge eiamedu boe ebogodure ji. egore awu Saulo emare ure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewido Jerusalém keje. Emare aregodure mato tuwo tugeragu nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei tuwo erego Jerusalém ka tuwo emagu nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etai. Mare rokare aino pugeje.
source: Mearudure jiwuge eiamedu boe ebogodure ji. egore awu Saulo emare ure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewido Jerusalém keje. Emare aregodure mato tuwo tugeragu nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei tuwo erego Jerusalém ka tuwo emagu nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etai. Mare rokare aino pugeje.

b: Dukodire Saulo mako pemegare rugadu. Roiware tuwo boe etaora mekido rugadu tuwo Pao Kurirewu mearudae maku etai. Makore ewiagai tuioruduwa tabo Jesus umode boe ekinorudowu nuie ema duji. Dukodire nowu Damasco kejewu Judeu doge eroiwakare tumagowo nowu Saulo bataru jipagi.
source: Dukodire Saulo mako pemegare rugadu. Roiware tuwo boe etaora mekido rugadu tuwo Pao Kurirewu mearudae maku etai. Makore ewiagai tuioruduwa tabo Jesus umode boe ekinorudowu nuie ema duji. Dukodire nowu Damasco kejewu Judeu doge eroiwakare tumagowo nowu Saulo bataru jipagi.

b: Meri raire ji nono. Dukeje Judeu doge ere bato pui tuwo tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo Saulo bito.
source: Meri raire ji nono. Dukeje Judeu doge ere bato pui tuwo tumearudae pegarewu tawuje tuwo Saulo bito.

b: Etaiwore nowu ba kurirewu bai poroji meri ji boeco ji tuwo tugeragu Sauloji tuwo bito. Mare ia boe ure Saulo bie nowu emearudae pegarewuji.
source: Etaiwore nowu ba kurirewu bai poroji meri ji boeco ji tuwo tugeragu Sauloji tuwo bito. Mare ia boe ure Saulo bie nowu emearudae pegarewuji.

b: Ia boeco ji aidure Saulo jiwuge eture apo nowu ure taiado nowu ba kurirewu tabowu moto ri ao ka ia baito. Dukeje nowu moto ri ao piji, nowu bai piji ere Saulo tugu tugodaraboto dukeje ere rawuje toro moto ka. Dukodire Saulo uture Damasco piji.
source: Ia boeco ji aidure Saulo jiwuge eture apo nowu ure taiado nowu ba kurirewu tabowu moto ri ao ka ia baito. Dukeje nowu moto ri ao piji, nowu bai piji ere Saulo tugu tugodaraboto dukeje ere rawuje toro moto ka. Dukodire Saulo uture Damasco piji.

b: Saulo Rakojere Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Saulo Rakojere Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: Saulo uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Aidure turagojewo Jesus ure joruduwadowugebo nono. Mare emearutorukare ji. Epagudure ce.
source: Saulo uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Aidure turagojewo Jesus ure joruduwadowugebo nono. Mare emearutorukare ji. Epagudure ce.

b: Nono Barnabé ure tugera maku ai. Ure Saulo reko nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae. Ure ewie nowu Saulo joruduie Jesus ji awara keje duji. Jesus makoie nowu Sauloji. Ure ewie Saulo rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji Damasco keje. Saulo uie boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji rugadu.
source: Nono Barnabé ure tugera maku ai. Ure Saulo reko nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae. Ure ewie nowu Saulo joruduie Jesus ji awara keje duji. Jesus makoie nowu Sauloji. Ure ewie Saulo rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji Damasco keje. Saulo uie boe eruduwado Jesus jiboe ji rugadu.

b: Barnabé makore aino ei dukeje etaidu pemegare nowu Sauloji. Saulo rakojere ebo. Uture Jerusalém jamedu boe ji tumagowo boe ji Jesus jiboe ji.
source: Barnabé makore aino ei dukeje etaidu pemegare nowu Sauloji. Saulo rakojere ebo. Uture Jerusalém jamedu boe ji tumagowo boe ji Jesus jiboe ji.

b: Mako raire nowu joruduware Grécia bataru jiwu Judeu dogei. Mare etaidure tuwo Saulo bito.
source: Mako raire nowu joruduware Grécia bataru jiwu Judeu dogei. Mare etaidure tuwo Saulo bito.

b: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eruduware nowu emearudae pegarewu ji dukeje ere Saulo reko Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka tuwo utudo toro Tarso ba kurirewu ka, nowu ricodure kejewu ba kurirewu ka.
source: Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eruduware nowu emearudae pegarewu ji dukeje ere Saulo reko Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka tuwo utudo toro Tarso ba kurirewu ka, nowu ricodure kejewu ba kurirewu ka.

b: Aino nowu Judéia kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge, nowu Galiléia kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge, nowu Samaria kejewuge emearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere tamudo. Boe ero pegare eidu akedure kodi. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji tumearutoruwo ji rugadu dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure eragado, ure emagado pugeje.
source: Aino nowu Judéia kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge, nowu Galiléia kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge, nowu Samaria kejewuge emearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere tamudo. Boe ero pegare eidu akedure kodi. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji tumearutoruwo ji rugadu dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure eragado, ure emagado pugeje.

b: Pedro Uture Lida Ba Kurirewu Ka, Jope Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Pedro Uture Lida Ba Kurirewu Ka, Jope Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Pedro uture moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Ia meri keje aregodure Lida ba kurirewu ka. Aidure tuioruduwo mearutorure Jesus jiwugei nono.
source: Pedro uture moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Ia meri keje aregodure Lida ba kurirewu ka. Aidure tuioruduwo mearutorure Jesus jiwugei nono.

b: Aregodure toro dukeje jorudure ia imeduji. Iere Enéias. Nou Enéias ukare turagojedo kejewu joru oto padure oito pogora kugudure dukodi.
source: Aregodure toro dukeje jorudure ia imeduji. Iere Enéias. Nou Enéias ukare turagojedo kejewu joru oto padure oito pogora kugudure dukodi.

b: Pedro makore ji. Akore Jesus Cristo unure apemegago. Aragojedo. Akeragu apadure kejewu kodoji. Ca nowu Enéias ure turagojedo taci je tugudau kodo tabo.
source: Pedro makore ji. Akore Jesus Cristo unure apemegago. Aragojedo. Akeragu apadure kejewu kodoji. Ca nowu Enéias ure turagojedo taci je tugudau kodo tabo.

b: Nou Lida kejewuge eiamedu erudure nowu inoduji. Nou Sarom ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe erudure nowu inoduji jamedu. Dukodire ere tugera ra tumearutorure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo tu Jesus ji.
source: Nou Lida kejewuge eiamedu erudure nowu inoduji. Nou Sarom ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe erudure nowu inoduji jamedu. Dukodire ere tugera ra tumearutorure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo tu Jesus ji.

b: Jope ba kurirewu kejere ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu aredu iere Tabita. Iere Dorcas jamedu. Ro pemegare boe ji meri jamedu ji. Ure tugera maku marenarue doge etai rugadu.
source: Jope ba kurirewu kejere ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu aredu iere Tabita. Iere Dorcas jamedu. Ro pemegare boe ji meri jamedu ji. Ure tugera maku marenarue doge etai rugadu.

b: Ia meri keje kogodure. Nono bire kuri rugadu. Boe ere nowu birewu pemegado dukeje ere tugu ia baito.
source: Ia meri keje kogodure. Nono bire kuri rugadu. Boe ere nowu birewu pemegado dukeje ere tugu ia baito.

b: Jope ba kurirewu jakare Lida ba kurirewu piji. Dukodire nowu Jope kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure Pedro rakojeie Lida keje duji. Dukodire ere ime pobedu doge etudo toro Pedro bagai. Etaregodure ae dukeje emagore ji: – Mato cedabo amara tabo.
source: Jope ba kurirewu jakare Lida ba kurirewu piji. Dukodire nowu Jope kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure Pedro rakojeie Lida keje duji. Dukodire ere ime pobedu doge etudo toro Pedro bagai. Etaregodure ae dukeje emagore ji: – Mato cedabo amara tabo.

b: Dukodire Pedro ure tudo turugadu. Uture ebo Jope ba kurirewu ka. Etaregodure toro dukeje ere Pedro remo nowu birewu padure tadawu baito. Areme ere tuburedo Pedro ji tragudu tabo. Ere Pedro jorududo nowu Dorcas maragodae pemegarewuji. Nou aredu Dorcas areia midodu epanure ema.
source: Dukodire Pedro ure tudo turugadu. Uture ebo Jope ba kurirewu ka. Etaregodure toro dukeje ere Pedro remo nowu birewu padure tadawu baito. Areme ere tuburedo Pedro ji tragudu tabo. Ere Pedro jorududo nowu Dorcas maragodae pemegarewuji. Nou aredu Dorcas areia midodu epanure ema.

b: Pedro makore nowu boe ji ewo tudawuje nowu bai piji. Nono ure tubu jodo moto keje. Makore baru to dukeje makore nowu birewudoji. Akore are. Aragojedo. Ca nowu aredu ure tuioku jado. Jorudure Pedro ji dukeje ure tumugudo.
source: Pedro makore nowu boe ji ewo tudawuje nowu bai piji. Nono ure tubu jodo moto keje. Makore baru to dukeje makore nowu birewudoji. Akore are. Aragojedo. Ca nowu aredu ure tuioku jado. Jorudure Pedro ji dukeje ure tumugudo.

b: Pedro ure tugera maku ai uwo turagojedo. Dukeje makore mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai, nowu oragudurewu areme ewagai. Nono ure erududo ji. Bikare pugeje duji.
source: Pedro ure tugera maku ai uwo turagojedo. Dukeje makore mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai, nowu oragudurewu areme ewagai. Nono ure erududo ji. Bikare pugeje duji.

b: Nou rore ainodu ure tumaedo nowu ba kurirewu Jope jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe emagare tumearutorure Jesus jitu tabo.
source: Nou rore ainodu ure tumaedo nowu ba kurirewu Jope jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe emagare tumearutorure Jesus jitu tabo.

b: Pedro rakoje raire nowu Jope ba kurirewu keje. Mugure ia maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu uwai keje. Nou imedu iere Simão.
source: Pedro rakoje raire nowu Jope ba kurirewu keje. Mugure ia maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu uwai keje. Nou imedu iere Simão.

b: Pedro Uture Imedu Cornélio Ae
source: Pedro Uture Imedu Cornélio Ae

b: Ia imedu iere Cornélio. Mugure Cesaréia ba kurirewu keje. Judeu karegure ema. Romano doge tugobaigarege eimijeranure ema. Nou Romano doge tugobaigarege ekiere “Italiano doge”.
source: Ia imedu iere Cornélio. Mugure Cesaréia ba kurirewu keje. Judeu karegure ema. Romano doge tugobaigarege eimijeranure ema. Nou Romano doge tugobaigarege ekiere “Italiano doge”.

b: Nou Cornélio aidure Pao Kurirewu ji. Ema uwobe eiamedu boe eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji tumearutoruwo ji. Nou Cornélio ure tugera maku Judeu doge marenarue doge etai jamedu. Makore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tu tu je.
source: Nou Cornélio aidure Pao Kurirewu ji. Ema uwobe eiamedu boe eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji tumearutoruwo ji. Nou Cornélio ure tugera maku Judeu doge marenarue doge etai jamedu. Makore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tu tu je.

b: Ia meri keje merirekodutabo emare makore baru to pugeje. Makore dukeje jorudure jiboe ure nono uniau mogadure. Jorudure Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji. Ure turemo Cornélio uwaito dukeje makore ji. Akore cornélio.
source: Ia meri keje merirekodutabo emare makore baru to pugeje. Makore dukeje jorudure jiboe ure nono uniau mogadure. Jorudure Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji. Ure turemo Cornélio uwaito dukeje makore ji. Akore cornélio.

b: Cornélio aiwore tu nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji tubagudu tabo. Dukeje akore Imireo. Nou Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu akore Pao Kurirewu aidure rugadu aro pemegarewuji. Aidure amagore baru to duji. Umode amagore bagaiboe maku akai rugadu.
source: Cornélio aiwore tu nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji tubagudu tabo. Dukeje akore Imireo. Nou Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu akore Pao Kurirewu aidure rugadu aro pemegarewuji. Aidure amagore baru to duji. Umode amagore bagaiboe maku akai rugadu.

b: Ia ime etudo toro Jope ba kurirewu ka ia imedu bagai. Nou imedu iere Simão Pedro.
source: Ia ime etudo toro Jope ba kurirewu ka ia imedu bagai. Nou imedu iere Simão Pedro.

b: Emare mugure ia maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu uwai keje. Nou maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu iere Simão jamedu. Mugure pobo maerewu okwai.
source: Emare mugure ia maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu uwai keje. Nou maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu iere Simão jamedu. Mugure pobo maerewu okwai.

b: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu uture piji. Dukeje Cornélio makore tudugare pobedu doge ewagai. Makore ia tugobaigare bagai. Nou tugobaigare aidure Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu. Emare jetu pemegare nowu Cornélio oeji tu tu je.
source: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu uture piji. Dukeje Cornélio makore tudugare pobedu doge ewagai. Makore ia tugobaigare bagai. Nou tugobaigare aidure Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu. Emare jetu pemegare nowu Cornélio oeji tu tu je.

b: Cornélio readodure nowu tuniauji ewiagai dukeje ure etudo Jope ba kurirewu ka Pedro bagai.
source: Cornélio readodure nowu tuniauji ewiagai dukeje ure etudo Jope ba kurirewu ka Pedro bagai.

b: Nou barogwato etaregodukare raga dukeje Pedro ruture tuwai ao ka tumagowo baru to. Meri jeture pagaia keje.
source: Nou barogwato etaregodukare raga dukeje Pedro ruture tuwai ao ka tumagowo baru to. Meri jeture pagaia keje.

b: Dukeje uke boeire ji. Aidure togwagewo mare boe ekare uke pemegado raga. Nono jorudure ia iaboe ji.
source: Dukeje uke boeire ji. Aidure togwagewo mare boe ekare uke pemegado raga. Nono jorudure ia iaboe ji.

b: Jorudure baru ure tuiado duji. Jorudure ia boe ekudau areia kigadurewuji. Nou boe ekudau areia kurire, jadodure duji. Ure turawuje baru piji gu je.
source: Jorudure baru ure tuiado duji. Jorudure ia boe ekudau areia kigadurewuji. Nou boe ekudau areia kurire, jadodure duji. Ure turawuje baru piji gu je.

b: Nou boe ekudau kejere barege pegarewuge emugure, kiebarege pegarewuge emugure jamedu. Iage ere nono batrarewuge emogadure. Emugure keje jamedu.
source: Nou boe ekudau kejere barege pegarewuge emugure, kiebarege pegarewuge emugure jamedu. Iage ere nono batrarewuge emogadure. Emugure keje jamedu.

b: Nono ia boe makore Pedro ji baru piji. Akore Pedro. Aragojedo. Akeragu iaji awo bito, awo kowuje.
source: Nono ia boe makore Pedro ji baru piji. Akore Pedro. Aragojedo. Akeragu iaji awo bito, awo kowuje.

b: Mare Pedro aidukare. Nou Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu eno bakaru koiare emodukare nowu barege nowu kiebarege ekowuje. Dukodi Pedro akore Boro. Marigudu are mariguduwuge iwobe eno bakaru maku etai. Nou bakaru akore boe ekaiago ia barege ekowuje ekaiago ia kiebarege ekowuje. Akore emoduie kowuje dukeje epemegamodukaie turowo nowu bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji pugeje. Marigudu ikare nowu barege nowu kiebarege ekowuje rugadu jii aino. Aino imodukare ekowuje rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro aidukare. Nou Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu eno bakaru koiare emodukare nowu barege nowu kiebarege ekowuje. Dukodi Pedro akore Boro. Marigudu are mariguduwuge iwobe eno bakaru maku etai. Nou bakaru akore boe ekaiago ia barege ekowuje ekaiago ia kiebarege ekowuje. Akore emoduie kowuje dukeje epemegamodukaie turowo nowu bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji pugeje. Marigudu ikare nowu barege nowu kiebarege ekowuje rugadu jii aino. Aino imodukare ekowuje rugadu.

b: Mare nowu baru pijiwu makore pugeje. Akore Pao Kurirewunure imi. Imagomode ai ia barogo uie turugadu boe ewo ko dukeje akaidudo ji.
source: Mare nowu baru pijiwu makore pugeje. Akore Pao Kurirewunure imi. Imagomode ai ia barogo uie turugadu boe ewo ko dukeje akaidudo ji.

b: Pao Kurirewu akore ainodu ure pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care nowu boe ekudau areia kigadurewu ruture tuibagi kuri je baru to.
source: Pao Kurirewu akore ainodu ure pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care nowu boe ekudau areia kigadurewu ruture tuibagi kuri je baru to.

b: Pedro biagorore nowu tuiorudure jiboe ji. Aidure tuioruduwawo nuba boe mode. Dukeje nowu Cornélio ure etudowuge etaregodure nowu rakojere tadawu bai ka.
source: Pedro biagorore nowu tuiorudure jiboe ji. Aidure tuioruduwawo nuba boe mode. Dukeje nowu Cornélio ure etudowuge etaregodure nowu rakojere tadawu bai ka.

b: Emagore Pedro bagai. egore Simão Pedro mugure woe?
source: Emagore Pedro bagai. egore Simão Pedro mugure woe?

b: Pedro biagoro kimore nowu tuiorudure jiboe ji dukodire mearudukare nowu ime etaregodure pudae duji. Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore Pedro ji. Akore akaiwodo. Ime etaregodu awagai.
source: Pedro biagoro kimore nowu tuiorudure jiboe ji dukodire mearudukare nowu ime etaregodure pudae duji. Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore Pedro ji. Akore akaiwodo. Ime etaregodu awagai.

b: Ado arugadu atuwo ebo. Ire etarego mato awagai.
source: Ado arugadu atuwo ebo. Ire etarego mato awagai.

b: Dukodire Pedro ure turawuje nowu bai ao piji. Nono makore nowu imei. Akore iwagai na taroino? Kodiba tagaregodure woe?
source: Dukodire Pedro ure turawuje nowu bai ao piji. Nono makore nowu imei. Akore iwagai na taroino? Kodiba tagaregodure woe?

b: egore tugobaigarege eimijera Cornélio koiare ure cedudo mato awagai. Imedu pemegarewunure ema. Joku kidugore Pao Kurirewu jiwunure ema tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Judeu doge eiamedu boe etaidure ji. Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure cegimijera Cornélio joruduwado tumagowo awagai atuwo tuwai ka tumearuduwo awadaru ji.
source: egore tugobaigarege eimijera Cornélio koiare ure cedudo mato awagai. Imedu pemegarewunure ema. Joku kidugore Pao Kurirewu jiwunure ema tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Judeu doge eiamedu boe etaidure ji. Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure cegimijera Cornélio joruduwado tumagowo awagai atuwo tuwai ka tumearuduwo awadaru ji.

b: Nono Pedro ure eremo tuwaito enuduwo nono nowu boeco ji. Nou barogwato Pedro ure tudo turugadu dukeje uture ebo. Ia mugure Jope ba kurirewu kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture ebo jamedu.
source: Nono Pedro ure eremo tuwaito enuduwo nono nowu boeco ji. Nou barogwato Pedro ure tudo turugadu dukeje uture ebo. Ia mugure Jope ba kurirewu kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture ebo jamedu.

b: Nou barogwato pugeje etaregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Cornélio upagare ewagai nono tuwobebo tumagore bagaiwu tumedagebo jamedu.
source: Nou barogwato pugeje etaregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Cornélio upagare ewagai nono tuwobebo tumagore bagaiwu tumedagebo jamedu.

b: Pedro uiago turemo uwaito mare nowu Cornélio uture togi. Nono ure tubu jodo moto keje Pedro jokorai.
source: Pedro uiago turemo uwaito mare nowu Cornélio uture togi. Nono ure tubu jodo moto keje Pedro jokorai.

b: Mare Pedro ure rakojedo. Akore aragojedo. Imedunure imi. Pao Kurirewu karegure imi.
source: Mare Pedro ure rakojedo. Akore aragojedo. Imedunure imi. Pao Kurirewu karegure imi.

b: Nono Pedro makore nowu Cornélioji. Ere turemo baito. Nono Pedro jorudure nowu boe ji nowu bai ja tada. Emagare rugadu.
source: Nono Pedro makore nowu Cornélioji. Ere turemo baito. Nono Pedro jorudure nowu boe ji nowu bai ja tada. Emagare rugadu.

b: Makore ei. Akore tagi taruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Nou bakaru akore cedaregodukaiago ia boe tuginaiwuge ewai ka. Cemugukaiago ia boe tuginaiwugebo. Mare maigodu aino Pao Kurirewu ure ioruduwado tuwo imearudae pemegado boe tuginaiwuge ji. Boe pegarewuge kaiegure emage duji. Emodukaie cebegado duji.
source: Makore ei. Akore tagi taruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Nou bakaru akore cedaregodukaiago ia boe tuginaiwuge ewai ka. Cemugukaiago ia boe tuginaiwugebo. Mare maigodu aino Pao Kurirewu ure ioruduwado tuwo imearudae pemegado boe tuginaiwuge ji. Boe pegarewuge kaiegure emage duji. Emodukaie cebegado duji.

b: Dukodire itaregodure aino woe. Amagore iwagai dukeje iture mato. Ca. Kodiba akagoino iwagai?
source: Dukodire itaregodure aino woe. Amagore iwagai dukeje iture mato. Ca. Kodiba akagoino iwagai?

b: Cornélio akore Ia jawu meri ji imagore baru to iwai tada merirekodutabo. Irore puku ia imedu rakojere itogi duji. Ukudau kigadu maere ji.
source: Cornélio akore Ia jawu meri ji imagore baru to iwai tada merirekodutabo. Irore puku ia imedu rakojere itogi duji. Ukudau kigadu maere ji.

b: Emare makore i. Akore, “Pao Kurirewu mearudure akagoino baru to duji. Jorudure aro pemegarewuji.
source: Emare makore i. Akore, “Pao Kurirewu mearudure akagoino baru to duji. Jorudure aro pemegarewuji.

b: Ia boe utudo Jope ba kurirewu ka ia imedu bagai. Nou imedu iere Simão Pedro. Rakojere ia maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu uwai keje. Nou maragodure tapira biri urugudowu jiwu iere Simão jamedu. Mugure pobo maerewu okwai.”
source: Ia boe utudo Jope ba kurirewu ka ia imedu bagai. Nou imedu iere Simão Pedro. Rakojere ia maragodure tapira biri urugudowu imedu uwai keje. Nou maragodure tapira biri urugudowu jiwu iere Simão jamedu. Mugure pobo maerewu okwai.”

b: Dukodire imagore aino awagai. Ca akaregodure mato rugadu. Aino paragojere woe Pao Kurirewu apo. Cebaganure awagai awo cewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Dukodire imagore aino awagai. Ca akaregodure mato rugadu. Aino paragojere woe Pao Kurirewu apo. Cebaganure awagai awo cewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Pedro Umode Eruduwado Pao Kurirewu Bataruji
source: Pedro Umode Eruduwado Pao Kurirewu Bataruji

b: Nono Pedro makore ei. Akore aino ioruduwagodure Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Marigudu imearudaere Pao Kurirewu aidure tu Judeu dogei duji. Mare aino ioruduware Pao Kurirewu aidure boe eiamedu boe ji duji. Aidumode mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Aidumode rore Pao Kurirewu aidure jiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Aiwomodukare boe ewiriji boe ekudaeji. Aiwomode tu emearutorure puduidu bagai, ero pemegaredu bagai.
source: Nono Pedro makore ei. Akore aino ioruduwagodure Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Marigudu imearudaere Pao Kurirewu aidure tu Judeu dogei duji. Mare aino ioruduware Pao Kurirewu aidure boe eiamedu boe ji duji. Aidumode mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Aidumode rore Pao Kurirewu aidure jiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Aiwomodukare boe ewiriji boe ekudaeji. Aiwomode tu emearutorure puduidu bagai, ero pemegaredu bagai.

b: Taruduware Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu eno bataru ji. Ure pawie Jesus Cristo umoduie boe ekinorudo ewudugugoduwo. Jesus Cristo boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu.
source: Taruduware Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu eno bataru ji. Ure pawie Jesus Cristo umoduie boe ekinorudo ewudugugoduwo. Jesus Cristo boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu.

b: Taruduware nuba boere Judeu doge eno moto keje. João Batista ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Nouge ere tugera ra turo pegarewu piji dukeje João ure etao pegodo.
source: Taruduware nuba boere Judeu doge eno moto keje. João Batista ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Nouge ere tugera ra turo pegarewu piji dukeje João ure etao pegodo.

b: Dukeje Jesus ure boe erududo turoji Galiléia keje. Emare mugure Nazaré ba kurirewu keje. Pao Kurirewu ure Tuwari maku Jesus ai. Ure Jesus rakado rugadu. Dukeje uture nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje turo pemegarewu tabo. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji tuwo epemegago. Pao Kurirewu rakojere apo dukodire rore aino.
source: Dukeje Jesus ure boe erududo turoji Galiléia keje. Emare mugure Nazaré ba kurirewu keje. Pao Kurirewu ure Tuwari maku Jesus ai. Ure Jesus rakado rugadu. Dukeje uture nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje turo pemegarewu tabo. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji tuwo epemegago. Pao Kurirewu rakojere apo dukodire rore aino.

b: Cegi cerudure Jesus rore jiboe ji Israel moto keje. Cerudure rore jiboe ji Jerusalém keje. Iage ere Jesus bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Nonore ere bito nono.
source: Cegi cerudure Jesus rore jiboe ji Israel moto keje. Cerudure rore jiboe ji Jerusalém keje. Iage ere Jesus bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Nonore ere bito nono.

b: Mare merire pobe metia bokware dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus jewodudo pugeje.
source: Mare merire pobe metia bokware dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus jewodudo pugeje.

b: Ure boe erududo Jesus ji. Mare boe eiamedu karega. Ia cegi cerudure ji. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge erududo Jesus ji rugadu. Jesus jewodure dukeje cenogwagere apo, cegudure apo jamedu.
source: Ure boe erududo Jesus ji. Mare boe eiamedu karega. Ia cegi cerudure ji. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge erududo Jesus ji rugadu. Jesus jewodure dukeje cenogwagere apo, cegudure apo jamedu.

b: Makore cei cewo boe ewie tuwadaru pemegarewuji. Cewo boe ewie Pao Kurirewu ure boe eimijerado pudumi duji. Dukodire Jesus aiwomode jaoboe eroji, maiwu boe eroji jamedu ero pemegarewu bagai, ero pegarewu bagai.
source: Makore cei cewo boe ewie tuwadaru pemegarewuji. Cewo boe ewie Pao Kurirewu ure boe eimijerado pudumi duji. Dukodire Jesus aiwomode jaoboe eroji, maiwu boe eroji jamedu ero pemegarewu bagai, ero pegarewu bagai.

b: Dujire nowu jaoboe makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe emagore. Ere boe ewie Jesus biagodumoduie mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe ero pegare jiboe piji. Emearutorure Jesus ji dukodire biagodumode ero pegare jiboe jamedu boe piji rugadu.
source: Dujire nowu jaoboe makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe emagore. Ere boe ewie Jesus biagodumoduie mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe ero pegare jiboe piji. Emearutorure Jesus ji dukodire biagodumode ero pegare jiboe jamedu boe piji rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ure Turemo Boe Tuginaiwugeto Jamedu
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ure Turemo Boe Tuginaiwugeto Jamedu

b: Pedro makore aino dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje nowu mearudurewuge etae.
source: Pedro makore aino dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje nowu mearudurewuge etae.

b: Nou aregodure Pedro apowuge erore ta je nowu inoduji. Judeu dogenure emage. Emearutorure Jesus ji. Mare aino Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turemo boe tuginaiwugeto jamedu.
source: Nou aregodure Pedro apowuge erore ta je nowu inoduji. Judeu dogenure emage. Emearutorure Jesus ji. Mare aino Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turemo boe tuginaiwugeto jamedu.

b: Dukejere nowu boe tuginaiwuge emagore ia boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru tabo. Nono emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Pemegaie, kurie rugadu.
source: Dukejere nowu boe tuginaiwuge emagore ia boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru tabo. Nono emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Pemegaie, kurie rugadu.

b: Nono Pedro akore pugeje: – Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turemo awu boe tuginaiwugeto nono ure turemo cedo dumogadure. Ca ure turugadu etao pegododuwo jamedu.
source: Nono Pedro akore pugeje: – Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turemo awu boe tuginaiwugeto nono ure turemo cedo dumogadure. Ca ure turugadu etao pegododuwo jamedu.

b: Dukodire makore ia tumedagei ewo nowu boe tuginaiwuge etao pegodo emearutorure Jesus Cristoji kodi. Nono emagore Pedro ji rakojewo nono pudabo tu jao.
source: Dukodire makore ia tumedagei ewo nowu boe tuginaiwuge etao pegodo emearutorure Jesus Cristoji kodi. Nono emagore Pedro ji rakojewo nono pudabo tu jao.

b: Pedro Ure Jerusalém Tadawu Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ewie
source: Pedro Ure Jerusalém Tadawu Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ewie

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge emearudure boe tuginaiwuge emearutoruie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu duji. Nou Judéia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu eruduware jamedu.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge emearudure boe tuginaiwuge emearutoruie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu duji. Nou Judéia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu eruduware jamedu.

b: Nono Pedro uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Iage etaidure tuwo nowu mearutorurewuge boe tuginaiwuge enoe oto biri kado nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Emago pegare Pedro ji.
source: Nono Pedro uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Iage etaidure tuwo nowu mearutorurewuge boe tuginaiwuge enoe oto biri kado nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Emago pegare Pedro ji.

b: egore ukare turugadu aragojewo akwagewo aino boe tuginaiwuge ewai tada.
source: egore ukare turugadu aragojewo akwagewo aino boe tuginaiwuge ewai tada.

b: Dukodire Pedro readodure ewiagai nuba boere pudui toro rugadu.
source: Dukodire Pedro readodure ewiagai nuba boere pudui toro rugadu.

b: Akore iragojere Jope ba kurirewu tada dukeje imagore baru to. Nono iorudure iaboe ji. Ure nono iniau mogadure. Iorudure ia boe ekudau areia kigadurewuji. Nou boe ekudau areia kurire, ture tuiado dukeje. Ure turawuje baru piji itae rugadu.
source: Akore iragojere Jope ba kurirewu tada dukeje imagore baru to. Nono iorudure iaboe ji. Ure nono iniau mogadure. Iorudure ia boe ekudau areia kigadurewuji. Nou boe ekudau areia kurire, ture tuiado dukeje. Ure turawuje baru piji itae rugadu.

b: Nou boe ekudau kejere barege pegarewuge emugure, kiebarege pegarewuge emugure jamedu. Iage ere nono batrarewuge emogadure. Emugure keje jamedu.
source: Nou boe ekudau kejere barege pegarewuge emugure, kiebarege pegarewuge emugure jamedu. Iage ere nono batrarewuge emogadure. Emugure keje jamedu.

b: Dukejere imearudure ia boe makore baru piji duji. Akore, “Pedro. Aragojedo. Akeragu iaji awo bito, awo kowuje.”
source: Dukejere imearudure ia boe makore baru piji duji. Akore, “Pedro. Aragojedo. Akeragu iaji awo bito, awo kowuje.”

b: Mare inagore, “Boro. Marigudu are nowu mariguduwuge iwobe eno bakaru maku etai. Nou bakaru akore boe ekaiago ia barege ekowuje ekaiago ia kiebarege ekowuje. Akore emoduie kowuje epemegamodukaie turowo nowu bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji pugeje. Mare ikare nowu barege nowu kiebarege ekowuje rugadu jii aino. Aino imodukare ekowuje rugadu.”
source: Mare inagore, “Boro. Marigudu are nowu mariguduwuge iwobe eno bakaru maku etai. Nou bakaru akore boe ekaiago ia barege ekowuje ekaiago ia kiebarege ekowuje. Akore emoduie kowuje epemegamodukaie turowo nowu bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji pugeje. Mare ikare nowu barege nowu kiebarege ekowuje rugadu jii aino. Aino imodukare ekowuje rugadu.”

b: Nono nowu baru pijiwu makore pugeje. Akore, “Pao Kurirewunure imi. Imagomode ai ia barogo uie turugadu boe ewo ko dukeje akaidudo ji.”
source: Nono nowu baru pijiwu makore pugeje. Akore, “Pao Kurirewunure imi. Imagomode ai ia barogo uie turugadu boe ewo ko dukeje akaidudo ji.”

b: Akoino i dure pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care nowu boe ekudau areia kigadurewu ruture tuibagi baru to.
source: Akoino i dure pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care nowu boe ekudau areia kigadurewu ruture tuibagi baru to.

b: Ruture dukeje ime etaregodure iwagai. Ere pobe metia bokware. Etaregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu piji.
source: Ruture dukeje ime etaregodure iwagai. Ere pobe metia bokware. Etaregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu piji.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore i ituwo ebo imara tabo. Awu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture itabo jamedu. Jope kejewugenure emage. Enodo padure seis. Cedure toro Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Cere ceremo Cornélio uwaito nono.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore i ituwo ebo imara tabo. Awu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture itabo jamedu. Jope kejewugenure emage. Enodo padure seis. Cedure toro Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Cere ceremo Cornélio uwaito nono.

b: Emare readodure cewiagai tuioruduie Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji tuwai ja tada. Akoie aino pudui, “Ia boe utudo Jope ba kurirewu ka ia imedu bagai. Nou imedu iere Simão Pedro.
source: Emare readodure cewiagai tuioruduie Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji tuwai ja tada. Akoie aino pudui, “Ia boe utudo Jope ba kurirewu ka ia imedu bagai. Nou imedu iere Simão Pedro.

b: Emare umode aruduwado nuba aromode, nuba awobe eromode tawo taginorudo boe pegarewu piji.”
source: Emare umode aruduwado nuba aromode, nuba awobe eromode tawo taginorudo boe pegarewu piji.”

b: Ca itaregodure toro etae dukeje ire ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje etae nono ure turawuje pagae dumogadure.
source: Ca itaregodure toro etae dukeje ire ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje etae nono ure turawuje pagae dumogadure.

b: Dukeje iwiabuture Pagimijera Jesus bataru keje. Akore, “João ure boe etao pegodo pobo tabo mare imire imode Pao Kurirewu Uwari rawuje tagae iwo tugu tamearudaeto.”
source: Dukeje iwiabuture Pagimijera Jesus bataru keje. Akore, “João ure boe etao pegodo pobo tabo mare imire imode Pao Kurirewu Uwari rawuje tagae iwo tugu tamearudaeto.”

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Pagimijera Jesus ure Pao Kurirewu Uwari maku awu boe tuginaiwuge etai nono ture maku pagai dumogadure. Pamearutorure Pagimijera Jesus Cristoji dukeje ure Tuwari maku pagai. Aino ure maku etai jamedu. Imire imodukare imearudae udo tuginai Pao Kurirewu mearudae piji.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Pagimijera Jesus ure Pao Kurirewu Uwari maku awu boe tuginaiwuge etai nono ture maku pagai dumogadure. Pamearutorure Pagimijera Jesus Cristoji dukeje ure Tuwari maku pagai. Aino ure maku etai jamedu. Imire imodukare imearudae udo tuginai Pao Kurirewu mearudae piji.

b: Nou boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje emago pegakare nowu boe tuginaiwugei pugeje. Emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. egore Pao Kurirewu aidure boe tuginaiwugei ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji jamedu, Pao Kurirewu uwo ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji.
source: Nou boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje emago pegakare nowu boe tuginaiwugei pugeje. Emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. egore Pao Kurirewu aidure boe tuginaiwugei ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji jamedu, Pao Kurirewu uwo ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Edure Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Edure Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: Boe eimijera pegarewuge ere Estêvão bito dukeje boe pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei rugadu. Dukodire ere taodo Jerusalém piji. Iage eture Fenícia moto ka. Iage eture Chipre moto ka. Iage eture Cirene moto ka. Emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji tu Judeu doge ewiagai nono.
source: Boe eimijera pegarewuge ere Estêvão bito dukeje boe pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei rugadu. Dukodire ere taodo Jerusalém piji. Iage eture Fenícia moto ka. Iage eture Chipre moto ka. Iage eture Cirene moto ka. Emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji tu Judeu doge ewiagai nono.

b: Mare ia Chipre kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Ia Cirene kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture Antioquia ba kurirewu ka jamedu. Emagere emagore Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji boe tuginaiwuge ewiagai jamedu. Ere ewie Jesus umode ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji duji. Ewo tugimijerado ema.
source: Mare ia Chipre kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Ia Cirene kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture Antioquia ba kurirewu ka jamedu. Emagere emagore Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji boe tuginaiwuge ewiagai jamedu. Ere ewie Jesus umode ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji duji. Ewo tugimijerado ema.

b: Jesus ure turaga maku etai. Dukodire boe emagare tumearutoru tabo ewadaru ji. Ere tugera ra tumearutorure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo tu Jesus ji.
source: Jesus ure turaga maku etai. Dukodire boe emagare tumearutoru tabo ewadaru ji. Ere tugera ra tumearutorure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo tu Jesus ji.

b: Nou Jerusalém kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje ere Barnabé utudo etae toro Antioquia ba kurirewu ka.
source: Nou Jerusalém kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje ere Barnabé utudo etae toro Antioquia ba kurirewu ka.

b: Emare aregodure toro dukeje jorudure Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ei duji. Dukodire jakarere pudui. Makore ei ekawo tugera ra Jesus piji. Emearutoru rakawo ji rugadu.
source: Emare aregodure toro dukeje jorudure Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ei duji. Dukodire jakarere pudui. Makore ei ekawo tugera ra Jesus piji. Emearutoru rakawo ji rugadu.

b: Nou Barnabé imedu pemegarewunure ema. Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere apo. Mearutoru rakare Jesus ji. Ure boe emearutorudo Jesus ji rugadu. Emagare.
source: Nou Barnabé imedu pemegarewunure ema. Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere apo. Mearutoru rakare Jesus ji. Ure boe emearutorudo Jesus ji rugadu. Emagare.

b: Dukeje Barnabé uture Tarso ba kurirewu ka taiwo tabo Saulo bagai.
source: Dukeje Barnabé uture Tarso ba kurirewu ka taiwo tabo Saulo bagai.

b: Jorudure Sauloji dukeje ure tugirimi apo Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Jorure mitotu je ei toro ere boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dutabo. Ere bato pui mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo tu tu je. Nou Antioquia kejere boe ere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ekiedo. Egore: “Cristo uwobe reo.”
source: Jorudure Sauloji dukeje ure tugirimi apo Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Jorure mitotu je ei toro ere boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dutabo. Ere bato pui mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo tu tu je. Nou Antioquia kejere boe ere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ekiedo. Egore: “Cristo uwobe reo.”

b: Ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eture Jerusalém piji Antioquia ba kurirewu ka.
source: Ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eture Jerusalém piji Antioquia ba kurirewu ka.

b: Ia iere Ágabo. Ure turagojedo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Ágabo makodo. Akore bubutumodukaie moto jamedu boe parugajeje. (Ca Cláudio Romano doge eimijera kurirewu ure ema dukeje bubutukare nono nowu Ágabo bataru mogadure.)
source: Ia iere Ágabo. Ure turagojedo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Ágabo makodo. Akore bubutumodukaie moto jamedu boe parugajeje. (Ca Cláudio Romano doge eimijera kurirewu ure ema dukeje bubutukare nono nowu Ágabo bataru mogadure.)

b: Dukodire nowu Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere tumearudae tawuje tuwo ia tuge maku diero bagai tuwo nowu diero maku toro nowu Judéia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai.
source: Dukodire nowu Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere tumearudae tawuje tuwo ia tuge maku diero bagai tuwo nowu diero maku toro nowu Judéia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai.

b: Erore aino rugadu. Nono ere Barnabé, Saulo etudo diero tabo toro nowu Judéia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai rugadu.
source: Erore aino rugadu. Nono ere Barnabé, Saulo etudo diero tabo toro nowu Judéia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai rugadu.

b: Boe Pegare Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei Pugeje
source: Boe Pegare Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei Pugeje

b: Boe eimijera kurirewu Herodes ro pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Ure iage etugu baicorewuto.
source: Boe eimijera kurirewu Herodes ro pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Ure iage etugu baicorewuto.

b: Ure to tugobaigarege edo Tiago bito tariga kurirewu tabo. Nou Tiago, João umananure ema.
source: Ure to tugobaigarege edo Tiago bito tariga kurirewu tabo. Nou Tiago, João umananure ema.

b: Judeu doge etaidure nowu Herodes ro pegarewuji. Dukodire Herodes ure tugeragu Pedro ji jamedu. Ure tugu baicorewuto. Rore aino mare Judeu doge ewadure ia tuwadaeji. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Dukodire Herodes roiwakare tuwo Pedro bito nowu meri ji. Meardaere tuwo bito nowu Judeu doge ewadae akedu keje. Nono Herodes ure tugeragu tugobaigaregei. Enodo padure dezesseis. Ure etu pemegado Pedro ji nowu baicorewu ja tada. Herodes aidure Judeu doge emagowo boe ewo nowu Pedro bito.
source: Judeu doge etaidure nowu Herodes ro pegarewuji. Dukodire Herodes ure tugeragu Pedro ji jamedu. Ure tugu baicorewuto. Rore aino mare Judeu doge ewadure ia tuwadaeji. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Dukodire Herodes roiwakare tuwo Pedro bito nowu meri ji. Meardaere tuwo bito nowu Judeu doge ewadae akedu keje. Nono Herodes ure tugeragu tugobaigaregei. Enodo padure dezesseis. Ure etu pemegado Pedro ji nowu baicorewu ja tada. Herodes aidure Judeu doge emagowo boe ewo nowu Pedro bito.

b: Dukodire Pedro rakojere baicorewu ja tada. Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emago raire baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai Pedro paru tabo.
source: Dukodire Pedro rakojere baicorewu ja tada. Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emago raire baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai Pedro paru tabo.

b: Pedro Tawujedure Baicorewu Piji
source: Pedro Tawujedure Baicorewu Piji

b: Herodes uiago Pedro maku Judeu doge etai barogwakododu keje. Mare nowu boeco ji Pedro unudure tugobaigarege etoiadada. Ere pobe. Ere Pedro kogudo corrente pobedu tabo. Tugobaigarege edure nowu baicorewu bai poro keje jamedu.
source: Herodes uiago Pedro maku Judeu doge etai barogwakododu keje. Mare nowu boeco ji Pedro unudure tugobaigarege etoiadada. Ere pobe. Ere Pedro kogudo corrente pobedu tabo. Tugobaigarege edure nowu baicorewu bai poro keje jamedu.

b: Rore puku Pedro ji ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakojere nono apo duji. Urugu rakare nowu baicorewu ja tada. Nou Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure tugerado Pedro poru keje jetaduwo. Akore aragojedo. Amara tabo. Ca nowu corrente ure tugiwuje Pedro piji.
source: Rore puku Pedro ji ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakojere nono apo duji. Urugu rakare nowu baicorewu ja tada. Nou Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure tugerado Pedro poru keje jetaduwo. Akore aragojedo. Amara tabo. Ca nowu corrente ure tugiwuje Pedro piji.

b: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu akore akudau areia tugu ai kogudo. Awure tugu awuretadauto. Paduwo. Atudo itabo. Ca Pedro mearutorure nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu bataru ji.
source: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu akore akudau areia tugu ai kogudo. Awure tugu awuretadauto. Paduwo. Atudo itabo. Ca Pedro mearutorure nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu bataru ji.

b: Uture rekodaji nowu baicorewu piji. Mare mearudaere tuniaunure duji. Joruduwakare boe remawunure aino pudui duji.
source: Uture rekodaji nowu baicorewu piji. Mare mearudaere tuniaunure duji. Joruduwakare boe remawunure aino pudui duji.

b: Ekodure nowu tugobaigare boeto jiwu kori dukeje ekodure ia kori pugeje. Nono etaregodure nowu baicorewu bai poro ka. Nou bai poro ure tuiado poku je dukeje ere tudawuje nowu baicorewu piji. Ekodure nowu ba kurirewu tadawu awara ji. Nono Pedro rore puku nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu uture tubiji duji.
source: Ekodure nowu tugobaigare boeto jiwu kori dukeje ekodure ia kori pugeje. Nono etaregodure nowu baicorewu bai poro ka. Nou bai poro ure tuiado poku je dukeje ere tudawuje nowu baicorewu piji. Ekodure nowu ba kurirewu tadawu awara ji. Nono Pedro rore puku nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu uture tubiji duji.

b: Aino care Pedro joruduware turore jiboe ji dukeje akore Boe remawu rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ure tudugare baru tadawu arego itae uwo ikinorudo nowu Herodes ro pegarewu piji, nowu Judeu doge etaidure jiwu ero pegarewu jiboe piji jamedu.
source: Aino care Pedro joruduware turore jiboe ji dukeje akore Boe remawu rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ure tudugare baru tadawu arego itae uwo ikinorudo nowu Herodes ro pegarewu piji, nowu Judeu doge etaidure jiwu ero pegarewu jiboe piji jamedu.

b: Joruduware ure tudawuje baicorewu piji dukeje Pedro uture João Marcos uce uwai ka. Nou uce iere Maria. Boe emagare nono. Ere bato pui tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai Pedro paru tabo.
source: Joruduware ure tudawuje baicorewu piji dukeje Pedro uture João Marcos uce uwai ka. Nou uce iere Maria. Boe emagare nono. Ere bato pui tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai Pedro paru tabo.

b: Pedro aregodure toro dukeje ure tugera to nowu bawadu kejewu bai poroji. Ia bai kejewu utugare nogwaredu uture tugimaduwo apo. Iere Rode.
source: Pedro aregodure toro dukeje ure tugera to nowu bawadu kejewu bai poroji. Ia bai kejewu utugare nogwaredu uture tugimaduwo apo. Iere Rode.

b: Puredugodure toro dukeje mearudure Pedro mako ji. Joruduware ji dukeje jakaregodure pudui rugadu. Dukodire rekodure tuwaito pugeje. Mare ukare bai poro jado dukodire Pedro rakoje kimore toro bawadu keje. Nou Rode makore nowu boe ji Pedro rakojeie bawadu keje.
source: Puredugodure toro dukeje mearudure Pedro mako ji. Joruduware ji dukeje jakaregodure pudui rugadu. Dukodire rekodure tuwaito pugeje. Mare ukare bai poro jado dukodire Pedro rakoje kimore toro bawadu keje. Nou Rode makore nowu boe ji Pedro rakojeie bawadu keje.

b: Mare emearutorukare. egore akaora bai baire. Mare emare ukare togwa ra tumagore ei dupiji. Dukodire egore Pedro karega. Uwarire akoino.
