source: Mare emearutorukare. egore akaora bai baire. Mare emare ukare togwa ra tumagore ei dupiji. Dukodire egore Pedro karega. Uwarire akoino.

b: Mare Pedro ure tugera to bai poroji kimo. Dukodire boe ere bai poro jado. Nono erudure ji. Pedronure ema rugadu. Dukodire ebogodure.
source: Mare Pedro ure tugera to bai poroji kimo. Dukodire boe ere bai poro jado. Nono erudure ji. Pedronure ema rugadu. Dukodire ebogodure.

b: Pedro ure tugera raido emugu kiorowo nono. Readodure ewiagai nuba Pao Kurirewu rore pudui tuwo tudawuje baicorewu piji duji. Akore tadudo toro nowu Tiago ae tawo bie. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ewie jamedu. Nono Pedro uture epiji toro ia ba kurirewu ka.
source: Pedro ure tugera raido emugu kiorowo nono. Readodure ewiagai nuba Pao Kurirewu rore pudui tuwo tudawuje baicorewu piji duji. Akore tadudo toro nowu Tiago ae tawo bie. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ewie jamedu. Nono Pedro uture epiji toro ia ba kurirewu ka.

b: Barogwakododure dukeje nowu baicorewu tadawu tugobaigarege eruduwakare nuba boere Pedro ji dukodire etokire pui.
source: Barogwakododure dukeje nowu baicorewu tadawu tugobaigarege eruduwakare nuba boere Pedro ji dukodire etokire pui.

b: Herodes mako rakare ei etaiwowo Pedro bagai mare erudukare ji. Dukodire Herodes ure nowu tugobaigarege etarego pudae. Unara raire ei dukeje ure ewido. Rore aino ei dukeje Herodes uture Judéia moto piji tugiriaduwo toro Cesaréia moto ka.
source: Herodes mako rakare ei etaiwowo Pedro bagai mare erudukare ji. Dukodire Herodes ure nowu tugobaigarege etarego pudae. Unara raire ei dukeje ure ewido. Rore aino ei dukeje Herodes uture Judéia moto piji tugiriaduwo toro Cesaréia moto ka.

b: Boe Eimijera Herodes Bire
source: Boe Eimijera Herodes Bire

b: Herodes korigodure Tiro ba kurirewu kejewugei, Sidom ba kurirewu kejewugei jamedu. Dukejere ia nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge eture ae. Mare ere tumearudae maku ia Herodes uwai tadawu boe eimijera ai jao. Etaiduie tubemegawo Herodiji, etaiduie Herodes pemegawo pudui jamedu. Etuwobe etaiduie tuwo akirodo nouia tugeji Herodes piji jamedu. Nou Herodes uwai tadawu boe eimijera iere Blasto. Nou Blasto jorudu pemegare nowu emearudae ji. Dukodire ure tuwadaru utudo toro Herodes ae eparu tabo tuwo emearudae maku Herodes ai epemegawo pui pugeje.
source: Herodes korigodure Tiro ba kurirewu kejewugei, Sidom ba kurirewu kejewugei jamedu. Dukejere ia nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge eture ae. Mare ere tumearudae maku ia Herodes uwai tadawu boe eimijera ai jao. Etaiduie tubemegawo Herodiji, etaiduie Herodes pemegawo pudui jamedu. Etuwobe etaiduie tuwo akirodo nouia tugeji Herodes piji jamedu. Nou Herodes uwai tadawu boe eimijera iere Blasto. Nou Blasto jorudu pemegare nowu emearudae ji. Dukodire ure tuwadaru utudo toro Herodes ae eparu tabo tuwo emearudae maku Herodes ai epemegawo pui pugeje.

b: Dukodire Herodes makore ewagai. Ure meri maku etai etaregoduwo nowu meri ji. Ca nowu meri keje Herodes ure nowu tugudau boe eimijera kurirewu areia moturewu tugu pudui. Ure tumugudo to boe eimijera kurirewu muga ira keje. Dukejere mako raire boe ji.
source: Dukodire Herodes makore ewagai. Ure meri maku etai etaregoduwo nowu meri ji. Ca nowu meri keje Herodes ure nowu tugudau boe eimijera kurirewu areia moturewu tugu pudui. Ure tumugudo to boe eimijera kurirewu muga ira keje. Dukejere mako raire boe ji.

b: Nou mearudure nowu Herodes bataru jiwuge etaidure ji rugadu. egore imedu karegure ema. Ia baru tadawu paonure ema rugadu.
source: Nou mearudure nowu Herodes bataru jiwuge etaidure ji rugadu. egore imedu karegure ema. Ia baru tadawu paonure ema rugadu.

b: Erore puku Pao Kurirewu ure Herodes bito duji. Herodes aidure tuwo Pao Kurirewu udo pudumi kodi dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure bito. Ate doge ere Herodes kodu rugadu ko dukodire Herodes bire.
source: Erore puku Pao Kurirewu ure Herodes bito duji. Herodes aidure tuwo Pao Kurirewu udo pudumi kodi dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure bito. Ate doge ere Herodes kodu rugadu ko dukodire Herodes bire.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu bataru ure tumaedo moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagagodure rugadu.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu bataru ure tumaedo moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagagodure rugadu.

b: Barnabé uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka Saulo apo tuwo nowu diero reko nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai. Ere maku etai dukeje ere tugirimi Antioquia ba kurirewu ka João Marcos apo.
source: Barnabé uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka Saulo apo tuwo nowu diero reko nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai. Ere maku etai dukeje ere tugirimi Antioquia ba kurirewu ka João Marcos apo.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ure Saulo Tawuje, Ure Barnabé Tawuje
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ure Saulo Tawuje, Ure Barnabé Tawuje

b: Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eragojere Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo. Ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eragojere nono ebo jamedu. Ainore ekiere. Ia iere Barnabé. Metia iere Simão. Nou Simão iere Corewu jamedu. Ia iere Lúcio. Nou Lúcio aregodure Cirene moto piji. Ia metia iere Manaém. Nou Manaém ricodure tu nowu boe eimijera Herodes apo. Ia iere Saulo.
source: Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eragojere Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo. Ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge eragojere nono ebo jamedu. Ainore ekiere. Ia iere Barnabé. Metia iere Simão. Nou Simão iere Corewu jamedu. Ia iere Lúcio. Nou Lúcio aregodure Cirene moto piji. Ia metia iere Manaém. Nou Manaém ricodure tu nowu boe eimijera Herodes apo. Ia iere Saulo.

b: Awu joruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge enogwagekare nowu meri keje tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji tu rugadu nowu meri ji. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore ei. Akore tamedia Barnabé, tamedia Saulo etudo tabiji ewo itaidure jiwu ire maku etaiwu emaragodae towuje.
source: Awu joruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge enogwagekare nowu meri keje tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji tu rugadu nowu meri ji. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari makore ei. Akore tamedia Barnabé, tamedia Saulo etudo tabiji ewo itaidure jiwu ire maku etaiwu emaragodae towuje.

b: Dukodire nowu boe enogwagekare nowu meri ji rugadu jii nowu meri butu ka rugadu. Dukeje ere tugera bu nowu Saulo keje, nowu Barnabé keje tumagowo baru to eparu tabo Pao Kurirewu utugaregewo emage rugadu. Dukeje ere etudo.
source: Dukodire nowu boe enogwagekare nowu meri ji rugadu jii nowu meri butu ka rugadu. Dukeje ere tugera bu nowu Saulo keje, nowu Barnabé keje tumagowo baru to eparu tabo Pao Kurirewu utugaregewo emage rugadu. Dukeje ere etudo.

b: Saulo, Barnabé Eture Chipre Moto Ka
source: Saulo, Barnabé Eture Chipre Moto Ka

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tumearudae maku etai dukodire Barnabé, Saulo eture toro Selêucia ba kurirewu ka. Nou Selêucia piji eture toro Chipre moto ka ikarerewu tabo.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tumearudae maku etai dukodire Barnabé, Saulo eture toro Selêucia ba kurirewu ka. Nou Selêucia piji eture toro Chipre moto ka ikarerewu tabo.

b: Etaregodure toro dukeje ere turemo Salamina ba kurirewuto. Emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ja tada. João Marcos uture ebo tuwo tugera maku etai.
source: Etaregodure toro dukeje ere turemo Salamina ba kurirewuto. Emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ja tada. João Marcos uture ebo tuwo tugera maku etai.

b: Eture nowu Chipre moto okwa ka toro nowu Pafos ba kurirewu ka. Nonore erudure ia bariji. Nou bari iere Barjesus. Judeunure ema. Emare akore tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare pagare akoino.
source: Eture nowu Chipre moto okwa ka toro nowu Pafos ba kurirewu ka. Nonore erudure ia bariji. Nou bari iere Barjesus. Judeunure ema. Emare akore tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare pagare akoino.

b: Nou Chipre kejewu boe eimijera iere Sérgio Paulo. Joruduwarewunure ema. Emare aidure nowu Barjesusji. Nou Sérgio Paulo makore Barnabé bagai nowu Saulo bagai jamedu. Aidure tumearuduwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Nou Chipre kejewu boe eimijera iere Sérgio Paulo. Joruduwarewunure ema. Emare aidure nowu Barjesusji. Nou Sérgio Paulo makore Barnabé bagai nowu Saulo bagai jamedu. Aidure tumearuduwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Mare nowu Barjesus rakojere nono jamedu. Emare iere Elimas jamedu. Barinure ema dukodire boe ere iedo Elimas jamedu. Makore nowu boe eimijeraji mearutorukawo nowu Barnabé nowu Saulo ewadaru ji, mearutorukawo Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Mare nowu Barjesus rakojere nono jamedu. Emare iere Elimas jamedu. Barinure ema dukodire boe ere iedo Elimas jamedu. Makore nowu boe eimijeraji mearutorukawo nowu Barnabé nowu Saulo ewadaru ji, mearutorukawo Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Nou Saulo iere Paulo jamedu. Emare Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere apo. Paulo aiwore tu nowu bariji.
source: Nou Saulo iere Paulo jamedu. Emare Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere apo. Paulo aiwore tu nowu bariji.

b: Nono Makore ji. Akore bope onaregedunure aki. Arudu pegare boe pemegarewu boe ji. Aruduware tu boe pegarewu ji awo boe ekiripagado. Akaidure awo Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu mekido awadrarodutabo.
source: Nono Makore ji. Akore bope onaregedunure aki. Arudu pegare boe pemegarewu boe ji. Aruduware tu boe pegarewu ji awo boe ekiripagado. Akaidure awo Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu mekido awadrarodutabo.

b: Pao Kurirewu umode tugera rakado ai rugadu kuri aino. Aku bokwamode arudukawo boe ji tu jao. Rore puku ji nowu Elimas joku bokware duji. Ure nono boetugu corewu mogadure buture joku keje duji. Dukodire meru pagare jetu woje ia boe ewagai ewo tugeragu tugeraji tumeruwo apo.
source: Pao Kurirewu umode tugera rakado ai rugadu kuri aino. Aku bokwamode arudukawo boe ji tu jao. Rore puku ji nowu Elimas joku bokware duji. Ure nono boetugu corewu mogadure buture joku keje duji. Dukodire meru pagare jetu woje ia boe ewagai ewo tugeragu tugeraji tumeruwo apo.

b: Nou Chipre kejewu boe eimijera jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje mearutorure rugadu. Jebogodure nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé emagore jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Nou Chipre kejewu boe eimijera jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje mearutorure rugadu. Jebogodure nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé emagore jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Paulo, Barnabé Eture Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Ka Pisídia Moto Ka
source: Paulo, Barnabé Eture Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Ka Pisídia Moto Ka

b: Paulo uture tumedagebo ikarerewu tabo Pafos ba kurirewu piji toro Perge ba kurirewu ka. Perge rakojere Panfília moto keje. Toro João Marcos uture epiji tuduwo tuibagi Jerusalém ka.
source: Paulo uture tumedagebo ikarerewu tabo Pafos ba kurirewu piji toro Perge ba kurirewu ka. Perge rakojere Panfília moto keje. Toro João Marcos uture epiji tuduwo tuibagi Jerusalém ka.

b: Dukejere eture Perge piji. Etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu ka Pisídia moto keje. Sábado meri ji eture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Edure nono bai ja tada.
source: Dukejere eture Perge piji. Etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu ka Pisídia moto keje. Sábado meri ji eture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Edure nono bai ja tada.

b: Ia boe aiwore Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu bataru ji tumagowo nowu rakojere nowu bai tadawu boe ewiagai. Aiwore ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu. Makore ji nowu boe ewiagai jamedu. Nou bai kejewuge eimijerage erudure nowu Pauloji nowu metagei. Dukeje emagore ewagai. egore ia tagi tagaidure tamagowo ia bataru pemegarewu ji cewiagai?
source: Ia boe aiwore Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu bataru ji tumagowo nowu rakojere nowu bai tadawu boe ewiagai. Aiwore ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu. Makore ji nowu boe ewiagai jamedu. Nou bai kejewuge eimijerage erudure nowu Pauloji nowu metagei. Dukeje emagore ewagai. egore ia tagi tagaidure tamagowo ia bataru pemegarewu ji cewiagai?

b: Dukodire Paulo ure turagojedo. Ure tugera awagado boe emagokawo pugeje ewiapagawo nowu tuwadaru ji. Dukeje makore ei. Akore iwobenure ia tagi Judeunure imi kodi. Boe tuginaiwugenure ia tagi jamedu. Tagaregodure woe tawo tabu jodo tamago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodi tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji.
source: Dukodire Paulo ure turagojedo. Ure tugera awagado boe emagokawo pugeje ewiapagawo nowu tuwadaru ji. Dukeje makore ei. Akore iwobenure ia tagi Judeunure imi kodi. Boe tuginaiwugenure ia tagi jamedu. Tagaregodure woe tawo tabu jodo tamago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodi tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji.

b: Judeu doge emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jawu pawobei marigudu. Eragojere Egito moto keje dukeje ure emagado rugadu. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure etawuje Egito moto piji turo rakarewu tabo.
source: Judeu doge emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jawu pawobei marigudu. Eragojere Egito moto keje dukeje ure emagado rugadu. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure etawuje Egito moto piji turo rakarewu tabo.

b: Mare pawobe emearutorukare ji dukodire emeru pagare jetu woje boe maerewu keje. Jorure 40 ei nono duji.
source: Mare pawobe emearutorukare ji dukodire emeru pagare jetu woje boe maerewu keje. Jorure 40 ei nono duji.

b: Dukejere Pao Kurirewu ure boe pegarewuge etagedudo jawu pawobe etododai tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge eno moto maku jawu pawobe etai enoce.
source: Dukejere Pao Kurirewu ure boe pegarewuge etagedudo jawu pawobe etododai tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge eno moto maku jawu pawobe etai enoce.

b: Jorure 450 ei eture Canaã moto piji Egito moto ka ewo tugirimi tuibagi Canaã moto ka pugeje ewo tugeragu nowu moto ji toce. Eimijera bokware mare Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu iagei etaiwowo nowu jawu pawobe erore jiboe ji. Erore aino jii toro makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Samuel muguredu ka.
source: Jorure 450 ei eture Canaã moto piji Egito moto ka ewo tugirimi tuibagi Canaã moto ka pugeje ewo tugeragu nowu moto ji toce. Eimijera bokware mare Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu iagei etaiwowo nowu jawu pawobe erore jiboe ji. Erore aino jii toro makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Samuel muguredu ka.

b: Nono nowu pawobe etaidure ia tugimijera kurirewu bagai. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu Saulji eimijera kurirewuce. Quis onaregedunure ema. Judeu doge etumana Benjamim uwobenure ema jamedu. Nou Saul nowu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure ema dukejere jorure 40 ei nono.
source: Nono nowu pawobe etaidure ia tugimijera kurirewu bagai. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu Saulji eimijera kurirewuce. Quis onaregedunure ema. Judeu doge etumana Benjamim uwobenure ema jamedu. Nou Saul nowu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure ema dukejere jorure 40 ei nono.

b: Nono Pao Kurirewu ure Saul tawuje epiji. Ure tugeragu Daviji eimijera kurirewuce pugeje. Jessé onaregedunure ema. Pao Kurirewu akore, “Itaidure awu Davi rore jiboe ji. Emare ro pemegamode itaidure jiboe ji.”
source: Nono Pao Kurirewu ure Saul tawuje epiji. Ure tugeragu Daviji eimijera kurirewuce pugeje. Jessé onaregedunure ema. Pao Kurirewu akore, “Itaidure awu Davi rore jiboe ji. Emare ro pemegamode itaidure jiboe ji.”

b: Ca Jesusre Davi uwobenure ema. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu Jesus ji uwo boe ekinorudowu udo ema. Ure udo aino nono nowu tuwadaru mogadure. Ure aino rugadu. Emare umode Judeu doge ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji.
source: Ca Jesusre Davi uwobenure ema. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu Jesus ji uwo boe ekinorudowu udo ema. Ure udo aino nono nowu tuwadaru mogadure. Ure aino rugadu. Emare umode Judeu doge ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji.

b: Jesus otodaire João Batista ure Judeu doge ewie ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji etao pegododuwo.
source: Jesus otodaire João Batista ure Judeu doge ewie ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji etao pegododuwo.

b: João Batista uiago tumaragodae iado dukeje ure boe ewie. Akore, “Tabagare bagaiwu karegure imi. Boe kurirewu karegure imi. Mare tabagare bagaiwu aregodumode iregodaji kuri je. Boe kurirewu mode ema rugadu. Ipogurumode ipureduwo ji.”
source: João Batista uiago tumaragodae iado dukeje ure boe ewie. Akore, “Tabagare bagaiwu karegure imi. Boe kurirewu karegure imi. Mare tabagare bagaiwu aregodumode iregodaji kuri je. Boe kurirewu mode ema rugadu. Ipogurumode ipureduwo ji.”

b: – Ia tagi iwobenure tagi. Abraão uwobe Judeu dogenure ia tagi jamedu. Ia tagi boe tuginaiwuge taeku kigodure Pao Kurirewu ji tamago pemegawo ji jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru pemegarewu maku pagai rugadu. Ure boe ekinorudowu maku pagai rugadu.
source: – Ia tagi iwobenure tagi. Abraão uwobe Judeu dogenure ia tagi jamedu. Ia tagi boe tuginaiwuge taeku kigodure Pao Kurirewu ji tamago pemegawo ji jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru pemegarewu maku pagai rugadu. Ure boe ekinorudowu maku pagai rugadu.

b: Jerusalém kejewuge eruduwakare ji. Eimijerage eruduwakare ji jamedu. Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema mare emearutorukare nowu inoduji. Eruduwakare tumearudure jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje marigudu. Nou Jerusalém kejewuge emearudure nowu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Sábado meri ji tu tu je. Mare eruduwakare nowu padure kejewu bapera akoino jiboe ji. Emearutorukare ji jamedu. Mare erore jiboe ure nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge egore nowu umode boe ekinorudowu bimoduie. Ca nowu Jerusalém kejewuge emearutorukare nowu bataru ji. Mare ere Jesus bito. Turoino dutabo ere nowu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu.
source: Jerusalém kejewuge eruduwakare ji. Eimijerage eruduwakare ji jamedu. Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema mare emearutorukare nowu inoduji. Eruduwakare tumearudure jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje marigudu. Nou Jerusalém kejewuge emearudure nowu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Sábado meri ji tu tu je. Mare eruduwakare nowu padure kejewu bapera akoino jiboe ji. Emearutorukare ji jamedu. Mare erore jiboe ure nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge egore nowu umode boe ekinorudowu bimoduie. Ca nowu Jerusalém kejewuge emearutorukare nowu bataru ji. Mare ere Jesus bito. Turoino dutabo ere nowu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu.

b: Erudukare ia Jesus ro pegarewu ji tuwo bito mare emagore tugimijera Pilatoji uwo bito.
source: Erudukare ia Jesus ro pegarewu ji tuwo bito mare emagore tugimijera Pilatoji uwo bito.

b: Aino ere Pao Kurirewu bataru udo turugadu. Jesus bire dukeje ere tawuje ipo padure pugajejewu piji. Ere tugu tori poroto.
source: Aino ere Pao Kurirewu bataru udo turugadu. Jesus bire dukeje ere tawuje ipo padure pugajejewu piji. Ere tugu tori poroto.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudo pugeje.

b: Nono Jesus ure boe erududo pudui. Boe raire ji rore aino duji. Galiléia kejewuge erudure ji. Jerusalém kejewuge erudure ji jamedu. Nou jorudure jiwuge emagore tuiorudure jiboe ji nowu Judeu doge ewiagai.
source: Nono Jesus ure boe erududo pudui. Boe raire ji rore aino duji. Galiléia kejewuge erudure ji. Jerusalém kejewuge erudure ji jamedu. Nou jorudure jiwuge emagore tuiorudure jiboe ji nowu Judeu doge ewiagai.

b: Dukodire cedaregodure woe tagae. Cedaidure cewo tawie nowu Jesus bataru pemegarewuji. Pao Kurirewu makore jawu pawobei turomode jiboe ji. Aino care ure tuwadaru jetudo pudui rugadu. Ure Jesus jewodudo rugadu. Ainore akore Salmo capítulo 2 keje. Akore, “Itonaregedunure aki. Awu meri ji aonure imi.”
source: Dukodire cedaregodure woe tagae. Cedaidure cewo tawie nowu Jesus bataru pemegarewuji. Pao Kurirewu makore jawu pawobei turomode jiboe ji. Aino care ure tuwadaru jetudo pudui rugadu. Ure Jesus jewodudo rugadu. Ainore akore Salmo capítulo 2 keje. Akore, “Itonaregedunure aki. Awu meri ji aonure imi.”

b: – Nono Pao Kurirewu makore tumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu jewodudo biri pegamodukaie moto tada birewuge eda keje. Akore, “Imode nowu imagore Davi jiwu iro pemegarewu maku tagai.”
source: – Nono Pao Kurirewu makore tumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu jewodudo biri pegamodukaie moto tada birewuge eda keje. Akore, “Imode nowu imagore Davi jiwu iro pemegarewu maku tagai.”

b: – Ainore akore jamedu, “Amode atugare pemegarewu tawuje birewuge eda piji biri pegakawo toro.”
source: – Ainore akore jamedu, “Amode atugare pemegarewu tawuje birewuge eda piji biri pegakawo toro.”

b: – Jao pagimijera Davi rore Pao Kurirewu roji. Pegagodure dukeje bire. Boe ere tugu mototo nono turo mogadure. Biri pegare toro tori poro ja tada.
source: – Jao pagimijera Davi rore Pao Kurirewu roji. Pegagodure dukeje bire. Boe ere tugu mototo nono turo mogadure. Biri pegare toro tori poro ja tada.

b: Mare nowu Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudowu biri pegakare toro tori ja tada. Jewodure rugadu.
source: Mare nowu Pao Kurirewu ure jewodudowu biri pegakare toro tori ja tada. Jewodure rugadu.

b: Iwobe Judeu dogenure tagi. Iwo tawie. Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru ukare boe etawuje ero pegarewu piji. Mare awu Jesus umode mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe etawuje ero pegarewu piji. Jesus koiare umode Pao Kurirewu biagodudo boe ero pegarewu piji. Dukodi cenure tawie aino.
source: Iwobe Judeu dogenure tagi. Iwo tawie. Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru ukare boe etawuje ero pegarewu piji. Mare awu Jesus umode mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe etawuje ero pegarewu piji. Jesus koiare umode Pao Kurirewu biagodudo boe ero pegarewu piji. Dukodi cenure tawie aino.

b: Taeku jado tarokawo nono jawu pawobe ero mogadure. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore ei marigudu.
source: Taeku jado tarokawo nono jawu pawobe ero mogadure. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emagore ei marigudu.

b: Egore, “Mako pegarewugenure tagi. Ca taruduwakare mare tawimode kuri aino. Tamearutorumodukare iroji awu meri ji. Boe emode taruduwado mare tamearutorumodukare ji.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore nowu boe ji marigudu. – Ca tarokaba nono joruduwa bokwarewuge ero mogadure.
source: Egore, “Mako pegarewugenure tagi. Ca taruduwakare mare tawimode kuri aino. Tamearutorumodukare iroji awu meri ji. Boe emode taruduwado mare tamearutorumodukare ji.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore nowu boe ji marigudu. – Ca tarokaba nono joruduwa bokwarewuge ero mogadure.

b: Ewadaru akedure dukeje nowu Paulo, nowu Barnabé etuiago pugeje. Nou boe emagore ei ewo tugirimi boeiwu Sábado keje ewo boe eruduwado pugeje.
source: Ewadaru akedure dukeje nowu Paulo, nowu Barnabé etuiago pugeje. Nou boe emagore ei ewo tugirimi boeiwu Sábado keje ewo boe eruduwado pugeje.

b: Boe ere tudawuje nowu bai piji dukeje eture nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé eregodaji. Judeu dogenure iage. Rore Judeu doge ero jiwu boe tuginaiwugenure iage jamedu. Paulo, Barnabé utumode Pao Kurirewu bataru tabowugenure emage dukodi emagore ei. Ere egarego. Emagore ei ekawo tugera ra turo pemegarewu piji Pao Kurirewu ro pemegawo ei.
source: Boe ere tudawuje nowu bai piji dukeje eture nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé eregodaji. Judeu dogenure iage. Rore Judeu doge ero jiwu boe tuginaiwugenure iage jamedu. Paulo, Barnabé utumode Pao Kurirewu bataru tabowugenure emage dukodi emagore ei. Ere egarego. Emagore ei ekawo tugera ra turo pemegarewu piji Pao Kurirewu ro pemegawo ei.

b: Boeiwu Sábado meri keje nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui tumearuduwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Boeiwu Sábado meri keje nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui tumearuduwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Nou Judeu doge erudure nowu inoduji dukeje erudu pegare ei rugadu. Etaidukare nouia boe emearuduwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dukodire emago pegare Paulo bataru ji. Emago pegare ji rugadu.
source: Nou Judeu doge erudure nowu inoduji dukeje erudu pegare ei rugadu. Etaidukare nouia boe emearuduwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dukodire emago pegare Paulo bataru ji. Emago pegare ji rugadu.

b: Mare nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé epogurukare tumagowo rugadu nowu Judeu dogei. egore cemagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tawiagai boeto ji. Judeu dogenure tagi. Mare tamearutorukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Tagaidukare tawo tado tarugadu tamearutoruwo Jesus ji. Dukodire tamugumodukare apo rugadu. Dukodire cedumode tabiji cewo boe tuginaiwuge ewie nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji.
source: Mare nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé epogurukare tumagowo rugadu nowu Judeu dogei. egore cemagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tawiagai boeto ji. Judeu dogenure tagi. Mare tamearutorukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Tagaidukare tawo tado tarugadu tamearutoruwo Jesus ji. Dukodire tamugumodukare apo rugadu. Dukodire cedumode tabiji cewo boe tuginaiwuge ewie nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji.

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore, “Ire atudo boe tuginaiwuge etae awo eruduwado i nono jorugu umode boe eruduwado awara jitu mogadure. Iwo boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo.”
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore, “Ire atudo boe tuginaiwuge etae awo eruduwado i nono jorugu umode boe eruduwado awara jitu mogadure. Iwo boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo.”

b: Nou rakojere nonowu boe tuginaiwuge emearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje egaregodure nowu bataru keje rugadu. Emago pemegare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwuge emearutorure rugadu. Aino ewimode mare eragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo du akedumodukare.
source: Nou rakojere nonowu boe tuginaiwuge emearudure nowu bataru ji dukeje egaregodure nowu bataru keje rugadu. Emago pemegare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwuge emearutorure rugadu. Aino ewimode mare eragojemode Pao Kurirewu apo du akedumodukare.

b: Aino Pao Kurirewu bataru ure tumaedo nowu moto jamedu boe ji.
source: Aino Pao Kurirewu bataru ure tumaedo nowu moto jamedu boe ji.

b: Mare ia Judeu doge ere boe eimijerage ero pegado nowu Pauloji nowu Barnabeji. Nou boe eimijerage ere Paulo Barnabé etudo to moto piji. Ia mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu jiwu areme etaidukare Pauloji Barnabeji jamedu nowu Judeu doge ewadaru koia. Oe kurirewugenure emage. Ere Paulo Barnabé etudo jamedu.
source: Mare ia Judeu doge ere boe eimijerage ero pegado nowu Pauloji nowu Barnabeji. Nou boe eimijerage ere Paulo Barnabé etudo to moto piji. Ia mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu jiwu areme etaidukare Pauloji Barnabeji jamedu nowu Judeu doge ewadaru koia. Oe kurirewugenure emage. Ere Paulo Barnabé etudo jamedu.

b: Dukodire Paulo Barnabé eture. Ere tuwure okeakejewu to pui tuwo moto urugudu tawuje tuwure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo taidukare nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge erore jiboe jituji. Dukeje eture Icônio ba kurirewu ka.
source: Dukodire Paulo Barnabé eture. Ere tuwure okeakejewu to pui tuwo moto urugudu tawuje tuwure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo taidukare nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge erore jiboe jituji. Dukeje eture Icônio ba kurirewu ka.

b: Mare nowu Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge egarere kimo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari meture etada rugadu.
source: Mare nowu Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge egarere kimo. Pao Kurirewu Uwari meture etada rugadu.

b: Paulo Uture Icônio Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Paulo Uture Icônio Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Paulo uture Barnabé apo toro Icônio ba kurirewu ka. Toro boe erore ei nono nowu Antioquia kejewuge ero mogadure. Paulo uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Dukodire Judeu doge emearutorure Jesus ji. Emagare rugadu. Boe tuginaiwuge emearutorure Jesus ji jamedu. Emagare jamedu.
source: Paulo uture Barnabé apo toro Icônio ba kurirewu ka. Toro boe erore ei nono nowu Antioquia kejewuge ero mogadure. Paulo uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Dukodire Judeu doge emearutorure Jesus ji. Emagare rugadu. Boe tuginaiwuge emearutorure Jesus ji jamedu. Emagare jamedu.

b: Mare iage emearutorukare ji. Judeu dogenure emage. Ere boe tuginaiwuge ekorigo nowu mearutorure Jesus bataru jiwuge ji.
source: Mare iage emearutorukare ji. Judeu dogenure emage. Ere boe tuginaiwuge ekorigo nowu mearutorure Jesus bataru jiwuge ji.

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eragoje raire nono Icônio ba kurirewu keje. Epogurukare tumagowo rugadu Jesus roji, bataru ji. Jesus ure eragado ero rakawo, ero kuriwo. Ainore ure boe eruduwado boe jokodu jire nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé egoino. Egore Pao Kurirewu ro pemegamoduie mearutorure puduiwuge ji.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge eragoje raire nono Icônio ba kurirewu keje. Epogurukare tumagowo rugadu Jesus roji, bataru ji. Jesus ure eragado ero rakawo, ero kuriwo. Ainore ure boe eruduwado boe jokodu jire nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé egoino. Egore Pao Kurirewu ro pemegamoduie mearutorure puduiwuge ji.

b: Nou Icônio kejewuge epokare puapo. Emearudaekare nono pu mearudae mogadure. Iage etaidure Paulo mearudae ji, Barnabé mearudae ji. Mare iage etaidure nowu Judeu doge emearudae pegarewu ji jamedu.
source: Nou Icônio kejewuge epokare puapo. Emearudaekare nono pu mearudae mogadure. Iage etaidure Paulo mearudae ji, Barnabé mearudae ji. Mare iage etaidure nowu Judeu doge emearudae pegarewu ji jamedu.

b: Dukeje ia boe tuginaiwuge, ia Judeu doge emearudaere turo pegawo nowu Pauloji nowu Barnabeji. Nou ba kurirewu boe eimijerage etaidure turowo aino jamedu. Etaidure tugidowo tori tabo ei.
source: Dukeje ia boe tuginaiwuge, ia Judeu doge emearudaere turo pegawo nowu Pauloji nowu Barnabeji. Nou ba kurirewu boe eimijerage etaidure turowo aino jamedu. Etaidure tugidowo tori tabo ei.

b: Nou Paulo nowu Barnabé eruduware nowu emearudae pegarewu ji dukodire eture nowu ba kurirewu piji. Eture Listra ba kurirewu ka. Eture Derbe ba kurirewu ka jamedu Licaônia moto ka. Eture nowu puredurewu boe eda jamedu boe ka.
source: Nou Paulo nowu Barnabé eruduware nowu emearudae pegarewu ji dukodire eture nowu ba kurirewu piji. Eture Listra ba kurirewu ka. Eture Derbe ba kurirewu ka jamedu Licaônia moto ka. Eture nowu puredurewu boe eda jamedu boe ka.

b: Tugodui dutabo ere boe eruduwado Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji rugadu.
source: Tugodui dutabo ere boe eruduwado Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Paulo Uture Listra Ba Kurirewu Ka, Derbe Ba Kurirewu Ka Jamedu
source: Paulo Uture Listra Ba Kurirewu Ka, Derbe Ba Kurirewu Ka Jamedu

b: Listra ba kurirewu kejere ia pogora pegarewu imedu mugure. Marigudu meru bokware jii je, boture tubogora pegare dutabo.
source: Listra ba kurirewu kejere ia pogora pegarewu imedu mugure. Marigudu meru bokware jii je, boture tubogora pegare dutabo.

b: Emare mugu puredure tu Pauloji. Mearudure Paulo makore jiboe ji. Mearutorure rugadu. Paulo aiwore tu ji. Jorudure mearutorure duji. Dukodire joruduware Pao Kurirewu umode pemegado duji.
source: Emare mugu puredure tu Pauloji. Mearudure Paulo makore jiboe ji. Mearutorure rugadu. Paulo aiwore tu ji. Jorudure mearutorure duji. Dukodire joruduware Pao Kurirewu umode pemegado duji.

b: Dukodire mako pemegare ji boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore aragojedo ameruwo. Ca nowu imedu ure turagojedo taci je. Merure tuwure tabo rugadu.
source: Dukodire mako pemegare ji boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore aragojedo ameruwo. Ca nowu imedu ure turagojedo taci je. Merure tuwure tabo rugadu.

b: Nou boe erudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaiwore Pauloji Barnabeji. Emearudae pegare ei egore bope doge ewari nuie emage. Ekudugodure tuwadaru tabo: – Pamearutorure jiwu pawari ere imedudo pudumi taregoduwo mato pagae. Awu ime pobedu doge pawarinure emage.
source: Nou boe erudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaiwore Pauloji Barnabeji. Emearudae pegare ei egore bope doge ewari nuie emage. Ekudugodure tuwadaru tabo: – Pamearutorure jiwu pawari ere imedudo pudumi taregoduwo mato pagae. Awu ime pobedu doge pawarinure emage.

b: Paulo makore boeto ji dukodire ere Paulo iedo Mercúrio. Ere Barnabé iedo Júpiter.
source: Paulo makore boeto ji dukodire ere Paulo iedo Mercúrio. Ere Barnabé iedo Júpiter.

b: Nou ewari Júpiter uwai mugure nowu ba kurirewu jokorai. Nou Júpiter uwai tadawu bari aregodure tapira doge imebo, okureboe tabo jamedu nowu boe ewo nowu tapira doge ekowu tomeawo ema Paulo ai, Barnabé ai tuwo tuwarido emage.
source: Nou ewari Júpiter uwai mugure nowu ba kurirewu jokorai. Nou Júpiter uwai tadawu bari aregodure tapira doge imebo, okureboe tabo jamedu nowu boe ewo nowu tapira doge ekowu tomeawo ema Paulo ai, Barnabé ai tuwo tuwarido emage.

b: Paulo Barnabé eruduware nuba nowu boe eromode duji dukeje ere tugudau areia bowuje. Eregodure nowu boe etoiagi.
source: Paulo Barnabé eruduware nuba nowu boe eromode duji dukeje ere tugudau areia bowuje. Eregodure nowu boe etoiagi.

b: Ekudugodure: – Tarokaba aino! Imenure cegi nono tamogadure. Cedaregodure cewo tawie Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji tawo tagera ra nowu tamearudae pagarewu piji tamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare paga karega. Ure rugadu. Ema koiare ure baru to, moto to, pobo maerewu to, boe jamedu boe towuje.
source: Ekudugodure: – Tarokaba aino! Imenure cegi nono tamogadure. Cedaregodure cewo tawie Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji tawo tagera ra nowu tamearudae pagarewu piji tamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare paga karega. Ure rugadu. Ema koiare ure baru to, moto to, pobo maerewu to, boe jamedu boe towuje.

b: Marigudu boe ere tumearudae tawuje tumearutoruwo taidure jiboe ji.
source: Marigudu boe ere tumearudae tawuje tumearutoruwo taidure jiboe ji.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare boe ji marigudu. Ure bubutudo turo pemegawo boe ere tugu boe ji. Ure boe eke maku etai. Ure boe egaredo pudui rugadu.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare boe ji marigudu. Ure bubutudo turo pemegawo boe ere tugu boe ji. Ure boe eke maku etai. Ure boe egaredo pudui rugadu.

b: Mare nowu boe etaidure tuwariwo Barnabé Paulo emagece. Etaidure tuwo iaboe kowu tuwo maku etai.
source: Mare nowu boe etaidure tuwariwo Barnabé Paulo emagece. Etaidure tuwo iaboe kowu tuwo maku etai.

b: Dukeje ia Judeu doge etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu piji, Icônio ba kurirewu piji jamedu. Ere nowu boe emearudae mekido turo pegawo Pauloji. Dukodire eidore tori tabo Pauloji. Emearudaere tuie bito rugadu tori tabo dukodire ere tumugudo kororo keje toro nowu ba kurirewu piji.
source: Dukeje ia Judeu doge etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu piji, Icônio ba kurirewu piji jamedu. Ere nowu boe emearudae mekido turo pegawo Pauloji. Dukodire eidore tori tabo Pauloji. Emearudaere tuie bito rugadu tori tabo dukodire ere tumugudo kororo keje toro nowu ba kurirewu piji.

b: Ca mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere bato pui taiwowo Pauloji. Ure turagojedo dukeje uture tuibagi ebo nowu ba kurirewu ka pugeje. Nou barogwato nowu Paulo, nowu Barnabé eture epiji Derbe ba kurirewu ka.
source: Ca mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere bato pui taiwowo Pauloji. Ure turagojedo dukeje uture tuibagi ebo nowu ba kurirewu ka pugeje. Nou barogwato nowu Paulo, nowu Barnabé eture epiji Derbe ba kurirewu ka.

b: Ere Tugirimi Síria Moto Kejewu Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Ere Tugirimi Síria Moto Kejewu Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Paulo, Barnabé emagore nowu Derbe kejewu boe ewiagai Jesus bataru pemegarewuji. Dukodire ia boe emearutorure Jesus ji nono jamedu. Emagare. Dukejere Paulo Barnabé eture tuibagi Listra ba kurirewu ka, Icônio moto ka. Dupijire eture Pisídia moto kejewu Antioquia ba kurirewu ka pugeje.
source: Paulo, Barnabé emagore nowu Derbe kejewu boe ewiagai Jesus bataru pemegarewuji. Dukodire ia boe emearutorure Jesus ji nono jamedu. Emagare. Dukejere Paulo Barnabé eture tuibagi Listra ba kurirewu ka, Icônio moto ka. Dupijire eture Pisídia moto kejewu Antioquia ba kurirewu ka pugeje.

b: Nono ere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakado. Emagore ei ekawo tugera ra tumearutorure Jesus jitu piji. egore Pamode pagimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce dukeje boe rakamode pai woe awu moto keje tu jao. Mare paga karega paruduwo baru to dukodire paroino.
source: Nono ere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakado. Emagore ei ekawo tugera ra tumearutorure Jesus jitu piji. egore Pamode pagimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce dukeje boe rakamode pai woe awu moto keje tu jao. Mare paga karega paruduwo baru to dukodire paroino.

b: Nou emearutorure Jesus jiwuge eda jamedu boe kejere nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé ere tugeragu iagei tuwo mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragedo emage. Enogwagekare nowu ture tugeragu ei kejewu meri ji tumagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai Pao Kurirewu jetu pemegawo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ji.
source: Nou emearutorure Jesus jiwuge eda jamedu boe kejere nowu Paulo nowu Barnabé ere tugeragu iagei tuwo mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragedo emage. Enogwagekare nowu ture tugeragu ei kejewu meri ji tumagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai Pao Kurirewu jetu pemegawo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ji.

b: Ekodure nowu Pisídia moto ji dukeje etaregodure toro Panfília moto ka.
source: Ekodure nowu Pisídia moto ji dukeje etaregodure toro Panfília moto ka.

b: Nonore ere nowu Perge kejewuge ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Dukeje eture Atália ba kurirewu ka.
source: Nonore ere nowu Perge kejewuge ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Dukeje eture Atália ba kurirewu ka.

b: Nou Atália pijire eture ikarerewu tabo tuibagi Síria moto kejewu Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Nou Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagere ere Paulo Barnabé etudo emaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai. Aino ere tugirimi tuibagi pugeje. Pao Kurirewu jetu pemegare ei etaregodu pemegawo tuibagi.
source: Nou Atália pijire eture ikarerewu tabo tuibagi Síria moto kejewu Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Nou Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagere ere Paulo Barnabé etudo emaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu ai. Aino ere tugirimi tuibagi pugeje. Pao Kurirewu jetu pemegare ei etaregodu pemegawo tuibagi.

b: Etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu ka dukeje ere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo bato pui tureadoduwo nuba Pao Kurirewu rore pudui duji. Pao Kurirewu ure boedo turugadu boe tuginaiwugei emearutorure Jesus ji dukodi.
source: Etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu ka dukeje ere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo bato pui tureadoduwo nuba Pao Kurirewu rore pudui duji. Pao Kurirewu ure boedo turugadu boe tuginaiwugei emearutorure Jesus ji dukodi.

b: Nono edu raire nono nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo rugadu.
source: Nono edu raire nono nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo rugadu.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eimijerage Ere Bato Pui Jerusalém Keje
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eimijerage Ere Bato Pui Jerusalém Keje

b: Ia Judéia kejewuge etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Ere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eruduwado. egore Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu bakaru akore boe ewo tuwaga oto biri kado. Boe emodukare tuwaga oto biri kado dukeje Pao Kurirewu umodukare ekinorudo.
source: Ia Judéia kejewuge etaregodure Antioquia ba kurirewu ka. Ere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eruduwado. egore Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu bakaru akore boe ewo tuwaga oto biri kado. Boe emodukare tuwaga oto biri kado dukeje Pao Kurirewu umodukare ekinorudo.

b: Paulo Barnabé emearudaekare nono emearudae mogadure. Dukodire emago rakare ei. Mare emearudae kodukare pu mearudae kodaji. Nono nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage ere tumearudae tawuje Paulo Barnabé etuwo Jerusalém ka ia Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo emagowo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowugei, emagowo nouia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragei jamedu. Nonore eruduwamode nuba turomode nowu Judéia kejewuge emearudae ji.
source: Paulo Barnabé emearudaekare nono emearudae mogadure. Dukodire emago rakare ei. Mare emearudae kodukare pu mearudae kodaji. Nono nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage ere tumearudae tawuje Paulo Barnabé etuwo Jerusalém ka ia Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo emagowo nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowugei, emagowo nouia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragei jamedu. Nonore eruduwamode nuba turomode nowu Judéia kejewuge emearudae ji.

b: Dukodire nowu Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere Paulo Barnabé etudo Jerusalém ka. Ekodure jii toro dukeje etaregodure Fenícia moto ka. Ere nowu moto kejewuge ewie nuba turore nowu boe tuginaiwugei emearutoruwo Jesus ji jamedu. Nou moto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje egaregodure pudui. Paulo, Barnabé etaregodure Samaria moto ka jamedu turore aino dutabo jamedu. Nou Samaria moto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge egarere pudui jamedu.
source: Dukodire nowu Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere Paulo Barnabé etudo Jerusalém ka. Ekodure jii toro dukeje etaregodure Fenícia moto ka. Ere nowu moto kejewuge ewie nuba turore nowu boe tuginaiwugei emearutoruwo Jesus ji jamedu. Nou moto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje egaregodure pudui. Paulo, Barnabé etaregodure Samaria moto ka jamedu turore aino dutabo jamedu. Nou Samaria moto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge egarere pudui jamedu.

b: Nou Paulo nowu Barnabé etaregodure Jerusalém ka dukeje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ekimadure ebo. Nou eimijerage, nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ekimadure ebo jamedu. Nono Paulo makore ei tugoduie toro boe tuginaiwuge etae Pao Kurirewu ro pemegaie nowu boe tuginaiwugei jamedu.
source: Nou Paulo nowu Barnabé etaregodure Jerusalém ka dukeje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ekimadure ebo. Nou eimijerage, nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ekimadure ebo jamedu. Nono Paulo makore ei tugoduie toro boe tuginaiwuge etae Pao Kurirewu ro pemegaie nowu boe tuginaiwugei jamedu.

b: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere tudawuje fariseu doge epiji tumearutoruwo Jesus ji marigudu. Nouge etaidure tuwo tumearudae maku nowu boe tuginaiwuge etai. Emearudure nowu Paulo bataru ji dukeje ere turagojedo tumagowo jamedu. egore Moisés ure maku cenaiwu bakaru koiare ure awu boe tuginaiwuge edo tuwaga oto biri kado nono cero mogadure. Eromodukare aino dukeje emearutorure Jesus jiwuge emodukare emage. Emearutoruwo ceno bakaru jamedu boe ji mearutorure Jesus jiwugewo emage.
source: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere tudawuje fariseu doge epiji tumearutoruwo Jesus ji marigudu. Nouge etaidure tuwo tumearudae maku nowu boe tuginaiwuge etai. Emearudure nowu Paulo bataru ji dukeje ere turagojedo tumagowo jamedu. egore Moisés ure maku cenaiwu bakaru koiare ure awu boe tuginaiwuge edo tuwaga oto biri kado nono cero mogadure. Eromodukare aino dukeje emearutorure Jesus jiwuge emodukare emage. Emearutoruwo ceno bakaru jamedu boe ji mearutorure Jesus jiwugewo emage.

b: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge, nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui tumagowo pui nowu emearudae ji.
source: Nou uture Jesus bataru tabowuge, nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui tumagowo pui nowu emearudae ji.

b: Emago raire pui dukeje Pedro ure turagojedo. Akore imedagenure tagi. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu i tabiji imagowo Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji awu boe tuginaiwuge ewiagai, emearutoruwo tu Jesus ji jamedu.
source: Emago raire pui dukeje Pedro ure turagojedo. Akore imedagenure tagi. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu i tabiji imagowo Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji awu boe tuginaiwuge ewiagai, emearutoruwo tu Jesus ji jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu joruduware boe eiamedu boe emearudae ji. Emare aidure nowu boe tuginaiwugei nono taidumoga pai dumogadure. Ure tuwari maku etai nono ure maku pagai dumogadure dukodire paruduware aidure ei duji.
source: Pao Kurirewu joruduware boe eiamedu boe emearudae ji. Emare aidure nowu boe tuginaiwugei nono taidumoga pai dumogadure. Ure tuwari maku etai nono ure maku pagai dumogadure dukodire paruduware aidure ei duji.

b: Pao Kurirewu ukare turo tuginaiwudo ei. Rore ei nono turore pai dumogadure. Emearutorure Jesus ji dukodire biagodure ero pegarewu piji nono turore pai dumogadure.
source: Pao Kurirewu ukare turo tuginaiwudo ei. Rore ei nono turore pai dumogadure. Emearutorure Jesus ji dukodire biagodure ero pegarewu piji nono turore pai dumogadure.

b: Ca pagawo Pao Kurirewu korigo. Pagawo ia paroia maku boe tuginaiwuge etai. Jao pawobe eroiwakare tuwo nowu paroia towuje. Ca aino pagi paroiwakare pawo nowu paroia to jamedu. Pagawo maku etai.
source: Ca pagawo Pao Kurirewu korigo. Pagawo ia paroia maku boe tuginaiwuge etai. Jao pawobe eroiwakare tuwo nowu paroia towuje. Ca aino pagi paroiwakare pawo nowu paroia to jamedu. Pagawo maku etai.

b: Pamearutorumode Pagimijera Jesus ji dukeje emare umode paginorudo taidu tabo. Pagi pamodukare paginorudo ia paro pemegarewu tabo.
source: Pamearutorumode Pagimijera Jesus ji dukeje emare umode paginorudo taidu tabo. Pagi pamodukare paginorudo ia paro pemegarewu tabo.

b: Nono Barnabé, nowu Paulo ere nowu boe ewie nuba boere ei eture nouia moto ka dukeje. Egore Pao Kurirewu ro rakaie, ro kurie nowu boe tuginaiwuge ji. Nou boe edukiorore tuwiapaga tabo nowu Paulo, nowu Barnabé ewadaru ji.
source: Nono Barnabé, nowu Paulo ere nowu boe ewie nuba boere ei eture nouia moto ka dukeje. Egore Pao Kurirewu ro rakaie, ro kurie nowu boe tuginaiwuge ji. Nou boe edukiorore tuwiapaga tabo nowu Paulo, nowu Barnabé ewadaru ji.

b: Ere tuwadaru akedudo dukeje Tiago makore tumearudae ji jamedu. Akore tawiapagado iwadaru ji. Imedagenure tagi.
source: Ere tuwadaru akedudo dukeje Tiago makore tumearudae ji jamedu. Akore tawiapagado iwadaru ji. Imedagenure tagi.

b: Pedro ure pawie nuba Pao Kurirewu rore tuwo tugeragu nouia boe tuginaiwugei emearutoruwo pudui uwobewo emage.
source: Pedro ure pawie nuba Pao Kurirewu rore tuwo tugeragu nouia boe tuginaiwugei emearutoruwo pudui uwobewo emage.

b: Ia mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ewadaru ure nono nowu Pedro bataru mogadure jamedu. Ere Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje.
source: Ia mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ewadaru ure nono nowu Pedro bataru mogadure jamedu. Ere Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje.

b: Akore tagimijeranure imi. Imire imode boe kurirewugedo tagi pugeje nono tare tagimijera Davi apo dumogadure. Imode tawai jamedu boe epemegado pugeje tago moto keje tawo tagirimi moto jamedu boe piji tago moto ka. Imode taragado pugeje.
source: Akore tagimijeranure imi. Imire imode boe kurirewugedo tagi pugeje nono tare tagimijera Davi apo dumogadure. Imode tawai jamedu boe epemegado pugeje tago moto keje tawo tagirimi moto jamedu boe piji tago moto ka. Imode taragado pugeje.

b: Dukeje nouia moto kejewuge etaregodumode itae. Nou ire ikeragu jiwuge boe tuginaiwuge etaregodumode itae jamedu.
source: Dukeje nouia moto kejewuge etaregodumode itae. Nou ire ikeragu jiwuge boe tuginaiwuge etaregodumode itae jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewunure imi. Marigudu rugadu ire boe ewie rugadu. Ainore iromode duji.
source: Pao Kurirewunure imi. Marigudu rugadu ire boe ewie rugadu. Ainore iromode duji.

b: Tiago mako kimore: – Imearudaere pagawo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge boe tuginaiwuge erodo nono parore jiboe ji.
source: Tiago mako kimore: – Imearudaere pagawo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge boe tuginaiwuge erodo nono parore jiboe ji.

b: Pawo ia atugoreboe maku etai. Pamagowo ei ekawo ia makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge eke kowuje. Ime eribarikawo tumugukare apowu aremei. Areme eribarikawo tumugukare apowu imei. Ekawo bukigu kogure itoru kajejewu barogo ko. Ekawo barogo ku kowuje jamedu.
source: Pawo ia atugoreboe maku etai. Pamagowo ei ekawo ia makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge eke kowuje. Ime eribarikawo tumugukare apowu aremei. Areme eribarikawo tumugukare apowu imei. Ekawo bukigu kogure itoru kajejewu barogo ko. Ekawo barogo ku kowuje jamedu.

b: Boe eiamedu boe eruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu bakaruji. Boe etaiwore ji ture bato puiwu bai doge emagare dutada.
source: Boe eiamedu boe eruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu bakaruji. Boe etaiwore ji ture bato puiwu bai doge emagare dutada.

b: Ere Atugoreboe Maku Boe Tuginaiwuge Etai
source: Ere Atugoreboe Maku Boe Tuginaiwuge Etai

b: Dukejere nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge, nowu boe eimijerage, nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe emearudaere tuwo tugeragu imei tuwo etudo Paulo apo Barnabé apo toro Antioquia kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Ere tugeragu ime pobedu dogei. Emearutoru rakare Jesus ji rugadu. Ia iere Judas. Iere Barsabás jamedu. Nou metia iere Silas.
source: Dukejere nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge, nowu boe eimijerage, nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe emearudaere tuwo tugeragu imei tuwo etudo Paulo apo Barnabé apo toro Antioquia kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Ere tugeragu ime pobedu dogei. Emearutoru rakare Jesus ji rugadu. Ia iere Judas. Iere Barsabás jamedu. Nou metia iere Silas.

b: Ainore nowu boe ere ia atugoreboe pemegado tuwo maku nowu Antioquia kejewuge ewagai nowu ime pobedu dogebo. Ainore nowu atugoreboe ure. Akore uture Jesus bataru tabowugenure cegi. Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure cegi. Cenure awu atugoreboe maku Antioquia kejewuge etai, Síria moto kejewuge etai, Cilícia moto kejewuge etai. Judeu doge karegure tagi mare tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire cewobenure tagi. –
source: Ainore nowu boe ere ia atugoreboe pemegado tuwo maku nowu Antioquia kejewuge ewagai nowu ime pobedu dogebo. Ainore nowu atugoreboe ure. Akore uture Jesus bataru tabowugenure cegi. Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure cegi. Cenure awu atugoreboe maku Antioquia kejewuge etai, Síria moto kejewuge etai, Cilícia moto kejewuge etai. Judeu doge karegure tagi mare tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire cewobenure tagi. –

b: Ia cewobe eture tagae dukeje etaidure tuwo tumearudae maku tagai. Mare cegare nowu emearudae maku etai. Nou emearudae koiare ure tagiarigo ure tamororamagadudo.
source: Ia cewobe eture tagae dukeje etaidure tuwo tumearudae maku tagai. Mare cegare nowu emearudae maku etai. Nou emearudae koiare ure tagiarigo ure tamororamagadudo.

b: Mare cere bato pui woe cewo cemearudae tawuje. Dukodire cenure awu ime etudo toro cewadaru tabo tagae. Etaregodumode pamearudu kurire jiwu pamedia Paulo apo, pamedia Barnabé apo jamedu.
source: Mare cere bato pui woe cewo cemearudae tawuje. Dukodire cenure awu ime etudo toro cewadaru tabo tagae. Etaregodumode pamearudu kurire jiwu pamedia Paulo apo, pamedia Barnabé apo jamedu.

b: Emaragodure Pao Kurirewu ai dukeje boe pegare ei rugadu. Boe ere tori to ei tuwo ewido mare ewikare.
source: Emaragodure Pao Kurirewu ai dukeje boe pegare ei rugadu. Boe ere tori to ei tuwo ewido mare ewikare.

b: Ca nouia cere etudowu tagaewu imedu iere Judas. Nou metia iere Silas. Emagere emode tawie cewadaru ji, awu cere bu bapera kejewu cewadaru ji rugadu.
source: Ca nouia cere etudowu tagaewu imedu iere Judas. Nou metia iere Silas. Emagere emode tawie cewadaru ji, awu cere bu bapera kejewu cewadaru ji rugadu.

b: Cewo tawie. Tagaba makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge eke kowuje. Tagaba barogo ku kowuje. Tagaba bukigu kogure itoru kajejewu barogo ko. Taeribarikaba tamugukare apowu aremei. Taeribarikaba tamugukare apowu imei. Taromodukare nowu ro pegarewu ji dukeje boe pemegamode tai rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ukare ia Judeu doge ero maku tagai tarokawo ji. Ainore cemearudaere jamedu. Cedaidure boe pemegawo tai. Kodire cere tawie. Ca urugadurewu.
source: Cewo tawie. Tagaba makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge eke kowuje. Tagaba barogo ku kowuje. Tagaba bukigu kogure itoru kajejewu barogo ko. Taeribarikaba tamugukare apowu aremei. Taeribarikaba tamugukare apowu imei. Taromodukare nowu ro pegarewu ji dukeje boe pemegamode tai rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ukare ia Judeu doge ero maku tagai tarokawo ji. Ainore cemearudaere jamedu. Cedaidure boe pemegawo tai. Kodire cere tawie. Ca urugadurewu.

b: Ca nowu ime pobedu doge eture toro Antioquia ba kurirewu ka nowu atugoreboe tabo. Toro nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui nowu ime pobedu dogebo. Nou ime ere nowu atugoreboe maku etai.
source: Ca nowu ime pobedu doge eture toro Antioquia ba kurirewu ka nowu atugoreboe tabo. Toro nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui nowu ime pobedu dogebo. Nou ime ere nowu atugoreboe maku etai.

b: Etaiwore ji dukeje egarere pudui rugadu. Nou atugoreboe ure nowu ekiarigodu barigu epiji.
source: Etaiwore ji dukeje egarere pudui rugadu. Nou atugoreboe ure nowu ekiarigodu barigu epiji.

b: Nou Judas, nowu Silas makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugenure emage. Dukodire emago raire nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei tuwo emearutoru rakado tuwo emearudae pemegado.
source: Nou Judas, nowu Silas makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugenure emage. Dukodire emago raire nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei tuwo emearutoru rakado tuwo emearudae pemegado.

b: Edu raire nono nowu boe dogebo. Nou Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etaidu pemegare ei. Nono ere tuwadaru pemegarewu maku etai tuwo nowu ime pobedu doge edo tugirimi tuibagi nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae Jerusalém ka.
source: Edu raire nono nowu boe dogebo. Nou Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etaidu pemegare ei. Nono ere tuwadaru pemegarewu maku etai tuwo nowu ime pobedu doge edo tugirimi tuibagi nowu uture Jesus bataru tabowuge etae Jerusalém ka.

b: Mare Paulo utukare. Rakoje raire nowu Antioquia ba kurirewu keje Barnabé apo. Iagebo ere boe eruduwado Pagimijera Jesus jiboe ji. Emago pemegare ji rugadu boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo.
source: Mare Paulo utukare. Rakoje raire nowu Antioquia ba kurirewu keje Barnabé apo. Iagebo ere boe eruduwado Pagimijera Jesus jiboe ji. Emago pemegare ji rugadu boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo.

b: Paulo Barnabé Ere Tugera Ra Pubiji
source: Paulo Barnabé Ere Tugera Ra Pubiji

b: Ia meri keje Paulo makore Barnabeji. Akore Paduwo toro nowu pamagore Pagimijera bataru kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka paruduwo mearutorure Jesus jiwugei nono, paruduwawo nuba boere nowu pamedagei.
source: Ia meri keje Paulo makore Barnabeji. Akore Paduwo toro nowu pamagore Pagimijera bataru kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka paruduwo mearutorure Jesus jiwugei nono, paruduwawo nuba boere nowu pamedagei.

b: Barnabé aidure João Marcos utuwo pudabo jamedu.
source: Barnabé aidure João Marcos utuwo pudabo jamedu.

b: Mare Paulo aidukare. João Marcos uture ebo boeto ji dutabo nowu João Marcos ure tugera ra epiji. Panfília moto keje ure tugera ra epiji. Ekare tumaragodae iado mare ure tugera ra epiji dukodire Paulo aidukare utuwo pudabo pugeje.
source: Mare Paulo aidukare. João Marcos uture ebo boeto ji dutabo nowu João Marcos ure tugera ra epiji. Panfília moto keje ure tugera ra epiji. Ekare tumaragodae iado mare ure tugera ra epiji dukodire Paulo aidukare utuwo pudabo pugeje.

b: Paulo Barnabé emago rakare pui mare ekare tumearudae tawuje. Dukodire ere tugera ra pubiji. Barnabé uture João Marcos apo toro Chipre moto ka ikarerewu tabo.
source: Paulo Barnabé emago rakare pui mare ekare tumearudae tawuje. Dukodire ere tugera ra pubiji. Barnabé uture João Marcos apo toro Chipre moto ka ikarerewu tabo.

b: Paulo ure tugeragu imedu Silasji tuduwo apo. Nou Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagore Jesus bagai eparu tabo Jesus ro pemegawo ei dukejere eture.
source: Paulo ure tugeragu imedu Silasji tuduwo apo. Nou Antioquia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagore Jesus bagai eparu tabo Jesus ro pemegawo ei dukejere eture.

b: Eture mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe etae Síria moto ka, Cilícia moto ka. Ere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakado rugadu.
source: Eture mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe etae Síria moto ka, Cilícia moto ka. Ere nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakado rugadu.

b: Paulo Silas Eture Timóteo Apo
source: Paulo Silas Eture Timóteo Apo

b: Paulo uture Derbe ba kurirewu ka. Uture Listra ba kurirewu ka. Listra kejere ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu mugure. Iere Timóteo. Timóteo uce mearutorure Jesus ji jamedu. Judeunure ema. Mare Timóteo uo Gregonure ema.
source: Paulo uture Derbe ba kurirewu ka. Uture Listra ba kurirewu ka. Listra kejere ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu mugure. Iere Timóteo. Timóteo uce mearutorure Jesus ji jamedu. Judeunure ema. Mare Timóteo uo Gregonure ema.

b: Nou Listra kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe emago pemegare nowu Timóteo rore jiboe ji. Icônio kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emago pemegare Timóteo rore jiboe ji jamedu.
source: Nou Listra kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe emago pemegare nowu Timóteo rore jiboe ji. Icônio kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emago pemegare Timóteo rore jiboe ji jamedu.

b: Paulo ure Timóteo baka oto biri kado nono Judeu doge ero mogadure Judeu doge emago pegakawo ji. Uo Judeu karegure ema dukodire boture dukeje uce ukare Timóteo baka oto biri kado. Paulo aidure Timóteo utuwo pudabo makowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Judeu doge ewiagai jamedu.
source: Paulo ure Timóteo baka oto biri kado nono Judeu doge ero mogadure Judeu doge emago pegakawo ji. Uo Judeu karegure ema dukodire boture dukeje uce ukare Timóteo baka oto biri kado. Paulo aidure Timóteo utuwo pudabo makowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Judeu doge ewiagai jamedu.

b: Ca eture. Ere nowu Jerusalém kejewuge ewadaru tadawu atugoreboe maku nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe etai. Enogituware ei emearutoruwo nowu atugoreboe kejewu bataru ji.
source: Ca eture. Ere nowu Jerusalém kejewuge ewadaru tadawu atugoreboe maku nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe etai. Enogituware ei emearutoruwo nowu atugoreboe kejewu bataru ji.

b: Dukodire nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakare Jesus ji pugeje. Meri jamedu boe ji emagagodure rugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakare Jesus ji pugeje. Meri jamedu boe ji emagagodure rugadu.

b: Paulo Jorudure Iaboe ji Trôade Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Paulo Jorudure Iaboe ji Trôade Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: Eture Frígia moto ji, Galácia moto ji mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tumearudae maku etai etukawo Ásia moto ka emagokawo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nono.
source: Eture Frígia moto ji, Galácia moto ji mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tumearudae maku etai etukawo Ásia moto ka emagokawo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nono.

b: Etaregodure Mísia moto ka dukeje etaidure tuduwo Bitínia moto ka jamedu. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tugeragu ei etukawo toro.
source: Etaregodure Mísia moto ka dukeje etaidure tuduwo Bitínia moto ka jamedu. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tugeragu ei etukawo toro.

b: Dukodire eture Mísia moto piji toro Trôade ba kurirewu ka.
source: Dukodire eture Mísia moto piji toro Trôade ba kurirewu ka.

b: Etaregodure toro dukeje nowu boeco ji Paulo jorudure iaboe ji. Ure nono boe uniau mogadure. Jorudure ia Macedônia kejewu imeduji. Rakojere duji. Makore nowu Paulo bagai. Akore mato Macedônia moto ka cedae tawo tagera maku cenai.
source: Etaregodure toro dukeje nowu boeco ji Paulo jorudure iaboe ji. Ure nono boe uniau mogadure. Jorudure ia Macedônia kejewu imeduji. Rakojere duji. Makore nowu Paulo bagai. Akore mato Macedônia moto ka cedae tawo tagera maku cenai.

b: Paulo jorudure nowu inoduji dukodire ceruduware Pao Kurirewu aidure cemagowo Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji nowu moto kejewuge ewiagai jamedu. Dukeje cere cegera pemegado cei ceduwo Macedônia moto ka.
source: Paulo jorudure nowu inoduji dukodire ceruduware Pao Kurirewu aidure cemagowo Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji nowu moto kejewuge ewiagai jamedu. Dukeje cere cegera pemegado cei ceduwo Macedônia moto ka.

b: Aredu Lídia Mearutorure Jesus ji Filipos Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Aredu Lídia Mearutorure Jesus ji Filipos Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: Cedure ikarerewu tabo Trôade piji toro Samotrácia moto ka. Nou barogwato cedaregodure Neápolis ba kurirewu ka.
source: Cedure ikarerewu tabo Trôade piji toro Samotrácia moto ka. Nou barogwato cedaregodure Neápolis ba kurirewu ka.

b: Neápolis pijire cedure awara ji toro Filipos ba kurirewu ka. Nou Filipos ba kurirewu mugure Macedônia moto keje. Romano doge ere nowu Filipos ba kurirewu rakojedo. Cedukare nowu ba kurirewu piji kuri je.
source: Neápolis pijire cedure awara ji toro Filipos ba kurirewu ka. Nou Filipos ba kurirewu mugure Macedônia moto keje. Romano doge ere nowu Filipos ba kurirewu rakojedo. Cedukare nowu ba kurirewu piji kuri je.

b: Sábado meri ji cedure poborerewu okwa ka. Puredure nowu ba kurirewuji. Cemearudaere Judeu doge emoduie bato pui nono tumagowo baru to. Cere cemugudo nono pobo okwai. Cemagore ia aremei nono.
source: Sábado meri ji cedure poborerewu okwa ka. Puredure nowu ba kurirewuji. Cemearudaere Judeu doge emoduie bato pui nono tumagowo baru to. Cere cemugudo nono pobo okwai. Cemagore ia aremei nono.

b: Ia aredu iere Lídia. Aregodure Tiatira ba kurirewu piji tuwo boe ekudau areia pemegarewu maku diero bagai. Nou aredu ure tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji tu tu je. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure nowu aredu joruduwado Paulo bataru ji mearutoruwo Jesus ji.
source: Ia aredu iere Lídia. Aregodure Tiatira ba kurirewu piji tuwo boe ekudau areia pemegarewu maku diero bagai. Nou aredu ure tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji tu tu je. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure nowu aredu joruduwado Paulo bataru ji mearutoruwo Jesus ji.

b: Dukodire ao pegododure. Nou rakojere uwai tadawuge eiamedu boe etao pegododure jamedu. Dukeje makore cei. Akore tamearudaere imearutorure Jesus ji rugadu dukodi mato taragojewo iwai tada. Akore aino dukodire cebadure uwai tada rugadu.
source: Dukodire ao pegododure. Nou rakojere uwai tadawuge eiamedu boe etao pegododure jamedu. Dukeje makore cei. Akore tamearudaere imearutorure Jesus ji rugadu dukodi mato taragojewo iwai tada. Akore aino dukodire cebadure uwai tada rugadu.

b: Paulo Silas Ewarigudure Baicorewuto
source: Paulo Silas Ewarigudure Baicorewuto

b: Ia meri keje cedure boe emagore baru to kejewu bai ka dukeje cedaregodure ia nogwaredu togi. Nou nogwaredu maragodure ia ime etai. Ia bope meture nowu nogwaredu tada dukodire joruduware nuba boemode boe ji. Nou nogwaredu joruduware boe jamedu ji. Makore jiboe jeture pudui tu tu je. Dukodire boe ere nowu bataru boe morido. Ure tugeragu diero kurirewu ji tugimijerage enoce.
source: Ia meri keje cedure boe emagore baru to kejewu bai ka dukeje cedaregodure ia nogwaredu togi. Nou nogwaredu maragodure ia ime etai. Ia bope meture nowu nogwaredu tada dukodire joruduware nuba boemode boe ji. Nou nogwaredu joruduware boe jamedu ji. Makore jiboe jeture pudui tu tu je. Dukodire boe ere nowu bataru boe morido. Ure tugeragu diero kurirewu ji tugimijerage enoce.

b: Nono meri raire nowu nogwareduji uture Paulo rekodaji dutabo. Kudugodure jamedu. Akore awu ime emaragodure baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu ai. Emage enure boe ewie nuba boe eromode tuwo cinorudo.
source: Nono meri raire nowu nogwareduji uture Paulo rekodaji dutabo. Kudugodure jamedu. Akore awu ime emaragodure baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu ai. Emage enure boe ewie nuba boe eromode tuwo cinorudo.

b: Meri raire ji rore aino duji dukejere Paulo korigodure ji. Dukodire ure tuie kirimi togi. Makore nowu bopeji. Akore Jesus Cristo ie tabore inagoino ai. Ema koiare atawuje nowu nogwaredu piji. Ca nowu bope ure tudawuje nowu nogwaredu piji rugadu.
source: Meri raire ji rore aino duji dukejere Paulo korigodure ji. Dukodire ure tuie kirimi togi. Makore nowu bopeji. Akore Jesus Cristo ie tabore inagoino ai. Ema koiare atawuje nowu nogwaredu piji. Ca nowu bope ure tudawuje nowu nogwaredu piji rugadu.

b: Nou maragodure aiwu ime eruduware nowu inoduji dukeje ekorigodure rugadu. Nou nogwaredu makomodukare pugeje nuba boemode duji dukodire umodukare tugeragu dieroji pugeje enoce. Dukodire nowu ime ere tugeragu Pauloji, Silasji. Eture ebo toro nowu ba kurirewu kejewu boe eimijerage etae nowu ba kurirewu oia ka.
source: Nou maragodure aiwu ime eruduware nowu inoduji dukeje ekorigodure rugadu. Nou nogwaredu makomodukare pugeje nuba boemode duji dukodire umodukare tugeragu dieroji pugeje enoce. Dukodire nowu ime ere tugeragu Pauloji, Silasji. Eture ebo toro nowu ba kurirewu kejewu boe eimijerage etae nowu ba kurirewu oia ka.

b: Etaregodure nowu Romano doge eimijerage etae dukeje egore awu ime Judeu dogenure emage. Ero pegare woe awu ba kurirewu keje.
source: Etaregodure nowu Romano doge eimijerage etae dukeje egore awu ime Judeu dogenure emage. Ero pegare woe awu ba kurirewu keje.

b: Enure boe ero mekido paroia piji ero pegawo. Romano dogenure pagi. Pagaidukare nowu eroiaji. Paromodukare nono ero mogadure.
source: Enure boe ero mekido paroia piji ero pegawo. Romano dogenure pagi. Pagaidukare nowu eroiaji. Paromodukare nono ero mogadure.

b: Boe eiamedu boe emago pegare aino nowu Pauloji nowu Silasji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ere nowu Paulo nowu Silas ekudau areia tawuje epiji. Emagore tugobaigaregei ewo boeto ei.
source: Boe eiamedu boe emago pegare aino nowu Pauloji nowu Silasji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ere nowu Paulo nowu Silas ekudau areia tawuje epiji. Emagore tugobaigaregei ewo boeto ei.

b: Tugobaigarege ere boeto ei dukeje ere ewarigu baicorewuto. Emagore nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijeraji uwo ekogudo rugadu.
source: Tugobaigarege ere boeto ei dukeje ere ewarigu baicorewuto. Emagore nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijeraji uwo ekogudo rugadu.

b: Nou baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera mearudure ewadaru ji dukeje ure Paulo Silas etugu nowu baicorewu tadawu baicorewu roguto. Ure ewure ekogudo ira kurirewu tabo.
source: Nou baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera mearudure ewadaru ji dukeje ure Paulo Silas etugu nowu baicorewu tadawu baicorewu roguto. Ure ewure ekogudo ira kurirewu tabo.

b: Ari aregodure baru oia ka dukeje Paulo Silas eragodure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Emagore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Nouia baicorewu tadawu ro pegarewuge ewiapagare ei.
source: Ari aregodure baru oia ka dukeje Paulo Silas eragodure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Emagore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Nouia baicorewu tadawu ro pegarewuge ewiapagare ei.

b: Rore puku ei moto magadugodu rakare duji. Ure nowu baicorewu magadudo jamedu. Ca nowu baicorewu bai poro rugadu boe ere tuiado. Nou corrente ere tugiwuje nowu ro pegarewuge eiamedu boe epiji.
source: Rore puku ei moto magadugodu rakare duji. Ure nowu baicorewu magadudo jamedu. Ca nowu baicorewu bai poro rugadu boe ere tuiado. Nou corrente ere tugiwuje nowu ro pegarewuge eiamedu boe epiji.

b: Nou baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera jetadure dukeje jorudure nowu bai poro rugadu boe jadodure duji. Meardaere nowu baicorewu tadawuge eiamedu boe ere marigudu. Dukodire ure tugeragu to tariga kurirewuji. Ure tuiago tuwido tabo.
source: Nou baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera jetadure dukeje jorudure nowu bai poro rugadu boe jadodure duji. Meardaere nowu baicorewu tadawuge eiamedu boe ere marigudu. Dukodire ure tugeragu to tariga kurirewuji. Ure tuiago tuwido tabo.

b: Mare Paulo kudugodure ae ukawo tuwido. Akore akaba awido. Ceiamedu boe ceragoje kimore woe baicorewu tada.
source: Mare Paulo kudugodure ae ukawo tuwido. Akore akaba awido. Ceiamedu boe ceragoje kimore woe baicorewu tada.

b: Nou baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera makore jorugu bagai. Dutabore ure turemo Paulo ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Paulo Silas egorai tumago pemegawo ei.
source: Nou baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera makore jorugu bagai. Dutabore ure turemo Paulo ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Paulo Silas egorai tumago pemegawo ei.

b: Nono ure erego toro bawadu ka. Unarare ei. Akore nuba iromode iwo ikinorudo?
source: Nono ure erego toro bawadu ka. Unarare ei. Akore nuba iromode iwo ikinorudo?

b: egore amearutorudo Pagimijera Jesus ji dukeje umode akinorudo. Umode awobe ekinorudo jamedu.
source: egore amearutorudo Pagimijera Jesus ji dukeje umode akinorudo. Umode awobe ekinorudo jamedu.

b: Dukejere emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji biagai, nowu uwai tadawu uwobe ewiagai jamedu.
source: Dukejere emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji biagai, nowu uwai tadawu uwobe ewiagai jamedu.

b: Nou boeco ji rugadu nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera ure jorubo reko nowu ime pobedu doge ecebaeji. Nou boeco ji rugadu nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera ao pegododure tuwobe eiamedu boe apo.
source: Nou boeco ji rugadu nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera ure jorubo reko nowu ime pobedu doge ecebaeji. Nou boeco ji rugadu nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera ao pegododure tuwobe eiamedu boe apo.

b: Dukejere uture Paulo apo Silas apo toro tuwai ka tuwo enogwagedo nono tuwai keje. Ema uwobe eiamedu boe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire egarere pudui rugadu.
source: Dukejere uture Paulo apo Silas apo toro tuwai ka tuwo enogwagedo nono tuwai keje. Ema uwobe eiamedu boe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodire egarere pudui rugadu.

b: Nou barogwato nowu Romano doge eimijerage ere tugobaigaregedo atugoreboe maku toro nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera bagai. Nou atugoreboe akore Nou ime etudo.
source: Nou barogwato nowu Romano doge eimijerage ere tugobaigaregedo atugoreboe maku toro nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera bagai. Nou atugoreboe akore Nou ime etudo.

b: Dukodire nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera ure Paulo bie. Akore Pagimijerage ere atugoreboe maku mato inai. Egore iago tadudo baicorewu piji. Ca ure turugadu tawo tadawuje taduwo. Tadu pemegawo taibagi.
source: Dukodire nowu baicorewu tadawu boe eimijera ure Paulo bie. Akore Pagimijerage ere atugoreboe maku mato inai. Egore iago tadudo baicorewu piji. Ca ure turugadu tawo tadawuje taduwo. Tadu pemegawo taibagi.

b: Mare Paulo makore nowu tugobaigaregei. Akore boe erudukare ia cero pegarewuji. Mare jawu meri ji tare boeto cei boe egai. Romano dogenure cegi jamedu! Jawu meri ji tagimijerage ere cedugu baicorewuto boe egai. Mare etaidukare boe eruduwawo cedure duji. Mare ceromodukare aino. Nou Romano doge eimijerage emagere etaregoduwo woe tuwo cedawuje awu baicorewu piji ceduwo pugeje.
source: Mare Paulo makore nowu tugobaigaregei. Akore boe erudukare ia cero pegarewuji. Mare jawu meri ji tare boeto cei boe egai. Romano dogenure cegi jamedu! Jawu meri ji tagimijerage ere cedugu baicorewuto boe egai. Mare etaidukare boe eruduwawo cedure duji. Mare ceromodukare aino. Nou Romano doge eimijerage emagere etaregoduwo woe tuwo cedawuje awu baicorewu piji ceduwo pugeje.

b: Nou tugobaigarege ere tugimijerage ewie nowu Paulo bataru ji rugadu. Nou eimijerage emearudure Paulo Silas Romano dogere emage duji dukeje epagudugodure rugadu.
source: Nou tugobaigarege ere tugimijerage ewie nowu Paulo bataru ji rugadu. Nou eimijerage emearudure Paulo Silas Romano dogere emage duji dukeje epagudugodure rugadu.

b: Dukodire eture toro etae. Eimadure ebo dukeje ere etawuje baicorewu piji. Nono emagore ei etuwo nowu ba kurirewu piji.
source: Dukodire eture toro etae. Eimadure ebo dukeje ere etawuje baicorewu piji. Nono emagore ei etuwo nowu ba kurirewu piji.

b: Mare Paulo Silas ere tudawuje nowu baicorewu piji dukeje eture nowu aredu Lídia uwai ka nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Emagore nowu tumedagei tuwo emearutoru rakado dukeje eture. Mare imi itukare ebo.
source: Mare Paulo Silas ere tudawuje nowu baicorewu piji dukeje eture nowu aredu Lídia uwai ka nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Emagore nowu tumedagei tuwo emearutoru rakado dukeje eture. Mare imi itukare ebo.

b: Eture Tessalônica Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Eture Tessalônica Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Paulo Silas eture Anfípolis ba kurirewu ka nowu pijire eture toro Apolônia ba kurirewu ka. Nono etaregodure Tessalônica ba kurirewu ka. Ia Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai mugure nowu ba kurirewu keje.
source: Paulo Silas eture Anfípolis ba kurirewu ka nowu pijire eture toro Apolônia ba kurirewu ka. Nono etaregodure Tessalônica ba kurirewu ka. Ia Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai mugure nowu ba kurirewu keje.

b: Paulo uture nowu bai ka tu tu je Sábado meri ji turo mogadure. Sábado merire pobe metia bokware akoe tumago tabo nowu boe ji dukeje. Nou boe emagore ji jamedu.
source: Paulo uture nowu bai ka tu tu je Sábado meri ji turo mogadure. Sábado merire pobe metia bokware akoe tumago tabo nowu boe ji dukeje. Nou boe emagore ji jamedu.

b: Paulo ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru akore nowu umode boe ekinorudowu bimoduie dukeje jewodumoduie pugeje. Paulo akore Inure tawie Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji.
source: Paulo ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru akore nowu umode boe ekinorudowu bimoduie dukeje jewodumoduie pugeje. Paulo akore Inure tawie Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema duji.

b: Iage emearutorure Paulo bataru ji dukodire ere bato pui Paulo Silas etae. Ia boe eimijerage areme emearutorure jamedu. Emagare. Ia mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu jiwu Grego doge emearutorure jamedu. Emagare jamedu.
source: Iage emearutorure Paulo bataru ji dukodire ere bato pui Paulo Silas etae. Ia boe eimijerage areme emearutorure jamedu. Emagare. Ia mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu jiwu Grego doge emearutorure jamedu. Emagare jamedu.

b: Mare ia Judeu doge erudu pegare dukodire ere tugeragu ro pegarewugei awara piji tuwo ero pegado. Ero pegare nowu ba kurirewu ji rugadu. Ere turemo ia baito turaga tabo. Nou uwaire bai cewu iere Jasom. Mearutorure Jesus jiwunure ema. Nou ro pegarewuge etaiwore Paulo bagai, nowu Silas bagai.
source: Mare ia Judeu doge erudu pegare dukodire ere tugeragu ro pegarewugei awara piji tuwo ero pegado. Ero pegare nowu ba kurirewu ji rugadu. Ere turemo ia baito turaga tabo. Nou uwaire bai cewu iere Jasom. Mearutorure Jesus jiwunure ema. Nou ro pegarewuge etaiwore Paulo bagai, nowu Silas bagai.

b: Erudukare ei dukeje ere tugeragu nowu Jasomji turaga tabo. Ere tumugudo keje kororo je ia mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo toro nowu ba kurirewu tadawu boe eimijerage etae. egore nou ime ero pegare rugadu moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Ca etaregodure woe jamedu.
source: Erudukare ei dukeje ere tugeragu nowu Jasomji turaga tabo. Ere tumugudo keje kororo je ia mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo toro nowu ba kurirewu tadawu boe eimijerage etae. egore nou ime ero pegare rugadu moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Ca etaregodure woe jamedu.

b: Awu Jasom emare ure tugera upodo ebo tuwai keje. Dukodire eiamedu boe emearutorukare pagimijera kurirewu Roma tadawu Cesaji pugeje. Egore tumearutoruie ia tugimijera kurirewuji. Nou ekimijera iere Jesus.
source: Awu Jasom emare ure tugera upodo ebo tuwai keje. Dukodire eiamedu boe emearutorukare pagimijera kurirewu Roma tadawu Cesaji pugeje. Egore tumearutoruie ia tugimijera kurirewuji. Nou ekimijera iere Jesus.

b: Nou tuwadrarodu tabore ere boe ekorigo, ere nowu ba kurirewu tadawu boe eimijerage ekorigo rugadu.
source: Nou tuwadrarodu tabore ere boe ekorigo, ere nowu ba kurirewu tadawu boe eimijerage ekorigo rugadu.

b: Nou boe eimijerage emagore nowu Jasomji nowu iagei ewo turo morido diero tabo etawujeduwo. Ere morido dukeje eture.
source: Nou boe eimijerage emagore nowu Jasomji nowu iagei ewo turo morido diero tabo etawujeduwo. Ere morido dukeje eture.

b: Eture Beréia Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Eture Beréia Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Boecodure dukeje nowu ba kurirewu tadawu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere Paulo Silas etudo Beréia ba kurirewu ka. Etaregodure toro dukeje eture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka.
source: Boecodure dukeje nowu ba kurirewu tadawu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere Paulo Silas etudo Beréia ba kurirewu ka. Etaregodure toro dukeje eture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka.

b: Nou Beréia kejewuge ekare nono nowu Tessalônica kejewuge emogadure. Beréia kejewuge etaidure tuioruduwawo rugadu. Ewiapaga pemegare Paulo bataru ji tiegarere puduidu tabo. Meri jamedu boe ji etaiwore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tuioruduwo Paulo bataru ji nono boe jokodumode dubagai.
source: Nou Beréia kejewuge ekare nono nowu Tessalônica kejewuge emogadure. Beréia kejewuge etaidure tuioruduwawo rugadu. Ewiapaga pemegare Paulo bataru ji tiegarere puduidu tabo. Meri jamedu boe ji etaiwore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tuioruduwo Paulo bataru ji nono boe jokodumode dubagai.

b: Iage emearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Emagare. Oe kurirewu areme emearutorure jamedu. Emagare. Grego doge ime emearutorure jamedu. Emagare jamedu.
source: Iage emearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Emagare. Oe kurirewu areme emearutorure jamedu. Emagare. Grego doge ime emearutorure jamedu. Emagare jamedu.

b: Mare toro nowu Tessalônica ba kurirewu keje Judeu doge emearudure Paulo rakojeie Beréia keje duji. Emearudure Paulo uie boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nono duji. Dukodire nowu Judeu doge etaregodure bagai turo pegawo Pauloji pugeje. Ere nowu Beréia kejewu boe ekorigo Pauloji. Ere boe emagado pugeje turo pegawo Pauloji pugeje.
source: Mare toro nowu Tessalônica ba kurirewu keje Judeu doge emearudure Paulo rakojeie Beréia keje duji. Emearudure Paulo uie boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nono duji. Dukodire nowu Judeu doge etaregodure bagai turo pegawo Pauloji pugeje. Ere nowu Beréia kejewu boe ekorigo Pauloji. Ere boe emagado pugeje turo pegawo Pauloji pugeje.

b: Ca je nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere Paulo utudo nowu ro pegarewuge epiji. Mare Silas, Timóteo eragoje kimore Beréia keje.
source: Ca je nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere Paulo utudo nowu ro pegarewuge epiji. Mare Silas, Timóteo eragoje kimore Beréia keje.

b: Nou eture Paulo apowu ime eture apo Atenas ba kurirewu ka dukeje ere tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka. Paulo ure tuwadaru maku etai ewo Silas Timóteo ewie etuwo kuri aino mato tuwagai.
source: Nou eture Paulo apowu ime eture apo Atenas ba kurirewu ka dukeje ere tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka. Paulo ure tuwadaru maku etai ewo Silas Timóteo ewie etuwo kuri aino mato tuwagai.

b: Eragojere Atenas Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Eragojere Atenas Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: Nou Atenas ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutoru rakare tuwai tadawu santo dogei rugadu. Paulo upagare Silas bagai, Timóteo bagai dukeje jorudure nowu santo doge eiamedu boe ji. Emagare rugadu. Dukodire Paulo kiarigodure.
source: Nou Atenas ba kurirewu kejewuge emearutoru rakare tuwai tadawu santo dogei rugadu. Paulo upagare Silas bagai, Timóteo bagai dukeje jorudure nowu santo doge eiamedu boe ji. Emagare rugadu. Dukodire Paulo kiarigodure.

b: Dukodire makore Judeu dogei nowu ere bato puiwu bai ja tada tuwo emearutorudo tu Jesus ji. Makore nowu boe tuginaiwugei jamedu. Nou boe tuginaiwuge eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji tumago pemegawo ji. Mare Paulo makore ei tuwo emearutorudo Jesus ji. Dukeje makore nowu ba kurirewu oiadada jamedu boe eiamedu boe ji tuwo emearutorudo tu Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Dukodire makore Judeu dogei nowu ere bato puiwu bai ja tada tuwo emearutorudo tu Jesus ji. Makore nowu boe tuginaiwugei jamedu. Nou boe tuginaiwuge eku kidugodure Pao Kurirewu ji tumago pemegawo ji. Mare Paulo makore ei tuwo emearutorudo Jesus ji. Dukeje makore nowu ba kurirewu oiadada jamedu boe eiamedu boe ji tuwo emearutorudo tu Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Ia joruduwarewuge emago raire Pauloji jamedu. Epicurewunure iage. Estóiconure iage. Iage egore awu Paulo joruduwa bokwa. Ocarore tumago tabo tuwadaru ji. Iage egore Makonure cewiagai ia boe tuginaiwuge eno Santo dogei. Paulo makore nowu boe ewiagai Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji dukodire egoino. Akore Jesus jewoduie pugeje. Mare emearutorukare dukodire egoino Paulo makore jiboe ji.
source: Ia joruduwarewuge emago raire Pauloji jamedu. Epicurewunure iage. Estóiconure iage. Iage egore awu Paulo joruduwa bokwa. Ocarore tumago tabo tuwadaru ji. Iage egore Makonure cewiagai ia boe tuginaiwuge eno Santo dogei. Paulo makore nowu boe ewiagai Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji dukodire egoino. Akore Jesus jewoduie pugeje. Mare emearutorukare dukodire egoino Paulo makore jiboe ji.

b: Dukodire ere Paulo reko toro nowu ba kurirewu kejewu boe eimijerage etae. Edure kejewu bai iere Areópago. Nou boe eimijerage egore cedaidure ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiwu awadaru maiwuji.
source: Dukodire ere Paulo reko toro nowu ba kurirewu kejewu boe eimijerage etae. Edure kejewu bai iere Areópago. Nou boe eimijerage egore cedaidure ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiwu awadaru maiwuji.

b: Marigudu cemearudukare nowu inodu awadaru ji. Cedaidure awo ceruduwado nuba awadarure.
source: Marigudu cemearudukare nowu inodu awadaru ji. Cedaidure awo ceruduwado nuba awadarure.

b: (Nou Atenas kejewuge, nouia rakojere nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge emago raire pui bakaru maiwu jamedu boe ji.)
source: (Nou Atenas kejewuge, nouia rakojere nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge emago raire pui bakaru maiwu jamedu boe ji.)

b: Nono Paulo ure turagojedo nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge boe eimijerage egai. Akore tagire Atenas kejewuge mearutorurewugenure tagi taro jamedu boe tabo.
source: Nono Paulo ure turagojedo nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge boe eimijerage egai. Akore tagire Atenas kejewuge mearutorurewugenure tagi taro jamedu boe tabo.

b: Ikodure tago ba kurirewu ji dukeje iorudure tamearutorure jiwu santo doge ewairogu jamedu boe ji bawadu keje. Nono iorudure ia bairoguji pugeje. Nou bairogu keje ia bataru padure. Akore, “Paruduwakare Jiwu Pao Kurirewu Uwai Rogu Reo.” Ca tare tabu jodo tamago pemegawo taruduwakare jiboe ji. Mare imire imode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu ji.
