b: Pao Kurirewu uwo turo pemegarewu maku tagai. Uwo tabemegado pudui jamedu. Pagimijera Jesus Cristo uwo turo pemegarewu maku tagai. Uwo tabemegado pudui jamedu.
source: Pao Kurirewu uwo turo pemegarewu maku tagai. Uwo tabemegado pudui jamedu. Pagimijera Jesus Cristo uwo turo pemegarewu maku tagai. Uwo tabemegado pudui jamedu.

b: Jesus Cristo Ro Pemegarewu Reo
source: Jesus Cristo Ro Pemegarewu Reo

b: Ikimadure Pao Kurirewu apo tu tu je ro pemegare tai kodi. Tamearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare tai.
source: Ikimadure Pao Kurirewu apo tu tu je ro pemegare tai kodi. Tamearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare tai.

b: Dukodire tamugu pemegare Jesus Cristo apo dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tagoe kurido. Mare boe enoe ji karega inagoino. Ure taruduwado tamagowo Jesus bataru pemegarewuji. Dujire inagoino. Ure taruduwa kurido. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire taruduware bope doge ewadrarodaeji, taruduware boe remawu ji jamedu. Nono taruduware tamearutoruwo boe remawu ji tu rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Du taruduware tarowo ji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Dukodire tamugu pemegare Jesus Cristo apo dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tagoe kurido. Mare boe enoe ji karega inagoino. Ure taruduwado tamagowo Jesus bataru pemegarewuji. Dujire inagoino. Ure taruduwa kurido. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire taruduware bope doge ewadrarodaeji, taruduware boe remawu ji jamedu. Nono taruduware tamearutoruwo boe remawu ji tu rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Du taruduware tarowo ji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Cere tawie Jesus Cristo o bakaru pemegarewuji. Tamearutorure ji rugadu. Ji aino tagare tagera ra nowu bataru piji rugadu.
source: Cere tawie Jesus Cristo o bakaru pemegarewuji. Tamearutorure ji rugadu. Ji aino tagare tagera ra nowu bataru piji rugadu.

b: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tumaragodae maku tagai tamaragodaece. Ure tawie tuwadaru jamedu boe ji dukodire ure tado tarugadu tamaragodu pemegawo nowu ture maku tagaiwu tamaragodaeji jii toro rugadu. Taruduware Pagimijera Jesus Cristo aregodumode pugeje duji. Dukodire tabagare bagai rugadu. Jesus Cristo aregodumode pugeje dukeje boe erudumode ji rugadu.
source: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tumaragodae maku tagai tamaragodaece. Ure tawie tuwadaru jamedu boe ji dukodire ure tado tarugadu tamaragodu pemegawo nowu ture maku tagaiwu tamaragodaeji jii toro rugadu. Taruduware Pagimijera Jesus Cristo aregodumode pugeje duji. Dukodire tabagare bagai rugadu. Jesus Cristo aregodumode pugeje dukeje boe erudumode ji rugadu.

b: Jesus emare umode tamearutoru rakado pudui jii toro taregodumode du ka. Tamearutorumode Pagimijera Jesus ji rugadu jii toro rugadu. Dukodire Jesus mako pegamodukare tarore jiboe ji. Pagimijera Jesus aregodumode dukeje mako pegamodukare tarore jiboe ji.
source: Jesus emare umode tamearutoru rakado pudui jii toro taregodumode du ka. Tamearutorumode Pagimijera Jesus ji rugadu jii toro rugadu. Dukodire Jesus mako pegamodukare tarore jiboe ji. Pagimijera Jesus aregodumode dukeje mako pegamodukare tarore jiboe ji.

b: Boe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Emare makore tawagai tamugu pemegawo tonaregedu Jesus Cristo apo. Pagimijera Kurirewunure ema. Pao Kurirewu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Boe emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Emare makore tawagai tamugu pemegawo tonaregedu Jesus Cristo apo. Pagimijera Kurirewunure ema. Pao Kurirewu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Nou Corinto Kejewuge Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Emearudaekare Nono Pure
source: Nou Corinto Kejewuge Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Emearudaekare Nono Pure

b: Imedagenure tagi. Inogituwawo tai Pagimijera Jesus bataru tabo taromode jiboe ji. Ca tamago pemegado pui tawo tamearudae tawuje. Tamearudae udo nono pu jamedu boe mearudaere. Tamaragodu pemegawo puapo. Nono taragamode tamagore jiboe ji.
source: Imedagenure tagi. Inogituwawo tai Pagimijera Jesus bataru tabo taromode jiboe ji. Ca tamago pemegado pui tawo tamearudae tawuje. Tamearudae udo nono pu jamedu boe mearudaere. Tamaragodu pemegawo puapo. Nono taragamode tamagore jiboe ji.

b: Mare kocare tagare tamearudae tawuje. Tagokire pui. Imedu Cloé uwobe ere iwie nowu tarore jiboe ji. Ekare taro biado ipiji.
source: Mare kocare tagare tamearudae tawuje. Tagokire pui. Imedu Cloé uwobe ere iwie nowu tarore jiboe ji. Ekare taro biado ipiji.

b: Imagowo tarore jiboe ji. Taiamedu boe tamearudaere ia tamearudae ji. Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Paulo bataru ji tu rugadu. Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Apolo bataru ji tu rugadu. Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Pedro bataru ji tu rugadu. Mare ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Cristo bataru ji tu rugadu jamedu.
source: Imagowo tarore jiboe ji. Taiamedu boe tamearudaere ia tamearudae ji. Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Paulo bataru ji tu rugadu. Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Apolo bataru ji tu rugadu. Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Pedro bataru ji tu rugadu. Mare ia tagi tagagore tamearutoruie Cristo bataru ji tu rugadu jamedu.

b: Dutabore tare mearutorure Jesus Cristo jiwuge emearudae pegado emearudaekawo nono pumearudaere pugeje. Paulonure imi. Imi karega iwire taro pegarewu morice! Jesus emare bire taro pegarewu morice. Tagao pegododure mare itugaregewo tagi karega! Jesus emare makore tagao pegododuwo tudugaregewo tagi rugadu. I karega tamearutorumode. Tamearutorumode tu Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Dutabore tare mearutorure Jesus Cristo jiwuge emearudae pegado emearudaekawo nono pumearudaere pugeje. Paulonure imi. Imi karega iwire taro pegarewu morice! Jesus emare bire taro pegarewu morice. Tagao pegododure mare itugaregewo tagi karega! Jesus emare makore tagao pegododuwo tudugaregewo tagi rugadu. I karega tamearutorumode. Tamearutorumode tu Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Imi igoia karega ire tagao pegodo. Iagarere i ia imedu koiare ure tagao pegodo duji dukodire ikimadure Pao Kurirewu apo. Ire ao pegodouge ere pobetu je. Ia iere Crispo. Metia iere Gaio.
source: Imi igoia karega ire tagao pegodo. Iagarere i ia imedu koiare ure tagao pegodo duji dukodire ikimadure Pao Kurirewu apo. Ire ao pegodouge ere pobetu je. Ia iere Crispo. Metia iere Gaio.

b: Tagao pegododure. Mare ikie tabo karega tagao pegododure. Jesus ie tabore tagao pegododure.
source: Tagao pegododure. Mare ikie tabo karega tagao pegododure. Jesus ie tabore tagao pegododure.

b: (Mare ire imedu Estéfanas uwobe eiamedu boe etao pegodo. Mare imearudaekare iagei pugeje, ikare iage etao pegodo pugeje.)
source: (Mare ire imedu Estéfanas uwobe eiamedu boe etao pegodo. Mare imearudaekare iagei pugeje, ikare iage etao pegodo pugeje.)

b: Jesus Cristo ure itarego tawagai iwo tawie tuwadaru pemegarewu boe ji Jesus uwo taginorudo. Itaregodukare iwo tagao pegodo. Itaregodure iwo tawie mare imagokare nono joruduwarewuge emago mogadure. Imagomode nono joruduwarewuge emago mogadure dukeje tarudu motumode imagore jiboe ji mare tawiapagamodukare imagore jiboe ji. Nono taragamodukare tawo taro pemegado. Mare imagokare nono joruduwarewuge emago mogadure. Tu Jesus Cristo bataru jire imagore tawiagai tamearutoruwo tu Jesus ji uwo taginorudo. Emare bitodure ipo padure pugajejewu keje boe ero pegarewu morice. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu bataru ji dukeje Jesus umode boe ekinorudo, umode boe eragado ero pemegawo rugadu.
source: Jesus Cristo ure itarego tawagai iwo tawie tuwadaru pemegarewu boe ji Jesus uwo taginorudo. Itaregodukare iwo tagao pegodo. Itaregodure iwo tawie mare imagokare nono joruduwarewuge emago mogadure. Imagomode nono joruduwarewuge emago mogadure dukeje tarudu motumode imagore jiboe ji mare tawiapagamodukare imagore jiboe ji. Nono taragamodukare tawo taro pemegado. Mare imagokare nono joruduwarewuge emago mogadure. Tu Jesus Cristo bataru jire imagore tawiagai tamearutoruwo tu Jesus ji uwo taginorudo. Emare bitodure ipo padure pugajejewu keje boe ero pegarewu morice. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu bataru ji dukeje Jesus umode boe ekinorudo, umode boe eragado ero pemegawo rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Joruduwa Kurire Rugadu
source: Pao Kurirewu Joruduwa Kurire Rugadu

b: Jesus Cristo bire ipo padure pugajejewu keje boe ero pegarewu morice. Mare mearutorukare jiwuge egore pagaie Jesus roino. Dukodire ewarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Mare pamearutorure ji dukodire nowu bataru koiare ure paruduwado Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewuji. Emare rakare tuwo paginorudo rugadu.
source: Jesus Cristo bire ipo padure pugajejewu keje boe ero pegarewu morice. Mare mearutorukare jiwuge egore pagaie Jesus roino. Dukodire ewarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Mare pamearutorure ji dukodire nowu bataru koiare ure paruduwado Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewuji. Emare rakare tuwo paginorudo rugadu.

b: Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Imode joruduwarewuge eruduware jiboe akedudo. – Imode aiwore bapera jiwuge eruduware jiboe okwado epiji. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore.
source: Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Imode joruduwarewuge eruduware jiboe akedudo. – Imode aiwore bapera jiwuge eruduware jiboe okwado epiji. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore.

b: Moto kejewuge eruduware boe ji. Mare eruduwakare nono Pao Kurirewu joruduwa mogadure. Dukodire eruduwa bokware rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai. Joruduwarewuge eruduwa bokware Pao Kurirewu jakai. Aiwo raire bapera jiwuge eruduwa bokware Pao Kurirewu jakai. Mako raire puiwuge eruduwa bokware jamedu Pao Kurirewu jakai.
source: Moto kejewuge eruduware boe ji. Mare eruduwakare nono Pao Kurirewu joruduwa mogadure. Dukodire eruduwa bokware rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai. Joruduwarewuge eruduwa bokware Pao Kurirewu jakai. Aiwo raire bapera jiwuge eruduwa bokware Pao Kurirewu jakai. Mako raire puiwuge eruduwa bokware jamedu Pao Kurirewu jakai.

b: Pao Kurirewu joruduware rugadu. Boe etaidure tuioruduwawo Pao Kurirewu ji tuioruduware jiboe tabo, tumearudae tabo. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure boe eiamedu boe eroiwa bokwado dukodire eruduwamodukare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu tuioruduware jiboe tabo. Mare cere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji rugadu. Mare mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge egore pagaie cenagoino. Mare boe emearutorumode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje eruduwamode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Mare tuioruduware jiboe tabo karega. Pao Kurirewu umode nowu boe ekinorudo.
source: Pao Kurirewu joruduware rugadu. Boe etaidure tuioruduwawo Pao Kurirewu ji tuioruduware jiboe tabo, tumearudae tabo. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure boe eiamedu boe eroiwa bokwado dukodire eruduwamodukare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu tuioruduware jiboe tabo. Mare cere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji rugadu. Mare mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge egore pagaie cenagoino. Mare boe emearutorumode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje eruduwamode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Mare tuioruduware jiboe tabo karega. Pao Kurirewu umode nowu boe ekinorudo.

b: Judeu doge etaiwore ia Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu bagai dukodire emearutorukare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Grego doge etaiwore boe eruduware jiboe bagai tuwo tuioruduwa kurido dukodire emearutorukare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji.
source: Judeu doge etaiwore ia Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu bagai dukodire emearutorukare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji. Grego doge etaiwore boe eruduware jiboe bagai tuwo tuioruduwa kurido dukodire emearutorukare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji.

b: Mare cegi cere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji, Jesus Cristo bitodure ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dujire cenagoino. Mare Judeu doge ekorigodure awu cewadaru keje dukodire emearutorukare ji. Mare eiamedu boe karega ekorigodure. Pao Kurirewu makore bagaiwuge Judeu doge emearutorure cewadaru ji. Etaidure ji. Boe tuginaiwuge egore pagaie cenagoino jamedu dukodire emearutorukare ji. Mare eiamedu boe karega. Pao Kurirewu makore bagaiwuge boe tuginaiwuge emearutorure cewadaru ji. Etaidure ji jamedu. Nou mearutorure cewadaru jiwuge emearutorure Jesus Cristoji rugadu. Dukodire eruduware Pao Kurirewu ro rakare rugadu tuwo ekinorudo. Eruduware Pao Kurirewu joruduwa kurire rugadu tuwo ekinorudo duji. Jesus koiare ure nowu mearutorure puduiwuge eruduwado nowu inodu boe ji.
source: Mare cegi cere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewuji, Jesus Cristo bitodure ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dujire cenagoino. Mare Judeu doge ekorigodure awu cewadaru keje dukodire emearutorukare ji. Mare eiamedu boe karega ekorigodure. Pao Kurirewu makore bagaiwuge Judeu doge emearutorure cewadaru ji. Etaidure ji. Boe tuginaiwuge egore pagaie cenagoino jamedu dukodire emearutorukare ji. Mare eiamedu boe karega. Pao Kurirewu makore bagaiwuge boe tuginaiwuge emearutorure cewadaru ji. Etaidure ji jamedu. Nou mearutorure cewadaru jiwuge emearutorure Jesus Cristoji rugadu. Dukodire eruduware Pao Kurirewu ro rakare rugadu tuwo ekinorudo. Eruduware Pao Kurirewu joruduwa kurire rugadu tuwo ekinorudo duji. Jesus koiare ure nowu mearutorure puduiwuge eruduwado nowu inodu boe ji.

b: Boe emearudae pegamode ia Pao Kurirewu bataru roguji. Egomode pagaie Pao Kurirewu akoino. Egomode nowu Pao Kurirewu batarurogu nuie pagatu je, boe emearutorukaiago nowu bataru roguji. Mare iwo taruduwado. Nou Pao Kurirewu batarurogu koiare umode boe eruduwa pemegado rugadu joruduwarewuge eiamedu boe ero boe piji. Ia boe emearudae pegamode Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji. Egomode Pao Kurirewu raka akeduie. Mare pagare egoino. Eruduwakare kaba jiba Pao Kurirewu roino. Pao Kurirewu rakare rugadu. Rakare boe eiamedu boe eraga kori.
source: Boe emearudae pegamode ia Pao Kurirewu bataru roguji. Egomode pagaie Pao Kurirewu akoino. Egomode nowu Pao Kurirewu batarurogu nuie pagatu je, boe emearutorukaiago nowu bataru roguji. Mare iwo taruduwado. Nou Pao Kurirewu batarurogu koiare umode boe eruduwa pemegado rugadu joruduwarewuge eiamedu boe ero boe piji. Ia boe emearudae pegamode Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji. Egomode Pao Kurirewu raka akeduie. Mare pagare egoino. Eruduwakare kaba jiba Pao Kurirewu roino. Pao Kurirewu rakare rugadu. Rakare boe eiamedu boe eraga kori.

b: Imedagenure tagi. Tawiabutudo nowu mariguduwu taro keje. Marigudu boe egore taruduwa bokwaie rugadu. Egore taragakaie. Egore boe kurirewuge kaiegure tagi. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore tawagai.
source: Imedagenure tagi. Tawiabutudo nowu mariguduwu taro keje. Marigudu boe egore taruduwa bokwaie rugadu. Egore taragakaie. Egore boe kurirewuge kaiegure tagi. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore tawagai.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure tumearudae tawuje tumagowo boe etaidukare jiwuge ewagai tuwo joruduwarewuge epogurudo. Egore tuioruduwaie. Egore nowu tumedage eruduwa bokwaie. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge ewagai rugadu tuwo nowu joruduwarewuge epogurudo dubagai. Makore nowu rakakarewuge ewagai tuwo nowu rakarewuge epogurudo. Nou rakarewuge egore pudumie turagaie. Egore nowu tumedage eraga bokwaie. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu rakakarewuge ewagai tuwo nowu rakarewuge epogurudo dubagai.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure tumearudae tawuje tumagowo boe etaidukare jiwuge ewagai tuwo joruduwarewuge epogurudo. Egore tuioruduwaie. Egore nowu tumedage eruduwa bokwaie. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu joruduwa bokwarewuge ewagai rugadu tuwo nowu joruduwarewuge epogurudo dubagai. Makore nowu rakakarewuge ewagai tuwo nowu rakarewuge epogurudo. Nou rakarewuge egore pudumie turagaie. Egore nowu tumedage eraga bokwaie. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu rakakarewuge ewagai tuwo nowu rakarewuge epogurudo dubagai.

b: Boe emearudae pegare boe ji rugadu. Egore ero pegaie. Egore pagaie eromode turore jiboe ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu boe etaidukare jiwuge ewagai tuwo nowu boe emearudae pegarewu akedudo.
source: Boe emearudae pegare boe ji rugadu. Egore ero pegaie. Egore pagaie eromode turore jiboe ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore nowu boe etaidukare jiwuge ewagai tuwo nowu boe emearudae pegarewu akedudo.

b: Dukodire boe enojarokawo turore jiboe ji pugeje Pao Kurirewu jakai. Boe enojarokawo tuwadaru ji pugeje Pao Kurirewu biagai.
source: Dukodire boe enojarokawo turore jiboe ji pugeje Pao Kurirewu jakai. Boe enojarokawo tuwadaru ji pugeje Pao Kurirewu biagai.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure pamugu pemegado Jesus Cristo apo. Pamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu pai pudae. Nono umode paruduwado tuioruduware jiboe ji. Emare ure paro jetorodo. Ure paro udo tuginai mearutorukare jiwuge ero boe piji. Ure paginorudo paro pegarewu piji pagawo paro pegarewu morido pugeje.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure pamugu pemegado Jesus Cristo apo. Pamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu pai pudae. Nono umode paruduwado tuioruduware jiboe ji. Emare ure paro jetorodo. Ure paro udo tuginai mearutorukare jiwuge ero boe piji. Ure paginorudo paro pegarewu piji pagawo paro pegarewu morido pugeje.

b: Dukodire padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ure turugadu. Akore boe enojarowo tu Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji tu rugadu.
source: Dukodire padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ure turugadu. Akore boe enojarowo tu Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji tu rugadu.

b: Jesus Cristo Bitodure Kodiwu Bakaru Reo
source: Jesus Cristo Bitodure Kodiwu Bakaru Reo

b: Imedagenure tagi. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure ia tumearudae biado boe epiji. Mare itaregodure tagae dukeje ire taruduwado nowu Pao Kurirewu ure biadowu tumearudae ji. Imedagenure tagi. Imagokare tai iwadaru kurirewu tabo. Imagokare tai joruduwarewuge ewadaru tabo.
source: Imedagenure tagi. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure ia tumearudae biado boe epiji. Mare itaregodure tagae dukeje ire taruduwado nowu Pao Kurirewu ure biadowu tumearudae ji. Imedagenure tagi. Imagokare tai iwadaru kurirewu tabo. Imagokare tai joruduwarewuge ewadaru tabo.

b: Iragojere tagabo dukeje imearudaekare ia imearudae ji. Imearudaere tu iwo tawie Jesus Cristo jiwu bakaruji. Ire tawie Jesus bitodure ipo padure pugajejewu keje duji rugadu.
source: Iragojere tagabo dukeje imearudaekare ia imearudae ji. Imearudaere tu iwo tawie Jesus Cristo jiwu bakaruji. Ire tawie Jesus bitodure ipo padure pugajejewu keje duji rugadu.

b: Iragojere tagabo dukeje iragakare pugeje. Ioku kidugodunure Pao Kurirewu ji iwo ure maku inaiwu imaragodae pemegado imagowo boe remawu ji tawiagai. Mare imororamagadure taruduwamodukare iwadaru jituji. Dukodire ire iragado imagowo boe remawu ji tawiagai.
source: Iragojere tagabo dukeje iragakare pugeje. Ioku kidugodunure Pao Kurirewu ji iwo ure maku inaiwu imaragodae pemegado imagowo boe remawu ji tawiagai. Mare imororamagadure taruduwamodukare iwadaru jituji. Dukodire ire iragado imagowo boe remawu ji tawiagai.

b: Mare itaidukare iwo tamearutorudo iwadaru moturewuji. Itaidure tamearutoruwo tu Jesus ji rugadu. Dukodire ikare imago motudo tawiagai. Ire taruduwado mare imagokare tai iwadaru moturewu tabo. Ire taruduwado mare imagokare tai joruduwarewuge ewadaru tabo. Mare ire taruduwado Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakare duji. Ema koiare ure tamearutorudo ire tawie jiwu Jesus jiboe ji. Dukodire tamearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Boe ewadaru moturewu ukare tamearutorudo. Pao Kurirewu rakare rugadu dukodire tamearutorure Jesus ji.
source: Mare itaidukare iwo tamearutorudo iwadaru moturewuji. Itaidure tamearutoruwo tu Jesus ji rugadu. Dukodire ikare imago motudo tawiagai. Ire taruduwado mare imagokare tai iwadaru moturewu tabo. Ire taruduwado mare imagokare tai joruduwarewuge ewadaru tabo. Mare ire taruduwado Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakare duji. Ema koiare ure tamearutorudo ire tawie jiwu Jesus jiboe ji. Dukodire tamearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Boe ewadaru moturewu ukare tamearutorudo. Pao Kurirewu rakare rugadu dukodire tamearutorure Jesus ji.

b: Pao Kurirewu Joruduware Jiboe Reo
source: Pao Kurirewu Joruduware Jiboe Reo

b: Imode mearutoru rakare Jesus jiwuge eruduwado rugadu. Mare boe eruduware jiboe karega. Boe eimijerage eruduware jiboe karega. Bope doge eruduware jiboe karega. Nou boe eimijerage eraga akedugodunure. Nou bope doge eraga akedugodunure jamedu.
source: Imode mearutoru rakare Jesus jiwuge eruduwado rugadu. Mare boe eruduware jiboe karega. Boe eimijerage eruduware jiboe karega. Bope doge eruduware jiboe karega. Nou boe eimijerage eraga akedugodunure. Nou bope doge eraga akedugodunure jamedu.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu mearudaere jiboe jire imode boe eruduwado. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu mariguduwu tumearudae biado boe epiji. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ukare moto to raga dukeje ure tumearudae tawuje tuwo boe pemegado mearutorure puduiwuge ji. Mare ukare boe ewie. Ure nowu tumearudae biado boe epiji jii je rugadu. Mare ukare moto to raga dukeje joruduware tumode paruduwado nowu tumearudae ji duji. Dukodire care ure paruduwado nuba turomode mearutorure puduiwugei rugadu. Dukodire care paruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji kodire joruduwarewugenure pagi.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu mearudaere jiboe jire imode boe eruduwado. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu mariguduwu tumearudae biado boe epiji. Tamearudaemode tawo tageragu nowu mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge emearudae ji tawo taruduwado dukeje pagare taroino Pao Kurirewu jakai. Tarokaba aino. Nou mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge eruduware jiboe barigu tabiji tawo taruduwado tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware jiboe ji. Nono mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge egomode taruduwa bokwaie. Mare tawia pagakaba egoino tai duji.

b: Mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge egore tuioruduwaie rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu akore pagaie nowu boe egoino. Eruduwa bokware Pao Kurirewu jakai. Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emearudaere tuioruduwaie rugadu duji. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure ewadaru rugadu pogurudo.
source: Mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge egore tuioruduwaie rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu akore pagaie nowu boe egoino. Eruduwa bokware Pao Kurirewu jakai. Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emearudaere tuioruduwaie rugadu duji. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure ewadaru rugadu pogurudo.

b: Ia padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore jamedu: – Joruduwarewuge ere tumearudae tawuje mare Pagimijera Kurirewu joruduware pagatu jere eroino duji.
source: Ia padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore jamedu: – Joruduwarewuge ere tumearudae tawuje mare Pagimijera Kurirewu joruduware pagatu jere eroino duji.

b: Dukodire tagojarokaba boe erore jiboe ji. Tamagokaba joruduwarewuge enuie tagi. Ca Pao Kurirewu utugarenure Jesusce. Dukodire care tamearutorure Jesus ji. Nou inodu kodire Jesus Cristo utugaregenure tagi jamedu. Dukodire emare ure boe jamedu boe maku tagai. Ure iwadaru maku tagai. Ure Apolo makore jiboe maku tagai. Ure Pedro makore jiboe maku tagai. Ure awu moto kejewuge eruduware jiboe maku tagai. Umode tamugu pemegado. Emare joruduware tawimode kejewu meri ji. Emare joruduware nuba boere tai. Joruduware nuba boemode tai rugadu tuwo boe pemegado tagai rugadu jii toro rugadu.
source: Dukodire tagojarokaba boe erore jiboe ji. Tamagokaba joruduwarewuge enuie tagi. Ca Pao Kurirewu utugarenure Jesusce. Dukodire care tamearutorure Jesus ji. Ure awu moto kejewuge eruduware jiboe maku tagai. Umode tamugu pemegado. Emare joruduware tawimode kejewu meri ji. Emare joruduware nuba boere tai. Joruduware nuba boemode tai rugadu tuwo boe pemegado tagai rugadu jii toro rugadu.

b: Uture Jesus Cristo Bataru Tabowuge Ero Reo
source: Uture Jesus Cristo Bataru Tabowuge Ero Reo

b: Iwo tawie. Jesus Cristo utugaregenure cegi. Jesus Cristo mearutorure cei dukodire ure Pao Kurirewu bataru biadowu maku cenai cetu pemegawo ji. Marigudu boe eruduwakare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Aino care cenure boe ewie nowu boe eruduwakare jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire cenagoino. Dukodire care tamearutorudo cei tawo taro udo turugadu cei.
source: Iwo tawie. Jesus Cristo utugaregenure cegi. Jesus Cristo mearutorure cei dukodire ure Pao Kurirewu bataru biadowu maku cenai cetu pemegawo ji. Marigudu boe eruduwakare nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Aino care cenure boe ewie nowu boe eruduwakare jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire cenagoino. Dukodire care tamearutorudo cei tawo taro udo turugadu cei.

b: Boe eimijerage emearutorumode tudugaregei dukeje nowu etugarege erowo tu nowu tugimijerage etaidure jiboe ji rugadu. Ainore cerore jamedu nono nowu boe etugarege ero mogadure.
source: Boe eimijerage emearutorumode tudugaregei dukeje nowu etugarege erowo tu nowu tugimijerage etaidure jiboe ji rugadu. Ainore cerore jamedu nono nowu boe etugarege ero mogadure.

b: Tagaiwomode ceroji ia cero pegarewu bagai mare imororamagadukare. Itaora butugugodure. Boe etaiwomode ceroji rugadu. Mare Pagimijera Jesus emare mako pegamode ia cero pegarewuji. Imi karega. Imago pegamodukare ia ceroji. Itaiwore ia cero pegarewu bagai mare iorudukare ji. Mare ia cero pegarewu mode dukeje Pagimijera Jesus jorudumode ji rugadu. Emare mako pegamode cero pegarewu ji cewiagai. Dujire cewiapagamode cemearutorumode.
source: Tagaiwomode ceroji ia cero pegarewu bagai mare imororamagadukare. Itaora butugugodure. Boe etaiwomode ceroji rugadu. Mare Pagimijera Jesus emare mako pegamode ia cero pegarewuji. Imi karega. Imago pegamodukare ia ceroji. Itaiwore ia cero pegarewu bagai mare iorudukare ji. Mare ia cero pegarewu mode dukeje Pagimijera Jesus jorudumode ji rugadu. Emare mako pegamode cero pegarewu ji cewiagai. Dujire cewiapagamode cemearutorumode.

b: Dukodire akekaba tai tamago pegawo boe ero pegarewuji. Du tabagado Jesus bagai. Jesus aregodumode pugeje dukeje emare aiwomode boe erore jiboe ji rugadu ero pegarewu bagai. Boe emode turore jiboe biado mare Jesus joruduware ji marigudu. Umode boe eruduwado erore jiboe ji rugadu. Boe emode tumearudae biado mare Jesus joruduware ji marigudu. Umode boe eruduwado emearudae ji rugadu. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu mako pemegamode boe ero pemegarewuji, emearudae pemegarewuji. Mako pegamode ero pegarewu ji emearudae pegarewu ji jamedu.
source: Dukodire akekaba tai tamago pegawo boe ero pegarewuji. Du tabagado Jesus bagai. Jesus aregodumode pugeje dukeje emare aiwomode boe erore jiboe ji rugadu ero pegarewu bagai. Boe emode turore jiboe biado mare Jesus joruduware ji marigudu. Umode boe eruduwado erore jiboe ji rugadu. Boe emode tumearudae biado mare Jesus joruduware ji marigudu. Umode boe eruduwado emearudae ji rugadu. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu mako pemegamode boe ero pemegarewuji, emearudae pemegarewuji. Mako pegamode ero pegarewu ji emearudae pegarewu ji jamedu.

b: Imedagenure tagi. Ia tagi tagagore mearutorure Apolo jiwuge enuie tagi. Tagagoino aino dutabo tamago pegare imagore jiboe ji. Ia tagi tagagore mearutorure Paulo jiwuge enuie tagi. Tagagoino aino dutabo tamago pegare Apolo makore jiboe ji. Dukodire inagoino tai tamago pegakawo boe erore jiboe ji. Ainore boe egore amearudae kaba ia amearudae ji boe ji Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji. Dukodire tarudu kurikaba ia boe ji tarudu pegawo ia boe ji jamedu. Mare tarudu kurido eiamedu boe ji puapo.
source: Imedagenure tagi. Ia tagi tagagore mearutorure Apolo jiwuge enuie tagi. Tagagoino aino dutabo tamago pegare imagore jiboe ji. Ia tagi tagagore mearutorure Paulo jiwuge enuie tagi. Tagagoino aino dutabo tamago pegare Apolo makore jiboe ji. Dukodire inagoino tai tamago pegakawo boe erore jiboe ji. Ainore boe egore amearudae kaba ia amearudae ji boe ji Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji. Dukodire tarudu kurikaba ia boe ji tarudu pegawo ia boe ji jamedu. Mare tarudu kurido eiamedu boe ji puapo.

b: Kocare tagagore taruduwaie rugadu. Kocare tagagore tagoe kurie rugadu. Mare taigoia karega tare tagoedo. Taigoia karega tare taruduwado. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure tagoe rugadu maku tagai. Ure taruduware jiboe rugadu maku tagai. Dukodire care tagojarokaba tagoeji. Tagojarokaba taruduware jiboe ji.
source: Kocare tagagore taruduwaie rugadu. Kocare tagagore tagoe kurie rugadu. Mare taigoia karega tare tagoedo. Taigoia karega tare taruduwado. Pao Kurirewu koiare ure tagoe rugadu maku tagai. Ure taruduware jiboe rugadu maku tagai. Dukodire care tagojarokaba tagoeji. Tagojarokaba taruduware jiboe ji.

b: Kocare tagagore tagoeie, tagoe kurie. Kocare tagagore joruduwarewuge enuie tagi kodie boe eimijerage enuie tagi. Mare tagagore boe eimijerage kaiegure cegi. Boe eimijerage emode tagi rugadu dukeje boe eimijerage emode cegi jamedu. Mare Pao Kurirewu utugaregenure cegi. Dukodire boe eimijerage karegure tagi jamedu.
source: Kocare tagagore tagoeie, tagoe kurie. Kocare tagagore joruduwarewuge enuie tagi kodie boe eimijerage enuie tagi. Mare tagagore boe eimijerage kaiegure cegi. Boe eimijerage emode tagi rugadu dukeje boe eimijerage emode cegi jamedu. Mare Pao Kurirewu utugaregenure cegi. Dukodire boe eimijerage karegure tagi jamedu.

b: Iwo tawie rugadu. Uture Jesus bataru tabowugenure cegi rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure boe etugaregedo cegi. Ure cedo nono ia bitodumodewu boe emogadure boe egai. Boe etaiwore boe pegare cei duji. Baru tadawuge etaiwore boe pegare cei duji. Ainore imearudaere.
source: Iwo tawie rugadu. Uture Jesus bataru tabowugenure cegi rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure boe etugaregedo cegi. Ure cedo nono ia bitodumodewu boe emogadure boe egai. Boe etaiwore boe pegare cei duji. Baru tadawuge etaiwore boe pegare cei duji. Ainore imearudaere.

b: Cemearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire boe egore joruduwa bokwarewuge enuie cegi. Kocare tagagore tamearutoruie Jesus Cristoji dukodire joruduwarewuge enuie tagi. Pagare tagagoino. Cemearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire boe egore ceragakaie. Kocare tagagore taragaie. Pagare tagagoino. Cemearutorure Jesus ji dukodire boe erudu pegare cei. Kocare tagagore boe eie tugimijeragedo tagi. Pagare tagagoino.
source: Cemearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire boe egore joruduwa bokwarewuge enuie cegi. Kocare tagagore tamearutoruie Jesus Cristoji dukodire joruduwarewuge enuie tagi. Pagare tagagoino. Cemearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire boe egore ceragakaie. Kocare tagagore taragaie. Pagare tagagoino. Cemearutorure Jesus ji dukodire boe erudu pegare cei. Kocare tagagore boe eie tugimijeragedo tagi. Pagare tagagoino.

b: Cewiapagakare cewo boe pemegado cei. Cewiapagare tu cemearutoruwo Jesus Cristoji tu rugadu. Dukodire jii aino cege boeire cei. Pobo boeire cei. Cegudau areia pega. Boe ere boeto cei. Cewai bokware. Dukodire cemeru pagare aino boe parugajeje.
source: Cewiapagakare cewo boe pemegado cei. Cewiapagare tu cemearutoruwo Jesus Cristoji tu rugadu. Dukodire jii aino cege boeire cei. Pobo boeire cei. Cegudau areia pega. Boe ere boeto cei. Cewai bokware. Dukodire cemeru pagare aino boe parugajeje.

b: Cemaragodu rakare dukodire cemedugodure rugadu. Boe emago pegare cei mare cere cemago pemegado ei nowu ewadaru pegarewu jipagi. Boe ero pegare cei mare cegorigodukare erore aino cei duji.
source: Cemaragodu rakare dukodire cemedugodure rugadu. Boe emago pegare cei mare cere cemago pemegado ei nowu ewadaru pegarewu jipagi. Boe ero pegare cei mare cegorigodukare erore aino cei duji.

b: Boe emago pegare cerore jiboe ji mare cemago pegakare erore jiboe ji ewadaru pegarewu jipagi. Boe etaidure tuwo cewarigu tubiji nono ture ia areia pegagodurewu barigu dumogadure. Jii aino boe emearudae pegare cei rugadu.
source: Boe emago pegare cerore jiboe ji mare cemago pegakare erore jiboe ji ewadaru pegarewu jipagi. Boe etaidure tuwo cewarigu tubiji nono ture ia areia pegagodurewu barigu dumogadure. Jii aino boe emearudae pegare cei rugadu.

b: Inure tawie aino awu padure bapera kejewu imearudae ji. Mare itaidukare iwo tabogurudo tamearudaere jiboe ji. Itaidure iwo taruduwado nono boe emode tumearudu kurire jiwu tore eruduwado dumogadure.
source: Inure tawie aino awu padure bapera kejewu imearudae ji. Mare itaidukare iwo tabogurudo tamearudaere jiboe ji. Itaidure iwo taruduwado nono boe emode tumearudu kurire jiwu tore eruduwado dumogadure.

b: Nono boe emagamode tuwo taruduwado Jesus jiwu bakaru pemegarewu ji tietu pemegawo tai mare imire ire taruduwado Jesus jiwu bakaru pemegarewu ji boeto ji. Awu iwadaru koiare ure tamearutorudo Jesus ji. Dukodire ire ido nono tao mogadure.
source: Nono boe emagamode tuwo taruduwado Jesus jiwu bakaru pemegarewu ji tietu pemegawo tai mare imire ire taruduwado Jesus jiwu bakaru pemegarewu ji boeto ji. Awu iwadaru koiare ure tamearutorudo Jesus ji. Dukodire ire ido nono tao mogadure.

b: Dukodire inogwamaguduwo tai. Tarodo nono iro mogadure.
source: Dukodire inogwamaguduwo tai. Tarodo nono iro mogadure.

b: Dukodire ire imedu Timóteo utudo tawagai. Emare mearutoru kurire Jesus bataru ji. Dukodire ure nono imearudu kurire jiwu itonaregedu mogadure. Emare umode taruduwado pugeje irore jiboe ji. Imearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire imearudaere nono Jesus mearudae mogadure. Nou Jesus mearudae koiare ure irore jiboe udo tuginai nowu mariguduwu irore jiboe piji. Ire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe eruduwado nowu Jesus mearudae pemegarewu ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Dukodire ire imedu Timóteo utudo tawagai. Emare mearutoru kurire Jesus bataru ji. Dukodire ure nono imearudu kurire jiwu itonaregedu mogadure. Emare umode taruduwado pugeje irore jiboe ji. Imearutorure Jesus Cristoji dukodire imearudaere nono Jesus mearudae mogadure. Nou Jesus mearudae koiare ure irore jiboe udo tuginai nowu mariguduwu irore jiboe piji. Ire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe eruduwado nowu Jesus mearudae pemegarewu ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: I a t a g i t a m e a r d a e r e itaregodumodukaie tagae pugeje. Dukodire tagojarore tai. Tagagore Pao Kurirewu Uwari uie turaga maku tagai.
source: I a t a g i t a m e a r d a e r e itaregodumodukaie tagae pugeje. Dukodire tagojarore tai. Tagagore Pao Kurirewu Uwari uie turaga maku tagai.

b: Mare itaregodumode kuri aino tagae rugadu ioruduwo nowu ocarore puduiwuge erore jiboe ji rugadu. Pagimijera aidumode dukeje itaregodumode rugadu. Itaregodumode dukeje itaiwomode erore jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turaga maku etai dubagai. Nono imearudumode ewadaru ji iwija tabo rugadu. Iorudumode erore jiboe ji ioku tabo rugadu.
source: Mare itaregodumode kuri aino tagae rugadu ioruduwo nowu ocarore puduiwuge erore jiboe ji rugadu. Pagimijera aidumode dukeje itaregodumode rugadu. Itaregodumode dukeje itaiwomode erore jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turaga maku etai dubagai. Nono imearudumode ewadaru ji iwija tabo rugadu. Iorudumode erore jiboe ji ioku tabo rugadu.

b: Iwo tawie. Boe egomode tumearutoruie Pao Kurirewu ji mare tu tumago tabo karega boe emearutorumode tugimijeraji. Turore jiboe jamedu boe tabore boe emearutorumode tugimijeraji. Nono nowu boe emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu turo jamedu boe tabo tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Mare paga karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode turaga maku etai dukeje eragamode tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu.
source: Iwo tawie. Boe egomode tumearutoruie Pao Kurirewu ji mare tu tumago tabo karega boe emearutorumode tugimijeraji. Turore jiboe jamedu boe tabore boe emearutorumode tugimijeraji. Nono nowu boe emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu turo jamedu boe tabo tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Mare paga karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode turaga maku etai dukeje eragamode tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu.

b: Nuba tamearudaere? Itaregodumode tagae dukeje kaba ia taro jiba iorudumode? Pagare tagagoino tamearutoruie Pao Kurirewu ji kana? Boe rugadu kana tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu tarore jiboe jamedu boe tabo? Pagamode tagagoino dukeje imago rakamode tarore jiboe ji iwo taro jetorodo nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure. Mare boe rugadu mode tagagoino dukeje imago pemegamode tarore jiboe ji. Nono itaora butugumode tai. Taruduwamode imearudu kurire tai duji rugadu.
source: Nuba tamearudaere? Itaregodumode tagae dukeje kaba ia taro jiba iorudumode? Pagare tagagoino tamearutoruie Pao Kurirewu ji kana? Boe rugadu kana tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu tarore jiboe jamedu boe tabo? Pagamode tagagoino dukeje imago rakamode tarore jiboe ji iwo taro jetorodo nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure. Mare boe rugadu mode tagagoino dukeje imago pemegamode tarore jiboe ji. Nono itaora butugumode tai. Taruduwamode imearudu kurire tai duji rugadu.

b: Ia Mearutorure Jesus Jiwu Ro Pegare Toreduje Piji
source: Ia Mearutorure Jesus Jiwu Ro Pegare Toreduje Piji

b: Mare aino care boe ere iwie tarore jiboe ji. Ia tamedia imedu ro pegare rugadu. Ro pegarewuge erokare aino. Mare awu imedu ro pegare ro pegarewuge ero kori. Jeribarire tuo oredujeji mare tuje ji karega roino.
source: Mare aino care boe ere iwie tarore jiboe ji. Ia tamedia imedu ro pegare rugadu. Ro pegarewuge erokare aino. Mare awu imedu ro pegare ro pegarewuge ero kori. Jeribarire tuo oredujeji mare tuje ji karega roino.

b: Kocare tarudu pegakare nowu tamedia ro pegarewuji. Kocare tagojarore tarore aino duji. Ukare turugadu! Tagiarigodudo nowu imedu ro pegarewuji. Tamode bato pui mare nowu imedu apo karega. Ukawo bato pui tagabo.
source: Kocare tarudu pegakare nowu tamedia ro pegarewuji. Kocare tagojarore tarore aino duji. Ukare turugadu! Tagiarigodudo nowu imedu ro pegarewuji. Tamode bato pui mare nowu imedu apo karega. Ukawo bato pui tagabo.

b: Tamode bato pui tamagowo Jesus bataru ji pui dukeje iragoje jaere tabiji. Mare iwiakurure imugure tagabo du ka. Dukodire ure nono iragojere tagabo dumogadure. Dukodire care imago pegare nowu imedu ro pegare duji rugadu. Mare paga karega. Pagimijera Jesus jorudu pegare nowu imedu ro pegare duji dukodire imago pegare aino ji. Tamode bato pui dukeje iragojemode tagabo mare iwiabutu tawugeje dutabo. Tamode bato pui dukeje Pagimijera Jesus rakojemode tagabo jamedu mare turaga tabo rugadu.
source: Tamode bato pui tamagowo Jesus bataru ji pui dukeje iragoje jaere tabiji. Mare iwiakurure imugure tagabo du ka. Dukodire ure nono iragojere tagabo dumogadure. Dukodire care imago pegare nowu imedu ro pegare duji rugadu. Mare paga karega. Pagimijera Jesus jorudu pegare nowu imedu ro pegare duji dukodire imago pegare aino ji. Tamode bato pui dukeje iragojemode tagabo mare iwiabutu tawugeje dutabo. Tamode bato pui dukeje Pagimijera Jesus rakojemode tagabo jamedu mare turaga tabo rugadu.

b: Dukodire tamode awu imedu maku bope doge eimijera uwari bope ai uwo boe pegado nowu imeduji. Mare paga karega nowu imedu uwo tudo nono birewu mogadure dubagai kodire taromode aino ji. Mare bi ji karega inagoino. Biapagakawo tuwodure tabowu tumearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino. Nono umode tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji rugadu. Dukodire Pagimijera Jesus aregodumode pugeje dukeje umode awu imedu udo cinorudo rugadu.
source: Dukodire tamode awu imedu maku bope doge eimijera uwari bope ai uwo boe pegado nowu imeduji. Mare paga karega nowu imedu uwo tudo nono birewu mogadure dubagai kodire taromode aino ji. Mare bi ji karega inagoino. Biapagakawo tuwodure tabowu tumearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino. Nono umode tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji rugadu. Dukodire Pagimijera Jesus aregodumode pugeje dukeje umode awu imedu udo cinorudo rugadu.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai. Tagojarokaba tarore jiboe ji. Taruduware boe ewadaru ji. Egore: “Fermento biagarewu tabore boe emode pão barodudo rugadu.” Ainore boe egore.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai. Tagojarokaba tarore jiboe ji. Taruduware boe ewadaru ji. Egore: “Fermento biagarewu tabore boe emode pão barodudo rugadu.” Ainore boe egore.

b: Nono boe ero pegarewu ure nono fermento mogadure. Mare fermento ji karega inagoino. Taro pegarewu jire inagoino. Taro pegarewu umode tamearudae jamedu boe pegado. Dujire inagoino. Ca taro pegarewu barigu tabiji. Tamode tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje tabemegamode, tamearudae pemegamode jamedu. Tamode nono amirewu remawu mogadure. Mare amirewu ji karega inagoino. Tabemegamode, tamearudae pemegamode tawo taro pemegado. Dujire inagoino. Mare tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire ure tabemegado marigudu. Aino tamode tagera ra taro pegarewu piji pugeje tabemegamode nono tamogadure rugadu. Mare paga karega. Jesus Cristo bire boe ero pegarewu morice dukodire ure nono boe ere bitowu Páscoa kejewu cordeiro mogadure. Mare cordeiro ji karega inagoino. Emare bire paro pegarewu morice rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: Nono boe ero pegarewu ure nono fermento mogadure. Mare fermento ji karega inagoino. Taro pegarewu jire inagoino. Taro pegarewu umode tamearudae jamedu boe pegado. Dujire inagoino. Ca taro pegarewu barigu tabiji. Tamode tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje tabemegamode, tamearudae pemegamode jamedu. Tamode nono amirewu remawu mogadure. Mare amirewu ji karega inagoino. Tabemegamode, tamearudae pemegamode tawo taro pemegado. Dujire inagoino. Mare tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire ure tabemegado marigudu. Aino tamode tagera ra taro pegarewu piji pugeje tabemegamode nono tamogadure rugadu. Mare paga karega. Jesus Cristo bire boe ero pegarewu morice dukodire ure nono boe ere bitowu Páscoa kejewu cordeiro mogadure. Mare cordeiro ji karega inagoino. Emare bire paro pegarewu morice rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Dukodire pawo pawadae tawuje. Pawo udo nono nowu Judeu doge egore Páscoa aino jiwu ewadae mogadure. Mare pawadae ji karega inagoino. Pamearutoru pemegawo Jesus bataru ji paegare tabo. Dujire inagoino. Pawo paro pegarewu barigu pabiji. Pawo pamearudae pegarewu barigu pabiji. Dujire inagoino. Paro pemegawo. Pamearutoruwo boe remawu ji. Pamagowo boe remawu ji boe ewiagai. Dujire inagoino.

Dujire inagoino. Pawo paro pegarewu barigu pabiji. Pawo pamearudae pegarewu barigu pabiji. Dujire inagoino. Paro pemegawo. Pamearutoruwo boe remawu ji. Pamagowo boe remawu ji boe ewiagai. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ire bapera atugodo tawagai marigudu. Dutabore ire tawie tawo tagera ra jeribarire tumugukare apowuge ime areme epiji. Taburedukaba ei.
source: Ire bapera atugodo tawagai marigudu. Dutabore ire tawie tawo tagera ra jeribarire tumugukare apowuge ime areme epiji. Taburedukaba ei.

b: Mare mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge ei karega inagoino. Mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge eribarire tumugukare apowuge ji. Enogwa kidure tu pudai diero keje. Erudu pegare boe enoe bagai pudai. Ekiwogu kigodure rugadu. Emearutorure tuwai tadawu santo dogei jamedu. Taruduware marigudu tarokawo nono awu ro pegarewuge mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge ero mogadure. Mare eragojere moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire taroiwakare taduwo epiji.

Mare eragojere moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire taroiwakare taduwo epiji.

b: Mare ia boe egore tumearutoruie Jesus ji mare ero pegare kimo nono awu ro pegarewuge ero mogadure. Eire inagoino tawo tagera ra epiji. Eribarire tumugukare apowugei rugadu. Enogwa kidure tu pudai diero keje. Emearutorure bai tadawu santoji. Emago pegare ro pemegarewuge ji. Ekudu kigodure piga kuruce. Ekiwogu kigodure. Egore tumearutoruie Jesus ji mare pagatu je. Eire inagoino tawo tagera ra epiji rugadu. Tagaba tamedagedo emage. Tagaba tamugudo ebo. Tagwagekaba ebo jamedu.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure tuwadaru bu bapera keje. Akore tamode ro pegarewu utudo tabiji ukawo bato pui tagabo. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore. Mare mearutorukare puduiwuge ei karega akoino. Pagi karega pagaiwomodukare mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge erore jiboe ji. Emare aiwomode mearutorukare puduiwuge erore jiboe ji ero pegarewu bagai. Mare nowu egore tumearutoruie Jesus jiwuge eire pagaiwomode ero pegarewu bagai. Ere bato pui pagabo dukodire pagaiwomode erore jiboe ji rugadu ero pegarewu bagai rugadu. Dujire Pao Kurirewu akoino ekawo bato pui mearutorure puduiwugebo pugeje.

Dujire Pao Kurirewu akoino ekawo bato pui mearutorure puduiwugebo pugeje.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ekawo Boe Pegado Pui Ekawo Turo Morido
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ekawo Boe Pegado Pui Ekawo Turo Morido

b: Ia tagi tagorigodure pui pu roredu boe ji. Dukejere tadure mearutorukare Jesus jiwu boe eimijera ae uwo taruduwado tarore jiboe ji uwo tamugu pemegado tarore jiboe piji. Kodiba tarore aino? Ukare turugadu. Kodiba tamagokare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage ewagai ewo tabemegado pui tarore jiboe piji?
source: Ia tagi tagorigodure pui pu roredu boe ji. Dukejere tadure mearutorukare Jesus jiwu boe eimijera ae uwo taruduwado tarore jiboe ji uwo tamugu pemegado tarore jiboe piji. Kodiba tarore aino? Ukare turugadu. Kodiba tamagokare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage ewagai ewo tabemegado pui tarore jiboe piji?

b: Taruduwa bokware. Ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu uwobe emagere etaiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji ero pegarewu bagai. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge mode tagi dukeje Pao Kurirewu uwobe mode tagi rugadu. Dukodire tagaiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji. Mare kocare taroiwakare tawo ia taro pegarewu biagarewu tawuje tabiji tawo tabemegado pui pugeje.
source: Taruduwa bokware. Ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu uwobe emagere etaiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji ero pegarewu bagai. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge mode tagi dukeje Pao Kurirewu uwobe mode tagi rugadu. Dukodire tagaiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji. Mare kocare taroiwakare tawo ia taro pegarewu biagarewu tawuje tabiji tawo tabemegado pui pugeje.

b: Taruduwa bokware. Ia meri keje pagaiwomode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge erore jiboe ji. Kocare taroiwakare tagaiwowo moto kejewu tarore jiboe ji.
source: Taruduwa bokware. Ia meri keje pagaiwomode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge erore jiboe ji. Kocare taroiwakare tagaiwowo moto kejewu tarore jiboe ji.

b: Kocare tadure mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo tarore jiboe ji emagowo tai nuba taromode.
source: Kocare tadure mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo tarore jiboe ji emagowo tai nuba taromode.

b: Taro pega! Iwo tabogurudo tarore jitu bagaire inagoino tai. O kocare ia joruduwarewu mugure nono tagabo. Mare kocare tagaidukanure ji na?
source: Taro pega! Iwo tabogurudo tarore jitu bagaire inagoino tai. O kocare ia joruduwarewu mugure nono tagabo. Mare kocare tagaidukanure ji na?

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure tagi dukodire tamedagenure pugi. Mare kocare tagorigodure pui. Kocare tadure mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo tarore jiboe ji taro pegarewu bagai taro pemegarewu bagai jamedu. Ukare turugadu!
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure tagi dukodire tamedagenure pugi. Mare kocare tagorigodure pui. Kocare tadure mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo tarore jiboe ji taro pegarewu bagai taro pemegarewu bagai jamedu. Ukare turugadu!

b: Tadure boe eimijera bagai aiwowo tarore jiboe ji tumagowo tai nuba taromode pui tamugu pemegawo pu apo dukodire nowu inodu pegare rugadu ukare turugadu! Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegamode tai mare tagaba rore taidu morido. Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu iwogumode tai mare tagaba rore taidu morido.
source: Tadure boe eimijera bagai aiwowo tarore jiboe ji tumagowo tai nuba taromode pui tamugu pemegawo pu apo dukodire nowu inodu pegare rugadu ukare turugadu! Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegamode tai mare tagaba rore taidu morido. Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu iwogumode tai mare tagaba rore taidu morido.

b: Mare kocare taro pegare pui puibagi. Tagiwogure pui puibagi jamedu. Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure tagi. Tamedagenure pugi. Kocare tarore aino!
source: Mare kocare taro pegare pui puibagi. Tagiwogure pui puibagi jamedu. Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure tagi. Tamedagenure pugi. Kocare tarore aino!

b: Taruduware Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Ro pegarewuge ekare tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukodire Pao Kurirewu umodukare emugudo baru tada rugadu. Tagaba taekiripagado. Ro pegare tieribari tabowuge, mearutorure tuwai tadawu santo jiwuge, jeribarire toreduje pijiwuge, jeribarire toredu pijiwuge, ime ere tugeragu dieroji tieribari tabowuge, jeribarire puiwuge ime, jeribarire puiwuge areme nouge emugumodukare baru tada rugadu.
source: Taruduware Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Ro pegarewuge ekare tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukodire Pao Kurirewu umodukare emugudo baru tada rugadu. Tagaba taekiripagado. b: Iwogu kigodurewuge, okwa kidure tu pudaiwuge, korigodure tumedage enoe bagaiwuge, uke kurure jiwuge, mako pegare boe ero jiwuge, iwogure tumedage enoroe jiwuge, nouge emugumodukare baru tada jamedu. Ekare tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukodire Pao Kurirewu umodukare emugudo baru tada.
source: Iwogu kigodurewuge, okwa kidure tu pudaiwuge, korigodure tumedage enoe bagaiwuge, uke kurure jiwuge, mako pegare boe ero jiwuge, iwogure tumedage enoroe jiwuge, nouge emugumodukare baru tada jamedu. Ekare tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukodire Pao Kurirewu umodukare emugudo baru tada.

b: Marigudu tagi tarore awu taro pegarewu boe ji jamedu. Mare aino care Pagimijera Jesus Cristo Pao Kurirewu Uwari apo ere tagaimo. Mare boe etaimodu ji karega inagoino. Ere taro pegarewu barigu tabiji. Dujire inagoino. Ere tado taginai taro pegarewu piji taro pemegawo. Ere tugeragu tai pudae tuwo tado nono ro pemegarewuge emogadure. Dujire inagoino.
source: Marigudu tagi tarore awu taro pegarewu boe ji jamedu. Mare aino care Pagimijera Jesus Cristo Pao Kurirewu Uwari apo ere tagaimo. Mare boe etaimodu ji karega inagoino. b: Taro Pemegado Boe Emago Pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji
source: Taro Pemegado Boe Emago Pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji

b: Ia tagi tagagore: – Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutorumodukare Judeu doge eno bakaruji pugeje dukodire parowo pagaidure jiwu parore jiboe jamedu boe ji. Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegamodukare paromode aino duji. Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Imi jamedu imearutorumodukare Judeu doge eno bakaruji pugeje. Iromode itaidure jiwu irore jiboe ji. Mare pagaidure jiboe jamedu boe karega pemegare pai. Dukodire ire imearudae tawuje irokawo nowu pemegakare iwu iroji pugeje. Iromode itaidure jiwu irore jiboe ji. Mare itaidumodukare iwo ikera ra nowu iro piji pugeje dukeje imode ikera ra nowu iro pegarewu piji rugadu. Imodukare irore jiboe udo boe pegado i pugeje.

b: Ia tagi tagagore: – Page boeire pai kodi pagwagemode. Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegamodukare parore aino duji. Mare boe eke ji karega tagagoino. Taro pegarewu jire tagagoino. Tagagore: – Boe etaidure areduji nono taidu moga tuge jitu mogadure. Boe emodukare tugeragu areduji dukeje boe pegamode ei nono boe pegare uke bokwarewu jitu mogadure. Ainore tagagore. Mare tagaidure taro pegawo taeribari pagawo pui. Dujire tagagoino. Nou tamearudae ukare turugadu. Tamearudae pegare. Pao Kurirewu ure boe etowuje rugadu mare boe emearutoruwo pudui dubagai Pao Kurirewu roino. Dukodire pamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu utugaregewo pagi. Dukodire paeribarikawo pagoreduje piji, pagoredu piji. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode pagodu pawiri akedudo. Pamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire umode pagodu maiwu pawiri maiwu maku pagai pugeje. Dukodire boe eke boeimodukare pai pugeje. Pagimijera Kurirewunure ema kodi. Turaga tabore Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus jewodudo pugeje. Dukodire umode paewodudo pugeje jamedu turaga tabo rugadu.

b: Tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire tare nono Jesus Cristo biri mogadure. Tagodure nono Jesus Cristo kodu mogadure jamedu. Mare Jesus biri ji karega inagoino. Jesus kodu ji karega inagoino. Jesus rakojere tagabo. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire tabadumode ia aredu ure tugeragu dieroji tieribari tabowudo apo nowu taro ukare turugadu! Nou taro peganure. Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru mako pemegare. Akore imedu mugumode aredu apo dukeje ere mitotu puapo turoi pui dutabo Pao Kurirewu jakai. Dukodire imedu jeribarimode nowu jeribarire diero bagaiwu areduji dukeje emode nono mitotu puapo turoi pui dutabo Pao Kurirewu jakai jamedu. Taruduware.

b: Mare tamode tamagu Pagimijera Jesus ai dukeje tamearudaere jiboe umode mitotu je tamearutoruwo Jesus jitu tabo. Tamearutorumodukare ia boe emearudae pegarewu ji pugeje.
source: Mare tamode tamagu Pagimijera Jesus ai dukeje tamearudaere jiboe umode mitotu je tamearutoruwo Jesus jitu tabo. Tamearutorumodukare ia boe emearudae pegarewu ji pugeje.

b: Taeribarikaba tawire epiji tagoge epiji ia tamugukare apowuge ji. Boe emode boe pegado ia boe ji turo pegarewu jamedu boe tabo. Mare boe eribarimode toreduje piji toredu piji dukeje tuwiri jire tugodu jire boe emode boe pegado rugadu.
source: Taeribarikaba tawire epiji tagoge epiji ia tamugukare apowuge ji. Boe emode boe pegado ia boe ji turo pegarewu jamedu boe tabo. Mare boe eribarimode toreduje piji toredu piji dukeje tuwiri jire tugodu jire boe emode boe pegado rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari mugure mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etada. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari uwainure tagi. Pao Kurirewu ure Tuwari maku tagai rugadu. Taruduware nowu inoduji marigudu. Dukodire tagimijera karegure tagi. Pao Kurirewu emare tagimijeranure ema. Kocare taruduwakare nowu inoduji?

b: Ure akirodo tai. Tamori kurire rugadu. Mare diero ji karega inagoino. Jesus bire tamugato. Dujire inagoino. Jesus ure tugu redo taro pegarewu morice. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire care tarore jiboe tagodu tabo udo turugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai tamearutoru tabo ji uwo tamugu pemegado boe emago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.

Dukodire care tarore jiboe tagodu tabo udo turugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai tamearutoru tabo ji uwo tamugu pemegado boe emago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.

b: Boe Etuwire Pemegawo Etugoge Pemegawo
source: Boe Etuwire Pemegawo Etugoge Pemegawo

b: Tare atugoreboe maku iwagai. Dutabore tanarare i Pao Kurirewu mearudae bagai. Tagagore imedu mugumodukaie aredu apo du pegamodukaie.
source: Tare atugoreboe maku iwagai. Dutabore tanarare i Pao Kurirewu mearudae bagai. Tagagore imedu mugumodukaie aredu apo du pegamodukaie.

b: Mare iwo tawie. Boe eribari pagare pui tu tu je. Dukodire imagowo tai. Imedu muguwo tu toreduje remawudo apo. Aredu muguwo tu toredu remawu apo.
source: Mare iwo tawie. Boe eribari pagare pui tu tu je. Dukodire imagowo tai. Imedu muguwo tu toreduje remawudo apo. Aredu muguwo tu toredu remawu apo.

b: Imedu umode tugeragu tu toreduje remawudoji. Aredu umode tumagu tu toredu remawu ai. Dukodire emugure puapo. Oreduje jetorimodukare toreduji. Oredu jetorimodukare toredujeji. Aredu umodukare tumearudae tawuje tuginaigodu tieribariwo. Nou oredu umode tumearudae maku toreduje ai ewo tumearudae maku puai. Aino jamedu imedu umodukare tumearudae tawuje tuginaigodu tieribariwo. Nou oreduje umode tumearudae maku toredu ai jamedu ewo tumearudae maku puai emearudaewo nono pumearudae mogadure.
source: Imedu umode tugeragu tu toreduje remawudoji. Aredu umode tumagu tu toredu remawu ai. Dukodire emugure puapo. Oreduje jetorimodukare toreduji. Oredu jetorimodukare toredujeji. Nou oreduje umode tumearudae maku toredu ai jamedu ewo tumearudae maku puai emearudaewo nono pumearudae mogadure.

b: Emode tumearudae maku puai tuwo tugera ra tieribarire pui dupiji tu jao tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to du pegakare. Mare nowu emagore jiwu meri akedumode dukeje ure turugadu ewo tugirimi puae pugeje. Nono ero pemeganure pui. Aredu umodukare tumagu toredu ai dukeje mareboe umode oredu aora pegado jemaruwo ia aredu bagai toreduje piji. Rakamodukare tuwo turo pemegado. Imedu aidumodukare tuwo tugeragu toredujeji dukeje mareboe umode nowu oreduje aora pegado jemaruwo toro ia imedu bagai toredu piji jamedu. Rakamodukare tuwo turo pemegado jamedu. b: Care imagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji okogerewuge ewiagai, uwirerewuge ewiagai. Iwadaru karega. Pao Kurirewu bataru reo. Ainore akore aremei: – Tagaba tagera ra tagoredu piji.

b: Pao Kurirewu Makore Tawagai Dukodire Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu Bataruji

b: Pao Kurirewu makore tawagai. Dukodire care tarodo nono Pagimijera ure maku tagaiwu taroji. Mare tado nono tare marigudu. Ainore imagore mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Mare boe emearudae pegarewu boe ero pegarewu ji karega inagoino. Ia tagi tare tawaga oto biri kadowuge Judeu dogenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu makore tawagai dukodi karega tamode tagera ra Judeu doge ero pemegarewu boe piji. Du jire inagoino. Tamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu mare tagaba tagera ra Judeu doge ero pemegarewu piji. Tamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji mare tagaba tado nono nowu ukare tuwaga oto biri kadowuge emogadure. b: Ure tuwaga oto biri kadowuge bagai karega Pao Kurirewu aiwore pugeje. Boe ekare tuwaga oto biri kado dubagai karega Pao Kurirewu aiwore. Pao Kurirewu aiwore nowu mearutorure tuwadaru jiwuge ewagai tu rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu makore tawagai. Dukodire tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu kodi karega tamode tagera ra tamaragodae piji.
source: Pao Kurirewu makore tawagai. Dukodire tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu kodi karega tamode tagera ra tamaragodae piji.

b: Ia tagi boe ere tugeragu tai turaga tabo tuwo tudugaregedo tagi. Dukodire tamaragodae rakare tai. Mare tamororamagadukaba. Tamaragodu pemegado nowu tagimijera ure maku tagaiwu tamaragodaeji. Tagaba tagera ra tagimijerage epiji. Mare tagimijerage etaidure tuwo taginorudo tamaragodae rakarewu piji taduwo ia tamaragodae pemegarewu ka dukeje tadudo rugadu tawo tagamudo nowu tamaragodae rakarewu piji.
source: Ia tagi boe ere tugeragu tai turaga tabo tuwo tudugaregedo tagi. Dukodire tamaragodae rakare tai. Mare tamororamagadukaba. Tamaragodu pemegado nowu tagimijera ure maku tagaiwu tamaragodaeji. b: Ia tagi boe ere tugeragu tai turaga tabo tuwo tudugaregedo tagi. Tamearutorure Jesus ji mare tamaragodae rakare tai kimo. Mare tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire ure taginorudo taro pegarewu piji. Dukodire tare tagamudo nowu taro pegarewu piji. Tamaragodae rakare tai mare tare tagamudo nowu taro pegarewu boe piji. Ia tagi boe etugarege karegure tagi. Tamaragodure tu tagai rugadu. Mare aino Jesus makore tawagai dukodire ure tudugaregedo tagi rugadu.

Mare tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire ure taginorudo taro pegarewu piji. Dukodire tare tagamudo nowu taro pegarewu piji. Tamaragodae rakare tai mare tare tagamudo nowu taro pegarewu boe piji. Ia tagi boe etugarege karegure tagi. Tamaragodure tu tagai rugadu. Mare aino Jesus makore tawagai dukodire ure tudugaregedo tagi rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure akirodo tai. Taro pegarewu mori kurire. Dukodire Jesus bire taro pegarewu morice. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire tagaba tagirimi boe emearudae pegarewu ka pugeje. Tawiapagakaba boe emearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Tamode tagirimi boe emearudae pegarewu ka dukeje nowu boe emearudae pegarewu etugarege emode tagi rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tagawo tagirimi emearudae pegarewu ka pugeje.

Tawiapagakaba boe emearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Tamode tagirimi boe emearudae pegarewu ka dukeje nowu boe emearudae pegarewu etugarege emode tagi rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tagawo tagirimi emearudae pegarewu ka pugeje.

b: Imedagenure tagi. Tamearutoru rakamode Jesus ji dukeje tamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Ca boe etugaregenure tagi. Boe kurirewugenure tagi. Mare tamororamagadukaba. Tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodi karega tamode tagera ra tamaragodae piji. Tamaragodu pemegado tamaragodaeji. Ainore taromode tamearutoru pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.
source: Imedagenure tagi. Tamearutoru rakamode Jesus ji dukeje tamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Ca boe etugaregenure tagi. Boe kurirewugenure tagi. Mare tamororamagadukaba. Tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodi karega tamode tagera ra tamaragodae piji. Tamaragodu pemegado tamaragodaeji. Ainore taromode tamearutoru pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.

b: Paulo Makore Okoge Bokwarewuge Eroji Boe Ewiagai
source: Paulo Makore Okoge Bokwarewuge Eroji Boe Ewiagai

b: Tanarare nogware maiwuge ero bagai. Padukare ia Pao Kurirewu bataru keje. Mare Pagimijera okudugodure itabo dukodire ioruduware Pagimijera mearudae ji. Dukodire inogituwamode tai nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure.
source: Tanarare nogware maiwuge ero bagai. Padukare ia Pao Kurirewu bataru keje. Mare Pagimijera okudugodure itabo dukodire ioruduware Pagimijera mearudae ji. Dukodire inogituwamode tai nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure.

b: Boe rakare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Dukodire boe rakare tai rugadu. Dukodire care tamode nono tare du pegakare.
source: Boe rakare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Dukodire boe rakare tai rugadu. Dukodire care tamode nono tare du pegakare.

b: Nou mugure toreduje apowugenure ia tagi. Dukodire imode tawie. Tagaba tagera ra tagoreduje piji. Mare ia tagi uwire bokwarewuge imenure tagi. Iwo tawie jamedu. Taemarukaba ia aredu bagai tagoredujece.
source: Nou mugure toreduje apowugenure ia tagi. Dukodire imode tawie. Tagaba tagera ra tagoreduje piji. Mare ia tagi uwire bokwarewuge imenure tagi. Iwo tawie jamedu. Taemarukaba ia aredu bagai tagoredujece.

b: Mare tawiremode dukeje pegakare jamedu. Taro pegakare. Nogwaredu okogemode dukeje pegakare. Ro pegakare. Mare boe emugumode puapo dukeje boe ewiagoromode toredujeji, torei jamedu. Mare paga karega boe rakamode ei dukeje mororamagadumode ei tuwo boe pemegado ei. Mare uwire bokwarewuge ewiagorokare iaboe ji iaboe ji ure mitotu je dukodi. Dukodire inagoino tai tawiagorokawo aredu bagai, imedu bagai.
source: Mare tawiremode dukeje pegakare jamedu. Taro pegakare. Nogwaredu okogemode dukeje pegakare. Ro pegakare. Mare boe emugumode puapo dukeje boe ewiagoromode toredujeji, torei jamedu. Mare paga karega boe rakamode ei dukeje mororamagadumode ei tuwo boe pemegado ei. Mare uwire bokwarewuge ewiagorokare iaboe ji iaboe ji ure mitotu je dukodi. Dukodire inagoino tai tawiagorokawo aredu bagai, imedu bagai.

b: Boe puredugodure boe jamedu boe akeduwo rugadu. Imedagenure tagi. Dukodire inagoino tai. Nou uwirerewu ime ewiagorokawo tuwaiji pugeje toeji pugeje. Mare ewiagorowo tu tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji jii toro.
source: Boe puredugodure boe jamedu boe akeduwo rugadu. Imedagenure tagi. Dukodire inagoino tai. Nou uwirerewu ime ewiagorokawo tuwaiji pugeje toeji pugeje. Mare ewiagorowo tu tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji jii toro.

b: Ragudurewuge ewiagorokawo traguduji pugeje, ewiagorowo tu tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji jii toro. Jakarere puduiwuge ewiagorokawo tiegareji pugeje, ewiagorowo tu tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji jii toro. Boe emode akirodo boe enoeji. Mare nowu boe ewiagorokawo nowu ture akirodo jiboe ji pugeje ewiagorowo tu tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tu rugadu jii toro.

Jakarere puduiwuge ewiagorokawo tiegareji pugeje, ewiagorowo tu tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji jii toro. Boe emode akirodo boe enoeji. b: Biagorore toe jiwuge ewiagorokawo toeji pugeje. Ire tawie aino. Mare paga karega. Awu tadu kejewu moto, awu taruduware jiwu baru akedumode rugadu kuri aino rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tawiagorowo tu tamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tu rugadu.
source: Biagorore toe jiwuge ewiagorokawo toeji pugeje. Ire tawie aino. Mare paga karega. Awu tadu kejewu moto, awu taruduware jiwu baru akedumode rugadu kuri aino rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tawiagorowo tu tamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tu rugadu.

b: Itaidure iwo tamearudae mekido tawiagorore jiboe piji tamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tu rugadu. Uwirekarewu imedu mearudaere tu tumaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu maragodaeji. Aidure tuwo Pagimijera jakaredo pudui.
source: Itaidure iwo tamearudae mekido tawiagorore jiboe piji tamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji tu rugadu. Uwirekarewu imedu mearudaere tu tumaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu maragodaeji. Aidure tuwo Pagimijera jakaredo pudui.

b: Mare imedu uwiremode dukeje mororamagadumode toe bagai, tuge bagai tuwo toreduje jakaredo pudui. Mare aidure tumaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu maragodaeji jamedu.
source: Mare imedu uwiremode dukeje mororamagadumode toe bagai, tuge bagai tuwo toreduje jakaredo pudui. Mare aidure tumaragoduwo Pao Kurirewu maragodaeji jamedu.

b: Dukodire aidure jiwu maragodaere pobe. Pudai Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu. Ainore boere aredu okogerewudoji jamedu. Aredu okogere dukeje biagorore tuwo toredu jakaredo jamedu. Mare okoge bokwarewu aredu, okoge bokwarewu nogwaredu ewiagorore tu Pagimijera Jesus maragodaeji. Etaidure tumaragoduwo tu Pao Kurirewu ai rugadu turaga tabo tumearudae jamedu boe tabo rugadu.
source: Dukodire aidure jiwu maragodaere pobe. Pudai Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu. Ainore boere aredu okogerewudoji jamedu. Aredu okogere dukeje biagorore tuwo toredu jakaredo jamedu. Mare okoge bokwarewu aredu, okoge bokwarewu nogwaredu ewiagorore tu Pagimijera Jesus maragodaeji. Etaidure tumaragoduwo tu Pao Kurirewu ai rugadu turaga tabo tumearudae jamedu boe tabo rugadu.

b: Itaidure iwo boe pemegado tai. Dukodire inagoino. Itaidukare iwo taro akedudo. Mare itaidure tawo taro jetorodo. Itaidure taro pemegawo. Itaidure tamaragoduwo rugadu Pagimijera ai utugaregewo tagi rugadu.

b: Imedu aidure nogwareduji. Mearudu kurire ji rugadu. Joruduware turo pegakare nowu nogwaredu jituji. Aidure tumuguwo apo rugadu. Mare mearudaere turo pegarumode Pao Kurirewu jakai tumugumode apo duji. Mare etaidure pui. Iwo tawie. Emuguwo puapo rugadu. Emugumode puapo du pegakare Pao Kurirewu jakai rugadu.

b: Mare ia imedu mearudaere tuwirekawo rugadu. Emare joruduware tuwo turo jetorodo. Ure tumearudae tawuje rugadu. Nono pegakare uwirekawo rugadu.
source: Mare ia imedu mearudaere tuwirekawo rugadu. Emare joruduware tuwo turo jetorodo. Ure tumearudae tawuje rugadu. Nono pegakare uwirekawo rugadu.

b: Imedu uwiremode du pegakare. Mare ia imedu uwiremodukare du pemegare rugadu.
source: Imedu uwiremode du pegakare. Mare ia imedu uwiremodukare du pemegare rugadu.

b: Aredu mearutorumode toreduji jii toro toredu bire du ka. Mugukawo ia imedu apo pugeje. Mare oredu bire dukeje aredu mearudaere tumuguwo ia imedu apo pugeje. Du pegakare. Mare nowu aredu muguwo tu mearutorure Jesus jiwu imedu apo tu rugadu.
source: Aredu mearutorumode toreduji jii toro toredu bire du ka. Mugukawo ia imedu apo pugeje. Mare oredu bire dukeje aredu mearudaere tumuguwo ia imedu apo pugeje. Du pegakare. Mare nowu aredu muguwo tu mearutorure Jesus jiwu imedu apo tu rugadu.

b: Mare nowu aredu okogemodukare pugeje dukeje jakaregodumode rugadu. Ainore imearudaere rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere itada dukodire ioruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode imearudae udo nono tumearudae mogadure rugadu.
source: Mare nowu aredu okogemodukare pugeje dukeje jakaregodumode rugadu. Ainore imearudaere rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere itada dukodire ioruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode imearudae udo nono tumearudae mogadure rugadu.

b: Ainore Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eromode Makudure Santo Doge Etaiwu Bope Doge Ekeji
source: Ainore Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eromode Makudure Santo Doge Etaiwu Bope Doge Ekeji

b: Tanarare i nuba taromoduie makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge ekeji. Ca boe egore Paiamedu boe paruduware boe ji. Ainore boe egore. Boe jokodu jire boe egoino. Mare boe mearudaemode tuioruduwaie rugadu dukeje boe enojaromode tuwadaru ji rugadu. Mare boe emearudu kurimode boe ji dukeje emago pemegamode nowu boe erore jiboe ji tuwo nowu tumedage emearutoru rakado Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Tanarare i nuba taromoduie makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge ekeji. Ca boe egore Paiamedu boe paruduware boe ji. Ainore boe egore. Boe jokodu jire boe egoino. Mare boe mearudaemode tuioruduwaie rugadu dukeje boe enojaromode tuwadaru ji rugadu. Mare boe emearudu kurimode boe ji dukeje emago pemegamode nowu boe erore jiboe ji tuwo nowu tumedage emearutoru rakado Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Boe emearudaemode tuioruduwaie boe ji rugadu dukeje emodukare turagado tuioruduwawo iaboe ji pugeje. Dukodire nowu boe eruduwa pemegamodukare iaboe ji pugeje.
source: Boe emearudaemode tuioruduwaie boe ji rugadu dukeje emodukare turagado tuioruduwawo iaboe ji pugeje. Dukodire nowu boe eruduwa pemegamodukare iaboe ji pugeje.

b: Mare boe emearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Pao Kurirewu joruduware mearudu kurire puduiwugei rugadu.
source: Mare boe emearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Pao Kurirewu joruduware mearudu kurire puduiwugei rugadu.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu ure mitotu je. Ia bokware. Mare boe emearudaere tuwai tadawu santo doge eragaie nono Pao Kurirewu mogadure. Mare pagatu jere boe eroino. Pao Kurirewu karegure emage. Boe ere towujeboenure emage tu rugadu. Mare boe emearudaere boe rakarewuge emagaie baru tada, moto keje jamedu. Dukodire ere to santo doge emagado. Ere etowuje tuwo pao kurirewugedo emage. Emearutorure nowu ture towujewu santo dogei rugadu dukodire emode ia tuge maku nowu tuwai tadawu santo doge etai mare pagatu je. Mare Pao Kurirewu ure mitotu je rugadu. Boe Etuo Kurirewunure ema. Emare ure boe jamedu boe towuje. Emare ure baru tadaboe eiamedu boe etowuje. Dukodire pamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tu rugadu. Pagimijera Kurirewu ure mitotu je. Jesus Cristonure ema. Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus udo boe jamedu boe towuje moto keje, baru tada jamedu. Ema koiare ure paragojedo aino.

Boe ere towujeboenure emage tu rugadu. Mare boe emearudaere boe rakarewuge emagaie baru tada, moto keje jamedu. Dukodire ere to santo doge emagado. Ere etowuje tuwo pao kurirewugedo emage. Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus udo boe jamedu boe towuje moto keje, baru tada jamedu. Ema koiare ure paragojedo aino.

b: Mare ia boe eruduwakare nowu inoduji. Marigudu emearutorure tuwai tadawu santo dogei rugadu. Dukodire ere ia tuge maku nowu santo doge etai bope doge ekece tu tu je. Mare aino emearutorure Jesus ji. Mare eruduwakare Jesus mearudae jamedu boe ji dukodire emearutoru rakakare ji. Dukodire nowu boe emodukare nowu makudure bope doge etaiwu boe eke ko. Etaidukare ji. Emearudaere bope uwari uke nuie ema duji. Enogwagemode ji dukeje emearudaere turo pega nure.
source: Mare ia boe eruduwakare nowu inoduji. Marigudu emearutorure tuwai tadawu santo dogei rugadu. Dukodire ere ia tuge maku nowu santo doge etai bope doge ekece tu tu je. Emearudaere bope uwari uke nuie ema duji. Enogwagemode ji dukeje emearudaere turo pega nure.

b: Mare pagare egoino. Pagwagere jiwu page umodukare pado pagera ra Pao Kurirewu piji. Pagwagere jiwu page umodukare pamugu pemegado Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Pagwagemode makudure bope doge etaiwu boe ekeji du pegakare. Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegamodukare parore aino duji.
source: Mare pagare egoino. Pagwagere jiwu page umodukare pado pagera ra Pao Kurirewu piji. Pagwagere jiwu page umodukare pamugu pemegado Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Pagwagemode makudure bope doge etaiwu boe ekeji du pegakare. Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegamodukare parore aino duji.

b: Mare taeku jado tarore jiboe ji. Tamearudu kurido tamedagei. Tagaba emearutoru bokwado. Ia tagi tagwagemode bope uwari ukeji du pegakare tawo ko. Mare ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge erudumode tarore aino duji erudu pegamode tarore jiboe ji dukeje tagaba ko. Mare paga karega emearutoru rakakare Jesus ji dukodire erudu pegare tamode ko duji. Dukodire emode tugera ra Jesus piji.
source: Mare taeku jado tarore jiboe ji. Tamearudu kurido tamedagei. Tagaba emearutoru bokwado. Ia tagi tagwagemode bope uwari ukeji du pegakare tawo ko. Dukodire emode tugera ra Jesus piji.

b: Mare paga karega. Tagwagemode bope uwari ukeji nowu bope uwari uwai ja tada. Nono nowu mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu jorudumode tarore aino duji. Dukeje umode kowuje jamedu. Nono mearudae pegamode turore jiboe ji.
source: Mare paga karega. Tagwagemode bope uwari ukeji nowu bope uwari uwai ja tada. Nono nowu mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu jorudumode tarore aino duji. Dukeje umode kowuje jamedu. Nono mearudae pegamode turore jiboe ji.

b: Ture ko dukeje mearudae pegamode ture tugera ra Jesus piji duji. Mare boe rugadu ji karega mearudaere. Jesus bire boe ero pegarewu morice. Boe enogwagemode nowu bope uwari ukeji mare ero pega karegure. Taruduware nowu inoduji. Mare nowu tamedia joruduwakare. Dukodire mearudae pegare ture ko duji.
source: Ture ko dukeje mearudae pegamode ture tugera ra Jesus piji duji. Mare boe rugadu ji karega mearudaere. Jesus bire boe ero pegarewu morice. Boe enogwagemode nowu bope uwari ukeji mare ero pega karegure. Taruduware nowu inoduji. Mare nowu tamedia joruduwakare. Dukodire mearudae pegare ture ko duji.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai. Tagaba nowu bope uke kowuje nowu tamedia ukawo ko taro kao. Tamode ko dukeje taro peganure nowu mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu jakai. Tamode nowu tamedia ro pagado taidukare jiboe ji. Dukodire taro pegamode Jesus Cristoji jamedu taroino dutabo.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai. Tagaba nowu bope uke kowuje nowu tamedia ukawo ko taro kao. Tamode ko dukeje taro peganure nowu mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu jakai. Tamode nowu tamedia ro pagado taidukare jiboe ji. Dukodire taro pegamode Jesus Cristoji jamedu taroino dutabo.

b: Inogwagemode bope uwari ukeji. Mare awu iro koiare umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegado dukeje inogwagemodukare nowu bope uwari ukeji pugeje. Imearudu kurire ji dukodi. Imodukare ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegado rugadu.
source: Inogwagemode bope uwari ukeji. Mare awu iro koiare umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegado dukeje inogwagemodukare nowu bope uwari ukeji pugeje. Imearudu kurire ji dukodi. Imodukare ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegado rugadu.

b: Ainore Uture Jesus Bataru Tabowu Rore
source: Ainore Uture Jesus Bataru Tabowu Rore

b: Iorudure Pagimijera Jesus ji rugadu. Ure ikinorudo iro pegarewu boe piji rugadu. Makore i ituwo tuwadaru tabo boe ewagai rugadu. Dukodire ire tawie nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji rore jiboe ji jamedu. Dukodire tamearutorure ji rugadu.
source: Iorudure Pagimijera Jesus ji rugadu. Ure ikinorudo iro pegarewu boe piji rugadu. Makore i ituwo tuwadaru tabo boe ewagai rugadu. Dukodire ire tawie nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji rore jiboe ji jamedu. Dukodire tamearutorure ji rugadu.

b: Iage emearutorukare i. Egore imagokaie Jesus o bakaru remawu ji. Mare taruduware. Tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire tamugu pemegare Pagimijera Jesus apo rugadu. Dukodire boe eruduware Jesus o bakaru remawu jire inagoino rugadu. Ia uture Jesus bataru tabowunure imi jamedu.
source: Iage emearutorukare i. Egore imagokaie Jesus o bakaru remawu ji. Mare taruduware. Tamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire tamugu pemegare Pagimijera Jesus apo rugadu. Dukodire boe eruduware Jesus o bakaru remawu jire inagoino rugadu. Ia uture Jesus bataru tabowunure imi jamedu.

b: Boe emago pegamode iroji dukeje imagomode ewadaru jipagi.
source: Boe emago pegamode iroji dukeje imagomode ewadaru jipagi.

b: Iwo boe ewie Jesus o bakaruji imaragodaere tu nowu rugadu. Dukodire ure turugadu rugadu boe ekerogu makuduwo inai imaragodae morice, iworo kuru makuduwo inai imaragodae morice.
source: Iwo boe ewie Jesus o bakaruji imaragodaere tu nowu rugadu. Dukodire ure turugadu rugadu boe ekerogu makuduwo inai imaragodae morice, iworo kuru makuduwo inai imaragodae morice.

b: Itaidumode imuguwo mearutorure Jesus jiwu aredu apo utuwo itabo jamedu du pegakare. Ainore Pedro rore rugadu. Ainore Pagimijera Jesus uwiemage erore jamedu. Ainore ia uture Jesus bataru tabowuge erore jamedu.
source: Itaidumode imuguwo mearutorure Jesus jiwu aredu apo utuwo itabo jamedu du pegakare. Ainore Pedro rore rugadu. Ainore Pagimijera Jesus uwiemage erore jamedu. Ainore ia uture Jesus bataru tabowuge erore jamedu.

b: Ure turugadu cedaidure jiboe jamedu boe makuduwo cenai cemaragodae morice. Mare toro ia boebo imi imedia Barnabé cere ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare ekare tuge maku cenai, tugudure ceboe maku cenai jamedu. Mare cenogwamagudu karegure ei. Dukodire cemaragodure ia cemaragodaeji diero bagai cewo akirodo cege roguji, cegudure ceboe ji jamedu.
source: Ure turugadu cedaidure jiboe jamedu boe makuduwo cenai cemaragodae morice. Mare toro ia boebo imi imedia Barnabé cere ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare ekare tuge maku cenai, tugudure ceboe maku cenai jamedu. Mare cenogwamagudu karegure ei. Dukodire cemaragodure ia cemaragodaeji diero bagai cewo akirodo cege roguji, cegudure ceboe ji jamedu.

b: Mare iwo tawie. Boe eke makudumode tugobaigarege etai. Emodukare akirodo ji. Maragodure boepa jiwu umode ture tuguboe kowuje. Umodukare akirodo ji. Jeture tapira doge eiwuge ekudumode emoguru kuruce rugadu. Emodukare akirodo ji.
source: Mare iwo tawie. Boe eke makudumode tugobaigarege etai. Emodukare akirodo ji. Maragodure boepa jiwu umode ture tuguboe kowuje. Umodukare akirodo ji. Jeture tapira doge eiwuge ekudumode emoguru kuruce rugadu. Emodukare akirodo ji.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai ure turugadu boe eke makuduwo inai jamedu imaragodae morice. Mare iwo tawie. Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru akore nono nowu imagore jiboe mogadure jamedu.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai ure turugadu boe eke makuduwo inai jamedu imaragodae morice. Mare iwo tawie. Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru akore nono nowu imagore jiboe mogadure jamedu.

b: Moisés ure nowu bakaru bu bapera keje. Akore boe emode tapira merudo trigo aoji uwo nowu trigo a rawuje nowu cenari piji dukeje tagaba nowu tapira okwa miwuje okwagewo tumaragodutabo jamedu. Ure tuwuredo nowu trigo keje tagai kodi. Tapira jire Pao Kurirewu akoino.
source: Moisés ure nowu bakaru bu bapera keje. Akore boe emode tapira merudo trigo aoji uwo nowu trigo a rawuje nowu cenari piji dukeje tagaba nowu tapira okwa miwuje okwagewo tumaragodutabo jamedu. Ure tuwuredo nowu trigo keje tagai kodi. Tapira jire Pao Kurirewu akoino.

b: Mare ceire akoino jamedu. Maragodure boepa jiwu maragodumode to boepaji tuge bagai. Nou boepa tadaboe makudumode nowu maragodure nowu boepa jiwu ai. Nou boepa tadaboe makudumode nowu ure kadowu ai jamedu. Boepa ji karega cemaragodure. Jesus o bakaru jire cemaragodure cewo boe ewie ji rugadu. Dukodire cemaragodure jiboe moridoduwo cenai jamedu. Dujire akoino.
source: Mare ceire akoino jamedu. Maragodure boepa jiwu maragodumode to boepaji tuge bagai. Nou boepa tadaboe makudumode nowu maragodure nowu boepa jiwu ai. Nou boepa tadaboe makudumode nowu ure kadowu ai jamedu. Boepa ji karega cemaragodure. Jesus o bakaru jire cemaragodure cewo boe ewie ji rugadu. Dukodire cemaragodure jiboe moridoduwo cenai jamedu. Dujire akoino.

b: Cere tawie Jesus jiboe ji. Dukodire pemegare rugadu tawo ia tagoe maku cenai cemaragodae morice.
source: Cere tawie Jesus jiboe ji. Dukodire pemegare rugadu tawo ia tagoe maku cenai cemaragodae morice.

b: Tare ia tagoe maku ia boe etai. Cemaragodae pemegare nowu iage emaragodae kori dukodire pemegare rugadu tawo ia tagoe maku cenai jamedu. Mare cegi cenogwamagudukare tai iaboe bagai. Cere ceragado cei. Cedaidukare cewo boe pegado tai. Tamearutoruwo tu nowu Jesus jiwu bakaru remawu ji kodire cere ceragado cei rugadu.

Cere ceragado cei. Cedaidukare cewo boe pegado tai. Tamearutoruwo tu nowu Jesus jiwu bakaru remawu ji kodire cere ceragado cei rugadu.

b: Maragodure Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawuge emode tugeragu tugeji nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada rugadu. Taruduware nowu inoduji. Nou ure boe enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge emode tugeragu ia nowu makudure Pao Kurirewu aiwu tapira koduji tugece. Taruduware nowu inoduji.

b: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure pawie jamedu boe ewo iaboe maku makore Jesus jiwu bataru pemegarewu jiwuge etai. Emagomode Jesus jiwu bataru pemegarewuji. Emaragodae reno. Dukodire iaboe makuduwo etai emaragodae morice.
source: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure pawie jamedu boe ewo iaboe maku makore Jesus jiwu bataru pemegarewu jiwuge etai. Emagomode Jesus jiwu bataru pemegarewuji. Emaragodae reno. Dukodire iaboe makuduwo etai emaragodae morice.

b: Imire imagokare iaboe bagai. Ire awu atugoreboe pemegado mare tawo iaboe maku inai dubagai karega. Imagomodukare iaboe bagai rugadu. Inojaromodukare iwadaru ji. Imagomode Jesus jiboe ji tu je boe emearutoruwo tu ji rugadu. Jesus emare makore i ituwo tuwadaru pemegarewu tabo boe ewagai. Dukodire iture tabo rugadu. Imagomodukare Jesus jiwu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewiagai dukeje boe pegamode i rugadu! Dukodire imagore Jesus jiwu bataru pemegarewu ji tu rugadu. Iwadaru jire inojaromodukare. Dukodire inogwamagudumodukare iaboe bagai imaragodae morice. Iwimode mare inogwamagudumodukare iaboe bagai imaragodae morice rugadu.
