p: Depois pegou um outro cordel de cabelos e enrolou-o no seu braço. Pegou o seu arco com flechas de ponta dura, pôs na ponta do seu arco o enfeite de penas e saiu.

b: Kodo jii kago kae. Aiwore tododai: Raru, bai, ipo, i, kujagunure, nowu kago padurewo keje.\nAkore Kaboba? Inoba ureboeba? Kakodiboeba?

p: Dirigiu-se para o lugar onde estava a armadilha para pegar peixe. Observando na sua frente viu que no lugar da armadilha tudo estava vermelho: as folhas das árvores e palmeiras, os paus e ás árvores, tudo!\nE perguntou: - O que é isso? Que fenômeno é esse? Que classe de coisa é isso?

p: Jakômea é como um peixe. Parece um peixe. Mas os pés dele não são como os de peixe. O rabo dele é com rabo de arara vermelha. Ele é todo vermelho e a cauda é também vermelha. No meio é pintado, tem pintas amarelas através do vermelho. A cabeça é como cabeça de peixe. As asas são como asas de peixe. As asas do ventre são como as de peixe. A boca parece com a de peixe. Os olhos são como os de peixe. Mas os Bororos não o comem porque é um espírito.

Pobore taiado. Pobo ruture baruto.
Icare ure tuie to paci! Aroe Po otodai. Rekodure, rekodure ‘m!… Je pado bororo okwa kae ta!
Akore A! Tarego .. Aroe Pó kodo mato!...
Kodure tuwai kae. Ure tugeragu apidorogodu uru ji. Ure tuiebu tabo taci!, tuwai piji, icai turegodui Toduiori ao kae kodi.

(Logo que Meriri Poro flechou Jakômea) O rio se agitou e a água começou a subir.
Aí (Meriri Poro) correu fugindo da água. Correu, correu, e, chegando na beira da aldeia, foi gritando: Ah! Corram! A inundação está chegando!
Correu para sua casa, pegou um tição aceso de pecíolo seco de buriti e saiu da casa com ele, correndo para cima do morro Toduiori.
Jerigi Otojiwu saiu de sua casa levando o pariko de borda enfeitada de penugem branca e correu atrás de seu primo Meriri Poro até que chegaram na ponta do Toduiori.

b: Ere cewu apidorogodu urugo to, ere jeriji barigu uruto.Icare ere tori barigu ao kae. Icare nowu urugodure. Nowu urgoduredu icare ere barigu poboto tuibagi. Jore poboto co, co, co! A! Dukeje icare nowu pobore tuwuredo. Po rore tuibagi gr, gr, gr, gr!

p: Eles avivaram a chama do tição de pecíolo seco de buriti, e juntaram lenha nele. Depois jogaram por cima pedras que ficaram incandescentes. Depois foram jogando estas pedras incandescentes no rumo da água. As pedras bateram na água cho cho cho!\nAh! Então a água parou de subir e foi retrocedendo gr gr gr!

b: Dukeje icare ere turawuje puapo, pó rekodaji. Ekodo jii.. moto kae. Etaregodure puapo moto kae tu. Ere tuiemaedo tu...Egore Wo!... Boe emagarabora woe! Boe ekurirabora woe! Du kode boe makodure ino boe ewogai.

b:
Bakaru reo. Bakaru remawu reo. Awure iere Bakaru. Awu kejere boe ewiabuture mariguduwu tuwobe ewugeje, mariguduwu tuomage ewugeje, mariguduwu tujemage ewugeje. Boe ewiabuture Pemo keje. Boe ewiabuture Braedugume bukeje. Dukeje boe etoragudure. Boe enogudure tu… toro tuwobe ewogai, Pemo bogai, Braedugume bogai.
Eigoiare ere Boe ewodudo kodi. Eigoiare ere boe ewadarudo kodi. Ere Boe emearudae towuje. Ere Boe etowuje. Ere Boe ekeru towuje. Ere Boe enogwa towuje. Ere Boe eeku towuje.
Ere Boe enogituwado pui boe pemegareu tabo ma, Boe eiamedu rutuwo baruto, boe eeda pemegareu kae. Mearutorukareuge eture toro, eroiwakare tuwo tugirimi. Eture toro rugadu, epegare kodi.
Duwu Bakaru reo. Icare pamagomode oino ji, Pemo koia, Braedugume koia. Okudure pagabo kodi. Oino.

p: Esta aqui é uma história (bakaru = história, lenda, mito, mistério). Esta aqui é uma história importante. É isto que se chama mistério. É aqui que os Bororos se lembram de seus antepassados, de seus antigos e mães. Eles se lembram de Pemo e de Braedugume. Aí eles choram enternecidos pelo seu povo, por Pemo, por Braedugume, porque foram eles que fizeram nascer os Bororo. Foram eles que fizeram os Bororo falar, foram eles que fizeram o pensamento dos Bororo. Eles criaram os Bororo, eles criaram a boca dos Bororo, eles criaram os olhos dos Bororo. Eles fizeram com que os Bororo se aconselhassem mutuamente com conselhos bons, para que todos pudessem ir para o céu, para o lugar bom. Os que não acreditam vão para o abismo e não podem voltar. Eles vão para lá mesmo, porque são ruins.\nEsta é a história. Agora nós vamos contá-la, por obra de Pemo, por obra de Braedugume. Porque ele é bondoso conosco. É assim.

p:
Então! Meriri Poro foi atrás da corça. Queria vê-la. Andou bastante até que chegou a onde ela estava.
Chegando a onde ela estava, disse: - Sim! Eis! Ela esta aí!
Estava deitada ao pé de uma palmeira acumã.
Foi no rumo dela e, quando ela o viu, levantou-se e fugiu.
Meriri Poro ficou observando-a, depois correu atrás dela até chegar perto. Aproximou-se dela devagar, mas quando ela o viu, fugiu de novo.
Foi atrás dela de novo até encontrá-la. Estava de novo deitada ao pé de um pé de acumã.
Aproximou-se novamente dela, mas quando o viu, fugiu novamente.

Aí ele começou a fazer a sua casa, até terminá-la.
Quando foi de noite preparou sua cama. Estedeu nela folhas de palmeira indaiá e por cima colocou folhas secas.
Depois disse: - Já arrumei a nossa cama.
Aí os dois se conheceram e trabalharam juntos durante toda a noite. Com isso a corça ficou grávida. Então ela a engravidou.

Então ele colocou uma madeira através do rio para nós.
Na beirada de lá ele fez a água correr para lá, na beirada de cá ele fez a água correr para cá. Aí ele nos fez navegar na madeira no meio do rio. Vocês (brancos) estavam colocados atrás de nós (Bororo). Aí a madeira se quebrou.
Então água empurrou para lá o pedaço que ficou para trás, enquanto o outro pedaço foi empurrado conosco para a beirada de cá.
Por isso nos saímos para cá.
Olhem bem! Era para nós ficarmos aqui longe de vocês e para vocês ficarem lá, para andarem lá.
Isso é de vocês. Essa é sua terra. Lá vocês podem dizer: - Esta é nossa terra.
Esta, porém, é terra nossa. Eis, vai assim, vai assim, vai assim (indicando o horizonte ao redor)

p:
Esta é a nossa terra, por isso nos viemos para cá, assim para cá.
Aqui, porém, em tempos antigos, fomos prejudicados pela água. Foi a água que nos prejudicou.
Quem fez isso conosco foi Meriri Poro. Foi ele que nos prejudicou. Ele flechou os espíritos Jakomeadoge na armadilha de pegar peixe.
Então o os espíritos fizeram a água aumentar.
Então Meriri Paro correwu na frente das águas, para cá, atravessando o Córrego Kujibo (Coxipó) para cá.
Ele falava (para as águas): Parem! Parem!
Depois ele correwu mais forte e falou para cá (para os Bororo): Corram que a água está vindo no nosso rumo.
A mulher dele saiu com o seu filho.
Ele olhou e viu a arara de seu filho que estava aí encima.
Ele chegou e disse: Eu falei que é para vocês correrem!
Logo foi e alargou um pau (para pegar a arara).
A água estava chegando atrás, cresceu por todo lado e matou todo mundo.
Ela cobriu todo mundo.
(Meriri Poro) dizia à sua mulher: - Corra, corra, corra!
Depois lhe disse: - Dê-me o seu filho para você ficar mais leve. Aí ele pegou seu filho e o jogou no ombro.
Dizia: Corra! Corra! Corra! Corra! Corra! Corra!
Aí viu que a água estava se aproximando dele.
Por isso passou na frete de sua mulher, marcando o lugar onde tinha passado para frente dela. Correwu para cima de um morro e falou para ele:.
- Meu padrinho, cresça comigo! Meu padrinho, cresça comigo! Meu padrinho Morro do gavião Torowa, cresça comigo!
Ele cresceu, cresceu, cresceu e depois parou de crescer.
A água ia subindo, subindo, subindo, estava se aproximando dele.
De novo disse: meu padrinho, cresça comigo; meu padrinho, cresça comigo; meu padrinho, cresça comigo!
O morro foi crescendo com ele até que parou de novo.
A água estava chegando nele novamente.

source: Ana kuiarure Icare boe aregodure pudae dukeje, kuri buture ia tonaregedu imedu rogu apo. Dure ure iedo Samuel, dure oino inogwamagudure Pao ji bogai.

b: Nowu du kodi, Ana, tui tonaregedu Samuel okwagiri kado dukeje, ure ko pudabo, ure tugeragu ia tapira kodure maiwu o jorure pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, ia trigo meta korobadureuji, ia pori korobadui parera kuru tabo duji, ure reko Silo kejewu Pao uwai kae.
source: Nowu du kodi, Ana, tui tonaregedu Samuel okwagiri kado dukeje, ure ko pudabo, ure tugeragu ia tapira kodure maiwu o jorure pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, ia trigo meta korobadureuji, ia pori korobadui parera kuru tabo duji, ure reko Silo kejewu Pao uwai kae.

b: Negedurogu kodure mai kimo.
source: Negedurogu kodure mai kimo.

b: Ere nowu tapira maku Pao ai, ere nowu negedurogu maku Pao burejoia Heli ai.
source: Ere nowu tapira maku Pao ai, ere nowu negedurogu maku Pao burejoia Heli ai.

b: Ana akore oino Ikimejera, awiapagado inagoi aiduji: cewu rakojere woe togwamagudui Pao jiwu aredu nure ime.
source: Ana akore oino Ikimejera, awiapagado inagoi aiduji: cewu rakojere woe togwamagudui Pao jiwu aredu nure ime.

b: Cewu inogwamagudure bogaiwu negedu rogu reo Pao biapagare inagoi pudui duji.
source: Cewu inogwamagudure bogaiwu negedu rogu reo Pao biapagare inagoi pudui duji.

b: Icare imode awu negedurogu maku Pao ai, rakoje tonaji, Pao jeonawo ji.
source: Icare imode awu negedurogu maku Pao ai, rakoje tonaji, Pao jeonawo ji.

b: Icare ere tubujodo Pao ji.
source: Icare ere tubujodo Pao ji.

b: Nowu du kodi iparedu Samuel maragodure Pao ai, Heli jetui jitu tabo.
source: Nowu du kodi iparedu Samuel maragodure Pao ai, Heli jetui jitu tabo.

b: Tai jere Pao makore nowu kodi, tai jere boe enuiaore jamedu.
source: Tai jere Pao makore nowu kodi, tai jere boe enuiaore jamedu.

b: Ia meri keje Hali unudu nure tuwai tada (Jordu arudugodure boeji joku pegagodure kodi).
source: Ia meri keje Hali unudu nure tuwai tada (Jordu arudugodure boeji joku pegagodure kodi).

b: Pao urugu bitukare kimo. Samuel unudu nure Pao uwai tada, Pao o boe eroiagudu meture tadawu irá mugurewo keje.
source: Pao urugu bitukare kimo. Samuel unudu nure Pao uwai tada, Pao o boe eroiagudu meture tadawu irá mugurewo keje.

b: Du keje Icare Pao makore Samuel bogai Samuel, Samuel! Samuel akore imireo!
source: Du keje Icare Pao makore Samuel bogai Samuel, Samuel! Samuel akore imireo!

b: Du tabo rekodure kuri Heli bogai, akore ji imireo, amagore iwogai kodi.
source: Du tabo rekodure kuri Heli bogai, akore ji imireo, amagore iwogai kodi.

b: Mare akore imagokare awogai; toro! Anududo! Samuelre tuwu pugeje.
source: Mare akore imagokare awogai; toro! Anududo! Samuelre tuwu pugeje.

b: Pao makore bogai pugeje Samuel, Samuel!
source: Pao makore bogai pugeje Samuel, Samuel!

b: Samuelre turagojedo, rekodure Heli ae, akore ji imireo! Amagore iwogai!
source: Samuelre turagojedo, rekodure Heli ae, akore ji imireo! Amagore iwogai!

b: Mare akore imagokare awogai, itonaregedu. Anududo!
source: Mare akore imagokare awogai, itonaregedu. Anududo!

b: Samuelkare boe pa Pao ji roga, Pao bataru aregodukare bogai raga kodi.
source: Samuelkare boe pa Pao ji roga, Pao bataru aregodukare bogai raga kodi.

b: Pao makore Samuel bogai pobe ma jewu metuia bokware pugeje Samuel, Samuel!
source: Pao makore Samuel bogai pobe ma jewu metuia bokware pugeje Samuel, Samuel!

b: Ure turagojedo, rekodure Heli ae pugeje, akore imireo! Amagore iwogai!
source: Ure turagojedo, rekodure Heli ae pugeje, akore imireo! Amagore iwogai!

b: Icare Helire boe pa Pao akoino negedurogu bogai duji.
source: Icare Helire boe pa Pao akoino negedurogu bogai duji.

b: Icare akore oino Samuel ji toro! Anuduwo. Boe emagomode awogai pugeje ma, akagomode Ikimejera, amagodo! Atugare biapaga nure ai. Samuel uture tuba kae, ure tuwu.
source: Icare akore oino Samuel ji toro! Anuduwo. Boe emagomode awogai pugeje ma, akagomode Ikimejera, amagodo! Atugare biapaga nure ai. Samuel uture tuba kae, ure tuwu.

b: Du keje Icare Paore turemo, ure tuwuredo ji, makore bogai tago magai jao du reore Samuel, Samuel! Samuel akore Ikimejera, amagodo! Atugare biapaga nure ai!
source: Du keje Icare Paore turemo, ure tuwuredo ji, makore bogai tago magai jao du reore Samuel, Samuel! Samuel akore Ikimejera, amagodo! Atugare biapaga nure ai!

b: Samuel ricodure, Pao rakojere apo, bia rokare piki ia Pao bataruji.
source: Samuel ricodure, Pao rakojere apo, bia rokare piki ia Pao bataruji.

b: Du kodi Icare, Israeldoge eiamedu boe, Dan moto piji jii Bersabeia kejewuge ere boe pa Pao o profetaie ure Samuelce duji.
source: Du kodi Icare, Israeldoge eiamedu boe, Dan moto piji jii Bersabeia kejewuge ere boe pa Pao o profetaie ure Samuelce duji.

b: Nowu du kodi, filisteudoge ere tudo pui turugoduwo; Israeldoge eture etogi, ere baado Eben-Ezer keje. Filisteudogere baado Afec keje, ere tudo turugadu Israeldoge etogi. Icare erugodure pui; filisteudoge ere tumorido Israeldogei; bitodurewu tugobaigarege ere 4...
source: Nowu du kodi, filisteudoge ere tudo pui turugoduwo; Israeldoge eture etogi, ere baado Eben-Ezer keje. Filisteudogere baado Afec keje, ere tudo turugadu Israeldoge etogi. Icare erugodure pui; filisteudoge ere tumorido Israeldogei; bitodurewu tugobaigarege ere 4...

b: Icare Israeldoge ere tudo pui pugeje, emagore codureugei kodiba Paore cekado cemorido filisteudogei? Paduwo Silo kae Pao o irá pemegarewu bogai; mugumode pagoiadoda ma, umode paginorudo onare paiwuge ekera piji.
source: Icare Israeldoge ere tudo pui pugeje, emagore codureugei kodiba Paore cekado cemorido filisteudogei? Paduwo Silo kae Pao o irá pemegarewu bogai; mugumode pagoiadoda ma, umode paginorudo onare paiwuge ekera piji.

b: Du kodire ere boedo Pao ro rakarewu mugui tupadoge ewugejewu o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá arego Silo piji. Eli ore Ofni, Finéias, etaregodure tabo.
source: Du kodire ere boedo Pao ro rakarewu mugui tupadoge ewugejewu o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá arego Silo piji. Eli ore Ofni, Finéias, etaregodure tabo.

b: Icare Pao o irá pemegarewu aregodui ere baadodu kae dukeje, Israeldoge eiamedu boe enoiogwarire tuiegare rakaguraga tabo. Nowu egoinodu ure moto amagadudo.
source: Icare Pao o irá pemegarewu aregodui ere baadodu kae dukeje, Israeldoge eiamedu boe enoiogwarire tuiegare rakaguraga tabo. Nowu egoinodu ure moto amagadudo.

b: Filisteudoge, tumearudui egoinodu jitu keje, enoragodure inoba boere kodiba ere toiogwari rakaguragado hebreudogere baadowo keje? Icare emearudure Pao o irá pemegarewu aregodui Israeldoge ere baadowo kae duji.
source: Filisteudoge, tumearudui egoinodu jitu keje, enoragodure inoba boere kodiba ere toiogwari rakaguragado hebreudogere baadowo keje? Icare emearudure Pao o irá pemegarewu aregodui Israeldoge ere baadowo kae duji.

b: Filisteudoge epagudugodure, egore oino Pao Aroe Eimejera aregodure ere baadowo kae. Egore toragudu tabo.
source: Filisteudoge epagudugodure, egore oino Pao Aroe Eimejera aregodure ere baadowo kae. Egore toragudu tabo.

b: Inoba boemode pai? Boekare oino pai jii oino? Inoba boemode pai? Ioguduba umode paginorudo nowu Aroe Eimejerage ro rakareuge ekera piji? Nowu Aroe Eimejerage ere Egito korido boe pega jamedu boe tabo.
source: Inoba boemode pai? Boekare oino pai jii oino? Inoba boemode pai? Ioguduba umode paginorudo nowu Aroe Eimejerage ro rakareuge ekera piji? Nowu Aroe Eimejerage ere Egito korido boe pega jamedu boe tabo.

b: Mare, filisteudoge, tadugu tado! Tabagudu kaba, hebreudoge erorerukawo tai, taro magai ei jao du reore. Tadurudo, tarugodudo!
source: Mare, filisteudoge, tadugu tado! Tabagudu kaba, hebreudoge erorerukawo tai, taro magai ei jao du reore. Tadurudo, tarugodudo!

b: Boe jokodu, filisteudoge erugodure, Icare Israeldoge ekare tumorido, eregodure tu tu tuwai aroia bai kae. Ewi makaguragare. Birewu Israeldoge ere 3...
source: Boe jokodu, filisteudoge erugodure, Icare Israeldoge ekare tumorido, eregodure tu tu tuwai aroia bai kae. Ewi makaguragare. Birewu Israeldoge ere 3...

b: Filisteudoge ere tugeragu Pao o irá pemegareuji. Eli ore ei pobedu, Ofni, Finéias, ewire jamedu.
source: Filisteudoge ere tugeragu Pao o irá pemegareuji. Eli ore ei pobedu, Ofni, Finéias, ewire jamedu.

b: Nowu kodi, Israeldoge codureuge eiamedu boe ere tudo pui, eture Samuel ae Rama keje, egore oino ji icare apegagodure, akore ekodukare aro rekodaji. Du kodi Icare ia cegimejerado, jetuwo cei, boe eimejeragei moto kejedu reore.
source: Nowu kodi, Israeldoge codureuge eiamedu boe ere tudo pui, eture Samuel ae Rama keje, egore oino ji icare apegagodure, akore ekodukare aro rekodaji. Du kodi Icare ia cegimejerado, jetuwo cei, boe eimejeragei moto kejedu reore.

b: Nowu egoinodu jetu pemegakare Samuel ji, egore ia boe eimejera maku cenai, jetuwo cei, oino du kodi.
source: Nowu egoinodu jetu pemegakare Samuel ji, egore ia boe eimejera maku cenai, jetuwo cei, oino du kodi.

b: Mare Pao akore oino Samuel ji awiapagado awu boe egoi aidu jamedu boeji; paga karega, ai karega etaidukare, mare imi, ietu kawo pudui.
source: Mare Pao akore oino Samuel ji awiapagado awu boe egoi aidu jamedu boeji; paga karega, ai karega etaidukare, mare imi, ietu kawo pudui.

b: Icare Samuel makore Pao makore jiboe jamedu boeji boe ewiegai, tagoi oino dutabo:
source: Icare Samuel makore Pao makore jiboe jamedu boeji boe ewiegai, tagoi oino dutabo:

b: Oinore jetumode aiwu tagimejera romode umode tugeragu tagorei, umode emaragodudo to imaridodoge ebo, tagu kowarudoge ebo, umode edo tumugudo to imarido keje.
source: Oinore jetumode aiwu tagimejera romode umode tugeragu tagorei, umode emaragodudo to imaridodoge ebo, tagu kowarudoge ebo, umode edo tumugudo to imarido keje.

b: Umode imei mil cedu eimejerado emage, umode emaragodudo to boepa boeji, umode edo tugeragu to boepa tadaboeji, umode edo turugodumode tabowu baiga, toriga rairewu, imarido boe, meriri otorewu boe, boere onado puduiwu meriri boe, towuje.
source: Umode imei mil cedu eimejerado emage, umode emaragodudo to boepa boeji, umode edo tugeragu to boepa tadaboeji, umode edo turugodumode tabowu baiga, toriga rairewu, imarido boe, meriri otorewu boe, boere onado puduiwu meriri boe, towuje.

b: Makomode tagore areme ewogai ewo tuge boe, tuge amirewu boe towuje.
source: Makomode tagore areme ewogai ewo tuge boe, tuge amirewu boe towuje.

b: Umode tugeragu tago boepa tadaboe pemegarewu jamedu boeji, tago parera iguruji, tago oliveira iguruji tuwo maku tudugarege etai.
source: Umode tugeragu tago boepa tadaboe pemegarewu jamedu boeji, tago parera iguruji, tago oliveira iguruji tuwo maku tudugarege etai.

b: Umode tugeragu tadugarege imei, tadugarege aremei, tagagu tapiradoge pemegareugei, tagagu burudoge pemegareugei, emaragoduwo pudai.
source: Umode tugeragu tadugarege imei, tadugarege aremei, tagagu tapiradoge pemegareugei, tagagu burudoge pemegareugei, emaragoduwo pudai.

b: Umode tugeragu tagaguiee boe puiato pudai; tagirema roreraemode tagi jamedu.
source: Umode tugeragu tagaguiee boe puiato pudai; tagirema roreraemode tagi jamedu.

b: Du keje Icare tagoiogwarimode tare tageragu jiwu tagimejera koia, mare Pao biapaga modukare tawadaru ji.
source: Du keje Icare tagoiogwarimode tare tageragu jiwu tagimejera koia, mare Pao biapaga modukare tawadaru ji.

b: Mare boe etaidukare tuwiapagawo Samuel bataruji, egore oino boro! Ia pagimejera rumode, jetuwo pai, boe magai moto kejewu boe eiamedu boe ereore; ia boe eimejera jetuwo pai, koduwo pagododai, rugoduwo parugodu keje.
source: Mare boe etaidukare tuwiapagawo Samuel bataruji, egore oino boro! Ia pagimejera rumode, jetuwo pai, boe magai moto kejewu boe eiamedu boe ereore; ia boe eimejera jetuwo pai, koduwo pagododai, rugoduwo parugodu keje.

b: Samuel mearudure boe emagore jiboe jamedu boeji, ure Pao bie egoino duji.
source: Samuel mearudure boe emagore jiboe jamedu boeji, ure Pao bie egoino duji.

b: Icare Pao akore oino ji awiapagado egoino duji. Ia boe eimejerado etai.
source: Icare Pao akore oino ji awiapagado egoino duji. Ia boe eimejerado etai.

b: Benjamim Uwoe ia imedure, iere Quis, Abiel onaregedu, Seror onaregedu, Bekora onaregedu, Afia, Benjamim uwobe, onaregedu; imedu pagudu bokwarewu nure ema.
source: Benjamim Uwoe ia imedure, iere Quis, Abiel onaregedu, Seror onaregedu, Bekora onaregedu, Afia, Benjamim uwobe, onaregedu; imedu pagudu bokwarewu nure ema.

b: Ia onaregedu iere Saul: kodure maiwu, moturewu nure ema. Israeldoge etadawu ia ime emodu kodukare motu kori; kanaora piji, rico kodure tumedage eiamedu rico kori.
source: Ia onaregedu iere Saul: kodure maiwu, moturewu nure ema. Israeldoge etadawu ia ime emodu kodukare motu kori; kanaora piji, rico kodure tumedage eiamedu rico kori.

b: Ia meri keje Quis, Saul uo, aku burudoge ewogware boeto. Du kodi Icare Quis akore oino tonaregeduji ia itugare ko akabo, aemarudo inagu burudoge ewogai.
source: Ia meri keje Quis, Saul uo, aku burudoge ewogware boeto. Du kodi Icare Quis akore oino tonaregeduji ia itugare ko akabo, aemarudo inagu burudoge ewogai.

b: Eemarure ewogai Efraim o torekari kao, Salisa o moto kao, tuiordukai ei dutabo; eemarure ewogai Salim o moto keje, eedukare nono jamedu; ekodure Benjamim o moto kori, mare eerdukare ei.
source: Eemarure ewogai Efraim o torekari kao, Salisa o moto kao, tuiordukai ei dutabo; eemarure ewogai Salim o moto keje, eedukare nono jamedu; ekodure Benjamim o moto kori, mare eerdukare ei.

b: Samuel jordui Saul jitu keje, Pao akore oino ji cewu inagoino jiwu imedu reo; emare jetumode iwobei.
source: Samuel jordui Saul jitu keje, Pao akore oino ji cewu inagoino jiwu imedu reo; emare jetumode iwobei.

b: Saulre tuburedo Samuel ji, baiporo oiadoda, akore oino ji kaiba jordure Pao jiwu imedu mugure?
source: Saulre tuburedo Samuel ji, baiporo oiadoda, akore oino ji kaiba jordure Pao jiwu imedu mugure?

b: Icare Samuel akore oino Saul ji jordure Pao jiwu imedu imireo. Arududo itododai boe aorewu kae; akogwagemode itabo awuji, barogwato kuri je, ii aerduwado meture awabo tadaboe jamedu boe jitu rekodaji, imode atudo.
source: Icare Samuel akore oino Saul ji jordure Pao jiwu imedu imireo. Arududo itododai boe aorewu kae; akogwagemode itabo awuji, barogwato kuri je, ii aerduwado meture awabo tadaboe jamedu boe jitu rekodaji, imode atudo.

b: Barogwatore Icare Samuelre tugeragu ia boekaguru meture tadawu meriri kuruji, ure redo Saul aora joki, ure togwami ji, tagoi oino dutabo boe jokodu jire Paore tugeragu ai aetuwo tuwobe Israeldogei. Akire aetumode Pao uwobei, amode edo cinorudo onare oieiwuge epiji.
source: Barogwatore Icare Samuelre tugeragu ia boekaguru meture tadawu meriri kuruji, ure redo Saul aora joki, ure togwami ji, tagoi oino dutabo boe jokodu jire Paore tugeragu ai aetuwo tuwobe Israeldogei. Akire aetumode Pao uwobei, amode edo cinorudo onare oieiwuge epiji.

b: Nowu du kodi Samuel akore oino Saul ji awiapagado ii, imagowo ai Pao akore awu boecoji iiboeji. Saul akore ji amagodo!
source: Nowu du kodi Samuel akore oino Saul ji awiapagado ii, imagowo ai Pao akore awu boecoji iiboeji. Saul akore ji amagodo!

b: Samuel akore amearudaere awiega toriji; ia dukeje Israeldoge eimejera karega ure aki? Paore Israeldoge eimejerado aki, ure arojai, tagoi oino ai dutabo: 'Toro! Ro pegareuge eeda kedodo, amalecitadoge eeda kedodo, arugo ei ai eeda kedodo du kae'. Kode, kodiba amearutorukare Pao bataruji? Kodiba are Pao kiarire jiboe to, ai akeragu enoroe jitu tabo?
source: Samuel akore amearudaere awiega toriji; ia dukeje Israeldoge eimejera karega ure aki? Paore Israeldoge eimejerado aki, ure arojai, tagoi oino ai dutabo: 'Toro! Ro pegareuge eeda kedodo, amalecitadoge eeda kedodo, arugo ei ai eeda kedodo du kae'. Kode, kodiba amearutorukare Pao bataruji? Kodiba are Pao kiarire jiboe to, ai akeragu enoroe jitu tabo?

b: Saul akore oino Samuel ji boro! Imearutorure Pao bataruji; iture Paore irojai boe kae; ire Agag, Amalec kejewuge eimejera arego mato, ire amalecitadoge eeda kedodo. Boere tugeragu ovelhadogei, tapiradogei, awure pemegare pegadodumodeboe kori, ewo tomeado tabo ako Aroe Eimejera ai Gálgala keje.
source: Saul akore oino Samuel ji boro! Imearutorure Pao bataruji; iture Paore irojai boe kae; ire Agag, Amalec kejewuge eimejera arego mato, ire amalecitadoge eeda kedodo. Boere tugeragu ovelhadogei, tapiradogei, awure pemegare pegadodumodeboe kori, ewo tomeado tabo ako Aroe Eimejera ai Gálgala keje.

b: Samuel akore ia dukeje boe eno mea boe kodu kana boe emearutorui Pao bataru jitu kori? Akaiwodo! Boe emearutorui Pao bataru jitu kodure boe ji tomea maku ai du kori. Boe emearutorui Pao bataru jitu kodure carneirodoge eka kori.
source: Samuel akore ia dukeje boe eno mea boe kodu kana boe emearutorui Pao bataru jitu kori? Akaiwodo! Boe emearutorui Pao bataru jitu kodure boe ji tomea maku ai du kori. Boe emearutorui Pao bataru jitu kodure carneirodoge eka kori.

b: U! Boe emearutorui paga paga jitu boe ero pegarewu rema, du reorere boe enojaroi puduidu ure nono boe emearutoru magai Aroe Eimejerakare emawuge ei du reore. Awiapagakare Pao ui aroiaguduji, du kodire biapaga modukare ai jamedu; umode boe eimejerai akidu tawuje apiji.
source: U! Boe emearutorui paga paga jitu boe ero pegarewu rema, du reorere boe enojaroi puduidu ure nono boe emearutoru magai Aroe Eimejerakare emawuge ei du reore. Awiapagakare Pao ui aroiaguduji, du kodire biapaga modukare ai jamedu; umode boe eimejerai akidu tawuje apiji.

b: Nowu du kodi, Pao akore oino Samuel ji jii inoba boere du kejeba akoragudu akedumode Saul jiboe kodi, itaidukai jetuwo Israeldogei pugeje dutabo?
source: Nowu du kodi, Pao akore oino Samuel ji jii inoba boere du kejeba akoragudu akedumode Saul jiboe kodi, itaidukai jetuwo Israeldogei pugeje dutabo?

b: Ia tapira kiga korobadudo boekaguru tabo, imode atudo Jessé bogai, Belém kae, ire ia boe eimejera tawuje ore epiji kodi.
source: Ia tapira kiga korobadudo boekaguru tabo, imode atudo Jessé bogai, Belém kae, ire ia boe eimejera tawuje ore epiji kodi.

b: Samuel akore inoba iromode ituwo toro? Saul jorduwamode ma, umode iwido!
source: Samuel akore inoba iromode ituwo toro? Saul jorduwamode ma, umode iwido!

b: Pao akore oino ji amode akeragu ia tapira aredu kodui maiwudoji, akagomode: 'Itaregodure iwo ino mea maku Pao ai'. Amagomode Isaiji koduwo akabo akomea kae; imode aerduwado inoba aromode duji, amode boekaguru reko imode aerdudo jiwu joki inai.
source: Pao akore oino ji amode akeragu ia tapira aredu kodui maiwudoji, akagomode: 'Itaregodure iwo ino mea maku Pao ai'. Amagomode Isaiji koduwo akabo akomea kae; imode aerduwado inoba aromode duji, amode boekaguru reko imode aerdudo jiwu joki inai.

b: Samuel rore nono Pao akoi puduidu reore, uture Belém kae.
source: Samuel rore nono Pao akoi puduidu reore, uture Belém kae.

b: Nowu bakurirewu kejewu codureuge eture ake tabo togi, egore oino ji pemega kodina akaregodure woe?
source: Nowu bakurirewu kejewu codureuge eture ake tabo togi, egore oino ji pemega kodina akaregodure woe?

b: Akore oino ei u! Itaregodure iwo inomeado Pao ai; tabemegado! Mato itabo ino mea kae. Ure Jessedo tubemegado torebo, makore ei etuwo to mea kae.
source: Akore oino ei u! Itaregodure iwo inomeado Pao ai; tabemegado! Mato itabo ino mea kae. Ure Jessedo tubemegado torebo, makore ei etuwo to mea kae.

b: Etaregodui jokorai dukeje, tuiordui Eliab jitu keje, mearudaere oino: 'Awu ji kana Paore tugeragu pudai? '
source: Etaregodui jokorai dukeje, tuiordui Eliab jitu keje, mearudaere oino: 'Awu ji kana Paore tugeragu pudai? '

b: Mare Pao akore oino Samuel ji awiapaga kaba ureuji, ricoji, ire pijido. Aroe Eimejera aiwokare boe ji boe etaiwo magai pui du reore; boe etaiwore pu ureuji, mare Aroe Eimejera aiwore ime etuwaboji.
source: Mare Pao akore oino Samuel ji awiapaga kaba ureuji, ricoji, ire pijido. Aroe Eimejera aiwokare boe ji boe etaiwo magai pui du reore; boe etaiwore pu ureuji, mare Aroe Eimejera aiwore ime etuwaboji.

b: Du kodi Icare Jessé makore Abinadab bogai, ure ko Samuel jokorai, dure akore awu jamedu Pao ukare tugeragu ji pudai.
source: Du kodi Icare Jessé makore Abinadab bogai, ure ko Samuel jokorai, dure akore awu jamedu Pao ukare tugeragu ji pudai.

b: Jessere Sama ko jokorai jamedu, mare Samuel akore awu jamedu, Pao ukare tugeragu ji pudai jamedu.
source: Jessere Sama ko jokorai jamedu, mare Samuel akore awu jamedu, Pao ukare tugeragu ji pudai jamedu.

b: Du kodi Icare Jessere torei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu ekodudo Samuel jokorai. Mare Samuel akore oino pudui awuge karega Paore tugeragu ei pudai.
source: Du kodi Icare Jessere torei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu ekodudo Samuel jokorai. Mare Samuel akore oino pudui awuge karega Paore tugeragu ei pudai.

b: Du rekodaji unoragodure Jesseji akore eiamedu boe na eedure woe?
source: Du rekodaji unoragodure Jesseji akore eiamedu boe na eedure woe?

b: Akore oino kodure maiwure okwa kimore, jetu nure barege kugurei, Samuel akore oino ji iaboe erego bogai; pamodukare pamugudo irá keje pagogwagewo, aregodu otodai.
source: Akore oino kodure maiwure okwa kimore, jetu nure barege kugurei, Samuel akore oino ji iaboe erego bogai; pamodukare pamugudo irá keje pagogwagewo, aregodu otodai.

b: Du kodi Icare Jessere iaboe erego bogai.
source: Du kodi Icare Jessere iaboe erego bogai.

b: Ao ekure, joku moture, urewu jamedu moture.
source: Ao ekure, joku moture, urewu jamedu moture.

b: Pao akore oino Samuel ji aragojedo, boekaguru redo ao joki. Ema reno!
source: Pao akore oino Samuel ji aragojedo, boekaguru redo ao joki. Ema reno!

b: Samuelre tugeragu boekaguru metui tapira kiga tada duji, ure boekaguru redo ao joki, umanamage eegai. Nowu meri piji, Pao Utaroere turawuje Davi keje. Icare Samuelre turagojedo, ure tugirimi Rama kae.
source: Samuelre tugeragu boekaguru metui tapira kiga tada duji, ure boekaguru redo ao joki, umanamage eegai. Nowu meri piji, Pao Utaroere turawuje Davi keje. Icare Samuelre turagojedo, ure tugirimi Rama kae.

b: Nowu kodi Davi rekodudodure Saul ae, akore oino ji Ikimejera uwabo kugudugodu kawo filisteu koia. Atugare rugodumode ji.
source: Nowu kodi Davi rekodudodure Saul ae, akore oino ji Ikimejera uwabo kugudugodu kawo filisteu koia. Atugare rugodumode ji.

b: Saul akore oino Davi ji akare arugadu arugoduwo nowu filisteuji, iparedu rogu nure aki, emarema, tugodui maidu tabore rugodure jii oino.
source: Saul akore oino Davi ji akare arugadu arugoduwo nowu filisteuji, iparedu rogu nure aki, emarema, tugodui maidu tabore rugodure jii oino.

b: Icare Davi akore oino Saul ji Pao ure ido ikinorudo adugo agareuge, barogo bu kurireuge, ekinogi piji, du umode ido ikinorudo awu filisteu iera piji jamedu. Du kodi Icare Saul akore oino Davi ji toro! Pao rakojemode akabo!
source: Icare Davi akore oino Saul ji Pao ure ido ikinorudo adugo agareuge, barogo bu kurireuge, ekinogi piji, du umode ido ikinorudo awu filisteu iera piji jamedu. Du kodi Icare Saul akore oino Davi ji toro! Pao rakojemode akabo!

b: Ure tugeragu tuiodoji, ure tugeragu pobore tada tori bariga kororogodureugei ikera awubodure, ure tugu to miciguto, Icare tugedui to aroia baibai jitu tabo, uture filisteu togi.
source: Ure tugeragu tuiodoji, ure tugeragu pobore tada tori bariga kororogodureugei ikera awubodure, ure tugu to miciguto, Icare tugedui to aroia baibai jitu tabo, uture filisteu togi.

b: Awu ure tuburedo gu gu Davi togi; jeture jiwu utugare kodure otodai.
source: Awu ure tuburedo gu gu Davi togi; jeture jiwu utugare kodure otodai.

b: Filisteu, tuiordui Davi jitu keje, ukare boedo ema, iparedu rogu kimore ema du kodi, ao ekure, urewu moture, kodi.
source: Filisteu, tuiordui Davi jitu keje, ukare boedo ema, iparedu rogu kimore ema du kodi, ao ekure, urewu moture, kodi.

b: Akore ji arigao nure imi kana atuwo itae akojodo tabo icare ure Davi jiwo pegado to aroe eimejerage ekie tabo.
source: Akore ji arigao nure imi kana atuwo itae akojodo tabo icare ure Davi jiwo pegado to aroe eimejerage ekie tabo.

b: Icare akore oino Davi ji mato itae, imode akodu maku baru tadawu kiege barege etai, boe kaowu barege etai.
source: Icare akore oino Davi ji mato itae, imode akodu maku baru tadawu kiege barege etai, boe kaowu barege etai.

b: Mare Davi akore oino ji ature itae atoriga rairewu tabo, ako meriri oto tabo, onare aiwu meriri aiarewu tabo; imirema karega, itumode atogi Pao ro rakarewu ie tabo, Israel o tugobaigarege eno Aroe Eimejera apagudukare cewu.
source: Mare Davi akore oino ji ature itae atoriga rairewu tabo, ako meriri oto tabo, onare aiwu meriri aiarewu tabo; imirema karega, itumode atogi Pao ro rakarewu ie tabo, Israel o tugobaigarege eno Aroe Eimejera apagudukare cewu.

b: Pao umode amagu ikera kai awu meriji, imode awududo, imode akidoru kado, imode atugarege ekodu maku baru tadawu kiege barege etai, boe tadawu barege etai. Moto jamedu kejeboe eerduwamode ia Aroe Eimejerai Israeldoge etada duji.
source: Pao umode amagu ikera kai awu meriji, imode awududo, imode akidoru kado, imode atugarege ekodu maku baru tadawu kiege barege etai, boe tadawu barege etai. Moto jamedu kejeboe eerduwamode ia Aroe Eimejerai Israeldoge etada duji.

b: Boe eiamedu boe eerduwamode Pao umodukae boedo tumorido tariga rairewu tabo, meriri oto tabo duji; paga karega Paore rugodumode, umode tamagu cegera kai.
source: Boe eiamedu boe eerduwamode Pao umodukae boedo tumorido tariga rairewu tabo, meriri oto tabo duji; paga karega Paore rugodumode, umode tamagu cegera kai.

b: Filisteu ui tuburedo Davi togi dukeje, awure tudawuje tumedage epiji, rekodure nowu filisteu togi, ure tugera tugu tumiciguto, ure ia tori tawuje, ure barigu to aroia baibai tabo, jeture filisteu jeriji. Torire turemo jerito, Icare nowu imedu kurirewu enojore tuwudu tabo.
source: Filisteu ui tuburedo Davi togi dukeje, awure tudawuje tumedage epiji, rekodure nowu filisteu togi, ure tugera tugu tumiciguto, ure ia tori tawuje, ure barigu to aroia baibai tabo, jeture filisteu jeriji. Torire turemo jerito, Icare nowu imedu kurirewu enojore tuwudu tabo.

b: Oinore Davire tumorido filisteuji to aroia baibai tabo, tori tabo, ure butudo, ure bito toriga bokwa tabo.
source: Oinore Davire tumorido filisteuji to aroia baibai tabo, tori tabo, ure butudo, ure bito toriga bokwa tabo.

b: Du keje Icare Davi rekodure jii padurewo kae, ure tuwarigu keje, ure tugeragu utoriga raireuji, ure tawuje tuia piji, ure itoru kado. Icare filisteudoge, tuiordui tugimejera butui tuwi tabo duji dukeje, eregodure.
source: Du keje Icare Davi rekodure jii padurewo kae, ure tuwarigu keje, ure tugeragu utoriga raireuji, ure tawuje tuia piji, ure itoru kado. Icare filisteudoge, tuiordui tugimejera butui tuwi tabo duji dukeje, eregodure.

b: Nowu du kodi, ei tugirimi Davii filisteu bito dupiji dukeje, Israeal kejewu bakurirewu jamedu boe kejewu areme ere tuiebu tureru tabo, turagodu tabo Saul jokorai, to ka boe tabo, meriri kiarewu tabo, tui boe eerdudo tuiegarae jitu tabo.
source: Nowu du kodi, ei tugirimi Davii filisteu bito dupiji dukeje, Israeal kejewu bakurirewu jamedu boe kejewu areme ere tuiebu tureru tabo, turagodu tabo Saul jokorai, to ka boe tabo, meriri kiarewu tabo, tui boe eerdudo tuiegarae jitu tabo.

b: Areme ererure turagodu tabo, tagoi oino dutabo saulre bitowugere mil, mare Davire bitowugere dez mil.
source: Areme ererure turagodu tabo, tagoi oino dutabo saulre bitowugere mil, mare Davire bitowugere dez mil.

b: Nowu inodu ukare turugadu Saul ji; du kodi Icare korigodure, akore ere dez mil maku Davi ai, inai ere mil maku tu rugadu; kaboba okware ewo tugimejerado ema? Nowu meri piji, Saul aiwo pemagakare Davi ji pugeje.
source: Nowu inodu ukare turugadu Saul ji; du kodi Icare korigodure, akore ere dez mil maku Davi ai, inai ere mil maku tu rugadu; kaboba okware ewo tugimejerado ema? Nowu meri piji, Saul aiwo pemagakare Davi ji pugeje.

b: Saulre tonaregedu Jonas biie, ure tudugarege eiamedu boe ewiie, tumearudaeie tuwo Davi bito duji.
source: Saulre tonaregedu Jonas biie, ure tudugarege eiamedu boe ewiie, tumearudaeie tuwo Davi bito duji.

b: Mare Jônatas, Saul naregedu, mearudu kurire Davi ji.
source: Mare Jônatas, Saul naregedu, mearudu kurire Davi ji.

b: Ure Davido tumearudu awadudo pudui, tagoi oino jitu tabo ioga Saul jemarure tuwo awido, du kodire ire awiie, kuri barogwato atuwo ia boe biarewu kae, awo awiado. Imi, imode itawuje, imode iragoje puredudo iogaji, imode awiie boemodedu jameduji.
source: Ure Davido tumearudu awadudo pudui, tagoi oino jitu tabo ioga Saul jemarure tuwo awido, du kodire ire awiie, kuri barogwato atuwo ia boe biarewu kae, awo awiado. Imi, imode itawuje, imode iragoje puredudo iogaji, imode awiie boemodedu jameduji.

b: Jônatas makore Davi paru tabo tuo Saul biagai, dutabo Icare akore oino pugeje akaidu kaba aro pegawo atugare Davi ji, paga karega, ro pegakare ai, rore aiboe pemegaguragare. Biapagakai tuwimode duji, ure filisteu bito, ure Israeldogedo tumorido filisteudogei. Aerdure, aegarere. Inoba ure kodiba akaidure awo akera kudo boe eku pemegarewu tabo, ai Davi bito ia ro pegarewu bokwa tabo?
source: Jônatas makore Davi paru tabo tuo Saul biagai, dutabo Icare akore oino pugeje akaidu kaba aro pegawo atugare Davi ji, paga karega, ro pegakare ai, rore aiboe pemegaguragare. Biapagakai tuwimode duji, ure filisteu bito, ure Israeldogedo tumorido filisteudogei. Aerdure, aegarere. Inoba ure kodiba akaidure awo akera kudo boe eku pemegarewu tabo, ai Davi bito ia ro pegarewu bokwa tabo?

b: Saul biapagare Jônatas akoi pudui duji, ure tuwadaru maku Pao jerewu koia, bimodukare.
source: Saul biapagare Jônatas akoi pudui duji, ure tuwadaru maku Pao jerewu koia, bimodukare.

b: Icare Jônatas makore Davi bogai, readodure awu jamedu boeji biagai, Du kejere ure reko Saul ae, dure Icare maragodure ai, tumaragodui jao du reore.
source: Icare Jônatas makore Davi bogai, readodure awu jamedu boeji biagai, Du kejere ure reko Saul ae, dure Icare maragodure ai, tumaragodui jao du reore.

b: Nowu du kodi, Saulre tugeragu meture tudodawu Israeldoge ei 3. 0 ceduji, uture Davi bogai, apowuge ewogai cabritodoge emugure kejewu torekaridoge etae, meri rutu jaogwai.
source: Nowu du kodi, Saulre tugeragu meture tudodawu Israeldoge ei 3. 0 ceduji, uture Davi bogai, apowuge ewogai cabritodoge emugure kejewu torekaridoge etae, meri rutu jaogwai.

b: Taregodui ia ibora padui awara okwai, Saulre turemo ia tori poroto mugui nonodu tuwo tuwure amudo; Davi mugure pudabowuge ebo nowu tori poro opo keje.
source: Taregodui ia ibora padui awara okwai, Saulre turemo ia tori poroto mugui nonodu tuwo tuwure amudo; Davi mugure pudabowuge ebo nowu tori poro opo keje.

b: Du kodi Icare Davi utugarege egore oino ji meri aregodure Pao akoi tumoduie onare aiwu maku akera kai. Du kodi Icare Davire turagojedo, utu podure Saul ae, ure ukudae okwa kado.
source: Du kodi Icare Davi utugarege egore oino ji meri aregodure Pao akoi tumoduie onare aiwu maku akera kai. Du kodi Icare Davire turagojedo, utu podure Saul ae, ure ukudae okwa kado.

b: Mare turoi oino dukeje, Davi tori buture jagi, tui Saul kudae okwa kado du kodi.
source: Mare turoi oino dukeje, Davi tori buture jagi, tui Saul kudae okwa kado du kodi.

b: Akore oino tudugaregei Pao ukawo irowo oino Ikimijeraji, Paore tugeragu ji pudaiwu imeduji. Pao ukawo ido ikera oagado ji, Paore tugeragu ji pudai kodi.
source: Akore oino tudugaregei Pao ukawo irowo oino Ikimijeraji, Paore tugeragu ji pudaiwu imeduji. Pao ukawo ido ikera oagado ji, Paore tugeragu ji pudai kodi.

b: Nowu tuwadaru tabo, Davikare tudugaregedo taredo Saul keje. Icare Saulre tudawuje nowu tori poro piji, uture tudawaraji pugeje.
source: Nowu tuwadaru tabo, Davikare tudugaregedo taredo Saul keje. Icare Saulre tudawuje nowu tori poro piji, uture tudawaraji pugeje.

b: Du keje Icare Davire turagojedo jamedu, tui tuiebu tori poro piji dutabo, oiogwarire Saul rekodaji, tagoi oino dutabo. Ikimejera, boe eimejera! Saul aiwore tuibagi, Icare Davire tuie jodo mototo tuwo tubujodo ji.
source: Du keje Icare Davire turagojedo jamedu, tui tuiebu tori poro piji dutabo, oiogwarire Saul rekodaji, tagoi oino dutabo. Ikimejera, boe eimejera! Saul aiwore tuibagi, Icare Davire tuie jodo mototo tuwo tubujodo ji.

b: Du rekodaji Davi akore oino Saul ji kodiba awiapagare boe egoi: 'Davi aidure tuwo boe pegado ai? ' oino duji?
source: Du rekodaji Davi akore oino Saul ji kodiba awiapagare boe egoi: 'Davi aidure tuwo boe pegado ai? ' oino duji?

b: Ca! Awuji aeku jordure Paoi amagu ikera kai tori poro tada duji, boere turugadu iwo awido du bogai. Mare irokare ino, imagore oino ii imodukare ikera aogado Ikimejera ji, Paore tugeragu ji pudai kodi.
source: Ca! Awuji aeku jordure Paoi amagu ikera kai tori poro tada duji, boere turugadu iwo awido du bogai. Mare irokare ino, imagore oino ii imodukare ikera aogado Ikimejera ji, Paore tugeragu ji pudai kodi.

b: Akaiwodo ikedui akudae okwa kobo jituji. Ii akudae okwa kado ikai awido dutabo, du kodire amode boe pa imearudae pegakai, iro pegakai ai duji. Dure karega, akonare ii awo iwido.
source: Akaiwodo ikedui akudae okwa kobo jituji. Ii akudae okwa kado ikai awido dutabo, du kodire amode boe pa imearudae pegakai, iro pegakai ai duji. Dure karega, akonare ii awo iwido.

b: Pao umode tugogado ai, ii; umode togwamorido ai iparu tabo. Mare ikera padumodukare awugeje jii je.
source: Pao umode tugogado ai, ii; umode togwamorido ai iparu tabo. Mare ikera padumodukare awugeje jii je.

b: Bakaru mariguduwu ako magadu reore: 'Ro pegareuge epijire boe pegarewu aregodure'; mare ikera puredumodukare ai.
source: Bakaru mariguduwu ako magadu reore: 'Ro pegareuge epijire boe pegarewu aregodure'; mare ikera puredumodukare ai.

b: Ioguduba jiba Israeldoge eimejera rugodumode? Ioguduba jiba akonare? Ia arigao birewu rabodu, ia kuieje rabodu?
source: Ioguduba jiba Israeldoge eimejera rugodumode? Ioguduba jiba akonare? Ia arigao birewu rabodu, ia kuieje rabodu?

b: Pao umode tugogado pai puibagi, uwo tugogado akonai ii duji.
source: Pao umode tugogado pai puibagi, uwo tugogado akonai ii duji.

b: Davi ui tuwadaru akedudo dukeje, Saul akore oino bataru jipagi itonaregedu Davi, awadaru na?
source: Davi ui tuwadaru akedudo dukeje, Saul akore oino bataru jipagi itonaregedu Davi, awadaru na?

b: Icare ragudu kuricigore.
source: Icare ragudu kuricigore.

b: Du keje akore oino Davi ji akire aro jetoro kodure iro jetorogodu kori; paga karega, aki aro pemegare ii, imirema, iro boe pega kuricigodo ai.
source: Du keje akore oino Davi ji akire aro jetoro kodure iro jetorogodu kori; paga karega, aki aro pemegare ii, imirema, iro boe pega kuricigodo ai.

b: Awuji are iordudo aro pemegai ii duji. Paore imagu akera kai, mare akare iwido.
source: Awuji are iordudo aro pemegai ii duji. Paore imagu akera kai, mare akare iwido.

b: Ioguduba jordumode onare jiwuji ma, umode utu pemegado tudawaraji pugeje? Du kodire Pao umode aiwo pemegado aroi ii duji.
source: Ioguduba jordumode onare jiwuji ma, umode utu pemegado tudawaraji pugeje? Du kodire Pao umode aiwo pemegado aroi ii duji.

b: Icare iorduwa jokodure akie aetumode boe ji duji. Israeldoge eimejerage ekedure jiboe mugumode akera keje.
source: Icare iorduwa jokodure akie aetumode boe ji duji. Israeldoge eimejerage ekedure jiboe mugumode akera keje.

b: Nowu du kodi, Israeldoge eimejera kurirewu Saul uture toro boe makodurewu iere Zif cedu kae, tuwo tuwu Davi otogajeje nowu boe makodurewu tada. O tugobaigaregere 3. OOO, duwugere eroiwa kodure tumedage eroiwa kori Israel moto keje.
source: Nowu du kodi, Israeldoge eimejera kurirewu Saul uture toro boe makodurewu iere Zif cedu kae, tuwo tuwu Davi otogajeje nowu boe makodurewu tada. O tugobaigaregere 3. OOO, duwugere eroiwa kodure tumedage eroiwa kori Israel moto keje.

b: Icare Davi mare metuia Abisai eture boecoji jii ere baadowo kae, eerdure Saul padui tunu tabo duji, o meriri otowu meture moto tada, aora padurewu jaogwai; Saul metuia, iere Abner cedu, mare utugarege, enu padu bire oiei.
source: Icare Davi mare metuia Abisai eture boecoji jii ere baadowo kae, eerdure Saul padui tunu tabo duji, o meriri otowu meture moto tada, aora padurewu jaogwai; Saul metuia, iere Abner cedu, mare utugarege, enu padu bire oiei.

b: Icare Abisai akore oino Davi ji awuji Paore onare aiwu maku akera kai. Ido o meriri oto bu kajeje mito tu je mototo, boe emodukare boe bu kajeje pobe.
source: Icare Abisai akore oino Davi ji awuji Paore onare aiwu maku akera kai. Ido o meriri oto bu kajeje mito tu je mototo, boe emodukare boe bu kajeje pobe.

b: Mare Davi akore oino Abisai ji ioguduba umode tugera bu Paore tugera bu kejewu keje, duma boe keadu modukare ji?
source: Mare Davi akore oino Abisai ji ioguduba umode tugera bu Paore tugera bu kejewu keje, duma boe keadu modukare ji?

b: Icare Davire tugeragu rakojere Saul ao jaogwaiwu meriri otoji, pobo jaji, eture tabo. Boe eerdukare iaboeji iaboeji, boe ekare boe pa boe oino duji, iaboe iaboe eedadukare, eiamedu boe enudu nure, paga karega, Paore ewarigu nore kori jaoto kodi.
source: Icare Davire tugeragu rakojere Saul ao jaogwaiwu meriri otoji, pobo jaji, eture tabo. Boe eerdukare iaboeji iaboeji, boe ekare boe pa boe oino duji, iaboe iaboe eedadukare, eiamedu boe enudu nure, paga karega, Paore ewarigu nore kori jaoto kodi.

b: Davire pagado bakowu kae, ure turagojedo ia tori kudu ao keje jaegiri, boe jaegirire pubuji puae.
source: Davire pagado bakowu kae, ure turagojedo ia tori kudu ao keje jaegiri, boe jaegirire pubuji puae.

b: Icare Davi oiogwarire, akore Pagimejera o meriri oto reo. Ia iparedu boe tagi, mato kae.
source: Icare Davi oiogwarire, akore Pagimejera o meriri oto reo. Ia iparedu boe tagi, mato kae.

b: Pao umode paiwo aidugirido puibagi, paro pamearutoru reore. Paore tamagu ikera kai awu meriji, mare itaidukare iwo ikera aogado Pao Aroe Eimejera o kruca padure kejewuji.
source: Pao umode paiwo aidugirido puibagi, paro pamearutoru reore. Paore tamagu ikera kai awu meriji, mare itaidukare iwo ikera aogado Pao Aroe Eimejera o kruca padure kejewuji.

b: Nowu du kodi, Davire tugirimi tui amalecitadoge eeda kedodo dupiji, merire pobe ji Siqueleg keje.
source: Nowu du kodi, Davire tugirimi tui amalecitadoge eeda kedodo dupiji, merire pobe ji Siqueleg keje.

b: Merii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware durekodaji Saulre baadodu pijire ia imedu aregodure tugudae bodu tabo, ao korobadure moto urugudu tabo; taregodui Davi ae dukeje, ure tuie jodo mototo, ure tubujodo ji.
source: Merii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware durekodaji Saulre baadodu pijire ia imedu aregodure tugudae bodu tabo, ao korobadure moto urugudu tabo; taregodui Davi ae dukeje, ure tuie jodo mototo, ure tubujodo ji.

b: Davi unoragodure ji kaba pijiba akaregodure? Akore oino iregodure Israeldoge ere baadodu piji.
source: Davi unoragodure ji kaba pijiba akaregodure? Akore oino iregodure Israeldoge ere baadodu piji.

b: Davi akore ji areadodudo iwiegai inoba boere tai toro? Akore oino ji boe eregodure turugodu piji, makareuge ewudure, ewire; Saul bire jamedu tonaregedu Jônatas apo.
source: Davi akore ji areadodudo iwiegai inoba boere tai toro? Akore oino ji boe eregodure turugodu piji, makareuge ewudure, ewire; Saul bire jamedu tonaregedu Jônatas apo.

b: Du kodi Icare Davire tugeragu tugudaeji, ure bowuje. Mugure apowuge eiamedu boe erore ino jamedu.
source: Du kodi Icare Davire tugeragu tugudaeji, ure bowuje. Mugure apowuge eiamedu boe erore ino jamedu.

b: Etoragudure, ekare boe ko meri rekodu kae, Saul, Jônatas, eregodaji, Pao uwobe Israel kejewuge eregodaji, ewidodure tariga rairewu tabo kodi.
source: Etoragudure, ekare boe ko meri rekodu kae, Saul, Jônatas, eregodaji, Pao uwobe Israel kejewuge eregodaji, ewidodure tariga rairewu tabo kodi.

b: Icare Davi akore oino Israel! Oinore ako tugobaigarege kurireuge ewudure boe padui tugajeje ako boe aoporu boe keje!
source: Icare Davi akore oino Israel! Oinore ako tugobaigarege kurireuge ewudure boe padui tugajeje ako boe aoporu boe keje!

b: Saul, Jônatas, boe emearudu kurire jiwuge, akaru kurireuge; boe ee, boe ewi, ekare edo tugera ra pubiji. Ekodu raka kodure aroecebadoge ekori, ero raka kodure adugo agareuge ekori.
source: Saul, Jônatas, boe emearudu kurire jiwuge, akaru kurireuge; boe ee, boe ewi, ekare edo tugera ra pubiji. Ekodu raka kodure aroecebadoge ekori, ero raka kodure adugo agareuge ekori.

b: Israel ore areme tagoragududo Saul okwa rekodaji, ure tagudae kurukururewu tugu tai, ure tagudae motudo meriri ekurewu tabo.
source: Israel ore areme tagoragududo Saul okwa rekodaji, ure tagudae kurukururewu tugu tai, ure tagudae motudo meriri ekurewu tabo.

b: Kodiba ewudure tumedui tudoda dutabo, turugodu oiado? Kodiba iwie Jônatas bitodure Israeldoge eno aoporu keje?
source: Kodiba ewudure tumedui tudoda dutabo, turugodu oiado? Kodiba iwie Jônatas bitodure Israeldoge eno aoporu keje?

b: Iwie Jônatas, iwabo ragudure aregodaji, imearudu kurire ai kodi. Amearudu kuri pemega kodure areme emearudu kuriae kori!
source: Iwie Jônatas, iwabo ragudure aregodaji, imearudu kurire ai kodi. Amearudu kuri pemega kodure areme emearudu kuriae kori!

b: Oinore tugobaigarege ro rakareuge ewudure, oinore boe erugodure taboboe akedure!
source: Oinore tugobaigarege ro rakareuge ewudure, oinore boe erugodure taboboe akedure!

b: Nowu du kodi, Pao makore Natã ji, akore ji toro, akagodo oino itugare Davi ji oinore Pao akore ako merimode turugadu dukeje, amugumode aomage ebo dukeje, imode ia aregodajiwu mugudo amuga keje, ia aregodure apijiwu imode boe eimejerado ema. Umode ia bai to inai, imode boe eimejerado ema jii je. Uo rumode imi, itonaregedu rumode ema. Awai, aetui boeidu, umode jii je iegai, amuga rakojemode jii je, jamedu.
source: Nowu du kodi, Pao makore Natã ji, akore ji toro, akagodo oino itugare Davi ji oinore Pao akore ako merimode turugadu dukeje, amugumode aomage ebo dukeje, imode ia aregodajiwu mugudo amuga keje, ia aregodure apijiwu imode boe eimejerado ema. Umode ia bai to inai, imode boe eimejerado ema jii je. Uo rumode imi, itonaregedu rumode ema. Awai, aetui boeidu, umode jii je iegai, amuga rakojemode jii je, jamedu.

b: Nowu du kodi, Israel uwobe epadui pumekejedu jamedu boe eture Davi ae, tagoi oino jitu tabo cegireo, ara, akodu, nure cegi. Marigudu, Saul jetui cei kimo dutabo, akire are Israeldoge erego tu tu je. Pao akore oino ai 'Akire aetumode iwobe Israeldogei, eimejeramode aki'.
source: Nowu du kodi, Israel uwobe epadui pumekejedu jamedu boe eture Davi ae, tagoi oino jitu tabo cegireo, ara, akodu, nure cegi. Marigudu, Saul jetui cei kimo dutabo, akire are Israeldoge erego tu tu je. Pao akore oino ai 'Akire aetumode iwobe Israeldogei, eimejeramode aki'.

b: Du kodi Icare Israel kejewu boe codureuge eiamedu boe eture boe eimejera bogai Hebron kae. Icare Davire tuwadaru maku etai Pao jekai. Du kodi Icare ere Israeldoge eimejerado Davice.
source: Du kodi Icare Israel kejewu boe codureuge eiamedu boe eture boe eimejera bogai Hebron kae. Icare Davire tuwadaru maku etai Pao jekai. Du kodi Icare ere Israeldoge eimejerado Davice.

b: Davi o jorure trinta, turudui Israeldoge eimejarai pudumi du kae. Jorure 40 jetui ei dutabo.
source: Davi o jorure trinta, turudui Israeldoge eimejarai pudumi du kae. Jorure 40 jetui ei dutabo.

b: Hebron keje jeture Judá kejewugei jorure ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, arire ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto. Jerusalém keje jeture Israeldogei, Judá kejewuge eiamedu boeji, jorure 33 cedu tabo.
source: Hebron keje jeture Judá kejewugei jorure ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, arire ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto. Jerusalém keje jeture Israeldogei, Judá kejewuge eiamedu boeji, jorure 33 cedu tabo.

b: Davi uture Jerusalém kae tudugarege ebo, mugure torowu jebuseudoge etogi, duwuge egore oino Davi ji amodukare aremo woe; joku bokwareuge, pogora bokwareuge, emode awarigu. Dure oino Davi umodukare turemo woe.
source: Davi uture Jerusalém kae tudugarege ebo, mugure torowu jebuseudoge etogi, duwuge egore oino Davi ji amodukare aremo woe; joku bokwareuge, pogora bokwareuge, emode awarigu. Dure oino Davi umodukare turemo woe.

b: Mare Davire tugeragu Sião kejewu bakurirewu moto ri onare jiwuji, dure Icare Davi o bakurirewu rema.
source: Mare Davire tugeragu Sião kejewu bakurirewu moto ri onare jiwuji, dure Icare Davi o bakurirewu rema.

b: Davi ro rakagodure gu gu je, Pao utugare makarewu rakojere apo kodi.
source: Davi ro rakagodure gu gu je, Pao utugare makarewu rakojere apo kodi.

b: Nowu du kodi, Davi uture tuwo Pao o boe eroiagudu meture tadawu irá reko tuiegare kuricigo tabo Obe-Edom uwai piji Davi o bakurirewu kae du bogai.
source: Nowu du kodi, Davi uture tuwo Pao o boe eroiagudu meture tadawu irá reko tuiegare kuricigo tabo Obe-Edom uwai piji Davi o bakurirewu kae du bogai.

b: Ure nowu irá pemegarewu rekowuge etui tabo dukeje kuri je, ere ia tapira imedu karewu bito ia barogo kuguri karewu apo.
source: Ure nowu irá pemegarewu rekowuge etui tabo dukeje kuri je, ere ia tapira imedu karewu bito ia barogo kuguri karewu apo.

b: Davi rerure tuduru jamedu boe tabo Pao jekai, tui ia aroia kigadurewu kuru kururewu tugu pudui dutabo.
source: Davi rerure tuduru jamedu boe tabo Pao jekai, tui ia aroia kigadurewu kuru kururewu tugu pudui dutabo.

b: Davire nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu reko Israeldoge eiamedu boe ebo, toiogwari tabo, meriri iworewu ako utonaji.
source: Davire nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu reko Israeldoge eiamedu boe ebo, toiogwari tabo, meriri iworewu ako utonaji.

b: Du kodi Icare ere Pao o irá pemegarewu reko, ere mugudo tumugumodewo kae, Davire pemegadowu aroia bai oiadoda.
source: Du kodi Icare ere Pao o irá pemegarewu reko, ere mugudo tumugumodewo kae, Davire pemegadowu aroia bai oiadoda.

b: Du keje ure tomea maku Pao ai.
source: Du keje ure tomea maku Pao ai.

b: Nowu ei tomea akedudo dukeje, Davire togwamu boe ji, Pao ro rakarewu ie tabo.
source: Nowu ei tomea akedudo dukeje, Davire togwamu boe ji, Pao ro rakarewu ie tabo.

b: Du keje Icare Davire tapira kodu maku, amirewu tabo, parera tudu kirewu torudodu tabo boe eiamedu boe etai israeldoge eiamedu boe, ime, areme, etai. Du kejere eiamedu boe eture tu tu tuwai kae.
source: Du keje Icare Davire tapira kodu maku, amirewu tabo, parera tudu kirewu torudodu tabo boe eiamedu boe etai israeldoge eiamedu boe, ime, areme, etai. Du kejere eiamedu boe eture tu tu tuwai kae.

b: Brae Eimejera Davi ui tumugudo tuwai kurirewu tada dukeje, onare jiwu eedure oieiwuge epemegai ji Pao koia dutabo, akore oino profeta Natã ji akaiwodo, imugure bai noakodu irá cedu tada; Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu ira pemegarewu mugui bai aroia kuda du tonaji.
source: Brae Eimejera Davi ui tumugudo tuwai kurirewu tada dukeje, onare jiwu eedure oieiwuge epemegai ji Pao koia dutabo, akore oino profeta Natã ji akaiwodo, imugure bai noakodu irá cedu tada; Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu ira pemegarewu mugui bai aroia kuda du tonaji.

b: Icare Natã akore ji u! Ema rugadu! Meture awabo tadaboe jamedu boe towuje; paga karega, Pao rakojere akabo.
source: Icare Natã akore ji u! Ema rugadu! Meture awabo tadaboe jamedu boe towuje; paga karega, Pao rakojere akabo.

b: Nowu du kodi, Pao makore Natã ji, tagoi oino dutabo:
source: Nowu du kodi, Pao makore Natã ji, tagoi oino dutabo:

b: Toro! Amagodo itugare Davi ji: 'Oinore Pao akore Amearudaere awo ia bai towuje imugace?
source: Toro! Amagodo itugare Davi ji: 'Oinore Pao akore Amearudaere awo ia bai towuje imugace?

b: Boe jokodu, ii Israeldoge etawuje Egito piji dupiji jii oino, iwai bokware imugace, mare imerure aroia bai boe tada, bairogu boe tada.
source: Boe jokodu, ii Israeldoge etawuje Egito piji dupiji jii oino, iwai bokware imugace, mare imerure aroia bai boe tada, bairogu boe tada.

b: Ikodui Israel ore ebo jii oino du kae, imago kana ia ire jetudo iwobeiwugei: 'Kodiba akare ia bai towuje inai nowakodu irá cedu tabo? '
source: Ikodui Israel ore ebo jii oino du kae, imago kana ia ire jetudo iwobeiwugei: 'Kodiba akare ia bai towuje inai nowakodu irá cedu tabo? '

b: Icare akagomode oino itugare Davi ji oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore Ire atawuje boku piji, aetui barege kugurei dupiji, iwobe Israeldoge eimejerawo aki du bogai; amerurewo jamedu boe keje iragojere akabo.
source: Icare akagomode oino itugare Davi ji oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore Ire atawuje boku piji, aetui barege kugurei dupiji, iwobe Israeldoge eimejerawo aki du bogai; amerurewo jamedu boe keje iragojere akabo.

b: Ire onare aiwuge eiamedu boe eeda kedodo akododai, ire akagaru kuricigodo, ia brae eimejerage kurireuge etagaru reore.
source: Ire onare aiwuge eiamedu boe eeda kedodo akododai, ire akagaru kuricigodo, ia brae eimejerage kurireuge etagaru reore.

b: Imode iwobe Israeldoge eedado turugadu, nono Icare imode edo tuwure tugu eeduwo nono jii je, boe ekawo emorora amagadudo pudui pugeje.
source: Imode iwobe Israeldoge eedado turugadu, nono Icare imode edo tuwure tugu eeduwo nono jii je, boe ekawo emorora amagadudo pudui pugeje.

b: Ro pegareuge eroreru modukare ei, uwo magai ire boe eimejerage jorduwareuge eetudo iwobe Israeldogei dukeje du reore. Imode amugu butugudo, imode ado akinorudo onare aiwuge epiji.
source: Ro pegareuge eroreru modukare ei, uwo magai ire boe eimejerage jorduwareuge eetudo iwobe Israeldogei dukeje du reore. Imode amugu butugudo, imode ado akinorudo onare aiwuge epiji.

b: Paore awie pudumie tumode ia bai mugudo akai.
source: Paore awie pudumie tumode ia bai mugudo akai.

b: Ako meri aregodui pudae dukeje, amugumode kodure akododaiwuge ebo dukeje, imode aregodajiwu, umode tudowuje apijiwu aogado, imode boe eimejerado ema.
source: Ako meri aregodui pudae dukeje, amugumode kodure akododaiwuge ebo dukeje, imode aregodajiwu, umode tudowuje apijiwu aogado, imode boe eimejerado ema.

b: Emare umode ia bai towuje inai, imode boe eimejerado ema jii je.
source: Emare umode ia bai towuje inai, imode boe eimejerado ema jii je.

b: Uomode imi, itonaregedumode ema. Ro jetorogodu modukare ma, imode okorido iwara tabo, ime ero magai pui, tui boe to ro jetorokareugei dutabo, du reore.
source: Uomode imi, itonaregedumode ema. Ro jetorogodu modukare ma, imode okorido iwara tabo, ime ero magai pui, tui boe to ro jetorokareugei dutabo, du reore.

b: Mare imodukare iro pemegarewu jaedo ji, iro magai Saul jitu reore, dure ire barigu akoda piji.
source: Mare imodukare iro pemegarewu jaedo ji, iro magai Saul jitu reore, dure ire barigu akoda piji.

b: Awai, boe eimejerai akidu, umode jii je iegai, amuga rakamode jii je.
source: Awai, boe eimejerai akidu, umode jii je iegai, amuga rakamode jii je.

b: Natã readodure Davi biegai awu Pao bataru jameduji. Natã makoi Davi jitu rekodaji, boe eimejerare turemo Pao uwaito, tui turagojedo Pao jekai dutabo, akore ioguduba ure imi, Pao Aroe Eimejera, ioguduba iwobere emage, awo irego jii awu boe oino du kae?
source: Natã readodure Davi biegai awu Pao bataru jameduji. Natã makoi Davi jitu rekodaji, boe eimejerare turemo Pao uwaito, tui turagojedo Pao jekai dutabo, akore ioguduba ure imi, Pao Aroe Eimejera, ioguduba iwobere emage, awo irego jii awu boe oino du kae?

b: Mare awu inodu ukare turugadu aegai roga, Ioga Aroe Eimejera, are aromodedudo kimo atugare uwobei ia jaegiri aregodumodeboe kae.
source: Mare awu inodu ukare turugadu aegai roga, Ioga Aroe Eimejera, are aromodedudo kimo atugare uwobei ia jaegiri aregodumodeboe kae.

b: Are awobe Israeldoge awobedo emage jii je, ino Aroe Eimejera, are eno Aroe Eimejerado aki.
source: Are awobe Israeldoge awobedo emage jii je, ino Aroe Eimejera, are eno Aroe Eimejerado aki.

b: Oinore Icare, Pao Aroe Eimejera, akagoi atugare jitu, uwobe eidu, boe jokodudo jii je, boe ko awadaru rekodaji.
source: Oinore Icare, Pao Aroe Eimejera, akagoi atugare jitu, uwobe eidu, boe jokodudo jii je, boe ko awadaru rekodaji.

b: Akagaru kuriwo jii je du bogai, boe egowo Pao ro rakarewu, Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera nure ema. Atugare Davi uwai muguwo jii je aegai.
source: Akagaru kuriwo jii je du bogai, boe egowo Pao ro rakarewu, Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera nure ema. Atugare Davi uwai muguwo jii je aegai.

b: Paga karega, akire Pao utugare makarewu, Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera, are boe awadudo atugare biegai, akagoi oino dutabo imode ia bai towuje akai. - Du kodire, atugarere tudugu tudo togwamaguduwo oino ai.
source: Paga karega, akire Pao utugare makarewu, Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera, are boe awadudo atugare biegai, akagoi oino dutabo imode ia bai towuje akai. - Du kodire, atugarere tudugu tudo togwamaguduwo oino ai.

b: Du kodire, Ikimejera, Aroe Eimejera nure aki, boe rikirewu nure awadaru rema. Aromode atugare aiboe pemegarewu kuricigo, makaguragare; du kodire oino akogwamu atugare uwaiji, muguwo jii aegai. Atugare uwai pemegamode jii je, ai akogwamu jitu dutabo, akire akagore aromoduie oino du kodi.
source: Du kodire, Ikimejera, Aroe Eimejera nure aki, boe rikirewu nure awadaru rema. Aromode atugare aiboe pemegarewu kuricigo, makaguragare; du kodire oino akogwamu atugare uwaiji, muguwo jii aegai. Atugare uwai pemegamode jii je, ai akogwamu jitu dutabo, akire akagore aromoduie oino du kodi.

b: Rekodajiwu joru keje, brae eimejera etu eture turugodu kae dukejere, Davire tudugare Joab utudo tugobaigarege eimejerage ebo Israeldoge eiamedu boe etae, duwugere, tui amonitadoge eno moto pegado dukeje, ere bakuredo Rabat bakurireuji. Davi rema mugure Jerusalém keje eiageje.
source: Rekodajiwu joru keje, brae eimejera etu eture turugodu kae dukejere, Davire tudugare Joab utudo tugobaigarege eimejerage ebo Israeldoge eiamedu boe etae, duwugere, tui amonitadoge eno moto pegado dukeje, ere bakuredo Rabat bakurireuji. Davi rema mugure Jerusalém keje eiageje.

b: Ia meri rekodu tabo, Davire turagojedo tuba piji, merure tuwai aogajejewu boe boareuji, dutabore jordure ia aredui taimo duji. Aredu motu rakaguragareudo nure ema.
source: Ia meri rekodu tabo, Davire turagojedo tuba piji, merure tuwai aogajejewu boe boareuji, dutabore jordure ia aredui taimo duji. Aredu motu rakaguragareudo nure ema.

b: Ure boe enarago kakoduwu areduba. Icare biedodure betsabéia rema, Eliam naregedu, Urias heteu oreduje.
source: Ure boe enarago kakoduwu areduba. Icare biedodure betsabéia rema, Eliam naregedu, Urias heteu oreduje.

b: Du kodi Icare ure boe erojai bogai ewo arego pudae gore; Betsabeia ure ema, Elian naregedu, Urias ‘eteu’ oreduje. Du keje, Davi ure utugaege edo rego padae. Aregodu keje, unudure apo.
source: Du kodi Icare ure boe erojai bogai ewo arego pudae gore; Betsabeia ure ema, Elian naregedu, Urias ‘eteu’ oreduje. Du keje, Davi ure utugaege edo rego padae. Aregodu keje, unudure apo.

b: Du keje Betsabéia ure tugirimi tuwai kae. Tuguiaru keje, ure Davi biie, tagoi oino dutabo ikuiarure.
source: Du keje Betsabéia ure tugirimi tuwai kae. Tuguiaru keje, ure Davi biie, tagoi oino dutabo ikuiarure.

b: Du kodi Icare Davire boe emagodo oino Joabji Urias heteu utudo mato iwogai. Joabre Urias utudo Davi bogai rugadu.
source: Du kodi Icare Davire boe emagodo oino Joabji Urias heteu utudo mato iwogai. Joabre Urias utudo Davi bogai rugadu.

b: Uriai Davi jordudo pudui dukeje, unoragodure ji Joab jiboeji, tugobaigarege eiboeji, inoba boere toro turugodu tabo.
source: Uriai Davi jordudo pudui dukeje, unoragodure ji Joab jiboeji, tugobaigarege eiboeji, inoba boere toro turugodu tabo.

b: Du keje Icare akore oino Urias ji. Arawuje awai kae, awure kabi. Uriasre tudawuje nowu tugimejera uwai piji; rekodaji ia nowu boe eimejera o mea rekodudodure bogai.
source: Du keje Icare akore oino Urias ji. Arawuje awai kae, awure kabi. Uriasre tudawuje nowu tugimejera uwai piji; rekodaji ia nowu boe eimejera o mea rekodudodure bogai.

b: Mare Urias unudure boe eimejera uwai poro keje ia tugimejera utugarege ebo, ukare turawuje tuwai kae.
source: Mare Urias unudure boe eimejera uwai poro keje ia tugimejera utugarege ebo, ukare turawuje tuwai kae.

b: Ere Davi biie tagoi oino jitu tabo uriaskare turawuje tuwai kae. Divi unorara Uriaji akaregodukare jae piji? Kodiba atukare awai kae?
source: Ere Davi biie tagoi oino jitu tabo uriaskare turawuje tuwai kae. Divi unorara Uriaji akaregodukare jae piji? Kodiba atukare awai kae?

b: Uria akore Pao o Arca, Isral, Judá, emugu nure aroia kuda, Joab mãe Ikimejera otugobaigarege.
source: Uria akore Pao o Arca, Isral, Judá, emugu nure aroia kuda, Joab mãe Ikimejera otugobaigarege.

b: Emugure baawadu keje, imirema, imirema, kodiba aitumode iwai kae inogwagewo, ikuduwo, inuduwo itoreduje apo? Iromodukare inoduji iaboe keje iaboe keje.
source: Emugure baawadu keje, imirema, imirema, kodiba aitumode iwai kae inogwagewo, ikuduwo, inuduwo itoreduje apo? Iromodukare inoduji iaboe keje iaboe keje.

b: Do kodire Davi akore ji, amugudo woe awuji, borogwato amerumode aibagi. Urias mugure nowu meriji kimo Jewrusalém tada.
source: Do kodire Davi akore ji, amugudo woe awuji, borogwato amerumode aibagi. Urias mugure nowu meriji kimo Jewrusalém tada.

b: Nowu meri rekodaji, Davire okwagedo, kududo pudabo, nono ure aora baibaido. Boecoji, Uriasre tudawuje, ure tuwu tugimejera utugarege etoiadoda, mare ukare turawuje tuwai ake.
source: Nowu meri rekodaji, Davire okwagedo, kududo pudabo, nono ure aora baibaido. Boecoji, Uriasre tudawuje, ure tuwu tugimejera utugarege etoiadoda, mare ukare turawuje tuwai ake.

b: Nowu rekodaji pugejewu meriji, Davire bapera atugodo Joab bogai, ure Uriasdo reko.
source: Nowu rekodaji pugejewu meriji, Davire bapera atugodo Joab bogai, ure Uriasdo reko.

b: Nowu bapera atugo keje akore Urias rakojedo boe erugodui puidu pegarewu oiadoda, okoridoduwo ma, biwo du bogai.
source: Nowu bapera atugo keje akore Urias rakojedo boe erugodui puidu pegarewu oiadoda, okoridoduwo ma, biwo du bogai.

b: Toebatodui bakurirewu jitu dutabo, Ure Urias rakojedo ime emedure tadawuge etogi.
source: Toebatodui bakurirewu jitu dutabo, Ure Urias rakojedo ime emedure tadawuge etogi.

b: Nowu jeture bakurirewu jiwu tugobaigarege erugodure Joabji, ia Davi utugarege, ia tugobaigarege ewire. Urias heteu meture bireuge etada jamedu.
source: Nowu jeture bakurirewu jiwu tugobaigarege erugodure Joabji, ia Davi utugarege, ia tugobaigarege ewire. Urias heteu meture bireuge etada jamedu.

b: Nowu du kodi Paore Profeta Natã utudo Davi ae; taregodui ae dukeje, akore oino ji ia bakurirewu keje, imere pobe: ia oroe kurire, ia marenaru rema.
source: Nowu du kodi Paore Profeta Natã utudo Davi ae; taregodui ae dukeje, akore oino ji ia bakurirewu keje, imere pobe: ia oroe kurire, ia marenaru rema.

b: Nowu oroe kurirewu aku tapiradoge, barege kugure, emagaguragare.
source: Nowu oroe kurirewu aku tapiradoge, barege kugure, emagaguragare.

b: Dure karega, cewu marenaru aku barogo rogu ure mito tu je; ure akirodo ji, ure okwagedo, ure ricodudo pudabo, torebo; ure togwagere jiboe, tugudure ceboe maku ai jamedu, unudure kubi, ure nono onaregeduie ure ema.
source: Dure karega, cewu marenaru aku barogo rogu ure mito tu je; ure akirodo ji, ure okwagedo, ure ricodudo pudabo, torebo; ure togwagere jiboe, tugudure ceboe maku ai jamedu, unudure kubi, ure nono onaregeduie ure ema.

b: Boekarema, iaboe etaregodure nowu oroe kurirewu uwai kae, aidukare tuwo ia tagu tapira, ia tagu barege kugure ewido tuwo tugera pemegado ji nowu aregodure pudaewu okwagewo ji pudabo; du kodire Icare ure tugeragu nowu marenaru aku barogo roguji, ure tugera pemegado ji, nowu aregodure pudaewu okwagewo ji pudabo.
source: Boekarema, iaboe etaregodure nowu oroe kurirewu uwai kae, aidukare tuwo ia tagu tapira, ia tagu barege kugure ewido tuwo tugera pemegado ji nowu aregodure pudaewu okwagewo ji pudabo; du kodire Icare ure tugeragu nowu marenaru aku barogo roguji, ure tugera pemegado ji, nowu aregodure pudaewu okwagewo ji pudabo.

b: Du kodi Icare Davi korigodu kuricigore nowu imedu bogai, akore oino Natã ji. Pao jerewu ie koia, nowu rore oinowu imedu bitodu rumode, umode nowu barogo morido pobe puibiji, nowu ro pegai oinodu koia, mare okudukare boebo kodi.
source: Du kodi Icare Davi korigodu kuricigore nowu imedu bogai, akore oino Natã ji. Pao jerewu ie koia, nowu rore oinowu imedu bitodu rumode, umode nowu barogo morido pobe puibiji, nowu ro pegai oinodu koia, mare okudukare boebo kodi.

b: Icare Natã akore oino Davi ji nowu imedu nure aki! Awiapagado Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera akoi aiduji ire Israeldoge eimejerado aki, ire akinorudo Saul iera piji, ire akimejera uwai maku akai.
source: Icare Natã akore oino Davi ji nowu imedu nure aki! Awiapagado Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera akoi aiduji ire Israeldoge eimejerado aki, ire akinorudo Saul iera piji, ire akimejera uwai maku akai.

b: Ire uwire emagu akera kai, ire Israeldoge, Judá kejewuge eimejerado aki. Aerdu kuri modukare awu inoduji ma, imode ia akaidure jiboe maku akai kimo.
source: Ire uwire emagu akera kai, ire Israeldoge, Judá kejewuge eimejerado aki. Aerdu kuri modukare awu inoduji ma, imode ia akaidure jiboe maku akai kimo.

b: Kodiba aro pemegakare ako Aroe Eimejera jekai? Are boedo Urias Heteu bito tariga rairewu tabo, are akeragu oredujeji akai.
source: Kodiba aro pemegakare ako Aroe Eimejera jekai? Are boedo Urias Heteu bito tariga rairewu tabo, are akeragu oredujeji akai.

b: Tariga rairewu jae modukare awai piji, are boe kado imi, ai akeragu Urias heteu toreduje ji akai, ai amonitadogedo Urias bito tariga rairewu tabodu kodi.
source: Tariga rairewu jae modukare awai piji, are boe kado imi, ai akeragu Urias heteu toreduje ji akai, ai amonitadogedo Urias bito tariga rairewu tabodu kodi.

b: Du kodi Icare Pao akore oino imode awai pijiwu iaboe etonado ai. Imode ikeragu awirei aegai, imode emagu onare aiwu ai, mugumode ebo meri rugu keje.
source: Du kodi Icare Pao akore oino imode awai pijiwu iaboe etonado ai. Imode ikeragu awirei aegai, imode emagu onare aiwu ai, mugumode ebo meri rugu keje.

b: Paga karega, aro oinodu biadodure, mare imi awu inodu to Israeldoge eiamedu boe eegai meri rugu keje.
source: Paga karega, aro oinodu biadodure, mare imi awu inodu to Israeldoge eiamedu boe eegai meri rugu keje.

b: Du kodi Icare Davi ureadodure turo pegareuji Natã biegai, tagoi oino dutabo iro pegare Pao ji.
source: Du kodi Icare Davi ureadodure turo pegareuji Natã biegai, tagoi oino dutabo iro pegare Pao ji.

b: Icare Natã akore oino ji Pao butugugodure aro pegareuji, du kodire awimodukare.
source: Icare Natã akore oino ji Pao butugugodure aro pegareuji, du kodire awimodukare.

b: Mare awu aro oino dutabo, are Pao korigodu kuricigodo aro pegareuji, du kodire botumode akaiwu akonaregedu bimode.
source: Mare awu aro oino dutabo, are Pao korigodu kuricigodo aro pegareuji, du kodire botumode akaiwu akonaregedu bimode.

b: Natãre tugirimi tuwai kae, Icare Urias oreduje onaregedu botui Davi aiwu kogodu kuricigore.
source: Natãre tugirimi tuwai kae, Icare Urias oreduje onaregedu botui Davi aiwu kogodu kuricigore.

b: Icare Davi okwamagudure Pao ji nowu negedurogu paru tabo, ukare boe kowuje; tui tugirimi tuwai kae dutabo, unudure moto keje.
source: Icare Davi okwamagudure Pao ji nowu negedurogu paru tabo, ukare boe kowuje; tui tugirimi tuwai kae dutabo, unudure moto keje.

b: Uwai tadawu codureugere tuburedo ji tuwo udo turagojedo moto piji; mare aidukare, okwagekare ebo jamedu.
source: Uwai tadawu codureugere tuburedo ji tuwo udo turagojedo moto piji; mare aidukare, okwagekare ebo jamedu.

b: Nowu du kodi, bakaru aregodure Davi bogai israeldoge ewabore tuie jodo Absalão keje.
source: Nowu du kodi, bakaru aregodure Davi bogai israeldoge ewabore tuie jodo Absalão keje.

b: Du kodi Icare Davi akore oino jeture pudabo Jerusalém kejewu tudugaregei taragojedo, paregoduwo, paroiwa modukare pawo paginorudo Absalão koda apiji. Tadu marigudu! Umodukare ino ma, umode paeto pui, umode boe pegado pai, umode bakurirewu kejeboe bito tariga rairewu tabo.
source: Du kodi Icare Davi akore oino jeture pudabo Jerusalém kejewu tudugaregei taragojedo, paregoduwo, paroiwa modukare pawo paginorudo Absalão koda apiji. Tadu marigudu! Umodukare ino ma, umode paeto pui, umode boe pegado pai, umode bakurirewu kejeboe bito tariga rairewu tabo.

b: Davi rutu nure Oliveira aoporu kujeto; ragudu nure turudu tabo, aroia padui tao keje dutabo, tuwure kedo tabo. Kodure apowu boe eiamedu boe aroia padure etao keje, erudure apo toragudu tabo.
source: Davi rutu nure Oliveira aoporu kujeto; ragudu nure turudu tabo, aroia padui tao keje dutabo, tuwure kedo tabo. Kodure apowu boe eiamedu boe aroia padure etao keje, erudure apo toragudu tabo.

b: Nowu boe eimejera aregodui Baurim kae dukeje, ia Saul uwobe imedu ure tudawuje nowu piji, iere Semei, Gera onaregedu, tumago pega tabo Davi ji.
source: Nowu boe eimejera aregodui Baurim kae dukeje, ia Saul uwobe imedu ure tudawuje nowu piji, iere Semei, Gera onaregedu, tumago pega tabo Davi ji.

b: Ure tori to ji, apowu tugaregei jamedu, boe eiamedu boe, utugobaigarege eiamedu boe, emerure jaogwai puibiji, kodi karega.
source: Ure tori to ji, apowu tugaregei jamedu, boe eiamedu boe, utugobaigarege eiamedu boe, emerure jaogwai puibiji, kodi karega.

b: Tumago pegai jitu tabo, Semei akore toro, toro! Ure boe eku redowu imedu pegarewu.
source: Tumago pegai jitu tabo, Semei akore toro, toro! Ure boe eku redowu imedu pegarewu.

b: Paore Saul uwai pijiwu boe eku butudo awugeje, are barigu tumuga piji kodi, du kodire ure boe eimejerage ekedure jiboe maku akonaregedu Absalão iera kai. Jeonare aiwu boe pegarewu makudure akai, ure boe eku redowu imedu nure aki kodi.
source: Paore Saul uwai pijiwu boe eku butudo awugeje, are barigu tumuga piji kodi, du kodire ure boe eimejerage ekedure jiboe maku akonaregedu Absalão iera kai. Jeonare aiwu boe pegarewu makudure akai, ure boe eku redowu imedu nure aki kodi.

b: Du keje Icare Abisai, Servia naregedu, unoragodure nowu boe eimejeraji kodiba awu arigao birewu inodu mako pegare ikimejera boe eimejeraji? Ido itoru kado ii toriga rairewu to ji mito tu je dutabo.
source: Du keje Icare Abisai, Servia naregedu, unoragodure nowu boe eimejeraji kodiba awu arigao birewu inodu mako pegare ikimejera boe eimejeraji? Ido itoru kado ii toriga rairewu to ji mito tu je dutabo.

b: Mare nowu boe eimejera akore inoba ure kodiba aerdure oino ii akagowo oino, Servia naregedu? Mako pegawo ii rugadu. Pao koiare ure akodo oino Davi ji; ioguduba akomode oino Pao ji kodiba aro oino?
source: Mare nowu boe eimejera akore inoba ure kodiba aerdure oino ii akagowo oino, Servia naregedu? Mako pegawo ii rugadu. Pao koiare ure akodo oino Davi ji; ioguduba akomode oino Pao ji kodiba aro oino?

b: Du kodi Icare Davi akore oino Abisai ji, tudugarege eiamedu boe ji icare itonaregedu, boture ipijiwu, aidure tuwo iwido; kode benjaminita aidu modukare aidu kori? Mako pegado rugadu, Pao koiare ure akodo oino. Ia dukeje Pao aiwomode togudu tabo ii, umode boe pemegado ii, awu boe egoi oino ii dutabo.
source: Du kodi Icare Davi akore oino Abisai ji, tudugarege eiamedu boe ji icare itonaregedu, boture ipijiwu, aidure tuwo iwido; kode benjaminita aidu modukare aidu kori? Mako pegado rugadu, Pao koiare ure akodo oino. Ia dukeje Pao aiwomode togudu tabo ii, umode boe pemegado ii, awu boe egoi oino ii dutabo.

b: Kodi Icare, Davi uture tododai tudugarege ebo.
source: Kodi Icare, Davi uture tododai tudugarege ebo.

b: Nowu du kodi, Absalão jeture pa je Davi utugobaigarege eimejeragei, mugure ia burrico keje, dure ure tudugu ia carvalho itura boe kuda. Absalão aore tubodo nowu itura tabo, Icare bararere baru otoji moto piji, nowu mugure kejewu burrico uture todobiji.
source: Nowu du kodi, Absalão jeture pa je Davi utugobaigarege eimejeragei, mugure ia burrico keje, dure ure tudugu ia carvalho itura boe kuda. Absalão aore tubodo nowu itura tabo, Icare bararere baru otoji moto piji, nowu mugure kejewu burrico uture todobiji.

b: Ia imedu jordure ji, ure Joab biie, tagoi oino dutabo iordure Absalão bararei ia carvalho itura jituji.
source: Ia imedu jordure ji, ure Joab biie, tagoi oino dutabo iordure Absalão bararei ia carvalho itura jituji.

b: Icare Joabre tugeragu tudugoi pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, du ure bu Absalão morora kajeje.
source: Icare Joabre tugeragu tudugoi pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, du ure bu Absalão morora kajeje.

b: Davi mugure baiporodoge emugure pujeto dukeje. Oeaiwore jiwu utugare ruture nowu boe boarewu mugui baiporo aogejedu kae, dutabo ure tuie aogado ma, jordure ia imedu kodui turegodu tabo tuginoigodu duji.
source: Davi mugure baiporodoge emugure pujeto dukeje. Oeaiwore jiwu utugare ruture nowu boe boarewu mugui baiporo aogejedu kae, dutabo ure tuie aogado ma, jordure ia imedu kodui turegodu tabo tuginoigodu duji.

b: Nowu oeaiwore jiwu oiogwarire, ure boe eimejera biie, dure akore tuginoigodu ro oino ma, bakaru tabore ro oino.
source: Nowu oeaiwore jiwu oiogwarire, ure boe eimejera biie, dure akore tuginoigodu ro oino ma, bakaru tabore ro oino.

b: Icare boe eimejera akore oino ji awure taru gu oino, awudugudo aregodu bogai.
source: Icare boe eimejera akore oino ji awure taru gu oino, awudugudo aregodu bogai.

b: Ure tuwure taru gu oino, upagare bogai turagoje tabo. Nowu cusita aregodure, akore oino boe eimejeraji bakaru pemegarewu tabore iro oino, ikimejera boe eimejera, paga karega, Paore tugogado onare aiwuge eiamedu boe ji.
source: Ure tuwure taru gu oino, upagare bogai turagoje tabo. Nowu cusita aregodure, akore oino boe eimejeraji bakaru pemegarewu tabore iro oino, ikimejera boe eimejera, paga karega, Paore tugogado onare aiwuge eiamedu boe ji.

b: Icare boe eimejera unoragodure nowu Etiópia kejewuji iparedu Absalão inorudodure? Pemegare? Icare nowu aregodurewu akore oino ji onare ikimejera jiwuge, ure tugera aogado tuwo boe pegado aidu eiamedu boe eiwo pegawo nono nowu iparedu jiwo pega reore.
source: Icare boe eimejera unoragodure nowu Etiópia kejewuji iparedu Absalão inorudodure? Pemegare? Icare nowu aregodurewu akore oino ji onare ikimejera jiwuge, ure tugera aogado tuwo boe pegado aidu eiamedu boe eiwo pegawo nono nowu iparedu jiwo pega reore.

b: Du kodi icare tori buture nowu boe eimejera jagi, icare, rutui tumuga mugure baiporo aogejedu kae dukeje, ragudure.
source: Du kodi icare tori buture nowu boe eimejera jagi, icare, rutui tumuga mugure baiporo aogejedu kae dukeje, ragudure.

b: Icare, tumeru tabo, akore oino; Itonaregedu Absalão, Itonaregedu Absalão, itonaregedu Absalão! Iwiia amugato! Absalão itonaregedu! Itonaregedu!
source: Icare, tumeru tabo, akore oino; Itonaregedu Absalão, Itonaregedu Absalão, itonaregedu Absalão! Iwiia amugato! Absalão itonaregedu! Itonaregedu!

b: Icare Joab biedodure tugimejera ragudui tonaregedu bitoduji.
source: Icare Joab biedodure tugimejera ragudui tonaregedu bitoduji.

b: Du kodi Icare nowu ei tumoridodu, nowu utugarege eiamedu boe ekiarigodae rema Paga karega, nowu meri keje boe emearudure boe eimejera kiarigodui tonaregedu rekodaji duji.
source: Du kodi Icare nowu ei tumoridodu, nowu utugarege eiamedu boe ekiarigodae rema Paga karega, nowu meri keje boe emearudure boe eimejera kiarigodui tonaregedu rekodaji duji.

b: Nowu kodi, boe eimejera Davi akore oino Joabji, tugobaigarege eedui apo duji tadudo, tagaiwodo Israeldoge eedurewu boeji, Dã piji jii Bersabéia kae, boe eremagu, iorduwawo kaba kejeba enodo padure.
source: Nowu kodi, boe eimejera Davi akore oino Joabji, tugobaigarege eedui apo duji tadudo, tagaiwodo Israeldoge eedurewu boeji, Dã piji jii Bersabéia kae, boe eremagu, iorduwawo kaba kejeba enodo padure.

b: Joabre nowu enodo padui bapera kejedu maku nowu boe eimejera ai: tugobaigarege enodo padure 8. 0 keje, roiware tariga rairewu tabowuge Israel ai; Judá aiwu imere 5...
source: Joabre nowu enodo padui bapera kejedu maku nowu boe eimejera ai: tugobaigarege enodo padure 8. 0 keje, roiware tariga rairewu tabowuge Israel ai; Judá aiwu imere 5...

b: Tui boe eremagu durekodaji, Davi kiarigodure turo oino duji, akore oino Pao Aroe Eimejera ji iro pega kuricigore awu iro oino dutabo, mare oino, Ikimejera, awudugugo atugare ro pegarewu keje, iro pegare itaora baibai tabo kodi.
source: Tui boe eremagu durekodaji, Davi kiarigodure turo oino duji, akore oino Pao Aroe Eimejera ji iro pega kuricigore awu iro oino dutabo, mare oino, Ikimejera, awudugugo atugare ro pegarewu keje, iro pegare itaora baibai tabo kodi.

b: Ia meri keje kuri barogwato, Davire turagojedo, Pao makoi profeta Gad, Davi uwariji, tagoi oino dutabo, du tonaji:
source: Ia meri keje kuri barogwato, Davire turagojedo, Pao makoi profeta Gad, Davi uwariji, tagoi oino dutabo, du tonaji:

b: Toro, amagodo Davi ji: - Oinore Pao akore imode iaboedo pobe ma jewu metuia bokware aegai: akeragu akaidure jiwuji, imode to.
