source: Toro, amagodo Davi ji: - Oinore Pao akore imode iaboedo pobe ma jewu metuia bokware aegai: akeragu akaidure jiwuji, imode to.

b: Du kodi Icare Gad ure tuburedo Davi ji, akore ji inoba akaidure boewo ai? - Boe eke boi butuwo boe ewugeje jorui pobe ma jewu metuia bokware dutabo? - Iarema aregoduwo ari pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du tonaji onare aiwuge etododai eemarui awogai dutabo? - Iarema boe ekogodae pegarewu jetuwo jorui pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du reore aeture jiwu moto keje? Amearudaedo, awiatugu inoba inagomode ure irojaiwu biagai.
source: Du kodi Icare Gad ure tuburedo Davi ji, akore ji inoba akaidure boewo ai? - Boe eke boi butuwo boe ewugeje jorui pobe ma jewu metuia bokware dutabo? - Iarema aregoduwo ari pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du tonaji onare aiwuge etododai eemarui awogai dutabo? - Iarema boe ekogodae pegarewu jetuwo jorui pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du reore aeture jiwu moto keje? Amearudaedo, awiatugu inoba inagomode ure irojaiwu biagai.

b: Davi akore oino Gadji ikiarigodu kuricigore, mare ure turugadu pawuduwo Pao iera keje, okudu oiagudu kuricigore kodi, mare pawudui ime ekera kejedu karega.
source: Davi akore oino Gadji ikiarigodu kuricigore, mare ure turugadu pawuduwo Pao iera keje, okudu oiagudu kuricigore kodi, mare pawudui ime ekera kejedu karega.

b: Icare Davi aidure boe ekogodaeji. Boere tugeragu trigo enariji du kodiwu keje rabodu.
source: Icare Davi aidure boe ekogodaeji. Boere tugeragu trigo enariji du kodiwu keje rabodu.

b: Du kodi Icare Paore ia boe ekogodae pegarewu jetudo Israeldogei, nowu meri piji jii ia kodiboe kae; Icare, Dan piji jii Bersabéia kae, bireboere 7...
source: Du kodi Icare Paore ia boe ekogodae pegarewu jetudo Israeldogei, nowu meri piji jii ia kodiboe kae; Icare, Dan piji jii Bersabéia kae, bireboere 7...

b: Paore ia to tupa arego Jerusalém kae uwo jeta kedodo. Mare kuri je okudugodure nowu boe pega kuricigoredu koia; Icare akore nowu ure boe eeda kedodowu tupaji urugadu! Akera puredu kaba ei pugeje. Pao o tupa rakojere Areuna jebuseu o trigo pa puredu.
source: Paore ia to tupa arego Jerusalém kae uwo jeta kedodo. Mare kuri je okudugodure nowu boe pega kuricigoredu koia; Icare akore nowu ure boe eeda kedodowu tupaji urugadu! Akera puredu kaba ei pugeje. Pao o tupa rakojere Areuna jebuseu o trigo pa puredu.

b: Icare Davi, tuiordui nowu tupa rorerui boe ji dukeje, akore oino Pao ji imire iro pegare, ire boe pegarewu towuje. Awu barege kugure rema inoba erore? Akerado boe pegado ii, ioga uwaiji.
source: Icare Davi, tuiordui nowu tupa rorerui boe ji dukeje, akore oino Pao ji imire iro pegare, ire boe pegarewu towuje. Awu barege kugure rema inoba erore? Akerado boe pegado ii, ioga uwaiji.

b: Judite oredu iere Manasés, duwu bire boe ji cevada kado dukeje; meri joku urugu ro pegare ji, oebatodui boe ji cevada opodo dutabo. Bire to bakurirewu Betúlia keje; tugududodure mototo tuomage ebo, moto padui Dotain, Balamon, etoiadoda du tada.
source: Judite oredu iere Manasés, duwu bire boe ji cevada kado dukeje; meri joku urugu ro pegare ji, oebatodui boe ji cevada opodo dutabo. Bire to bakurirewu Betúlia keje; tugududodure mototo tuomage ebo, moto padui Dotain, Balamon, etoiadoda du tada.

b: Jorure pobe ma jewu metuia bokware pobe puibijidu oiado Judite oredu okware piji dukeje.
source: Jorure pobe ma jewu metuia bokware pobe puibijidu oiado Judite oredu okware piji dukeje.

b: Ure ia tumuga pemegado tuwai mugui tumeduia aogejedu keje; nonore ure tugera opodo pudabo, tugarege areme ebo. Ure ia tujebae epa bu tubeagajeje, tugudae corewu ure tugu tugu pudui; otorogare pudui meri jameduji tu tu je tugoadu tonaji; mare sábado keje, ari rutu boe keje, Israeldoge eegarei puduidu boe keje, otorogakare pudui.
source: Ure ia tumuga pemegado tuwai mugui tumeduia aogejedu keje; nonore ure tugera opodo pudabo, tugarege areme ebo. Ure ia tujebae epa bu tubeagajeje, tugudae corewu ure tugu tugu pudui; otorogare pudui meri jameduji tu tu je tugoadu tonaji; mare sábado keje, ari rutu boe keje, Israeldoge eegarei puduidu boe keje, otorogakare pudui.

b: Je motu remawu nure, jordu aidugirire boe ji. Oredu Manasesre meriri ekurewu, meriri kigadurewu jetudo apo, ure tudugarege areme, ime, eedudo apo, ure moto maerewu jetudo apo jamedu, du ure inodu padu pemegado pudabo kimo. Iaboe iaboe emago pegakare ji, pagudu kuricigore Paoce kodi.
source: Je motu remawu nure, jordu aidugirire boe ji. Oredu Manasesre meriri ekurewu, meriri kigadurewu jetudo apo, ure tudugarege areme, ime, eedudo apo, ure moto maerewu jetudo apo jamedu, du ure inodu padu pemegado pudabo kimo. Iaboe iaboe emago pegakare ji, pagudu kuricigore Paoce kodi.

b: Nowu du kodi Mardoqueu akore Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, akire boe emago pemegare ai.
source: Nowu du kodi Mardoqueu akore Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, akire boe emago pemegare ai.

b: Ikimejera, Ikimejera, Boe Eimejera ro rakarewu, boe jamedu boe mugure aro raka kuda, iaboe iaboe emodukare tudugu awadaru kuda, akaidui awo Israeldoge einorudo dukeje.
source: Ikimejera, Ikimejera, Boe Eimejera ro rakarewu, boe jamedu boe mugure aro raka kuda, iaboe iaboe emodukare tudugu awadaru kuda, akaidui awo Israeldoge einorudo dukeje.

b: Are baru, moto, towuje, are baru kudaboe jamedu boe towuje.
source: Are baru, moto, towuje, are baru kudaboe jamedu boe towuje.

b: Akire akore boe jamedu boece, iaboe iaboe emodukare tudugu aro raka kuda.
source: Akire akore boe jamedu boece, iaboe iaboe emodukare tudugu aro raka kuda.

b: Akire aerduware, Ikimejera, ire irugadu iwo inogwa mi Amã bureji, Israeldogewo cinorudo du bogai.
source: Akire aerduware, Ikimejera, ire irugadu iwo inogwa mi Amã bureji, Israeldogewo cinorudo du bogai.

b: Ikiarire irowo inoduji ikawo ia imedu urugu mugudo arugu bukajeje. Imodukare iejodo iaboe etai, mare akai tu rugadu, Pao Aroe Eimejera.
source: Ikiarire irowo inoduji ikawo ia imedu urugu mugudo arugu bukajeje. Imodukare iejodo iaboe etai, mare akai tu rugadu, Pao Aroe Eimejera.

b: Icare, Pao Boe Eimejera, Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, akaba boe puredo awobei! Emearudaere tuwo ceeda kedodo, etaidure tuwo boture apijiboe mariguduwu boe eeda kedodo.
source: Icare, Pao Boe Eimejera, Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, akaba boe puredo awobei! Emearudaere tuwo ceeda kedodo, etaidure tuwo boture apijiboe mariguduwu boe eeda kedodo.

b: Akaba awu awobe eiwo pegado, are etaru Egito piji akaidu.
source: Akaba awu awobe eiwo pegado, are etaru Egito piji akaidu.

b: Awiapagado inogwamagudui ai duji, akerabraredo akaiwugei, ceegare mugudo cegiarigodu mugato. Du keje ceemode cewo akie kurido, Ikimejera, mare akaba okwa jerebarire akabowuge emago bokwado.
source: Awiapagado inogwamagudui ai duji, akerabraredo akaiwugei, ceegare mugudo cegiarigodu mugato. Du keje ceemode cewo akie kurido, Ikimejera, mare akaba okwa jerebarire akabowuge emago bokwado.

b: Nowu du kodi Brae Eimejerago Ester, tugiarigodu kuricigo tabo, uture Pao ae, okwamagudure oino Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ji, akore Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, boe emago pemegare ai. Mato, akerabraredo ii, ire ikinoigodu kodi, iaboe iaboekare tuwo tugerabraredo ii apiji, Pao Aroe Eimejera. Imi remawu ire imago boe puredugodui ii du kae. Pao Aroe Eimejera, imearudure, iedagamege eno bapera piji, akie akaidure jiwuge einorudo jii boe oto kae. Du kodi icare, mato, akerabraredo marenaru ii. Bataru moturewu bu inogwa keje, imugumode adugo agarewu jekai dukeje, uwabo tududo tugorigoduwo onare ceiwuji, jeta kedowo tumedage eiamedu apo. Ceginorudo onare ceiwuge ekera piji; ceegareaedo cemarenarudaece, cebemegado ceiwaece.
source: Nowu du kodi Brae Eimejerago Ester, tugiarigodu kuricigo tabo, uture Pao ae, okwamagudure oino Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ji, akore Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, boe emago pemegare ai. Mato, akerabraredo ii, ire ikinoigodu kodi, iaboe iaboekare tuwo tugerabraredo ii apiji, Pao Aroe Eimejera. Imi remawu ire imago boe puredugodui ii du kae. Pao Aroe Eimejera, imearudure, iedagamege eno bapera piji, akie akaidure jiwuge einorudo jii boe oto kae. Du kodi icare, mato, akerabraredo marenaru ii. Bataru moturewu bu inogwa keje, imugumode adugo agarewu jekai dukeje, uwabo tududo tugorigoduwo onare ceiwuji, jeta kedowo tumedage eiamedu apo. Ceginorudo onare ceiwuge ekera piji; ceegareaedo cemarenarudaece, cebemegado ceiwaece.

b: Nowu meri keje, Ester ure brae eimejeragere tugu puduiwu tugudae pemegarewu tugu pudui, dukeje ure turagojedo brae eimejera mugurewu otodai. Brae eimejera mugure tumuga keje, brae eimejerage ewai tada baiporo jekai. Jordui nowu brae eimejerago jitu keje kuri je, nowu braedu ure uwabodo tugeragu pudui; icare ure boe eimejerage ekedure jiboe meriri ekurewu raido ai, icare Ester ure tuburedo ji, tugera jetuwo ji.
source: Nowu meri keje, Ester ure brae eimejeragere tugu puduiwu tugudae pemegarewu tugu pudui, dukeje ure turagojedo brae eimejera mugurewu otodai. Brae eimejera mugure tumuga keje, brae eimejerage ewai tada baiporo jekai. Jordui nowu brae eimejerago jitu keje kuri je, nowu braedu ure uwabodo tugeragu pudui; icare ure boe eimejerage ekedure jiboe meriri ekurewu raido ai, icare Ester ure tuburedo ji, tugera jetuwo ji.

b: Du keje icare brae eimejera akore oino ji kaboba jiba akogwa magudumode? Kaboba jiba akaidure irowo? Ia dukeje imode ieture jiwu moto kado oiado akai.
source: Du keje icare brae eimejera akore oino ji kaboba jiba akogwa magudumode? Kaboba jiba akaidure irowo? Ia dukeje imode ieture jiwu moto kado oiado akai.

b: Icare Ester akore oino ji Ikimejera, aerdu pemegamode ii dukeje, akaidu keje, iedo: inogwa magudumode jiboe reo; iwobe einorudo: itaidure jiboe reo!
source: Icare Ester akore oino ji Ikimejera, aerdu pemegamode ii dukeje, akaidu keje, iedo: inogwa magudumode jiboe reo; iwobe einorudo: itaidure jiboe reo!

b: Boewo nono Pao batarure Jeremias ja pijidu. Du kodire Paore Pérsia kejewu brae eimejera Ciro mearudae pemegarewu maku ai, jorui mito brae eimejerai ema dutabo. Du kodire nowu Pérsia kejewu brae eimejera Ciro ure bapera atugodo mugure to moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etai, tagoi oino dutabo oinore Pérsia kejewuge eimejera Ciro akore Aroe Eimejera baru tadawu ure boe epadui pumekejewu boe makuinai; akore iiagu ia tuwai towuje Jerusalém bakurirewu keje, Judá moto keje.
source: Boewo nono Pao batarure Jeremias ja pijidu. Du kodire Paore Pérsia kejewu brae eimejera Ciro mearudae pemegarewu maku ai, jorui mito brae eimejerai ema dutabo. Du kodire nowu Pérsia kejewu brae eimejera Ciro ure bapera atugodo mugure to moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etai, tagoi oino dutabo oinore Pérsia kejewuge eimejera Ciro akore Aroe Eimejera baru tadawu ure boe epadui pumekejewu boe makuinai; akore iiagu ia tuwai towuje Jerusalém bakurirewu keje, Judá moto keje.

b: Kakoduwu tagiba taeonare nowu boe ji? Eno Aroe Eimejera muguwo tagabo. Tarududo toro Jerusalém kae, tawo Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera uwai towuje.
source: Kakoduwu tagiba taeonare nowu boe ji? Eno Aroe Eimejera muguwo tagabo. Tarududo toro Jerusalém kae, tawo Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera uwai towuje.

b: Boe eedure Judá keje kimowuge ebo, emode tugera braredo, meriri ekurewu, meriri kigadurewu tabo, tuge tabo, tuguiee tabo, taidure jiboe tabo, Pao mugure Jerusalém kejewu uwaice.
source: Boe eedure Judá keje kimowuge ebo, emode tugera braredo, meriri ekurewu, meriri kigadurewu tabo, tuge tabo, tuguiee tabo, taidure jiboe tabo, Pao mugure Jerusalém kejewu uwaice.

b: Du keje icare Judá uwobe eimejerage, Benjamim uwobe eimejerage, Pao o burejoiage, levitadoge, aidure Pao jiwuge eiamedu boe, ere turagojedo tuwo Pao uwai towuje, Jerusalém keje.
source: Du keje icare Judá uwobe eimejerage, Benjamim uwobe eimejerage, Pao o burejoiage, levitadoge, aidure Pao jiwuge eiamedu boe, ere turagojedo tuwo Pao uwai towuje, Jerusalém keje.

b: Mugu puredure eiwuge ere turoiware taboboe jamedu boe maku etai: meriri kigadure, meriri ekurewu, boe eke, boe eeguiee, boe enoroe mori kuricigorewu; iage ere tumagu taidu tabo jamedu.
source: Mugu puredure eiwuge ere turoiware taboboe jamedu boe maku etai: meriri kigadure, meriri ekurewu, boe eke, boe eeguiee, boe enoroe mori kuricigorewu; iage ere tumagu taidu tabo jamedu.

b: Nowu kodi, brae eimejera Dário ure bapera atugodo brae eimejerage eedui Eufrates okwa bakowu kejewuge etai, tagoi oino dutabo boe emaragodui Aroe Eimejera uwai jiwuge emaragodu rugadu. Judeudoge eimejerage, codureuge ewo nowu bai towuje tumuga keje.
source: Nowu kodi, brae eimejera Dário ure bapera atugodo brae eimejerage eedui Eufrates okwa bakowu kejewuge etai, tagoi oino dutabo boe emaragodui Aroe Eimejera uwai jiwuge emaragodu rugadu. Judeudoge eimejerage, codureuge ewo nowu bai towuje tumuga keje.

b: Ire bapera atugodo Taromodedu tabo, nowu codureuge etai ewo Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado. Nowu pobo okwa bakowu kejewuge emode nuwu brae eimejera aiboe maku nowu maragodureuge etai, enoe, eke boe morice, ekawo tumaragodaedo tuwuredo.
source: Ire bapera atugodo Taromodedu tabo, nowu codureuge etai ewo Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado. Nowu pobo okwa bakowu kejewuge emode nuwu brae eimejera aiboe maku nowu maragodureuge etai, enoe, eke boe morice, ekawo tumaragodaedo tuwuredo.

b: Brae eimejera Dariore imi imagore oino, tarowo oino rugadu.
source: Brae eimejera Dariore imi imagore oino, tarowo oino rugadu.

b: Nowu codurewu judeudoge emaragodure taidu tabo, profeta Ageu bataru rekodaji. Zacarias, Ido onaregedu bataru rekodaji jamedu; ere towujedu akedudo, Pao Israeldoge Eno Aroe Eimejera aidu rekodaji. Círio, Dário, Artaxerxes, Pérsia kejewu brae eimejerage etaidu rekodaji jamedu.
source: Nowu codurewu judeudoge emaragodure taidu tabo, profeta Ageu bataru rekodaji. Zacarias, Ido onaregedu bataru rekodaji jamedu; ere towujedu akedudo, Pao Israeldoge Eno Aroe Eimejera aidu rekodaji. Círio, Dário, Artaxerxes, Pérsia kejewu brae eimejerage etaidu rekodaji jamedu.

b: Emaragodure nowu Pao uwaiji jii, Adar o ari kejewu meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du kae, jorui ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto, brae eimejerai Dário cedu tabo.
source: Emaragodure nowu Pao uwaiji jii, Adar o ari kejewu meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du kae, jorui ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto, brae eimejerai Dário cedu tabo.

b: Du keje icare, judeudoge, Pao burejoiage, levitadoge, ia aregodure nonowu ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge, ere tuiegaredo nowu Pao uwai todu akedure duji.
source: Du keje icare, judeudoge, Pao burejoiage, levitadoge, ia aregodure nonowu ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge, ere tuiegaredo nowu Pao uwai todu akedure duji.

b: Ere tapiradoge ekodure maiwuge emagaguragado, ere carneirodoge emagaguragado, ere maku Pao ai, ere cabritodoge ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwure awubowutodu maku Israeldoge eiamedu boe eparu tabo, epadui pumekejedu reore.
source: Ere tapiradoge ekodure maiwuge emagaguragado, ere carneirodoge emagaguragado, ere maku Pao ai, ere cabritodoge ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwure awubowutodu maku Israeldoge eiamedu boe eparu tabo, epadui pumekejedu reore.

b: Ere sacerdotedoge, levitadoge eedudo tu tu tumaragodae boe keje, emaragoduwo Pao ai Jerusalém keje, padu magai Moisés o bapera kejedu reore.
source: Ere sacerdotedoge, levitadoge eedudo tu tu tumaragodae boe keje, emaragoduwo Pao ai Jerusalém keje, padu magai Moisés o bapera kejedu reore.

b: Aregodure ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge ere Páscoa towuje inodu rekodaji, boetojiwu ari kejewu merire ikera pudogidure buture iwure awubowuto pobe puibijiwu keje.
source: Aregodure ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge ere Páscoa towuje inodu rekodaji, boetojiwu ari kejewu merire ikera pudogidure buture iwure awubowuto pobe puibijiwu keje.

b: Levitadoge eiamedu boe ere tubemegado, du kodire eiamedu boe ewabo pemegare: ere Páscoa jiwu cordeirodoge ewido, aregodure ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge etai, tumanamage Pao burejoiage etai, tuiamedu boe etai.
source: Levitadoge eiamedu boe ere tubemegado, du kodire eiamedu boe ewabo pemegare: ere Páscoa jiwu cordeirodoge ewido, aregodure ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge etai, tumanamage Pao burejoiage etai, tuiamedu boe etai.

b: Meri rekodu tabo, boe ji tomea maku Pao ai dukeje, Esdras imi, ire ikiarigodu barigu ipiji, ikudae mega megai iiogi dutabo, iwudure ipojô tabo, ire ikera aogado Ioga Aroe Eimejera bogai.
source: Meri rekodu tabo, boe ji tomea maku Pao ai dukeje, Esdras imi, ire ikiarigodu barigu ipiji, ikudae mega megai iiogi dutabo, iwudure ipojô tabo, ire ikera aogado Ioga Aroe Eimejera bogai.

b: Inagore oino ji ino Aroe Eimejera, ipogurure, imorora amagadure ii ie aogado awogai dukeje. Paga karega, cero pegarewu itodure cedaogeje kodi; cero pegarewu kuricigoredu aregodure baruto.
source: Inagore oino ji ino Aroe Eimejera, ipogurure, imorora amagadure ii ie aogado awogai dukeje. Paga karega, cero pegarewu itodure cedaogeje kodi; cero pegarewu kuricigoredu aregodure baruto.

b: Ia boe ero pegarewu motudu nure cedaogeje jii ceomage epiji jii awu meri kae. Cero pega koiare, cegi, cegimejerage, ceno Pao burejoiage, cemagudure ia moto tuginoiwu kejewu brae eimejerage ekera kai, cemagudure toriga rairewu kai, boe erorerui ceidu kai, iwogu kigodureuge etai, cebogurae mugui cewugeje jii awu meri kaedu kai.
source: Ia boe ero pegarewu motudu nure cedaogeje jii ceomage epiji jii awu meri kae. Cero pega koiare, cegi, cegimejerage, ceno Pao burejoiage, cemagudure ia moto tuginoiwu kejewu brae eimejerage ekera kai, cemagudure toriga rairewu kai, boe erorerui ceidu kai, iwogu kigodureuge etai, cebogurae mugui cewugeje jii awu meri kaedu kai.

b: Oino, biega tu je, ceno Aroe Eimejera ure ceomage ekobo cegi ceragoje kimodo, ure cedo cemugudo tumuga pemegarewu keje. Oinore Pao aroe Eimejera aidure ceerduwo turuguji, tui ceragoje kimodo dutabo, boe erorerui ceidu oiado.
source: Oino, biega tu je, ceno Aroe Eimejera ure ceomage ekobo cegi ceragoje kimodo, ure cedo cemugudo tumuga pemegarewu keje. Oinore Pao aroe Eimejera aidure ceerduwo turuguji, tui ceragoje kimodo dutabo, boe erorerui ceidu oiado.

b: U! Boe jokodu, boe erorerure jiwugere cegi, mare ceno Aroe Eimejera ukare tugera ra cebiji, boe erorerui ceidu tonaji; dure karega, ure Pérsia kejewuge eimejerado turo pemegado cei, ure ceragoje kimodo cewo ceno Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado, cewo cegera pemegado pegadodureboeji; ure ia ceeda pemegado Judá keje.
source: U! Boe jokodu, boe erorerure jiwugere cegi, mare ceno Aroe Eimejera ukare tugera ra cebiji, boe erorerui ceidu tonaji; dure karega, ure Pérsia kejewuge eimejerado turo pemegado cei, ure ceragoje kimodo cewo ceno Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado, cewo cegera pemegado pegadodureboeji; ure ia ceeda pemegado Judá keje.

b: Nowu du kodi, Davire Israeldoge eiamedu boe eto pui Jerusalém keje ewo Pao o irá pemegarewu taru ture pemegadowu muga kae.
source: Nowu du kodi, Davire Israeldoge eiamedu boe eto pui Jerusalém keje ewo Pao o irá pemegarewu taru ture pemegadowu muga kae.

b: Davi makore Arão rekodajiwuge ewogai, Levitadoge ewogai jamedu.
source: Davi makore Arão rekodajiwuge ewogai, Levitadoge ewogai jamedu.

b: Levi ore ere Pao o irá pemegarewu aogado tui o iwara bu tuganaora keje dutabo, Moisés akore Pao bataru rekodajidu reore.
source: Levi ore ere Pao o irá pemegarewu aogado tui o iwara bu tuganaora keje dutabo, Moisés akore Pao bataru rekodajidu reore.

b: Davi makore Levitadoge eimejeragei eiagu uwiemage eonado turagodu turagoduwo, boe ekera enogwa akore jiboe tabo, harpadoge, citaradoge ka boe tabo, ewo tugera ako, togwa ako rakaguragado, tuiegare koia.
source: Davi makore Levitadoge eimejeragei eiagu uwiemage eonado turagodu turagoduwo, boe ekera enogwa akore jiboe tabo, harpadoge, citaradoge ka boe tabo, ewo tugera ako, togwa ako rakaguragado, tuiegare koia.

b: Tui Pao o irá pemegarewu remo dutabo, ere mugudo Divire pemegado bogaiwu aroia bai oiadoda. Ere tomea boe ku bokwarewu maku.
source: Tui Pao o irá pemegarewu remo dutabo, ere mugudo Divire pemegado bogaiwu aroia bai oiadoda. Ere tomea boe ku bokwarewu maku.

b: Nowu ei tomea boe ku bokwarewu maku durekodaji, Davire togwamu boe eiogi Pao ie tabo.
source: Nowu ei tomea boe ku bokwarewu maku durekodaji, Davire togwamu boe eiogi Pao ie tabo.

b: Nowu du kodi boe eimejera Salomão, Israeldoge eiamedu boe ei tudo pui apodu, Pao o irá pemegarewu jekai, ere tomea barege kugure, tapiradoge, emagaguragado, du kodire boe eerduwakare kaiba enodo padure.
source: Nowu du kodi boe eimejera Salomão, Israeldoge eiamedu boe ei tudo pui apodu, Pao o irá pemegarewu jekai, ere tomea barege kugure, tapiradoge, emagaguragado, du kodire boe eerduwakare kaiba enodo padure.

b: Pao burejoiagere nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu reko tumuga kae Pao uwai pemegarewu remawu tada, tupadoge eigodo kuda; tupadoge ere cigodo jado nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu joki, o iwaradoge ei pobedu joki jamedu.
source: Pao burejoiagere nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu reko tumuga kae Pao uwai pemegarewu remawu tada, tupadoge eigodo kuda; tupadoge ere cigodo jado nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu joki, o iwaradoge ei pobedu joki jamedu.

b: Nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu mugure nono jii awu meri kae.
source: Nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu mugure nono jii awu meri kae.

b: Iaboe iaboe metukare nowu irá pemegarewu tada, mare tu boe eroiagudu padure kejewu tori boarewu ui pobedu, Moisesre mugudo tadawu, Paoi tuwadaru maku Israeldoge etai dukeje, ei tudawuje Egito pijidu kejewu, mugure tada.
source: Iaboe iaboe metukare nowu irá pemegarewu tada, mare tu boe eroiagudu padure kejewu tori boarewu ui pobedu, Moisesre mugudo tadawu, Paoi tuwadaru maku Israeldoge etai dukeje, ei tudawuje Egito pijidu kejewu, mugure tada.

b: Kuri je, tumagai mito tu je du reore, meriri iworewu epage, urareuge, ere tudo mito tu je tuiaruru tabo, tuiegarei Pao jitu tabo.
source: Kuri je, tumagai mito tu je du reore, meriri iworewu epage, urareuge, ere tudo mito tu je tuiaruru tabo, tuiegarei Pao jitu tabo.

b: Meriri iworewu, ka boe, boe ekera akore jiboe boe, boe enogwa akore jiboe boe ego utonaji, boe emearudure boe egoi Pao jituji pemegaguragare kodi, okudu oiagudure boe ebo jii je kodi.
source: Meriri iworewu, ka boe, boe ekera akore jiboe boe, boe enogwa akore jiboe boe ego utonaji, boe emearudure boe egoi Pao jituji pemegaguragare kodi, okudu oiagudure boe ebo jii je kodi.

b: Nowu Pao uwai korobadure boetugu corewu tabo, du kodire Pao burejoiage eroiwakare tumaragodaeji.
source: Nowu Pao uwai korobadure boetugu corewu tabo, du kodire Pao burejoiage eroiwakare tumaragodaeji.

b: Paore tuwai korobadudo turugu tabo kodi.
source: Paore tuwai korobadudo turugu tabo kodi.

b: Du kodi icare Salomão akore Pao aidure tumuguwo boe eerdukare pudui boe tada, mare ire awai towuje, amuguwo tada jii je.
source: Du kodi icare Salomão akore Pao aidure tumuguwo boe eerdukare pudui boe tada, mare ire awai towuje, amuguwo tada jii je.

b: Joiada bi rekodaji, nowu Judá kejewuge eimejerage etaregodure tuwo tubujodo nowu brae eimejera kurirewu Joasji.
source: Joiada bi rekodaji, nowu Judá kejewuge eimejerage etaregodure tuwo tubujodo nowu brae eimejera kurirewu Joasji.

b: Nowu brae eimejera kurirewu ure tuwiapagado ei.
source: Nowu brae eimejera kurirewu ure tuwiapagado ei.

b: Du tabore icare ere tugera ra tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera uwai piji, ere tubujodo Aroe Eimejerakare emaboe ji; ere Pao korigo Judá kejewugei, Jerusalém kejewugei, awu ero pegarewu koia.
source: Du tabore icare ere tugera ra tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera uwai piji, ere tubujodo Aroe Eimejerakare emaboe ji; ere Pao korigo Judá kejewugei, Jerusalém kejewugei, awu ero pegarewu koia.

b: Paore profetadoge emagodo ei ewo tugirimi Aroe Eimejera ae, mare ewiapagakare egoi pudui duji.
source: Paore profetadoge emagodo ei ewo tugirimi Aroe Eimejera ae, mare ewiapagakare egoi pudui duji.

b: Du kodi icare Pao Utaroere turemo Zacaria, Pao burejoia Joiada onaregeduto, dure icare uture boe etae, akore ei oinore Pao akore Kodiba tawiapagakare Paoi boe eroiaguduji, du kodi icare boe pemegakare tai pugeje? Tare tagera ra Pao piji, du kodire ure tugera ra tabiji jamedu!
source: Du kodi icare Pao Utaroere turemo Zacaria, Pao burejoia Joiada onaregeduto, dure icare uture boe etae, akore ei oinore Pao akore Kodiba tawiapagakare Paoi boe eroiaguduji, du kodi icare boe pemegakare tai pugeje? Tare tagera ra Pao piji, du kodire ure tugera ra tabiji jamedu!

b: Du kodi icare. Ere taogado jokorai, brae eimejera kurirewu ure edo bito tori tabo.
source: Du kodi icare. Ere taogado jokorai, brae eimejera kurirewu ure edo bito tori tabo.

b: Brae eimejera kurirewu Joás biagodure tuo Joiada roi pudai dupiji, ure onaregedu bito, dure akore oino tuwi tabo Pao umode tugogado awu inoduji.
source: Brae eimejera kurirewu Joás biagodure tuo Joiada roi pudai dupiji, ure onaregedu bito, dure akore oino tuwi tabo Pao umode tugogado awu inoduji.

b: Du tabore icare, nowu jorui mitodu akedu keje, Arameia kejewu tugobaigarege eture Joás togi, ere turemo Judá mototo, Jerusalém bakurireuto, ere boe imejerage eiamedu boe eeda kedodo, ere boe enoroe jamedu boe maku Damasco kejewu brae eimejera ai.
source: Du tabore icare, nowu jorui mitodu akedu keje, Arameia kejewu tugobaigarege eture Joás togi, ere turemo Judá mototo, Jerusalém bakurireuto, ere boe imejerage eiamedu boe eeda kedodo, ere boe enoroe jamedu boe maku Damasco kejewu brae eimejera ai.

b: Aram o tugobaigarege emagagirikare mare Paore ia tugobaigarege emagaguragareuge emagu ai, awuge ere tugera ra tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera piji kodi. Oinore ere tugogado Joasji.
source: Aram o tugobaigarege emagagirikare mare Paore ia tugobaigarege emagaguragareuge emagu ai, awuge ere tugera ra tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera piji kodi. Oinore ere tugogado Joasji.

b: Eture piji tui kuridodu kuricigodo dutabo; dukeje icare utugarege emago pegare ji, ure Joiada onaregedu bito dukoia, icare ere bito tuba keje. Oinore bire, ere tugu Davi bakurirewu keje, mare brae eimejerage kurireuge emedu emedure tadawu tada karega.
source: Eture piji tui kuridodu kuricigodo dutabo; dukeje icare utugarege emago pegare ji, ure Joiada onaregedu bito dukoia, icare ere bito tuba keje. Oinore bire, ere tugu Davi bakurirewu keje, mare brae eimejerage kurireuge emedu emedure tadawu tada karega.

b: Nowu du kodi, Pao burejoiage eimejerage, boe eiamedu boe ere turo pega kuricigodo. Ere turodo nono kruca padukare kejewuge ero reore. Ewiapagakare turoi Pao uwai todui Jerusalém keje duji.
source: Nowu du kodi, Pao burejoiage eimejerage, boe eiamedu boe ere turo pega kuricigodo. Ere turodo nono kruca padukare kejewuge ero reore. Ewiapagakare turoi Pao uwai todui Jerusalém keje duji.

b: Mare etuomage eno Aroe Eimejera ure boe erojai tu tu ewogai, okudure tuwobe ebo, tuwai pemegarewu apo, kodi.
source: Mare etuomage eno Aroe Eimejera ure boe erojai tu tu ewogai, okudure tuwobe ebo, tuwai pemegarewu apo, kodi.

b: Mare ere tuwadaru kedaedo Paore rojaiwugei, ewiapagakare ewadaruji, ere togwari omeado profetadogei.
source: Mare ere tuwadaru kedaedo Paore rojaiwugei, ewiapagakare ewadaruji, ere togwari omeado profetadogei.

b: Du kodi icare Pao korigodui tuwobe eidu oto padukare.
source: Du kodi icare Pao korigodui tuwobe eidu oto padukare.

b: Du kodi icare onare eiwuge ere joru tugu Pao uwaito, ere aiare Jerusalém tabowu moto ri rugadu butudo, ere joru tugu Jerusalém kejewu bai kurireuge eiamedu boeto, ere enoroe mori kuricigorewu rugadu pegado.
source: Du kodi icare onare eiwuge ere joru tugu Pao uwaito, ere aiare Jerusalém tabowu moto ri rugadu butudo, ere joru tugu Jerusalém kejewu bai kurireuge eiamedu boeto, ere enoroe mori kuricigorewu rugadu pegado.

b: Nowu inodu rekodaji, brae eimejera Nabucodonosor ure rakoje kimoreuge eiamedu boe erego Babilônia kae, du kodi icare ere Nabucodonosor utugaregedo pudumi, ere nowu brae eimejera ore etugaregedo pudumi jamedu, jii Persa kejewuge eimejera jeture nowu moto jiboe kae.
source: Nowu inodu rekodaji, brae eimejera Nabucodonosor ure rakoje kimoreuge eiamedu boe erego Babilônia kae, du kodi icare ere Nabucodonosor utugaregedo pudumi, ere nowu brae eimejera ore etugaregedo pudumi jamedu, jii Persa kejewuge eimejera jeture nowu moto jiboe kae.

b: Oinore boe kodure Pao akoi Jeremias ja pijidu reore. Motore tamudo boe erorerui ei du tonaji jii jorure 70 cedu kae.
source: Oinore boe kodure Pao akoi Jeremias ja pijidu reore. Motore tamudo boe erorerui ei du tonaji jii jorure 70 cedu kae.

b: Du keje icare, Persa kejewuge eimejerai Ciro cedu boetojiwu joru keje, Paore brae eimejera Ciro roto nono tuwadaru aregodui Jeremias ja pijidu reore.
source: Du keje icare, Persa kejewuge eimejerai Ciro cedu boetojiwu joru keje, Paore brae eimejera Ciro roto nono tuwadaru aregodui Jeremias ja pijidu reore.

b: Cirore boedo boe awadudo to moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etai, tuwadaru tabo, bapera atugo tabo, tagoi oino dutabo oinore Persa kejewu brae eimejera Ciro akore Pao baru tadawu ure moto jamedu boe mugudo ikera keje. Ure ido ia tuwai to Jerusalém, Judá kejewu bakurirewu, keje. Jeonare awu boe eiboe, tadudo toro, tago Aroe Eimejera muguwo tagabo.
source: Cirore boedo boe awadudo to moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etai, tuwadaru tabo, bapera atugo tabo, tagoi oino dutabo oinore Persa kejewu brae eimejera Ciro akore Pao baru tadawu ure moto jamedu boe mugudo ikera keje. Ure ido ia tuwai to Jerusalém, Judá kejewu bakurirewu, keje. Jeonare awu boe eiboe, tadudo toro, tago Aroe Eimejera muguwo tagabo.

b: Ure tugogado boeiwuge eeture boe ei du kodiwu keje, boe eke boi buture nowu moto keje, dukeje Icare ia Judá o moto kejewu bakurirewu iei Belém cedu kejewu ia imedu uture toreduje apo, tore kugurei pobe tu jedu apo, tumugu koboriwo Moab o moto keje.
source: Ure tugogado boeiwuge eeture boe ei du kodiwu keje, boe eke boi buture nowu moto keje, dukeje Icare ia Judá o moto kejewu bakurirewu iei Belém cedu kejewu ia imedu uture toreduje apo, tore kugurei pobe tu jedu apo, tumugu koboriwo Moab o moto keje.

b: Imedu iere Elimelec, oredu iere Noemi, ore ei pobedu ekiere Maalon masre Quelion.
source: Imedu iere Elimelec, oredu iere Noemi, ore ei pobedu ekiere Maalon masre Quelion.

b: Du keje Icare Elimelec, Noemi oredu, bire, emare rakojere tuginoigodu tore kugure ebo.
source: Du keje Icare Elimelec, Noemi oredu, bire, emare rakojere tuginoigodu tore kugure ebo.

b: Awuge ere tugera maku Moab kejewu areme etai, duwuge ia iere Orfa, metuia iere Rute. Eedure nono jorui ikera pudogidu reore.
source: Awuge ere tugera maku Moab kejewu areme etai, duwuge ia iere Orfa, metuia iere Rute. Eedure nono jorui ikera pudogidu reore.

b: Du keje, nowu ime ei pobedu, Maclon mare Quilion, ewire jamedu. Du kodi Icare nowu aredu rakojere tore bokwa tabo, tugoge bokwa tabo.
source: Du keje, nowu ime ei pobedu, Maclon mare Quilion, ewire jamedu. Du kodi Icare nowu aredu rakojere tore bokwa tabo, tugoge bokwa tabo.

b: Du kodi Icare cewu aredu ure turagojedo turagomage ei pobedu apo, tuwo tugirimi Moab moto piji pugeje; paga karega, mearudure boe egoi Paoi tugududo tuwobe ebo, tui amirewu maku etai dutabo duji.
source: Du kodi Icare cewu aredu ure turagojedo turagomage ei pobedu apo, tuwo tugirimi Moab moto piji pugeje; paga karega, mearudure boe egoi Paoi tugududo tuwobe ebo, tui amirewu maku etai dutabo duji.

b: Icare etoragudure pugeje. Du kodi Icare Orfare togwabi tujarugoji, ure tugirimi tuwobe etae pugeje, mare Rute ukare tugera ra piji.
source: Icare etoragudure pugeje. Du kodi Icare Orfare togwabi tujarugoji, ure tugirimi tuwobe etae pugeje, mare Rute ukare tugera ra piji.

b: Du kodi Icare Noemi akore oino ji icare amedagore tugirimi tuwobe ewogai, to Aroe Eimejera bogai. Aki jamedu akirimi apo jamedu.
source: Du kodi Icare Noemi akore oino ji icare amedagore tugirimi tuwobe ewogai, to Aroe Eimejera bogai. Aki jamedu akirimi apo jamedu.

b: Mare Rute akore oino ji akao tugudu kaba ii, iwo ikera ra apiji, iwo iiaedo apiji, mare akodumodewo kae ikodumode jamedu; amode amugudowo keje, imode imugudo keje jamedu; iwobe nure awobece, ino Aroe Eimejera nure ako Aroe Eimejerace jamedu.
source: Mare Rute akore oino ji akao tugudu kaba ii, iwo ikera ra apiji, iwo iiaedo apiji, mare akodumodewo kae ikodumode jamedu; amode amugudowo keje, imode imugudo keje jamedu; iwobe nure awobece, ino Aroe Eimejera nure ako Aroe Eimejerace jamedu.

b: Oinore Noemire tugirimi Moab moto piji, turago Moab kejewudo Rute apo. Etaregodure Belém kae, boere tugera tugu cevada a jitu kae.
source: Oinore Noemire tugirimi Moab moto piji, turago Moab kejewudo Rute apo. Etaregodure Belém kae, boere tugera tugu cevada a jitu kae.

b: Noemi uwobere ia toredu uwobece, imedu oe kuricigorewu, Elimelec uwobe, iere Booz.
source: Noemi uwobere ia toredu uwobece, imedu oe kuricigorewu, Elimelec uwobe, iere Booz.

b: Rute moabita akore oino Noemi ji itudo boepato iwo ikeragu ia trigo imodoji, jewu imedu aidumode iiwu rekodaji. Noemi akore oino ji toro, itonaregedu!
source: Rute moabita akore oino Noemi ji itudo boepato iwo ikeragu ia trigo imodoji, jewu imedu aidumode iiwu rekodaji. Noemi akore oino ji toro, itonaregedu!

b: Uture boepato, ure tugeragu trigo imodoji ure trigo kadowuge ekera rekodaji, dure jiwo aidugirire nowu Booz o boepa kejegodu radu ure tugeragu nowu trigo imodoji, cewu Elimelec uwobe.
source: Uture boepato, ure tugeragu trigo imodoji ure trigo kadowuge ekera rekodaji, dure jiwo aidugirire nowu Booz o boepa kejegodu radu ure tugeragu nowu trigo imodoji, cewu Elimelec uwobe.

b: Du kodi Icare Elimelec akore oino Ruteji. Awiapagado, itonaregedu, akaba akeragu trigo imodoji ia toro, mare woe tu rugadu; akaba aiaedo awu piji, mare amedagedo itugarege aremece. Akaiwodo kakoduwu boepa kejeba emode trigo kado, ako eregodaji. Imagore itugaregei emago kawo ai. Pobo boimode ai ma, aku itugarege ere tawuje motoia pijiwu mugure epowari tadawu poboce.
source: Du kodi Icare Elimelec akore oino Ruteji. Awiapagado, itonaregedu, akaba akeragu trigo imodoji ia toro, mare woe tu rugadu; akaba aiaedo awu piji, mare amedagedo itugarege aremece. Akaiwodo kakoduwu boepa kejeba emode trigo kado, ako eregodaji. Imagore itugaregei emago kawo ai. Pobo boimode ai ma, aku itugarege ere tawuje motoia pijiwu mugure epowari tadawu poboce.

b: Du kodi Icare Rute ure tubujodo tui tuie jodo mototo, dutabo akore ji kaiba iwo aidugirire awiapagawo ii? Kode, ia moto tuginoiwu kejewudo nure imi.
source: Du kodi Icare Rute ure tubujodo tui tuie jodo mototo, dutabo akore ji kaiba iwo aidugirire awiapagawo ii? Kode, ia moto tuginoiwu kejewudo nure imi.

b: Booz akore oino ji boe ereadodure kobori kobori iwiagai arore acarugo jituji akoredu bi rekodaji, are akera ra ao piji, ace piji, ako moto piji, amuguwo ia aerduwakare jiwu boe etada.
source: Booz akore oino ji boe ereadodure kobori kobori iwiagai arore acarugo jituji akoredu bi rekodaji, are akera ra ao piji, ace piji, ako moto piji, amuguwo ia aerduwakare jiwu boe etada.

b: Du kodi Icare Boozre Rute mugudo pudabo, ure tugera maku ai, mugure apo, du kodi Icare, Pao aidu rekodaji, kuiarure, kuri buture ia tonaregedu apo.
source: Du kodi Icare Boozre Rute mugudo pudabo, ure tugera maku ai, mugure apo, du kodi Icare, Pao aidu rekodaji, kuiarure, kuri buture ia tonaregedu apo.

b: Du kodi Icare areme egore oino Noemi biagai boewo Pao akaru kurido, ukare ia aregodajiwu bokwado! Ie uwo tumaedo Israeloge etada, ierabrarewo ai apegagodu keje; paga karega, boture arago piji, dure pemegare ai akore emode ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du kori.
source: Du kodi Icare areme egore oino Noemi biagai boewo Pao akaru kurido, ukare ia aregodajiwu bokwado! Ie uwo tumaedo Israeloge etada, ierabrarewo ai apegagodu keje; paga karega, boture arago piji, dure pemegare ai akore emode ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du kori.

b: Du kodi Icare Noemire tugeragu negeduroguji, ure bu tugana keje, jeture ji uce mugato.
source: Du kodi Icare Noemire tugeragu negeduroguji, ure bu tugana keje, jeture ji uce mugato.

b: Mugu puredure jiwu metage egore Noemi negedurogu boture! Ure iedo Obed. Dure Jessé uo rema. Davi uore Jessece.
source: Mugu puredure jiwu metage egore Noemi negedurogu boture! Ure iedo Obed. Dure Jessé uo rema. Davi uore Jessece.

b: Nowu kodi, Israeldoge ere Pao aidukare jiboe towuje, ere tubujodo Baaldogei.
source: Nowu kodi, Israeldoge ere Pao aidukare jiboe towuje, ere tubujodo Baaldogei.

b: Ere tuboru barigu tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera ji, ure etawuje Egito pijidu, ekodure ia aroe eimejerage tuginoiwuge eregodaji, mugu puredure puduiwuge eno aroe eimejeragei, dutabo ere Pao korigo.
source: Ere tuboru barigu tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera ji, ure etawuje Egito pijidu, ekodure ia aroe eimejerage tuginoiwuge eregodaji, mugu puredure puduiwuge eno aroe eimejeragei, dutabo ere Pao korigo.

b: Ere tuiaedo Pao ji tuwo tubujodo Baal ji, Astartedogei.
source: Ere tuiaedo Pao ji tuwo tubujodo Baal ji, Astartedogei.

b: Du kodi Icare Pao korigodu kuricigore Israeldogei, ure emagu roarodureuge ekera kai, duwugere tugeragu enoe boeji; ure emagu mugu puredure eiwu onare eiwuge etai, du kodire Icare eroiwakare tuwo turodo ia turo onare puduiwugei.
source: Du kodi Icare Pao korigodu kuricigore Israeldogei, ure emagu roarodureuge ekera kai, duwugere tugeragu enoe boeji; ure emagu mugu puredure eiwu onare eiwuge etai, du kodire Icare eroiwakare tuwo turodo ia turo onare puduiwugei.

b: Erore ia turo dukeje, Pao iera motudure ewugeje, turo pegai ei dutabo, ture tuwadaru maku ei du reore, ure emorora amagadudodu rakaguragado pudui.
source: Erore ia turo dukeje, Pao iera motudure ewugeje, turo pegai ei dutabo, ture tuwadaru maku ei du reore, ure emorora amagadudodu rakaguragado pudui.

b: Paore ia ure tugogado boeiwuge emagu emagu etai, duwuge ere einoru einorudo rorerure eiwuge epiji.
source: Paore ia ure tugogado boeiwuge emagu emagu etai, duwuge ere einoru einorudo rorerure eiwuge epiji.

b: Mare boe ewiapagakare nowu ure tugogado boeiwuge ewadaruji jamedu; ere tumagu pagapagawu aroe eimejerage tuginoiwugei, ere tubujodo ei. Kuri je ere tuiaedo tuomage ekodure jiwu awara piji, duwugere emearutorure Pao o boe eroiaguduji, emagerema erokare ino.
source: Mare boe ewiapagakare nowu ure tugogado boeiwuge ewadaruji jamedu; ere tumagu pagapagawu aroe eimejerage tuginoiwugei, ere tubujodo ei. Kuri je ere tuiaedo tuomage ekodure jiwu awara piji, duwugere emearutorure Pao o boe eroiaguduji, emagerema erokare ino.

b: Paore ia ure tugogado boeiwu maku etai dukeje, turagojei apo du tonaji, ure einoru einorudo onare eiwuge erorerui ei dupiji, nowu ure tugogado boeiwu rakoje kimo tabo. Pao okudure akoi toragudu tabo duji, onare eiwuge erorerui eiwuge eigoia.
source: Paore ia ure tugogado boeiwu maku etai dukeje, turagojei apo du tonaji, ure einoru einorudo onare eiwuge erorerui ei dupiji, nowu ure tugogado boeiwu rakoje kimo tabo. Pao okudure akoi toragudu tabo duji, onare eiwuge erorerui eiwuge eigoia.

b: Mare nowu ure tugogado boeiwu okwa rekodaji, ere turo pega jagudo tuomage ekori, tudui aroe eimejerage pagapagareuge eregodaji tuwo tubujodo ji, ekare tugera ra ia turo pegarewu piji, du kodire ero pega kowodure.
source: Mare nowu ure tugogado boeiwu okwa rekodaji, ere turo pega jagudo tuomage ekori, tudui aroe eimejerage pagapagareuge eregodaji tuwo tubujodo ji, ekare tugera ra ia turo pegarewu piji, du kodire ero pega kowodure.

b: Nowu dukeje, Pao o tupare turawuje, ure tumugudo Ofra kejewu terebinto i paru, Joas, Abiezer uwobe o moto keje, onaregedu Gedeão ui trigo to boeji, tuwo biado madianitadoge epiji du tonaji.
source: Nowu dukeje, Pao o tupare turawuje, ure tumugudo Ofra kejewu terebinto i paru, Joas, Abiezer uwobe o moto keje, onaregedu Gedeão ui trigo to boeji, tuwo biado madianitadoge epiji du tonaji.

b: Nowu Pao o tupa aregodure ai, dutabo akore oino ji Pao muguwo akabo, tugobaigare ro rakarewu!
source: Nowu Pao o tupa aregodure ai, dutabo akore oino ji Pao muguwo akabo, tugobaigare ro rakarewu!

b: Icare Gedeão akore oino Ikimejera, inogwa magudumode ai: amugure cedabo ma, kodiba boere oino cei? Boe ero rakarewu towujedure paomage eegaiwu pa? Oinore egore cewiagai 'Paore cedawuje Egito piji'. Macare oino Paore tuiaedo cei, ure cemagu madianitadoge ekera kai.
source: Icare Gedeão akore oino Ikimejera, inogwa magudumode ai: amugure cedabo ma, kodiba boere oino cei? Boe ero rakarewu towujedure paomage eegaiwu pa? Oinore egore cewiagai 'Paore cedawuje Egito piji'. Macare oino Paore tuiaedo cei, ure cemagu madianitadoge ekera kai.

b: Mare Paore tuie kirimi ae, akore oino ji toro, nowu aduru tabo, amode Israeldoge einorudo madianitadoge erorerui ei dupiji. Imi karega ire atudo atudo toro?
source: Mare Paore tuie kirimi ae, akore oino ji toro, nowu aduru tabo, amode Israeldoge einorudo madianitadoge erorerui ei dupiji. Imi karega ire atudo atudo toro?

b: Gedeão akore Ikimejera, inoba imode Israeldoge einorudo? Iwobe ewiega remawure Manasés uwobe etada, imire ikodure boigodu ioga uwai keje.
source: Gedeão akore Ikimejera, inoba imode Israeldoge einorudo? Iwobe ewiega remawure Manasés uwobe etada, imire ikodure boigodu ioga uwai keje.

b: Pao akore oino ji iragojemode akabo, amode amorido madianitadogei emagai imedui mito tu je du reore.
source: Pao akore oino ji iragojemode akabo, amode amorido madianitadogei emagai imedui mito tu je du reore.

b: Gedeão akore aerdu pemegai ii dukeje, akaidumode awo ido boe pa ia aro jitu keje, inogwa magudumode ai atukawo awu piji jii imode ikirimi ia ino mea tabo akai.
source: Gedeão akore aerdu pemegai ii dukeje, akaidumode awo ido boe pa ia aro jitu keje, inogwa magudumode ai atukawo awu piji jii imode ikirimi ia ino mea tabo akai.

b: Pao akore u! Iragojemode jii woe, ai akirimidu kae.
source: Pao akore u! Iragojemode jii woe, ai akirimidu kae.

b: Gedeão uture, ure tugera pemegado ia cabritoji, ure ia amirewu towuje ia trigo kudu tabo; ure kodureboe tugu ia kodoraboto, ure kuru tugu ia ariato, ure reko toro 'carvalho' i paru kae, ure makuai.
source: Gedeão uture, ure tugera pemegado ia cabritoji, ure ia amirewu towuje ia trigo kudu tabo; ure kodureboe tugu ia kodoraboto, ure kuru tugu ia ariato, ure reko toro 'carvalho' i paru kae, ure makuai.

b: Icare Pao o tupa akore oino ji akeragu kodureboeji, amireuji, mugudo awu tori aogeje, kuru redo.
source: Icare Pao o tupa akore oino ji akeragu kodureboeji, amireuji, mugudo awu tori aogeje, kuru redo.

b: Gedeão mearutorure bataruji.
source: Gedeão mearutorure bataruji.

b: Du kodi Icare Pao o tupare nowu ure arego tugedui ji tu tabowu iwara aogado, ure oto jetudo nowu kodureboeji, nowu amireuji. Kuri je, joru aregodure nowu tori piji, dure ure nowu kodureboe, nowu amirewu rugadu akedudo, Icare Pao o tupa okware pi tuku joku piji.
source: Du kodi Icare Pao o tupare nowu ure arego tugedui ji tu tabowu iwara aogado, ure oto jetudo nowu kodureboeji, nowu amireuji. Kuri je, joru aregodure nowu tori piji, dure ure nowu kodureboe, nowu amirewu rugadu akedudo, Icare Pao o tupa okware pi tuku joku piji.

b: Du kodi Icare Gedeãore boe pa Pao Aroe Eimejera o tupa iure ema duji, Icare akore iui! Ikimejera Aroe Eimejera, iordure ako tupaji ioku awadu tabo!
source: Du kodi Icare Gedeãore boe pa Pao Aroe Eimejera o tupa iure ema duji, Icare akore iui! Ikimejera Aroe Eimejera, iordure ako tupaji ioku awadu tabo!

b: Mare Pao akore oino ji boe butugurewu muguwo akabo! Apagudu kaba! Awimoduka!
source: Mare Pao akore oino ji boe butugurewu muguwo akabo! Apagudu kaba! Awimoduka!

b: Icare Gedeão ure ia tori bu pu aogeje nono, ure iedo oino Pao ro butugurewu.
source: Icare Gedeão ure ia tori bu pu aogeje nono, ure iedo oino Pao ro butugurewu.

b: Nowu du kodi, Siquém kejewuge eiamedu boe, Bet-Melo kejewuge eiamedu boe, ere tudo pui, ere tugimejerado Abimelecce, puredu tu Siquém kejewu tori mugui paru kejeu 'carvalho' iji.
source: Nowu du kodi, Siquém kejewuge eiamedu boe, Bet-Melo kejewuge eiamedu boe, ere tudo pui, ere tugimejerado Abimelecce, puredu tu Siquém kejewu tori mugui paru kejeu 'carvalho' iji.

b: Boe ereadodui nowu inoduji Joatão biagai dukeje, awu ruture torekari Garizim ao kae, makore etai toiogwari tabo tawiapagado ii, Siquém kejewu boe, Pao mearuduwo tai!
source: Boe ereadodui nowu inoduji Joatão biagai dukeje, awu ruture torekari Garizim ao kae, makore etai toiogwari tabo tawiapagado ii, Siquém kejewu boe, Pao mearuduwo tai!

b: Ia boe keje itura boe etaidure tuwo tugimejerado ia iji pudai. Du kodi Icare egore oino 'oliva' iji: 'Cegimerado aki cenai! '
source: Ia boe keje itura boe etaidure tuwo tugimejerado ia iji pudai. Du kodi Icare egore oino 'oliva' iji: 'Cegimerado aki cenai! '

b: 'Oliva' i akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra boekaguru boture ipijiwu, dutabo boere Pao kurido, ime ekurido, dupiji, iwo imugudo iguru boe ewugeje? '
source: 'Oliva' i akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra boekaguru boture ipijiwu, dutabo boere Pao kurido, ime ekurido, dupiji, iwo imugudo iguru boe ewugeje? '

b: Du keje Icare iguru boe egore oino figueiraji 'Mato, awo cegimejerado aki cenai'.
source: Du keje Icare iguru boe egore oino figueiraji 'Mato, awo cegimejerado aki cenai'.

b: Akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra iwedu piji, itudu rorewu piji, iwo imugudo iguru boe ewugeje? '
source: Akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra iwedu piji, itudu rorewu piji, iwo imugudo iguru boe ewugeje? '

b: Du keje Icare iguru boe egore oino 'parera' ikuji: 'Mato, cegimejerawo aki du bogai! '
source: Du keje Icare iguru boe egore oino 'parera' ikuji: 'Mato, cegimejerawo aki du bogai! '

b: Mare nowu 'parera' iku akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra ure Pao, ime eegaredowu ikuru piji, iwo imugudo itura boe ewugeje? '
source: Mare nowu 'parera' iku akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra ure Pao, ime eegaredowu ikuru piji, iwo imugudo itura boe ewugeje? '

b: Du kodi Icare iguru boe eiamedu boe egore oino boto ikuji 'Mato, awo cegimejerado aki cenai! '
source: Du kodi Icare iguru boe eiamedu boe egore oino boto ikuji 'Mato, awo cegimejerado aki cenai! '

b: Icare nowu boto iku akore nowu iguru boe ji 'Tagaidumode tagimejerawo imi rugadu ma, mato, tagamudo itugu kuda; mare tagaidukare dukeje, joru aregodumode botoguru piji tuwo Líbano kejewu nowakodu iguru rugadu kowuje'.
source: Icare nowu boto iku akore nowu iguru boe ji 'Tagaidumode tagimejerawo imi rugadu ma, mato, tagamudo itugu kuda; mare tagaidukare dukeje, joru aregodumode botoguru piji tuwo Líbano kejewu nowakodu iguru rugadu kowuje'.

b: Nowu du kodi, Pao utaroere turaweje Jefté keje, dure kodure Galaad Manasés eno moto kajeje, Galaad kejewu Mispa kori, aregodure amonitadoge eno moto kae.
source: Nowu du kodi, Pao utaroere turaweje Jefté keje, dure kodure Galaad Manasés eno moto kajeje, Galaad kejewu Mispa kori, aregodure amonitadoge eno moto kae.

b: Jeftere tuwadaru maku Pao ai, tagoi oino dutabo amode amonitadoge emagu ikera kai ma, cewu utumode iwai poro piji itogiwu, ii ikirimi boe puredukai ii amonitadoge epiji dukeje, emare Pao Aroe Eimejera o mode ema, imode inomeado apo Pao ai:
source: Jeftere tuwadaru maku Pao ai, tagoi oino dutabo amode amonitadoge emagu ikera kai ma, cewu utumode iwai poro piji itogiwu, ii ikirimi boe puredukai ii amonitadoge epiji dukeje, emare Pao Aroe Eimejera o mode ema, imode inomeado apo Pao ai:

b: Jefté uture amonitadoge etogi turugoduwo ei, dukeje Icare Paore emagu iera kai.
source: Jefté uture amonitadoge etogi turugoduwo ei, dukeje Icare Paore emagu iera kai.

b: Ure tumorido ei jii Aroer piji jii Menit kae, bakurireuge ere ikera awubodure iwure awubodure, jii Abel-Carmim kae, tui ewidodu kuricigodo. Du kodire icare Israeldoge ere tumorido amonitadogei.
source: Ure tumorido ei jii Aroer piji jii Menit kae, bakurireuge ere ikera awubodure iwure awubodure, jii Abel-Carmim kae, tui ewidodu kuricigodo. Du kodire icare Israeldoge ere tumorido amonitadogei.

b: Jefté, ui tugirimi Mispa kejewu tuwai kae dukeje, onaregedu aredu uture togi tureru tabo. Onaregedu ui mito tu jedu, ia bokware piji.
source: Jefté, ui tugirimi Mispa kejewu tuwai kae dukeje, onaregedu aredu uture togi tureru tabo. Onaregedu ui mito tu jedu, ia bokware piji.

b: Tuiordui jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje toiogwari tabo ié! Itonaregedu, are iwo pegado! Aigoiare are imorora amagadudo ii, paga karega. Ire iwadaru maku Pao ai, iroiwakare iwo iwadaru kirimi tuibagi.
source: Tuiordui jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje toiogwari tabo ié! Itonaregedu, are iwo pegado! Aigoiare are imorora amagadudo ii, paga karega. Ire iwadaru maku Pao ai, iroiwakare iwo iwadaru kirimi tuibagi.

b: Emare akore oino ji ioga, are awadaru maku Pao ai dukeje, arodo ii aiabijiboe rekodaji, Paore tumorido onare aiwuge Amon orei akera tabo kodi.
source: Emare akore oino ji ioga, are awadaru maku Pao ai dukeje, arodo ii aiabijiboe rekodaji, Paore tumorido onare aiwuge Amon orei akera tabo kodi.

b: Du keje okwamagudure tuoji inogwa magudumode ai: imedage eko itabo torekaridoge etao kao, arimode pobe, itoragoduwo ikodui mai duji.
source: Du keje okwamagudure tuoji inogwa magudumode ai: imedage eko itabo torekaridoge etao kao, arimode pobe, itoragoduwo ikodui mai duji.

b: Akore oino ji toro! Icare ure utudo ari pobe dutabo. Kodure tumedage ebo torekaridoge etao kao, toragodui tugodui mai duji.
source: Akore oino ji toro! Icare ure utudo ari pobe dutabo. Kodure tumedage ebo torekaridoge etao kao, toragodui tugodui mai duji.

b: Arii pobedu akedu keje, ure tugirimi tuo uwai kae, dure ure tuwadaru maku Pao aidu towuje ji.
source: Arii pobedu akedu keje, ure tugirimi tuo uwai kae, dure ure tuwadaru maku Pao aidu towuje ji.

b: Nowu meri keje, ia Saraá kejewu ia imedure, Dan uwobe, iere Manué, oreduje ore bokware.
source: Nowu meri keje, ia Saraá kejewu ia imedure, Dan uwobe, iere Manué, oreduje ore bokware.

b: Pao o tupa ure tawadudo nowu aredu ai, akore ji icare ore bokwareudo nure aki, mare akuiarumode, akuributumode ia akonaregedu apo.
source: Pao o tupa ure tawadudo nowu aredu ai, akore ji icare ore bokwareudo nure aki, mare akuiarumode, akuributumode ia akonaregedu apo.

b: Du kodi Icare akodu kaba parera kuruce, ia kuru korirewu boece, akaba ia ake pegarewu kowuje; paga karega, akuiarumode, ia akonaregedu botumode, dure ia meriri o micigirewu umodukare ao kado; paga karega, nowu negedurogu makudumode Pao ai tuwodu otodai, umode Israeldoge etaru filisteodoge ekera piji.
source: Du kodi Icare akodu kaba parera kuruce, ia kuru korirewu boece, akaba ia ake pegarewu kowuje; paga karega, akuiarumode, ia akonaregedu botumode, dure ia meriri o micigirewu umodukare ao kado; paga karega, nowu negedurogu makudumode Pao ai tuwodu otodai, umode Israeldoge etaru filisteodoge ekera piji.

b: Icare nowu aredu ure toredu biie tagoi oino dutabo ia Pao apowu imedu aregodure iwogai, ure nono Pao o tupare, pemegaguragare. Inoragodukare ji kaiba kejewu ure ema duji, ukare iwie tugieji jamedu. Akore oino ii 'Akuiarumode, akuri butumode ia akonaregedu apo. Du kode, akudu kaba parera kuruce, ia kuru korireboe boece, akaba ia boe pegarewu ko; paga karega, nowu negedu rogu makudumode Pao ai botumodedu otodai jii tuwi kae.
source: Icare nowu aredu ure toredu biie tagoi oino dutabo ia Pao apowu imedu aregodure iwogai, ure nono Pao o tupare, pemegaguragare. Inoragodukare ji kaiba kejewu ure ema duji, ukare iwie tugieji jamedu. Akore oino ii 'Akuiarumode, akuri butumode ia akonaregedu apo. Du kode, akudu kaba parera kuruce, ia kuru korireboe boece, akaba ia boe pegarewu ko; paga karega, nowu negedu rogu makudumode Pao ai botumodedu otodai jii tuwi kae.

b: Icare nowu aredu kuri buture ia tonaregedu apo, dure ure iedo Sansão. Nowu negedurogu ricodure, Paore jiwo pemegado.
source: Icare nowu aredu kuri buture ia tonaregedu apo, dure ure iedo Sansão. Nowu negedurogu ricodure, Paore jiwo pemegado.

b: Pao utaroere tawadudo keje, Dan moto keje.
source: Pao utaroere tawadudo keje, Dan moto keje.

b: Nowu du kodi Pao akore oino Josueji awu piji, imode akurido Israeldoge eegai, ewo boe pa iragojei akabo, iragoje magai Moisés apo du reore duji. Aki amode Sacerdotedogedo boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu irá reko, akagoi ei oino dutabo: 'Tagaregodui Jordão po okwato dukeje, tawuredo nono'.
source: Nowu du kodi Pao akore oino Josueji awu piji, imode akurido Israeldoge eegai, ewo boe pa iragojei akabo, iragoje magai Moisés apo du reore duji. Aki amode Sacerdotedogedo boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu irá reko, akagoi ei oino dutabo: 'Tagaregodui Jordão po okwato dukeje, tawuredo nono'.

b: Icare Josué akore oino Israeldogei taburedo, tamearududo Tago Aroe Eimejera Bataruji.
source: Icare Josué akore oino Israeldogei taburedo, tamearududo Tago Aroe Eimejera Bataruji.

b: Du kejere akore oino pugeje oinore taerdumode Pao jerewu rakojei tadoda duji: umode Canaã kejewuge ewarigu tagoda piji.
source: Du kejere akore oino pugeje oinore taerdumode Pao jerewu rakojei tadoda duji: umode Canaã kejewuge ewarigu tagoda piji.

b: Icá, Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu ira umode pagado Jordão kajeje tagododai.
source: Icá, Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu ira umode pagado Jordão kajeje tagododai.

b: Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá rekowu sacerdotedoge emode tuwure tugu Jordão poto dukeje, pobo umode tugado puiato; aregodure cobugiwu pobo umode tuwuredo tui tudo pui dutabo.
source: Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá rekowu sacerdotedoge emode tuwure tugu Jordão poto dukeje, pobo umode tugado puiato; aregodure cobugiwu pobo umode tuwuredo tui tudo pui dutabo.

b: Dure karega, ere turagojedo tuwo pagado Jordão po kajeje dukeje, sacerdotedogere tugo etododai.
source: Dure karega, ere turagojedo tuwo pagado Jordão po kajeje dukeje, sacerdotedogere tugo etododai.

b: Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu irá rekowuge etaregodui Jordão po okwai dukeje, ewure pegoi pobo okwa keje dukeje (Jordão pore tumaedo togwa jamedu joki ere toe boe kado jiboe keje), pobore tuwuredo.
source: Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu irá rekowuge etaregodui Jordão po okwai dukeje, ewure pegoi pobo okwa keje dukeje (Jordão pore tumaedo togwa jamedu joki ere toe boe kado jiboe keje), pobore tuwuredo.

b: Aregodure cobugiboe pijiwu pobo ure tuwuredo, ure tudo puidu raicigore, Adam bakurirewu piji jii bakurirewu moto ri padure porugajejewu iei Sartã cedu kae.
source: Aregodure cobugiboe pijiwu pobo ure tuwuredo, ure tudo puidu raicigore, Adam bakurirewu piji jii bakurirewu moto ri padure porugajejewu iei Sartã cedu kae.

b: Ure turawuje pobo maerewu Sal meture kejewu towu pobo akedure pi tuku je.
source: Ure turawuje pobo maerewu Sal meture kejewu towu pobo akedure pi tuku je.

b: Icare nowu boe ere pagado Jericó bakurirewu otodai.
source: Icare nowu boe ere pagado Jericó bakurirewu otodai.

b: Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá rekowu sacerdotedoge ere tuwuredo turagoje tabo Jordão po kidu reia keje, Israeldoge eiamedu boe ei pagado tuwure kidu tabodu tonaji. Eedure nono jii boe eiamedu boe ei pagado du kae.
source: Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá rekowu sacerdotedoge ere tuwuredo turagoje tabo Jordão po kidu reia keje, Israeldoge eiamedu boe ei pagado tuwure kidu tabodu tonaji. Eedure nono jii boe eiamedu boe ei pagado du kae.

b: Nowu du kodi Pao akore oino Josueji awuji ire Egito kejewu boe erorerae barigu tabiji.
source: Nowu du kodi Pao akore oino Josueji awuji ire Egito kejewu boe erorerae barigu tabiji.

b: Israeldogere baado Gálgala keje, Nonore Icare, meri rekodu tabo, ere Páscoa towuje, ari kejewu merire ikera pudogidure buture iwure awubowuto pobe puibiji dukeje, Jericó boe boarewu keje.
source: Israeldogere baado Gálgala keje, Nonore Icare, meri rekodu tabo, ere Páscoa towuje, ari kejewu merire ikera pudogidure buture iwure awubowuto pobe puibiji dukeje, Jericó boe boarewu keje.

b: Páscoa rekodajiwu meri keje, ere nowu moto kejeboe kowuje: amirewu bari bari, trigo goridodu tabo.
source: Páscoa rekodajiwu meri keje, ere nowu moto kejeboe kowuje: amirewu bari bari, trigo goridodu tabo.

b: Rekodajiwu meri keje, enogwagei nowu moto kejeboe rekodaji, cewu 'maná' butukare pugeje Israeldoge etai; nowu joru piji, enogwagere Canaã moto kejeboeji.
source: Rekodajiwu meri keje, enogwagei nowu moto kejeboe rekodaji, cewu 'maná' butukare pugeje Israeldoge etai; nowu joru piji, enogwagere Canaã moto kejeboeji.

b: Nowu du kodi, Josuere ia altar towuje Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ai, Ebal boe aoporu aogeje, Pao utugare Moisés akoi Israeldogei durekodaji, padu magai Moisés o bapera atugo keje.
source: Nowu du kodi, Josuere ia altar towuje Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ai, Ebal boe aoporu aogeje, Pao utugare Moisés akoi Israeldogei durekodaji, padu magai Moisés o bapera atugo keje.

b: Nowu altar keje, ure to mea maku Pao Aroe Eimejera ai ro pemegarewu jipagi.
source: Nowu altar keje, ure to mea maku Pao Aroe Eimejera ai ro pemegarewu jipagi.

b: Nonore Icare Josuére Moisés o boe eroiagudu atugodo ia tori keje, Israel ore eegai.
source: Nonore Icare Josuére Moisés o boe eroiagudu atugodo ia tori keje, Israel ore eegai.

b: Israeldoge eiamedu boe, codureuge, tugobaigarege, boe jetororewu epage eragojere nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu jeke keje puibiji, Pao burejoiage eegai, levitadoge eegai, duwugere enoredure Pao o irá pemegarewu tabo.
source: Israeldoge eiamedu boe, codureuge, tugobaigarege, boe jetororewu epage eragojere nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu jeke keje puibiji, Pao burejoiage eegai, levitadoge eegai, duwugere enoredure Pao o irá pemegarewu tabo.

b: Ia moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eragojere nono Israeldoge ebo; iage eragojere taiwo tabo Gerizim aoporu jaogwai, iage eragojere taiwo tabo Ebal aoporu jaogwai, oinore Pao utugare Moisés akore boe eroiagu, tuwo togwami boe eiogi.
source: Ia moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eragojere nono Israeldoge ebo; iage eragojere taiwo tabo Gerizim aoporu jaogwai, iage eragojere taiwo tabo Ebal aoporu jaogwai, oinore Pao utugare Moisés akore boe eroiagu, tuwo togwami boe eiogi.

b: Nowu inodu rekodaji Josué makore nowu boe eroiagudu padui bapera kejedu jamedu boeji, boe eiwo pemegareuji, boe eiwo pegareuji, padu magai nowu mugure bapera kejewu boe eroiagudu kejedu reore.
source: Nowu inodu rekodaji Josué makore nowu boe eroiagudu padui bapera kejedu jamedu boeji, boe eiwo pemegareuji, boe eiwo pegareuji, padu magai nowu mugure bapera kejewu boe eroiagudu kejedu reore.

b: Josué makore Moisés ui boe eroiagudu jamedu boeji Israeldoge eiamedu boe ewiagai, areme, boe etore, moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eragojere nono ebodu ewiegai jamedu.
source: Josué makore Moisés ui boe eroiagudu jamedu boeji Israeldoge eiamedu boe ewiagai, areme, boe etore, moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eragojere nono ebodu ewiegai jamedu.

b: Nowu dukeje, Josuere Israel uwobe epadui pumekejedu eto pui Siquém keje, makore codureuge, boe eimejerage, ure tugogado boeiwuge, aiwore boeiwuge, ewogai, duwugere etaregodure Pao jekae.
source: Nowu dukeje, Josuere Israel uwobe epadui pumekejedu eto pui Siquém keje, makore codureuge, boe eimejerage, ure tugogado boeiwuge, aiwore boeiwuge, ewogai, duwugere etaregodure Pao jekae.

b: Icare Josué akore boe eiamedu boe ji oinore Pao Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera akore taomagere, Abrão Nakormage etuo iei Taré cedu reore, eedure marigudu pobo okwa bakowu keje, ere tubujodo ia aroe eimejeragei.
source: Icare Josué akore boe eiamedu boe ji oinore Pao Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera akore taomagere, Abrão Nakormage etuo iei Taré cedu reore, eedure marigudu pobo okwa bakowu keje, ere tubujodo ia aroe eimejeragei.

b: Mare ire tao Abraão tawuje pobo okwa bakowu piji, ire reko Canaã kejewu moto jamedu boe kajeje, ire rekodajiwuge emagaguragado.
source: Mare ire tao Abraão tawuje pobo okwa bakowu piji, ire reko Canaã kejewu moto jamedu boe kajeje, ire rekodajiwuge emagaguragado.

b: Ire Isaac maku ai, ire Jacó mare Esaú maku Isaac ai. Ire Seir torekari maku Esaú ai, Jacoi turawuje Egito kae tore ebo du tonaji.
source: Ire Isaac maku ai, ire Jacó mare Esaú maku Isaac ai. Ire Seir torekari maku Esaú ai, Jacoi turawuje Egito kae tore ebo du tonaji.

b: Du keje Icare ire Moisés Aarão mage erojai, ire Egito kejewuge etogorido, iro rakarewu tuginoiwu boe tabo. Ire tado tadawuje nowu moto piji.
source: Du keje Icare ire Moisés Aarão mage erojai, ire Egito kejewuge etogorido, iro rakarewu tuginoiwu boe tabo. Ire tado tadawuje nowu moto piji.

b: Mare taomage etaregodui pobo maerewu okwa kae dukeje, Egito kejewuge eregodure eregodaji to imarido boe tabo, kowarudoge ewugejewuge ebo, jii Pobo Kujagu maerewu kae.
source: Mare taomage etaregodui pobo maerewu okwa kae dukeje, Egito kejewuge eregodure eregodaji to imarido boe tabo, kowarudoge ewugejewuge ebo, jii Pobo Kujagu maerewu kae.

b: Emagore iwogai ire taedudo Egito kejewuge epiji, ii boetugu mugudo tagoiadoda dutabo. Ire pobo maerewu barigu eiogi, dure ure ekowuje.
source: Emagore iwogai ire taedudo Egito kejewuge epiji, ii boetugu mugudo tagoiadoda dutabo. Ire pobo maerewu barigu eiogi, dure ure ekowuje.

b: Taerdure taeku tabo iroi Egito keje duji, durekodaji tamugu raicigore boe makodu tada.
source: Taerdure taeku tabo iroi Egito keje duji, durekodaji tamugu raicigore boe makodu tada.

b: Ire tarego amorreudoge emugui Jordão bakowu kejedu eno moto kae. Erugodure tai, mare ire emagu tagera kai, tare tamugudo eno moto keje, ire eeda kedodo tagododai.
source: Ire tarego amorreudoge emugui Jordão bakowu kejedu eno moto kae. Erugodure tai, mare ire emagu tagera kai, tare tamugudo eno moto keje, ire eeda kedodo tagododai.

b: Moab kejewuge eimejera Balac, Sefor onaregedu, ure turagojedo jamedu, rugodure Israeldogei, makore Beor naregedu Balaão bogai uwo eiwo pegado du bogai.
source: Moab kejewuge eimejera Balac, Sefor onaregedu, ure turagojedo jamedu, rugodure Israeldogei, makore Beor naregedu Balaão bogai uwo eiwo pegado du bogai.

b: Mare imi itaidukare iwiapagawo bataruji, du kodire Icare ure tuwadaru pemegarewu bu tawugeje, ire taginorudo iera piji.
source: Mare imi itaidukare iwiapagawo bataruji, du kodire Icare ure tuwadaru pemegarewu bu tawugeje, ire taginorudo iera piji.

b: Tai tawu Jordão kajeje dukeje, tagaregodui Jericó kae dukeje, nowu bakurirewu kejewuge erugodure tai, durekodaji, amorreudoge, ferezeudoge, cananeudoge, hititadoge, gergeseudoge, heveudoge, jebuseudoge, erugodure tai jamedu, mare ire emagu tagera kai.
source: Tai tawu Jordão kajeje dukeje, tagaregodui Jericó kae dukeje, nowu bakurirewu kejewuge erugodure tai, durekodaji, amorreudoge, ferezeudoge, cananeudoge, hititadoge, gergeseudoge, heveudoge, jebuseudoge, erugodure tai jamedu, mare ire emagu tagera kai.

b: Ire atuge etudo tagododai duwugere tuiodo nowu boe ewugeje tabiji, amorreudoge eimejerage ei pobedu ewugeje jamedu, tago tariga rairewu bokwa tabo, tawaiga bokwa tabo.
source: Ire atuge etudo tagododai duwugere tuiodo nowu boe ewugeje tabiji, amorreudoge eimejerage ei pobedu ewugeje jamedu, tago tariga rairewu bokwa tabo, tawaiga bokwa tabo.

b: Oinore ire tamaragodukare jiwu moto maku tagai, ire tamugudo takare towujewu bakurireuge etada, tagogwagere takare tuguwu parera iguru kurodu boeji, oliveira iguru kurodu boeji.
source: Oinore ire tamaragodukare jiwu moto maku tagai, ire tamugudo takare towujewu bakurireuge etada, tagogwagere takare tuguwu parera iguru kurodu boeji, oliveira iguru kurodu boeji.

b: Nowu kodi, Josué akore boe eiamedu boe ji tabagududo Paoce, tawiapagado ji tawabo pemegarewu jetororewu tabo. Taomage ewiapagare jiwu pobo bakowu keje, Egito keje, aroe eimejerage pagapagawuge ewarigu tabiji, tawiapagado tu Pao ji.
source: Nowu kodi, Josué akore boe eiamedu boe ji tabagududo Paoce, tawiapagado ji tawabo pemegarewu jetororewu tabo. Taomage ewiapagare jiwu pobo bakowu keje, Egito keje, aroe eimejerage pagapagawuge ewarigu tabiji, tawiapagado tu Pao ji.

b: Mare taerdu pegamode tawiapagawo Pao ji ma, tawiapagado toro iage ewogai awuji; taomage ewiapagare jiwu pobo okwa bakowu kejewuge ewogai rakudu, iarema amorreudoge eno aroe eimejerage ewogai, duwuge eno moto keje taedure. Imirema, iwobe ebo, cewiapagamode Pao Aroe Eimejera ji.
source: Mare taerdu pegamode tawiapagawo Pao ji ma, tawiapagado toro iage ewogai awuji; taomage ewiapagare jiwu pobo okwa bakowu kejewuge ewogai rakudu, iarema amorreudoge eno aroe eimejerage ewogai, duwuge eno moto keje taedure. Imirema, iwobe ebo, cewiapagamode Pao Aroe Eimejera ji.

b: Icare boe egore cemearudaei cewo cegera ra Pao pijidu, mugu jaedo cebiji; mare Aroe Eimejerare pago Aroe Eimejera rema; ure cegi, ceomage cedawuje Egito moto piji, boe erorerui cei dupiji; ure turo kurirewu towuje ceegai, aiwore cegodure kejewu awara jamedu boe keje, cegodui boe eiamedu boe ekori dutabo.
source: Icare boe egore cemearudaei cewo cegera ra Pao pijidu, mugu jaedo cebiji; mare Aroe Eimejerare pago Aroe Eimejera rema; ure cegi, ceomage cedawuje Egito moto piji, boe erorerui cei dupiji; ure turo kurirewu towuje ceegai, aiwore cegodure kejewu awara jamedu boe keje, cegodui boe eiamedu boe ekori dutabo.

b: Paore boe epadui pumekejewu boe eiamedu boe ewarigu cegoda piji, mugure awu moto kejewu amorreudoge jamedu.
source: Paore boe epadui pumekejewu boe eiamedu boe ewarigu cegoda piji, mugure awu moto kejewu amorreudoge jamedu.

b: Du kodi Icare, cegi jamedu cewiapagamode Pao ji, ceno Aroe Eimejera nure ema kodi.
source: Du kodi Icare, cegi jamedu cewiapagamode Pao ji, ceno Aroe Eimejera nure ema kodi.

b: Josué akore oino boe ji taroiwa modukare tawiapagawo Pao ji; paga karega, Aroe Eimejera pemegarewu nure ema, joku iru barikare kodi. Umodukare tu je, tai taboru barigu ji taro pegarewu tabo.
source: Josué akore oino boe ji taroiwa modukare tawiapagawo Pao ji; paga karega, Aroe Eimejera pemegarewu nure ema, joku iru barikare kodi. Umodukare tu je, tai taboru barigu ji taro pegarewu tabo.

b: Tamode tagera ra Pao piji ma, tawiapagamode ia aroe eimejerage pagapagawuge ei ma, umode tugirimi tuibagi, Icare, ro pemegai tai durekodaji, ro pegamode tai, umode taeda kedodo.
source: Tamode tagera ra Pao piji ma, tawiapagamode ia aroe eimejerage pagapagawuge ei ma, umode tugirimi tuibagi, Icare, ro pemegai tai durekodaji, ro pegamode tai, umode taeda kedodo.

b: Mare boe egore oino Josueji boro! Cewiapagamode Pao ji!
source: Mare boe egore oino Josueji boro! Cewiapagamode Pao ji!

b: Josué akore oino boe ji tamearudure pu akoinoduji, tai tageragu Pao ji, tawiapagawo tu ji.
source: Josué akore oino boe ji tamearudure pu akoinoduji, tai tageragu Pao ji, tawiapagawo tu ji.

b: Egore cewiapagare pu akoino duji.
source: Egore cewiapagare pu akoino duji.

b: Icare Josué akore kode, aroe eimejerage tuginoiwuge ewarigu tabiji, tawabodo tuiekirimi Pao Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ji.
source: Icare Josué akore kode, aroe eimejerage tuginoiwuge ewarigu tabiji, tawabodo tuiekirimi Pao Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ji.

b: Boe egore oino Josueji cewiapagamode ceno Aroe Eimejera ji, ceromode nono bataru rekodaji.
source: Boe egore oino Josueji cewiapagamode ceno Aroe Eimejera ji, ceromode nono bataru rekodaji.

b: Oinore nowu meri keje, Josuere tuwadaru maku tuwobe etai Siquém keje, tui boe eroiagudu maku etai dutabo.
source: Oinore nowu meri keje, Josuere tuwadaru maku tuwobe etai Siquém keje, tui boe eroiagudu maku etai dutabo.

b: Ure nowu inodu jamedu bu Pao o boe eroiagudu padure kejewu bapera keje. Du kejere, ure tugeragu ia tori kurireuji, ure rakojedo nono, mugure makudure Pao aiwu moto kejewu carvalho i kuda.
source: Ure nowu inodu jamedu bu Pao o boe eroiagudu padure kejewu bapera keje. Du kejere, ure tugeragu ia tori kurireuji, ure rakojedo nono, mugure makudure Pao aiwu moto kejewu carvalho i kuda.

b: Icare makore oino boe eiamedu boe ji awu tori mugumode woe pamagai pawadaru maku puai du reore; paga karega, mearudure Pao akoi paidu jamedu boeji. Emare okituwamode tai, takawo tagera ra Pao Aroe Eimejera piji.
source: Icare makore oino boe eiamedu boe ji awu tori mugumode woe pamagai pawadaru maku puai du reore; paga karega, mearudure Pao akoi paidu jamedu boeji. Emare okituwamode tai, takawo tagera ra Pao Aroe Eimejera piji.

b: Du rekodaji Josué imadure boe ji, eture tu tu tumugurewo boe kae.
source: Du rekodaji Josué imadure boe ji, eture tu tu tumugurewo boe kae.

b: Nowu inodu rekodaji, Josué, Nun onaregedu, Pao utugare, bire to jorui 1 0 cedu keje.
source: Nowu inodu rekodaji, Josué, Nun onaregedu, Pao utugare, bire to jorui 1 0 cedu keje.

b: Paoi tuiagu Elias reko ia managadodu tabo baruto dukeje, Elias uture Galgala piji, Eliseu apo.
source: Paoi tuiagu Elias reko ia managadodu tabo baruto dukeje, Elias uture Galgala piji, Eliseu apo.

b: Etaregodui Jericó kae dukeje, Elias akore oino Eliseu ji aragojedo tu woe, Pao nure itudo Jordão kae kodi. Mare Eliseu akore oino aroe Eimejera koia, akaroe koia, imodukare iwuredo apiji. Du kodi Icare, ei pobedu, eture.
source: Etaregodui Jericó kae dukeje, Elias akore oino Eliseu ji aragojedo tu woe, Pao nure itudo Jordão kae kodi. Mare Eliseu akore oino aroe Eimejera koia, akaroe koia, imodukare iwuredo apiji. Du kodi Icare, ei pobedu, eture.

b: Ia etugarege ei 50 cedu, ekodure jamedu ere tuburedo eegai, eedui Jordão okwa bakowu keje dutabo.
source: Ia etugarege ei 50 cedu, ekodure jamedu ere tuburedo eegai, eedui Jordão okwa bakowu keje dutabo.

b: Du keje icare Eliare tugeragu tugudae aogejewu, ure oreado, ure to poboji, ure toiado pubiji, dutabore ei pobedu ere pagado tuwure tabo moto kiji.
source: Du keje icare Eliare tugeragu tugudae aogejewu, ure oreado, ure to poboji, ure toiado pubiji, dutabore ei pobedu ere pagado tuwure tabo moto kiji.

b: Ere pagado bakowuto dukeje, Elias akore oino Eliseu ji akogwamagududo ii akaidure jiboe bogai, iregodudodumode apiji duotodai. Eliseu akore oino itaroedo akaroe reore pobe.
source: Ere pagado bakowuto dukeje, Elias akore oino Eliseu ji akogwamagududo ii akaidure jiboe bogai, iregodudodumode apiji duotodai. Eliseu akore oino itaroedo akaroe reore pobe.

b: Elias akore akogwamagudure ii boe biarewu bogai. Mare iregodudodumode apiji, aerdumode ii dukeje, makudumode akai. Aerdumodukare ii dukeje, makudu modukare akai.
source: Elias akore akogwamagudure ii boe biarewu bogai. Mare iregodudodumode apiji, aerdumode ii dukeje, makudumode akai. Aerdumodukare ii dukeje, makudu modukare akai.

b: Ekodure awaraji tumagoi pui dutabore Icare ia jorui nono imarido cedu reoredu, kawarudogei tumugudo kejedu, ure ewarigu pubiji, Icare Elias ruture baruto ia managadodu tada.
source: Ekodure awaraji tumagoi pui dutabore Icare ia jorui nono imarido cedu reoredu, kawarudogei tumugudo kejedu, ure ewarigu pubiji, Icare Elias ruture baruto ia managadodu tada.

b: Eliseu aiwore rekodaji toiogwari tabo ioga, ioga! Israeldoge eno imarido, eegu kawarudoge!
source: Eliseu aiwore rekodaji toiogwari tabo ioga, ioga! Israeldoge eno imarido, eegu kawarudoge!

b: Tuiordukare jitu rekodaji, ure tugeragu tugudaeji, tui tumugudo taci keje, ure bowuje puibiji; durekodaji, ure tugeragu buture Elias pijiwu aroia ogejewuji, ure tugirimi Jordão okwato.
source: Tuiordukare jitu rekodaji, ure tugeragu tugudaeji, tui tumugudo taci keje, ure bowuje puibiji; durekodaji, ure tugeragu buture Elias pijiwu aroia ogejewuji, ure tugirimi Jordão okwato.

b: Ure tugeragu nowu buture Elias kanaora pijiwu aroiaji, ure to poboji, tagoi oino dutabo kaiba Elias o Aroe Eimejera rakojere. Ema jamedu, ure to poboji, pobore tugado puiato, Icare Eliseu ure pagado.
source: Ure tugeragu nowu buture Elias kanaora pijiwu aroiaji, ure to poboji, tagoi oino dutabo kaiba Elias o Aroe Eimejera rakojere. Ema jamedu, ure to poboji, pobore tugado puiato, Icare Eliseu ure pagado.

b: Ia meri keje, Eliseu kodure Sunam kori. Ia aredu oroe kuricigoreudo mugure nono, duwudo makore ji okwagewo tuwai keje. Kodu kodui nowu kori dukeje, ure tuwure tuwuredo togwagewo nono.
source: Ia meri keje, Eliseu kodure Sunam kori. Ia aredu oroe kuricigoreudo mugure nono, duwudo makore ji okwagewo tuwai keje. Kodu kodui nowu kori dukeje, ure tuwure tuwuredo togwagewo nono.

b: Nowu aredu akore oino toreduji awu aregodu aregodure woe pawai kaewu imedu ire boe pa Pao bure joia iure ema duji.
source: Nowu aredu akore oino toreduji awu aregodu aregodure woe pawai kaewu imedu ire boe pa Pao bure joia iure ema duji.

b: Kode, pawo ia bairogu to pawai aogeje, pawo ia kamorewu, ia ira rogu, ia muga ira, ia jorugu bu tada, uwo tamudo tugodui woe pagori dukeje.
source: Kode, pawo ia bairogu to pawai aogeje, pawo ia kamorewu, ia ira rogu, ia muga ira, ia jorugu bu tada, uwo tamudo tugodui woe pagori dukeje.

b: Ia meri keje, tugodui ekori dukeje, Eliseu ure turemo nowu bai roguto tuwo tamudo.
source: Ia meri keje, tugodui ekori dukeje, Eliseu ure turemo nowu bai roguto tuwo tamudo.

b: Icare akore oino tudugare Gieziji inoba iromode ji? Icare Giezi akore ji ore bokwa, oredu codugodure.
source: Icare akore oino tudugare Gieziji inoba iromode ji? Icare Giezi akore ji ore bokwa, oredu codugodure.

b: Eliseu akore ji amagodo bogai. Makore bogai. Aregodure baiporo kae.
source: Eliseu akore ji amagodo bogai. Makore bogai. Aregodure baiporo kae.

b: Eliseu akore oino ji ia joru aregodumode dukeje, ia akonaregedu rogu mugumode akana keje.
source: Eliseu akore oino ji ia joru aregodumode dukeje, ia akonaregedu rogu mugumode akana keje.

b: Ia meri keje, sunamita onaregedu uture tuo rakojere ure trigo kadowuge ebo du kae.
source: Ia meri keje, sunamita onaregedu uture tuo rakojere ure trigo kadowuge ebo du kae.

b: Akore oino ji ié itaora! Ié itaora! Icare uo akore oino ia tudugareji reko tuje bogai!
source: Akore oino ji ié itaora! Ié itaora! Icare uo akore oino ia tudugareji reko tuje bogai!

b: Ure tugeragu ji, ure reko uce bogai, duwudo ure mugudo tubogora keje jii meri brae etaiadoda, dukeje bire.
source: Ure tugeragu ji, ure reko uce bogai, duwudo ure mugudo tubogora keje jii meri brae etaiadoda, dukeje bire.

b: Icare ruture apo ure bu profeta Eliseu pa keje, ure baiporo mi, uture piji.
source: Icare ruture apo ure bu profeta Eliseu pa keje, ure baiporo mi, uture piji.

b: Icare Elias, taregodui tuwai kae dukeje, jorudure nowu negedurogu biji, padui tuba keje duji.
source: Icare Elias, taregodui tuwai kae dukeje, jorudure nowu negedurogu biji, padui tuba keje duji.

b: Ure turemo, ure baiporo mi, pudui, nowu negedurogu apo, Icare okwamagudure Aroe Eimejera ji.
source: Ure turemo, ure baiporo mi, pudui, nowu negedurogu apo, Icare okwamagudure Aroe Eimejera ji.

b: Ruture tuba kae, ure tuwu nowu negedrogu keje, ore togwa bu okwa keje, ure tuioku bu joku keje, ure tugera bu iera keje, tubadui keje dutabo, dutabore nowu negedrogu kodu urugodure.
source: Ruture tuba kae, ure tuwu nowu negedrogu keje, ore togwa bu okwa keje, ure tuioku bu joku keje, ure tugera bu iera keje, tubadui keje dutabo, dutabore nowu negedrogu kodu urugodure.

b: Du keje Icare merure jice woje jice woje tuwai tada; dukeje Icare ruture pugeje, ure tuwu negedrogu keje. Awure Icare ure tuia barido ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, ure tuioku jado.
source: Du keje Icare merure jice woje jice woje tuwai tada; dukeje Icare ruture pugeje, ure tuwu negedrogu keje. Awure Icare ure tuia barido ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, ure tuioku jado.

b: Icare Eliseu makore utugare Giezi bogai, akore ji amagodo sunamita bogai. Icare Giezi makore bogai. Aregodui pudae dukeje, Eliseu makore oino ji akeragu akonaregeduji.
source: Icare Eliseu makore utugare Giezi bogai, akore ji amagodo sunamita bogai. Icare Giezi makore bogai. Aregodui pudae dukeje, Eliseu makore oino ji akeragu akonaregeduji.

b: Ure turemo, buture bure paru, tuie jodo jii mototo, Icare ure tugeragu tonaregeduji, ure tuiebu.
source: Ure turemo, buture bure paru, tuie jodo jii mototo, Icare ure tugeragu tonaregeduji, ure tuiebu.

b: Nowu du kodi, Baal-Salisa kejewu ia imedu aregodure, unure to boepa pijiboe boetojiwu ui amireudo emadu arego tugodorabo tada Pao utugare Eliseu bogai: trigo maiwu, cevada maiwu amireure ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure du reorere.
source: Nowu du kodi, Baal-Salisa kejewu ia imedu aregodure, unure to boepa pijiboe boetojiwu ui amireudo emadu arego tugodorabo tada Pao utugare Eliseu bogai: trigo maiwu, cevada maiwu amireure ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure du reorere.

b: Eliseu akore oino ji maku boe etai ewo kowuje.
source: Eliseu akore oino ji maku boe etai ewo kowuje.

b: Mare nowu imedu akore oino ji inoba iromode iwo maku umodukai turugadu boe ji dutabo? Eliseu akore ji pemega pugeje.
source: Mare nowu imedu akore oino ji inoba iromode iwo maku umodukai turugadu boe ji dutabo? Eliseu akore ji pemega pugeje.

b: Maku boe etai ewo kowuje; paga karega, oinore Pao akore emode kowuje, jetumode tuiageje kimo'.
source: Maku boe etai ewo kowuje; paga karega, oinore Pao akore emode kowuje, jetumode tuiageje kimo'.

b: Icare nowu imedu ure pedo boe etai; jeture tuiageje kimo, Pao bataru rekodaji.
source: Icare nowu imedu ure pedo boe etai; jeture tuiageje kimo, Pao bataru rekodaji.

b: Nowu du kodi, Síria kejewu brae eimejera o tugobaigarege eimejera Naaman, boe eerdu pemegare jiwu imedu, ukimejera rokare kara kara ia bataru keje, paga karega, iera tabore Paore Síria kejewuge einorudo. Mare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ro rakarewu, pagudu bokwarewu, moci baare ji.
source: Nowu du kodi, Síria kejewu brae eimejera o tugobaigarege eimejera Naaman, boe eerdu pemegare jiwu imedu, ukimejera rokare kara kara ia bataru keje, paga karega, iera tabore Paore Síria kejewuge einorudo. Mare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ro rakarewu, pagudu bokwarewu, moci baare ji.

b: Boekarema, ia arameudoge etaregodui Síria pijidu, erade ia Israel pijiwu ia nogwaredu rogu arego pudabo, duwudore maragodure Naaman oreduje ai.
source: Boekarema, ia arameudoge etaregodui Síria pijidu, erade ia Israel pijiwu ia nogwaredu rogu arego pudabo, duwudore maragodure Naaman oreduje ai.

b: Duwudo akore oino tugimejeragoji uia turugadu ikimejera utuwo Samaria kejewu profeta ae. Ia dukeje umode moci barigu piji.
source: Duwudo akore oino tugimejeragoji uia turugadu ikimejera utuwo Samaria kejewu profeta ae. Ia dukeje umode moci barigu piji.

b: Icare Naaman readodure inoduji tugimejera brae eimejera biegai, akore ji oinore Israel kejewu nogwaredurogu akore.
source: Icare Naaman readodure inoduji tugimejera brae eimejera biegai, akore ji oinore Israel kejewu nogwaredurogu akore.

b: Du kodi Icare Síria kejewu brae eimejera akore ji u! Atudo toro. Imode bapera atugodo Israeldoge eimejera bogai. Naaman uture meriri kigadurewu mori kuricigorewu ui tugera pudogidu reore dutabo, meriri ekurewu ui 6. 0 cedu tabo, boe ekudae mori kuricigorewu ui ikera pudogidure dutabo.
source: Du kodi Icare Síria kejewu brae eimejera akore ji u! Atudo toro. Imode bapera atugodo Israeldoge eimejera bogai. Naaman uture meriri kigadurewu mori kuricigorewu ui tugera pudogidu reore dutabo, meriri ekurewu ui 6. 0 cedu tabo, boe ekudae mori kuricigorewu ui ikera pudogidure dutabo.

b: Ure bapera atugo maku Israeldoge eimejera ai, akoi oino dutabo ire itugare Naaman utudo awogai awu bapera atugo tabo, awo moci barigu piji.
source: Ure bapera atugo maku Israeldoge eimejera ai, akoi oino dutabo ire itugare Naaman utudo awogai awu bapera atugo tabo, awo moci barigu piji.

b: Israeldoge eimejera, tumagoi nowu bapera jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje, akore oino aroe Eimejera kana ure imi, iwo boe eedo, iwo boe ewogwado, uwo iaboe etudo iwogai iwo moci barigu pijidu bogai? Taerdu nure aidui turugoduwo ii duji!
source: Israeldoge eimejera, tumagoi nowu bapera jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje, akore oino aroe Eimejera kana ure imi, iwo boe eedo, iwo boe ewogwado, uwo iaboe etudo iwogai iwo moci barigu pijidu bogai? Taerdu nure aidui turugoduwo ii duji!

b: Pao utugare Eliseu, tumearudui israeldoge eimejera ui tugudae bowuje dukeje, ure ia boe emagodo nowu brae eimejeraji kodiba are akudae bowuje? Utudo iwogai, jorduwawo ia profetaie ure Israeldoge etada duji.
source: Pao utugare Eliseu, tumearudui israeldoge eimejera ui tugudae bowuje dukeje, ure ia boe emagodo nowu brae eimejeraji kodiba are akudae bowuje? Utudo iwogai, jorduwawo ia profetaie ure Israeldoge etada duji.

b: Icare Naaman aregodure tagu kowarudoge ebo, to imarido tabo, ure tuwuredo Eliseu uwaiporo keje.
source: Icare Naaman aregodure tagu kowarudoge ebo, to imarido tabo, ure tuwuredo Eliseu uwaiporo keje.
